result.text: The Göttinger Verkehrsbetriebe GmbH (GöVB) is a municipal transport company 100% owned by the City of Göttingen. It operates local public transport in the city of Göttingen and adjacent regions and ensures the daily mobility of residents and guests with its bus fleet. As a sectoral contracting authority within the meaning of § 100 of the Act against Restraints of Competition (GWB), GöVB is responsible for the procurement of services and systems that secure the operation and further development of local public transport. GöVB pursues the goal of gradually converting its bus fleet to alternative, in particular electric, drive systems. In doing so, it makes a significant contribution to sustainable mobility, the reduction of emissions, and the achievement of the climate targets of the City of Göttingen. The expansion of the e-bus fleet is accompanied by a considerable need for modern charging infrastructure that enables efficient, reliable, and economical operational management. To support this transformation, GöVB is planning the introduction of a charging and load management system (LLEMS). This system is intended to enable intelligent control and monitoring of all charging processes at the depot and, in the future, also in scheduled service. The focus is on ensuring vehicle availability, grid and load optimisation, and the safe and economical operation of electromobility in local public transport in Göttingen.

parts.source: Die Göttinger Verkehrsbetriebe GmbH (GöVB) ist ein kommunales Verkehrsunternehmen in 100%iger Trägerschaft der Stadt Göttingen. Sie betreibt den öffentlichen Personennahverkehr in der Stadt Göttingen und angrenzenden Regionen und gewährleistet mit ihrer Busflotte die tägliche Mobilität von Einwohnerinnen, Einwohnern und Gästen. Als Sektorenauftraggeber im Sinne von § 100 GWB ist die GöVB für die Beschaffung von Leistungen und Systemen verantwortlich, die den Betrieb und die Weiterentwicklung des ÖPNV sichern. Die GöVB verfolgt das Ziel, ihre Busflotte schrittweise auf alternative, insbesondere elektrische Antriebe umzustellen. Damit leistet sie einen wesentlichen Beitrag zur nachhaltigen Mobilität, zur Reduktion von Emissionen und zur Erreichung der Klimaziele der Stadt Göttingen. Mit dem Ausbau der E-Bus-Flotte geht ein erheblicher Bedarf an moderner Ladeinfrastruktur einher, die ein effizientes, zuverlässiges und wirtschaftliches Betriebsmanagement ermöglicht. Zur Unterstützung dieser Transformation plant die GöVB die Einführung eines Lade- und Lastmanagementsystems (LLEMS). Dieses System soll eine intelligente Steuerung und Überwachung aller Ladeprozesse auf dem Betriebshof und perspektivisch auch im Linienbetrieb ermöglichen. Im Mittelpunkt stehen die Gewährleistung der Fahrzeugverfügbarkeit, die Netz- und Lastoptimierung sowie der sichere und wirtschaftliche Betrieb der Elektromobilität im ÖPNV Göttingen.

result.text: The aim of the tender is to procure a powerful, scalable and user-friendly software solution that supports the contracting authority in efficient, quality-assured and data protection-compliant translation in customer contact. The contracting authority shall conclude a framework agreement with the contractor regarding the provision and management service of licences for cloud-based translation software - text/document translation and conversation mode/voice - over a period of 2 years and the option of extension by 2 x one further year. The aim of the tender is to procure a powerful, scalable and user-friendly software solution that supports the efficient, quality-assured and data protection-compliant translation of scientific, administrative and technical content. The solution must be suitable both for automated translations and for the integration of human translation services and, in particular, meet the requirements for multilingualism in customer communication. In addition, the subject matter of the contract includes the provision of a central licence and user administration service as well as the provision of support and maintenance services over the entire term of the framework agreement. The translation software to be offered must be provided as a cloud-based solution. Local installation on servers or end devices of the respective contracting authority is not planned and will not be accepted. An app is provided for mobile Apple end devices. The software must be usable via web-based access (e.g. via a common internet browser). The minimum requirements are specified in the service description.

parts.source: Ziel der Ausschreibung ist die Beschaffung einer leistungsfähigen, skalierbaren und benutzerfreundlichen Softwarelösung, die die Auftraggeberin bei der effizienten, qualitätsgesicherten und datenschutzkonformen Übersetzung im Kundenkontakt unterstützt. Die Auftraggeberin schließt mit dem Auftragnehmer eine Rahmenvereinbarung über die Überlassung und den Management Service von Lizenzen einer cloudbasierten Übersetzungssoftware - Text-/Dokumentenübersetzung und Konversationsmodus/Voice - über einen Zeitraum von 2 Jahren und der Option der Verlängerung um 2 x ein weiteres Jahr ab. Ziel der Ausschreibung ist die Beschaffung einer leistungsfähigen, skalierbaren und benutzerfreundlichen Softwarelösung, die bei der effizienten, qualitätsgesicherten und datenschutzkonformen Übersetzung wissenschaftlicher, administrativer und technischer Inhalte unterstützt. Die Lösung muss sowohl für automatisierte Übersetzungen als auch für die Einbindung menschlicher Übersetzungsleistungen geeignet sein und insbesondere den Anforderungen an Mehrsprachigkeit in der Kunden-Kommunikation gerecht werden. Darüber hinaus umfasst der Leistungsgegenstand die Bereitstellung eines zentralen Lizenz- und Benutzerverwaltungsdienstes sowie die Erbringung von Support- und Wartungsleistungen über die gesamte Laufzeit des Rahmenvertrags. Die anzubietende Übersetzungssoftware muss als cloudbasierte Lösung bereitgestellt werden. Eine lokale Installation auf Servern oder Endgeräten des jeweiligen Auftraggebers ist nicht vorgesehen und wird nicht akzeptiert. Für mobile Apple Endgeräte wird eine App bereitgestellt. result.text: The subject of the procedure is the conclusion of framework agreements with several companies for the provision, introduction, operation, maintenance and further development of a network management system for low voltage (hereinafter NMS). The scope of services is described in full in the service description (Annex 03). General requirements. Overarching requirements for the NMS, in particular regarding architecture, data storage, interfaces, information security, scalability, as well as integration into the existing system and process landscape of the eligible company. Functional scope 1: Calculable low-voltage network model (digital twin) including integration into ERP, GIS and EDM systems as well as mapping of actual and target switching states. Functional scope 2: Integration of measurement data from local network stations and TAF values, network calculation, determination of network status as well as controllability checks. Functional scope 3: Network-oriented control in accordance with § 14a EnWG and § 9 EEG including verification and documentation. Extended functional scope: Network calculation for network planning, automated network connection testing as well as redispatch 2.0 and prospectively redispatch 3.0. The Thüga Aktiengesellschaft is procuring as a central purchasing body in accordance with § 4a SektVO in the name and on behalf of the participating affiliated companies (currently around 100 companies of the Thüga Group). On the basis of the contract terms negotiated in the procedure, the individual participating companies will conclude individual framework agreements based on the EVB-IT contracts.

result.text: The NSF State and Regional AI Infrastructure Hubs program aims to expand access to the compute required for AI-enabled scientific discovery and to transform the research, education, and training opportunities offered by institutions of higher education. AI Infrastructure Hubs will connect researchers to new compute infrastructure that leverages contributions from state governments, research institutions, industry, and philanthropy, accelerating AI-enabled discovery across science and engineering and developing a skilled technical workforce for AI use in the scientific enterprise. The program responds to a core tenet of Science: A New Golden Age to renew America’s research and development (R&D) for changes in today’s scientific enterprise, including the role of AI in laying the foundation for a new era of scientific discovery and the growing role of industry and philanthropy in funding R&D. In response, the Administration’s FY28 R&D Priorities Memorandum called for investing in AI for science as a national mission and expanding the scale of, and flexible access to, advanced compute and data infrastructure that researchers now require for frontier scientific discovery. Each AI Infrastructure Hub will be organized as a flexible state or regional consortium of state and local governments, research institutions, philanthropies, and the private sector. Consortia will be responsible for all funding for new or expanded computing, data, and AI resources, whether on-premises or cloud-based. NSF will fund each Hub’s consortium coordination, AI infrastructure workforce development, and faculty training and coursework development in leveraging AI for science.

Die Seminarmanagementsoftware muss sämtliche Prozesse von der Veröffentlichung und Pflege der Veranstaltungsangebote über eine Pflege von Adressdaten (CRM) inkl. Kommunikationsmöglichkeiten bis hin zur Nachbereitung und Auswertung in einer integrierten Gesamtlösung abbilden. Die Lösung ist auf ein Volumen von derzeit rund 500 Seminaren und 5.000 Teilnehmenden pro Jahr auszulegen. Zum Leistungsumfang gehören insbesondere: Bereitstellung der Software einschließlich Hosting Einrichtung und erforderliches Customizing; Pflege, Wartung, Updates und Weiterentwicklung; telefonischer sowie E-Mail-Support; Migration der bestehenden Datensätze in das neue System; Durchführung von mehreren flexiblen Schulungsformaten für bis zu 20 Mitarbeiter*innen mit einer Gesamtlänge von insgesamt 8 Stunden. Bereitstellung dokumentierter Schnittstellen zu aidshilfe.de und CleverReach. Vertragsgrundlage: EVB-IT Cloudvertrag Auftragsverarbeitungsvertrag (AVV) Grundlaufzeit: 24 Monate; zwei Verlängerungsoptionen um jeweils weitere 24 Monate, maximale Vertragslaufzeit 72 Monate (vorbehaltlich der Zuwendungsgewährung). Die Leistung wird nicht in Lose aufgeteilt. Details sind den Vergabeunterlagen zu entnehmen. Nebenangebote werden nicht zugelassen. Seminarmanagementsoftware, CRM, SaaS

result.text: The subject of the procurement is high-level procurement expertise and legal expertise for various public procurements and public procurement tender assignments of different sizes, as well as consulting, development, training and legal representation related to the entire lifecycle of public procurements to support and provide additional resources for the contracting authority's own procurement organisation. In addition to good delivery reliability, the contract suppliers must have the ability, competence and resources to handle demanding and varied assignments within each area of expertise for the expert services. A framework arrangement will be formed from the procurement. The assignments covered by the procurement vary according to the current need. The procurement is divided into six areas as follows: • Area 1: Expert services for public procurements (goods and services) • Area 2: Expert services for public procurements (ICT procurements) • Area 3: Expert services for public procurements (construction) • Area 4: Expert services for public procurements (social and health services and other special service procurements) • Area 5: Expert services for public procurements (innovative procurements and procurement development) • Area 6: Legal services related to public procurements. For each area, 4 suppliers will be selected, unless there are fewer suppliers that meet the requirements. A separate priority order will be formed for each area. The maximum value of the procurement is 10,5 million euros (VAT 0 %). The estimated value includes the entire contract period, i.e. four (4) years, and it is estimated to be divided by area as follows: area 1: 2,8 million €, area 2: 2,65 million €, area 3: 1,65 million €, area 4: 700 000 €, area 5: 1 million €, area 6: 1,7 million €. The services of the area include goods and service procurements. There are separate areas for ICT procurements, construction-related procurements, social and health services and other special services, as well as innovative procurements. Assignments may include carrying out the entire procurement process or individual tasks related to the procurement process, participating in or leading working groups consisting of the contracting authority's experts and stakeholder representatives, and other expert tasks related to procurements. The subject of the procurement is defined in more detail in this invitation to tender and its appendices.; The services of the area include ICT procurements, which are typically various information system procurements of different scopes or other ICT equipment, goods, service or combination procurements. The area emphasises knowledge of the special features of ICT procurements and markets, their contract and pricing models, and other commercial aspects related to ICT procurements. Assignments may include carrying out the entire procurement process or individual tasks related to the procurement process, participating in or leading working groups consisting of the contracting authority's experts and stakeholder representatives, and other expert tasks related to procurements. The subject of the procurement is defined in more detail in this invitation to tender and its appendices.; The services of the area include construction-related procurements. The area emphasises special expertise related to construction projects, contract forms, YSE terms and conditions, and construction contract law. Assignments may include carrying out the entire procurement process or individual tasks related to the procurement process, participating in or leading working groups consisting of the contracting authority's experts and stakeholder representatives, and other expert tasks related to procurements. The subject of the procurement is defined in more detail in this invitation to tender and its appendices.; The services of the area include procurements according to social and health services and other special services, which belong to the procurements according to Appendix E of the Procurement Act. Assignments may include carrying out the entire procurement process or individual tasks related to the procurement process, participating in or leading working groups consisting of the contracting authority's experts and stakeholder representatives, and other expert tasks related to procurements. The subject of the procurement is defined in more detail in this invitation to tender and its appendices.; The services of the area include, in particular, innovative public procurements. By innovative procurements, we mean the procurement of a new or significantly improved product or service that aims to improve productivity, quality, sustainability and effectiveness. The area emphasises: - development of result- and effectiveness-based procurements and development/modelling of the earnings logic for related procurements, - definition of effectiveness targets and monitored impacts, as well as preparation of a measurement system. Assignments may include carrying out the entire procurement process or individual tasks related to the procurement process, participating in or leading working groups consisting of the contracting authority's experts and stakeholder representatives, and other expert tasks related to procurements. The subject of the procurement is defined in more detail in this invitation to tender and its appendices.; The services of the area do not include carrying out the entire procurement process, but the service focuses on legal advice related to public procurements and representation in courts regarding the Procurement Act (the Procurement Act refers to procurements falling within the scope of the Procurement Act and the Act on Public Procurement and Concession Contracts in the Utilities Sector; acts 1397/2016, 1398/2016). The subject of the procurement is defined in more detail in this invitation to tender and its appendices.

parts.source: Hankinnan kohteena on korkeatasoinen hankinta-asiantuntemus ja juridinen asiantuntemus erilaisiin ja eri kokoluokan julkisiin hankintoihin ja julkisten hankintojen kilpailutustoimeksiantoihin, sekä julkisten hankintojen koko elinkaareen liittyvään konsultointiin, kehittämiseen, kouluttamiseen sekä oikeudelliseen edustamiseen tilaajan oman hankintaorganisaation tueksi ja lisäresurssiksi. Sopimustoimittajilla tulee olla hyvän toimitusvarmuuden lisäksi kykyä, osaamista ja resursseja hoitaa vaativia ja vaihtelevia toimeksiantoja kunkin asiantuntijapalvelun osa-alueen sisällä. Hankinnasta muodostetaan puitejärjestely. Hankinnan piiriin kuuluvat toimeksiannot vaihtelevat kulloisenkin tarpeen mukaan. Hankinta on jaettu kuuteen osa-alueeseen seuraavasti: • Osa-alue 1: Julkisten hankintojen asiantuntijapalvelut (tavarat ja palvelut) • Osa-alue 2: Julkisten hankintojen asiantuntijapalvelut (ICT-hankinnat) • Osa-alue 3: Julkisten hankintojen asiantuntijapalvelut (rakentaminen) • Osa-alue 4: Julkisten hankintojen asiantuntijapalvelut (sote-palvelut ja muut erityiset palveluhankinnat) • Osa-alue 5: Julkisten hankintojen asiantuntijapalvelut (innovatiiviset hankinnat ja hankintojen kehittäminen) • Osa-alue 6: Julkisiin hankintoihin liittyvät juridiset palvelut Jokaiselle osa-alueelle valitaan 4 toimittajaa, ellei vaatimukset täyttäviä toimittajia ole vähemmän. Jokaiselle osa-alueelle muodostetaan oma etusijajärjestyksensä. Hankinnan enimmäisarvo on 10,5 milj. euroa (alv 0 %). Arvioitu arvo sisältää koko sopimuskauden eli neljä (4) vuotta ja sen arvioidaan jakautuvan osa-alueittain seuraavasti: osa-alue 1: 2,8 milj. €, osa-alue 2: 2,65 milj. €, osa-alue 3: 1,65 milj. €, osa-alue 4: 700 000 €, osa-alue 5: 1 milj. €, osa-alue 6: 1,7 milj. €. Osa-alueen palvelut sisältävät tavara- ja palveluhankintoja. ICT-hankintoihin, rakentamiseen liittyviin hankintoihin ja sosiaali- ja terveyspalvelujen sekä muiden erityisten palvelujen mukaisiin hankintoihin sekä innovatiivisiin hankintoihin on omat osa-alueensa. Toimeksiannot voivat sisältää koko hankintaprosessin läpiviemisen tai hankintaprosessiin liittyviä yksittäisiä tehtäviä, erilaisissa hankintayksikön asiantuntijoiden ja sidosryhmien edustajista koostuviin työryhmiin osallistumista tai työryhmien vetämistä sekä muita hankintoihin liittyviä asiantuntijatehtäviä. Hankinnan kohde on määritelty tarkemmin tässä tarjouspyynnössä ja sen liitteissä.; Osa-alueen palvelut sisältävät ICT-hankintoja, jotka ovat tyypillisesti erilaisia ja eri laajuisia tietojärjestelmähankintoja tai muita ICT-laite-, - tavara-, - palvelu- tai näiden yhdistelmien hankintoja. Osa-alueessa korostuu ICT-hankintojen ja -markkinoiden erityispiirteiden ja niiden sopimus- ja hinnoittelumallien sekä muiden ICT - hankintoihin liittyvien kaupallisten näkökohtien tuntemus. Toimeksiannot voivat sisältää koko hankintaprosessin läpiviemisen tai hankintaprosessiin liittyviä yksittäisiä tehtäviä, erilaisissa hankintayksikön asiantuntijoiden ja sidosryhmien edustajista koostuviin työryhmiin osallistumista tai työryhmien vetämistä sekä muita hankintoihin liittyviä asiantuntijatehtäviä. Hankinnan kohde on määritelty tarkemmin tässä tarjouspyynnössä ja sen liitteissä.; Osa-alueen palvelut sisältävät rakentamiseen liittyviä hankintoja. Osa-alueessa korostuvat rakennushankkeisiin, urakkamuotoihin, YSE-ehtoihin ja rakennuttamisen sopimusjuridiikkaan liittyvä erityisosaaminen. Toimeksiannot voivat sisältää koko hankintaprosessin läpiviemisen tai hankintaprosessiin liittyviä yksittäisiä tehtäviä, erilaisissa hankintayksikön asiantuntijoiden ja sidosryhmien edustajista koostuviin työryhmiin osallistumista tai työryhmien vetämistä sekä muita hankintoihin liittyviä asiantuntijatehtäviä. Hankinnan kohde on määritelty tarkemmin tässä tarjouspyynnössä ja sen liitteissä.; Osa-alueen palvelut sisältävät sosiaali- ja terveyspalvelujen sekä muiden erityisten palvelujen mukaisia hankintoja, jotka kuuluvat hankintalain liitteen E-mukaisiin hankintoihin. Toimeksiannot voivat sisältää koko hankintaprosessin läpiviemisen tai hankintaprosessiin liittyviä yksittäisiä tehtäviä, erilaisissa hankintayksikön asiantuntijoiden ja sidosryhmien edustajista koostuviin työryhmiin osallistumista tai työryhmien vetämistä sekä muita hankintoihin liittyviä asiantuntijatehtäviä. Hankinnan kohde on määritelty tarkemmin tässä tarjouspyynnössä ja sen liitteissä.; Osa-alueen palvelut sisältävät erityisesti innovatiivisia julkisia hankintoja. Innovatiivisilla hankinnoilla tarkoitamme uuden tai merkittävästi parannellun tuotteen tai palvelun hankintaa, jolla tavoitellaan tuottavuuden, laadun, kestävyyden ja vaikuttavuuden paranemista. Osa-alueessa korostuu: - tulos- ja vaikuttavuusperusteisten hankintojen kehittäminen sekä näihin liittyvien hankintojen ansaintalogiikan kehittäminen/mallintaminen, - vaikuttavuustavoitteiden ja seurattavien vaikutusten määrittely sekä mittariston laatiminen. Toimeksiannot voivat sisältää koko hankintaprosessin läpiviemisen tai hankintaprosessiin liittyviä yksittäisiä tehtäviä, erilaisissa hankintayksikön asiantuntijoiden ja sidosryhmien edustajista koostuviin työryhmiin osallistumista tai työryhmien vetämistä sekä muita hankintoihin liittyviä asiantuntijatehtäviä. Hankinnan kohde on määritelty tarkemmin tässä tarjouspyynnössä ja sen liitteissä.; Osa-alueen palvelut eivät sisällä koko hankintaprosessin läpivientiä, vaan palvelu keskittyy julkisiin hankintoihin liittyvään oikeudelliseen neuvontaan sekä edustamiseen tuomioistuimissa hankintalakiin liittyen (hankintalailla tarkoitetaan hankintalain ja erityisalojen hankintalain soveltamisalaan kuuluvia hankintoja; lait 1397/2016, 1398/2016). Hankinnan kohde on määritelty tarkemmin tässä tarjouspyynnössä ja sen liitteissä.

result.text: Vanguard Learning Trust invites qualified suppliers to tender for the provision of a cloud-based human resources information system (HRIS) and a fully managed payroll service to support approximately 615 employees across 6 schools and a central Trust team. The solution must deliver secure, efficient HR and payroll processes, ensure statutory compliance with UK employment, pensions and HMRC regulations, and provide high-quality support to both Trust leaders and school-based staff. Objectives The Trust aims to procure a combined HRIS and payroll solution that: Provides a single source of truth for employee data across all schools and the Trust's central team. Reduces administrative workloads and manual processing. Ensures accurate, timely payroll with all third-party submissions completed by the provider, including HMRC, pension providers, and statutory bodies. Supports workforce planning, reporting, and strategic oversight at Trust level. Offers excellent employee and manager self-service. Ensures data security, GDPR compliance, and UK-based hosting. Scope of software and services The software will include: General HR system of record (SoR) Absence and attendance management functionality, which will link to occupational sickness scheme requirements Time and expenses (the functionality for employees to log additional hours and expenses, which would only be approved at managerial level) Organisation structure Employee Self Service Manager Self Service People Analytics A fully managed payroll and pension service The Trust would not be procuring the functionality below in the first instance but may consider doing at a later date. These are, therefore, 'desirable' rather than 'essential': Integrated applicant tracking and onboarding functionality Performance management and appraisal functionality Case management functionality The service provision will include: Fully managed payroll services Fully managed pensions services Solution hosting Requirements Our requirements (functional and non-functional) have been listed and are provided in an Excel sheet along with this document. Supplier Responses Suppliers are requested to complete the supplier response columns within the requirements document and to provide a commercial proposal using the template in the attached sheet. Additionally, please provide a high level project plan to demonstrate the timescales that your solution could be deployed in and a copy of your customer support service-level agreement (SLA). Finally, short-listed providers will be required to complete the Trust's data protection impact assessment (DPIA). Lot 1: .

result.text: The gkv informatik eGbR is a service provider for AOKs Nordost, AOK NordWest and AOK NordWest, Rheinland/Hamburg. It provides all necessary operational IT services for its shareholders, who have a total of approximately 20.000 employees. The subject of the tender is the service packages for Workplace, Service Desk and Service Management. The contract duration is a maximum of 120 months. 12 months are planned for the transition phase at the beginning of the contract period, followed by an operational period of at least 48 months. The client may extend the operational period twice by 24 months (a total of 48 months). After the operational period has expired, a so-called transition-out phase follows, which can last up to 12 months. The service consists of the service packages Workplace, Service Desk and Service Management. The central task of the Workplace service package is the operation of all end devices (clients) such as notebooks, including the required software, and the complete lifecycle of software management from certification and packaging to software distribution. Essentially, the following services are to be provided: - End device management: The contractor is responsible, in accordance with the client's specifications, for the design, engineering, continuous maintenance and further development, and the configuration of the hardware and software of a cross-platform client environment up to the top edge of the operating system. - Application and desktop environments: Provision of the centrally operated VDI infrastructure for the end devices at the user's workplace. - Software management: The software management service essentially consists of the components test, software packaging and software distribution. - Shopping cart services: As part of the shopping cart services, the contractor provides and maintains a comprehensive shopping cart in accordance with the client's specifications. The shopping cart includes hardware (IT workplace hardware, e.g. desktops, notebooks, monitors, etc.), software and services, which for hardware include the management of corresponding maintenance contracts (in particular warranty processing) and disposal. - Field services: Field services include the provision of services by the contractor that involve the installation, restoration or dismantling of systems, including patching network connections at the workplace. - Mobile device management: The subject of mobile device management (MDM) by the contractor is the administration of the mobile end devices such as tablets or smartphones in use by the client and the beneficiaries. - Print: As part of the print services, the contractor provides and operates a complete print environment for workplace printing for the client and the beneficiaries. - Collaboration services: The collaboration services package describes the provision and operation of a hybrid (on-premises and cloud) mail solution, including archiving, by the contractor. - M365: Parts of the organisation use M365 services. The contractor supports and advises the client on the operation and further development of the Microsoft M365 services within the framework of existing contractual relationships with Microsoft. - Disaster recovery: The conception and testing of so-called 'disaster recovery' precautions, planning and measures, which essentially have to ensure the defined maintenance of operations and restoration of IT services in the event of an emergency (crisis, disaster) as well as crisis management, must be ensured by the contractor on the basis of legal requirements and the client's requirements. The subject of the Service Desk service package is the provision of a service desk aligned with ITIL standards, which acts as a central point of contact (SPOC) for end users, internal organisational units and customers. Within the framework of the functional requirements, the Service Desk takes over the acceptance and processing of faults (incidents) and service requests (requests) during the entire term of the contract. The Service Management service package essentially includes the implementation of IT service management processes as well as the use of the client's ITSM tool or, alternatively, the establishment of an interface from the contractor's ITSM tool, as well as the transfer of process objects in real time. Service Management is to be regarded as a classic cross-sectional topic.

parts.source: Die gkv informatik eGbR ist ein Dienstleister der AOKs Nordost, AOK NordWest und AOK NordWest, Rheinland/Hamburg. Sie erbringt alle erforderlichen Leistungen des operativen IT-Betriebes für ihre Gesellschafter mit insgesamt ca. 20.000 Mitarbeitern. Gegenstand der Ausschreibung sind die Leistungspakete Arbeitsplatz, Service Desk und Service Management. Die Vertragslaufzeit beträgt maximal 120 Monate. Für die Transitionsphase zu Beginn der Vertragslaufzeit sind 12 Monate eingeplant, gefolgt von einem Betriebszeitraum von mindestens 48 Monaten. Der Auftraggeber kann den Betriebszeitraum zwei Mal um 24 Monate verlängern (insgesamt 48 Monate). Nach Ablauf des Betriebszeitraumes schließt sich eine sog. Transition-Out Phase an, die bis zu 12 Monate dauern kann. Die Leistung setzt sich zusammen aus den Leistungspaketen Arbeitsplatz, Service Desk und Service Management. Zentrale Aufgabe des Leistungspaketes Arbeitsplatz ist der Betrieb sämtlicher Endgeräte (Clients) wie zum Beispiel Notebooks inkl. der benötigten Software, der vollständige Lifecycle des Softwaremanagements von der Zertifizierung über die Paketierung bis hin zur Softwareverteilung. Es sind im Wesentlichen folgende Leistungen zu erbringen: - Endgerätemanagement: Der Auftragnehmer ist entsprechend der Vorgaben des Auftraggebers verantwortlich für das Design, das Engineering sowie die kontinuierliche Wartung und Weiterentwicklung und der Ausgestaltung der Hard- und Software einer plattformübergreifenden Clientumgebung bis Oberkante Betriebssystem. - Anwendungs- und Desktopumgebungen: Bereitstellung der zentral zu betreibenden VDI-Infrastruktur für die Endgeräte am Arbeitsplatz der Anwender - Softwaremanagement: Die Leistung Softwaremanagement setzt sich im Wesentlichen aus den Bestandteilen Test, Softwarepaketierung und Softwareverteilung zusammen. - Warenkorb Services: Im Rahmen der Warenkorb Services stellt der Auftragnehmer einen umfassenden Warenkorb gemäß Spezifikationen des Auftraggebers bereit und pflegt diesen. Der Warenkorb beinhaltet Hardware (IT-Arbeitsplatzhardware, z.B. Desktops, Notebooks, Monitore usw.), Software und Serviceleistungen, die bei der Hardware das Management entsprechender Wartungsverträge (insbesondere Garantieabwicklungen) und die Entsorgung umfassen. - Field Services: Die Field Services umfassen die Erbringung von Leistungen des Auftragnehmers, die eine Installation, Wiederherstellung oder den Abbau von Systemen inkl. Patchen der Netzwerkanschlüsse am Arbeitsplatz beinhalten. - Mobile Device Management: Gegenstand des Mobile Device Management (MDM) durch den Auftragnehmer ist die Verwal-tung der bei der Auftraggeberin und den Begünstigten im Einsatz befindlichen mobilen Endgeräte wie Tablets oder Smartphones. - Print: Im Rahmen der Print-Services stellt der Auftragnehmer der Aufraggeberin und den Begünstig-ten eine vollständige Printumgebung für den Arbeitsplatzdruck bereit und betreibt diese. - Collaboration Services: Das Leistungspaket Collaboration Services beschreibt die Bereitstellung und den Betrieb einer hybriden (on Premises und Cloud) Mail-Lösung inklusive Archivierung durch den Auftragnehmer. - M365: Teile der Organisation nutzen M365-Services. Der Auftragnehmer unterstützt und berät die Auftraggeberin beim Betrieb und der Weiterentwicklung der Microsoft M365 Services im Rahmen der bestehenden Vertragsbeziehungen mit Microsoft. - Disaster Recovery: Die Konzeption und Prüfung der so genannten "Disaster Recovery"-Vorsorge, -Planung und -Maßnahmen, die im Wesentlichen die definierte Aufrechterhaltung des Betriebs und Wieder-herstellung der IT Services im Falle eines Notfalls (Krise, Desaster) sowie Krisenmanagement zu gewährleisten haben, ist auf Basis der gesetzlichen Anforderungen und der Anforderungen der Auftraggeberin durch den Auftragnehmer sicherzustellen. Gegenstand des Leistungspaketes Service Desk ist die Bereitstellung eines nach ITIL Standards ausgerichteten Service Desks, der als zentrale Anlaufstelle (Single Point of Contact, SPOC) für Endanwender, interne Organisationseinheiten und Kunden fungiert. Im Rahmen der funktionalen Anforderungen übernimmt der Service Desk die Annahme und Bearbeitung von Störungen (Incidents) und Serviceanfragen (Requests) während der gesam-ten Laufzeit des Vertrages. Das Leistungspaket Service Management beinhaltet im Wesentlichen die Implementierung der IT-Service Management-Prozesse sowie die Nutzung des ITSM-Tools der Auftraggeberin oder alternativ den Aufbau einer Schnittstelle vom ITSM-Tool des Auftragnehmers, sowie die Übertragung der Prozessobjekte in Echtzeit. Das Service Management ist als klassisches Querschnittsthema zu betrachten.

result.text: Aarhus Vand is a utility group that manages water and wastewater activities. In this context, Aarhus Vand owns, operates, and maintains many kilometres of water and wastewater pipes distributed across the supply area. To ensure efficient operation of the pipes, Aarhus Vand requires accurate, updated, and accessible registration of the pipe network. For this purpose, Aarhus Vand needs a pipe registration system. Aarhus Vand wishes for a collective agreement comprising both the licences for the pipe registration system itself and consultancy services for ongoing development and maintenance of the system. Aarhus Vand hereby invites to a market dialogue regarding the above. The purpose of the market dialogue includes determining which systems are on the market that can fulfil Aarhus Vand's factual and objective needs. Aarhus Vand has identified the following requirements as being important in relation to a future pipe registration system. It is important to Aarhus Vand that these requirements can already be fulfilled now. The list is not considered exhaustive: 1. Full support for DANVA's latest models, currently: Dandas 3.1.2, TV inspection and manhole report 3.1.2, Danvand 2.1.2, cables, third-party pipes, and areas 1.1, burst registration 1.1.1. For all models, this applies to all concepts, attributes, codes, relations, and interfaces as well as DANVA's guidelines and data manuals. The system is configurable so that it can be easily and quickly adapted to changes in both the models and the user interface 2. All registrations are saved / data resides in one and the same database 3. The system must support data exchange in XML format. There must be an option for direct updating via e.g. SQL. There must be direct access to data, as well as the possibility of making direct integrations with other systems. 4. Quality assurance. XSD validation, predefined validations, etc., which support pipe registration and work with data, and thus ensure and maintain good data quality. 5. Possibility to work in "jobs" in connection with the digitalisation of an area / project / subject, which can subsequently be upgraded to be the master. That is, so that one does not work in the master until changes have been upgraded to the master. 6. The language in the system must be Danish. To a minor extent, it can be in English. 7. User interface. An intuitive and user-friendly user interface. Workflows must be supported by configurable templates/flows. Must contain a tool for replacing, splitting, and merging objects, e.g. pipes. Must have various construction tools. Must have 3D support. 8. User management via AD integration. Users must be able to have different roles/rights. 9. The solution must have stable and high performance 10. There must be an auto-save feature, or recovery of unsaved work or similar. All market operators who believe they can meet the above requirements are encouraged to register for the market dialogue. FRAMEWORK AND PARTICIPATION OF THE DIALOGUE As a general rule, the market dialogue will take place physically at Aarhus Vand, Hasselager Allé 29, 8260 Viby J. The dialogue is held individually per market operator. Interest in the market dialogue must be reported to Christoffer Larsen at christoffer.larsen@aarhusvand.dk or indkob@aarhusvand.dk no later than 20.10.2025. The dialogue meetings are held in the period from 21.10.2025 to 31.10.2025.

parts.source: Aarhus Vand er en koncern der håndterer vand- og spildevandaktiviteter. I den forbindelse ejer, driver og vedligeholder Aarhus Vand mange kilometer vand- og spildevandledninger fordelt over forsyningsområdet. For at sikre effektiv drift af ledningerne, kræver det at Aarhus Vand har nøjagtig, opdateret og tilgængelig registrering af ledningsnettet. Til dette har Aarhus Vand behov for et ledningsregistreringssystem. Aarhus Vand ønsker en samlet aftale omfattende både selve licenserne til ledningsregistrereringssystemet, samt konsulentydelser til løbende udvikling, vedligeholdelse af systemet. Aarhus Vand inviterer hermed til markedsdialog vedr. ovenstående. Formålet med markedsdialogen er bl.a. at afgøre hvilke systemer der er på markedet, der kan opfylde Aarhus Vand saglige og objektive behov. Aarhus Vand har identificeret følgende krav, som værende vigtige ift. et fremtidigt ledningsregistreringssystem. Det er vigtigt for Aarhus Vand at kravene allerede kan opfyldes nu. Listen anses ikke for udtømmende: 1. Fuld understøttelse af DANVAs seneste modeller, pt.: Dandas 3.1.2, TV-Inspektion og brøndrapport 3.1.2, Danvand 2.1.2, Kabler, Fremmedrør samt Flader 1.1, Brudregistrering 1.1.1. For alle modeller gælder det alle begreber, attributter, koder, relationer og snitflader samt Danva's vejledninger og datamanualer. Systemet er konfigurerbar, således at systemet nemt og hurtigt kan tilpasse ændringer i såvel modellerne som brugerflade 2. Alle registreringer gemmes/data ligger i én og samme database 3. Systemet skal understøtte dataudveksling i XML-format. Der skal være mulighed for direkte opdatering via f.eks. SQL. Der skal være direkte adgang til data, samt mulighed for at lave direkte integrationer til andre systemer. 4. Kvalitetssikring. XSD-validering, foruddefinerede valideringer mv., der understøtter ledningsregistring og arbejde med data, og dermed sikrer og fastholder en god datakvalitet. 5. Mulighed for at arbejde i "jobs" i forbindelse med digitalisering af et område/projekt/emne, som efterfølgende kan opgraderes til at være master. Altså således at man ikke arbejde i master, før man har opgradreret ændringer til master. 6. Sproget i systemet skal være på dansk. Kan i mindre omfang være på engelsk. 7. Brugerflade. En intuitiv og brugervenlig brugerflade. Arbejdsgange skal kunne understøttes af konfigurerbare skabeloner/flows. Skal indeholde et værktøj til erstat, delling og samling af objekter f.eks. Ledninger Skal have diverse konstruktionsværktøjer. Skal have 3D understøttelse. 8. Brugerstyring via AD integration. Brugerne skal kunne have forskellige roller/rettigheder. 9. Løsningen skal have stabil og høj performance 10. Der skal være en auto-gem feature, eller gendannelse af ikke gemt-arbejde eller lign. Alle markedsaktører der mener at kunne leve op til ovenstående krav, opfordres til at tilmelde sig markedsdialogen. DIALOGENS RAMMER OG DELTAGELSE Markedsdialogen vil som udgangspunkt ske fysisk ved Aarhus Vand, Hasselager Allé 29, 8260 Viby J. Dialogen afholdes individuelt pr. markedsaktør. Interesse i markedsdialogen meldes til Christoffer Larsen, på christoffer.larsen@aarhusvand.dk eller indkob@aarhusvand.dk senest d. 20.10.2025. Dialogmøderne afholdes i perioden 21.10.2025 til 31.10.2025.

result.text: The Copernicus European earth observation and monitoring programme has entered its operational phase following the adoption of the Copernicus Regulation 377/2014. The Global Land component is earmarked as a component of the Land Service and is operational since 2013. The purpose of this contract is to continue and up-grade the previous Sentinel-2 Global Mosaic (S2GM) service in the framework of the Global Component of the Copernicus Land Service. The main objective of this activity is to produce and distribute temporal mosaic images on-demand as well as land biophysical products tools. The service will also answer to ad-hoc requests and focus mainly within the domain of the sustainable management of natural resources. The aim is in delivering land information on specific areas of interest for the European Union (EU).

result.text: The tender procedure is carried out by the contracting authorities as a joint procurement procedure, cf. section 123, subsection 5. The tender procedure is covered by the Danish Public Procurement Act (Act No. 1564 of 15 December 2015 as amended), which implements the Public Procurement Directive (Directive 2014/24/EU). The tender procedure concerns the procurement of diabetes technology by Region Midtjylland, Region Syddanmark, Region Nordjylland and Region Østdanmark (current Region Sjælland and Region Hovedstaden), divided into two subcontracts concerning respectively (1) AID insulin pump systems and (2) continuous glucose monitoring systems (CGM). The tender also covers the system components, accessories and consumables that are necessary or relevant for putting the offered systems into operation and using them as intended. As an integral part of the delivery, the suppliers must also make the associated digital solutions available, including apps and patient and clinician platforms, and provide training for patients and healthcare professionals as well as technical support for patients. The products covered are set out in Contract Appendix 3, while the requirements for the products and associated services are set out in the Contract and the Requirements Specification, cf. Contract Appendix 2. The contract put out to tender, including subcontracts (1) and (2), are framework agreements in accordance with section 24, no. 30 of the Public Procurement Act. Subcontract 1 and Subcontract 2 are separate framework agreements. In connection with the conclusion of the contract, separate contracts and contract appendices will be drawn up (except for contract appendix 5, which is already included in the tender documents in one copy for each participating region) for each of the other participating regions. This means that each region concludes separate contracts/framework agreements with the winning tenderers. The subcontract concerns the procurement of AID insulin pumps in the form of either insulin pumps for infusion sets or patch pumps. The subcontract also covers the system components, accessories and consumables that are necessary or relevant for putting the offered AID insulin pump system into operation and using it as intended, including, depending on the offered system, for example pods, pump bases, PDM/control units, infusion sets and reservoirs. As an integral part of the delivery, the supplier must make associated digital solutions available, including apps and patient and clinician platforms, and provide training in the use of the offered products as well as technical support for patients. The detailed scope of the subcontract appears from the tender documents, including Contract Appendix 2 and Contract Appendix 3.; The subcontract concerns the procurement of continuous sensor-based glucose monitoring systems (CGM). The subcontract covers sensors, receivers and other system components, accessories and consumables that are necessary or relevant for putting the offered CGM system into operation and using it as intended, including, for example, senders/transmitters. As an integral part of the delivery, the supplier must make associated digital solutions available, including apps and patient and clinician platforms, and provide training in the use of the offered products as well as technical support for patients. The detailed scope of the subcontract appears from the tender documents, including Contract Appendix 2 and Contract Appendix 3. As an integral part of the delivery, the supplier must make associated digital solutions available, including apps and patient and clinician platforms, and provide training in the use of the offered products as well as technical support for patients. The detailed scope of the subcontract appears from the tender documents, including Contract Appendix 2 and Contract Appendix 3.

result.text: Open-quantity framework agreements are concluded for development services required by DB Systemtechnik. DB Systemtechnik works on extremely demanding digitalisation projects in the field of rail vehicle technology. The project portfolio thus encompasses challenges of the entire railway system, i.e. rail vehicles, their components, the infrastructure and the corresponding interfaces. For the initiation, definition, planning, control and successful completion of these technically demanding projects, DB Systemtechnik is looking for experienced partners with broad methodological expertise and industry know-how for consulting and project management services.; DB Systemtechnik uses various sensors, measurement and data loggers to acquire, process, transmit to the land side and evaluate process, diagnostic and operating data from rail vehicles and railway assets. For the development of customer-specific and standard assemblies based on embedded technology and railway-compatible measurement and sensor modules, DB Systemtechnik is looking for development partners and suppliers. The services cover all steps, from conception to the approval-ready hardware product that can be implemented in the vehicle by the client, including the necessary basic software. The suppliers are experienced in the development of railway-approved embedded hardware and software and have established certified development and production processes. They master documented series-delivery and quality processes and are experienced in supply chain and obsolescence management in the railway sector.; Within the scope of digitalisation projects in the railway sector, DB Systemtechnik develops customer-specific products which, among other things, require the development, modification and operation of specific applications. For this purpose, suppliers and development partners are sought who can efficiently develop reliable, robust and secure software solutions and use structured and proven development methods and certifiable development processes for this purpose. The suppliers have comprehensive knowledge and experience in the field of architecture, software development, CI/CD, software testing and quality assurance for embedded systems in critical environments. All software solutions must comply with the standards for approval in rail vehicles and operation in the railway sector.

parts.source: Für bei der DB Systemtechnik anfallende Entwicklungs DL werden mengenoffene Rahmenverträge geschlossen. Die DB Systemtechnik bearbeitet äußerst anspruchsvolle Digitalisierungsprojekte im Bereich der Schienenfahrzeugtechnik. Das Projektportfolio umfasst somit Herausforderungen des gesamten Systems Bahn, d.h. Schienenfahrzeuge, deren Komponenten, die Infrastruktur und die entsprechenden Schnittstellen. Für die Initialisierung, Definition, Planung, Steuerung und den erfolgreichen Abschluss dieser fachlich anspruchsvollen Projekte sucht die DB Systemtechnik erfahrene Partner mit breiter Methodenexpertise und Branchen Know-how für Consulting- und Projektmanagementleistungen.; Die DB Systemtechnik setzt unterschiedliche Sensoren, Mess- und Datenlogger ein, um Prozess-, Diagnose- und Betriebsdaten von Schienenfahrzeugen und Bahn-Assets zu gewinnen, zu verarbeiten, zur Landseite zu übertragen und auszuwerten. Für die Entwicklung der kundenspezifischen und Standardbaugruppen, basierend auf Embedded Technologie und bahntauglichen Mess- und Sensormodulen, sucht die DB Systemtechnik Entwicklungspartner und Lieferanten. Die Services decken alle Schritte, von der Konzep-tion bis zum zulassungsfertigen, durch den Auftraggeber im Fahrzeug implementierbaren Hardwareprodukt mit der notwendigen Basissoftware ab. Die Lieferanten sind erfahren in der Entwicklung von bahnzugelassener Embedded Hard-/Software und haben zertifizierte Entwicklungs- und Produktionsprozesse etabliert. Sie beherrschen dokumentierte Serien-liefer- und Qualitätsprozesse und sind erfahren in Supply Chain- und Obsoleszenz-Management im Bahnsektor.; Im Rahmen von Digitalisierungsprojekten im Bahnsektor entwickelt die DB Systemtechnik kun-denspezifische Produkte, die unter anderem die Entwicklung, Änderung und Betriebsführung von spezifischen Applikationen erfordern. Dafür werden Lieferanten und Entwicklungspartner gesucht, die zuverlässige, robuste und sichere Softwarelösungen effizient entwickeln können und dafür strukturierte und bewährte Entwicklungsmethoden und zertifizierbare Entwicklungsprozesse an-wenden. Die Lieferanten haben umfassenden Kenntnisse und Erfahrungen im Bereich Architek-tur, Softwareentwicklung, CI/CD, Softwaretests und Qualitätssicherung für embedded Systeme im Kritis-Umfeld. Alle Softwarelösungen müssen den Standards für die Zulassung in Schienen-fahrzeugen und dem Betrieb im Eisenbahnsektor entsprechen.

result.text: OBJECT OF THE PROCUREMENT The object of the procurement is support services for railway data management, which includes, among other things, the following tasks: - The supplier coordinates and develops the services required for quality management of railway infrastructure data in support of the contracting authority and railway data maintenance operators, and prepares analyses on the quality of railway data. - The supplier participates in supporting the contracting authority in the development of railway data analytics reporting. - The supplier supports the contracting authority in the creation, contacting and activation of a network of railway data maintainers and users. - The supplier supports the contracting authority in the planning, preparation and implementation of training for new versions of railway data systems and other railway data services. - The supplier supports the contracting authority in communication related to railway data management in accordance with the communication plan agreed with the contracting authority. - The supplier supports the contracting authority in the management and production of official instructions and other guidelines related to railway data maintenance. GENERAL Please note that this is an invitation to a market survey (hereinafter the notice), and this notice does not yet request tenders. All information provided in this notice is preliminary and may change as the preparation progresses. Hansel Oy acts in a consultative role in the tendering process. REGISTRATION You can register for the market survey by filling in the form in the "Other information" section of this notice in the Tender Service and sending it to the contracting authority by the deadline of 27.11.2026 at 12.00. MARKET DIALOGUE The contracting authority reserves the possibility to send draft material of the tender to the registered tenderers for written comment in a so-called market dialogue during November-December 2025.

result.text: NTNU is Norway's largest university, with approx. 43,500 students and 8,500 employees. NTNU currently has up to 35,000 safety data sheets for the substance register. NTNU has a comprehensive laboratory and workshop activity, with approx. 300 laboratories and workshops with relatively extensive use of chemicals and gases, in addition to many laboratories and workshops with more limited activity. NTNU currently has approx. 300 persons with editing access in the substance register. The aim is to procure a user friendly substance register and exposure register, which supports both laboratory and workshop activities and ordinary operations. The system shall be a practical tool for research, teaching and operational environments, which contributes to more efficient work flow, increases the quality of the work and supports NTNU's compliance with relevant requirements in Norwegian and European rules. The solution will be used in the training of students. The offered system shall be complete, and it must have been fully tested so that it has been implemented and been in use by customers with similar needs. See Part 2 Annex 1 the Contracting Authority ́s requirement specifications for further information. A continual service contract shall be signed with one tenderer. The contract will be signed as soon as possible after the waiting period has expired. The system shall be handed over and ready for use three months after the contract has been signed, tentatively 01.03.2027. The contract will be valid for 3 years, with an option for an extension until the contract is terminated by one of the parties.

result.text: The Norwegian Defence Materiel Agency (NDMA) is conducting this Request for Information (RFI) to gather market information on modular and scalable Command, Control, Communications, Computers and Information Systems (C4IS) with embedded navigation capabilities for military craft up to 24 metres in length. The information gathered will support NDMA in assessing available technologies, integration concepts, support arrangements and potential procurement strategies. NDMA intends to explore the possibility of establishing a future framework agreement covering system architecture, embedded navigation solutions, system integration, maintenance, support and lifecycle development. This RFI is conducted solely for market research purposes and does not constitute a procurement procedure or a commitment to procure. NDMA will not carry out a direct procurement based on this RFI and will not provide financial compensation for responses received. NDMA encourages all relevant suppliers and system integrators to respond, including those offering partial solutions or collaborative delivery models. Responses shall be submitted through the Mercell portal, or via e-mail to the Contracting Officer no later than 9 October 2026 at 12:00 (GMT+1).

rejected.text: The objective of the Cybersecurity Innovation for Cyberinfrastructure (CICI) programme is to advance scientific discovery and innovation by enhancing the security and privacy of cyberinfrastructure. CICI supports efforts to develop, deploy and integrate cybersecurity that will benefit the broader scientific community by securing science data, computation, collaborations workflows, and infrastructure. CICI recognises the unique nature of modern, complex, data-driven, distributed, rapid, and collaborative science and the breadth of infrastructure and requirements across scientific disciplines, practitioners, researchers, and projects. CICI seeks proposals in four programme areas: 1. Usable and Collaborative Security for Science (UCSS): Projects in this programme area should support novel and/or applied security and usability research that facilitates scientific collaboration, encourages the adoption of security into the scientific workflow, and helps create a holistic, integrated security environment that spans the entire scientific cyberinfrastructure ecosystem. 2. Reference Scientific Security Datasets (RSSD): Projects in this programme area should leverage instrumented cyberinfrastructure to capture metadata from scientific workflows and workloads as reference data artifacts that can help support reproducible security research, testing and evaluation. 3. Transition to Cyberinfrastructure Resilience (TCR): Projects in this programme area should improve the robustness, trustworthiness, integrity, and/or resilience of scientific cyberinfrastructure through testing, evaluation, hardening, validation, and technology transition of novel cybersecurity research. The TCR area further encourages transition activities that advance the deployment and use of reproducibility in CI, workflows, and data. 4. Integrity, Provenance, and Authenticity for Artificial Intelligence Ready Data (IPAAI): Projects in this programme area should enhance confidence and reproducibility in AI produced scientific results by improving the integrity, provenance, and authenticity of scientific datasets used by Artificial Intelligence systems.

result.text: NHS 24 is undertaking market engagement to inform the potential procurement of a Headless Content Management System (CMS) and Digital Experience Platform (DXP). The exercise will explore available solutions, delivery models, implementation approaches and commercial options to support the future NHS 24 digital experience and content management capability. Lot 1: . NHS 24 is undertaking a preliminary market consultation to inform the potential procurement and implementation of a modern Headless Content Management System (CMS) and wider Digital Experience Platform (DXP) capability. The objective is to understand available market solutions, delivery approaches, commercial models and routes to market capable of supporting a secure, scalable and API-driven platform for the creation, management and reuse of content across websites, mobile experiences, conversational interfaces and future digital channels. The potential requirement may include platform licensing, hosting, implementation, systems integration, content modelling, content migration, user experience design, front-end development, training, support, knowledge transfer and ongoing service management. NHS 24 has not yet determined the preferred procurement approach and is seeking supplier input on alternative delivery models, including platform-only, implementation-only, end-to-end and multi-supplier arrangements. This exercise is for market engagement purposes only and does not constitute a formal procurement competition or commitment to procure. Supplier responses will be used to inform NHS 24's future strategy, scope and procurement approach

result.text: The subject of the intended procurement is the awarding of an integrated overall service for the SAP technology stack of BARMER and HEK. The service to be procured comprises taking over application responsibility, platform operation and infrastructure operation for the operation of the statutory health insurance (GKV) core system oscare® in an SAP S/4HANA environment. Lot PAR-0000: SAP Operation and AI Integration. BARMER and HEK are jointly conducting an EU-wide market consultation in accordance with Section 28 of the Public Procurement Ordinance (VgV). The aim is to determine which providers on the European market are in a position to provide the SAP technology stack of BARMER and HEK - consisting of application responsibility, platform operation and infrastructure operation - for the operation of the GKV core system oscare® in an SAP S/4HANA environment. Ensuring the SAP software licence required for operation is an integral part of the overall service.

Die zu beschaffende Leistung umfasst die Über-nahme der Applikationsverantwortung, des Plattformbetriebs sowie des Infrastrukturbetriebs für den Betrieb des GKV-Kernsystems oscare® in einer SAP S/4HANA-Umgebung. Lot PAR-0000: SAP-Betrieb und KI-Integration. Die BARMER und die HEK führen gemeinsam gemäß § 28 VgV eine EU-weite Markterkundung durch. Ziel ist die Ermittlung, welche Anbieter am europäischen Markt in der Lage sind, den SAP‐Technologie‐Stack der BARMER und HEK, bestehend aus Applikationsverantwortung, Plattformbe-trieb und Infrastrukturbetrieb - für den Betrieb des GKV‐Kernsystems oscare® in einer SAP S/4HANA‐Umgebung bereitzustellen. Die Sicherstellung der für den Betrieb erforderlichen SAP‐Softwarelizenz ist dabei integraler Bestandteil der Gesamtleistung.

result.text: VIVO Defence Services is looking for an Energy Management Platform to manage meter data from across sites within its Defence portfolio (c4,000 meters) and facilitate reduction of costs and carbon emissions. result.text: This is a negotiated procedure with a call for competition in accordance with Section 11 ( 1 ) sentence 1 alternative 2 of the VSVgV. The subject of the contract to be awarded is the procurement for the supply and setup of software as a complete system a) for the analysis, IT-supported comparison and research of mass data in a repository of several partially federated source databases as well as ad-hoc imported data, in particular from the backups of digital evidence by the Polizei SH, b) for the technical integration of existing data sources into a central data integration platform (data integration component). The initial licence requirement comprises 30 concurrent users; the required number of licences for this must be procured. Optionally, there should be the possibility to expand the number to up to 75 concurrent users. This option must be included in the tender; however, the actual take-up is optional. The contracting authority envisages a staggered approach for the further licences to be acquired optionally. The additional licences are offered in stages: Option 1 allows for the procurement of 20 further licences (a total of 50 users), Option 2 for a further 25 licences each, so that a maximum number of 75 users can be reached. The term of the licence is three years from the award of the contract. The contracting authority has the right to extend the term up to three times by twelve months each. Licences acquired within the scope of options 1 and 2 have a term of three years from their provision, which can also be extended three times by twelve months each, but the licences procured through the exercise of options shall end no later than the term of the initially procured base licences. The contracting authority uses an EVB-IT transfer contract Type B, an EVB-IT maintenance contract and an EVB-IT service contract as the basis for the contractual agreement. These will be made available together with the other documents during the tendering phase. The procurement essentially comprises the following services: The rental of a complete system consisting of • analysis software for the comprehensive analysis, IT-supported comparison and research of mass data in the repository of several partially federated source databases as well as ad-hoc imported data, in particular from the backups of digital evidence by the Polizei SH and • a central data integration platform (data integration component) for the integration of existing data sources, which can be installed in the Dataport data centre - on premise. This includes a production, development and test system, which is to be integrated into the existing IT infrastructure of the Polizei SH. Regarding the distinction between data integration and IT-supported comparison and automated data analysis, reference is made to the attached document "Definition of terms for analysis and data integration". Further details can be found in the document "Part A - General Part Call for Competition". The procedure concerns a classified contract in accordance with Section 104 ( 3 ) no. 2 of the GWB or Art. 2 letter b and d of Directive 2009/81/EC and is carried out in accordance with the VSVgV. According to the decision of the public contracting authority, only economic operators resident in an EU Member State or Iceland or Norway are entitled to participate (by application and tender) ("eligible participants"). Applicants and tenderers may not provide for subcontractors in their application and tenders who are resident in a state other than those mentioned in the previous sentence ("third country"). This also applies to any other reliance on the capacities of such companies. For the determination of residence, the definition of origin in Art. 3 ( 1 ) of Regulation (EU) 2022/1031 applies accordingly; for economic operators as groups, Art. 3 ( 2 ) of the aforementioned regulation applies.

parts.source: Es handelt sich um ein Verhandlungsverfahren mit Teilnahmewettbewerb gem. § 11Abs.1 S. 1 Alt. 2 VSVgV. Gegenstand des zu vergebenden Auftrages ist die Beschaffung zur Lieferung und Einrichtung einer Software als Gesamtsystem a) zur Analyse, zum IT-gestützten Abgleich und zur Recherche von Massendaten in einem Bestand mehrerer teils föderierter Quelldatenbanken sowie anlassbezogen im-portierter Daten insbesondere aus den Sicherungen digitaler Beweismittel durch die Polizei SH, b) für die technische Integration bestehender Datenquellen in einer zentralen Datenintegrationsplattform (Datenintegrationskomponente). Der Lizenzbedarf umfasst zunächst 30 gleichzeitige Nutzer; die hierfür erforderliche Lizenzmenge ist zu beschaffen. Optional soll die Möglichkeit bestehen, für die Anzahl auf bis zu 75 gleichzeitige Nutzer auszuweiten. Diese Option muss zwingend im Angebot enthalten sein, die tatsächliche Inanspruchnahme ist jedoch optional. Der Auftraggeber sieht dabei eine Staffelung der weiteren optional zu erwerbenden Lizenzen vor. Die zusätzlichen Lizenzen werden gestaffelt angeboten: Option 1 ermöglicht die Beschaffung von 20 weiteren Lizenzen (insgesamt 50 Nutzer), Option 2 jeweils weitere 25 Lizenzen, sodass eine maximale Nutzerzahl von 75 erreicht werden kann. Die Laufzeit der Lizenz beträgt drei Jahre ab Zuschlag. Der Auftraggeber hat das Recht, die Laufzeit bis zu dreimal um jeweils zwölf Monate zu verlängern. Im Rahmen der Optionen 1 und 2 erworbene Lizenzen haben eine Laufzeit von drei Jahren ab deren Bereitstellung, die ebenfalls dreimal um jeweils zwölf Monate verlängert werden kann, die durch Optionsausübung beschafften Lizenzen enden aber spätestens gleichzeitig mit der Laufzeit der zuerst grundständig beschafften Lizenzen. Der Auftraggeber verwendet als Grundlage der vertraglichen Vereinbarung einen EVB-IT-Überlassungsvertrag Typ B, einen EVB-IT Pflegevertrag und einen EVB-IT Dienstleistungsvertrag. Diese werden gemeinsam mit den weiteren Unterlagen in der Angebotsphase zur Verfügung gestellt. Die Beschaffung umfasst im Wesentlichen die folgenden Leistungen: Die Miete eines Gesamtsystems bestehend aus • einer Analysesoftware für die übergreifende Analyse, den IT-gestützten Abgleich und die Recherche von Massendaten in dem Bestand mehrerer teils föderierter Quelldatenbanken sowie anlassbezogen importierter Daten insbesondere aus den Sicherungen digitaler Beweismittel durch die Polizei SH und • einer zentralen Datenintegrationsplattform (Datenintegrationskomponente) zur Integration der bestehenden Datenquellen, welches im Rechenzentrum von Dataport - on premise - installiert werden kann. Dies beinhaltet ein Produktiv-, Entwicklungs- und Testsystem, welches in die bestehende IT-Infrastruktur der Polizei SH eingebunden werden soll. Hinsichtlich der Abgrenzung der Datenintegration vom IT-gestützten Abgleich und der automatisierten Datenanalyse wird auf das beigefügte Dokument „Begriffsbestimmung Analyse und Datenintegration“ verwiesen. Weitere Einzelheiten sind dem Dokument "Teil A - Allgemeiner Teil Teilnahmewettbewerb" zu entnehmen. Das Verfahren betrifft einen Verschlusssachenauftrag gem. § 104 Abs. 3 Nr. 2 GWB bzw. Art. 2 Buchst. b u. d Richtlinie 2009/81/EG und wird nach der VSVgV durchgeführt. Berechtigt zur Teilnahme (durch Bewerbung und Angebote) sind nach der Entscheidung des öffentlichen Auftraggebers nur in einem EU-Mitgliedstaat oder Island oder Norwegen ansässige Wirtschaftsteilnehmer („Teilnahmeberechtigte“). Bewerber und Bieter dürfen in ihrer Bewerbung und ihren Angeboten keine Unterauftragnehmer vor-sehen, die in einem anderen Staat als den im vorigen Satz genannten („Drittstaat“) an-sässig sind. Dies gilt auch für die sonstige Berufung auf die Kapazitäten solcher Unter-nehmen. Für die Bestimmung der Ansässigkeit gilt die Definition der Herkunft in Art. 3 Abs. 1 der VO (EU) 2022/1031 entsprechend, für Wirtschaftsteilnehmer als Gruppen Art. 3 Abs. 2 der genannten Verordnung.

rejected.text: Αντικείμενο του παρόντος έργου αποτελεί ο συνολικός ψηφιακός μετασχηματισμός των διαδικασιών εξέτασης υποθέσεων ιθαγένειας της ΓΓΙ, μέσω της αναβάθμισης του υφιστάμενου πληροφοριακού συστήματος διαχείρισης υποθέσεων Ιθαγένειας, με στόχο να εξυπηρετούνται στο ακέραιο οι ανάγκες και να βελτιωθεί η εμπειρία χρήστη των πολιτών, του προσωπικού της ΓΓΙ καθώς και όλων των συνεργαζόμενων φορέων στα πλαίσια της συλλογής και ελέγχου των απαραίτητων εγγράφων και πληροφοριών. Οι βασικοί άξονες της αναβάθμισης του υφιστάμενου πληροφοριακού συστήματος Ιθαγένειας είναι ο εκσυγχρονισμός του συστήματος Διαχείρισης Υποθέσεων Ιθαγένειας, η υλοποίηση συστήματος Ψηφιακής Θυρίδας αιτούντα, η οποία θα επικουρείται από τα υποσυστήματα Πρόσβασης Τρίτων Υπηρεσιών, το υποσύστημα Διαχείρισης Ερωτημάτων αιτούντων, το υποσύστημα Διαχείρισης Χρηστών και το υποσύστημα Επιχειρηματικής Ευφυΐας (Business Intelligence). Το αναβαθμισμένο σύστημα Διαχείρισης Υποθέσεων Ιθαγένειας θα αποτελέσει το κεντρικό πληροφοριακό σύστημα των υπαλλήλων των υπηρεσιών της ΓΓ Ιθαγένειας για να διαχειρίζονται αποδοτικά όλη την πληροφορία (έγγραφα, δεδομένα, διαδικασίες) σχετικά με τις υποθέσεις των αιτούντων. Στην ουσία το παραπάνω σύστημα θα αναβαθμίσει το υφιστάμενο σύστημα Διαχείρισης Υποθέσεων Ιθαγένειας, επεκτείνοντας το σε λειτουργικότητα, αυτοματοποίηση, διαλειτουργικότητα και βοηθητικά εργαλεία, ταυτόχρονα αναβαθμίζοντας την ασφάλεια των δεδομένων των αιτούντων και την δυνατότητα παρέμβασης του οργανισμού σε συγκεκριμένα σημεία της διαδικασίας αξιοποιώντας τα παρεχόμενα εργαλεία παραμετροποίησης. Το αναβαθμισμένο σύστημα Διαχείρισης Υποθέσεων Ιθαγένειας, θα αντλεί πληροφορία και έγγραφα που έχουν κατατεθεί από τους ενδιαφερόμενους και από τρίτες υπηρεσίες και θα τα δρομολογεί βάσει της ισχύουσας νομοθεσίας στις επιμέρους οργανικές δομές της ΓΓΙ για να διεκπεραιωθούν τα βήματα της διαδικασίας με ενσωματωμένη δυνατότητα χρήσης ψηφιακών υπογραφών. Η Ψηφιακή Θυρίδα θα λειτουργεί ως το κεντρικό κανάλι συναλλαγών με τους αιτούντες. Μέσα από την θυρίδα ο ενδιαφερόμενος θα μπορεί να ανεβάζει ψηφιοποιημένα έγγραφα, να επικαιροποιεί υπάρχοντα αρχεία και να πραγματοποιεί αιτήματα προς τρίτες υπηρεσίες, συγκεντρώνοντας σε αυτή όλη την απαραίτητη πληροφορία, για όλη την διάρκεια που η θυρίδα του είναι ενεργή. Επιπρόσθετα, για την εξυπηρέτηση θεμάτων και πληροφόρηση των ενδιαφερόμενων σχετικά με τα αιτήματα τους, θα προσφέρεται δυνατότητα κατάθεσης ερωτημάτων στις επιμέρους υπηρεσίες της ΓΓΙ μέσω του υποσυστήματος Διαχείρισης Ερωτημάτων. Τα σύστημα θα πρωτοκολλεί τα ερωτήματα των προσώπων και θα τα προωθεί στις υπηρεσίες της ΓΓΙ για απαντηθούν. H συλλογή των απαραίτητων πληροφοριών και δικαιολογητικών από τρίτες υπηρεσίες θα διεκπεραιώνεται κυρίως μέσω διαλειτουργικότητας του συστήματος με τα πληροφοριακά συστήματα των φορέων. Για τις τρίτες υπηρεσίες που δεν διαθέτουν πληροφοριακό σύστημα που υποστηρίζει σχετική διαλειτουργικότητα θα αξιοποιείται το υποσύστημα Πρόσβαση Τρίτων υπηρεσιών. Για την επίβλεψη και αξιοποίηση των παραγόμενων δεδομένων από την εκτέλεση της διαδικασίας ιθαγένειας σε αληθινό χρόνο από τα στελέχη της ΓΓΙ, θα υλοποιηθεί υποδομή Επιχειρηματικής Ευφυΐας (Business Intelligence). Η παρούσα σύμβαση λόγω της λογικής συνέχειας των μερών της και της σημασίας της διαλειτουργικότητας μεταξύ των διαφόρων υφιστάμενων ηλεκτρονικών συστημάτων της ΓΓΙ δεν υποδιαιρείται σε τμήματα. Προσφορές υποβάλλονται μόνον για το σύνολο του ενιαίου αντικειμένου. Η εκτιμώμενη αξία της παρούσας σύμβασης ανέρχεται στο ποσό των 3.426.000,00 €, μη περιλαμβανομένου ΦΠΑ, προϋπολογισμός με ΦΠΑ: 4.248.240,00 €, ΦΠΑ 24%: 822.240,00€). Μετά τη σύναψη της αρχικής σύμβασης, κατά την υλοποίηση του έργου και πριν τη λήξη της σύμβασης, η Αναθέτουσα Αρχή δύναται να αποφασίσει την άσκηση δικαιώματος προαίρεσης με αύξηση του φυσικού αντικειμένου του έργου (όπως αυτό περιγράφεται στην παρούσα) έως δεκαοχτώ τοις εκατό ( 18%) του συμβατικού τιμήματος, ήτοι έως του ποσού των 616.680,00€, μη περιλαμβανομένου ΦΠΑ, προϋπολογισμός με ΦΠΑ: 764.683,20 €, ΦΠΑ 24%: 148.003,20 €.
