result.text: The subject of this project is the comprehensive digital transformation of the citizenship case examination procedures of the General Secretariat for Citizenship (GSC), through the upgrade of the existing Citizenship Case Management Information System, with the aim of fully serving the needs and improving the user experience of citizens, GSC staff and all collaborating bodies in the context of collecting and checking the necessary documents and information. The main axes of the upgrade of the existing Citizenship Information System are the modernisation of the Citizenship Case Management system, the implementation of an applicant Digital Locker system, which will be supported by the Third-Party Services Access subsystems, the applicant Queries Management subsystem, the User Management subsystem and the Business Intelligence subsystem. The upgraded Citizenship Case Management system will constitute the central information system for the staff of the GSC services to efficiently manage all information (documents, data, procedures) relating to applicants' cases. In essence, the above system will upgrade the existing Citizenship Case Management system, expanding it in terms of functionality, automation, interoperability and auxiliary tools, while simultaneously upgrading the security of applicants' data and the organisation's ability to intervene at specific points in the procedure by utilising the provided parameterisation tools. The upgraded Citizenship Case Management system will draw information and documents submitted by interested parties and third-party services and route them, based on current legislation, to the individual organisational structures of the GSC to process the steps of the procedure with an integrated digital signature capability. The Digital Locker will operate as the central transaction channel with applicants. Through the locker, the interested party will be able to upload digitised documents, update existing files and make requests to third-party services, gathering all necessary information within it for the entire duration that their locker is active. Additionally, to serve issues and inform interested parties regarding their requests, the capability of submitting queries to the individual GSC services will be offered through the Queries Management subsystem. The system will register the individuals' queries and forward them to the GSC services to be answered. The collection of necessary information and supporting documents from third-party services will be carried out mainly through the system's interoperability with the bodies' information systems. For third-party services that do not have an information system supporting relevant interoperability, the Third-Party Services Access subsystem will be utilised. To supervise and utilise the data generated from the execution of the citizenship procedure in real time by GSC executives, a Business Intelligence infrastructure will be implemented. This contract, due to the logical continuity of its parts and the importance of interoperability between the various existing electronic systems of the GSC, is not subdivided into lots. Tenders are submitted only for the entirety of the single subject matter. The estimated value of this contract amounts to the sum of 3.426.000,00 €, excluding VAT, budget including VAT: 4.248.240,00 €, VAT 24%: 822.240,00€). Following the conclusion of the initial contract, during the implementation of the project and before the expiry of the contract, the Contracting Authority may decide to exercise an option by increasing the physical subject matter of the project (as described herein) up to eighteen percent (18%) of the contract price, i.e. up to the amount of 616.680,00€, excluding VAT, budget including VAT: 764.683,20 €, VAT 24%: 148.003,20 €. Before the expiry of the contract, the Client may decide to exercise a maintenance option up to the amount of 660.000,00 € excluding VAT, budget including VAT: 818.400,00 €, VAT 24%: 158.400,00 €), based on the Financial Tender of the Candidate Contractor, for maintenance services (as described in APPENDIX VI – FINANCIAL TENDER MODEL). Consequently, the total maximum estimated value of the contract, including the options as mentioned above, amounts to the sum of 4.702.680,00€, excluding VAT, budget including VAT: 5.831.323,20 €, VAT 24%: 1.128.643,20 €. The exercise of the aforementioned options is conditional upon the approval of their financing. The duration of the contract is set at thirty-one (31) months. A detailed description of the physical and financial subject matter of the contract is given in APPENDIX I of this tender notice. The contract will be awarded on the basis of the most economically advantageous tender, using the best price-quality ratio. [para. 1.3 & APPENDIX I of the Tender Notice]

parts.source: Αντικείμενο του παρόντος έργου αποτελεί ο συνολικός ψηφιακός μετασχηματισμός των διαδικασιών εξέτασης υποθέσεων ιθαγένειας της ΓΓΙ, μέσω της αναβάθμισης του υφιστάμενου πληροφοριακού συστήματος διαχείρισης υποθέσεων Ιθαγένειας, με στόχο να εξυπηρετούνται στο ακέραιο οι ανάγκες και να βελτιωθεί η εμπειρία χρήστη των πολιτών, του προσωπικού της ΓΓΙ καθώς και όλων των συνεργαζόμενων φορέων στα πλαίσια της συλλογής και ελέγχου των απαραίτητων εγγράφων και πληροφοριών. Οι βασικοί άξονες της αναβάθμισης του υφιστάμενου πληροφοριακού συστήματος Ιθαγένειας είναι ο εκσυγχρονισμός του συστήματος Διαχείρισης Υποθέσεων Ιθαγένειας, η υλοποίηση συστήματος Ψηφιακής Θυρίδας αιτούντα, η οποία θα επικουρείται από τα υποσυστήματα Πρόσβασης Τρίτων Υπηρεσιών, το υποσύστημα Διαχείρισης Ερωτημάτων αιτούντων, το υποσύστημα Διαχείρισης Χρηστών και το υποσύστημα Επιχειρηματικής Ευφυΐας (Business Intelligence). Το αναβαθμισμένο σύστημα Διαχείρισης Υποθέσεων Ιθαγένειας θα αποτελέσει το κεντρικό πληροφοριακό σύστημα των υπαλλήλων των υπηρεσιών της ΓΓ Ιθαγένειας για να διαχειρίζονται αποδοτικά όλη την πληροφορία (έγγραφα, δεδομένα, διαδικασίες) σχετικά με τις υποθέσεις των αιτούντων. Στην ουσία το παραπάνω σύστημα θα αναβαθμίσει το υφιστάμενο σύστημα Διαχείρισης Υποθέσεων Ιθαγένειας, επεκτείνοντας το σε λειτουργικότητα, αυτοματοποίηση, διαλειτουργικότητα και βοηθητικά εργαλεία, ταυτόχρονα αναβαθμίζοντας την ασφάλεια των δεδομένων των αιτούντων και την δυνατότητα παρέμβασης του οργανισμού σε συγκεκριμένα σημεία της διαδικασίας αξιοποιώντας τα παρεχόμενα εργαλεία παραμετροποίησης. Το αναβαθμισμένο σύστημα Διαχείρισης Υποθέσεων Ιθαγένειας, θα αντλεί πληροφορία και έγγραφα που έχουν κατατεθεί από τους ενδιαφερόμενους και από τρίτες υπηρεσίες και θα τα δρομολογεί βάσει της ισχύουσας νομοθεσίας στις επιμέρους οργανικές δομές της ΓΓΙ για να διεκπεραιωθούν τα βήματα της διαδικασίας με ενσωματωμένη δυνατότητα χρήσης ψηφιακών υπογραφών. Η Ψηφιακή Θυρίδα θα λειτουργεί ως το κεντρικό κανάλι συναλλαγών με τους αιτούντες. Μέσα από την θυρίδα ο ενδιαφερόμενος θα μπορεί να ανεβάζει ψηφιοποιημένα έγγραφα, να επικαιροποιεί υπάρχοντα αρχεία και να πραγματοποιεί αιτήματα προς τρίτες υπηρεσίες, συγκεντρώνοντας σε αυτή όλη την απαραίτητη πληροφορία, για όλη την διάρκεια που η θυρίδα του είναι ενεργή. Επιπρόσθετα, για την εξυπηρέτηση θεμάτων και πληροφόρηση των ενδιαφερόμενων σχετικά με τα αιτήματα τους, θα προσφέρεται δυνατότητα κατάθεσης ερωτημάτων στις επιμέρους υπηρεσίες της ΓΓΙ μέσω του υποσυστήματος Διαχείρισης Ερωτημάτων. Τα σύστημα θα πρωτοκολλεί τα ερωτήματα των προσώπων και θα τα προωθεί στις υπηρεσίες της ΓΓΙ για απαντηθούν. H συλλογή των απαραίτητων πληροφοριών και δικαιολογητικών από τρίτες υπηρεσίες θα διεκπεραιώνεται κυρίως μέσω διαλειτουργικότητας του συστήματος με τα πληροφοριακά συστήματα των φορέων. Για τις τρίτες υπηρεσίες που δεν διαθέτουν πληροφοριακό σύστημα που υποστηρίζει σχετική διαλειτουργικότητα θα αξιοποιείται το υποσύστημα Πρόσβαση Τρίτων υπηρεσιών. Για την επίβλεψη και αξιοποίηση των παραγόμενων δεδομένων από την εκτέλεση της διαδικασίας ιθαγένειας σε αληθινό χρόνο από τα στελέχη της ΓΓΙ, θα υλοποιηθεί υποδομή Επιχειρηματικής Ευφυΐας (Business Intelligence). Η παρούσα σύμβαση λόγω της λογικής συνέχειας των μερών της και της σημασίας της διαλειτουργικότητας μεταξύ των διαφόρων υφιστάμενων ηλεκτρονικών συστημάτων της ΓΓΙ δεν υποδιαιρείται σε τμήματα. Προσφορές υποβάλλονται μόνον για το σύνολο του ενιαίου αντικειμένου. The subject of this tender is the further development of the existing open-source low-code platform Limbas into an open, intuitive development environment for the Hessian administration (OSLOCO-Hessen). result.text: Framework Agreement for the Call-Off Provision of Associate Trainers: Digital Skills, Management Skills, Marketing including digital marketing and social media, Communication and Soft Skills, Health and Safety, Construction and Trade, Training and Assessment, Care, Mindfulness and Wellbeing, HR Training, Procurement, Tendering and bid writing, Accountancy systems, Visual Merchandising, Customer Service and Retail Optimisation Lot 1: Digital Skills. Digital skills, Artificial intelligence (AI) and automation skills, data literacy and data management, digital transformation and innovation capability, cybersecurity skills, digital marketing and e-commerce. With the acceleration of digital, the following are also subject areas that are in high demand: Digital skills focus on strong digital communication and collaboration abilities alongside cloud and productivity fundamentals. Artificial intelligence (AI) and automation skills centre on understanding foundational and responsible AI principles as well as applying process automation tools. Data literacy and data management priorities include the ability to interpret and visualise data effectively and uphold good data governance and ethics. Digital transformation and innovation capability requires skills in digital strategy and change leadership, paired with service design and user centred design approaches. Cybersecurity skills focus on building strong cyber hygiene and user awareness, supported by basic risk management and incident response knowledge. Digital marketing and e commerce emphasise SEO and analytics, combined with content creation and digital advertising to drive engagement and growth. Accredited and non-accredited opportunities ranging from SCQF5 and above requested. Training in widely used, industry standard digital tools- such as Microsoft Teams, OneNote for collaborative working, and digital bookkeeping platforms - is also in high demand. Lot 2: Management Skills. Strategic leadership & future planning, workforce development & talent management, change management and digital adoption, people, leadership & wellbeing management, operational & performance management. Businesses require managers who can demonstrate strong strategic leadership and future planning, workforce development and talent management, change management and digital adoption, people focused leadership and wellbeing management, and effective operational and performance management. Building these capabilities ensures leaders can respond to rapid technological change, manage skills gaps, and support resilient, high performing teams. Training should develop practical management capabilities including project management, change management, managing through crisis situations, supervising hybrid or home based teams, leading and motivating others, and building strong supervisory skills. Programmes should also strengthen interpersonal and developmental capabilities such as assertiveness, change and recovery management, coaching skills, developing individuals, and Insights Discovery profiling to support self awareness and team effectiveness. These subject areas are designed for new supervisors, emerging managers, and those seeking to upskill for career progression. Both accredited and non accredited options should be available. Non accredited workshops can be delivered as half day or full day sessions and should be contextualised to the specific needs of the business, particularly for bespoke contracts or sector specific requirements. Lot 3: Marketing. result.text: The Messe Berlin GmbH, hereinafter also referred to as Messe Berlin (MB) and the Contracting Authority (CA), is issuing a call for tenders for the following service: IP Address Management (DDI), CP1-2025-0019. The subject of this procurement is the provision, implementation and operation of a physical appliance for DHCP/DNS/IP address management. With the appliance being tendered, the Messe Berlin GmbH intends to position itself for the future in the field of network technology. The Messe Berlin GmbH is therefore seeking a dedicated IP address management solution as a complete DDI system with which the administration of DHCP ranges and DNS management can be made simpler and clearer. Due to the group's goal of further expanding its cloud architecture, it will also be necessary at a later date to introduce a central IP address management system in order to improve the overall overview of assigned IP addresses and to standardise overall management. The following service items are involved: - Hardware: Complete solution incl. maintenance - Software: DDI - Application - Maintenance (servicing, inspection, repair): Incident management (3rd level) + request + change management - Consulting service: Further development of the application at the customer's request - Implementation service: Delivery, commissioning, individual adjustments according to requirements, handover to operations incl. complete documentation (technical + user)

parts.source: Die Messe Berlin GmbH, im Folgenden gleichbedeutend auch Messe Berlin (MB) und Auftraggeber (AG) genannt, schreibt folgende Leistung aus: IP-Adressmanagement (DDI), CP1-2025-0019. Gegenstand dieser Vergabe ist die Bereitstellung, die Implementierung und der Betrieb einer physikalischen Appliance für DHCP/DNS/IP-Adressmanagement. Mit der ausgeschriebenen Appliance möchte sich die Messe Berlin GmbH künftig weiter zukunftssi-cher im Bereich der Netzwerktechnik aufstellen. Die Messe Berlin GmbH sucht deshalb, eine dedi-zierte IP-Adressmanagement-Lösung als Komplettsystem DDI mit welcher die Verwaltung der DHCP-Bereiche, sowie die DNS-Verwaltung einfacher und übersichtlicher gestaltet werden soll. Auf-grund des Konzerns-Ziel des weiteren Ausbau der Cloudarchitektur ist es zu einem späteren Zeit-punkt auch notwendig ein zentrales IP-Adress-Management einzuführen, um den Gesamtüberblick der vergebenen IP-Adressen zu verbessern und das gesamtheitliche Management zu vereinheitlichen. Es handelt sich um folgende Leistungsgegenstände: - Hardware: Komplettlösung inkl. Maintenance - Software: DDI - Anwendung - Instandhaltung (Wartung, Inspektion, Instandsetzung): Incident-Management (3rd Lvl) + Request + Change-Management - Beratungsleistung: Weiterentwicklungen der Applikation auf Kundenwunsch - Implementierungsleistung: Lieferung, Inbetriebnahme, individuelle Anpassungen gemäß Anforderung, Übergabe in den Betrieb inkl. vollständiger Dokumentationen (technisch + Anwender)

rejected.text: This is a special Notice of Funding Opportunity Announcement (NOFO) sponsored by the Air Force Office of Scientific Research (AFOSR), which will hereafter generally be referred to as “we”, “us”, “our”, or “AFOSR.” The Fiscal Year 2027 Air Force Young Investigator Research Program (YIP) intends to support individual early career scientists and engineers who have received their Ph.D. or equivalent degrees by 01 April 2019 or later showing exceptional ability and promise for conducting basic research. The program objective is to foster creative basic research in science and engineering; enhance early career development of outstanding young investigators; and increase opportunities for the young investigators to recognise the Air Force and Space Force mission and related challenges in science and engineering. Individual awards are made to U.S. institutions of higher education, industrial laboratories, for-profit, or non-profit research organisations where the principal investigator (PI) is employed on a full-time basis and holds a regular, non-contractor position. A YIP PI must be a U.S. citizen, national, or permanent resident. Researchers working at a Federally Funded Research and Development Center (FFRDC), or a Department of War (DoW) Laboratory are not eligible for this competition. YIP awards are funded up to $150,000 per year for three years, for a total of $450,000. No single year may exceed $150,000. Please review the remainder of this announcement for additional information. Under this competition, an anticipated thirty-seven (37) traditionally funded YIPs and three (3) YIPs funded in partnership with the Laboratory for Physical Sciences (LPS) in the Quantum Information Sciences research discipline may be awarded. There may be potential for an additional 37 YIPs funded from other AFOSR research funding. All actions are based on the availability of funds. Proposers are encouraged to confer with the designated AFOSR Program Officer(s) prior to submitting a full proposal. We will evaluate proposals using an internal review panel. AFOSR reserves the right to select and fund all, some, or none of the proposals from any of the topics below. AFOSR provides no funding for direct reimbursement of proposal development costs. Technical and budget proposals (or any other material) submitted in response to this NOFO will not be returned. It is the policy of AFOSR to treat all white papers and proposals submitted under this NOFO as sensitive competitive information and to disclose their contents only for the purposes of evaluation. White papers briefly summarising the proposed institution’s ideas are required. Submit white papers to our whitepaper portal, which is linked below. The topic points of contact (POCs) will coordinate to provide feedback on the white papers. The proposals will need to include a data management plan, outlining how samples and data collected in the program will be stored and managed. This includes but is not restricted to issues such as standards for data and metadata collection, content and format, data archiving, database management, and data sharing within, outside the awardee and beyond the lifetime of the grant. This precondition is modelled on the National Science Foundation Data Management Plan requirement (e.g., https://www.nsf.gov/eng/data-management-plans). IMPORTANT NOTE: Applicants should be alert for any amendments that may modify the announcement. result.text: The Norwegian Defence Materiel Agency (FMA) is the contracting authority and responsible for implementing the procurement. FMA is a part of the defence sector, directly under the Ministry of Defence (FD). FMA shall ensure that the Norwegian Armed Forces and other entities in the defence sector have access to cost efficient and secure material and services in line with approved long-term plans. FMA ́s main assignments are planning, procurement, management and disposal of material for the Norwegian Armed Forces and other departments under FD. Organisational reasons can be required during the contract period to transfer the resource to Cyber Defence ́s IT Department (CIT) DRIV. DRIV is responsible for the technical operation and further development (DEVSECOPS) of the Joint Integrated Management System (FIF). FIF is a SAP ERP system integrated with a number of other different applications. Internal processes are based on flexible frameworks (Scrum, SAFE), the Security Act and different industry standards for safety and ITIL for operation. DRIV consists of approx. 150 persons, most of whom are located in Oslo. Both employees and consultants staff the organisation. The aim of this notice is to fill the role of solution expert SAP Basis in project P1160 'Critical Upgrading of ERP'. The consultant will be a part of the enabling team SAP-Basis in CIT DRIV AGM and shall take care of the role within the discipline SAP Basis. The role can involve cooperation with any other departments and/or projects in the Norwegian Armed Forces.

result.text: The subject of the framework agreement for the procurement is the provision, implementation, and configuration of a web-based, audit-proof, and configurable specialist application for the funding management of Netzwerk Universitätsmedizin NUM GmbH (NUM). The scope of services comprises in particular software provision, hosting, and technical operation by the contractor, setup and customising, data migration, interfaces, and exports including system-neutral transfer to the financial software selected at a later date, a documented API, support, maintenance, training, and documentation. The subject of the framework agreement for the procurement is the provision, implementation, and configuration of a web-based, audit-proof, and configurable software solution for the funding management of Netzwerk Universitätsmedizin GmbH (NUM). The solution must digitally map the funding processes from application through review, approval, contract creation, payment request, and interim and final reports. NUM is in an organisational transition phase. Previous processes are partially connected to existing structures of Charité, external project management agency processes, SharePoint or file shares, Excel tables, PDF documents, and easyOnline/XML data. In future, the office is to establish its own structures for processing, reviewing, and documenting funding processes. The software must support both administrative processing and review (currently the Administration, Finance, and Controlling team) and specialist processing and review (currently the Science Management team). The respective reviews take place in parallel, sequentially, or consecutively depending on the process. Input masks, checklists, review notes, task lists, and status logic must therefore be able to traceably depict both review perspectives. The software does not execute the actual payment order, bank execution, or direct retrieval from the Federal Treasury. However, it must provide the data required for forwarding the funds in a structured and system-independent manner. Since the client's financial software will only be selected after this procurement, the technical transfer must be possible via at least a documented, configurable exchange format. The concrete target format and field assignment will be agreed upon in the implementation project after the financial software is selected. The actual retrieval of financial funds from the Federal Treasury and the bank execution take place outside the software. The provision of the retrieval data package and the technical implementation of the agreed data exchange are part of the scope of services. The subject of the tender is an integrated specialist application for funding management with which administrative and specialist review, processing, and decision-making processes can be fully digitally mapped. Document management is a central component of this specialist application and must ensure the process-related linking, structured storage, versioning, management, and retrievability of documents. What is being sought is therefore neither a pure document repository nor an isolated form system, but an end-to-end funding management solution. Insofar as products, procedures, or manufacturers are named in this specification of services, this is done exclusively to describe the required scope of services; equivalent solutions are permitted. Existing target systems of the client determined before publication, or those determined prior to publication, are clearly named in the procurement documents, including the required integration scope.

parts.source: Gegenstand des Rahmenvertrags der Beschaffung ist die Bereitstellung, Einführung und Konfiguration einer webbasierten, revisionssicheren und konfigurierbaren Fachanwendung für das Fördermittelmanagement des Netzwerk Universitätsmedizin NUM GmbH (NUM). Der Leistungsumfang umfasst insbesondere Softwarebereitstellung, Hosting und technischen Betrieb durch den Auftragnehmer, Einrichtung und Customizing, Datenmigration, Schnittstellen und Exporte einschließlich der systemneutralen Übergabe an die später ausgewählte Finanzsoftware, eine dokumentierte API, Support, Wartung, Schulung und Dokumentation. Gegenstand des Rahmenvertrags der Beschaffung ist die Bereitstellung, Einführung und Konfiguration einer webbasierten, revisionssicheren und konfigurierbaren Softwarelösung für das Fördermittelmanagement der Netzwerk Universitätsmedizin GmbH (NUM). Die Lösung soll die Förderprozesse vom Antrag über Prüfung, Bewilligung, Vertragserstellung, Zahlungsanforderung sowie Zwischen-und Verwendungsnachweis digital abbilden. Die NUM befindet sich in einer organisatorischen Übergangsphase. Bisherige Prozesse sind teilweise an bestehende Strukturen der Charité, externe Projektträgerprozesse, SharePointbzw. Dateiablagen, ExcelTabellen, PDFDokumente sowie easyOnline/XMLDaten angebunden. Künftig soll die Geschäftsstelle eigene Strukturen zur Bearbeitung, Prüfung und Dokumentation von Förderprozessen etablieren. Die Software muss sowohl die administrative Bearbeitung und Prüfung (derzeit Team Administration, Finanzen und Controlling) als auch die fachliche Bearbeitung und Prüfung (derzeit Team Wissenschaftsmanagement) unterstützen. Die jeweiligen Prüfungen erfolgen abhängig vom Prozess parallel, sequentiell oder aufeinander aufbauend. Eingabemasken, Checklisten, Prüfvermerke, Aufgabenlisten und Statuslogiken müssen daher beide Prüfperspektiven nachvollziehbar abbilden können. Die Software führt weder die tatsächliche Zahlungsanweisung noch die Bankausführung oder den unmittelbaren Abruf bei der Bundeskasse aus. Sie muss jedoch die für die Weiterleitung der Mittel erforderlichen Daten strukturiert und systemunabhängig bereitstellen. Da die Finanzsoftware des Auftraggebers erst nach dieser Vergabe ausgewählt wird, muss die technische Übergabe mindestens über ein dokumentiertes, konfigurierbares Austauschformat möglich sein. Das konkrete Zielformat und die Feldbelegung werden nach Auswahl der Finanzsoftware im Einführungsprojekt abgestimmt. Der tatsächliche Abruf von Finanzmitteln bei der Bundeskasse und die Bankausführung erfolgen außerhalb der Software. Die Bereitstellung des Abrufdatenpakets und die technische Umsetzung des abgestimmten Datenaustauschs sind Bestandteil des Leistungsumfangs. Gegenstand der Ausschreibung ist eine integrierte Fachanwendung für das Fördermittelmanagement, mit der die administrativen und fachlichen Prüf, Bearbeitungs- und Entscheidungsprozesse vollständig digital abgebildet werden können. Das Dokumentenmanagement ist zentraler Bestandteil dieser Fachanwendung und muss die vorgangsbezogene Verknüpfung, strukturierte Ablage, Versionierung, Verwaltung und Wiederauffindbarkeit von Dokumenten sicherstellen. Gesucht wird damit weder eine reine Dokumentenablage noch ein isoliertes Formularsystem, sondern eine durchgängige Fördermittelmanagementlösung. Soweit in dieser Leistungsbeschreibung Produkte, Verfahren oder Hersteller genannt werden, geschieht dies ausschließlich zur Beschreibung des geforderten Leistungsumfangs? gleichwertige Lösungen sind zugelassen. Bestehende beziehungsweise vor Veröffentlichung festgelegte Zielsysteme des Auftraggebers werden in den Vergabeunterlagen einschließlich des erforderlichen Integrationsumfangs eindeutig benannt.

Lot LOT-0001: Large sample sizes. Lot 1 is intended for studies with large sample sizes and should therefore go to a contractor that can demonstrate a corresponding panel size and quality with regular master data maintenance. This primarily concerns studies that are conducted in an online-representative manner with at least n=1.000 respondents. The implementation of tracking studies is also conceivable here. The contractor must ensure that representative surveys are possible not only for Germany as a whole but also for the broadcasting areas of the ARD regional broadcasting corporations (at least the larger broadcasting areas: BR - Bavaria; hr - Hesse; MDR - Saxony-Anhalt, Saxony, Thuringia; NDR - Lower Saxony, Hamburg, Schleswig-Holstein, Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania; RBB - Berlin, Brandenburg; SWR - Baden-Württemberg, Rhineland-Palatinate; WDR - North Rhine-Westphalia). Lot LOT-0002: QuickSurveys. Lot 2 is intended for studies that require quick and uncomplicated implementation. This primarily concerns format and pilot tests in which stimuli are used. The target groups do not necessarily have to be online-representative, but the contractor must ensure that surveys are possible not only for Germany as a whole but also for the broadcasting areas of the ARD regional broadcasting corporations (at least the larger broadcasting areas: BR - Bavaria; hr - Hesse; MDR - Saxony-Anhalt, Saxony, Thuringia; NDR - Lower Saxony, Hamburg, Schleswig-Holstein, Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania; RBB - Berlin, Brandenburg; SWR - Baden-Württemberg, Rhineland-Palatinate; WDR - North Rhine-Westphalia). The surveys should not last longer than 15 minutes. The sample sizes will vary between n=100 and n=2.000. Decisive factors here are field times, stimuli integration, smooth programming, and data quality.

Los 1 ist für Studien mit großen Fallzahlen vorgesehen und sollte daher an einen Auftragnehmer gehen, der eine entsprechende Panel-Größe und -Qualität mit einer regelmäßigen Stammdatenpflege vorweisen kann. Hier geht es vorrangig um Studien, die online-repräsentativ mit mindestens n=1.000 Befragten durchgeführt werden. Vorstellbar ist hier auch die Durchführung von Tracking-Studien. Der Auftragnehmer muss sicherstellen, dass repräsentative Umfragen außer für Deutschland insgesamt auch für die Sendegebiete der ARD-Landesrundfunkanstalten (zumindest die größeren Sendegebiete: BR - Bayern; hr - Hessen; MDR - Sachsen-Anhalt, Sachsen, Thüringen; NDR - Niedersachsen, Hamburg, Schleswig-Holstein, Mecklenburg-Vorpommern; RBB - Berlin, Brandenburg; SWR - Baden-Württemberg, Rheinland-Pfalz; WDR - Nordrhein-Westfalen) möglich sind. Lot LOT-0002: QuickSurveys. Los 2 ist für Studien vorgesehen, die einer schnellen und unkomplizierten Umsetzung bedürfen. Hier geht es vorrangig um Format- und Pilottests, in denen Stimuli eingesetzt werden. Die Zielgruppen müssen nicht zwingend online-repräsentativ sein, aber der Auftragnehmer muss sicherstellen, dass Umfragen außer für Deutschland insgesamt auch für die Sendegebiete der ARD-Landesrundfunkanstalten (zumindest die größeren Sendegebiete BR -Bayern; hr - Hessen; MDR - Sachsen-Anhalt, Sachsen, Thüringen; NDR - Niedersachsen, Hamburg, Schleswig-Holstein, Mecklenburg-Vorpommern; RBB - Berlin, Brandenburg; SWR - Baden-Württemberg, Rheinland-Pfalz; WDR - Nordrhein-Westfalen) möglich sind. Die Befragungen sollen nicht länger als 15 Minuten dauern. Die Stichprobengrößen werden zwischen n=100 und n=2.000 variieren. Entscheidende Faktoren sind hier Feldzeiten, Stimuli-Einbindung, reibungslose Programmierung und Datenqualität.

result.text: Bergen municipality shall procure a new financial system, delivered as a cloud service. The new system shall replace the current financial system (UNIT4 ERP, UBW Economy), which the municipality has used since 2003. The contract also includes operation/management, further development and user support. The new financial system shall cover the municipality ́s need for finance, accounts, incoming and outgoing invoices and project accounts. Areas that the financial system shall support are: Accounts, including registration and bookkeeping, remittance, asset management and duty management. Outgoing invoices, including invoicing, income management and follow-up of payment. Incoming invoices, including invoice receipt, invoice processing, invoice matching, processing deviations and following-up payments. Project accounts, including hourly registration, administration and follow-up of projects and the generation of the invoice basis. Performance management and reporting, as well as financial insight and control. Register and master data, such as, for example, the customer register, supplier register and site register. Integrations and exchange of data between different systems. A change of system involves a great opportunity for Bergen municipality to get an ICT system, which not only covers basic functionality for the financial area, but supports modern and efficient financial processes and that ensures the best possible utilisation of the resources. Tenderers shall offer services and systems/cloud services that cover the needs and requirements stated in the SSA-Cloud agreement with annexes and annexes. Bergen municipality would also like additional services such as consultancy services/consultancy services, training services beyond the need for establishing the service and options for expanded user support. The contracting authority for the procurement is Bergen municipality, c/o the City Council Department for Finance.

result.text: BackgroundAs part of the work of strengthening innovation capacity, Drammen municipality facilitates streamlining of the work processes through increased use of technology and automation. This applies for both service production and in internal processes. By adopting new methods and tools, the municipality would like to form the basis for continual improvement and development, and the implementation of a new administrative management system (ERP) is an important part of this process. The municipal executive has implemented a preliminary project for the procurement of a new administrative management system (ERP). The objective of the project is to procure a new ERP system that supports the national and municipality ́s digitalisation strategy in the best possible way: Phase out older technology, processes and systems that hinder effective digitalisation Developer and introduces secure and user-friendly digital solutionsForces work on automation of processes by using technologyUser data to create more efficient service Forces cooperation with the supplier industry on the development of future services Developer municipality ́s organisational ability for digital transformationDay's ERP system includes, among other things, finance/accounts, project management, wages, personnel, logistics and procurements. In addition the system is integrated with a number of surrounding trade systems. The final scope for the new system has not yet been decided, and we would like input on this in the market dialogue. The market dialogue framework municipality invites ERP platform suppliers and implementation partners to a market dialogue for a new ERP system. The aim of the market dialogue is to form the basis for a good procurement process, increase the predictability of suppliers, attract more tenderers and strengthen the competition. The following days are set aside for individual supplier meetings: 04.12.202505.12.2025 Invitation with agenda will be sent out after the deadline for registering their interest in participating in the process. See annex 1 in the documents for an invitation to the supplier conference.

result.text: Negotiated procedure without prior call for competition. The delivery can only be carried out by a specific economic operator for the following reasons: absence of competition for technical reasons. Explanation: The award of the procurement of passenger counting sensors and the necessary adjustments to the MOBILEguide software can only be carried out by INIT GmbH, as there is no competition for technical reasons in accordance with § 13 paragraph 2 no. 3 b) SektVO. The defined requirements in their extensive abundance and combination cannot be met by any other potential tenderers. In this case, only INIT GmbH is able to fulfil the listed requirements. The on-board computers used on Rheinbahn vehicles originate from the company INIT GmbH. Only the company INIT GmbH possesses the necessary technical knowledge to carry out any system additions to the on-board computer software in order to be able to connect these to the central component of the ITCS of the Rheinbahn AG. In the absence of generally binding standardisation, the software of the central component of an ITCS and the software of the on-board computers used on vehicles in public transport only possess the same processes if they are procured from the same system manufacturer. The processes are manufacturer-specific standards and as such are subject to trade secrets; they are therefore not generally and freely available. In this regard, the company INIT GmbH possesses a unique selling point due to the existing on-board computers at Rheinbahn, which must be included. In the absence of generally binding standardisation, a bidirectional interface between the central ITCS and the on-board computers used on the vehicles as a mobile component of an ITCS is only fully functional if the participating interface partners are procured from the same system manufacturer. The interface is a manufacturer-specific standard and as such is subject to trade secrets; it is therefore not generally and freely available. In this regard, the company INIT GmbH possesses a unique selling point due to the existing on-board computers at Rheinbahn, which must be included. As a result of the examination for the procurement of the central components of the ITCS, it must be determined that the company INIT GmbH possesses a unique selling point regarding mandatory requirements to be fulfilled for the services to be procured. Consequently, a public call for competition would be misleading and the associated effort would be temporally and economically inappropriate for all market participants. The procurement law limits of the public contracting authority's freedom to define the scope of services are adhered to, provided that the definition is objectively justified by the subject matter of the contract, the contracting authority has provided comprehensible objective, contract-related and actually existing reasons for this, and the definition does not discriminate against other economic operators. An artificial and therefore impermissible restriction of competition does not exist. The date of the conclusion of the contract with INIT GmbH cannot be entered, as this day is only possible 10 calendar days after the publication of this notice. The procurement office cannot determine exactly at the time of entry when the period of 10 calendar days begins, as the publication is carried out by the Official Journal and generally takes several days that cannot be precisely determined. The procurement office therefore points out that the conclusion of the contract between the Rheinbahn AG and INIT GmbH will take place 10 days after the publication of this notice. Precise information on the deadlines for lodging appeals: §160 para. 3 GWB reads: The application is inadmissible insofar as 1. the applicant has identified the asserted infringement of procurement regulations before submitting the review application and has not complained about it to the contracting authority within a period of ten calendar days; the expiry of the period according to § 134 paragraph 2 remains unaffected, 2. infringements of procurement regulations that are recognisable from the notice are not complained about to the contracting authority by the expiry of the deadline for application or submission of tenders specified in the notice, 3. infringements of procurement regulations that only become recognisable in the procurement documents are not complained about to the contracting authority by the expiry of the deadline for application or submission of tenders, 4. more than 15 calendar days have passed since receipt of the notification from the contracting authority that it does not intend to remedy a complaint. Sentence 1 does not apply to an application for a declaration of the ineffectiveness of the contract according to § 135 paragraph 1 number 2. § 134 paragraph 1 sentence 2 remains unaffected. Name and address of the contractor: Official name: INIT GmbH Postal address: Käppelestraße 4-10; Town: Karlsruhe NUTS code: Karlsruhe Postal code: 76131 Country: Germany Internet address: https://www.initse.com/

parts.source: Verhandlungsverfahren ohne vorherigen Aufruf zum Wettbewerb. Die Lieferung kann ausfolgenden Gründen nur von einem bestimmten Wirtschaftsteilnehmer ausgeführt werden: nicht vorhandener Wettbewerb aus technischen Gründen. Erläuterung: Eine Vergabe der Beschaffung von Fahrgastzählsensoren sowie der erforderlichen Anpassungen in der Software MOBILEguide ist nur an die INIT GmbH durchführbar, da aus technischen Gründen kein Wettbewerb gemäß § 13 Absatz 2 Nr. 3 b) SektVO vorhanden ist. Die definierten Anforderungen in ihrer umfangreichreichen Fülle und Kombination sind durch keine anderen potenziellen Bieter möglich. Vorliegend vermag nur die INIT GmbH die aufgeführten Anforderungen zu erfüllen. Von der Firma INIT GmbH stammen die auf den Fahrzeugen der Rheinbahn eingesetzten Bordrechner. Nur die Firma INIT GmbH verfügt über die notwendigen technischen Kenntnisse, eventuelle Systemergänzungen der Software der Bordrechner vorzunehmen, um diese an die zentrale Komponente des ITCS der Rheinbahn AG anbinden zu können. Mangels allgemeinverbindlicher Normung verfügen nur dann die Software der zentralen Komponente eines ITCS und die Software der Bordrechner, die auf den im ÖPNV eingesetzten Fahrzeugen eingesetzt werden, über die gleichen Prozesse, wenn sie vom gleichen Systemhersteller beschafft werden. Die Prozesse sind herstellerspezifische Standards und unterliegen als solche dem Betriebsgeheimnis; sie sind mithin nicht allgemein und frei verfügbar. Die Firma INIT GmbH verfügt diesbezüglich - wegen der bereits vorhandenen Bordrechner bei der Rheinbahn, die zwingend einzubeziehen sind - über ein Alleinstellungsmerkmal. result.text: Danmarks Nationalbank (the Customer) seeks to establish a framework agreement with one Supplier for the provision of specialized cybersecurity advisory and assessment services. As the operator and overseer of critical financial infrastructure in Denmark, Danmarks Nationalbank supports essential processes and systems that require a high level of security, resilience, and trust. The Customer continuously introduces new technologies, vendors, services and architectural changes that may impact its security posture. To ensure informed decision-making and maintain an appropriate level of cyber resilience, the Customer seeks access to independent technical experts capable of evaluating cybersecurity risks from an adversarial perspective. The purpose of the agreement is to provide the Customer with on-demand access to highly skilled technical cybersecurity experts with offensive security backgrounds, capable of delivering rapid, pragmatic and risk-based assessments of new technologies, systems, solutions, architectures and security-related questions. The service shall complement the Customer's internal cybersecurity capabilities by providing independent expert judgement, specialized technical expertise and threat-informed analysis to support secure decision-making, risk management and operational resilience. The Supplier shall provide access to cybersecurity specialists with relevant expertise across infrastructure, cloud, applications, identity and access management, emerging technologies, adversarial techniques and offensive security methodologies.

rejected.text: Digitalisation of invoice processing in relation to billing processes in accordance with § 302 SGB V and § 105 SGB XI. The AOK Baden-Württemberg (hereinafter: AOK BW or contracting authority) is a body governed by public law with joint self-administration by insured persons and employer representatives. It is divided into 14 district administrations and the head office in Stuttgart and insures over 4,6 million people in the state of Baden-Württemberg. To further increase efficiency in the processes, invoice processing is to be digitalised. Specifically affected are the billing processes in accordance with § 302 SGB V and § 105 SGB XI. The currently practised workflows differ according to the type of documents transmitted. In around 80-85 % of cases, a data record with a collective invoice is transmitted. In this case, invoice verification by the personnel employed by the AOK Baden-Württemberg is difficult, as the invoice receipts cannot be directly assigned to a file. Around 10 % of cases are purely paper-based. The remaining cases are transmitted with a structured data record and an image. The postal recipients are filled in automatically. The task of the future service provider will be to scan the paper documents and generate a single invoice together with the associated documents. The requirements of the BSI TR-03138 RESISCAN requirements catalogue must be strictly adhered to. Participation in the initiated competition requires that the requirements of the BSI TR-03138 RESISCAN requirements catalogue are met and that the future contractor either proves certification in accordance with the BSI TR-03138 RESISCAN requirements catalogue with the tender or undertakes to submit the application in relation to the services covered by the contract within two months of the award of the contract. If the certificate is not submitted within twelve months of the award of the contract, the client is entitled to immediate extraordinary termination. Details are set out in the service description.

parts.source: Digitalisierung der Rechnungsbearbeitung in Bezug auf die Abrechnungsprozesse gem. § 302 SGB V und § 105 SGB XI Die AOK Baden-Württemberg (nachfolgend: AOK BW oder Vergabestelle) ist eine Körperschaft des öffentlichen Rechts mit paritätischer Selbstverwaltung von Versicherten und Arbeitgebervertretern. Sie ist unterteilt in 14 Bezirksdirektionen und der Hauptverwaltung in Stuttgart und versichert über 4,6 Mio. Menschen im Land Baden-Württemberg. Für weitere Effizienzsteigerungen in den Prozessen soll die Rechnungsbearbeitung digitalisiert werden. Konkret betroffen sind dabei die Abrechnungsprozesse gem. § 302 SGB V und § 105 SGB XI. Die aktuell praktizierten Workflows unterscheiden sich durch die Art der übermittelten Dokumente. In rund 80-85 % der Vorgänge erfolgt eine Übermittlung eines Datensatzes mit einer Sammelrechnung. In diesem Fall ist eine Rechnungsprüfung durch das eingesetzte Personal der AOK Baden-Württemberg schwierig, da die Rechnungsbelege einer Akte nicht direkt zugeordnet werden können. Rund 10 % der Vorgänge erfolgen rein auf Papierbasis. Die übrigen Vorgänge werden mit einem strukturierten Datensatz und einem Image übermittelt. Die Postadressaten werden automatisiert ausgefüllt. Aufgabe des künftigen Dienstleisters wird es sein, die Papierdokumente einzuscannen und eine einzelne Rechnung mitsamt zugehöriger Dokumente zu erzeugen. Zwingend einzuhalten sind die Vorgaben des Anforderungskatalog der BSI TR-03138 RESISCAN. Die Teilnahme an dem eingeleiteten Wettbewerb setzt voraus, dass die sind die Vorgaben des Anforderungskatalog der BSI TR-03138 RESISCAN eingehalten werden und der künftige Auftragnehmer entweder mit dem Angebot die Zertifizierung gem. Anforderungskatalog der BSI TR-03138 RESISCAN nachweist oder sich verpflichtet, den Antrag in Bezug auf die vertragsgegenständlichen Leistungen binnen zwei Monaten nach Zuschlagserteilung zu stellen. Sollte das Zertifikat nicht binnen zwölf Monaten nach Zuschlagserteilung vorgelegt werden, ist der Auftraggeber zur sofortigen außerordentlichen Kündigung berechtigt. Details sind in der Leistungsbeschreibung dargestellt.

result.text: ITZBund requires external support for development and operational services to create a system for the implementation of Regulation (EU) 2019/1239 of the European Parliament and of the Council. The subject matter of the services to be provided is the design, development, implementation and further development, as well as the operation of the IT system "Maritime National Single Window" (MNSW). The objective is to build a future-proof, modular system landscape that fulfils the requirements of the specifications for the MNSW system 1.0 and simultaneously forms the basis for future expansions. The framework agreement is concluded for a term of 6 years (72 months). For the services of phase 1 for the creation of the MNSW system 1.0, an initial EVB-IT system contract for the MNSW system 1.0 and a corresponding initial sprint no. 1 for the MNSW system 1.0 are concluded in the course of the contract award and in parallel with the conclusion of the framework agreement. For the entire contract duration (incl. options), the maximum acceptance quantity is 10.195 person days or 81.560 person hours. Further procurement documents containing confidential or security-relevant information will only be made available to interested companies after submission of a fully completed and signed non-disclosure agreement (Annex Non-disclosure declaration service description operating platform WisIT V3.0_TLP_AMBER). The transmission of the further documents will take place only after receipt of the signed non-disclosure agreement by the awarding authority. Companies are requested to submit the completed annex in good time to enable timely submission of tenders.

parts.source: Das ITZBund benötigt externe Unterstützung bei Entwicklungs- und Betriebsleistungen zur Erstellung eines Systems zur Umsetzung der Verordnung (EU) 2019/1239 des europäischen Parlaments und des Rates. Gegenstand der zu erbringenden Leistungen ist die Konzeption, Entwicklung, Einführung und Weiterentwicklung, sowie der Betrieb des IT-Systems "Maritime National Single Window" (MNSW). Ziel ist der Aufbau einer zukunftsfähigen, modularen Systemlandschaft, die die Anforderungen des Lastenhefts zu MNSW-System 1.0 erfüllt und gleichzeitig die Grundlage für zukünftige Erweiterungen bildet. Der Rahmenvertrag wird für eine Laufzeit von 6 Jahren (72 Monaten) geschlossen. Für die Leistungen der Phase 1 zur Erstellung des MNSW-Systems 1.0 wird im Zuge der Zuschlagserteilung sowie parallel mit dem Abschluss des Rahmenvertrags ein initialer EVB-IT Systemvertrag zum MNSW-System 1.0 und ein zugehöriger initialer Sprint Nr. 1 MNSW-System 1.0 abgeschlossen. Für die gesamte Vertragslaufzeit (inkl. Optionen) beträgt die Höchstabnahmemenge 10.195 Personentage bzw. 81.560 Personenstunden. Weitere Vergabeunterlagen, die vertrauliche oder sicherheitsrelevante Informationen enthalten, werden interessierten Unternehmen erst nach Vorlage einer vollständig ausgefüllten und unterzeichneten Verschwiegenheitsvereinbarung (Anlage Verschwiegenheitserklärung Servicebeschreibung Betriebsplattform WisIT V3.0_TLP_AMBER) zur Verfügung gestellt. result.text: The present notice is not intended to initiate a procurement procedure nor to prepare one. It serves solely for market consultation. The Staatsinstitut für Schulqualität und Bildungsforschung (ISB) is conducting a market consultation in preparation for a procurement in the area of BayernCloud Schule (hereinafter: ByCS), which provides digital applications and services for the Bavarian school community. The contracting authority is examining the future provision, further development, integration and operation of a digital board application for the ByCS. The existing application is a browser-based interactive whiteboard software. The subject of the market consultation is the question of whether suitable market participants are in a position to take over, maintain, service and further develop the existing ByCS board or its code base, or to replace the existing ByCS board with another functionally and technically suitable board application. The aim of the market consultation is to obtain reliable information on solutions available on the market and fundamentally suitable for the described requirement. In particular, it is to be investigated whether an already available or adaptable board application can meet the functional, technical, data protection and operational requirements of the contracting authority and can be integrated, operated, maintained and further developed into the ByCS environment. Within the scope of the market consultation, insights are to be gained in particular as to whether and, if applicable, by whom the described services can be provided. Lot PAR-0001: Free State of Bavaria - Staatsinstitut für Schulqualität und Bildungsforschung (ISB) regarding tender for info services. The existing digital ByCS board application is a browser-based interactive whiteboard software for use in in-person and remote phases of teaching. The application was developed on behalf of the Bavarian State Ministry of Education and Cultural Affairs as a component of BayernCloud Schule and is continuously developed further. In doing so, the application is to fulfil the following criteria in particular: - Platform-independent (device types, operating system) - Browser-based - Responsive design - Offline app / PWA - GDPR-compliant design - Accessible according to WCAG - Collaboration - Very good writing feel / high quality of pen input with palm rejection - Suitable for primary schools -> Simplicity - Special school scripts integrable with individual menus - WOPI connection - Files can be saved offline - Sharing mechanism / permissions between teachers and pupils - Import/export of PDF files and images - Integration of websites and videos - Customisations to ByCS possible (design, repositories, CSP, ...) - Set square and compass - Import of GGS files (previous format) possible Within the scope of the market consultation, insights should be provided in particular on - the extent to which market participants are in a position to take over, maintain, service and further develop the existing board application; - whether other board applications suitable for school use are already available on the market; - whether such applications can meet the functional and technical requirements of the contracting authority; - whether and under what conditions an alternative application can be integrated into the ByCS environment; - what technical, operational and economic risks are associated with the different solution variants. Please contact markterkundung@abante.de by 20 September 2026, 23.59 hrs at the latest if you are interested in participating in the local market consultation. Your participation will not be remunerated. There is also no entitlement to participate in any procurement procedure that may subsequently follow. The decision as to whether a procurement procedure must be carried out is precisely what is to be brought about by the local market consultation. In your initial enquiry, please state as detailed as possible what qualifies you and what capacities you have to provide the envisaged services if the contracting authority decides on a procurement on the market. This is necessary in order to be able to assess the seriousness of the enquiry.

parts.source: Die vorliegende Bekanntmachung soll kein Vergabeverfahren einleiten und auch dieses nicht vorbereiten. Sie dient nur der Markterkundung. Das Staatsinstitut für Schulqualität und Bildungsforschung (ISB) führt eine Markterkundung zur Vorbereitung einer Beschaffung im Bereich der BayernCloud Schule (nachfolgend: ByCS) durch, welche digitale Anwendungen und Dienste für die bayerische Schulfamilie bereitstellt. Der Auftraggeber prüft die künftige Bereitstellung, Weiterentwicklung, Integration und den Be-trieb einer digitalen Board-Anwendung für die ByCS. Bei der bestehenden Anwendung handelt es sich um eine browserbasierte interaktive Tafelsoftware. Gegenstand der Markterkundung ist die Frage, ob geeignete Marktteilnehmer in der Lage sind, das bestehende ByCS-Board bzw. dessen Codebasis zu übernehmen, zu warten, zu pflegen und weiterzuentwickeln oder das bestehende ByCS-Board durch eine fachlich und technisch geeignete andere Board-Anwendung zu ersetzen. Ziel der Markterkundung ist es, belastbare Informationen über am Markt verfügbare und für den beschriebenen Bedarf grundsätzlich geeignete Lösungen zu gewinnen. Insbesondere soll untersucht werden, ob eine bereits verfügbare oder anpassbare Board-Anwendung die fachlichen, technischen, datenschutzrechtlichen und betrieblichen Anforderungen des Auftraggebers erfüllen kann und in die ByCS-Umgebung integriert, betrieben, gepflegt und weiterentwickelt werden kann. Im Rahmen der Markterkundung sollen insbesondere Erkenntnisse darüber gewonnen werden, ob und ggf. durch wen die beschriebenen Leistungen bereitgestellt werden können. Lot PAR-0001: Freistaat Bayern - Staatsinstitut für Schulqualität und Bildungsforschung (ISB) wegen Ausschreibung Infodienste. Bei der bestehenden digitalen ByCS-Board-Anwendung handelt es sich um eine browserbasierte interaktive Tafelsoftware für den Einsatz in Präsenz- und Distanzphasen des Unterrichts. Die Anwendung wurde im Auftrag des Bayerischen Staatsministeriums für Unterricht und Kultus als Bestandteil der BayernCloud Schule entwickelt und fortlaufend weiterentwickelt. Die Anwendung soll dabei insbesondere folgende Kriterien erfüllen: - Plattformunabhängig (Gerätetypen, Betriebsystem) - Browserbasiert - Responsives Design - OfflineApp/PWA - DSGVO-konforme Ausgestaltung - Barrierefrei nach WCGA - Kollaboration - Sehr gutes Schreibgefühl / hohe Qualität der Stifteingabe mit Handballenerkennung - Grundschultauglichkeit -> Simplizität - Spezielle Schulschriften mit individuellen Menüs integrierbar - WOPI-Anbindung - Dateien offline speicherbar - Teilmechanismus/Freigaben zwischen Lehrern und Schülern - Import/Export von PDF-Dateien und Bildern - Einbinden von Videos und Webseiten - Anpassungen an ByCS möglich (Design, Repositories, CSP, ...) - Geodreieck und Zirkel - Import von GGS-Files (bisheriges Format) möglich Im Rahmen der Markterkundung sollen insbesondere Erkenntnisse darüber bringen, - inwieweit Marktteilnehmer in der Lage sind, die bestehende Board-Anwendung zu über-nehmen, warten, pflegen und weiterentwickeln; - ob am Markt bereits andere, für den schulischen Einsatz geeignete Board-Anwendungen vorhanden sind; - ob solche Anwendungen die fachlichen und technischen Anforderungen des Auftraggebers erfüllen können; - ob und unter welchen Voraussetzungen eine alternative Anwendung in die ByCS-Umgebung integriert werden kann; - welche technischen, betrieblichen und wirtschaftlichen Risiken mit den unterschiedlichen Lösungsvarianten verbunden sind. Bitte wenden Sie sich bis spätestens 20. September 2026, 23.59 Uhr, an markterkundung@abante.de, wenn Sie Interesse an einer Beteiligung an der hiesigen Markterkundung haben. Eine Vergütung Ihrer Beteiligung erfolgt nicht. Auch ein Anspruch auf Beteiligung an einem u.U. sich anschließenden Vergabeverfahren besteht nicht. Die Entscheidung, ob ein Vergabeverfahren durchgeführt werden muss, soll gerade erst durch die hiesige Markterkundung herbeigeführt werden. Geben Sie in Ihrer initialen Anfrage bitte bereits möglichst detailliert an, was Sie qualifiziert und welche Kapazitäten Sie haben, um die angedachten Leistungen zu erbringen, wenn der Auftraggeber sich für eine Beschaffung am Markt entscheidet. Dies ist nötig, um die Seriosität der Anfrage beurteilen zu können.

result.text: Ards and North Down Borough Council is currently preparing to initiate a procurement process to appoint an Operating Partner for a Creative Innovation Hub in Holywood, Co.Down. The Holywood Innovation Hub is a project funded through investment from the Belfast Region City Deal (BRCD) and Ards and North Down Borough Council. It will focus on micro and small businesses within the digital, creative and screen industries: providing facilities and a secure environment to meet specific security, connectivity and technical needs. The proposed hub is intended to provide accommodation for the creative technology sector, specifically for start-up and smaller firms seeking to grow within the sector. It would also seek to provide accommodation for larger established 'anchor' tenants and potentially act as a short-term flexible base for FDI projects supported by NI Screen. The proposed hub is also intended to create an ecosystem within the creative technology sector: improving skills and employability across Ards and North Down and the overall Belfast Region City Deal (BRCD) region. A primary reason for market failure in this sector is stated as a lack of suitable accommodation. This project will address this situation, supporting the growth of firms in the digital creative sector beyond the initial 'work from home' phase. The capital funding requirement for the proposal is £8,921,200 from the BRCD, with a further contribution of £1.1m from Ards and North Down Borough Council (ANDBC), further funding is required from the private sector to unlock this funding. ANDBC intends to appoint an operator for the Innovation Hub at an early stage of project development. The operator will assume management responsibilities and associated risks as set out in the final contractual structure. The operator will be appointed prior to the procurement of the Integrated Consultancy Team (ICT) responsible for the design of the Innovation Hub, enabling operational requirements and commercial considerations to be incorporated into the design and helping to maximise the hub's long-term economic performance. Prior to initiating the procurement, the Council is undertaking an Expression of Interest (EoI) and Preliminary Market Engagement (PME) Exercise . This EoI/PME exercise is being conducted pursuant to section 16 of the Procurement Act 2023 for the purposes of: (a) developing the Council's requirements and approach to the procurement; (b) designing conditions of participation and award criteria; (c) preparing the tender notice and associated tender documents; and (d) identifying suppliers capable of performing the proposed contract. The pre-market engagement is intended to facilitate high-level conversations to identify potential interested suppliers and capabilities to inform the Council's procurement approach. A summary of the opportunity is detailed in the brochure and questionnaire documents that can be accessed via the CfT documents area (Resource ID 6717503) on the eTendersNI platform (https://etendersni.gov.uk).

parts.source: Ards and North Down Borough Council is currently preparing to initiate a procurement process to appoint an Operating Partner for a Creative Innovation Hub in Holywood, Co.Down. The Holywood Innovation Hub is a project funded through investment from the Belfast Region City Deal (BRCD) and Ards and North Down Borough Council. It will focus on micro and small businesses within the digital, creative and screen industries: providing facilities and a secure environment to meet specific security, connectivity and technical needs. The proposed hub is intended to provide accommodation for the creative technology sector, specifically for start-up and smaller firms seeking to grow within the sector. It would also seek to provide accommodation for larger established 'anchor' tenants and potentially act as a short-term flexible base for FDI projects supported by NI Screen. The proposed hub is also intended to create an ecosystem within the creative technology sector: improving skills and employability across Ards and North Down and the overall Belfast Region City Deal (BRCD) region. A primary reason for market failure in this sector is stated as a lack of suitable accommodation. This project will address this situation, supporting the growth of firms in the digital creative sector beyond the initial 'work from home' phase. The capital funding requirement for the proposal is £8,921,200 from the BRCD, with a further contribution of £1.1m from Ards and North Down Borough Council (ANDBC), further funding is required from the private sector to unlock this funding. ANDBC intends to appoint an operator for the Innovation Hub at an early stage of project development. The operator will assume management responsibilities and associated risks as set out in the final contractual structure. rejected.text: The ITZBund requires services in the area of Software Lifecycle Management (SLM) for deployed software development and project management solutions. The objective of this tender is the conclusion of a framework agreement to ensure the operation as well as the maintenance and (further) development of the existing software development and project management platform Cloud as well as ITZBund specialist applications based thereon. In addition, sovereignty is to be strengthened by expanding the Open Source tools to be procured. By Open Source, the ITZBund means software whose source code is freely available. In principle, everyone is permitted to use, analyse, modify and pass on this software free of charge and without content-related restrictions in object and source code. Requirements of the respective relevant Open Source licence, in particular regarding licence texts, copyright notices or copyleft effects, remain unaffected. The tendered services comprise services along the entire software lifecycle, in particular operational services, maintenance and support services, support services in connection with releases and rollouts, as well as demand-oriented new and further developments of existing software and software-related tools. Eligible to call off services is the contracting authority, which can call off services commissioned by its customers. The operation of the procured software products generally takes place within the ITZBund; exceptions in special individual cases allow for operation at the contracting authority's customers with their own licensing. The services mentioned at the beginning are tendered in five lots: - Lot 1: Ensuring the maintenance and (further) development of the deployed software development and project management platform Cloud - Lot 2: Ensuring the operation and automated rollout of releases of the deployed software development and project management platform Cloud - Lot 3: Provision of Sonatype software products - Lot 4: Provision of an Open Source Issue Tracker including, in particular, training, support, further development and migration services - Lot 5: Provision of an Open Source Wiki including, in particular, training, support, further development and migration services This service description considers the subject matter of Lot 4: The subject of this lot is the provision of an Open Source Issue Tracker including associated training, support, further development and migration services. For the total contract duration of 4 years, the estimated calculated costs result in an upper limit of 1.450 instances and 150.776 person-hours (PS) or 18.847 person-days (PT).

parts.source: Das ITZBund benötigt Dienstleistungen im Bereich des Software Lifecycle Managements (SLM) für eingesetzte Softwareentwicklungs- und Projektmanagementlösungen. Ziel dieser Ausschreibung ist der Abschluss eines Rahmenvertrages zur Sicherstellung des Betriebs sowie der Pflege und (Weiter-)Entwicklung der bestehenden Softwareentwicklungs- und Projektmanagementplattform Cloud sowie darauf aufbauender Fachanwendungen des ITZBund. Zudem soll die Souveränität durch die Erweiterung zu beschaffender Open Source Tools gestärkt werden. Unter Open Source versteht das ITZBund Software, deren Quellcode frei verfügbar ist. Grundsätzlich ist es jedermann gestattet, diese unentgeltlich und inhaltlich unbeschränkt im Objekt- und Quellcode zu benutzen, zu analysieren, zu verändern und weiterzugeben. Vorgaben der jeweils einschlägigen Open Source Lizenz, insbesondere zu Lizenztexten, Urhebervermerken oder Copyleft-Effekten, bleiben unberührt. Die ausgeschriebenen Leistungen umfassen Leistungen entlang des gesamten Software Lifecycle, insbesondere Betriebsleistungen, Pflege- und Supportleistungen, Unterstützungsleistungen im Zusammenhang mit Releases und Rollouts sowie bedarfsorientierte Neu- und Weiterentwicklungen bestehender Software und softwarebezogener Werkzeuge. Abrufberechtigt ist der Auftraggeber, der durch seine Kunden beauftragt Leistungen abrufen kann. Der Betrieb der bezogenen Softwareprodukte erfolgt grundsätzlich im ITZBund, Ausnahmen in besonderen Einzelfällen lassen einen Betrieb bei Kunden des Auftraggebers mit eigener Lizenzierung zu. Die eingangs genannten Leistungen werden in fünf Losen ausgeschrieben: - Los 1: Sicherstellung der Pflege und der (Weiter-)Entwicklung der eingesetzten Softwareentwicklungs- und Projektmanagementplattform Cloud - Los 2: Sicherstellung des Betriebs und des automatisierten Rollouts von Releases der eingesetzten Softwareentwicklungsund Projektmanagementplattform Cloud - Los 3: Bereitstellung Sonatype Softwareprodukte - Los 4: Bereitstellung eines Open Source Issue Tracker einschließlich insbesondere Schulungs-, Support-, Weiterentwicklungs- und Migrationsleistungen - Los 5: Bereitstellung eines Open Source Wikis einschließlich insbesondere Schulungs-, Support-, Weiterentwicklungs- und Migrationsleistungen Diese Leistungsbeschreibung betrachtet den Leistungsgegenstand des Los 4: Gegenstand dieses Loses ist die Bereitstellung eines Open Source Issue Trackers einschließlich zugehöriger Schulungs-, Support-, Weiterentwicklungs- und Migrationsleistungen. Für die Vertragslaufzeit von insgesamt 4 Jahren ergibt sich für die geschätzten kalkulatorischen Kosten eine Obergrenze von 1.450 Instanzen und 150.776 Personenstunden (PS) bzw. 18.847 Personentage (PT).

result.text: The assignment comprises the provision of system support for the management of wellness allowances for monthly-paid employees and an option for hourly-paid employees (hereinafter referred to as the Service). The Service shall support the entire process for managing wellness allowances and function as a digital tool for both employees and administrators at the Municipality. The assignment includes a comprehensive commitment for the Service, which encompasses the system support that forms part of the Service as well as associated services required for the Service to be introduced, used and function over time. The Service also comprises the following options: Option 1 Management of wellness allowances for hourly-paid employees. Price for Option 1 is included in the evaluation of bids. The tenderer shall state the price for Option 1 in the Price Schedule Appendix. If such price is not stated, the bid may be rejected. The Municipality has the right, but not the obligation, to exercise this option during the contract period. Option 2 Administering the management of expense receipts and supporting the disbursement of reimbursement from the Municipality to the employee for purchases of wellness services from wellness suppliers affiliated with the Service. (voluntary) Price for Option 2 is not included in the evaluation of bids. The Municipality has the right, but not the obligation, to exercise this option during the contract period. If the Supplier can provide this functionality, the price for Option 2 shall be submitted in the Price Schedule Appendix. Option 3 Benefit bicycles (voluntary) The option concerns the Supplier being able to offer support through the Service for the administration and management of benefit bicycles for the Municipality's employees for private use. The solution may be provided through a third-party supplier affiliated with the Service. The Municipality has not currently made a decision on the introduction of benefit bicycles and no requirements regarding such functionality are therefore set within the framework of this procurement. The option is not covered by the evaluation and the Tenderer shall therefore not submit any price for the option. The Municipality decides unilaterally if, when and to what extent the option is to be utilised during the contract period. The Municipality reserves the right to refrain from utilising the option and to, in whole or in part, procure a corresponding service or functionality through a separate procurement. parts.source: Uppdraget omfattar tillhandahållande av ett systemstöd för hantering av friskvårdsbidrag för månadsavlönade medarbetare samt option för timanställda medarbetare (nedan benämnt Tjänsten). Tjänsten ska stödja hela processen för hantering av friskvårdsbidrag och fungera som ett digitalt verktyg för både medarbetare och administratörer hos Kommunen. Uppdraget innefattar ett helhetsåtagande för Tjänsten, vilket omfattar det systemstöd som utgör en del av Tjänsten samt tillhörande tjänster som krävs för att Tjänsten ska kunna införas, användas och fungera över tid. Tjänsten omfattar även följande optioner: Option 1 Hantering av friskvårdsbidrag för timavlönade medarbetare. Pris för Option 1 ingår i utvärderingen av anbuden. Anbudsgivaren ska ange pris för Option 1 i Bilaga Prisblad. Om sådant pris inte anges kan anbudet komma att förkastas. Kommunen äger rätt, men inte skyldighet, att under avtalstiden nyttja denna option. Option 2 Administrera hanteringen av utläggskvitton och stödja utbetalning av ersättning från Kommunen till medarbetaren för köp av friskvårdstjänst av i Tjänsten anslutna friskvårdsleverantörer. (frivillig) Pris för Option 2 ingår inte i utvärderingen av anbuden. Kommunen äger rätt, men inte skyldighet, att under avtalstiden nyttja denna option. Om Leverantören kan tillhandahålla denna funktionalitet lämnas pris för Option 2 i Bilaga Prisblad. Option 3 Förmånscyklar (frivillig) Optionen avser att Leverantören genom Tjänsten ska kunna erbjuda stöd för administration och hantering av förmånscyklar för Kommunens anställda för privat bruk. Lösningen får tillhandahållas genom tredjepartsleverantör ansluten till Tjänsten. Kommunen har i dagsläget inte fattat beslut om införande av förmånscyklar och några krav avseende sådan funktionalitet ställs därför inte inom ramen för denna upphandling. Optionen omfattas inte av utvärderingen och Anbudsgivaren ska därför inte lämna något pris för optionen. Kommunen avgör ensidigt om, när och i vilken omfattning optionen ska nyttjas under avtalstiden. Kommunen förbehåller sig rätten att avstå från att nyttja optionen samt att, helt eller delvis, anskaffa motsvarande tjänst eller funktionalitet genom separat upphandling. result.text: The aims of the project are to produce an evaluation of the SLC’s rural land market reporting to generate insights and improvements for future reporting. The evaluation will focus on several elements: 1) Impact – this objective is to understand the use of the report and its effects, outcomes and the extent to which reporting is effective in informing policy and decision making. There is a comparative element for this. 2) Process – understanding the effectiveness of the current approach, how the reporting process is working, assessing potential improvements to the methodology, and considering expansion of the coverage of reporting to other areas. 3) Economic Value – understanding value for money and costing the tangible benefits of the reports compared to the costs. What are the wider economic benefits to participants, public finances and society? 4) Analysis and Recommendations – the above steps inform the analysis and evaluation to understand to what extent and degree of progress towards the reporting aims are being made, and any recommendations for improvements. The report should, where appropriate, include advice for the SLC for future land market reports. Lot 1: . What are the wider economic benefits to participants, public finances and society? 4) Analysis and Recommendations – the above steps inform the analysis and evaluation to understand to what extent and degree of progress towards the reporting aims are being made, and any recommendations for improvements. The report should, where appropriate, include advice for the SLC for future land market reports.
