result.text: Negotiated procedure with a call for competition in accordance with § 12 KonzVgV in conjunction with § 14 para. 2, para. 3 no. 2, no. 3 VgV, § 119 para. 5 GWB (two-stage negotiated procedure) to determine a network operator for the planning, construction and operation of a gigabit network under the economic gap model in the tendered expansion areas in accordance with the directive "Funding to support the gigabit expansion of telecommunications networks in the Federal Republic of Germany" of 31.03.2023 in the version of the 1. Amendment of 30.04.2024 (hereinafter "Gigabit-RL 2.0"). The essential basis of the procedure is the "Framework regulation of the Federal Republic of Germany to support the nationwide development of gigabit networks" of 01.08.2024 (hereinafter "Gigabit-RR 2.0"), the directive "Funding to support the gigabit expansion of telecommunications networks in the Federal Republic of Germany" of 31.03.2023 in the version of the 1. Amendment of 30.04.2024 (hereinafter Gigabit-RL 2.0) as well as the communication of the European Union "Guidelines for state aid to promote broadband networks" of 31.01.2023 (2023/C 36/01). The tendered addresses in the development area are, according to the results of the market survey, eligible, underserved addresses within the meaning of the Gigabit-RL 2.0. For this reason, a gigabit network is to be established there on the basis of this selection procedure as a technology-neutral network designation (network with broadband provision of at least 1 Gbit/s symmetrical under peak load conditions for all end users at the tendered addresses) in the underserved areas, whereby the up and download rates must at least double. Reference is also made to the requirements of the "B-Performance Specification" including its annexes. Planning, construction and operation of a gigabit network under the economic gap model for all tendered addresses based on the Gigabit-RL 2.0. The subject of this selection procedure is the awarding of a service concession for the planning, construction and operation of a gigabit network under the economic gap model according to section 3.1 of the Gigabit-RL 2.0. The aim of this measure is the gigabit supply of the expansion areas with gigabit-capable broadband connections with data transmission rates of at least 1 Gbit/s symmetrical under peak load conditions for all end users at the tendered addresses in the expansion area, whereby the up and download rate must at least double. The expansion area of Lot 1, Lot 2 and Lot 3 is set out in detail in the "B-Performance Specification" and its annexes, in particular the maps of the expansion area (B1, B1.1 to B1.10) and the address lists (B2, B2.1 to B2.3). Reference is made to the explanations in the supplementary documents for this selection procedure (see the list in "A-General Procedural Conditions" section 4); the following applies in particular: a) Technology neutrality The contracting authority clarifies that this selection procedure for the gigabit network to be built and operated with bandwidths of at least 1 Gbit/s symmetrical under peak load conditions is technology-neutral within the meaning of recital 117 of the State Aid Guidelines EU2023/C 26/01 (section 5.2.4.1, 5.2.4.2) as well as § 5 para. 7 Gigabit-RR 2.0, consequently the designation chosen here such as "gigabit network", the designation of the network levels etc., the representation of the network structure and definition of the material concept 5.0.2, section 2, page 5 et seq. is adopted, but this is to be viewed analogously if other technologies are used for the expansion and operation of the gigabit network. b) Construction and operation of a network for gigabit supply The funding purpose of the Gigabit-RL 2.0 is to support effective and technology-neutral gigabit expansion to achieve an ecologically sustainable, secure and high-performance gigabit network in underserved areas. The successful bidder must plan, construct and operate a gigabit network in the expansion area with the defined minimum bandwidths under peak load conditions. This includes both the necessary passive network infrastructure (e.g. civil engineering works, empty conduits with cables and associated components including manholes, distributors, house connections and network termination points) and the active technology for network operation. Provided the property owners consent, the construction of wired gigabit networks that is the subject of this selection procedure relates to all network parts, including the network termination in the building of every tendered address. Reference is also made to the requirements of the "B-Performance Specification" including its annexes. c) Funding requirements The gigabit network construction and its operation must mandatorily take into account all contents and requirements of the Gigabit-RR 2.0, the Gigabit-RL 2.0, the notice of a grant in a preliminary amount as well as its associated ancillary provisions (BNBest-Gigabit), material concept and requirements for the dimensioning of passive infrastructure etc. in the version on which this is based. Reference is also made to the applicable legal bases in the annex bundle "Funding Legal Bases" (A2); Planning, construction and operation of a gigabit network under the economic gap model for all tendered addresses based on the Gigabit-RL 2.0. The subject of this selection procedure is the awarding of a service concession for the planning, construction and operation of a gigabit network under the economic gap model according to section 3.1 of the Gigabit-RL 2.0. The aim of this measure is the gigabit supply of the expansion areas with gigabit-capable broadband connections with data transmission rates of at least 1 Gbit/s symmetrical under peak load conditions for all end users at the tendered addresses in the expansion area, whereby the up and download rate must at least double.

parts.source: Verhandlungsverfahren mit Teilnahmewettbewerb entsprechend § 12 KonzVgV i.V.m. § 14 Abs. 2, Abs. 3 Nr. 2, Nr. 3 VgV, § 119 Abs. 5 GWB (zweistufiges Verhandlungsverfahren) zur Bestimmung eines Netzbetreibers für die Planung, die Errichtung und den Betrieb eines Gigabit-Netzes im Wirtschaftlichkeitslückenmodell in den ausgeschriebenen Ausbaugebieten nach Maßgabe der Richtlinie "Förderung zur Unterstützung des Gigabitausbau der Telekommunikationsnetze in der Bundesrepublik Deutschland" vom 31.03.2023 in der Fassung der 1. Änderung vom 30.04.2024 (nachfolgend "Gigabit-RL 2.0"). Wesentliche Grundlage des Verfahrens sind die "Rahmenregelung der Bundesrepublik Deutschland zur Unterstützung des flächendeckenden Aufbaus von Gigabitnetzen" vom 01.08.2024 (nachfolgend "Gigabit-RR 2.0"), die Richtlinie "Förderung zur Unterstützung des Gigabitausbaus der Telekommunikationsnetze in der Bundesrepublik Deutschland" vom 31.03.2023 in der Fassung der 1. Änderung vom 30.04.2024 (nachfolgend Gigabit-RL 2.0) sowie die Mitteilung der Europäischen Union "Leitlinien für staatliche Beihilfen zur Förderung von Breitbandnetzen" vom 31.01.2023 (2023/C 36/01). Die ausgeschriebenen Adressen des Erschließungsgebietes sind nach Ergebnis der Markterkundung förderfähige unterversorgte Adressen im Sinne der Gigabit-RL 2.0. Aus diesem Grund soll dort auf Basis dieses Auswahlverfahrens ein Gigabit-Netz als technologieneutrale Netzbezeichnung (Netz mit einer Breitbandversorgung von mindestens 1 Gbit/s symmetrisch zu Spitzenlastzeitbedingungen für alle Endnutzer der ausgeschriebenen Adressen) in den unterversorgten Gebieten errichtet werden, wobei sich die Up- und Downloadraten mindestens verdoppeln müssen. Auf die Vorgaben der "B-Leistungsbeschreibung" inkl. deren Anlagen wird ergänzend verwiesen. Planung, Errichtung und Betrieb eines Gigabit-Netzes im Wirtschaftlichkeitslückenmodell aller aus-geschriebenen Adressen auf Basis der Gigabit-RL 2.0. Gegenstand dieses Auswahlverfahrens ist die Auftragsvergabe einer Dienstleistungskonzession für die Planung, die Errichtung und den Betrieb eines Gigabit-Netzes im Wirtschaftlichkeitslückenmodell nach Ziffer 3.1 der Gigabit-RL 2.0. Ziel dieser Maßnahme ist die Gigabitversorgung der Ausbaugebiete mit gigabitfähigen Breitbandanschlüssen mit Datenübertragungsraten von mindestens 1 Gbit/s symmetrisch zu Spitzenlastzeitbedingungen für alle Endnutzer der ausgeschriebenen Adressen im Ausbaugebiet, wobei sich die Up- und Downloadrate mindestens verdoppeln müssen. Das Ausbaugebiet des Los 1, des Los 2 und des Los 3 ergibt sich im Einzelnen aus "B-Leistungsbeschreibung" und deren Anlagen, insbesondere der Karten zum Ausbaugebiet (B1, B1.1 bis B1.10) und der Adresslisten (B2, B2.1 bis B2.3). Es wird auf die Ausführungen der ergänzenden Unterlagen dieses Auswahlverfahrens verwiesen (siehe hierzu Auflistung in "A-Allgemeine Verfahrensbedingungen" Ziff. 4); danach gilt insbesondere: a) Technologieneutralität Der Auftraggeber stellt klar, dass dieses Auswahlverfahren des zu errichtenden und zu betreibenden Gigabit-Netzes mit Bandbreiten von mindestens 1 Gbit/s symmetrisch zu Spitzenlastzeitbedingungen technologieneutral i.S.d. Randnummer 117 der Beihilfeleitlinien EU2023/C 26/01 (Ziff. 5.2.4.1, 5.2.4.2) sowie § 5 Abs. 7 Gigabit-RR 2.0 erfolgt, folglich die hier gewählte Bezeichnung wie "Gigabit-Netz", die Bezeichnung der Netzebenen etc., die Darstellung des Netzaufbaus und Definition des Materialkonzeptes 5.0.2, Ziff. 2, Seite 5 f. übernimmt, dies aber bei Einsatz anderer Technologien zum Ausbau und Betrieb des Gigabit-Netzes entsprechend analog zu sehen ist. b) Errichtung und Betrieb eines Netzes zur Gigabitversorgung Förderzweck der Gigabit-RL 2.0 ist die Unterstützung eines effektiven und technologieneutralen Gi-gabitausbaus zur Erreichung eines ökologisch nachhaltigen, sicheren und hochleistungsfähigen Gigabit-Netzes in unterversorgten Gebieten. Der Zuschlagsempfänger hat im Ausbaugebiet ein Gigabit-Netz mit den definierten Mindestbandbreiten zu Spitzenlastzeitbedingungen zu planen, zu errichten und zu betreiben. Dies umfasst sowohl die erforderliche passive Netzinfrastruktur (z.B. Tiefbauleistungen, Leerrohre mit Kabel sowie zugehörige Komponenten einschließlich Schächte, Verteiler, Hausanschlüsse und Netzabschlusseinrichtungen) als auch die aktive Technik zum Netzbetrieb. Das Einverständnis der Grundstückseigentümer vorausgesetzt, bezieht sich die diesem Auswahlverfahren gegenständliche Errichtung von leitungsgebundenen Gigabit-Netzen auf alle Netzteile, einschließlich Netzabschluss im Gebäude einer jeden ausgeschriebenen Adresse. Auf die Vorga-ben der "B-Leistungsbeschreibung" inkl. deren Anlagen wird ergänzend verwiesen. c) Förderrechtliche Vorgaben Die Gigabit-Netzerrichtung und dessen Betrieb müssen sämtliche Inhalte und Vorgaben der Gigabit-RR 2.0, der Gigabit-RL 2.0, des Bescheides über eine Zuwendung in vorläufiger Höhe sowie dessen zugehörige Nebenbestimmungen (BNBest-Gigabit), Materialkonzept und Vorgaben für die Dimensionierung passiver Infrastruktur etc. in der diesem zugrunde liegenden Fassung verpflichtend berücksichtigen. Auf die geltenden Rechtsgrundlagen im Anlagenkonvolut "Förderrechtliche Rechtsgrundlagen" (A2) wird ergänzend verwiesen.; Planung, Errichtung und Betrieb eines Gigabit-Netzes im Wirtschaftlichkeitslückenmodell aller aus-geschriebenen Adressen auf Basis der Gigabit-RL 2.0. Gegenstand dieses Auswahlverfahrens ist die Auftragsvergabe einer Dienstleistungskonzession für die Planung, die Errichtung und den Betrieb eines Gigabit-Netzes im Wirtschaftlichkeitslückenmodell nach Ziffer 3.1 der Gigabit-RL 2.0. Ziel dieser Maßnahme ist die Gigabitversorgung der Ausbaugebiete mit gigabitfähigen Breitbandanschlüssen mit Datenübertragungsraten von mindestens 1 Gbit/s symmetrisch zu Spitzenlastzeitbedingungen für alle Endnutzer der ausgeschriebenen Adressen im Ausbaugebiet, wobei sich die Up- und Downloadrate mindestens verdoppeln müssen.

result.text: Hanover Housing Association has been providing housing and support services across Scotland for over forty years. Managing approximately 150 homes with an aspect of care, predominantly for older people, Hanover is committed to enabling tenants to live independently within their communities. Hanover provides housing with care and very sheltered housing services which can range from light touch interventions such as reminding tenants to take medication to helping tenants with daily tasks such as personal care. Lot 1: . Hanover has initiated a Care and Support Systems Review at senior management level to address challenges caused by varied case management practices, inefficient data handling, and outdated digital tools. Two critical areas of improvement have been identified: - Care Scheduling/Planning – modernising currently paper-based processes, ensuring person-centred care and real-time updates. Although a full eMAR system is not required, medication management is a large area requiring support. - Rota Management – replacing fragmented manual scheduling with a centralised, digital platform. Through this forthcoming procurement, Hanover aims to secure a solution that will: - Improve service quality and tenant engagement through modern, digital care planning. - Increase operational efficiency and staff satisfaction via streamlined rota management. - Enhance safety, compliance, and oversight of medication management. - Provide integrated reporting, dashboards, and mobile accessibility. - Support compliance with relevant regulatory frameworks. The service will operate within a framework of continuous improvement with which the service provider will be required to engage; bringing innovation, sharing ideas, and implementing improvement measures to increase operational effectiveness/efficiency and drive out waste.

Hanover provides housing with care and very sheltered housing services which can range from light touch interventions such as reminding tenants to take medication to helping tenants with daily tasks such as personal care. Lot 1: . Hanover has initiated a Care and Support Systems Review at senior management level to address challenges caused by varied case management practices, inefficient data handling, and outdated digital tools. Two critical areas of improvement have been identified: - Care Scheduling/Planning – modernising currently paper-based processes, ensuring person-centred care and real-time updates. Although a full eMAR system is not required, medication management is a large area requiring support. - Rota Management – replacing fragmented manual scheduling with a centralised, digital platform. Through this forthcoming procurement, Hanover aims to secure a solution that will: - Improve service quality and tenant engagement through modern, digital care planning. - Increase operational efficiency and staff satisfaction via streamlined rota management. - Enhance safety, compliance, and oversight of medication management. - Provide integrated reporting, dashboards, and mobile accessibility. - Support compliance with relevant regulatory frameworks. The service will operate within a framework of continuous improvement with which the service provider will be required to engage; bringing innovation, sharing ideas, and implementing improvement measures to increase operational effectiveness/efficiency and drive out waste.

result.text: The aim of the project is to obtain an overall overview of the embedded operating systems used in the vehicle (including virtualisation environments) and an assessment of their cybersecurity properties. This is to include the operating conditions (hardware platforms, access options to control units, etc.) and the interaction of the operating systems within the overall vehicle architecture. In addition to examining the systems currently on the market and relevant standards, an outlook on future developments is also to be provided. Requirements for vehicle operating systems from a cybersecurity perspective are to be derived from applicable regulations and standards. This includes requirements for testing within the scope of type approval and market surveillance. In addition to a literature search for the market overview, practical analyses are also to be carried out on various operating systems. These are to be performed as part of work package 5 (WP 5). The test catalogue to be drawn up must be practically verifiable here. The result of the project is a study comprising the aforementioned contents.

parts.source: Ziel des Projektes ist es, einen Gesamtüberblick über die im Fahrzeug eingesetzten eingebetteten Betriebssysteme (einschließlich Virtualisierungsumgebungen) und eine Bewertung der Cybersicherheitseigenschaften zu erhalten. Es sollen dabei die Einsatzbedingungen (Hardwareplattformen, Zugriffsmöglichkeiten auf Steuereinheiten usw.) und das Zusammenspiel der Betriebssysteme im Rahmen der Gesamtfahrzeugarchitektur einbezogen werden. Neben der Betrachtung der aktuell auf dem Markt befindlichen Systeme und einschlägiger Standards soll auch ein Ausblick auf die zukünftigen Entwicklungen gegeben werden. Anforderungen an Fahrzeug-Betriebssysteme aus Cybersicherheitssicht sollen aus den gültigen Regulierungen und Standards abgeleitet werden. Dies schließt Anforderungen an Prüfungen im Rahmen der Typgenehmigung und Marktüberwachung ein. Neben einer Quellenrecherche für den Marktüberblick sollen auch praktische Analysen an verschiedenen Betriebssystemen durchgeführt werden. Diese sollen im Rahmen des Arbeitspakets 5 (AP 5) durchgeführt werden. Der zu erstellende Prüfkatalog soll hier praktisch verifiziert werden können. Ergebnis des Projekts ist eine Studie, die die oben genannten Inhalte umfasst.

result.text: The contracting authority plans to introduce an ERP system to optimise and digitalise core business processes. The focus is on end-to-end process support – from enquiries, orders and service provision through to billing and reporting. The implementation will take place within a municipal corporate group comprising areas such as Environment & Service, Mobility, Finance, and Leisure & Culture. The subject of the procurement is the delivery and implementation of the ERP software, including project-specific services. Estimated publication period of the contract notice: Planned between 01.11 and 31.12.2025. Procurement procedure: A transparency notice will be published in accordance with the relevant statutory provisions. The tender documents and all communication will be provided exclusively via the IT-Matchmaker procurement platform (www.it-matchmaker.de). The submission of requests to participate and tenders is possible exclusively online via the platform. Planned procedure: Competitive procedure with negotiation Planned lot division (if applicable): No / not envisaged [Information on lots, if multiple are awarded] Special notes: Interested companies are requested to prepare for the tender now and use the IT-Matchmaker platform to fulfil any access requirements in good time. Access to the tender documents is free of charge for all bidders, provided the project ID provided by the contracting authority is used. This preliminary information serves as early market information and does not entitle bidders to submit tenders. The contract notice with complete documents will be published separately. Publication: The preliminary notice will be published via the eVergabe portal.

Voraussichtlicher Zeitraum der Veröffentlichung der Auftragsbekanntmachung: Geplant im Zeitraum vom 01.11. bis 31.12.2025 Ablauf der Vergabe: Es wird eine Transparenzbekanntmachung gemäß den einschlägigen gesetzlichen Vorgaben erfolgen. result.text: KS Digital has, on behalf of the Committee Council, established a work group that shall review how the municipal sector can cooperate on the future childhood and school administration systems (OAS/SAS), digital ecosystems and possibilities for future joint procurements. The work includes both education and school administrative systems (OAS/SAS), the digital eco-system included in them, and how the municipal sector can strengthen coordination, standardisation and any future joint procurements. As a part of this work, we invite the supplier market to a dialogue. We want insight into how the market assesses developments in the area, what technological and organisational possibilities exist, and how the municipal sector and the supplier market together can contribute to a more open, coherent and future orientated digital ecosystem for the education sector. The work is anchored in a reported need from the municipalities for stronger coordination in relation to requirements, standardisation, architecture, data sharing, procurements and further development of digital systems in the area of adolescence. The aim is not to define a new system, but to assess how the municipal sector together can contribute to a more coherent, open and future orientated digital ecosystem for children, youths, guardians, employees, managers, owners and associated services. An important goal is also to contribute to a supplier market that supports this development, through clear common needs, standards and framework conditions that stimulate innovation and sustainable development of the systems. Information on the market dialogue including registration will be in the tender https://ksdigital.no/markedsdialoger-og-anskaffelser/

result.text: Caledonian Sleeper Limited (CSL) is seeking to establish a multi-supplier Operational Support Engineering Framework to provide a compliant, agile and cost-effective route for the procurement of reactive, planned and minor engineering and operational support services required across CSL operations. Lot 1: MECHANICAL AND GENERAL ENGINEERING. This lot covers mechanical and general engineering support services required to support CSL operations, including: mechanical fitting and repair light fabrication welding, including coded welding where relevant ancillary equipment repair temporary mechanical arrangements repair or modification of non-integrated mechanical systems basic plant and equipment support where within CSL-controlled scope non-OEM HVAC mechanical support metalwork, brackets, supports and local fabricated solutions mechanical support to temporary operational fixes. Exclusions Specific to Lot 1 rolling stock mechanical systems covered under TSSSA depot mechanical systems owned by Alstom or site owner safety-critical traction, brake or other OEM systems Lot 2: ELECTRICAL AND CONTROLS. This lot covers electrical and controls support services, including: low voltage electrical works temporary electrical arrangements non-integrated lighting systems control panel works on non-OEM assets fault finding on approved systems cable routing and connection for temporary arrangements temporary power distribution arrangements minor electrical support to CSL-controlled ancillary assets non-integrated controls support local system modifications outside OEM scope. Exclusions Specific to Lot 2: OEM-controlled rolling stock electrical systems depot fixed electrical infrastructure HV systems unless expressly stated and properly authorised works already within Alstom or CAF responsibility Lot 3: PLUMBING AND WELFARE. This lot covers plumbing and welfare-related operational support, including: plumbing repairs to CSL-controlled systems minor drainage support leak response welfare facility supports where within CSL commissioning authority temporary water arrangements repair or replacement of localised pipework or fittings in approved scope response to water ingress or similar operational issues temporary welfare service continuity arrangements hygiene related support associated with welfare systems. Exclusions Specific to Lot 3: depot-wide plumbing infrastructure owned by site owner integrated train plumbing systems under TSSSA major building services works Lot 4: SPECIALIST ENGINEERING SERVICES. This lot covers specialist support services, including: non-destructive testing specialist inspections corrosion treatment or assessment temporary works design engineering assessment services lifting support and related specialist advice specialist technical investigations reporting and assurance support on defined interventions specialist measurement and testing services local engineering assurance where required. Exclusions Specific to Lot 5: OEM certification work beyond supplier competence or authority services reserved to another contract or statutory body services requiring a separate regulated procurement due to value or strategic nature Lot 5: DIGITAL AND DATA SUPPORT. This lot covers digital and data support services, including: data extraction from approved sources data cleansing and transformation creation of structured datasets support to predictive maintenance initiatives support to condition monitoring initiatives support to third party analytics providers engaged by CSL set up of non-integrated monitoring devices or sensors dashboard or reporting support directly related to operational use cases data handling support linked to engineering or operational investigations technical support to improve data usability for CSL decision making. Exclusions Specific to Lot 6: unauthorised access to OEM restricted systems modification of CAF or Alstom systems without approval large-scale software development or enterprise platforms not suited to this Framework Lot 6: EMERGENCY RESPONSE SERVICES. This lot covers emergency response and incident support services, including: 24/7 call-out support urgent operational interventions rapid deployment to stabilise or mitigate service-affecting issues emergency temporary works immediate support to restore operational continuity urgent attendance for fault investigation outside restricted scope emergency logistics and mobilisation provision of on-call resources to support operational continuity urgent support to containment, isolation or temporary workaround activity. Exclusions Specific to Lot 6: emergency works falling wholly within CAF or Alstom contractual responsibility blue light or statutory emergency services functions uncontrolled instruction of works without CSL authorisation

result.text: The objective of the procurement is a framework agreement concerning the supply (purchase, rental, or subscription) of standard software, the maintenance associated with the standard software, and related services for Dataport's own/internal requirements and the requirements for customers/sponsors of Dataport within the scope of commercial transactions. Standard software is software that has already been developed and not programmed for an individual customer. In contrast, custom software, which is not part of this procurement, is software specially developed or programmed for a specific customer. The contract period of this framework agreement begins on 01.01.2027 and has a duration of up to 4 years (2 years with a twice-renewable option for 12 months each). The execution of the procurement procedure is carried out by Dataport in order to meet its own and customer requirements. The maximum value that must already be stated in the EU notice for framework agreements is 150 % of the awarded contract value. I.e. the contracting authority will call off services from this framework agreement up to a maximum value of 150% of the total tender sum.

parts.source: Ziel der Vergabe ist eine Rahmenvereinbarung über die Beschaffung (Kauf, Miete oder Subscription) von Standardsoftware, die zur Standardsoftware dazugehörige Pflege und damit zusammenhängende Leistungen für Dataport eigene/interne Bedarfe und die Bedarfe für Kunden/Träger von Dataport im Rahmen des Handelsgeschäfts. Bei Standardsoftware handelt es sich um bereits entwickelte und nicht für einen einzelnen Kunden programmierte Software. Im Gegensatz dazu handelt es sich bei Individualsoftware, die nicht Bestandteil dieser Vergabe ist, um speziell für einen bestimmten Kunden zu entwickelnde bzw. zu programmierende Software. Die Vertragslaufzeit dieses Rahmenvertrages beginnt am 01.01.2027 und hat eine Laufzeit von bis zu 4 Jahren (2 Jahre mit zweimaliger Verlängerungsoption um jeweils 12 Monate). Die Durchführung des Vergabeverfahrens erfolgt durch Dataport, um die eigenen und Kundenbedarfe zu decken. Der bei Rahmenvereinbarungen bereits in der EU-Bekanntmachung anzugebende Höchstwert beträgt 150 % des bezuschlagten Auftragswerts. D.h. der Auftraggeber wird maximal bis zum Höchstwert von 150% der Gesamtangebotssumme Leistungen aus diesem Rahmenvertrag abrufen.

result.text: Statped requires assistance to develop a new web-based version of the ICT learning tool Sarepta. The assistance includes the development of functionality that is currently located in the Text and Picture Book modules of the existing Sarepta. The new solution shall carry forward central functionality and pedagogical principles from the current Sarepta, while being established on a modern and future-oriented technical platform. The solution shall be a web application and published as open source. It shall be facilitated so that the solution can be managed and further developed by Statped after the assistance has been completed. Statped intends to enter into a contract with one supplier. A more detailed description of the assistance and the requirements for the new solution follows from SSA-B Appendix 1 ("The Customer's description of the assistance"), with a comprehensive description of Sarepta in the appendix's Attachment 1 ("Sarepta User Manual"). The procurement of assistance for the development of a new web-based version of Sarepta (base delivery) has an estimated maximum limit of 2,0 million NOK excl. VAT. The estimate is not to be considered binding for Statped. Statped reserves the right, in the event of any later needs, to order additional deliveries in the form of further development or new modules and functions during the project. Such deliveries will in that case be in addition to the base delivery and can be agreed upon via a change agreement.

parts.source: Statped har behov for bistand til å utvikle en ny webbasert versjon av IKT-læremiddelet Sarepta. Bistanden omfatter utvikling av funksjonalitet som i dagens Sarepta ligger i modulene Tekst og Billedbok. Den nye løsningen skal videreføre sentral funksjonalitet og pedagogiske prinsipper fra dagens Sarepta, samtidig som den etableres på en moderne og fremtidsrettet teknisk plattform. Løsningen skal være en webapplikasjon og publiseres som åpen kildekode. Det skal legges til rette for at løsningen kan forvaltes og videreutvikles av Statped etter at bistanden er avsluttet. Statped har til hensikt å inngå kontrakt med én leverandør. Nærmere beskrivelse av bistanden og kravene til den nye løsningen følger av SSA-B Bilag 1 («Kundens beskrivelse av bistanden»), med utfyllende beskrivelse av Sarepta i bilagets Vedlegg 1 («Bruksanvisning Sarepta»). Anskaffelsen av bistand til utvikling av ny webbasert versjon av Sarepta (grunnleveransen) har en estimert maksimalramme på 2,0 millioner kroner ekskl. mva. Anslaget er ikke å anse som forpliktende for Statped. Statped forbeholder seg samtidig retten til, ved eventuelle senere behov, å bestille tilleggsleveranser i form av videreutvikling eller nye moduler og funksjoner underveis i prosjektet. Slike leveranser vil i så fall komme i tillegg til grunnleveransen og kan avtales ved endringsavtale.

result.text: The Foundation Bergwerk Rammelsberg, Old Town of Goslar and Upper Harz Water Management, in short Foundation UNESCO World Heritage in the Harz is responsible for the promotion, communication, conservation and coordination of the UNESCO World Cultural Heritage in the Western Harz and was founded 2012 on the initiative of the contracting authority. In order to increase the effectiveness, efficiency and transparency of operational work and to position the foundation for the future in harmony with its shareholders, a comprehensive reorganising and strategic realignment is to take place. Taking into account the proper and economical use of public funds, the primary objective is to remain the reliable fulfilment of the foundation's tasks - the promotion, communication, conservation and coordination of the UNESCO World Cultural Heritage in the Western Harz. It is intended to have the ongoing business of the Harz Heritage Foundation, which is already largely geared towards the upcoming reorganization and is ready, comprehensively reviewed regarding its existing strategy, task distribution and working method, organizational structure and processes. The goal is to increase the effectiveness, efficiency and transparency of operational work and to position the foundation for the future in harmony with its shareholders. In addition, there is a discussion as to whether the existing legal form, the applicable statutes and the foundation's purpose are still appropriate or should be adapted in the course of the strategic realignment.

parts.source: Die Stiftung Bergwerk Rammelsberg, Altstadt von Goslar und Oberharzer Wasserwirtschaft", kurz Stiftung UNESCO-Welterbe im Harz ist verantwortlich für die Förderung, Vermittlung, Erhaltung und Koordination des UNESCO-Weltkulturerbes im Westharz und wurde 2012 auf Initiative des Auftraggebers gegründet. Um die Wirksamkeit, Effizienz und Transparenz der operativen Arbeit zu erhöhen und die Stiftung im Einklang mit ihren Gesellschaftern zukunftsfähig aufzustellen soll eine umfassende Umorganisation und strategische Neuausrichtung erfolgen. Unter Berücksichtigung der ordnungsgemäßen und wirtschaftlichen Verwendung der öffentlichen Mittel soll oberstes Ziel die verlässliche Erfüllung der Stiftungsaufgaben - die Förderung, Vermittlung, Erhaltung und Koordination des UNESCO-Weltkulturerbes im Westharz bleiben. Es ist beabsichtigt, das laufende Geschäft der Stiftung Welterbe Harz, welches bereits weitestgehend auf die anstehende Reorganisation ausgerichtet und bereit ist, ihre bestehende Strategie, Aufgabenverteilung und Arbeitsweise, Organisationsstruktur und Prozesse umfassend überprüfen zu lassen. Ziel ist es, Wirksamkeit, Effizienz und Transparenz der operativen Arbeit zu erhöhen und die Stiftung im Einklang mit ihren Gesellschaftern zukunftsfähig aufzustellen. Darüber hinaus steht zur Diskussion, ob die bestehende Rechtsform, die geltende Satzung und der Stiftungszweck noch angemessen sind oder im Zuge der strategischen Neuausrichtung angepasst werden sollten.

result.text: NIS-2-compliant transformation of OT systems cooling supply area Lot LOT-0001: Modernisation of automation and network technology water treatment works.. The subject of the tender is the renewal and modernisation of the automation, visualisation and network technology in two water treatment works and one elevated reservoir. The aim of the measure is to upgrade the systems to the state of the art, taking into account the requirements for cybersecurity, network segmentation, availability and operational reliability in the environment of NIS-2 requirements. The scope of services includes the planning, supply, installation, parametrisation, programming, migration, commissioning and documentation of the automation technology, including the replacement of existing PLC systems, decentralised automation components and the required communication and telecontrol interfaces. The replacement of the automation technology will take place on the basis of the Siemens system platform using current SIMATIC S7-1500 controllers, including engineering in the TIA Portal. The central process visualisation is to be supplied, configured and put into operation ready for use on the basis of Siemens WinCC Unified. The visualisation is to be integrated with the automation systems to be newly constructed and the existing technical equipment. Furthermore, the service includes the renewal and expansion of the industrial network infrastructure, including active network components, network segmentation, secure communication connections, remote access solutions and the components required to implement a modern IT/OT security concept. The service also includes the migration of existing functions and process data, the execution of factory, function and data point tests, commissioning during ongoing plant operation, training of operating personnel and the handover of complete as-built and inventory documentation. The specification of the Siemens system platform is intended to ensure a uniform system architecture within the client's facilities, guarantee compatibility with existing standards, secure the ability of operating personnel to perform their own maintenance, and avoid additional training, licensing and interface expenses. The targeted system continuity serves in particular to ensure long-term operational and investment security as well as the implementation of a consistent cybersecurity concept. Special requirements arise from the maintenance of the water supply during the conversion measures. The contractor must plan and execute the work in such a way that necessary operational interruptions are limited to the technically necessary minimum. Comparable references from water treatment works, wastewater facilities or other critical infrastructure facilities are required.

parts.source: NIS-2-konforme Transformation der OT-Systeme Versorgungsbereich Kühlung Lot LOT-0001: Modernisierung der Automatisierungs- und Netzwerktechnik Wasserwerke.. Gegenstand der Ausschreibung ist die Erneuerung und Modernisierung der Automatisierungs-, Visualisierungs- und Netzwerktechnik in zwei Wasserwerken sowie einem Hochbehälter. Ziel der Maßnahme ist die Ertüchtigung der Anlagen auf den aktuellen Stand der Technik unter Berücksichtigung der Anforderungen an Cybersecurity, Netzwerksegmentierung, Verfügbarkeit und Betriebssicherheit im Umfeld der NIS-2-Anforderungen. Der Leistungsumfang umfasst die Planung, Lieferung, Montage, Parametrierung, Programmierung, Migration, Inbetriebnahme und Dokumentation der Automatisierungstechnik einschließlich der Erneuerung vorhandener SPS-Systeme, dezentraler Automatisierungskomponenten sowie der erforderlichen Kommunikations- und Fernwirkschnittstellen. Die Erneuerung der Automatisierungstechnik erfolgt auf Basis der Siemens-Systemplattform unter Verwendung aktueller SIMATIC S7-1500 Steuerungen einschließlich Engineering im TIA Portal. Die zentrale Prozessvisualisierung ist auf Basis Siemens WinCC Unified zu liefern, zu projektieren und betriebsfertig in Betrieb zu nehmen. Die Visualisierung ist mit den neu zu errichtenden Automatisierungssystemen sowie den vorhandenen technischen Einrichtungen zu integrieren. Weiterhin umfasst die Leistung die Erneuerung und Erweiterung der industriellen Netzwerkinfrastruktur einschließlich aktiver Netzwerkkomponenten, Netzwerksegmentierung, sicherer Kommunikationsverbindungen, Fernzugriffslösungen sowie der zur Umsetzung eines zeitgemäßen IT-/OT-Sicherheitskonzeptes erforderlichen Komponenten. Die Leistung beinhaltet ferner die Migration bestehender Funktionen und Prozessdaten, die Durchführung von Werks-, Funktions- und Datenpunkttests, die Inbetriebnahme unter laufendem Anlagenbetrieb, die Schulung des Betriebspersonals sowie die Übergabe einer vollständigen Revisions- und Bestandsdokumentation. Die Vorgabe der Siemens-Systemplattform erfolgt zur Sicherstellung einer einheitlichen Systemarchitektur innerhalb der Anlagen des Auftraggebers, zur Gewährleistung der Kompatibilität mit bestehenden Standards, zur Sicherung der Eigenwartungsfähigkeit durch das Betriebspersonal sowie zur Vermeidung zusätzlicher Schulungs-, Lizenz- und Schnittstellenaufwände. Die angestrebte Systemkontinuität dient insbesondere der langfristigen Betriebs- und Investitionssicherheit sowie der Umsetzung eines durchgängigen Cybersecurity-Konzeptes. Besondere Anforderungen ergeben sich aus der Aufrechterhaltung der Wasserversorgung während der Umbaumaßnahmen. Der Auftragnehmer hat die Arbeiten so zu planen und auszuführen, dass notwendige Betriebsunterbrechungen auf das technisch erforderliche Mindestmaß beschränkt werden. Vergleichbare Referenzen aus Wasserwerken, Abwasseranlagen oder sonstigen Anlagen der kritischen Infrastruktur werden vorausgesetzt.

result.text: The U.S. Embassy Riyadh Public Diplomacy Section is accepting applications for a cooperative agreement to run the University-led Networks for Innovation, Technology, and Expertise (UNITE) program. UNITE will support approximately four to five applied project teams — university-industry partnerships between U.S. universities, U.S. companies or technical partners, and Saudi institutions — through project seed awards of up to $25,000 each to solve specific Saudi workforce and development gaps in high-demand strategic sectors, including Artificial Intelligence, critical minerals, cybersecurity, emerging technologies, and workforce development. Each project team will produce a U.S.-linked deliverable — such as a curriculum, module, technical roadmap, or standards briefs — that creates durable pathways for Saudi investment in American academic, workforce, and industry collaboration. Mission KSA will award a cooperative agreement to a single U.S. academic implementing partner to manage the portfolio. Each participating project team must provide a 1:1 cost-share match to ensure genuine institutional commitment and long-term viability.

result.text: A total of three lots are sought in the area of support - technical system administration. Lot 1: SAP Basis Support, Lot 2: Software Development Support, and Lot 3: Risk/Cont Software Development Support. Taking into account that LfA has outsourced the SAP operation of its ERP and BW systems to the SAP Cloud, SAP Basis Administration is responsible for the smooth operation of our SAP systems in close cooperation with SAP. Central tasks in the SAP Basis environment include the daily monitoring of the SAP landscape to ensure high-performance and error-free operation. Standard basis transactions are regularly checked for error messages - both directly in the relevant SAP transactions and on the basis of incoming system messages via email, or via active evaluation of reports in SAP for Me. Another essential component is the importation of hotfixes as well as SAP and LfA specialist releases to keep the systems constantly up to date and secure. This also includes the analysis, assessment, and processing of vulnerabilities in the Baramundi system to ensure sustainable IT security. Tasks in SAP Basis also include the operation and maintenance of SAP Solution Manager (e.g. importing security patches, creating new change cycles, analysing transport problems). New incoming tickets (incident, problem, and change management) are continuously processed. System and client copies are performed quarterly in cooperation with SAP, with the focus of LfA's activities being, on the one hand, the coordination of individual work packages, including the involvement of SAP peripheral systems, and, on the other hand, the follow-up work in the SAP systems.; - Analysis of requirements - Support of productive operations / support (error analysis and resolution) - Creation of IT concepts and test concepts - Implementation of customer-specific developments o Open Text Team Developer development o ABAP development o Pl/Sql developments o C# developments o Interfaces - Maintenance of the data model - Testing; - Software development for the RISK/CONT system - Interface programming for data provision for RISK/CONT from operational systems and data delivery from RISK/CONT to other dispositive systems - Creation of functional, IT, and test concepts - Clarification and coordination of functional requirements with the specialist department - Effort estimation for implementations resulting from functional requirements - Testing - Support of productive operations / support (error analysis and resolution) in the RISK/CONT system. - Creation and maintenance of documentation of technical systems and processes for the RISK/CONT system.

parts.source: Es werden insgesamt drei Lose im Bereich der Unterstützung - technische Systemadministration gesucht. Los 1: SAP Basis Unterstützung, Los 2: Unterstützung Softwareentwicklung und Los 3: Unterstützung Softwareentwicklung Risk/Cont Die SAP-Basis Administration verantwortet, unter der Beachtung, dass die LfA den SAP-Betrieb ihres ERP- sowie ihres BW-Systems in die SAP-Cloud ausgelagert hat, den reibungslosen Betrieb unserer SAP-Systeme in enger Zusammenarbeit mit der SAP. Zu den zentralen Aufgaben im SAP-Basis-Umfeld gehört die tägliche Überwachung der SAP-Systemlandschaft, um einen performanten und fehlerfreien Betrieb sicherzustellen. Dabei werden regelmäßig die Standard-Basis-Transaktionen auf Fehlermeldungen geprüft - sowohl direkt in den relevanten SAP-Transaktionen als auch anhand eingehender Systemmeldungen per E-Mail, bzw. über ein aktives Auswerten der Reports in SAP for Me. Ein weiterer wesentlicher Bestandteil ist das Einspielen von Hotfixes sowie SAP- und LfA-Fach-Releases, um die Systeme stets auf dem aktuellen und sicheren Stand zu halten. Dazu zählt auch die Analyse, Bewertung und das Abarbeiten von Schwachstellen im Baramundi-System, um die IT-Sicherheit nachhaltig zu gewährleisten. Zu den Aufgaben in der SAP Basis gehören zudem Betrieb und Wartung des SAP Solution Managers (z.B. Einspielen von Security-Patches, Anlage neuer Änderungszyklen, Analyse von Transportproblemen). Neue eingehende Tickets (Incident-, Problem- und Change-Management) werden kontinuierlich bearbeitet. Quartalsweise werden gemeinsam mit der SAP System- und Mandantenkopien durchgeführt, wobei der Schwerpunkt der Tätigkeiten in der LfA einerseits auf der Koordinierung der einzelnen Arbeitspakete auch unter Einbeziehung der SAP-Umsysteme und andererseits auf den Nacharbeiten in den SAP-Systemen liegt.; - Analysen von Anforderungen - Betreuung des produktiven Betriebs / Support (Fehleranalyse und -bereinigung) - Erstellung von IT-Konzeptionen und Testkonzepten - Umsetzung / Implementierung von kundeneigenen Entwicklungen o Open Text Team Developer - Entwicklung o ABAP-Entwicklung o Pl/Sql - Entwicklungen o C# - Entwicklungen o Schnittstellen o Pflege des Datenmodells - Test; - Softwareentwicklung für das RISK/CONT System - Schnittstellenprogrammierung für Datenversorgung RISK/CONT aus operativen Systemen und Datenlieferung aus RISK/CONT an weitere dispositive Systeme - Erstellen von Fach-, DV-, Test-Konzepten - Klärung und Abstimmung fachlicher Anforderungen mit dem Fachbereich - Aufwandsschätzung für Umsetzungen aus fachlichen Anforderungen - Test - Betreuung des produktiven Betriebs / Support (Fehleranalyse und -bereinigung) im RISK/CONT System. - Erstellen und Pflege von Dokumentation der technischen Systeme und Prozesse für das RISK/CONT System.

result.text: The purpose of this RFI is to gather information on market capabilities and solutions for a forthcoming procurement exercise, to supply a Digital Telephony Service to Scottish General Practitioner (GP) Practices. This RFI is not a call for competition and does not form part of any evaluation or award process. Lot 1: . Thank you for registering an interest in this exercise. We are exploring options for digital telephony across all Scottish GP Practices. The Scottish Government's Primary Care Directorate is seeking to support General Practices across Scotland in the adoption of advanced cloud-based telephony solutions. This will improve patient access, enhance practice resilience and support modern ways of working, including remote and flexible service delivery. Suppliers are invited to demonstrate how their solutions can meet the needs of General Practice, align with the requirements set out in the Advanced Telephony Guidance, and support the transition from legacy analogue services ahead of the UK-wide PSTN switch-off in January 2027. We are asking all interested suppliers to complete this RFI questionnaire with responses to the requirements outlined below. The instructions for completing the surveys and the questions can be found below. This will help us to understand the market in terms of capabilities and technology, and potential approaches to delivering a digital telephony solution.

result.text: In the autumn of 2023, the HL Center decided to work towards a new permanent exhibition on the Holocaust. The new permanent exhibition will build upon and enhance the unique national responsibility that the HL Center holds for the dissemination of the history of the Holocaust and related themes. The HL Center has prepared an exhibition brief for the new exhibition. This document defines the overarching goals, principles for the development of the concept and thematic content, as well as the framework for the organisation and implementation of the project. It is intended to serve as the cornerstone for the realisation of the main project. A prequalification process will now be carried out, followed by a tender competition in the form of a competitive dialogue to select the exhibition provider who will collaborate with the centre in realising the new permanent exhibition. The main project is planned to begin in 2026, and the new exhibition is scheduled to open to the public in the autumn of 2028.

rejected.text: The Norwegian Correctional Service shall procure parallel framework agreements for consultancy services. Consultants with experience within strategic consultancy, but not limited to: a) Strategy: scenario methodology and foresight, outside world analyses and strategy development b) Change management: Structured approach to leading individuals, teams and organisations from a current condition to a desired future condition. c) Performance management – some key words (not limited to, but relevant topics: process improvement, management tool/management system, target and result management, risk analyses and internal control. d) Reviews, analyses and evaluations: evaluation methodology and effect analyses. The Norwegian Correctional Service shall be more data driven and it needs more advanced analyses, predictive models, risk profile, prognoses etc., therefore there is a need for competence in data modelling and advanced analyses. e) Socio-economic analysis: methods for assessing and comparing the total costs and benefits of a measure for society as a whole. f) Cost estimation and uncertainty analysis: The process of calculating what a measure or project will cost, as well as assessing how secure or uncertain these estimates are and what factors can affect them. g) Profit planning/follow-up: Identifying, planning and ensuring that the expected gains from a measure or project are actually realised and measured over time. h) Innovation, design and service development: Need for competence in system design/management design in addition to service design i) AI: this means competence in AI and how the organisation can use this in an appropriate way. This also includes competence and experience on prerequisites and other consequences connected to implementation, from the technical to the more organisational sides. Competence/certification within recognised methods will be relevant. The sub-area covers the business perspective, and in some cases may overlap sub-area 2A.; Consultants with experience within operative management and consultancy services. The consultants shall contribute to the execution of deliveries in the form of, but not limited to: a) Project management: planning, organising, implementing and following-up a project in order to achieve defined goals within given frameworks for time, cost and quality. b) Management of development projects - competence in flexible methodology c) Alteration projects: manage and coordinate activities that shall carry out a planned change, with a focus on both technical deliveries and human factors such as involvement, communication and anchoring. d) Implementation project: ensure new systems, systems or processes in an organisation and ensure that they are implemented, anchored and used as planned. e) Digitalisation projects - The Norwegian Correctional Service shall digitalise several internal work processes and externally between actors in the criminal case chain as well as management cooperation partners. f) Preliminary projects and concept reviews: reviews the needs, assesses alternative solutions and recommends the most appropriate concept before the main project starts. g) Test management: Planning, managing and following-up test activities to ensure that a system or product fulfils the requirements and functions as expected. The Norwegian Correctional Service has started extensive work of renewing the ICT system and as a result of this need, both top competence and the capacity to carry out small and large projects. Competence/certification within recognised project implementation methods (e.g. the Project Wizard, Prince2 and/or other methods/framework) and flexible methods will be relevant.; Consultants with technical and developer competence, including, but not limited to: a) Architecture (business, business, security, information, application architecture) b) Development, further development and maintenance c) Utilisation of large data, advanced analysis and AI/machine learning. d) Integrations, data exchange, machine interface, API e) Design and user friendliness f) Technical assistance for infrastructure g) IT security and privacy h) Cloud journey - The Norwegian Correctional Service needs expertise in cloud architecture and specifically the Microsoft Cloud Technology platform It is important to ensure the correct architecture and sufficient security as an important part of the renewal of ICT systems in progress. This must be taken care of in the development as well as in the management of new and old ICT systems. Consultants shall have competence and experience within the use of tools and methods within DevOps, including: Automation, continual integration and delivery (CI/CD), version control, infrastructure such as code, continuous monitoring, configuration of cloud services etc. Particularly important for the customer ́s existing systems is competence within the Microsoft platform in its entirety, where the majority of all development and maintenance is based on .Net.; The Norwegian Correctional Service shall enter into parallel framework agreements for the procurement of consultancy services as stated in the tender documentation. Examples of competence areas: a) project management b) flexible management and management of development projects c) Process Management d) alteration management e) introduction projects and digitalisation projects. f) preliminary project and concept reviews g) test management; Examples of competence areas a) performance, information, application and security architecture b) system development, further development and maintenance c) service design, system design and management design d) integrations, APIs and data exchange e) data analysis, big data, AI and machine learning. f) design and user friendliness g) DevOps, CI/CD, automation and infrastructure as code h) cloud architecture and cloud journey i) Microsoft platform and .NET j) AI-consultancy for the implementation, management and consequences.;

This also includes competence and experience on prerequisites and other consequences connected to implementation, from the technical to the more organisational sides. Competence/certification within recognised methods will be relevant. The sub-area covers the business perspective, and in some cases may overlap sub-area 2A.; Consultants with experience within operative management and consultancy services. The consultants shall contribute to the execution of deliveries in the form of, but not limited to: a) Project management: planning, organising, implementing and following-up a project in order to achieve defined goals within given frameworks for time, cost and quality. b) Management of development projects - competence in flexible methodology c) Alteration projects: manage and coordinate activities that shall carry out a planned change, with a focus on both technical deliveries and human factors such as involvement, communication and anchoring. d) Implementation project: ensure new systems, systems or processes in an organisation and ensure that they are implemented, anchored and used as planned. e) Digitalisation projects - The Norwegian Correctional Service shall digitalise several internal work processes and externally between actors in the criminal case chain as well as management cooperation partners. f) Preliminary projects and concept reviews: reviews the needs, assesses alternative solutions and recommends the most appropriate concept before the main project starts. g) Test management: Planning, managing and following-up test activities to ensure that a system or product fulfils the requirements and functions as expected. The Norwegian Correctional Service has started extensive work of renewing the ICT system and as a result of this need, both top competence and the capacity to carry out small and large projects. Competence/certification within recognised project implementation methods (e.g. the Project Wizard, Prince2 and/or other methods/framework) and flexible methods will be relevant.; Consultants with technical and developer competence, including, but not limited to: a) Architecture (business, business, security, information, application architecture) b) Development, further development and maintenance c) Utilisation of large data, advanced analysis and KI/machine learning. d) Integrations, data exchange, machine interface, API e) Design and user friendliness f) Technical assistance for infrastructure g) IT security and privacy h) Skyreise - The Norwegian Correctional Service needs expertise in cloud architecture and specifically the Microsoft Cloud Technology platform It is important to ensure the correct architecture and sufficient security as an important part of the renewal of ICT systems in progress. This must be taken care of in the development as well as in the management of new and old ICT systems. Consultants shall have competence and experience within the use of tools and methods within DevOps, including: Automation, continual integration and delivery (CI/CD), version control, infrastructure such as code, continuous monitoring, configuration of cloud services etc. Particularly important for the customer ́s existing systems is competence within the Microsoft platform in it's entirety, where the majority of all development and maintenance is based on .Net.; The Norwegian Correctional Service shall enter into parallel framework agreements for the procurement of consultancy services as stated in the tender documentation. Examples of competence areas: a) project management b) flexible management and management of development projects c) Process Management d) alteration management e) introduction projects and digitalisation projects. f) preliminary project and concept reviews g) test management; Examples of competence areas a) performance, information, application and security architecture b) system development, further development and maintenance c) service design, system design and management design d) integrations, APIs and data exchange e) data analysis, big data, KI and machine learning. f) design and user friendliness g) DevOps, CI/CD, automation and infrastructure as code h) cloud architecture and cloud travel i) Microsoft platform and .NET j) KI-consultancy for the implementation, management and consequences.;

rejected.text: Hazard Management System [HMS] The Fraport AG, headquartered in Frankfurt am Main, is a leading global airport operator. The company was founded in 1924 and operates Frankfurt Airport, one of the world's most significant air transport hubs. Furthermore, Fraport is involved in the management and operation of several other airports worldwide. At the Frankfurt am Main site, Fraport currently operates the software (SW) ELDIS III from the company eurofunk as a KRITIS and LuftSIG-relevant system in the security control centre, serving as an operational command system for the works fire brigade, emergency medical services, and security, as well as a workflow system in the integrated passenger flow control centre. The system currently in use is foreseeably reaching its technical limits, making a replacement necessary. The functions to be replaced by new systems include operational command and resource deployment, hazard management, and the provision of geoinformation in the form of a geoproxy. Maintenance, servicing, service, and support are also required for all new systems. Applicants must sign a confidentiality agreement provided by Fraport (see information documents) and submit it together with the application to participate. Following the competition, an indicative tender round will be conducted as part of the tender phase, which will then be followed by one or more binding tender rounds. Within the indicative tender round, bidders may propose changes to the contract, the service description, and the annexes. Fraport will decide on their acceptance or rejection. The contracting authority hereby gives notice that, in the event of being invited to submit a binding tender, the contractor must mandatorily provide the following evidence: 1. All personnel deployed in the project and for all maintenance, service, and support activities must be German-speaking at least at level B2 according to the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages (CEFR) and must be provided from a time zone of UTC +0 to +3. 2. Proof of full access to the control of development resources and unrestricted authority to modify and expand the offered software and hardware. Due to the importance of the overall system to be procured for maintaining flight operations and the strictly mandatory framework schedule, Fraport may withdraw from the entire contract if the contractor culpably fails to provide, or fails to provide in accordance with the contract, services marked as "already available" in terms of hardware and software functions after the conclusion of the contract. The scope includes the delivery, agile (additional) development, commissioning with migration of legacy systems for a new hazard management system, training of the staff of the Fraport AG, as well as maintenance, service, and support services. The contracting authority hereby gives notice that, in the event of being invited to submit a binding tender, the contractor must mandatorily provide proof of a certificate for the hazard management system according to VdS 3534 and, furthermore, provide a concept demonstrating that the system is capable of handling at least 450.000 detector groups and an average of 96.000 messages to be processed per day.

The company was founded in 1924 and operates Frankfurt Airport, one of the most important aviation hubs in the world. Furthermore, Fraport is involved in the management and operation of several other airports worldwide. At the Frankfurt am Main site, Fraport currently operates the ELDIS III software (SW) from eurofunk as a KRITIS- and LuftSIG-relevant system in the security control centre with the operational divisions of company fire service, emergency medical services, and security as a computer-aided dispatch system, and in the integrated passenger flow control centre as a workflow system. The system currently in use is foreseeably reaching its technical limits, making a replacement necessary. The functions to be replaced by new systems comprise computer-aided dispatch and resource allocation, hazard alarm management, and the provision of geoinformation in the form of a geoproxy. Maintenance, upkeep, service, and support are also required for all new systems. Applicants must sign a non-disclosure agreement provided by Fraport (see informational documents) and submit it together with the application to participate. Following the competition for participation, an indicative tender round will first be conducted as part of the bidding phase, which will then be followed by one or more binding tender rounds. Within the indicative tender round, bidders may propose amendments to the contract, specification of services, and annexes. Fraport shall decide on their acceptance or rejection. The Contracting Authority points out even at this stage that, in the event of a request to submit a binding tender, the contractor must mandatorily provide the following proofs: 1. All persons deployed in the project and in all maintenance, service, and support services are German-speaking at least at level B2 in accordance with the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages (CEFR) and are provided from a time zone UTC +0 to +3. 2. Proof of full access to the control of development resources and unrestricted authorisation to modify and expand the offered software and hardware. Due to the importance of the overall system to be procured in this case for the maintenance of flight operations and the milestone schedule that must be strictly adhered to, Fraport may withdraw from the entire contract if the contractor culpably fails to provide or fails to provide in accordance with the contract services marked as "already available" at the conclusion of the contract within the meaning of hardware and software functions after the conclusion of the contract. The scope comprises the delivery, agile (additional) development, commissioning with migration of legacy systems of a new hazard management system, training of employees of Fraport AG as well as maintenance, service, and support services. The Contracting Authority points out even at this stage that, in the event of a request to submit a binding tender, the contractor must mandatorily provide proof of a certificate for the hazard management system in accordance with VdS 3534 and, furthermore, supply a design demonstrating that the system is capable of handling at least 450.000 detector groups and an average of 96.000 messages to be processed per day.

parts.source: Gefahrenmanagementsystem [GMS] Die Fraport AG, mit Hauptsitz in Frankfurt am Main, ist ein weltweit führender Flughafenbetreiber. Das Unternehmen wurde 1924 gegründet und betreibt den Flughafen Frankfurt, eines der bedeutendsten Luftverkehrsdrehkreuze der Welt. Darüber hinaus ist Fraport an der Verwaltung und dem Betrieb von mehreren anderen Flughäfen weltweit beteiligt. Der Fraport betreibt am Standort Frankfurt am Main aktuell die Software (SW) ELDIS III der Fa. eurofunk als KRITIS und LuftSIG relevantes System in der Sicherheitsleitstelle mit den Dienstbereichen Werksfeuerwehr, Rettungsdienst sowie Security als Einsatzleitsystem und in der Integrierten Passagierflußleitstelle als Workflowsystem. Das aktuell im Einsatz befindliche System stößt absehbar an seine technischen Grenzen, so dass eine Ablösung notwendig ist. Die mit neuen Systemen abzulösenden Funktionen umfassen dabei die Einsatzleit- und Kräftedisposition, das Gefahrenmeldermanagement und die Bereitstellung von Geoinformationen in Form eines Geoproxy. Innerhalb der indikativen Angebotsrunde können Änderungsvorschläge an Vertrag, Leistungsbeschreibung und Anhängen durch die Bieter angebracht werden. Fraport entscheidet über deren Annahme oder Ablehnung. Der Auftraggeber weist schon jetzt darauf hin, dass der Auftragnehmer im Falle der Aufforderung zur Abgabe eines verbindlichen Angebots zwingend die folgenden Nachweise zu erbringen hat: 1. Alle im Projekt und allen Wartung, Service und Supportleistung eingesetzte Personen sind deutschsprachig mindestens auf dem Niveau B2 gem. des europäischen Referenzrahmens für Sprachen (GER) und werden aus einer Zeitzone UTC +0 bis +3 zur Verfügung gestellt. 2. Nachweis eines vollumfänglichen Zugriff auf die Steuerung der Entwicklungsressourcen und uneingeschränkte Berechtigung zur Veränderung und Erweiterung der angebotenen Soft- und Hardware. Aufgrund der Bedeutung des vorliegend zu beschaffenden Gesamtsystems für die Aufrechterhaltung des Flugbetriebs zwingend notwendig einzuhaltenden Rahmenterminplan, kann Fraport vom gesamten Vertrag zurückzutreten, wenn der Auftragnehmer zum Vertragsschluss als "bereits verfügbar" gekennzeichnete Leistungen im Sinne von Hard- und Softwarefunktionen schuldhaft nach Vertragsschluss nicht oder nicht vertragsgemäß erbringt. Der Umfang umfasst die Lieferung, agile (Zusatz-)entwicklung, Inbetriebnahme mit Migration der Altsysteme eines neuen Gefahrenmanagementsystem, die Schulung der Mitarbeiter der Fraport AG sowie Wartungs-, Service- und Supportleistungen. Der Auftraggeber weist schon jetzt darauf hin, dass der Auftragnehmer im Falle der Aufforderung zur Abgabe eines verbindlichen Angebots zwingend den Nachweis eines Zertifikates des Gefahrenmanagementsystem nach VdS 3534 zu erbringen hat und darüber hinaus ein Konzept zu liefern, dass das System in der Lage ist, mindestens 450.000 Meldergruppen und durchschnittlich 96.000 zu verarbeitende Meldungen am Tag bewältigen kann.

result.text: Type 1 diabetes (T1D) is a complex disease involving interactions among many different cell types, tissues, organs and biological processes. Genetics, the environment, and lifestyle all play a role in disease development and progression. Over the past two decades, the National Institute of Diabetes and Digestive and Kidney Diseases (NIDDK) has supported major T1D research consortia covering basic, translational, and clinical research. Each consortium has focused on different aspects of T1D, such as specific organs, stages of disease or clinical outcomes. Together, these consortia have collected large longitudinal and multimodal datasets using standardized protocols and coordinated studies. While individual consortia have improved our understanding of specific areas, combining their work offers a rare opportunity to see how different biological processes interact to drive T1D development and progression. This integrated view can answer fundamental questions about T1D biology that cannot be answered using individual datasets or studies alone. Recent advances in artificial intelligence (AI) now make it possible to integrate these complementary datasets and study T1D across various tissues, disease stages, and biological levels. Building on these resources, NIDDK will support a coordinated, milestone-driven research project to answer fundamental questions about T1D biology and accelerate the development of personalized medicine. The project will combine multimodal human pancreas and clinical datasets to better understand how biological processes interact as T1D develops and progresses. The research will generate new insights into T1D biology, help us understand the different forms and stages of T1D, identify biomarkers, and inform new approaches for disease prevention, intervention, and treatment. To support the research, the project will develop and test advanced multimodal AI models. It will also develop AI-enabled research workflows, new methods to integrate data, and privacy-preserving synthetic datasets.

result.text: Open, electronic tender, above the thresholds for the conclusion of a contract for the supply of: 1. Supply of SIEM/SOAR system software licence (Security Information and Event Management – SIEM, Security Orchestration, Automation, and Response - SOAR), 2. Renewal of the Software Assurance (SA) Programme for the Ministry's Microsoft software licences 3. Renewal and extension of support licences (Firmware Updates, Enhanced Support and Phone Support) for the FortiAuthenticator system of the Secure Transmission System (STS) infrastructure, with a total estimated value of 140.300,00€ excluding (without) VAT 24% or 173.972,00€ including VAT 24%. Lot 1 : Supply of SIEM/SOAR system software licence (Security Information and Event Management – SIEM, Security Orchestration, Automation, and Response - SOAR). The requested supply concerns the need to adopt modern security solutions for the Ministry of Education, Religious Affairs and Sports. In this context, it is necessary to procure a SIEM/SOAR system software licence (Security Information and Event Management – SIEM, Security Orchestration, Automation, and Response - SOAR), which will detect threats and automate the response to them, supplementing the technical measures already maintained by the Agency. In detail, a SIEM/SOAR system allows for the centralised collection and analysis of logs from multiple sources, facilitating the timely detection of and immediate response to security incidents. At the same time, it strengthens compliance with regulatory frameworks and supports effective risk management. The installation of such a system in our organisation will provide better oversight of all critical systems, more effective management of security incidents and greater compliance with legal requirements.; Lot 2 : Renewal of the Software Assurance (SA) Programme for the Ministry's Microsoft software licences. The requested service provision concerns the renewal of the Software Assurance (SA) programme for the Microsoft software licences held by the Service. It is noted that, following a tender procedure for the conclusion of a contract by the competent financial services, its procurement was carried out, valid until October 2026 (31-10-2026). However, as the programme in question is considered essential for the smooth operation, security and continuous support of the Ministry's information systems, its renewal for three (3) years is deemed necessary.; Lot 3 : Renewal and extension of support licences (Firmware Updates, Enhanced Support and Phone Support) for the FortiAuthenticator system of the Secure Transmission System (STS) infrastructure. The requested service provision concerns the support of firmware upgrade licences (firmware and general updates), enhanced technical support, as well as phone support for the FortiAuthenticator system of the Secure Transmission System (STS) infrastructure, which is expected to expire on 23-10-2026. Taking into account the criticality of the system in question for the smooth operation of the STS, the renewal and extension of the above support licences up to and including 23-02-2030 is deemed necessary.

parts.source: Ανοικτός, Ηλεκτρονικός Διαγωνισμός, άνω των ορίων για τη σύναψη σύμβασης για την προμήθεια: 1. Προμήθεια Άδειας λογισμικού συστήματος SIEM/SOAR (Security Information and Event Management – SIEM, Security Orchestration, Automation, and Response -SOAR), 2. Ανανέωση του Προγράμματος Συντήρησης και Υποστήριξης (Software Assurance - SA) των Αδειών Λογισμικού Microsoft του Υπουργείου 3. Ανανέωση και Επέκταση των Αδειών Υποστήριξης (Firmware Updates, Enhanced Support και Phone Support) του Συστήματος FortiAuthenticator της Υποδομής του Συστήματος Ασφαλούς Μετάδοσης (ΣΑΜ), συνολικής προϋπολογισθείσας αξίας140.300,00€ πλέον (χωρίς) Φ.Π.Α. 24% ή 173.972,00€ συμπεριλαμβανομένου Φ.Π.Α. 24%. Τμήμα 1 : Προμήθεια Άδειας λογισμικού συστήματος SIEM/SOAR (Security Information and Event Management – SIEM, Security Orchestration, Automation, and Response -SOAR), Η ζητούμενη προμήθεια αφορά στην ανάγκη υιοθέτησης σύγχρονων λύσεων ασφάλειας του Υ.ΠΑΙ.Θ.Α.. Στο πλαίσιο αυτό απαιτείται η προμήθεια άδειας λογισμικού συστήματος SIEM/SOAR (Security Information and Event Management – SIEM, Security Orchestration, Automation, and Response -SOAR), το οποίο θα εντοπίζει απειλές και θα αυτοματοποιεί την απόκριση σε αυτές, συμπληρώνοντας τα τεχνικά μέτρα που ήδη τηρούνται στον Φορέα. Αναλυτικά, ένα σύστημα SIEM/SOAR επιτρέπει την κεντρική συλλογή και ανάλυση καταγραφών από πολλαπλές πηγές, διευκολύνοντας τον έγκαιρο εντοπισμό και την άμεση ανταπόκριση σε περιστατικά ασφάλειας. Παράλληλα ενισχύει τη συμμόρφωση με κανονιστικά πλαίσια και υποστηρίζει την αποτελεσματική διαχείριση κινδύνων. Η εγκατάσταση ενός τέτοιου συστήματος στον οργανισμό μας θα προσφέρει καλύτερη εποπτεία του συνόλου των κρίσιμων συστημάτων, αποτελεσματικότερη διαχείριση περιστατικών ασφάλειας και μεγαλύτερη συμμόρφωση με τις νομικές απαιτήσεις.; Τμήμα 2 : Ανανέωση του Προγράμματος Συντήρησης και Υποστήριξης (Software Assurance - SA) των Αδειών Λογισμικού Microsoft του Υπουργείου Η ζητούμενη παροχή υπηρεσιών αφορά στην ανανέωση του προγράμματος συντήρησης και υποστήριξης (Software Assurance - SA) των αδειών λογισμικού της εταιρείας Microsoft που διαθέτει η Υπηρεσία. Επισημαίνεται ότι, κατόπιν διαγωνιστικής διαδικασίας σύναψης σύμβασης από τις αρμόδιες οικονομικές υπηρεσίες, πραγματοποιήθηκε η προμήθειά του, με ισχύ έως τον Οκτώβριο του 2026 (31-10-2026). Ωστόσο, καθώς το εν λόγω πρόγραμμα θεωρείται απαραίτητο για την απρόσκοπτη λειτουργία, την ασφάλεια και τη συνεχή υποστήριξη των πληροφοριακών συστημάτων του Υπουργείου, κρίνεται απαραίτητη η ανανέωση του για τρία (3) έτη.; Τμήμα 3 : Ανανέωση και Επέκταση των Αδειών Υποστήριξης (Firmware Updates, Enhanced Support και Phone Support) του Συστήματος FortiAuthenticator της Υποδομής του Συστήματος Ασφαλούς Μετάδοσης (ΣΑΜ)».Η ζητούμενη παροχή υπηρεσιών αφορά την υποστήριξη των αδειών αναβάθμισης υλικολογισμικού (firmware και general updates), της διευρυμένης τεχνικής υποστήριξης (enhanced support), καθώς και της τηλεφωνικής υποστήριξης (phone support) του συστήματος Forti Authenticator της υποδομής του Συστήματος Ασφαλούς Μετάδοσης (ΣΑΜ), η οποία αναμένεται να λήξει στις 23-10-2026. Λαμβάνοντας υπόψη την κρισιμότητα του εν λόγω συστήματος για την απρόσκοπτη λειτουργία του ΣΑΜ, κρίνεται απαραίτητη η ανανέωση και επέκταση των ανωτέρω αδειών υποστήριξης έως και την 23-02-2030.

rejected.text: Society relies on chemical processes to turn raw materials into useful products. The Chemical Process Systems (CPS) programme invests in fundamental research on chemical and biochemical processes to make them more efficient, sustainable, and resilient. New CPS technologies for manufacturing, biotechnology, critical minerals, energy, food, and other national priorities will help make the U.S. more competitive and secure. Research supported by the CPS programme covers the full breadth of chemical and biochemical process innovation. It spans reaction engineering and molecular thermodynamics; reactor design; catalysis; electrochemical systems; separations; and process design. The programme encourages proposals that connect the molecular scale to process and plant scales. The CPS programme explores active-site structure and function, reaction mechanisms, in situ and operando characterisation, durability, and device-level integration. Microreactors, membrane and catalytic reactors, atmospheric plasmas, and other novel configurations are of interest. The programme supports research in catalysis and electrochemical systems to produce, use, and store energy, to reduce waste, to process polymers, and to synthesise fuels and chemicals. This includes process and materials innovation to support the nuclear fuel cycle. The CPS programme also targets chemical and biological separations that are efficient and scalable. Research includes the design of membranes, sorbents, and specialised interfaces. Advances can be used in gas separations, the recovery of critical minerals, bioprocessing, and protein and water purification. The programme supports research in process design and optimisation that uses tools such as artificial intelligence, machine learning, and uncertainty quantification. CPS research also explores quantum information science and engineering; quantum simulation and sensing, for example, may accelerate the discovery of materials and improve process models. Partnerships: To speed discovery and innovation, NSF partners with federal agencies, industry, international groups, and others. Current opportunities are at NSF ENG Partnerships.
