result.text: The tender process comprises the conclusion of one (1) contract regarding the Contracting Authority's procurement of the development of an AI-based simulation tool for training child interviews. Based on this tender, one (1) joint contract will be concluded between the supplier and the Responsible Contracting Authority, cf. point 1.2 of the tender conditions, which acts on behalf of all participating contracting authorities. The Responsible Contracting Authority is Professionshøjskolen Absalon, which is authorised to manage all rights and obligations under the contract and acts as the contracting party towards the supplier. The supplier may therefore only direct claims against the Responsible Contracting Authority. Other participating contracting authorities are not direct contracting parties and are not liable either individually or jointly for the performance of the contract. Professionshøjskolen Absalon, in collaboration with the other university colleges, Red Barnet, Barndom Uden Vold and Ole Kirk’s Fond, is offering a contract for the development of an AI-based simulation tool, which is referred to in the tender documentation as the Solution. The purpose is to strengthen the competencies of social workers and social work students to conduct interviews with children in vulnerable situations, including children who may have been exposed to violence or abuse. The Solution must create a realistic, safe and learning-oriented training environment where users can prepare for child interviews, conduct interviews with digital avatars, receive guidance and feedback from a Tutor and subsequently analyse their interviews for the purpose of learning and reflection. It must be capable of being used in social work education, in continuing and further education programmes and in municipal practice. The first version, which this tender covers, must provide the possibility for speech- and text-based interaction with four avatars aged 9–11 years, representing different backgrounds and case types. In addition, there is a Tutor who supports the user before, during and after the interview through preparatory information, ongoing professional hints and subsequent debriefing. The Solution must accommodate both full interview processes and shorter modules where individual interview techniques can be trained in isolation. In the long term, the ambition is to expand the solution with more advanced modalities such as facial expressions and body language as well as real-time analysis of non-verbal communication. The Contracting Authority therefore wishes to attract suppliers who can not only deliver the tendered solution but can also think visionarily in terms of creating a future-proof and innovative platform. The Responsible Contracting Authority provides an extensive knowledge base in the form of practice-oriented cases, anonymised child interviews and the expertise of professionals, and will also contribute actively with professional sparring during development. The tenders will be evaluated on feasibility and risk assessment, functionality and security, the realism of the avatars, the professional quality of the tutor as well as the overall user experience and technical robustness. The Responsible Contracting Authority is entitled to terminate the contract at Partial Delivery Day 1 (POC), solely for the purpose of bringing the project to an end, if it turns out during Partial Delivery 1 - POC that there are technical challenges which make it impossible to develop a suitable and usable Solution for the purpose that the contract supports, cf. point 31.2.1 of the Contract. However, it is the clear intention of the Responsible Contracting Authority to complete the development of a complete Solution that functions according to its purpose. Due to the established budget, the Contracting Authority has set a price ceiling for the Delivery Consideration. The Delivery Consideration, including the price for the Clarification Phase and the Delivery, cf. Contract Annex 01 – Schedule, must thus be a maximum of five (5) million DKK excl. VAT. Within the established price ceiling of five (5) million DKK excl. VAT, the Contracting Authority wishes to promote solutions that combine high technical quality and a high level of innovation. With this tender, the Contracting Authority aims to support a competition that is not only based on price, but also on the Tenderers' ability to think long-term and visionarily. The Contracting Authority therefore explains the strategic and technological ambitions for the Solution in order to encourage tenderers to present proposals that reflect a future-proof and technologically advanced approach. At the same time, it is important for the Contracting Authority that the Solution can be operated sustainably within the financial frameworks that apply to the joint operations of the university colleges. The Contracting Authority therefore wishes to enter into a contract with a Supplier who can ensure creativity and technical ingenuity in relation to developing a Solution that meets the desired needs, but which can at the same time be operated by the university colleges jointly - where interview flow is weighted higher than visualisation of the child's non-verbal language.

parts.source: Udbudsprocessen omfatter indgåelse af én (1) kontrakt vedrørende Ordregivers anskaffelse af udvikling af et AI-baseret simulationsredskab til træning af børnesamtaler. På baggrund af nærværende udbud vil der blive indgået én (1) fælles kontrakt mellem leverandøren og den Ansvarlige Ordregiver, jf. udbudsbetingelsernes punkt 1.2, som handler på vegne af samtlige deltagende ordregivere. Den Ansvarlige Ordregiver er Professionshøjskolen Absalon, som er bemyndiget til at varetage samtlige rettigheder og forpligtelserne i henhold til kontrakten og optræder som kontraktpart over for leverandøren. Leverandøren kan således alene rette krav mod den Ansvarlige Ordregiver. Øvrige deltagende ordregivere er ikke direkte kontraktparter og hæfter hverken individuelt eller solidarisk for opfyldelsen af kontrakten. Professionshøjskolen Absalon udbyder i samarbejde med de øvrige professionshøjskoler, Red Barnet, Barndom Uden Vold og Ole Kirk’s Fond en opgave om udvikling af et AI-baseret simulationsredskab, som i udbudsmaterialet betegnes Løsningen. Formålet er at styrke socialrådgiveres og socialrådgiverstuderendes kompetencer til at gennemføre samtaler med børn i sårbare situationer, herunder børn der kan have været udsat for vold eller overgreb. Løsningen skal skabe et realistisk, trygt og læringsorienteret træningsmiljø, hvor brugerne kan forberede sig på børnesamtaler, gennemføre samtaler med digitale avatarer, få vejledning og feedback fra en Tutor og efterfølgende analysere deres samtaler med henblik på læring og refleksion. Den skal både kunne anvendes i socialrådgiveruddannelsen, i efter- og videreuddannelsesforløb og i den kommunale praksis. Den første version, som dette udbud omfatter, skal give mulighed for tale- og tekstbaseret interaktion med fire avatarer i alderen 9–11 år, som repræsenterer forskellige baggrunde og sagstyper. Hertil kommer en Tutor, der understøtter brugeren før, under og efter samtalen gennem forberedende information, løbende faglige hints og efterfølgende debriefing. Løsningen skal rumme både fulde samtaleforløb og kortere moduler, hvor enkelte samtaleteknikker kan trænes isoleret. På længere sigt er ambitionen at udvide løsningen med mere avancerede modaliteter såsom mimik og kropssprog samt realtidsanalyse af nonverbal kommunikation. Ordregiver ønsker derfor at tiltrække leverandører, som ikke alene kan levere den udbudte løsning, men også kan tænke visionært i forhold til at skabe en fremtidssikret og innovativ platform. Den Ansvarlige Ordregiver stiller et omfattende vidensgrundlag til rådighed i form af praksisnære cases, anonymiserede børnesamtaler og fagpersoners ekspertise, og vil desuden bidrage aktivt med faglig sparring under udviklingen. Tilbuddene vil blive vurderet på realiserbarhed og risikovurdering, funktionalitet og sikkerhed, realismen i avatarerne, tutorens faglige kvalitet samt den samlede brugeroplevelse og tekniske robusthed. Den Ansvarlige Ordregiver er berettiget til at opsige kontrakten ved Delleverancedag 1 (POC), udelukkende med henblik på at kunne bringe projektet til ophør, såfremt det under Delleverance 1 - POC viser sig, at der foreligger tekniske udfordringer, som gør det umuligt at udvikle en egnet og anvendelig Løsning til det formål, som kontrakten understøtter, jf. Kontraktens punkt 31.2.1. Det er dog den Ansvarlige Ordregivers klare hensigt at gennemføre udviklingen af en fuldstændig Løsning, der fungerer efter sit formål. Af hensyn til fastlagt budget har Ordregiver fastlagt et prisloft for Leverancevederlaget. Leverancevederlaget, herunder prisen for Afklaringsfasen og Leverancen, jf. Kontraktbilag 01 – Tidsplan, må således maksimalt være fem (5) mio. DKK ekskl. moms. Inden for det fastlagte prisloft på fem (5) mio. DKK ekskl. moms ønsker Ordregiver at fremme løsninger, der kombinerer høj teknisk kvalitet og innovationshøjde. Med dette udbud tilstræber Ordregiver at understøtte en konkurrence, der ikke alene baseres på pris, men også på Tilbudsgivernes evne til at tænke langsigtet og visionært. Ordregiver redegør derfor for de strategiske og teknologiske ambitioner for Løsningen med henblik på at opfordre tilbudsgivere til at præsentere forslag, der afspejler en fremtidssikret og teknologisk avanceret tilgang. Samtidig er det vigtigt for Ordregiver, at Løsningen kan driftes bæredygtigt inden for de økonomiske rammer, der gælder for professionshøjskolernes fælles drift. Ordregiver ønsker derfor at indgå kontrakt med en Leverandør, der kan sikre iderigdom og teknisk snilde i forhold til at udvikle en Løsning, der opfylder de ønskede behov, men som samtidig kan driftes af professionshøjskolerne i fællesskab - hvor samtaleflow vægtes højere end visualisering af barnets nonverbale sprog.

result.text: Implementation of electronic time recording in SAP. In the course of advancing digitalisation, a central electronic time recording system is to be introduced. This is intended to enable the approximately 8.000 employees from technology, administration, and science to digitally record and manage daily working hours, absences - e.g., sick days, vacation days - as well as project-related working hours (project hours) in one place. This is intended not only to serve the reduction of administrative efforts, such as when applying for and approving absences, but also to create increased transparency and legal certainty. Please refer to the detailed description "Ausschreibung_ASP_Zeiterfassung" for all details. You can find this in the procurement documents section.

parts.source: Implementierung einer elektronischen Zeiterfassung in SAP. Im Zuge der fortschreitenden Digitalisierung soll eine zentrale elektronische Zeiterfassung eingeführt werden. Diese soll es den rund 8.000 Mitarbeitenden aus Technik, Verwaltung und Wis-senschaft ermöglichen, tägliche Arbeitszeiten, Abwesenheiten - z. B. Krankheitstage, Urlaubstage - sowie projektbezogene Arbeitszeiten (Projektzeiten) digital an einem Ort zu erfassen und verwalten. Dies soll nicht nur der Reduzierung administrativer Aufwände dienen, wie z. B. bei der Beantragung und Genehmigung von Abwesenheiten, sondern auch eine erhöhte Transparenz und Rechtssicherheit schaffen. Alle Details entnehmen Sie bitte der ausführlichen Beschreibung "Ausschreibung_ASP_Zeiterfassung". Dieses finden Sie im Bereich der Vergabeunterlagen.

result.text: Rajavartiolaitos is procuring hardware and software for a cyber monitoring and log collection technical solution during the year 2026, consisting of, among other things, equipment cabinets, server computers, network devices, firewalls, gateway solutions, encryptors, software and associated software licences, services, and presentation technology used in offices. The procurement is divided into lots forming appropriate units. The procurement includes additional procurement options, which are described in more detail by lot in the call for tenders. The subject of the procurement lot is several types of separate server units, examples of which are given below. The server units can be populated with various server chassis so that the capacity requirements defined for each unit can be met. • Server configuration 1 - max. 24 cores/48 threads - max. 64 GB - min. 1x network card for speeds of 1/10 GB - max. 5 TB • Server configuration 2 - max. 50 cores/ 100 threads - max. 128-256 GB RAM - min. 2x network cards, for speeds of 1/10/25 GB - HDD or min. 400 TB disk capacity • Server configuration 3 - max. 50 cores/ 100 threads - max. 128-256 GB RAM - min. 2x network cards, for speeds of 1/10/25 GB - SSD: 5 – 20 TB - HDD max. 400 TB disk capacity • Disk system - Expansion capacity up to 1 PB In addition to the described server units, other server configurations may also be procured. The configurations to be procured will be defined in more detail in the call for tenders and finalised with the selected supplier. At least 10 servers will be procured. At least 1 disk systems will be procured. The procurement includes associated software, extended warranty, and support service.; The subject of the procurement lot is physical and virtual NGFW firewalls, as well as layer 2 and 3 network devices. The procurement includes associated software, extended warranty, and support service.; The subject of the procurement lot is encryption devices approved by Traficom for security level TL III. The procurement includes associated software, extended warranty, and support service.; The subject of the procurement lot is equipment cabinets, workstations, and accessories. Accessories may include, for example, UPS devices, monitors, keyboards, mice, and cables. The procurement includes an extended warranty.; The subject of the lot procurement is SIEM licences and virtualisation platform licences for the use of the Finnish Border Guard.

Järjestelmän tulee tukea kunta-alan virka- ja työehtosopimuksia (KVTES, OVTES, TS ja TTES) ja mahdollistaa palvelussuhteen elinkaaren hallinnan, palkanmaksun prosessit sekä sisältää kattavan raportoinnin. Naantalin kaupunki pitää tärkeänä, että järjestelmän omistajuus ja kehitysoikeudet ovat tarjoajan hallinnassa, jotta voimme varmistua palkkapalvelun jatkuvuudesta ja järjestelmän kehityskyvystä sopimuskauden aikana. Hankittava järjestelmä toimii henkilöstöön liittyvien perus- ja palvelussuhdetietojen ensisijaisena master data -lähteenä muihin kaupungin järjestelmiin. Sen tulee tukea Microsoft 365 -tunnuksilla toimivaa kertakirjautumista (SSO, Entra ID (Azure AD) -integraatio). Järjestelmän tulee olla integroitavissa Naantalin kaupungin tällä hetkellä käytössä oleviin järjestelmiin: • kirjanpitojärjestelmä ProEconomica Premium • pankkiaineisto Nomentia • työajanseurantaohjelmat Nepton ja Titania • varhaiskasvatuksen tietovaranto Varda • varhaiskasvatuksen toiminnanohjausjärjestelmä Päikky • kansalaisopiston Hellewi • työterveyshuolto Mehiläinen • verohallinnon Tulorekisteri • verokorttien rajapinta VeroApi • käyttäjähallinta Ruuvi • ay-jäsenmaksuselvitykset VILO Järjestelmän käyttöönottoprojekti aloitetaan marraskuussa 2026. Järjestelmän tulee olla käyttöönotettavissa 1.4.2027 ja tuotantokäyttö aloitetaan 1.5.2027. Hankinnan kohde ja sitä koskevat vaatimukset on kuvattu yksityiskohtaisesti liitteessä 1 (Naantalin kaupunki_Palkka- ja HRjärjestelmän vaatimukset), jonka kaikki välilehdet tulee täyttää. Tarjousten vertailu perustuu kokonaisvertailuhintaan, liitteen 1 hintaliitteestä.

result.text: The subject of the procurement is a payroll and HR system, which also includes a travel management section. The system is procured as a SaaS service and includes implementation and operational support. The system must support municipal-sector office and collective agreements (KVTES, OVTES, TS and TTES) and enable the management of the employment relationship lifecycle, payroll processes and include comprehensive reporting. Naantalin kaupunki considers it important that system ownership and development rights are under the tenderer's control so that we can ensure the continuity of the payroll service and the development capability of the system during the contract period. The system to be procured acts as the primary master data source for personnel-related basic and employment relationship data for the city's other systems. It must support single sign-on operating with Microsoft 365 credentials (SSO, Entra ID (Azure AD) integration). The system must be integrable with the systems currently in use by the City of Naantali: • accounting system ProEconomica Premium • banking material Nomentia • working hours tracking software Nepton and Titania • early childhood education data repository Varda • early childhood education operational management system Päikky • adult education centre Hellewi • occupational healthcare Mehiläinen • tax administration Incomes Register • tax card interface VeroApi • user management Ruuvi • trade union membership fee statements VILO The system implementation project will be initiated in November 2026. The system must be capable of being implemented by 1.4.2027 and operational use will be started 1.5.2027. The subject of the procurement and the requirements concerning it are described in detail in Appendix 1 (Naantalin kaupunki_Payroll and HR system requirements), all tabs of which must be filled in. The comparison of tenders is based on the total comparison price from the price appendix of Appendix 1.

result.text: Numera Palvelut Oy (hereinafter Numera or Contracting Authority) requests your tender for a joint procurement concerning Printing and information services (Multifunction devices and related services) in accordance with the call for tender documents. The procurement is not divided into lots; instead, a single supplier will be selected, with whom Numera will draw up mutual procurement contracts.: The competitive tendering is conducted via an open procedure. The selection criterion used for the competitive tendering is the most economically advantageous tender, and the comparison criterion is [the best price-quality ratio]. Detailed information on scoring and comparison criteria is presented in the section Criteria for the subject of the procurement of the call for tender. If several tenderers achieve the exact same score with their tender, the Contracting Authority will draw lots to determine the winner. Drawing lots is an accepted method in procurement law case law. Parallel tenders and alternative tenders are not accepted. The procurement contract shall be valid for a fixed term of two (2) years. Thereafter, the contract shall continue until further notice. Numera's customer communities using the joint procurement and potentially joining it during the contract period are stated in appendix one (1) of the draft agreement. The procurement contract shall enter into force once the procurement decision has become legally binding or the Market Court has granted an enforcement permit for the procurement decision, and both contracting parties have signed a written procurement contract. The notice period for terminating the contract is six (6) months for both contracting parties. A customer participating in the contract may terminate the contract in respect of itself with a notice period of 6 months. By submitting a tender, the tenderer undertakes to comply with all conditions in the call for tender documents and any additional information provided during the procurement procedure. The Contracting Authority has the right to verify the information provided by the tenderer in its tender documents before making the procurement decision. If the information provided is incorrect, the tenderer may be excluded from the procurement procedure. The main subject of the procurement is multifunction devices for uniform use (emphasising A4-sized devices) for printing and scanning, document workflow management, and support and additional services related to the aforementioned devices and their services (e.g. secure printing, management solutions, toner and supply solutions, ordering system, etc.). The focus of the procurement is on cost-effective devices supporting A4 printing, X-archive scanning (healthcare XDS solutions) individual devices agreed on a case-by-case basis, taking GDPR into account in operations, support and maintenance services, and other additional printing services in accordance with the documents. This procurement does not include the procurement of printing paper, printing work, or printing services (e.g. digital and offset printing). It is possible to expand the procurement during the negotiation procedure as an option regarding printers connected to workstations via USB. Numera decides on the implementation of the option. In questions and problem situations related to the use of the tendering service, the tenderer must contact the service provider's (Cloudia Oy / Tarjouspalvelu.fi) Helpdesk: tel. 020 766 1075, tuki@cloudia.fi.

parts.source: Numera Palvelut Oy (myöhemmin Numera tai Hankintayksikkö) pyytää tarjoustanne Tulostus ja informaatiopalveluita (Monitoimilaitteet ja niihin liittyvät palvelut) koskevaan yhteishankintaan tarjouspyyntöasiakirjojen mukaan. Hankintaa ei ole jaettu osakokonaisuuksiin, vaan valitaan yksi toimittaja, jonka kanssa Numera laatii keskinäiset hankintasopimukset.: Kilpailutus suoritetaan avoimella menettelyllä. Kilpailutuksen valintaperusteena käytetään kokonaistaloudellista edullisuutta ja vertailuperusteena [parasta hinta-laatusuhdetta]. Tarkemmat tiedot pisteytyksestä ja vertailuperusteista on esitetty tarjouspyynnön osiossa Hankinnan kohteen kriteerit. Mikäli useampi tarjoaja ansaitsee tarjouksellaan täsmälleen saman pistemäärän, Hankintayksikkö arpoo voittajan. Arvonta on hankitalain oikeuskäytännössä hyväksytty tapa. Rinnakkaisia tarjouksia, vaihtoehtoisia tarjouksia ei hyväksytä. Hankintasopimus on voimassa määräaikaisena kaksi (2) vuotta. Sen jälkeen sopimus jatkuu toistaiseksi voimassa olevana. Yhteishankintaa käyttävät ja siihen mahdollisesti sopimuskauden aikana mukaan tulevat Numeran asiakasyhteisöt on ilmoitettu sopimusluonnoksen liitteellä yksi (1). Hankintasopimus astuu voimaan hankintapäätöksen tultua lainvoimaiseksi tai markkinaoikeuden antaessa hankintapäätökselle täytäntöönpanoluvan ja molempien sopijapuolten allekirjoitettua kirjallisen hankintasopimuksen. Sopimuksen irtisanomisaika on molempien sopijapuolten osalta kuusi (6) kuukautta. Sopimuksessa mukana oleva asiakas voi irtisanoa sopimuksen osaltaan 6 kk irtisanomisajalla. Tarjoaja sitoutuu tarjouksellaan kaikkiin tarjouspyyntöasiakirjojen sekä mahdollisesti hankintamenettelyn aikana annettujen lisätietojen mukaisiin ehtoihin. Hankintayksiköllä on oikeus tarkastaa tarjoajan tarjousasiakirjoissaan antamat tiedot ennen hankintapäätöksen tekemistä. Mikäli annetut tiedot eivät pidä paikkaansa, tarjoaja voidaan joutua sulkemaan hankintamenettelystä. Hankinnan pääasiallisena kohteena ovat yhtenäisen käytön mukaiset monitoimilaitteet (painotettuna A4-kokoiset laitteet) tulostamiseen ja skannaukseen, asiakirjojen työnkulun ohjaamiseen, sekä em. laitteisiin ja niiden palveluihin liittyvät tuki- ja lisäpalvelut (esim. turvatulostaminen, hallintaratkaisut, väri- ja tarvikeratkaisut, tilausjärjestelmä yms.). Hankinnan keskiössä ovat kustannustehokkaat, A4-tulostamista tukevat laitteet, X-arkistoskannaus (terveydenhuollon XDS-ratkaisut) yksittäisiä laitteita, jotka sovitaan tapauskohtaisesti, GDPR:n huomioiminen toiminnassa, tuki- ja huoltopalvelut sekä muut tulostuspalveluiden lisäpalvelut asiakirjojen mukaisesti. Tämä hankinta ei sisällä tulostuspaperin, painotöiden tai painopalvelujen (esim. digi- ja offset-paino) hankintaa. Hankintaa on mahdollista laajentaa neuvottelumenettelyn aikana optiona USB:lla työasemiin kytkettävien tulostimien osalta. Option käyttöönotosta päättää Numera. Tarjouspalvelun käyttöön liittyvissä kysymyksissä ja ongelmatilanteissa tarjoajan tulee olla yhteydessä palveluntuottajan (Cloudia Oy / Tarjouspalvelu.fi) Helpdeskiin: puh. 020 766 1075, tuki@cloudia.fi.

result.text: The district administration of the Oberhavel district (contracting authority) intends to award the supply of CAFM software as well as its maintenance and support (including configuration/implementation) with effect presumably from 01.05.2026. Following the competition for participation, at least three and at most five suitable candidates will be admitted to the 2 stage of the procurement procedure - the tender phase. Details of the procurement procedure can be found in the procedural conditions. The district administers a comprehensive range of properties, both in its own use and rented out. In order to efficiently fulfil the necessary facility management processes, the Landkreis Oberhavel plans to implement a professional CAFM system that offers a user-friendly software interface and effective process structures. This is intended to optimise workflows, better manage resources and improve the quality of services for the citizens of the district. The software must be purely web-based and provided as an on-premise solution. The software must essentially map the following processes: - Business planning, budget planning and budget control, maintenance, inspection, testing - Contract management - Letting management - Ticketing and complaint management - Special cleaning - Locking management - Cleaning and winter service - Invoice management - Service charge settlement including energy management - Vacancy management - Inventory management - Grounds maintenance - Warranty tracking - Space management including relocation management - in particular relocation variant planning - Master data maintenance / documentation and reporting The following processes are also desirable (better evaluated - see procurement documents), but not mandatory: - Sale / award of hereditary building right - Commissioning / commissioning management Service provision - Incl. installation, customisation, interfaces - Incl. documentation, training and training materials The technical requirements for each process are described in detail in Appendix 01 - LK Oberhavel process requirements. Further criteria to be met are provided by the specifications and performance sheets A / B / I, as well as the agenda with the S-criteria, which are evaluated in the course of the presentation.

parts.source: Die Kreisverwaltung des Landkreises Oberhavel (Auftraggeber) beabsichtigt, mit Wirkung voraussichtlich zum 01.05.2026 die Lieferung einer CAFM-Software sowie deren Pflege und Support (einschließlich Konfiguration/Implementierung) zu vergeben. Im Anschluss an den Teilnahmewettbewerb werden mindestens drei und höchstens fünf geeignete Bewerber zur 2. Stufe des Vergabeverfahrens - Angebotsphase zugelassen. Die Einzelheiten des Vergabeverfahrens sind den Verfahrensbedingungen zu entnehmen. Der Landkreis verwaltet eine umfangreiche Palette an Liegenschaften, sowohl in eigener Nutzung als auch vermietet. Um die notwendigen Facility Management-Prozesse effizient zu erfüllen, plant der Landkreis Oberhavel die Implementierung eines professionellen CAFM-Systems, das eine benutzerfreundliche Oberfläche und effektive Prozessstrukturen bietet. Dadurch sollen die Arbeitsabläufe optimiert, die Ressourcen besser verwaltet und die Qualität der Dienstleistungen für die Bürgerinnen und Bürger des Landkreises verbessert werden. Die Software ist rein webbasiert und als On-Premise Lösung zur Verfügung zu stellen. Im Wesentlichen sind folgende Prozesse durch die Software abzubilden: - Wirtschaftsplanung, Budgetplanung und Budgetsteuerung Wartung, Inspektion, Prüfungen - Vertragsmanagement - Vermietungsmanagement - Ticketing und Beschwerdemanagement - Sonderreinigung - Schließmanagement - Reinigung und Winterdienst - Rechnungsmanagement - Nebenkostenabrechnung inkl. Energiemanagement - Leerstandsmanagement - Inventarmanagement - Grünpflege - Gewährleitungsverfolgung - Flächenmanagement inkl. Umzugsmanagement-insbesondere Umzugsvariantenplanung - Stammdatenpflege / Dokumentation und Berichtswesen Wünschenswert (besser bewertet- siehe Vergabeunterlagen), aber nicht zwingend gefordert sind außerdem folgende Prozesse: - Verkauf / Vergabe Erbbaurecht - Inbetriebnahme / Inbetriebnahmemanagement Leistungserbringung - Inkl. Installation, Anpassung, Schnittstellen - inkl. Dokumentationen, Schulungen und Schulungsunterlagen Die technischen Anforderungen je Prozess werden in Anlage 01 - LK Oberhavel Prozessanforderungen detailliert beschrieben, Über die weiteren zu erfüllenden Kriterien geben das Lastenheft und die Leistungsblätter A / B / I Aufschluss, sowie die Agenda mit den S-Kriterien, die im Zuge der Präsentation bewertet werden.

rejected.text: The Republic of Moldova is undergoing an accelerated and complex European Union accession process following the opening of accession negotiations with the EU in 2024. The accession process requires comprehensive alignment of Moldova's legal, institutional and policy framework with the EU acquis, as well as strengthened governance structures, institutional coordination mechanisms and implementation capacities at national and local level. In September 2025, Moldova successfully completed the screening process for all chapters of the EU acquis, enabling the transition to structured technical negotiations and implementation of opening benchmarks and subsequent requirements identified during the screening process. These developments generate increasing demand for specialised expertise, institutional capacity development and practical support for the implementation of EU-related reforms. Particular importance is attached to reforms related to rule of law, democratic governance, public administration, justice and internal security, especially under Cluster I "Fundamentals", including Chapter 23 (Judiciary and Fundamental Rights) and Chapter 24 (Justice, Freedom and Security). At the same time, Moldova's EU accession process also requires stronger local governance capacities, improved multi-level coordination and increased participation of civil society, diaspora organisations and other stakeholders in EU-related reform processes. In this context, Deutsche Gesellschaft für Internationale Zusammenarbeit (GIZ) GmbH implements the projects "EU Integration Support Project" (EUISP), financed by the German Federal Foreign Office (FFO), and "Facilitating the EU Accession process through Coordination and Engagement in Moldova" (FACE), financed by the German Federal Ministry for Economic Cooperation and Development (BMZ). To support the implementation of these projects, GIZ foresees the establishment of a comprehensive Short-Term Expert Pool (STEP), enabling flexible and demand-driven mobilisation of national and international expertise. The STEP will support activities related to legislative and policy approximation to the EU acquis, negotiation preparation and benchmark fulfilment, institutional and organisational capacity development, strategic planning and coordination, strengthening local governance capacities, facilitation of international cooperation and peer-to-peer exchange, as well as structured stakeholder engagement and support for local initiatives. The contractor implementing the STEP will provide technical advisory services, analytical support, capacity development measures, international exchange formats and implementation support in close cooperation with GIZ and Moldovan partner institutions. The overall objective is to strengthen the capacities of national and local actors to effectively coordinate, implement and support Moldova's EU accession and alignment process. The procurement concerns the establishment and operation of a comprehensive Short-Term Expert Pool (STEP) supporting the implementation of activities under the GIZ projects "EU Integration Support Project" (EUISP) and "Facilitating the EU Accession process through Coordination and Engagement in Moldova" (FACE), both contributing to the Republic of Moldova's EU accession and alignment process. The contractor will provide flexible, demand-driven and results-oriented consultancy and implementation support services aimed at strengthening the capacities of national and local actors involved in Moldova's EU accession process. The services will combine technical advisory support, institutional and organisational capacity development, international experience exchange, stakeholder engagement and support for local initiatives. The contractor will be responsible for identifying, mobilising, coordinating and managing national and international experts and support measures in close cooperation with GIZ and Moldovan partner institutions. The assignment may include the following services and activities: - technical, legal and methodological advisory services related to EU acquis alignment, policy development and implementation of EU-related reforms; - preparation and revision of draft laws, regulations, strategies, methodologies, guidelines and analytical documents; - institutional, legislative and implementation gap analyses, including assessment of institutional capacities and implementation readiness; - support for negotiation process, fulfilment of opening and closing benchmarks and related monitoring and reporting processes; - development and strengthening of strategic planning, coordination, monitoring and reporting mechanisms related to EU accession and EU-aligned reforms; - provision of thematic expertise related to rule of law, democratic governance, justice, internal security, public administration reform and local governance; - design and delivery of trainings, workshops, mentoring, coaching and institutional learning activities for representatives of public institutions and other stakeholders; - organisation and facilitation of international peer-to-peer exchange, study visits, policy dialogues, expert discussions and cooperation formats involving EU Member States, accession countries and international experts; - support for strengthening coordination, cooperation and communication mechanisms between national institutions, local public authorities and other stakeholders involved in the accession process; - support for participatory and stakeholder engagement processes involving civil society organisations, diaspora representatives, women's organisations and organisations representing vulnerable groups; - support for strengthening local governance capacities and practical application of EU-related planning, implementation and monitoring approaches at local level;

result.text: With this procurement procedure, the contracting authority intends to conclude a framework agreement with two economic operators for the provision of PaaS services for AI applications on a high-performance, secure, and sovereign cloud platform. The subject of the service is the provision of a cloud-agnostic AI platform as a Platform-as-a-Service (PaaS), which serves as a building block of a modular, cross-cloud infrastructure. The services include the provision and operation of a high-performance, secure, and DVC-oriented cloud platform, particularly with regard to the appropriate use of open standards, open interfaces, or open-source components. The platform provides a uniform operating environment for containerised applications and AI workloads and supports multi-cloud and hybrid deployment scenarios. It must ensure the secure and reproducible operation of AI applications, provide GPU-supported computing environments, and support MLOps pipelines. In this context, the integration of existing on-premises systems that are managed centrally must be enabled. The first applications to be operated on the platform are the KIPITZ solutions and the AI application for accelerating planning and approval procedures. Further applications may be added during the contract term. The platform must provide uniform mechanisms for identity and role management, encryption (e.g., BYOK/HYOK), logging, auditing, as well as for change and exit processes. Further information on the subject of the contract can be found in the procurement documents, in particular in the description of services and the draft contract. ESTIMATED VALUE, MAXIMUM VALUE, FINANCIAL RESOURCES The estimated contract volume of this framework agreement is EUR 208,00 million net over the maximum contract term of four years. The maximum value of the framework agreement is EUR 249,60 million net over the maximum contract term of four years. Financial resources in the amount of EUR 200 million net are secured, of which there is a justified expectation in the amount of EUR 195 million net that the financing can be ensured. Financing in the amount of EUR 49,5 million is still uncertain. There is no entitlement to the award of individual contracts to a specific extent. The information is provided exclusively for procurement law purposes of transparency. Bidders must take this into account in their calculation. ENTITIES ENTITLED TO CALL OFF AND ENTITLED TO RECEIVE SERVICES The Bundesrepublik Deutschland, vertreten durch das Bundesministerium für Digitales und Staatsmodernisierung is both the contracting authority and the entity entitled to call off and receive services. It may award individual contracts for itself as well as for the entities entitled to receive services within the federal administration. This includes all parts of the federal administration, including the ITZBund. Individual call-offs are issued by the Federal Ministry for Digital and Transport for these entities entitled to receive services, which are entitled and obliged exclusively through the individual contract declared for them. In addition, govdigital eG is entitled to call off and receive services. It may award individual contracts for itself and for its members. Individual call-offs are carried out by govdigital eG for its members, which are entitled and obliged exclusively through the individual contract declared for them. NOTE ON ELIGIBILITY TO PARTICIPATE Economic operators from third countries that are not covered by an international agreement with the European Union guaranteeing equal and reciprocal access to public procurement ("non-covered countries") may be excluded from participation in this procurement procedure. The decision on the admission of such economic operators is made on a case-by-case basis by the contracting authority and is based on the case law of the European Court of Justice (in particular the judgment in case C-652/22 - Kolin). Requests to participate and tenders that include subcontractors or members of a bidding consortium from non-covered countries are also subject to a separate review and may be excluded or adjusted in the evaluation.

parts.source: Mit diesem Vergabeverfahren beabsichtigt die Auftraggeberin eine Rahmenvereinbarung über die Bereitstellung von PaaS-Diensten für KI-Anwendungen auf einer leistungsfähigen, sicheren und souveränen Cloud-Plattform mit zwei Wirtschaftsteilnehmern abzuschließen. Leistungsgegenstand ist die Bereitstellung einer cloud-agnostischen KI-Plattform als Platform-as-a-Service (PaaS), die als ein Baustein einer modularen, cloudübergreifenden Infrastruktur dient. Die Leistungen umfassen die Bereitstellung und den Betrieb einer leistungsfähigen, sicheren und DVC-orientierten Cloud-Plattform, insbesondere mit Blick auf die angemessene Verwendung von offenen Standards, offenen Schnittstellen oder Open-Source-Komponenten. Die Plattform stellt eine einheitliche Betriebsumgebung für containerisierte Anwendungen und KI-Workloads bereit und unterstützt Multi-Cloud- sowie hybride Einsatzszenarien. Sie muss den sicheren und reproduzierbaren Betrieb von KI-Anwendungen gewährleisten, GPU-gestützte Rechenumgebungen bereitstellen und MLOps-Pipelines unterstützen. Dabei ist eine Integration bestehender On-Premises-Systeme zu ermöglichen, die zentral verwaltet werden. Als erste Anwendungen sind die Lösungen KIPITZ und die KI-Anwendung zur Beschleunigung von Planungs- und Genehmigungsverfahren auf der Plattform zu betreiben. Weitere Anwendungen können während der Vertragslaufzeit ergänzt werden. Die Plattform hat einheitliche Mechanismen zur Identitäts- und Rollenverwaltung, Verschlüsselung (z. B. BYOK/HYOK), Protokollierung, Auditierung sowie für Change- und Exit-Prozesse bereitzustellen. Weitere Informationen zum Auftragsgegenstand ergeben sich aus den Vergabeunterlagen, insbesondere aus der Leistungsbeschreibung und dem Vertragsentwurf. SCHÄTZWERT, HÖCHSTWERT, FINANZIERUNGSMITTEL Das geschätzte Auftragsvolumen dieser Rahmenvereinbarung beträgt EUR 208,00 Mio. netto über die maximale Vertragslaufzeit von vier Jahren. Der Höchstwert der Rahmenvereinbarung beträgt EUR 249,60 Mio. netto über die maximale Vertragslaufzeit von vier Jahren. Die Finanzmittel sind in Höhe von EUR 200 Mio. netto gesichert, davon besteht in Höhe von EUR 195 Mio. netto eine begründete Erwartung, dass die Finanzierung sichergestellt werden kann. In Höhe von EUR 49,5 Mio. ist die Finanzierung noch ungewiss. Es besteht kein Anspruch auf die Erteilung von Einzelaufträgen in einem bestimmten Umfang. Die Angaben dienen ausschließlich vergaberechtlichen Zwecken der Transparenz. Die Bieter haben dies bei der Kalkulation zu berücksichtigen. ABRUFBERECHTIGTE UND BEZUGSBERECHTIGTE STELLEN Die Bundesrepublik Deutschland, vertreten durch das Bundesministerium für Digitales und Staatsmodernisierung, ist sowohl Auftraggeberin als auch Abruf- und Bezugsberechtigte. Sie kann Einzelaufträge für sich selbst sowie für die Bezugsberechtigten innerhalb der Bundesverwaltung erteilen. Dazu gehören alle Teile der Bundesverwaltung, einschließlich des ITZBund. Die Einzelabrufe werden durch das Bundesministerium für Digitales und Staatsmodernisierung für diese Bezugsberechtigten erteilt, die ausschließlich durch den für sie erklärten Einzelauftrag berechtigt und verpflichtet sind. Zusätzlich ist die govdigital eG abruf- und bezugsberechtigt. Sie kann Einzelaufträge für sich und für ihre Mitglieder erteilen. Die Einzelabrufe erfolgen durch die govdigital eG für ihre Mitglieder, die ausschließlich durch den für sie erklärten Einzelauftrag berechtigt und verpflichtet sind. Die Entscheidung über die Zulassung solcher Wirtschaftsteilnehmer erfolgt im Einzelfall durch die Auftraggeberin und basiert auf der Rechtsprechung des Europäischen Gerichtshofs (insbesondere Urteil in der Rechtssache C-652/22 - Kolin). result.text: Automation Marketplace DPS Intelligent automation services and solutions, including automation technologies, services, consultancy and licences. Updates 26/09/24: We have extended this agreement until November 2026. You will be able to buy and run tenders for services until the new expiry date. Description A Dynamic Purchasing System (DPS) that offers automation services and licences for use by the public sector, including their associated bodies and agencies. Automation services are needed to streamline processes and systems for public sector customers. The agreement offers the following services: strategy and business transformation problem solving with tech solutions resources and training software licences What is out of scope? Products and services out of scope include but are not limited to: any hardware and infrastructure hosting networks or connectivity services Benefits accessible route for suppliers – accessible for all suppliers (including SMEs) and suppliers can apply to join at any time government specific terms and conditions (Ts&Cs) – these have been created based on an agile approach using the public sector contract a dynamic filtering system – giving buyers flexibility based on their requirements. Suppliers receive notifications of competitions that are relevant to their service offering and buyers can easily identify potential eligible suppliers supports innovation – suppliers can add new services (within scope) during the lifetime of the DPS, meaning buyers can keep up with fast-moving market developments open to all public sector buyers – including central government departments and the wider public sector access to Cabinet Office (CO) automation task force – receive advice and support from the task force who specialise in the implementation of automation technologies, services and licences Products and suppliers Please read the 'How to buy' tab below for detailed instructions on how to find out which suppliers are on this agreement. Lot 1: Automation Marketplace DPS Understanding the opportunity, setting a strategic direction and target operating models. This filter allows buyers to build an evidence base and the sub-filters are areas to focus on. Expires: 15/11/2026 How to buy You must run a mini competition to select a supplier. There is no option for direct award. Before running your mini competition, find out which suppliers could meet your requirements using the Dynamic Purchasing System (DPS) Marketplace. The steps below outline how to search for suppliers, create a shortlist and carry out a mini competition. Register as a buyer on the Dynamic Purchasing System Marketplace. Note: although pages are headed ‘Supplier registration’ this is also where you can register as a buyer. Navigate to the Automation Marketplace DPS under Technology, choose the ‘Access as a buyer’ option and confirm your acceptance of the customer access agreement. On your ‘Manage your DPS Category Exports’ page you now have 2 options: view appointed suppliers click on the link to create a new category export. This is how you filter the suppliers that can meet your requirements. When creating a new category use the filtering tool (select all that apply) to specify your requirements and create your supplier shortlist. Save your filtered list of capable suppliers by clicking the ‘Save Category’ option and give the shortlist a unique name specific to your competition. From your ‘Manage your Category Exports’ page you can then export the list of suppliers and contact details (export is to an Excel spreadsheet) Quit the DPS. Use the list to run a Further Competition. Invite the suppliers identified by the DPS to bid against your detailed specification, evaluation criteria and contract format. The list is valid for only 2 working days , from the date of its creation, because new suppliers may apply to join at any point. If your Call for Competition excludes eligible suppliers it potentially breaches procurement regulations. You will need to get a fresh supplier list (steps 3.2 to 5) if you don’t use your list within 2 working days by clicking the ‘Search Again’ option for your export. You can use our eSourcing tool to run a Call for Competition. The tool is free to use for public sector buyers, or you can use your organisation’s own procurement tool. Your tender process should be proportionate to the value and complexity of your requirement. suppliers will need a reasonable period of time to review and prepare a response. This includes allowing sufficient time for suppliers to ask clarification questions and consider your answers before the deadline for written responses. Evaluate the responses. Request from the winning supplier(s) any required evidence that they can meet your requirements. Set a 2-day deadline for submitting evidence. If you’re satisfied with the evidence, award the contract Where appropriate, notify of the award on Contracts Finder. Contact Our customer services team is available Monday to Friday, 9am to 5pm. Email the team if you need help completing your procurement or call 0345 410 2222 Documents Updates Crown Commercial Service (CCS) became Government Commercial Agency (GCA) on 1 April 2026. Documents published before this date may still refer to CCS. All contract documents remain valid for existing and new contracts, and there are no changes to how you work with us. rejected.text: The Pathways to Enable Secure Open-Source Ecosystems (PESOSE) programme supports the translation of open-source science and engineering-focused research products into safe and sustainable ecosystems that address national and societal challenges. Open-source tools such as software, hardware, machine learning models, languages, and data platforms are designed to be shared as they are publicly-accessible and modifiable. These tools spark innovation in critical fields as varied as artificial intelligence (AI) and cloud computing, banking, healthcare, research, education, next-gen manufacturing, mobility, and National security (including cybersecurity). PESOSE supports the creation of managing organisations for these ecosystems, ensuring strong governance, distributed development, and broad user communities across academia, industry, and government. PESOSE also supports enhancements to the safety, security, and privacy of Open-Source Ecosystems (OSE) by addressing significant vulnerabilities, both technical and socio-technical, to improve the resistance of the ecosystem against threats. This solicitation seeks three types of proposals, allowing teams to propose specific activities to: 1) scope and plan the establishment of an OSE, 2) establish and expand a sustainable OSE based on a robust, promising open-source product that meets an emergent societal or national need, and 3) improve the safety, security, and privacy of an existing OSE and its products.

result.text: Above-threshold open electronic tender entitled "Procurement and installation of underground temporary waste storage systems for the pilot implementation of PAY AS YOU THROW (PAYT) programmes in the Municipality of Florina", with an estimated expenditure of 1.331.120,16€ including VAT of 24%, with sealed bids and with the award criterion being the most economically advantageous tender based on the best price-quality ratio Procurement and installation of fifty (50) "smart" underground waste collection bins (with a capacity of approximately 3m3 each), which will replace in volume approximately three (3) existing plastic bins. The bins shall be equipped with: 1) Access control and user identification system. 2) Weighing system for the discarded waste in each use.; In order for the Municipality to be able to monitor the conditions of use of the said underground bins and to develop an incentive policy towards users, it is necessary for the underground bins to be equipped with an access control and user registration system. The controlled access and disposal registration system must consist of: • User identification devices installed on the input "hoppers". • Security locks that restrict use only to certified users. • Deposit weighing system. • Controlled access via "smart" cards or mobile phones. • User management and event logging software.; The weighing system must be suitable for use in high humidity conditions and resistant to corrosive agents. The weighing system must be able to record the maximum possible and minimum possible weighing weight of individual discarded waste per user and the total temporarily stored waste. The weighing system must have the capability for automatic internal calibration and shall be accompanied by a calibration certificate at least for two indicative weights from a calibrated body/laboratory according to ISO 17025.; As part of this procurement, the contractor shall deliver to the Municipality a quantity of 2000 pcs. of RFID-type "smart" cards fully compatible with the offered controlled access system, which will be distributed to users/citizens. In their financial tender, tenderers must provide a separate unit price for the offered "smart" cards.; For their more efficient operation, the underground bins shall bear an attached fullness monitoring system, consisting of sensors to be placed at a suitable point, accompanied by a measurement transmission system application and software for data management, accessible via the internet (web based system).; Purchase of Software as a Service (SaaS) platform usage rights on a server of the Municipality. Monitoring of controlled access and fullness of underground bins with connection to a telemetry management platform. The required functionality shall be provided by the contractor for a period of twelve (12) months from the commissioning of the controlled access systems, in the form of Software as a Service (SaaS). Support, reporting and results compilation services are included for a period of (24) months.

parts.source: Ανοικτός ηλεκτρονικός διαγωνισμός άνω των ορίων με τίτλο «Προμήθεια και τοποθέτηση υπόγειων συστημάτων προσωρινής αποθήκευσης απορριμμάτων, για την πιλοτική εφαρμογή προγραμμάτων ΠΛΗΡΩΝΩ ΟΣΟ ΠΕΤΑΩ (ΠΟΠ), στο δήμο Φλώρινας», προεκτιμημένης δαπάνης 1.331.120,16€ συμπεριλαμβανομένου του ΦΠΑ 24%, με σφραγισμένες προσφορές και με κριτήριο κατακύρωσης την πλέον συμφέρουσα από οικονομική άποψη προσφορά με βάση τη βέλτιστη σχέση ποιότητας - τιμής Προμήθεια και εγκατάσταση πενήντα (50) «έξυπνων» υπογειοποιημένων κάδων συλλογής απορριμμάτων (χωρητικότητας περίπου 3m3 έκαστος), οι οποίοι θα αντικαταστήσουν σε όγκο περίπου τρείς (3) υφιστάμενους πλαστικούς κάδους Οι κάδοι θα είναι εξοπλισμένοι με: 1) Σύστημα ελέγχου πρόσβασης και αναγνώρισης χρήστη. 2) Σύστημα ζύγισης των απορριπτόμενων απορριμμάτων σε κάθε χρήση.; Προκειμένου ο Δήμος να μπορεί να επιτηρεί τις συνθήκες χρήσης των εν λόγω υπόγειων κάδων και να αναπτύξει μια πολιτική κινήτρων προς τους χρήστες, είναι απαραίτητο οι υπόγειοι κάδοι να εφοδιαστούν με σύστημα ελέγχου πρόσβασης και καταγραφής των χρηστών. Το σύστημα ελεγχόμενης πρόσβασης και καταγραφής απόρριψης θα πρέπει να αποτελείται από: • Διατάξεις ταυτοποίησης χρηστών εγκατεστημένες επί των “χοανών” εισαγωγής. • Κλειδαριές ασφαλείας που περιορίζουν τη χρήση μόνο σε πιστοποιημένους χρήστες. • Σύστημα ζύγισης των αποθέσεων. • Ελεγχόμενη πρόσβαση μέσω “έξυπνων” καρτών ή κινητών τηλεφώνων. • Λογισμικό διαχείρισης χρηστών και καταγραφής συμβάντων.; Το σύστημα ζύγισης θα πρέπει να είναι κατάλληλο για χρήση σε συνθήκες υψηλής υγρασίας και ανθεκτικό στους διαβρωτικούς παράγοντες. Το σύστημα ζύγισης θα πρέπει να μπορεί να καταγράψει το μέγιστο δυνατό και ελάχιστο δυνατό βάρος ζύγισης, των μεμονωμένων απορριπτόμενων απορριμμάτων ανά χρήστη και το σύνολο των προσωρινά αποθηκευμένων απορριμμάτων. Το σύστημα ζύγισης θα πρέπει να έχει τη δυνατότητα αυτόματου εσωτερικού καλιμπραρίσματος και θα συνοδεύεται από πιστοποιητικό διακρίβωσης σε τουλάχιστον δύο ενδεικτικά βάρη από διακριβωμένο φορέα/εργαστήριο κατά ISO 17025.; Στα πλαίσια της παρούσας προμήθειας ο ανάδοχος θα παραδώσει στον Δήμο μια ποσότητα 2000 τεμ. “έξυπνων” καρτών τύπου RFID πλήρως συμβατών με το προσφερόμενο σύστημα ελεγχόμενης πρόσβασης και οι οποίες θα διανεμηθούν στους χρήστες/δημότες. Στην οικονομική τους προσφορά, οι διαγωνιζόμενοι οφείλουν να δώσουν χωριστή τιμή μονάδος για τις προσφερόμενες “έξυπνες” κάρτες.; Για την αποτελεσματικότερη λειτουργία τους, οι υπόγειοι κάδοι θα φέρουν προσαρτημένο σύστημα επιτήρησης της πληρότητας τους, αποτελούμενο από αισθητήρες που θα τοποθετηθούν σε πρόσφορο σημείο, συνοδευόμενο από εφαρμογή συστήματος μετάδοσης μετρήσεων και λογισμικού (software) για την διαχείριση των δεδομένων, προσβάσιμο από το διαδίκτυο (web based system).; Αγορά Δικαιωμάτων παραχώρησης πλατφόρμας Υπηρεσίας Software as a Service (SaaS) σε server του Δήμου. The aim of the project E39 Smiene – Harestad is to build a new four-lane road that connects the E39 Rogfast tunnels with the existing E39 at Smiene (north of the Eiganes tunnel) and thereby contribute to a continuous four-lane and high standard road from Sandnes to Bokn. E39 Smiene-Harestad together with E39 Rogfast will open to greater synergy, freedom and expanded living and labour market area for the population. result.text: This competition replaces the previously announced competition 2026/2237, which was cancelled 14.08.2026. The system shall contribute to strengthening situational comprehension in Norwegian sea areas by using image forming sensors (optical and SAR – Synthetic Aperture Radar). This shall enable: verification of AIS data detection of vessels that do not send AIS (so-called "dark vessels") improved situation understanding and decision support in the operative contexts The coastal system has tested the use of non-cooperative sensor data from satellites in the summer and autumn 2025 through the company Vake AS's presentation and analysis system (vake.ai.). The testing of data in Vake is based on optical and SAR sensor data from Sentinel-1 and 2 satellites in the EU's Copernicus programme and on AIS data from the Norwegian Coastal Administration. Developments in this procurement cannot be included. Tenderers shall document that the offered system was established and operative at the tender deadline. The documentation shall, at a minimum, consist of: A technical description of the offered system, including main functionality, used data sources and central analysing functions. Screen images showing central functions in the system, including visualisation of satellite data, object detection and analysis functionality. Information on the date of production of the system to the customer. Description of the system's operative use for at least one customer or final user. Documentation that substantiates actual operative operations before the tender deadline expiry, e.g. customer confirmation, operational reports, uptime reports, user statistics or equivalent. The contract will be valid for one (1) year, with an option for an extension.

result.text: The Public Diplomacy Section (PDS) at U.S. Embassy Tunis invites results-oriented proposals for programs that foster economic opportunities for U.S. businesses and investors, innovation collaboration, showcase American leadership and excellence in science, technology, culture, the arts, sports, education, and English language, and strengthen ties between the United States and Tunisia in ways that make America safer, stronger, and more prosperous as we commemorate the 250 th anniversary of U.S. independence (2026) and 230 years of U.S.-Tunisian friendship (2027). All proposed programs must include an American element or a connection with American expert(s), organization(s), or institutions in ways that promote increased understanding of U.S. policies, perspectives, and society and/or celebrate U.S. culture and values. Proposals that include programming outside Greater Tunis or across multiple governorates and/or promote increased collaboration and networking among alumni of U.S. government programs are encouraged. Examples of possible PD small grant proposals include, but are not limited to: • Subject-matter expert, academic, and professional lectures, seminars, and speaker programs that include U.S. speakers/experts. • Programs that connect U.S. companies with Tunisian partners, suppliers, and market opportunities, facilitate business-to-business networking and investment matchmaking, prepare result.text: We operate a network of around 300 automatic weather stations (AWS), mostly in the UK, but also a small number overseas. The weather observation data collected at these sites is collated on a logger at site and then communicated every minute to our central cloud based system in real time. Some sites have mains power, some operate on a 50W solar panel. The majority of sites have 4G connectivity, but there are a subset that only have 2G connectivity at present. We are looking for a supplier to provide a communications solution to allow for the real time transfer of our land surface observation data to our central cloud based collection system every minute in real time.

result.text: Following an analysis of existing systems that revealed functional gaps related to reporting, early warning and funding tracking, the contracting authority has determined that the complexity of the Merheim campus project and the requirements of the funding providers necessitate an effective and transparent controlling and communication system. For this purpose, the contracting authority wishes to commission the implementation of an IT-supported system for construction and project controlling for the compliant and auditable management of all projects and sub-projects of the new health campus at the Merheim site, whereby transparency, traceability and early warning in particular must be ensured on all levels via system support. It must be ensured that the integration of existing systems and the connection of relevant interfaces take place smoothly. This includes the transfer and exchange of cost and financial data, the transmission of procurement information and contract award statuses, as well as the provision of structured, role-based access to relevant project data, plans and approvals for external service providers and suppliers. Furthermore, internal audit must be enabled through read-based access rights to ensure the traceability and documentation of internal audits.

parts.source: Nachdem eine Analyse der bestehenden Systeme funktionale Lücken im Zusammenhang mit Berichten, Frühwarnung und Fördermittel-Tracking aufgezeigt hat, hat der Auftraggeber festgestellt, dass die Komplexität des Campus-Projektes Merheim sowie die Anforderungen der Fördermittelgeber ein effektives und transparentes Controlling- und Kommunikationssystem erforderlich machen. Zu diesem Zweck möchte die Auftraggeberin die Implementierung eines IT-gestützten Systems für das Bau- und Projektcontrolling zur regelkonformen und prüfbaren Steuerung aller Projekte und Teilprojekte des neuen Gesundheitscampus am Standort Merheim beauftragen, wobei insbesondere Transparenz, Nachvollziehbarkeit und Frühwarnung systemgestützt auf allen Ebenen gewährleistet sein müssen. Dabei ist sicherzustellen, dass die Integration bestehender Systeme und die Anbindung relevanter Schnittstellen reibungslos erfolgt. Dies umfasst die Übergabe und den Austausch von Kosten- und Finanzdaten, die Übermittlung von Vergabeinformationen und Beauftragungs-ständen sowie die Bereitstellung eines strukturierten, rollenbasierten Zugriffs auf relevante Projektdaten, Pläne und Freigaben für externe Dienstleister und Lieferanten. Zudem muss die Innenrevision durch lesebasierte Zugriffsrechte in die Lage versetzt werden, die Nachvollziehbarkeit und Dokumentation interner Prüfungen sicherzustellen.

result.text: The Trust is seeking a single strategic partner to deliver an integrated suite of corporate and professional services that enable school leaders to focus on educational outcomes while ensuring the Trust operates efficiently, safely, compliantly and sustainably. The successful supplier will provide integrated professional support services that are reliable, compliant, responsive and strategically aligned to the Trust’s objectives, through a single accountable management structure combining strategic advice, operational delivery, performance management, continuous improvement and innovation. The Services comprise the following ten service areas, described in full in the Specification: Financial Services- Operational and transactional financial management, management accounts, 5-year planning, VAT/ONS returns and audit liaison (Sage 200; circa 20,000 transactions per year). Payroll Services - Payroll processing and system for circa 200 staff (pay date 15th), RTI/HMRC, Teachers’ Pension and Local Government Pension Scheme administration. Human Resources Services - Operational HR, recruitment, employee relations, policy development, TUPE advice and the staff wellbeing offer. Staff Training & Development - Mandatory and wider training (safeguarding, cyber, H&S and more), CPD support and maintenance of Trust accreditations. Legal Services (incl. employment) - Operational and strategic legal support on contracts, employment and H&S matters, from suitably regulated advisers. Managed ICT Services- Secure, resilient network, servers, connectivity, filtering, cyber security, helpdesk, backup and device management across both schools and the nursery. Estates Management Services - Strategic and operational facilities and estates management, statutory compliance, estates/asset/carbon strategy and H&S support. Communications, Marketing & PR - Brand and reputation management, media and PR, website and social media, prospectus and admissions materials, internal communications. Governance Support Services - Company secretarial and governance support, clerking and minutes (Convene), statutory filings and governance advice. Managed Procurement Services - Procurement advice, tendering and quotations, contracts register, supplier management and Procurement Act 2023 compliance. The full Specification, including service-level agreements, key performance indicators and technical standards for each area, is available to download via the Delta eSourcing website. This procurement is being conducted under the Open Procedure pursuant to section 20(2)(a) of the Act — a single-stage procedure with no restriction on who may submit a tender and no separate shortlisting stage. All compliant tenders received by the deadline will be assessed against the Conditions of Participation, the exclusion grounds and the award criteria in this ITT, and the Contract will be awarded to the Most Advantageous Tender under section 19 of the Act. The deadline for the submission of tenders via the Delta eSourcing portal is 12noon 7 October 2026 For more information about this opportunity, please visit the eSourcing portal at: https://www.delta-esourcing.com/tenders/UK-UK-Manchester:-Financial-consultancy-services./X7SY8A5TKF To respond to this opportunity, please click here: https://www.delta-esourcing.com/respond/X7SY8A5TKF

result.text: As part of the re-tendering process for TenneT’s Content Collaboration Platform, Lot 2 encompasses a multi-vendor framework agreement focused on the integration, implementation, configuration, migration, and support of platform functionalities tailored to TenneT’s infrastructure project needs. The present tender focuses primarily on TenneT’s German operations. As beneficiaries under the SaaS Agreement, Dutch TenneT operations may optionally draw from the services that are subject hereof. With the re-tendering of the current Content Collaboration Platform, TenneT is aiming to continue achieving a single source of information for all documents generated in infrastructure projects and managing the supplier collaboration (external collaboration) regarding the exchange and management of documents and additional data. The targeted system is facilitating and capturing the complete project lifecycle in addition to providing auditable documentation and information throughout the organization. The tender procedure is divided into two lots, which will be tendered in sequence in two different tenders: Tender 1 [Lot 1] "CDE - Collaboration-Platform for Document and Data Exchange": includes the platform provisioning, development, deployment (Implementation), initial customization and configuration, platform interfaces as well as maintenance and support of the platform and – as a proof of concept and for purposes of a successful transition – the migration of TenneT metadata as well as existing construction projects from the current to the new platform. This tender has been completed. The awarded solution is provided by ThinkProject. Tender 2 [Lot 2]: "CDE – Multi-Contractor Integration": includes intergration and implementation services associated with the platform and comprises subsequent configuration, customization and consulting services in relation to the Content Collaboration Platform. The Lot 1 Provider must always collaborate pro-actively and in a constructive manner with any Lot 2 Contractor(s), e.g. providing access, support and knowledge transfer regarding the platform and implementing technically necessary changes within Lot 1 where mutually agreed with or commissioned by TenneT. result.text: The Home Office seeks to engage suppliers for the provision of healthcare services at short-term holding facilities and ports of entry across the UK. These services will support individuals whilst detained for short periods of time including in, but not limited to, short-term holding facilities as defined under the Short-Term Holding Facilities Rules 2018 (as amended), where individuals can be held up to 24 hours. The Authority is seeking a flexible, responsive and value for money healthcare solution that meets the basic needs of individuals and can be flexible to different service environments; the short-term holding facilities are located at different location types across the UK which include Airports, Seaports, and Reporting Centres. Remote Healthcare Services: This market engagement aims to understand supplier capabilities and appetite, to further refine the Authority’s specification and gather feedback on the proposed approach of remote healthcare services. This includes gaining further understanding of both the provision of Clinicians to undertake remote consultations and the provision of IT infrastructure required to deliver a remote only healthcare service. The content of this Notice, including the nature of services and the start date of the contract, is subject to change. The contract is expected to commence in early 2028. The length of contract has not been confirmed yet. For the purposes of this Preliminary Market Engagement Notice, the estimated contract value has been listed as £0. This figure does not reflect the expected final value of the contract. The actual estimated value is currently being finalised and will be shared later.

result.text: UPDATED NOTICE - PLEASE READ: April 6, 2023 EDA is excited to announce the launch of its new grants management platform: the Economic Development Grants Experience (EDGE). EDGE was developed to streamline the application and grants management process by implementing a single platform with increased transparency, improved user experience, higher data quality, and more efficiency throughout the entire grant lifecycle. As of April 6th, 2023, applications can no longer be submitted on Grants.gov, and will ONLY be accepted through EDGE. To apply in EDGE, please go to: sfgrants.eda.gov . More information on how to apply is provided in the full NOFO. PARTNERSHIP PLANNING program instructions: Please note that applicants will be invited to submit applications through EDGE for the Partnership Planning program. For more information, please reach out to your EDA point of contact. Program Description: EDA makes planning and local technical assistance investments to support economic development, foster job creation, and attract private investment in economically distressed areas of the United States. Under the Planning program, EDA makes Partnership Planning, Short-Term Planning, and State Planning awards to eligible recipients to create and implement regional economic development plans designed to build capacity and guide the economic prosperity and resiliency of an area or region. More specifically, EDA makes Partnership Planning investments to designated planning organizations (i.e., District Organizations) serving EDA-designated Economic Development Districts and to Indian Tribes to facilitate the development, implementation, revision, or replacement of Comprehensive Economic Development Strategies (CEDS), which articulate and prioritize the strategic economic goals of recipients’ respective regions. EDA also makes Short-Term and State Planning awards for economic development planning activities that guide the eventual creation and retention of high-quality jobs, particularly for the unemployed and underemployed in the Nation’s most economically distressed regions. Under the Local Technical Assistance program, EDA makes awards to strengthen the capacity of local or State organizations, institutions of higher education, and other eligible entities to undertake and promote effective economic development programs through projects such as feasibility studies, impact analyses, disaster resiliency plans, and project planning. **Please note: While the published Notice of Funding Opportunity (available under "Related Documents") states that the ED900A form and the SF424B form are both required for a complete application, these forms are no longer required and have therefore been removed from the package template.

rejected.text: During the autumn of 2025, Copenhagen Municipality will issue a tender for a new app-based digital solution for performing parking enforcement and processing parking fines. The app solution must be capable of being used on the municipality's compatible, standard smart mobile phones. The solution must enable the printing of parking fines on the Contracting Authority's current printers. Tenders are requested for both the app, which is used by the parking attendants for issuing fines, and for a web solution for handling, storing and transferring data to the municipality's existing relevant systems. The tender will include a number of functional requirements for the app and web solution, but also a number of IT security requirements. Before the tender is issued, the Parking Department would like to have the industry's feedback on the security requirements that the municipality is setting – the so-called non-functional requirements. Including, in particular, the above requirements.

App-løsningen skal kunne anvendes på kommunens kompatible, gængse smart mobiltelefoner. Løsningen skal muliggøre udskrivning af parkeringsafgifter på Ordregivers nuværende printere. Der ønskes tilbud på såvel app, som anvendes af parkeringsvagterne til afgiftspålæggelse, samt på webløsning til håndtering, lagring og overførsel af data til kommunens eksisterende relevante systemer. I udbuddet vil der være en del funktionelle krav til app og webløsning, men også en del IT-sikkerhedskrav. Område for Parkering vil gerne, inden udbuddet udsendes, have branchens feedback på de sikkerhedskrav som kommunen stiller krav om – de såkaldte non-funktionelle krav. Herunder særligt ovenstående krav.

Examples of possible PD small grant proposals include, but are not limited to: · Subject-matter expert, academic, and professional lectures, seminars, and speaker programs that include U.S. speakers/experts. · Programs that strengthen relationships and linkages between U.S. and Tunisian higher education and cultural institutions. · Educational, artistic, and cultural programs, including programs that strengthen English language teaching and learning, music, musical theater, dance workshops, master classes, and performances, live theatre performances, art exhibitions, and sports and culinary diplomacy initiatives that increase mutual understanding between the people of the United States and Tunisia. · Programs, including podcasts, that promote economic empowerment, entrepreneurship, or that share U.S. experiences related to addressing community challenges, including the management of water or energy resources, waste management, urban design and planning, and preparing for and mitigating natural or human-caused disasters. · Cultural heritage conservation and preservation programming, including through the use new and immersive technologies, such as VR technology. (Note: This funding cannot be used to support construction-related activities. End note.) Priority Program Areas and Strategic Themes: Proposals must address at least one of the six priority areas outlined below: · Economic Prosperity and Entrepreneurship: Initiatives that prioritize mutual prosperity, expand economic and commercial links between the United States and Tunisia, promote U.S. entrepreneurial values and practices, and that share best practices of successful U.S. business partnerships, startups, and investors with the aim of increasing economic opportunities for U.S. and Tunisian businesses and investors. · INNOVATION and Collaboration in science and technology: Initiatives that promote collaboration and academic partnerships in STEM fields (science, technology, engineering, and mathematics), including cybersecurity, space, energy, water security, food security, smart agriculture, health technology, and artificial intelligence (AI) between U.S. and Tunisian academic and research institutions, non-governmental organizations, and private companies, as well as programs that promote interest in STEM education among young people. · EDUCATIONAL LINKAGES AND ENGLISH LANGUAGE : Initiatives that expand collaboration and partnerships between U.S. and Tunisian higher education and research institutions through programs and professional and academic exchanges; programs to strengthen English language instruction in Tunisian universities and colleges; programs to expand the teaching of English in sign language and braille; and other programs that support and promote English language learning among Tunisian youth. · LEADERSHIP: Initiatives that provide leadership training inspired by U.S. experiences, models, and best practices to Tunisian young people (high school and university students and young professionals) to help them become effective leaders in their communities and professional field of choice. Such training may include English language, public speaking and interpersonal communication, emotional intelligence, critical thinking and problem solving, financial literacy, goal-setting, and mental health management strategies. · MEGA DECADE OF SPORTS: Programs that leverage the “Mega-Decade in Sports” in North America (2023-2034) when the United States will host the 2025 FIFA World Club Cup, the 2026 FIFA Men’s World Cup, the 2028 Summer Olympics and Paralympics in Los Angeles, and the 2034 Winter Olympics and Paralympics in Salt Lake City, in ways that strengthen people-to-people ties between the United States and Tunisia, promote American values and demonstrate American excellence and leadership in sports and tourism. · Celebrating American Excellence AND U.S.-Tunisian Enduring Partnership: Programs that 1) celebrate U.S. scientific or sport prowess, innovation, economic dynamism, agricultural strength, and national parks and tourism during the 250th anniversary year of U.S.
