result.text: The tender aims to achieve and promote the stable and future-proof operation of the "Schleupen.CS" ERP system on a highly available and secure infrastructure for use by the client's employees and external service providers, including migration, SaaS operation, interfaces, administration, and support. The SWH is tendering for the provision of a highly available cloud infrastructure in the contractor's data centre. The service consists not only of providing data centre capacity but, due to the intended role as a solution provider, encompasses holistic responsibility for the stable and future-proof operation of Schleupen.CS. The services to be provided include, in particular: - the provision of the necessary hardware and data centre infrastructure, - the provision of software necessary for the operation of the systems (including current versions of Microsoft Windows Server, Microsoft SQL Server, Remote Desktop Services, and Citrix if applicable for the publication of remote apps, as approved by Schleupen SE), - the takeover or migration of the existing system (including the sub-systems necessary for operation) into the data centre environment, - the takeover of existing interfaces to third-party service providers (mandatory requirements: SMGWA, ticket system, customer portal), - the operation of the Schleupen.CS system (including sub-systems) in the data centre: production and test systems with the existing tenants, - the sufficiently performant - at least with symmetrical 200 Mbit/s - internet connection of the client to the contractor's data centre. Connection must be established via an encrypted VPN tunnel or by providing the service provider's own hardware, which is integrated into the contractor's internal network, - the takeover of support services within the scope of data centre operations, - the takeover of support services for the Schleupen.CS system, in particular holistic, independent communication with Schleupen SE in the event of application and problem cases, - the provision and maintenance of current hardware and software (operating system software, database software, application software), which are operated with active maintenance contracts / software assurance, - the monitoring of systems and applications, - immediate error detection, communication to the client in the event of an error, and error rectification, - the maintenance of highly available system operation (24 h/ 7 days a week) throughout the entire contract term. It is mandatory that strict, logical isolation from the contractor's other customers is maintained. The precise details regarding the subject matter of the contract can be found in the specifications (Annex B of the procedural letter).

parts.source: Mit der Ausschreibung soll der stabile und zukunftsfähige Betrieb des ERP-Systems "Schleupen.CS" auf einer hochverfügbaren und sicheren Infrastruktur für die Nutzung durch die Mitarbeitenden und externen Dienstleister des Auftraggebers einschließlich Migration, SaaS-Betrieb, Schnittstellen, Administration und Support erreicht und gefördert werden. Die SWH schreibt die Bereitstellung einer hochverfügbaren Cloud-Infrastruktur im Rechenzentrum des Auftragnehmers aus. Die Leistung besteht nicht nur aus der Bereitstellung der Rechenzentrumsleistung, sondern umfasst, aufgrund der beabsichtigten Stellung als Lösungsanbieter, die ganzheitliche Verantwortung für den stabilen und zukunftssicheren Betrieb von Schleupen.CS. Zu den dabei zu erbringenden Leistungen gehören insbesondere: - die Bereitstellung der notwendigen Hardware und Rechenzentrumsinfrastruktur, - die Bereitstellung von zum Betrieb der Systeme notwendiger Software (u.a. aktuelle und von der Schleupen SE freigegebene Versionen von Microsoft Windows Server, Microsoft SQL Server, Remote Desktop Services, ggfs. Citrix zur Veröffentlichung von Remote-Apps), - die Übernahme bzw. Migration des bestehenden Systems (inkl. der für den Betrieb notwendigen Sub-Systeme) in den Rechenzentrumsbetrieb, - die Übernahme der bestehenden Schnittstellen zu Drittdienstleistern (zwingend erforderlich SMGWA, Ticketsystem, Kundenportal), - der Betrieb des Schleupen.CS-Systems (inklusive der Sub-Systeme) im Rechenzentrum: Produktiv- und Testsysteme mit den bestehenden Mandanten, - die ausreichend performante - mindestens mit symmetrisch 200 Mbit/s - Internet-Anbindung des Auftraggebers an das Rechenzentrum des Auftragnehmers. Es muss mittels eines verschlüsselten VPN-Tunnels oder durch Bereitstellung von eigener Hardware des Dienstleister, welche in das interne Netzwerk des Auftragnehmers eingebunden wird, eine Anbindung erfolgen, - die Übernahme von Support-Dienstleistungen im Rahmen des Rechenzentrumsbetriebs, - die Übernahme von Support-Dienstleistungen für das Schleupen.CS-System, insbesondere die ganzheitliche, selbstständige Kommunikation mit der Schleupen SE bei Anwendungs- und Problemfällen, - die Bereitstellung und -haltung von aktueller Hardware und Software (Betriebssystemsoftware, Datenbanksoftware, Anwendersoftware), welche mit aktiven Wartungsverträgen / Software-Assurance betrieben werden, - das Monitoring der Systeme und Anwendungen, - die unverzügliche Fehlererkennung, Kommunikation im Fehlerfall an den Auftraggeber, sowie die Fehlerbehebung, - die Aufrechterhaltung eines hochverfügbaren Systembetriebs (24 h/ 7 Tage in der Woche) während der gesamten Vertragslaufzeit. Dabei ist zwingend erforderlich, dass eine strikte, logische Isolation zu anderen Kunden des Auftragnehmers gegeben ist. Die genauen Angaben zum Auftragsgegenstand können dem Leistungsverzeichnis (Anlage B des Verfahrensbriefes) entnommen werden.

rejected.text: DSB wishes to become better informed about SAP RISE, therefore an invitation is extended to a market dialogue regarding this. Background: DSB currently uses an SAP S/4HANA solution, which supports a large number of administrative business processes in the company. S/4HANA runs on-premises via an infrastructure and operations agreement with fa. TCS. This agreement expires in the summer of 2028, which is why DSB must conduct an EU tender, presumably in 2027. Against this background, DSB is considering whether the tender should include either: - Infrastructure and operations services regarding SAP S/4HANA based on on-premises or, - migration of DSB’s SAP S/4HANA solution to a SaaS solution in private cloud – which is currently marketed under the name SAP RISE. Therefore, DSB wishes, via market dialogue, to gain insight into what suppliers in the market offer related to SAP RISE. DSB expects the individual supplier to provide a total overview of deliveries and commercial terms. DSB wishes, among other things, for answers to: 1) Description of the current market. 2) Description of the supplier's footprint in the market. Generally and regarding SAP RISE. 3) Contract set-up including interfaces to fa. SAP SE. 4) Listing of services linked to the service: 4.1) Which services are delivered as standard? 4.2) Which services can be purchased additionally? 4.3) How are these services designed with regard to SLAs? 5) Description of collaboration model. 6) How and according to what structure does the settlement of ongoing operations take place? 7) Description of model for transition and settlement of this. Preferably with TCO assessments. 8) Description of hardware used, data centres and geography. 9) Description of IT security model and IT security management. DSB expects to conduct conversations with a selection of suppliers in December 2025 and January 2026. The purpose of the conversations is to gather information about which solutions and services are offered in the market. DSB plans to conduct market dialogue meetings with a maximum of six suppliers. If more than six suppliers come forward, DSB will make a representative selection among the received expressions of interest.

parts.source: DSB ønsker at bliver klogere på SAP RISE, derfor inviteres der til markedsdialog herom. Baggrund: DSB anvender i dag en SAP S/4HANA-løsning, som supporterer et stort antal administrative forretningsprocesser i virksomheden. S/4HANA kører on-premises via en infrastruktur- og driftsaftale med fa. TCS. Denne aftale udløber sommeren 2028, hvorfor DSB skal gennemføre et EU-udbud formentlig i 2027. På denne baggrund overvejer DSB, om udbuddet skal omfatte enten: - Infrastruktur- og drift-services vedrørende SAP S/4HANA baseret på on-premises eller, - migrering af DSB’s SAP S/4HANA-løsning til SaaS-løsning i private cloud – som p.t. markedsføres under navnet SAP RISE. Derfor ønsker DSB via markedsdialog at få indsigt i, hvad leverandørerne i markedet tilbyder relateret til SAP RISE. DSB forventer, at den enkelte leverandør giver et samlet overblik over leverancer og kommercielle vilkår. DSB ønsker bl.a. svar på: 1) Beskrivelse af det aktuelle marked. 2) Beskrivelse af leverandørens footprint i markedet. Generelt og vedrørende SAP RISE. 3) Kontraktset-up inklusive grænseflader til fa. SAP SE. 4) Oplistning af services knyttet til ydelsen: 4.1) Hvilke services leveres som standard? 4.2) Hvilke services kan tilkøbes? 4.3) Hvordan er disse services designet m.h.t. SLAer? 5) Beskrivelse af samarbejdsmodel. 6) Hvordan og efter hvilken struktur finder afregning af den løbende drift sted? 7) Beskrivelse af model for transition og afregning af denne. Gerne med TCO-vurderinger. 8) Beskrivelse af anvendte hardware, datacentre og geografi. 9) Beskrivelse af IT-sikkerhedsmodel og IT-sikkerhedsstyring. DSB forventer at gennemføre samtaler med et udvalg af leverandører i december 2025 og januar 2026. Formålet med samtalerne er at samle information om hvilke løsninger og services, som der tilbydes i markedet. DSB planlægger med at gennemføre markedsdialogmøder med maksimalt seks leverandører. Datenvolumen) fahren kann, - Durchführen einer eintägigen User-Schulung für das Serviceportal für maximal acht Teilnehmer, - kostenfreie Rechnungsstellung mit Einzelverbindungsnachweisen in elektronischer und ggf. nach Wunsch des Auftraggebers in Papierform, - kostenfreie Geschäftskundenhotline für alle Benutzer (7/24), - Bereitstellen eines Ansprechpartners (Key-Account-Service-Manager) und eines User-Help-Desks für einzelne Mitarbeiter der Auftraggeberin sowie - sonstige Leistungen im Zuge eines allgemeinen Kundenservices. Die Auftraggeberin kann ohne Angaben von Gründen pro Vertragsjahr bis zu 10 Prozent der Mobilfunkanschlüsse zu einem von ihr festgelegten Datum kündigen. Im Fall von größeren Restrukturierungsmaßnahmen können bis zu 25 Prozent der Mobilfunkanschlüsse durch die Auftraggeberin gekündigt werden. Es wird jedoch eine Mindestanzahl von 1.500 Mobilfunkanschlüsse, die bis zum Ende des Rahmenvertrags aktiviert bleiben, durch die Auftraggeberin garantiert.

result.text: The subject of the procurement is a work ability management system as a SaaS service. The procurement includes the delivery of the system, planning and implementation of the deployment, execution of necessary integrations, and ongoing maintenance and support services. In addition, the contracting authority has the option to procure separately agreed minor development during the contract period. The supplier is responsible for ensuring that the system can be deployed in a controlled manner and that it is integrated into the contracting authority's key back-end systems, such as HR and identity management systems. The migration of legacy data can be carried out as expert work as a separately ordered option in accordance with the hourly rate for expert work stated in the price appendix. The contracting authority shall decide on the implementation of the option at its own discretion during the contract period, and the contracting authority is under no obligation to implement the option or order related services. The system must support the contracting authority's work ability management operating models and processes, in particular early support practices, management of sickness absences, identification and prevention of work ability risks, and support for return to work. The objective of the solution is to improve the timeliness of work ability measures, increase operational transparency, and strengthen data-driven management at all levels of the organisation. The system must provide an up-to-date overall picture of the work ability situation at the employee, unit, and organisational level. It must form a clear, user-friendly, and intuitive whole regarding work ability management processes and offer views and access rights according to user roles. User groups include at least line managers, HR work ability specialists, management, and system administrators. Line managers must be able to utilise the system in their daily work ability management work, while for management, the system must offer summary views, reporting, and analytics to support strategic decision-making. The system must enable versatile reporting for different time periods and organisational levels and offer visual views, such as trends, comparisons, and key performance indicators to support decision-making. The supplier must carry out the deployment in cooperation with the contracting authority so that the solution meets the contracting authority's functional needs and the deployment supports a smooth transition to production use. The objective of the procurement is to improve the effectiveness of work ability management, reduce costs caused by sickness absences, strengthen proactive management, and support the staff's work ability, performance at work, and continuation in work. The system must be a modern, secure, scalable, and easy-to-use solution that supports the long-term development of the contracting authority's operations.

parts.source: Hankinnan kohteena on työkykyjohtamisen järjestelmä SaaS-palveluna. Hankintaan sisältyvät järjestelmän toimitus, käyttöönoton suunnittelu ja toteutus, tarvittavien integraatioiden toteuttaminen sekä jatkuvat ylläpito- ja tukipalvelut. Lisäksi tilaajalla on mahdollisuus hankkia erikseen sovittavaa pienkehitystä sopimuskauden aikana. Toimittaja vastaa siitä, että järjestelmä voidaan ottaa käyttöön hallitusti ja että se integroidaan tilaajan keskeisiin taustajärjestelmiin, kuten henkilöstö- ja identiteetinhallintajärjestelmiin. Vanhojen tietojen siirto voidaan toteuttaa asiantuntijatyönä hintaliitteessä ilmoitetun asiantuntijatyön tuntihinnan mukaisesti erikseen tilattavana optiona. Tilaaja päättää option käyttöönotosta oman harkintansa mukaan sopimuskauden aikana, eikä tilaajalla ole velvollisuutta ottaa optiota käyttöön tai tilata siihen liittyviä palveluita. Järjestelmän tulee tukea tilaajan työkykyjohtamisen toimintamalleja ja prosesseja, erityisesti varhaisen tuen käytäntöjä, sairauspoissaolojen hallintaa, työkykyriskien tunnistamista ja ennaltaehkäisyä sekä työhön paluun tukemista. Ratkaisun tavoitteena on parantaa työkykytoimenpiteiden oikea-aikaisuutta, lisätä toiminnan läpinäkyvyyttä sekä vahvistaa tiedolla johtamista organisaation kaikilla tasoilla. Järjestelmän tulee tarjota ajantasainen kokonaiskuva työkykytilanteesta työntekijä-, yksikkö- ja organisaatiotasolla. Sen on muodostettava selkeä, käyttäjäystävällinen ja intuitiivinen kokonaisuus työkykyjohtamisen prosesseista sekä tarjottava käyttäjäroolien mukaiset näkymät ja käyttöoikeudet. Käyttäjäryhmiä ovat vähintään esihenkilöt, HR:n työkykyasiantuntijat, johto sekä järjestelmän pääkäyttäjät. Esihenkilöiden tulee voida hyödyntää järjestelmää päivittäisessä työkykyjohtamisen työssä, kun taas johdolle järjestelmän tulee tarjota koontinäkymiä, raportointia ja analytiikkaa strategisen päätöksenteon tueksi. Järjestelmän tulee mahdollistaa monipuolinen raportointi eri aikajaksoille ja organisaatiotasoille sekä tarjota visuaalisia näkymiä, kuten kehityssuuntia, vertailuja ja tunnuslukuja päätöksenteon tueksi. Toimittajan tulee toteuttaa käyttöönotto yhteistyössä tilaajan kanssa siten, että ratkaisu vastaa tilaajan toiminnallisia tarpeita ja käyttöönotto tukee sujuvaa siirtymistä tuotantokäyttöön. Hankinnan tavoitteena on parantaa työkykyjohtamisen vaikuttavuutta, vähentää sairauspoissaoloista aiheutuvia kustannuksia, vahvistaa ennakoivaa johtamista sekä tukea henkilöstön työkykyä, työssä suoriutumista ja työssä jatkamista. Järjestelmän tulee olla moderni, tietoturvallinen, skaalautuva ja helppokäyttöinen ratkaisu, joka tukee tilaajan toiminnan pitkäjänteistä kehittämistä.

rejected.text: Complex generic drug products represent an increasing share of the generic marketplace and may have distinct user interface differences compared to reference listed drug (RLD) products. A modernised post-market surveillance approach is needed to compare clinical outcomes between complex generic products and their corresponding RLD products to monitor for potential issues with therapeutic equivalence and to inform regulatory decision making. Real-world data (RWD) combined with machine learning (ML) and/or artificial intelligence (AI) could help to identify post-market signals efficiently in an automated and repeatable fashion, facilitating timely regulatory action. The purpose of this funding opportunity is to develop and test an AI- or ML-based algorithmic RWD model for post-market surveillance of complex generic drug products.

result.text: With this notice, Istekki announces the organisation of market dialogues for a service voucher and purchased service system. The purpose of the dialogue is to ensure that those preparing the procurement have access to as comprehensive and up-to-date a picture of the market and available solutions as possible. The subject of the procurement is the service voucher and purchased service system entity and its interfaces with other systems, the delivery project (including e.g. migrations, conversions), maintenance and support of off-the-shelf software, support services, separately ordered expert services, as well as customer service. Further development may be carried out on the procured system during the contract period. The service voucher and purchased service system is used for granting service vouchers and payment commitments and for purchasing services from private service providers or other public actors. Through the system, it is necessary to centralise the creation and use of service vouchers and purchased service orders (payment commitment) and the settlement of accounts for rendered services to private service providers or other public actors. The service voucher and purchased service system must take into account needs from the perspectives of the service organiser, the service producer and the customer using the service. Through the system, the service organiser must have the option to manage service provider agreements, plan service provision, grant service vouchers and payment commitments, allocate payments, handle correction requests and monitor various report views. The service provider must have the option to apply to become a service provider through the system. In addition, the service provider must be able to record the service received by the customer in the system and thereby handle settlement based on approved transaction entries. The customer must receive the granted service voucher / payment commitment for use via the system. The service voucher customer must have the option to compare or view service providers, monitor the execution of the service from the system and provide feedback on the service. The contracting authority will organise the market dialogues either as remote meetings or in writing, or utilising both methods. The market dialogues will be held in Finnish. Istekki will notify the companies participating in the dialogue of more detailed schedules and instructions later. Please note that the information, descriptions and estimates of the publication date of the tendering procedure presented in this notice are merely preliminary and indicative. Final schedules will become more precise as preparation progresses. If you are interested in participating in the market dialogue, please notify us of your interest no later than 11.09.2026 at 14.00 to hankinnat@istekki.fi. If you wish, you can also attach Finnish-language brochures or other material regarding your own service. It is worth noting that this notice does not oblige Istekki Oy to carry out the procurement in the manner presented in this document or its appendices. A potential tendering procedure may also be omitted. No separate remuneration is paid for responding to the dialogue or participating in any presentation events. We would like to mention again that this is not a contract notice or call for tenders. The purpose is to familiarise oneself with the market situation and gather information related to the subject of the procurement to support the planning of the upcoming tendering procedure. Responding to the request for information is voluntary and is not a prerequisite for participating in a potential tendering procedure or bind Istekki to publish a tendering procedure. parts.source: Tällä ilmoituksella Istekki ilmoittaa palveluseteli- ja ostopalvelujärjestelmän markkinavuoropuheluiden järjestämisestä. Vuoropuhelun tarkoituksena on varmistaa, että kilpailutuksen valmistelijoilla on käytössään mahdollisimman kattava ja ajantasainen kuva markkinoista ja tarjolla olevista ratkaisuista. Hankinnan kohteena on palveluseteli- ja ostopalvelujärjestelmäkokonaisuus ja sen liittymät muihin järjestelmiin, toimitusprojekti (sisältäen mm. migraatiot, konversiot), valmisohjelmistojen ylläpito ja tuki, tukipalvelu, erikseen tilattavat asiantuntijapalvelut sekä asiakaspalvelu. Hankittavaan järjestelmään voidaan tehdä jatkokehitystä sopimuskauden aikana. Palveluseteli- ja ostopalvelujärjestelmää käytetään palveluseteleiden ja maksusitoumusten myöntämiseen ja palvelujen ostamiseen yksityisiltä palveluntuottajilta tai muilta julkisilta toimijoilta. Järjestelmän kautta on tarpeen saada keskitettyä palvelusetelien ja ostopalvelutilausten (maksusitoumus) luominen, käyttäminen ja annetuista palveluista tilitysten tekeminen yksityisille palveluntuottajille tai muille julkisille toimijoille. Palveluseteli- ja ostopalvelujärjestelmässä tulee huomioida tarpeet sekä palvelun järjestäjän, - tuottajan että palvelua käyttävän asiakkaan näkökulmista. Palvelun järjestäjällä tulee olla järjestelmän kautta mahdollisuus palveluntuottajasopimusten hallintaan, palveluntarjonnan suunnitteluun, palvelusetelien ja maksusitoumuksien myöntämiseen, maksujen tiliöintiin, korjauspyyntöihin ja erilaisten raporttinäkymien seuraamiseen. Palveluntuottajalla tulee olla mahdollisuus hakeutua palveluntuottajaksi järjestelmän kautta. Lisäksi palveluntuottajan tulee pystyä kirjaamaan järjestelmään asiakkaan saama palvelu ja sitä kautta tilitys hyväksyttyjen tapahtumakirjausten perusteella. Asiakkaan tulee saada myönnetty palveluseteli / maksusitoumus käyttöönsä järjestelmän kautta. Palveluseteliasiakkaalla tulee olla mahdollisuus verrata tai tarkastella palveluntuottajia, seurata järjestelmästä palvelun toteutumista ja antaa palautetta palvelusta. Hankintayksikkö järjestää markkinavuoropuhelut joko etätapaamisina tai kirjallisesti tai molempia keinoja hyödyntäen. Markkinavuoropuhelut järjestetään suomen kielellä. Istekki ilmoittaa vuoropuheluun osallistuville yrityksille tarkemmat aikataulut sekä ohjeet myöhemmin. Huomioithan, että tässä ilmoituksessa esitetyt tiedot, kuvaukset ja arviot kilpailutuksen julkaisuajankohdasta ovat vasta alustavia ja suuntaa antavia. Lopulliset aikataulut tarkentuvat valmistelun edetessä. Mikäli olette kiinnostuneita osallistumaan markkinavuoropuheluun, pyydämme ilmoittamaan kiinnostuksenne viimeistään 11.09.2026 klo 14.00 osoitteeseen hankinnat@istekki.fi. Halutessanne voitte liittää mukaan myös suomenkielisiä esitteitä tai muuta materiaalia omasta palvelustanne. On hyvä huomioida, että tämä ilmoitus ei velvoita Istekki Oy:tä toteuttamaan hankintaa tässä asiakirjassa tai sen liitteissä esitetyllä tavalla. Mahdollinen tarjouskilpailu voidaan myös jättää järjestämättä. Vuoropuheluun vastaamisesta tai mahdollisiin esittelytilaisuuksiin osallistumisesta ei makseta erillistä korvausta. Haluamme vielä mainita, että kyseessä ei ole hankintailmoitus tai tarjouspyyntö. Tarkoituksena on tutustua markkinatilanteeseen ja kerätä hankinnan kohteeseen liittyvää tietoa tulevan kilpailutuksen suunnittelun tueksi. Tietopyyntöön vastaaminen on vapaaehtoista, eikä se ole edellytys mahdolliseen tarjouskilpailuun osallistumiselle tai sido Istekkiä julkaisemaan tarjouskilpailua. Samalla kuitenkin arvostamme suuresti toimittajien osallistumista, sillä se auttaa meitä rakentamaan tulevasta kilpailutuksesta mahdollisimman toimivan ja selkeän kokonaisuuden.

result.text: Transparency notice within the meaning of § 135 para. 3 of the Act against Restraints of Competition (GWB) Measure: Acquisition of the software OK.Verkehr for vehicle registration and operation in the data centre for vehicle registration and driving licences Information on review periods: Regarding the deadlines for filing legal remedies, reference is made to § 160 para. 3 of the Act against Restraints of Competition (GWB). § 160 GWB reads as follows: (1) The Public Procurement Chamber shall initiate a review procedure only upon application. (2) Any undertaking that has an interest in the public contract or concession and claims an infringement of its rights under § 97 para. 6 due to non-compliance with procurement regulations is entitled to file an application. In doing so, it must be demonstrated that the undertaking has suffered or is threatened with damage as a result of the alleged infringement of procurement regulations. (3) The application is inadmissible if: 1) the applicant has recognised the alleged infringement of procurement regulations before submitting the application for review and has not complained about it to the contracting authority within a period of 10 calendar days; the expiry of the period according to § 134 paragraph 2 remains unaffected, 2) infringements of procurement regulations that are recognisable from the notice are not complained about to the contracting authority by the expiry of the deadline for application or submission of tenders specified in the notice, 3) infringements of procurement regulations that only become recognisable in the procurement documents are not complained about to the contracting authority by the expiry of the deadline for application or submission of tenders, 4) more than 15 calendar days have passed since receipt of the notification from the contracting authority that it does not intend to remedy a complaint. Sentence 1 does not apply to an application for a declaration of the ineffectiveness of the contract pursuant to § 135 para. 1 no. 2. § 134 para. 1 sentence 2 remains unaffected. The contract can only be executed by a specific economic operator, as here, pursuant to § 14 para. 4 no. 2b of the Public Procurement Ordinance (VgV), only one company can be considered for the contract for technical reasons.

(2) Antragsbefugt ist jedes Unternehmen, das ein Interesse an dem öffentlichen Auftrag oder der Konzession hat und eine Verletzung in seinen Rechten nach § 97 Abs. 6 durch Nichtbeachtung von Vergabevorschriften geltend macht. Dabei ist darzulegen, dass dem Unternehmen durch die behauptete Verletzung der Vergabevorschriften einSchaden entstanden ist oder zu entstehen droht. (3) Der Antrag ist unzulässig, soweit: 1) der Antragsteller den geltend gemachten Verstoß gegen Vergabevorschriften vor Einreichen des Nachprüfungsantrags erkannt und gegenüber dem Auftraggeber nicht innerhalb einer Frist von 10 Kalendertagen gerügt hat; der Ablauf der Frist nach § 134 Absatz 2 bleibt unberührt, 2) Verstöße gegen Vergabevorschriften, die aufgrund der Bekanntmachung erkennbar sind, nicht spätestens bis zum Ablauf der in der Bekanntmachung benannten Frist zur Bewerbung oder Angebotsabgabe gegenüber dem Auftraggeber gerügt werden, 3)Verstöße gegen Vergabevorschriften, die erst in den Vergabeunterlagen erkennbar sind, nicht spätestens bis zum Ablauf der Frist zur Bewerbung oder zur Angebotsabgabe gegenüber dem Auftraggeber gerügt werden, 4) mehr als 15 Kalendertage nach Eingang der Mitteilung des Auftraggebers, einer Rüge nicht abhelfen zu wollen, vergangen sind. Satz 1 gilt nicht bei einem Antrag auf Feststellung der Unwirksamkeit des Vertrages nach § 135 Abs. 1 Nr. 2. §134 Abs. 1 Satz 2 bleibt unberührt. result.text: In the tender, SGAV will outsource the screening part of a large proportion of the field blocks and associated map themes that are to be 1. processed to the supplier. This screening must be carried out according to specific guidelines, cf. this Annex 1 (Situation description) and Annex 3 (Screening instructions). This concerns the screening of a limited number of field blocks of 60.000 – 120.000 annually, as SGAV itself handles certain field blocks, e.g. due to their high complexity, if there are proposals for changes to the field block, or if analyses show that there is a high probability that the field block or an associated map theme needs to be corrected. After the supplier's screening, SGAV will itself edit the field blocks and associated map themes where there is a need for editing. The supplier must, however, update certain attribute data for all the screened field blocks, as described in Annex 4 (Interface description). Assessment of the field blocks and the associated map themes by the supplier must be based in particular on orthophotos from the last three years, certain attribute data on the field blocks and the associated map themes, as well as the field drawings from the applicants.

parts.source: I udbuddet vil SGAV lægge screeningsdelen af en stor del af de markblokke og tilhørende korttemaer, som skal 1. behandles, ud til leverandøren. Denne screening skal ske efter speci-fikke retningslinjer, jf. nærværende Bilag 1 (Situationsbeskrivelse) og Bilag 3 (Screeningsin-struks). Der er tale om screening af et afgrænset antal markblokke på 60.000 – 120.000 årligt, da SGAV selv håndterer visse markblokke f.eks. på grund af deres høje kompleksitet, hvis der er ændringsforslag til markblokken, eller hvis analyser viser, at der er stor sandsynlighed for, at markblokken eller et tilhørende korttema skal rettes. Vurdering af markblokkene og de tilhørende korttemaer hos leverandøren skal især ske på grundlag af ortofotos fra de seneste tre år, visse attributdata på markblokkene og de tilhøren-de korttemaer samt markindtegningerne fra ansøgerne.

The annual daily traffic is approx. 45,000. The tunnel shall be upgraded in accordance with the tunnel safety regulations and equipment in and outside the tunnel shall be replaced and replaced with new equipment that meets the current requirements. This includes, among other things: • New ventilation system. • New lighting installations with both new lights in the tunnel roof and continuous evacuation lights. • Extinguishing water shall be set up for the fire brigade. The overall goal of this program is to accelerate scientific discovery, improve research efficiency, and enhance the translation of research findings into improved health outcomes. Centers funded under this program will also foster multidisciplinary collaboration, support workforce development across career stages, and promote training in emerging areas such as data science, artificial intelligence, and implementation research.

rejected.text: The Transport Phenomena (TP) programme supports fundamental research to understand, model, and control the transport of mass, momentum, energy, and species across multiple scales. Innovative TP research supports advances in artificial intelligence; manufacturing; biotechnology; microelectronics; energy generation, extraction, and utilisation; nuclear energy; quantum science and engineering; and other national priorities. TP projects involve experiments, theory, and/or computational modelling. They aim to improve understanding and to create novel analytical techniques. While projects focus on fundamental principles, they also have a clear vision of how research outcomes will benefit applications in engineering. TP supports research on the dynamics of single- and multiphase systems. Special interests include flow separation, transition to turbulence, drag reduction, cavitation, instabilities, and reactive flows. The programme encourages research on the connection between dynamics at the microscale and material and flow properties at the macroscale. Fluids of interest include liquids, gases, suspensions, emulsions, granular materials, active fluids, biological fluids, colloids, aerosols, bubbles and drops, and fluids with surfactants. TP supports research on physicochemical phenomena at the interfaces between fluids and between fluids and solids. These phenomena include adsorption and desorption of nanoparticles and surfactants; bulk and interfacial rheology; wetting and capillarity phenomena; electrokinetics; flow in porous media; and directed and self-assembly of particles. TP supports research on thermodynamics and thermal transport involving conduction, diffusion, convection, phase transition, and radiation. Research may be across scales, in complex structures and at interfaces, in microelectronic devices, and in biological systems. Projects involving phonon transport and quantum thermal phenomena are welcome. TP encourages proposals focused on combustion of gas, liquid and solid fuels. Combustion topics of interest include chemical kinetic modelling, turbulence-chemistry interactions, detonations, plasma assisted reacting flows, sustainable fuels, mechanisms for pollutant control, and in-situ diagnostic methods. The programme also supports research on wildland fire behaviour that aims to prevent wildfire spread, inhibit its growth, and/or predict and mitigate fires at the wildland-urban interface. Partnerships: To speed discovery and innovation, NSF partners with federal agencies, industry, international groups, and others. Current opportunities are at NSF ENG Partnerships.

result.text: The Student Loans company (SLC) have an agreement for Enhanced Security Operations Managed Service expiring April 2028. In order to provision for a retender of the agreement SLC are undertaking pre-market engagement with regards to the provision of the following: • Requirement A: Enhanced Security Operations Managed Service - MXDR Service (2026-TR-0109a) • Requirement B: Enhanced Security Operations Managed Service - Vulnerability Management (VM) Service (2026-TR-0109b) • Requirement C: Enhanced Security Operations Managed Service - Breach Attack Simulation (BAS) Service (2026-TR-0109c) • Requirement D: Enhanced Security Operations Managed Service - Cyber Threat Intelligence (CTI) Service (2026-TR-0109d) • Requirement E: Enhanced Security Operations Managed Service - Digital Forensics and Incident Response (DFIR) Retainer Service (2026-TR-0109e) • Requirement F: Enhanced Security Operations Managed Service - Security Architecture and Engineering Support Services (2026-TR-0109f) SLC is considering an approach to the market to give the suppliers an option to bid for one or ALL of the contractual requirements. Requirement A Enhanced Security Operations Managed Service - MXDR Service The Supplier will provide a Managed Extended Detection and Response (MXDR) capability operating on a hybrid customer/supplier model. MXDR Service The Supplier will provide: • 24x7x365 monitoring of SLC security telemetry. • L1 and L2 Security Operations Centre capability (SLC retain L3). • Incident identification, triage and investigation. • Security use-case monitoring and tuning. • Management of Microsoft Sentinel detections. • SOAR playbook execution and optimisation. • Escalation management. • Alert enrichment. • Threat hunting capability. • Malicious activity investigation. • Service governance and performance management. • Security reporting at operational, tactical and strategic levels. Security Engineering (Operational) The Supplier shall provide: • L3 Engineering support for Sentinel. • Analytics rule development and tuning. • SOAR playbook management. • Connector maintenance and health monitoring. • Logging optimisation. • Onboarding and validation of agreed log sources. • Detection engineering support. • Detection gap analysis and monitoring coverage reviews. • Security use case development and continuous improvement. • Monitoring health checks. • Monitoring and remediation of ingestion issues. • Security platform optimisation. • Proactive automation support and development. • Threat intelligence-led detection improvements. Data Loss Prevention (DLP) & Phishing The Supplier shall: • Monitoring, triage and investigation of DLP, phishing, business email compromise (BEC), malicious email, malicious attachment and malicious URL alerts. • Investigation of suspected data loss, data exfiltration and policy breach events. • Support for user reported phishing submissions. • Escalation and coordination of confirmed incidents in accordance with agreed response procedures. • Identification and analysis of phishing campaigns, attacker infrastructure, indicators of compromise and emerging attack trends. • Recommendations for improvements to DLP policies, email security controls, detections and response processes. • Monthly reporting, trend analysis and security improvement recommendations. Reporting The Supplier shall provide: • Weekly operational reports. • Monthly service reports. • Quarterly service reviews. • KPI and SLA reporting. • Security metrics and trend analysis. Requirement B Enhanced Security Operations Managed Service - Vulnerability Management Service The Supplier shall provide Vulnerability Management services Monday to Friday, UK Core Hours (09:00-17:00). Vulnerability Management The Supplier shall: • Monitor vulnerability management queues. • Investigate vulnerability notifications. • Manage vulnerability triage. • Validate vulnerability findings. • Perform exploitability assessments. • Provide remediation recommendations. • Support exposure management activities. • Support CTEM activities. Stakeholder Engagement The Supplier shall: • Conduct monthly technical review meetings. • Support resolver teams. • Assist remediation planning. • Review remediation performance. • Provide vulnerability prioritisation guidance. Dashboarding & Reporting The Supplier shall: • Maintain executive dashboards. • Enhance Power BI reporting. • Produce technical reports. • Produce executive reports. • Produce PCI compliance reports. • Produce risk trending reports. Tooling The Supplier shall support: • Microsoft Defender for Endpoint. • Rapid7. • SLC PCI ASV Scanning tooling. • Jira. • Power BI. Requirement C Enhanced Security Operations Managed Service - Breach Attack Simulation Service The Supplier shall provide a Breach Attack Simulation (BAS) capability, currently using AttackIQ or similar. BAS Service The Supplier shall: • Operate and maintain the BAS platform. • Deploy and maintain BAS agents. • Configure integrations. • Execute scheduled simulations. • Execute customer-specific simulations. • Execute retests following remediation activities. Adversary Simulation Testing scenarios shall include: • Initial Access. • Execution. • Persistence. • Privilege Escalation. • Credential Access. • Lateral Movement. • Command and Control. • Exfiltration. • Malware. • Ransomware. • Advanced Persistent Threat activity. Security Validation The Supplier shall assess: • Security control effectiveness. • Security monitoring effectiveness. • Detection coverage. • Response capability. • Incident handling. • Use-case effectiveness. Reporting The Supplier shall produce: • Monthly BAS reports. • Executive summaries. • Technical findings. • Remediation recommendations. • Retest outcomes. Requirement D Enhanced Security Operations Managed Service - Cyber Threat Intelligence Service The Supplier shall provide strategic, operational and tactical Cyber Threat Intelligence services.

result.text: The subject of the contract is the "Operation, Maintenance, Support and Upgrade of the information systems 'Registration for First Grade Primary School' and electronic applications for admission to Model Schools, Public Onassis Schools, Model Ecclesiastical Schools and Experimental Schools". The subject of the contract focuses mainly on: • Operation, Maintenance and Technical Support Services (Phase A): concerns both systems, throughout the duration of the contract, which cover, by way of example: preventive and corrective maintenance, patch management, backup/restore, monitoring, alerting, management and optimisation of AWS infrastructure, load testing and enhanced readiness (on-call) during peak periods, as well as technical support for system administrators. It is clarified that the operation of a helpdesk for end users is not included in the subject of this contract. • Upgrade and Evolutionary Maintenance Actions (Phase B): concerns the annual adaptation of the two systems to the respective regulatory framework, the development of new functionalities, the improvement of user experience and accessibility (WCAG 2.1 AA), the expansion of interoperability and the strengthening of the traceability of the lottery/results procedures, in two (2) annual cycles, with mandatory production release of each annual version before the start of the corresponding application submission period. The Project is structured into the following Work Packages: • WP1 – Operation, Maintenance and Technical Support Services (Phase A): concerns both systems, throughout the duration of the contract, with quarterly service reports (Deliverables P1.1 and P1.2), which cover, by way of example: preventive and corrective maintenance, patch management, backup/restore, monitoring, alerting, management and optimisation of AWS infrastructure, load testing and enhanced readiness (on-call) during peak periods, as well as technical support for system administrators. It is clarified that the operation of a helpdesk for end users is not included in the subject of this contract. • WP2 – Upgrade and Evolutionary Maintenance Actions (Phase B): concerns the annual adaptation of the two systems to the respective regulatory framework, the development of new functionalities, the improvement of user experience and accessibility (WCAG 2.1 AA), the expansion of interoperability and the strengthening of the traceability of the lottery/results procedures, in two (2) annual cycles (Deliverables P2.1, P2.2), with mandatory production release of each annual version before the start of the corresponding application submission period.

parts.source: Αντικείμενο της σύμβασης αποτελεί η «Λειτουργία, Συντήρηση, Υποστήριξη και Αναβάθμιση των πληροφοριακών συστημάτων “Εγγραφή στην Πρώτη Δημοτικού” και ηλεκτρονικών αιτήσεων εισαγωγής σε Πρότυπα Σχολεία, Δημόσια Ωνάσεια Σχολεία, Πρότυπα Εκκλησιαστικά Σχολεία και Πειραματικά Σχολεία». Το αντικείμενο της σύμβασης επικεντρώνεται κυρίως σε: • Υπηρεσίες Λειτουργίας, Συντήρησης και Τεχνικής Υποστήριξης (Φάση Α ́): αφορά αμφότερα τα συστήματα, καθ' όλη τη διάρκεια της σύμβασης, οι οποίες καλύπτουν ενδεικτικά: προληπτική και διορθωτική συντήρηση, διαχείριση ενημερώσεων και ευπαθειών (patch management), αντίγραφα ασφαλείας και ανάκτηση (backup/restore), παρακολούθηση λειτουργίας (monitoring, alerting), διαχείριση και βελτιστοποίηση των υποδομών AWS, δοκιμές φόρτου και ενισχυμένη ετοιμότητα (on-call) κατά τις περιόδους αιχμής, καθώς και τεχνική υποστήριξη των διαχειριστών των συστημάτων. Διευκρινίζεται ότι η λειτουργία γραφείου αρωγής (helpdesk) προς τελικούς χρήστες δεν περιλαμβάνεται στο αντικείμενο της παρούσας σύμβασης. • Δράσεις Αναβάθμισης και Εξελικτικής Συντήρησης (Φάση Β ́): αφορά την ετήσια προσαρμογή των δύο συστημάτων στο εκάστοτε κανονιστικό πλαίσιο, την ανάπτυξη νέων λειτουργικοτήτων, τη βελτίωση της εμπειρίας χρήστη και της προσβασιμότητας (WCAG 2.1 AA), την επέκταση της διαλειτουργικότητας και την ενίσχυση της ιχνηλασιμότητας των διαδικασιών κλήρωσης/αποτελεσμάτων, σε δύο (2) ετήσιους κύκλους, με υποχρεωτική παραγωγική διάθεση κάθε ετήσιας έκδοσης πριν από την έναρξη της αντίστοιχης περιόδου υποβολής αιτήσεων. Το Έργο διαρθρώνεται στα ακόλουθα Πακέτα Εργασίας: • ΠΕ1 – Υπηρεσίες Λειτουργίας, Συντήρησης και Τεχνικής Υποστήριξης (Φάση Α ́): αφορά αμφότερα τα συστήματα, καθ' όλη τη διάρκεια της σύμβασης, με τριμηνιαίες εκθέσεις υπηρεσιών (Παραδοτέα Π1.1 και Π1.2), οι οποίες καλύπτουν ενδεικτικά: προληπτική και διορθωτική συντήρηση, διαχείριση ενημερώσεων και ευπαθειών (patch management), αντίγραφα ασφαλείας και ανάκτηση (backup/restore), παρακολούθηση λειτουργίας (monitoring, alerting), διαχείριση και βελτιστοποίηση των υποδομών AWS, δοκιμές φόρτου και ενισχυμένη ετοιμότητα (on-call) κατά τις περιόδους αιχμής, καθώς και τεχνική υποστήριξη των διαχειριστών των συστημάτων. Διευκρινίζεται ότι η λειτουργία γραφείου αρωγής (helpdesk) προς τελικούς χρήστες δεν περιλαμβάνεται στο αντικείμενο της παρούσας σύμβασης. • ΠΕ2 – Δράσεις Αναβάθμισης και Εξελικτικής Συντήρησης (Φάση Β ́): αφορά την ετήσια προσαρμογή των δύο συστημάτων στο εκάστοτε κανονιστικό πλαίσιο, την ανάπτυξη νέων λειτουργικοτήτων, τη βελτίωση της εμπειρίας χρήστη και της προσβασιμότητας (WCAG 2.1 AA), την επέκταση της διαλειτουργικότητας και την ενίσχυση της ιχνηλασιμότητας των διαδικασιών κλήρωσης/αποτελεσμάτων, σε δύο (2) ετήσιους κύκλους (Παραδοτέα Π2.1, Π2.2), με υποχρεωτική παραγωγική διάθεση κάθε ετήσιας έκδοσης πριν από την έναρξη της αντίστοιχης περιόδου υποβολής αιτήσεων.

result.text: The overarching goal of this notice of funding opportunity (NOFO) and its companion opportunities is to establish the Precision Medicine with AI: Integrating Imaging with Multimodal Data (PRIMED-AI) Program to support development of innovative, reliable, cost-effective, and sustainable multimodal AI-based clinical decision support (CDS) tools. PRIMED-AI CDS tools are based on the integration of clinical imaging with other types of multimodal health data to enhance care for patients with a wide range of health conditions. The PRIMED-AI Program seeks to catalyze the adoption of AI-based CDS tools into clinical workflows to enable novel personalized medicine strategies that address significant health challenges.The purpose of this NOFO is to catalyze the translation of Artificial Intelligence (AI)-enabled, image-centered, multimodal CDS tools, developed as Software as a Medical Device, from training and testing of prototypes towards clinical applications that address unmet health challenges in precision medicine. These projects are expected to have high potential for demonstrable, positive impact on patient outcomes and/or healthcare processes.

Home Digital Outcomes opportunities Procurement details SCOTTISH AMBULANCE SERVICE HIS/2026/1054 - Healthcare Improvement Scotland Digital Service Design and Website Development 0 Applications submitted Single stage Call-off procedure £170,000 Value Outside scope Off-payroll (IR35) status 02 October 2026 Application closing date 1. Context and requirements Overview Summary of the work Healthcare Improvement Scotland seeks a supplier to design and deliver the next phase of its website development using a people-led, user-centred approach. Working within the existing WordPress platform, the supplier will undertake discovery, user research, information architecture, accessibility improvements, website development and capability building. The initial scope covers two directorates and will create reusable design patterns, templates and approaches for wider organisational adoption. Pricing model Fixed price Provide further information Confirm if you require a contracted out service or supply of resource Contracted out service: the off-payroll rules do not apply Organisation the work is for Healthcare Improvement Scotland - NHS Scotland Where you want the supplier to work Scotland Where you want the supplier to work No specific location (for example they can work remotely) Latest start date 2026-10-27 Expected contract length 0-08-00 Expected contract structure 8 months Estimated contract value (excl VAT) 170000 Budget details The anticipated budget for this opportunity is up to £170,000 excluding VAT. This is a fixed-price contract and must include all costs associated with delivery, including project management, user research, service design, WordPress development, accessibility testing, quality assurance, knowledge transfer, stakeholder engagement, travel, subsistence, overheads, licences and any other expenses. Suppliers will be required to submit a breakdown of costs by deliverable and milestone as part of their tender response About the work Why the work is being done Healthcare Improvement Scotland (HIS) is seeking to improve the accessibility, usability and effectiveness of its website to better support health and social care professionals, partner organisations, citizens and communities across Scotland. User testing and stakeholder feedback have identified challenges relating to navigation, information architecture, content discovery and overall user experience. These issues can make it difficult for users to find and access important information, resources, tools, standards, frameworks and publications. HIS wishes to adopt a people-led, user-centred approach to improve access to information and digital services while building internal capability to sustainably manage and develop the website in the future. The project will focus initially on two directorates, creating reusable design patterns, templates and approaches that can subsequently be applied across the wider HIS web estate. The successful supplier will undertake discovery, user research, service design, accessibility improvement, WordPress development, implementation and knowledge transfer activities. The contract is expected to commence in November 2026 and all contracted deliverables must be completed by 30 June 2027. Problem to be solved Healthcare Improvement Scotland (HIS) has identified challenges with the usability, accessibility and effectiveness of its website. User testing and stakeholder feedback have highlighted difficulties with navigation, information architecture, content discovery and overall user experience. These issues make it harder for users to find and access important information, resources, standards, tools, frameworks and publications, reducing engagement and limiting the impact of nationally important content. HIS is seeking a supplier to help create a more user-centred, accessible and sustainable digital service. Working within the existing WordPress platform, the supplier should focus on understanding user needs and applying a people-led design approach to improve how users find, access and interact with content. The initial scope focuses on two HIS directorates and aims to create reusable design patterns, templates, components and approaches that can later be adopted across the wider HIS web estate. The successful supplier will also be expected to build internal capability through knowledge transfer, coaching and guidance. The outcomes sought are: • Improved accessibility, usability and user experience. • Improved navigation and information architecture. • Improved discoverability and use of HIS resources and digital content. • Reusable website templates, components and design approaches. • Increased adoption and use of HIS programmes and resources. • Greater internal capability through knowledge transfer and coaching. • Sustainable content management, governance and maintenance arrangements. Challenges include working within an existing WordPress environment, balancing multiple stakeholder needs, delivering improvements within a fixed budget, and ensuring outputs developed for the initial scope can be scaled across the wider HIS website. Who the users are and what they need to do As a health and social care professional, I need to quickly find guidance, standards, frameworks, publications, tools and resources so that I can use Healthcare Improvement Scotland information in my work. As a citizen or community member, I need to access information about Healthcare Improvement Scotland and its work so that I can understand and engage with health and care improvement activities. As a website user, I need to find information quickly and easily so that I can access the resources, publications and content relevant to my needs.

result.text: As a website user, I need intuitive navigation, accessible content and clear information architecture so that I can find information without needing detailed knowledge of Healthcare Improvement Scotland's organisational structure. As a HIS website editor, I need to create, update and manage website content efficiently so that information remains accurate, current and accessible. As a member of the HIS Communications Team, I need tools, templates and governance arrangements that support consistent and user-centred content management so that the website remains effective and up to date. As a member of the HIS Digital Team, I need sustainable website components, guidance and supporting documentation so that the website can be maintained and developed effectively. As a HIS employee responsible for managing and improving the website, I need knowledge transfer, coaching and capability development so that improvements can be sustained beyond the life of the contract. As a HIS stakeholder, I need website content, navigation and information architecture to reflect user needs so that users can easily locate the information they are seeking. Preliminary market engagement Work done so far Current phase Not started Existing team The successful supplier will work collaboratively with a range of stakeholders across Healthcare Improvement Scotland (HIS), including: Director of Evidence and Digital, and Chief Pharmacist – provides project oversight, strategic direction and overall accountability for delivery. Communications Team – key stakeholders responsible for website content, stakeholder communications and user engagement. Digital Team – responsible for digital services and ongoing management of the website and related technologies. Transformational Change – Systems Unit – responsible for contract management, project management and providing existing user-centred design expertise. Website Editors and Content Owners – staff located across the organisation who are responsible for maintaining, updating and managing website content. The successful supplier will be expected to work collaboratively with these stakeholders to shape, prioritise and deliver the work, undertake user engagement activities, and support knowledge transfer and capability building throughout the contract. Incumbent supplier No Provide further information Linked projects Work setup Working arrangements The successful supplier will be expected to work collaboratively with Healthcare Improvement Scotland (HIS) stakeholders throughout delivery of the contract. This will include regular engagement with the Director of Evidence and Digital and Chief Pharmacist, the Communications Team, the Digital Team, the Transformational Change – Systems Unit, and website editors and content owners across the organisation. The supplier will be expected to adopt a collaborative and flexible approach, working with HIS to agree priorities, delivery activities, milestones and outputs. Knowledge transfer, coaching and capability building are important elements of the requirement and suppliers should anticipate regular engagement with HIS staff throughout the contract. The Authority does not require a full-time on-site presence. Suppliers may propose a delivery approach that combines remote and on-site working where this supports effective stakeholder engagement, user research, workshops, training and project delivery. Any travel, subsistence, accommodation, overheads or other expenses associated with delivery of the contract must be included within the Total Contract Price submitted by the supplier. No additional expenses will be payable unless expressly agreed by the Authority in writing. This should be reflected within the supplier's pricing submission. Security clearance Baseline Personnel Security Standard (BPSS) Additional information on security clearance No specific security clearances required. Special terms and conditions 2. Assessment Criteria Set overall award criteria weightings Quality 80 Price 20 Conditions of participation Award criteria Enter your question Tenderers must complete and submit Appendix B – Technical Submission Document and Appendix A – Pricing Schedule in accordance with the requirements set out in the ITT. All mandatory non-scored questions, scored quality questions, weightings and evaluation criteria are detailed within the ITT and Appendix B – Technical Submission Document. The Authority will evaluate tenders on the basis of: Quality: 80% Price: 20% Tenderers should refer to the ITT and associated appendices for the full question set, scoring methodology, submission requirements and evaluation criteria. 3. result.text: Südwestrundfunk (SWR), as a public service broadcaster of the ARD, is strictly dependent on a functioning IT infrastructure to fulfil its tasks. In the age of digital communication, central elements are necessary for efficient process control in order to be able to plan, execute, and implement processes digitally, both internally and across the entire ARD. Different software solutions for network management are currently in use at Südwestrundfunk and the eligible state broadcasting corporations. The network management tool CheckMK is already in use across the board at a large number of the eligible entities and is deeply integrated into the system landscape. As part of the ARD structural reform, a holistic solution is to be established across the entire ARD. For this purpose, services for the Checkmk product are to be procured for Südwestrundfunk and other eligible state broadcasting corporations. Furthermore, the eligible entities require further services such as consulting and support in the area of network management and for the CheckMK product. Südwestrundfunk (SWR) as the contracting authority and the eligible broadcasting corporations therefore intended to procure in two lots: • Lot 1: Services for the Checkmk product incl. support • Lot 2: Development and consulting in the area of Checkmk The contracting authority (SWR) / eligible entities place the following essential requirements on the services to be provided by the contractor: Lot 1: - Contract Framework agreement for the basic term of 24 months - Delivery services Services of the Checkmk product incl. support for a limited period. - Optional additional services Extension of the framework agreement by 12 to then 36 months Extension of the framework agreement by a further 12 to a total of 48 months Advance payment guarantee Services in accordance with the requirements of the technical specifications (see contract documents and Annex 17 – Service and Price Sheet for Lot 1) The acceptance quantities for Lot 1 are shown in the procedural and contract documents, Chapter 5.6 Acceptance Quantities: Acceptance quantities Number of services in units for Checkmk incl. support: Minimum acceptance quantity: 1.000.000 units, Planned acceptance quantity: 1.400.000 units, Optional maximum acceptance quantity: 1.800.000 units Acceptance quantities Checkmk Synthetic Monitoring: Minimum acceptance quantity: 10 units, Planned acceptance quantity: 200 units, Optional maximum acceptance quantity: 500 units Acceptance quantities virtual appliances: Minimum acceptance quantity: 0 units, Planned acceptance quantity: 0 units, Optional maximum acceptance quantity: 1 units per licence scale up to 600.000 services Lot 2: - Contract Framework agreement for the basic term of 24 months - Services Consulting and support services for the Checkmk product from Lot 1 Development, migration, and integration services - Optional additional services Extension of the framework agreement by 12 to then 36 months Extension of the framework agreement by a further 12 to a total of 48 months Services in accordance with the requirements of the technical specifications (see contract documents and Annex 21 – Service and Price Sheet for Lot 2) The acceptance quantities for Lot 2 are shown in the procedural and contract documents, Chapter 6.8 Acceptance Quantities: Acceptance quantities Service in hours: Minimum acceptance quantity: 200 hours, Planned acceptance quantity: 400 hours, Optional maximum acceptance quantity: 600 hours Acceptance quantities Flat rate for incidental costs (incl. travel times) per on-site deployment: Minimum acceptance quantity: 0 hours, Planned acceptance quantity: 0 hours, Optional maximum acceptance quantity: 10 hours The start of the framework agreement for each lot is planned for 01.03.2027. In addition to the SWR as the contracting authority, the following public service broadcasting corporations as well as their subsidiaries and affiliated companies, provided that the participation of the public service broadcasting corporations is at least 50%, are involved in this framework agreement as eligible entities: • Deutschlandradio (DR) • Hessischer Rundfunk (HR) • ARD-Sternpunkt (represented by HR) • Mitteldeutscher Rundfunk (MDR) • Norddeutscher Rundfunk (NDR) • Rundfunk Berlin Brandenburg (RBB) • ARD-POC + Text (represented by RBB) • IVZ (represented by RBB) • Saarländischer Rundfunk (SR) • Südwestrundfunk (SWR) • Westdeutscher Rundfunk (WDR) Joint facilities (GSEA) for which the respective eligible entity has the lead are also eligible. The aim of the procurement procedure is to conclude one framework agreement per lot. result.text: NRW.BANK is the largest state promotional bank in Germany. It employs approximately 1650 members of staff and, with a total assets of approximately 162 billion euros, ranks 11 among all banks in Germany. It consists of 19 divisions with a total of 250 organisational units and 232 managers, of which 5 are dual leadership roles. Since 2022, a cultural change initiative has been underway within the bank, the results of which include the design of a mission statement with strong requirement criteria for collaboration, initiative, efficiency and personal responsibility. Culture pilots support implementation in the 19 divisions of the bank. In parallel with this, alongside the traditional run organisation for ongoing business processes, an agile delivery organisation has been and is currently being established in which larger change projects are bundled into agile-working teams. The organisational structure has not been changed in this context, i.e. the members of staff seconded wholly or partly to the agile delivery organisation also remain attached to managers in the existing organisational structure. The scope of the contract includes the preparation, execution and follow-up of an annual staff survey. The contractor shall conduct the surveys using an online survey instrument. The first survey shall be conducted in September 2026. The notification of all managers regarding the survey results for their areas of responsibility must have taken place by November 2026 at the latest. The workshops for processing the survey results shall follow immediately after the first survey and take place on demand. Following the first survey, the cycle for subsequent surveys shall be determined: this can be 12, 18 or 24 months. Further details can be found in the specification of requirements (Annex 1) or the framework agreement.

parts.source: Die NRW.BANK ist das größte Landesförderinstitut in Deutschland. Sie beschäftigt ca. 1650 Mitarbeitende und liegt mit einer Bilanzsumme von ca. 162 Milliarden Euro auf Platz 11 aller Banken in Deutschland. Sie besteht aus 19 Bereichen mit insgesamt 250 Organisationseinheiten und 232 Führungskräften, davon 5 Doppelspitzen. Seit dem Jahr 2022 findet in der Bank eine Kulturwandelinitiative statt, die im Ergebnis u.a. ein Leitbild entworfen hat mit starken Anforderungskriterien zu Zusammenarbeit, Initiative, Effizienz und Eigenverantwortlichkeit. Kulturlotsen unterstützen die Umsetzung in den 19 Bereichen der Bank. Parallel hierzu wurde und wird zurzeit neben der klassischen Run-Organisation für die laufenden Geschäftsprozesse eine agile Lieferorganisation aufgebaut in der größere Veränderungsvorhaben in agil arbeitenden Teams gebündelt werden. Die Aufbauorganisation wurde in diesem Zusammenhang nicht verändert, d.h. auch die ganz oder teilweise in die agile Lieferorganisation entsandten Mitarbeitenden sind weiterhin an Führungskräfte der bestehenden Aufbauorganisation angebunden. Der Umfang des Auftrags beinhaltet die Vorbereitung, Durchführung und Nachbereitung einer jährlichen Befragung der Mitarbeitenden. Die Befragungen führt die Auftragnehmerin unter Verwendung eines Online-Befragungsinstruments durch. Die erste Befragung wird im September 2026 durchgeführt. Die Information aller Führungskräfte über die Befragungsergebnisse ihrer Zuständigkeitsbereiche soll spätestens im November 2026 erfolgt sein. Die Workshops zur Bearbeitung der Befragungsergebnisse schließen unmittelbar an die erste Befragung an und erfolgen auf Abruf. Nach der ersten Befragung wird der Turnus für die Folgebefragungen festgelegt: Dieser kann 12, 18 oder 24 Monate betragen. Nähere Details sind der Leistungsbeschreibung (Anlage 1) bzw. der Rahmenvereinbarung zu entnehmen.

rejected.text: The subject of the procurement is nurse call, fall detection, and mobility monitoring systems for use by Helsingin kaupungin sosiaali-, terveys- ja pelastustoimiala. Nurse call systems are used in the social welfare, healthcare, and rescue services sector in hospitals, senior centres, sheltered housing facilities, enhanced sheltered housing units, health centre ward departments, rehabilitation units, and other operating environments requiring 24-hour care and monitoring. In addition, the systems are utilised in home care support services and special units where clients' need for help can be sudden and require a response. Nurse call systems are a central part of daily care work and client and patient safety. They ensure that requests for help are transmitted without delay to the correct staff and that nursing staff are able to prioritize their tasks according to the urgency of the situation. At the same time, they support staff occupational safety in threat and hazardous situations, for example, and enable operational monitoring, reporting, and development. The importance of nurse call systems is particularly emphasized in situations where clients' functional capacity has deteriorated, memory disorders are common, or the need for care is continuous. In such cases, the system's operational reliability, ease of use, and integration with other systems are not merely technical features, but factors directly affecting the quality and safety of care. The objective of the procurement is to ensure that the solutions in use meet current and future needs. This requires the systems to be scalable, compatible with other technologies, and capable of adapting to various care environments without complicating the use of the systems. At the same time, it is ensured that the solutions to be procured fulfil obligations concerning data protection, information security, and regulatory requirements. As a whole, nurse call systems are a critical part of the functionality of the service system, and their procurement must be implemented in a way that long-term supports the quality, safety, and cost-efficiency of services. The objective of the framework agreement procurement is to find a maximum of five suppliers capable of delivering a nurse call system to the sector's sites that can handle traditional nurse calls (client/patient can call a nurse to the room) and additionally utilise new technology enabling the system to alert a nurse to the client's/patient's location proactively regarding risk situations (e.g. getting out of bed, falling). The new technology aims to improve client/patient safety within the limits defined by law. A nurse call system is required in all new and renovated hospitals, senior centres, etc. In addition, the social welfare, healthcare, and rescue services sector has several sites where a previously procured but outdated nurse call system no longer has maintenance and support offered by the supplier. These outdated systems must be replaced with new ones. The solutions forming the subject of the procurement are primarily procured as a comprehensive service provided by the suppliers selected for the framework agreement. The subject of the procurement is described in more detail in the appendices of this call for tender.

parts.source: Hankinnan kohteena on Helsingin kaupungin sosiaali-, terveys- ja pelastustoimialan käyttöön tulevat hoitajakutsu-, kaatumisentunnistus- sekä liikkumisen seurantajärjestelmät. Hoitajakutsujärjestelmiä käytetään sosiaali-, terveys- ja pelastustoimialalla sairaaloissa, seniorikeskuksissa, palvelutaloissa, tehostetun palveluasumisen yksiköissä, terveysasemien vuodeosastoilla, kuntoutusyksiköissä sekä muissa ympärivuorokautista hoitoa ja valvontaa edellyttävissä toimintaympäristöissä. Lisäksi järjestelmiä hyödynnetään kotihoidon tukipalveluissa ja erityisyksiköissä, joissa asiakkaiden avuntarve voi olla äkillistä ja reagointia edellyttävää. Hoitajakutsujärjestelmät ovat keskeinen osa päivittäistä hoiva, - ja hoitotyötä ja asiakas- sekä potilasturvallisuutta. Niiden avulla varmistetaan, että avunpyynnöt välittyvät viiveettä oikealle henkilöstölle ja että hoitohenkilökunta pystyy priorisoimaan tehtävänsä tilanteen kiireellisyyden mukaan. Samalla ne tukevat henkilöstön työturvallisuutta esimerkiksi uhka- ja vaaratilanteissa sekä mahdollistavat toiminnan seurannan, raportoinnin ja kehittämisen. Hoitajakutsujärjestelmien merkitys korostuu erityisesti tilanteissa, joissa asiakkaiden toimintakyky on heikentynyt, muistisairaudet ovat yleisiä tai hoidon tarve on jatkuvaa. Tällöin järjestelmän toimintavarmuus, helppokäyttöisyys ja integraatio muihin järjestelmiin eivät ole pelkästään teknisiä ominaisuuksia, vaan suoraan hoidon laatuun ja turvallisuuteen vaikuttavia tekijöitä. Hankinnan tavoitteena on varmistaa, että käytössä olevat ratkaisut vastaavat nykyisiä ja tulevia tarpeita. Tämä edellyttää järjestelmiltä skaalautuvuutta, yhteensopivuutta muiden teknologioiden kanssa sekä kykyä mukautua erilaisiin hoitoympäristöihin ilman, että järjestelmien käyttö monimutkaistuu. Samalla varmistetaan, että hankittavat ratkaisut täyttävät tietosuojaa, tietoturvaa ja viranomaisvaatimuksia koskevat velvoitteet. Kokonaisuutena hoitajakutsujärjestelmät ovat kriittinen osa palvelujärjestelmän toimivuutta, ja niiden hankinta tulee toteuttaa siten, että se tukee pitkäjänteisesti palveluiden laatua, turvallisuutta ja kustannustehokkuutta. Puitejärjestelyn kilpailutuksessa on tavoitteena löytää enintään viisi toimittajaa, jotka kykenevät toimittamaan toimialan kohteisiin hoitajakutsujärjestelmän, jolla voidaan hoitaa perinteinen hoitajakutsu (asiakas/potilas voi kutsua hoitajan huoneeseen) ja lisäksi hyödyntää uutta teknologiaa, jonka avulla järjestelmä voi hälyttää hoitajan asiakkaan/potilaan luokse ennakoivasti riskitilanteisiin liittyen (esim. sängyltä nouseminen, kaatuminen). Uuden teknologian avulla pyritään parantamaan asiakas/potilasturvallisuutta lain määrittämissä rajoissa. Hoitajakutsujärjestelmä tarvitaan kaikkiin uusiin ja saneerattaviin sairaaloihin, seniorikeskuksiin jne. Lisäksi sosiaali-, terveys- ja pelastustoimialalla on useita kohteita, joissa aikoinaan hankittu, mutta vanhentunut hoitajakutsujärjestelmä, jolle toimittaja ei enää tarjoa ylläpitoa ja tukea. Nämä vanhentuneet järjestelmät pitää korvata uusilla. Hankinnan kohteena olevat ratkaisut hankintaan pääasiassa puitejärjestelyyn valittujen toimittajien tarjoamana kokonaispalveluna. Tarkemmin hankinnan kohde on kuvattu tämän tarjouspyynnön liitteissä.

result.text: HESA (part of Jisc) are seeking a supplier to support the annual coding of occupational information. Following its merger with the Higher Education Statistics Agency, Jisc has retained 'HESA' as a brand name, and Jisc's functions, activities and role as the DDB are undertaken by a dedicated directorate within Jisc, operating under the HESA brand. References to HESA within the Specification do not mean any legal entity. This will include Standard Industrial Classification (SIC) and Standard Occupational Classification (SOC) codes from the Office for National Statistics (ONS), along with some additional information to supplement this. The supply of this data will support our role as the designated data body for the HE sector, ensuring high quality, consistent classification of employer data. As survey responses are received, HESA/Jisc will securely make available to the supplier, in batches, an overnight file of the employer, course and role information to enable the supplier to complete the required SIC and SOC coding and return it to HESA/Jisc using an encrypted secure bulk data sending system. In addition to the purposes set out below, the coding will be used by Jisc to update and feed into the Graduate Outcomes provider dashboards so that Providers have visibility of the progress and outcomes of the coding. HESA/Jisc will run the Graduate Outcomes survey, working with third-party suppliers to manage the call centre system for contact management and to provide an online survey. It will be necessary for the supplier to join review calls with HESA/Jisc and HESA/Jisc's third-party suppliers to feedback any improvements required to the job role and employer data to improve the accuracy of coding. Lot LOT-0000: .

result.text: WISTA stands for Wissenschafts- und Wirtschaftsstandort Adlershof and is a state-of-the-art technology park in the Adlershof district of Berlin (Treptow-Köpenick borough). It is considered one of the most advanced high-tech parks in Europe and is a central hub for science, business, and start-ups. WISTA Adlershof is a location with an area of approx. 4,2 km2, approx. 1.300 companies, research institutions, and university institutes with 28.000 employees. The WISTA Management GmbH acts as a site developer, service provider, and economic promoter. It supports companies, research institutions, and start-ups at the site and fosters innovation and growth in the region. In addition to its real estate portfolio, WISTA possesses its own campus network, which consists of a high-performance cable network as well as a 5G infrastructure. The network has been continuously expanded and technologically developed since 1998 – from classic telephony and data services to Gigabit and 10G connections, cloud and UCC integration, campus-wide Wi-Fi and IoT applications, through to local 5G and current network 4.0 topics. It thus forms an essential digital infrastructure of the campus and is the subject of the expression of interest procedure. The attractiveness of the campus network stems from its established telecommunications infrastructure at a dynamically growing high-tech location. The network has an existing customer base, established line routes and network nodes, as well as redundant carrier connections. Additional development prospects arise from the continuous expansion of the campus through new buildings, the expansion potential for cloud, security, and UCC services, as well as the addition of a local 5G campus network. The campus network thus offers a resilient infrastructural foundation with further economic and technological growth potential. The reasons for the sale by WISTA are a strategic further development of the campus network by a specialised provider with qualified personnel and the necessary expertise. Subject of sale: Passive infrastructure (fibre optic, copper, conduits, manholes, cable distribution cabinets, building connections) Active infrastructure (switches, routers, servers, telecommunications system) Customer contracts (insofar as transferable, consent/transfers still to be checked) Frequency allocation 5G (not alienable, subsequent use/transfer still to be checked from a regulatory perspective, application for own allocation required) Land/line rights (insofar as transferable, easements/permissions still to be checked) Software/licences (insofar as transferable, licence terms still to be checked) Cable network: The WISTA campus network at the science and business location Adlershof forms the central communication infrastructure for voice and data services in the core area of the technology park. It currently serves around 400 customers as well as approx. 4.400 participants in the voice sector and is therefore an essential location factor for Germany's largest science and technology park. The existing infrastructure includes a high-performance cable duct system, a line network based on copper and fibre optics with a total length of almost 20 kilometres, as well as a Gigabit Ethernet backbone. Technically, fibre optic backbone connections, single-mode and multi-mode fibre optic cables, copper cables, copper cross-cables, and FM cables with 100 double cores are used in particular. At the active network and services level, the campus network includes transmission and switching equipment for voice and data communication, routing/switching components, data core and access areas, network gateways to wide area networks, as well as a communication network consisting of communication systems from the manufacturer Unify. The users' existing voice and data infrastructure is connected to the network; some users are connected via LAN ports under 100 Mbit/s or VDSL, while other users have connections from 100 Mbit/s. The WAN connection is designed to be redundant with at least two external carriers and has two redundant gateways with 100 Gbit/s. The campus network is particularly interesting as an established, operator-capable infrastructure with an existing customer base, available line routes, documented network gateways, and development potential. The future operator is to operate, maintain, further develop, and actively market the network to users on their own responsibility. In addition to the existing copper, fibre optic, and fibre infrastructure, the existing customers, the available telecommunications and data network components, the expansion potential at the growing Adlershof location, and the possibility of introducing new cloud, security, VoIP, and UCC services are of value. 5G network: The WISTA 5G campus network is designed as a local private 5G campus network at the science and business location Adlershof. It serves as a supplement to the existing cable infrastructure and is to be gradually expanded at outdoor and indoor locations. Initial expansion has been carried out in the area of Albert-Einstein-Straße 16 (central outdoor location) as well as in the showroom/a:head context (indoor location). The regulatory basis for the 5G infrastructure is a local frequency allocation by the Federal Network Agency for the frequency range 3.700–3.800 MHz. The allocation holder is WISTA Management GmbH. The allocated bandwidth is 100 MHz; the frequency allocation is limited until 20.02.2030. The allocation area covers an area of approx. 0,873273 km2. Technologically, the 5G infrastructure is based on a Nokia DAC/NDAC Medium+ environment with 5G standalone architecture, Edge Core, NDAC manager, Nokia AirScale components, HPE Edge servers, router and switching components, and SIM kit. WISTA Management GmbH intends to sell its cable network and 5G campus network at the science and business location Adlershof.
