result.text: Lapin hyvinvointialue invites tenders for an entity comprising: 1. safety devices provided to the home Lapin hyvinvointialue for customers 2. alarm reception service 3. alarm reception system for producing the above-mentioned service as the wellbeing services county's own operation. In the procurement, safety devices refer to various safety devices provided to the home that can be used to improve the safety of a customer living at home. The safety devices to be procured are safety phones and their accessories, a positioning safety wristband and a solution for door monitoring in communal living. Alarm reception service refers to a service in which alarms coming through safety devices are received, an initial assessment of the need for assistance is made and the request is forwarded further to safety assistants. The service must operate around the clock every day of the year. Alarm reception system refers to a system with which the contracting entity can receive alarms from various safety devices and forward them as tasks to safety assistants. It is intended for Lapin hyvinvointialue to take over the alarm reception service as its own operation according to a preliminary schedule in spring 2028. The wellbeing services county procures the alarm reception service until the reception system has been put into use, after which the procurement of the reception service will end. The subject of the procurement is described in more detail in the tender invitation and its appendices, particularly in appendix 1 "Hankinnan kohteen kuvaus". In the tender competition, one supplier is selected as the framework agreement supplier. Through the framework arrangement, the wellbeing services county procures safety devices and services from the selected supplier during the contract period as needed. The needs of the wellbeing services county may vary during the contract period, and the tender invitation does not commit to specific procurement quantities. The contract period of the framework agreement is fixed-term for two years, after which the agreement will continue until further notice. The contracting authority's intention is to conclude an agreement with the selected supplier as soon as the tender period has ended, the tenders have been compared, the procurement decision has been made and the appeal period has ended. According to the contracting authority's estimate, this time point will be during October 2026. The schedules for the implementation of device replacements and other measures related to commissioning will be agreed together with the selected supplier in a manner that takes into account the needs of both parties. In addition, an alarm reception system as a whole is procured from the selected supplier, which includes the delivery of the system and its ongoing service. The ongoing service agreement for the system is valid until further notice. The procurement has not been divided into lots because this is a unified entity formed of goods and services, the compatibility of all parts of which must be ensured. From the perspective of the safety of Lapin hyvinvointialue customers, it is important that one supplier is responsible for the functionality of the entire entity. The procurement notice has been published a second time because two previous procurement procedures had to be discontinued due to needs to modify the procurement documents.

parts.source: Lapin hyvinvointialue pyytää tarjouksia kokonaisuudesta, johon sisältyvät: 1. kotiin annettavat turvalaitteet Lapin hyvinvointialueen asiakkaille 2. hälytysten vastaanottopalvelu 3. hälytysten vastaanottojärjestelmä edellä mainitun palvelun tuottamiseen hyvinvointialueen omana toimintana. Hankinnassa turvalaitteilla tarkoitetaan erilaisia kotiin annettavia turvalaitteita, joilla voidaan parantaa kotona asuvan asiakkaan turvallisuutta. Hankittavia turvalaitteita ovat turvapuhelimet ja niiden lisälaitteet, paikantava turvaranneke sekä ratkaisu yhteisöllisen asumisen ovivalvontaan. Hälytysten vastaanottopalvelulla tarkoitetaan palvelua, jossa otetaan vastaan turvalaitteiden kautta tulevat hälytykset, tehdään alustavan arvion avuntarpeesta ja välitetään pyyntö edelleen turva-auttajille. Palvelun tulee toiminnassa vuorokauden ympäri vuoden jokaisena päivä. Hälytysten vastaanottojärjestelmällä tarkoitetaan järjestelmää, jolla tilaaja voi ottaa eri turvalaitteiden hälytykset vastaan ja edelleenvälittää ne tehtävänä turva-auttajille. Lapin hyvinvointialueella on tarkoitus ottaa hälytysten vastaanottopalvelu omaksi toiminnaksi alustavan aikataulun mukaan keväällä 2028. Hyvinvointialue hankkii hälytysten vastaanottopalvelua siihen asti, kunnes vastaanottojärjestelmä on otettu käyttöön, minkä jälkeen vastaanottopalvelun hankinta päättyy. Hankinnan kohde on kuvattu tarkemmin tarjouspyynnössä ja sen liitteissä, erityisesti liitteessä 1 "Hankinnan kohteen kuvaus". Kilpailutuksessa valitaan yksi toimitta puitesopimustoimittajaksi. Puitejärjestelyn kautta hyvinvointialue hankkii valitulta toimittajalta turvalaitteita ja palveluita sopimuskauden aikana tarpeen mukaan. Hyvinvointialueen tarpeet voivat vaihdella sopimuskauden aikana, eikä tarjouspyynnöllä sitouduta tiettyihin hankintamääriin. Puitesopimuksen sopimuskausi on määräaikaisena kaksi vuotta, jonka jälkeen sopimus jatkuu toistaiseksi voimassa olevana. Hankintayksikön tarkoitus on tehdä sopimus valitun toimittajan kanssa heti, kun tarjousaika on päättynyt, tarjoukset on vertailtu, hankintapäätös on tehty ja muutoksenhakuaika on päättynyt. Hankintayksikön arvion mukaan ajankohta on lokakuun 2026 aikana. Laitevaihtojen toteutuksen ja muiden käyttöönottoon liittyvien toimien aikataulut sovitaan yhdessä valitun toimittajan kanssa molempien osapuolten tarpeet huomioivalla tavalla. Lisäksi valitulta toimittajalta hankitaan hälytysten vastaanottojärjestelmä kokonaisuutena, johon sisältyy järjestelmän toimittaminen ja sen jatkuva palvelu. Järjestelmän jatkuvan palvelun sopimus on voimassa toistaiseksi. Hankintaa ei ole jaettu osiin, koska kyseessä on yhtenäinen tavaroiden ja palveluiden muodostama kokonaisuus, jonka kaikkien osasten yhteensopivuus on voitava varmistaa. Lapin hyvinvointialueen asiakkaiden turvallisuuden kannalta on tärkeää, että yksi toimittaja vastaa koko kokonaisuuden toimivuudesta. Hankintailmoitus on julkaistu toisen kerran uudelleen, koska kaksi aiempaa hankintamenettelyä on täytynyt keskeyttää hankinta-asiakirjojen muutostarpeiden vuoksi.

result.text: The project comprises the planning and execution of internal audits and security revisions in the area of information security to maintain the information network of the EU Paying Agency Brandenburg-Berlin, which is certified based on BSI IT-Grundschutz in accordance with ISO 27001. The ISO 27001 certification is proof of the Union law eligibility criterion of "security of information systems" of the EU paying agency (Article 1 in conjunction with Annex I point 3 letter B of Delegated Regulation (EU) No 2022/127) and requires the regular execution of internal audits and security revisions in accordance with BSI IT-Grundschutz. Internal personnel resources and competencies for carrying out internal audits are not available, which is why, in accordance with chapter 8.3, BSI standard 200-1, it has been decided to award the execution of the audits to external experts. The previously awarded project with the same project content expires in the year 2026, which is why a multi-year follow-up project is being awarded to ensure continuous and long-term internal auditing until 2030. The subject matter of the project shall be flexibly retrievable auditing services for the information network of the EU paying agency, which consists of the organisational units of the Ministry for Agriculture and Nutrition, Environment and Consumer Protection Brandenburg (MLEUV) and the directly subordinate State Office for Rural Development, Agriculture and Land Consolidation (LELF), as well as the other bodies involved in the paying agency procedure (districts, state forestry enterprise, investment bank and technical service providers), which as outsourcing partners or the components outsourced to them, shall represent the essential audit subjects of the audits. Based on an jointly prepared audit schedule, four audits per year are planned. The project is to be awarded to demonstrably experienced experts in the field of information security revision or ISMS auditing in accordance with BSI IT-Grundschutz. Lot LOT-0001: Internal audits and security revisions to maintain the information security of the EU paying agency in the MLEUV. The contract subject matter comprises the planning and execution of internal audits and security revisions for an information network certified on the basis of BSI IT-Grundschutz in accordance with ISO 27001 and its participating outsourcing partners. The information network to be audited "Operational running of the EU Paying Agency Brandenburg-Berlin" consists of the organisational units of the Ministry for Agriculture and Nutrition, Environment and Consumer Protection of the State of Brandenburg (MLEUV) and the directly subordinate State Office for Rural Development, Agriculture and Land Consolidation (LELF), which perform the professional tasks of approval, control, disbursement, accounting and administration of arrears of subsidy funds of the European Agricultural Guarantee Fund (EAGF), the European Agricultural Fund for Rural Development (EAFRD) and the European Maritime, Fisheries and Aquaculture Fund (EMFAF), as well as the other bodies involved in the paying agency procedure (districts, state forestry enterprise, investment bank and technical service providers), which are treated as outsourcing partners. The essential audit activities are to be carried out for the outsourced components of the information network at the outsourcing partners. With these institutions, a transfer of paying agency tasks has been agreed on the basis of responsibilities ordinances, transfer ordinances or other regulations. Based on a federal-state interface model for EU paying agencies coordinated with the Federal Office for Information Security (BSI for short), the outsourcing relationships are essentially differentiated into: 1. Organisational interfaces (S-O): Institutions that perform transferred tasks of approval and control within the business processes of the paying agency and use central paying agency specialist applications within the information network to fulfil tasks, as they do not provide central paying agency specialist applications themselves and do not operate any specific application environments. In Brandenburg, this currently affects: - 14 approval offices (offices for agriculture) in the districts, - the State Forestry Enterprise (LFB), - the Investment Bank of the State of Brandenburg (ILB). 2. Technical interfaces (S-T): Institutions of the technical operation of the central paying agency specialist applications and systems as well as data storage. In Brandenburg, this currently affects: - the central Brandenburg IT service provider (ZIT-BB), - Land Surveying and Basic Geographic Information Brandenburg (LGB) - init AG for the operation of an application procedure. A medium three-digit number of persons work in the information network. Every year, several million euros in a three-digit amount of EU, federal and state funds are administered. The paying agency specialist applications essentially comprise client/server and web applications, for which an IT system landscape consisting of terminal, web, application and database servers is deployed. Use is made by administrative units using virtual clients via the state administration network of the State of Brandenburg. Applicants access the online application systems operated in a demilitarised zone (DMZ) via the internet. In coordination with the client and based on the documentation of the ISMS, the contractor shall draw up and carry out a multi-year audit schedule. The planning and execution of the audits takes place with the participation of the information security officer of the EU paying agency. Based on empirical values, four audits per year are to be carried out with different procedure participants respectively, which should be flexibly retrievable.

parts.source: Das Vorhaben umfasst die Planung und Durchführung von internen Audits und Sicherheitsrevisionen im Bereich der Informationssicherheit zur Aufrechterhaltung des auf Basis vom BSI IT-Grundschutz nach ISO 27001 zertifizierten Informationsverbunds der EU-Zahlstelle Brandenburg-Berlin. Die ISO 27001 Zertifizierung ist ein Nachweis für das unionsrechtliche Zulassungskriterium der "Sicherheit der Informationssysteme" der EU-Zahlstelle (Artikel 1 i.V.m An-hang I Ziffer 3. Buchstabe B der Delegierten Verordnung (EU) Nr. 2022/127) und setzt nach BSI IT-Grundschutz die regelmäßige Durchführung von internen Audits und Sicherheitsrevisionen voraus. Eigene Personalressourcen und Kompetenzen zur Durchführung interner Audits stehen nicht zur Verfügung, weshalb sich gemäß Kapitel 8.3, BSI-Standard 200-1 dazu entschlossen wurde, die Durchführung der Prüfungen an externe Experten zu vergeben. Das zuvor bereits vergebene Vorhaben mit gleichem Projektinhalt läuft im Jahr 2026 aus, weshalb ein mehrjähriges Anschlussvorhaben vergeben wird, um eine kontinuierliche und langfristige interne Auditierung bis 2030 sicherzustellen. Gegenstand des Vorhabens sollen flexibel abrufbare Prüfungsleistungen für den Informationsverbund der EU-Zahlstelle sein, welcher aus den Organisationseinheiten des Ministeriums für Land- und Ernährungswirtschaft, Umwelt und Verbraucherschutz Brandenburg (MLEUV) und dem direkt nachgeordneten Landesamt für Ländliche Entwicklung, Landwirtschaft und Flurneuordnung (LELF) besteht, sowie den weiteren am Zahlstellenverfahren beteiligten Stellen (Landkreise, Landesforstbetrieb, Investitionsbank und technische Dienstleister), welche als Outsourcing-Partner bzw. die dorthin ausgelagerten Bestandteile, die wesentlichen Prüfgegenstände der Prüfungen darstellen sollen. Ausgehend von einer gemeinsam erstellten Prüfplanung sind voraussichtlich vier Prüfungen pro Jahr geplant. Das Vorhaben soll an nachweislich erfahrene Experten im Bereich der Informationssicherheitsrevision oder ISMS-Auditierung nach BSI IT-Grundschutz vergeben werden. Lot LOT-0001: Interne Audits und Sicherheitsrevisionen zur Aufrechterhaltung der Informationssicherheit der EU-Zahlstelle im MLEUV. Der Auftragsgegenstand umfasst die Planung und Durchführung interner Audits und Sicherheitsrevisionen für einen auf Basis von BSI IT-Grundschutz nach ISO 27001 zertifizierten Informationsverbund und dessen beteiligte Outsourcing-Partner. Der zu prüfende Informationsverbund "Operativer Betrieb der EU-Zahlstelle Brandenburg-Berlin" besteht aus den Organisationseinheiten des Ministeriums für Land- und Ernährungswirtschaft, Umwelt und Verbraucherschutz des Landes Brandenburg (MLEUV) und dem direkt nachgeordneten Landesamt für Ländliche Entwicklung, Landwirtschaft und Flurneuordnung (LELF), die die Fachaufgaben der Bewilligung, Kontrolle, Auszahlung, Verbuchung sowie Verwaltung der Außenstände von Fördergeldern des Europäischen Garantiefonds für die Landwirtschaft (EGFL), des Europäischen Landwirtschaftsfonds für die Entwicklung des ländlichen Raums (ELER) und des Europäischen Meeres-, Fischerei- und Aquakulturfonds (EMFAF) wahrnehmen, sowie den weiteren am Zahlstellenverfahren beteiligten Stellen (Landkreise, Landesforstbetrieb, Investitionsbank und technische Dienstleister), welche als Outsourcing-Partner behandelt werden. Die wesentlichen Prüfungshandlungen sind für die ausgelagerten Bestandteile des Informationsverbunds bei den Outsourcing-Partnern durchzuführen. Mit diesen Einrichtungen wurde eine Übertragung von Zahlstellenaufgaben auf Grundlage von Zuständigkeitsverordnungen, Überleitungsverordnungen oder andere Regelungen vereinbart. Die Outsourcing-Beziehungen werden auf Grundlage eines mit dem Bundesamt für Sicherheit in der Informationstechnik (kurz BSI) abgestimmten Bund-Länder-Schnittstellen-Modells für EU-Zahlstellen im Wesentlichen unterschieden in: 1. Organisatorische Schnittstellen (S-O): Einrichtungen, welche übertragene Aufgaben der Bewilligung und Kontrolle innerhalb der Geschäftsprozesse der Zahlstelle wahrnehmen und zur Aufgabenerfüllung zentrale Zahlstellen-Fachanwendungen innerhalb des Informationsverbundes nutzen, da sie selbst keine zentralen Zahlstellen-Fachanwendungen bereitstellen und keine spezifischen Anwendungsumgebungen betreiben. Dies betrifft in Brandenburg aktuell: - 14 Bewilligungsstellen (Ämter für Landwirtschaft) in den Landkreisen, - den Landesbetrieb Forst (LFB), - die Investitionsbank des Landes Brandenburg (ILB). 2. Technische Schnittstellen (S-T): Einrichtungen des technischen Betriebs der zentralen Zahlstelle-Fachanwendungen und Systeme sowie der Datenhaltung. Dies betrifft in Brandenburg aktuell: - den zentralen Brandenburgischen IT-Dienstleister (ZIT-BB), - die Landesvermessung und Geobasisinformation Brandenburg (LGB) - die init AG für den Betrieb eines Antragsverfahrens. Im Informationsverbund sind eine mittlere dreistellige Anzahl an Personen tätig. Jährlich werden mehrere Millionen Euro in dreistelliger Höhe an EU-, Bundes- und Landesmitteln verwaltet. Die Zahlstellen-Fachanwendungen umfassen im Wesentlichen Client/Server- und Webanwendungen, wofür eine die IT-Systemlandschaft bestehend aus Terminal-, Web-, Applikations- und Datenbankserver zum Einsatz kommt. Die Nutzung erfolgt für Verwaltungseinheiten mittels virtueller Clients über das Landesverwaltungsnetz des Landes Brandenburg. Antragsteller greifen auf die in einer demilitarisierten Zone (DMZ) betriebenen Onlineantragssysteme über das Internet zu. Der Aufragnehmer soll in Abstimmung mit dem Aufraggeber und auf Grundlage der Dokumentation des ISMS, eine mehrjährige Prüfplanung vornehmen und durchführen. Die Planung und Durchführung der Prüfungen erfolgt unter Beteiligung des Informationssicherheitsbeauftragen der EU-Zahlstelle. Ausgehend von Erfahrungswerten sind voraussichtlich pro Jahr vier Prüfungen bei jeweils unterschiedlichen Verfahrensbeteiligten durchzuführen, die flexibel aufrufbar sein sollen.

result.text: The subject of the contract is a research and development project for the investigation and further development of AI-supported methods for side-channel analysis of cryptographic implementations. The focus is in particular on post-quantum cryptographic procedures as well as, as a reference, symmetric procedures (e.g. AES) on microcontroller and FPGA platforms. The contractor shall set up a measurement/test environment, select or generate data sets (current/EM, where applicable multimodal) and investigate robust model architectures, trace compression, test-time tuning as well as suitable evaluation metrics and workflows for reproducible evaluations. Optionally, approaches for the auto-formalisation of selected security proofs are examined as examples. Deliverables include reports and presentations, executive summaries, a practice-oriented guide, data sets, source code as well as an extended software toolbox incl. installation instructions, user manual and a short quick-start tutorial. Lot LOT-0000: P 700 - AI Methods in Side-Channel Analysis II (KISKA II). The subject of the contract is a research and development project for the investigation and further development of AI-supported methods for side-channel analysis of cryptographic implementations. The contractor shall set up a measurement/test environment, select or generate data sets (current/EM, where applicable multimodal) and investigate robust model architectures, trace compression, test-time tuning as well as suitable evaluation metrics and workflows for reproducible evaluations. Optionally, approaches for the auto-formalisation of selected security proofs are examined as examples. Deliverables include reports and presentations, executive summaries, a practice-oriented guide, data sets, source code as well as an extended software toolbox incl. installation instructions, user manual and a short quick-start tutorial.

result.text: As part of a market survey, BGB-Gesellschaft der Rechtsanwaltskammern Berlin, Bremen, Düsseldorf, Frankfurt am Main, Hamburg, Hamm, Köln, München, Nürnberg, Sachsen und Stuttgart (hereinafter the Purchaser) wishes to enquire about current providers on the market and available solutions for a new management system. After completion of the market survey, the results will be evaluated for the next project steps and for a potentially intended procurement procedure. As part of the market survey, interested companies are invited to participate in discussions and present their solution portfolio. The procedure can be found in the following explanations. The subject of the market survey is the evaluation of possible solutions for a new management system. The sought-after management system should cover the following rough functional modules and exemplary use cases: 1. Personnel management o Management of natural and legal persons (different person types) o Manage training occupations o Manage trainees o Manage reference relationships between persons 2. Billing o Record and calculate membership fee data o Carry out membership fee billing o Create new fees/credits o Bill fees/credits o Manage outgoing invoice ledger 3. Complaint management / Case management o Create complaint/case o Manage complaint/case o Manage complaint/case overview 4. Archiving and deletion o Archive and delete data records o Search archived data records 5. Administration o Manage roles and permissions Participation in the market survey: 1. To participate in the market survey, we ask you to send us appointment proposals (approx. 1 hour) by email to florian.blauensteiner@reqpool.com or to markus.mycinski@reqpool.com by 26.09.2025 at 13:00. For appointment proposals received later, we cannot guarantee that participation is still possible. 2. During the appointment, we would like to talk about your solution portfolio. In addition, you can send us a presentation of your existing solution. The following three aspects are particularly important to us: • Price structure / licensing model • Expandability or possibility for software adjustments • Existing references 3. It is expressly emphasised that, beyond the publication of this preliminary information, companies will also be invited independently to participate in the market survey. This enables the implementation of a broad and transparent market survey and does not prevent other interested parties from participating in this market research. 4. The Purchaser reserves the right not to invite all companies to market survey discussions. In this case, there is the possibility to participate in the market survey in text form. Notes on the procedure: 1. The market survey discussions will be conducted in German. 2. There are no costs associated with your participation in this market survey. No costs will be reimbursed for your expenses incurred. 3. It is expressly pointed out that this is a preparatory market survey and not the award of a public contract. 4. The legal recourse to review bodies is not available within the framework of this procedure. 5. Participation in the market survey does not constitute a prerequisite for later participation in a possible procurement procedure. 6. The Purchaser reserves the right to change or adapt the performance requirements discussed in the market survey in a potentially later procurement procedure. 7. result.text: RVK is a modern transport company that has been under municipal ownership since 1996. The company was formed in 1976 from a merger of the railway and postal bus services. The transport area extends across the Rheinisch-Bergischer district, the left-bank Rhein-Sieg district, the Euskirchen district and the cities of Cologne, Bonn, Leverkusen, Hürth, Brühl and Wesseling. RVK thus connects urban conurbations with sparsely populated, more rural areas. With capacity, competence and many years of experience, RVK ensures that people in the region are on the move reliably and safely – and in an environmentally friendly, sustainable and innovative way. The RVK bus fleet comprises over 600 vehicles, some of which are operated by the company itself and some of which operate on behalf of RVK. The transport network comprises 132 lines with a total length of 2.595 km. In addition, 58 lines are operated by RVK for other transport companies. In total, RVK provides a mileage of approx. 22,6 million km with approx. 23 million passengers annually. Most of the RVK buses are already equipped with TFT interior displays. However, as not all buses have TFT monitors, RVK is procuring at least 100 additional 29 inch TFT interior displays (and up to a total of 350 TFT interior displays) for use in public transport vehicles via a framework agreement. result.text: The tender process comprises a contract for the contracting authority's procurement of the supply, implementation, operation, maintenance and support of an enterprise resource planning (ERP) system. The procurement of an enterprise resource planning system is part of the contracting authority's new strategy to create a greater degree of uniformity in the IT area across the contracting authority's organisation with a view to realising both financial and quality benefits. "Uniformity" does not mean that all units in the organisation must use identical solutions, but that IT decisions are made on the basis of common principles, procedures and guidelines. In this way, coherence, standardisation where possible, and flexibility where necessary are ensured. The purpose of procuring a new ERP system is thus to achieve a higher degree of standardisation and harmonisation of processes across the organisation. This is intended to ensure simpler workflows, reduced complexity and more cost-effective operation. The contracting authority wishes the new ERP system to offer modern technological capabilities, including support for machine learning (ML), artificial intelligence (AI) and other tools that can contribute to increased automation and decision support. Likewise, easy access to new functionality via ongoing upgrades is a central requirement, so that the organisation can quickly exploit new opportunities without extensive customisation. The ERP system must function as the central core of the organisation's transaction layer, where all significant data and processes are collected and handled. This is intended to ensure data consistency, transparency and support an integrated ecosystem of surrounding applications. The annual value of the contract is estimated at three (3) million DKK excl. VAT. In addition, there is a one-off implementation with an expected cost of three (3) million DKK excl. VAT. The duration of the contract is set at 10 years, which gives a total estimated contract value of 33 million DKK excl. VAT. The total volume is indicative only and based on historical data and can therefore not be considered a guarantee of future turnover.

parts.source: Udbudsprocessen omfatter en kontrakt til Ordregivers anskaffelse af levering, implementering, drift, vedligeholdelse og support af enterprise ressource planning (ERP) system. Anskaffelsen af et enterprise ressource planning system er et led i Ordregivers nye strategi om at skabe en større grad af ensartethed på it-området på tværs af Ordregivers organisation med henblik på at realisere både økonomiske og kvalitetsmæssige fordele. ”Ensartethed” betyder ikke, at alle enheder i organisationen skal anvende identiske løsninger, men at it-beslutninger træffes på baggrund af fælles principper, procedurer og retningslinjer. På den måde sikres sammenhæng, standardisering hvor det er muligt, og fleksibilitet hvor det er nødvendigt. Formålet med en anskaffelse af et nyt ERP-system er således at opnå en højere grad at standardisering og harmonisering af processer på tværs af organisationen. Dette skal sikre enklere arbejdsgange, reduceret kompleksitet og en mere omkostningseffektiv drift. Ordregiver ønsker, at det nye ERP-system tilbyder tidssvarende teknologiske muligheder, herunder understøttelse af maskinlæring (ML), kunstig intelligens (AI) og andre værktøjer, der kan bidrage til øget automatisering og beslutningsstøtte. Ligeledes er let adgang til ny funktionalitet via løbende opgraderinger et centralt ønske, så organisationen hurtigt kan udnytte nye muligheder uden omfattende tilpasninger. ERP-systemet skal fungere som den centrale kerne i organisationens transaktionslag, hvor alle væsentlige data og processer samles og håndteres. Dette skal sikre datakonsistens, transparens og understøtte et integreret økosystem af omkringliggende applikationer. Den årlige værdi af kontrakten er anslået til tre (3) millioner DKK ekskl. moms. Hertil kommer en engangsimplementering med en forventet omkostning på tre (3) millioner DKK ekskl. moms. Kontraktens varighed er sat til 10 år, hvilket giver en samlet estimeret kontraktværdi på 33 millioner DKK ekskl. moms. Den samlede volumen er alene vejledende og baseret på historiske data og kan derfor ikke betragtes som en garanti for fremtidig omsætning.

result.text: Background Many developing countries and emerging economies are negatively impacted by trade constraints resulting from red tape in the form of complicated customs documents, import surveillance and border procedures that lack transparency. High transaction costs make it difficult for them to tap into global value chains and make their businesses less competitive. Many enterprises are thereby denied opportunities to grow through trade. In 2017, the World Trade Organization"s (WTO) Trade Facilitation Agreement (TFA) entered into force with the objective to simplify, modernize and harmonize export and import processes in order to facilitate the cross-border movements of goods. It also establishes measures for effective cooperation between customs and other relevant authorities on trade facilitation and customs compliance. Additionally, it contains provisions for technical assistance and capacity building. Measures to facilitate trade play an important role across a variety of policy areas and sectors. They have a positive effect on food security, rural development, consumer protection, investment promotion and good governance among others. Project rationale The GIZ global program "Partnerships for Sustainable Trade" (PST) has been commissioned by the German Federal Ministry of Economic Cooperation and Development (BMZ) to establish measures that facilitate trade and support environment and climate protection. Its duration is from 07/2024 to 12/2027. The program focuses on implementing the Trade Facilitation Agreement of the World Trade Organization (WTO) and promotes cooperation between companies, business and trade associations as well as state institutions. As an implementation partner of the Global Alliance for Trade Facilitation (the Alliance), it aligns development objectives with economic interests. The Alliance supports low and middle-income countries in streamlining trade-related processes to move goods across their borders as quickly, safely, and cost-effectively as possible. The Alliance is an initiative that puts public private partnership at the heart of its approach to trade reform, believing that governments and businesses of all sizes working together represents the best way of delivering transformative, positive change. The Alliance is jointly hosted by the World Economic Forum, the International Chamber of Commerce and the Center for International Private Enterprise and works in cooperation with the Deutsche Gesellschaft für Internationale Zusammenarbeit (GIZ) GmbH. It is currently funded by the governments of Canada, Germany, Sweden, and the European Union (EU). Program measures include: - Planning and implementing trade facilitation measures in various countries in Africa, the Balkans, and Asia; - Increasing efficiency and reducing customs clearance costs by digitising processes and commercial documents; - Simplifying import and export procedures in developing and least developed countries (LDCs) through digital solutions and public-private partnerships; - Supporting developing countries in representing their interests in the multilateral trading system and in the WTO. The program is co-funded by different donors. At the beginning of 2025, the EU joined the Alliance as a new donor through co-funding the GIZ program. The EU contribution to the Alliance focusses on strengthening trade facilitation in least developed countries. Further co-financing comes from the World Trade Organisation (WTO) for the implementation of projects of the WTO Trade Facilitation Assistance Facility and by the EU Delegation to Madagascar for the implementation of an Alliance project in the country. Structure of the PST program The overall objective of the project is: In countries of the Global South, government, private actors or non-governmental organizations are equipped with improved instruments and competencies for the further development of the multilateral trading system for a Just Transition. The program is structured in 4 different Outputs: Output 1: Selected countries of the Global South are equipped with options for action for an inclusive, economic, and ecologically sustainable development of the multilateral trading system. Output 2: Proven trade facilitation instruments are embedded in selected countries of the Global South. Output 3: Innovative, climate and environmentally friendly approaches to trade facilitation have been further developed. Output 4: Trade facilitation instruments are embedded in selected LDCs. The project countries are specified in the Terms of Reference. The PST program seeks the services of a consulting firm to provide technical experts under different short-term expert (STE) pools, which can be deployed according to the project proposals and operational plans of each project country. The services will be delivered mainly by short-term experts in form of technical and administrative services for the development and implementation of specific trade facilitation measures in partner countries. The services also cover cross-cutting areas such as stakeholder engagement, workshop and training facilitation, and process management. Specifically, in the context of the respective in-country project workplans, the experts are foreseen to provide expertise in technical fields aimed at change management and capacity building of the respective identified border agencies.

result.text: The services to be delivered in the project countries include: - Conducting analyses and gap assessments on specific IT solutions or processes for Customs and other border agencies - Business process engineering of customs and logistics procedures - Technically oversee the implementation of IT solutions by IT solution providers - Support Customs and other partner agencies in developing and implementing change management plans - Developing and facilitating public-private dialogue formats - Developing training materials and conducting trainings (specifically train the trainer approaches) - Potentially, support for the scoping of Global Alliance for Trade Facilitation projects through fact finding missions and concept/proposal development[LL2.1]. Several new projects will be designed in the coming months. Potential countries for these new projects include Brazil, Cote d"Ivoire, Kenya, India, Indonesia, South Africa. Specifically, the following technical areas within respective work packages are covered through services provided by the STE pools: Work package 1. Customs modernisation and digitisation, including change management and process optimisation - Stabilizing and upgrading (ASYCUDA) and other customs management systems, - Reviewing customs management processes and drafting standard operating procedures (SOPs), - Supporting customs in piloting and rolling-out newly developed IT solutions or re-engineered processes; including specifically for airfreight and express clearance procedures. Work package 2. Support for specific Customs procedures - Improving customs workflows for tariff valuation and classification, fall-back and continuity procedures, - Development and roll-out of advance ruling systems. Work package 3. Risk management, including Authorised Economic Operator Schemes - Review existing risk management approaches, - Revision of selectivity rules, - Gap analysis of the policy and regulatory framework and on-the-ground implementation, - Development and proposal of improved risk management systems, approaches, or specific rules, adaptation or extension of existing approaches and systems to cover additional specialised cases, such as perishable goods, express shipments, or low value shipments, - Development and implementation of preferential schemes for trusted economic operators (Authorised economic operator schemes), - Pre-arrival processing of manifest information to trigger risk analysis, - Post Clearance Audits. Work package 4. Import and export permits/ certificates - Implementation of the IPPC ePhyto certification solution, - Development and implementation of processes / digital solutions for issuing (electronic) certificates for fish exports (eFish) as well as for animal products (eVet), - Digitisation of line Ministry agencies" import/export permit or certification processes (e.g. by Ministry of Agriculture, Bureau of Standards, Animal health board, etc.), - Process re-engineering, improvement of phytosanitary risk management systems, - Integration of the approvals/permits into the respective customs management systems and any other relevant platform (e.g. trade single windows), - Revision of workflows and processes. Since the focus of this tender lies on the provision of technical expertise through the mobilisation of short-term experts, the contractor is expected to implement rigorous processes for the selecting, preparing, training and steering the experts assigned to carry out the advisory services.

result.text: To map various ticketing processes, the State Office for Finance (LfF) requires a new ticketing system, which must be operated in the state-owned data centre of LDI (on-premise or in the rlp-Cloud). The new procedure is intended to replace the previously used SAP SOLUTION MANAGER 7.2 with the SP stack 20 - as of 11/2025 - and the previously used ticketing procedure Zammad. The new procedure is also intended to map tickets from other, non-SAP-based areas. The complete implementation of the new ticketing system (including the necessary connection to downstream systems, acceptance testing and multiplier training) is to take place by 31.07.2027. Productive use of the new ticketing system must therefore be ensured for all connected users (including users from other authorities in the federal state of Rhineland-Palatinate) from 01.08.2027 at the latest. Further details can be found in the attached procurement documents, in particular the specification of services, system environment and contract. Lot LOT-0001: Ticketing system. The subject of the procurement is the creation of the overall system described in the procurement documents, including the establishment of operational readiness by the contractor on the basis of a works contract, as well as system service and the further development of the overall system. The overall system consists of a client-specifically adapted, standard ticketing system software (on-premise or in the rlp-Cloud of LDI / rental) that meets the requirements of modern ticket processing by the client, including associated client-specifically created or adapted integrations into the client's IT system in accordance with the further regulations, in particular in accordance with the functional and technical specifications of the client, cf. specification of services. This includes, inter alia, the integration of the ticketing system software into the SAP landscape operated by the client, inter alia connection to transport management, the mapping of various evaluations and reports, the establishment of knowledge bases and migrations from various source systems. To produce the overall system, the software must, inter alia, be set up and configured, in particular user accounts created and data imported in accordance with the specification of services or system environment, the software connected via interfaces to various tools of the client, the required automation established, high interoperability with the named third-party systems established, tested, test instances set up and operated, and the onboarding process successfully completed, including interface integration with the third-party systems and training courses. Productive use after acceptance of the overall system must be contractually possible for all connected users of the client, cf. specification of services, by 01.08.2027. Further details can be found in the attached procurement documents, in particular the specification of services, system environment and contract.

parts.source: Zur Abbildung verschiedener Ticketprozesse benötigt das Landesamt für Finanzen (LfF) ein neues Ticketsystem, welches im landeseigenen Rechenzentrum des LDI betrieben werden muss (On Premise oder in der rlp-Cloud). Mit dem neuen Verfahren soll der bisher eingesetzte SAP SOLUTION MANAGER 7.2 mit dem SP Stack 20 -Stand 11/2025- und das bisher eingesetzte Ticketverfahren Zammad abgelöst werden. In das neue Verfahren sollen zudem auch Tickets aus anderen, nicht SAP-basierenden Bereichen abgebildet werden. Die vollständige Einführung des neuen Ticketsystems (einschließlich der notwendigen Anbindung an Folgesysteme, Abnahmetest und Multiplikatorenschulung) soll dabei bis zum 31.07.2027 erfolgt sein. Eine produktive Nutzung des neuen Ticketsystems muss somit für alle angebundenen Nutzer (auch Nutzer anderer Behörden im Land Rheinland-Pfalz) spätestens ab dem 01.08.2027 gegeben sein. Nähere Einzelheiten können Sie den beigefügten Vergabeunterlagen, insbesondere der Leistungsbeschreibung, Systemumgebung und Vertrag, entnehmen. Lot LOT-0001: Ticketsystem. Gegenstand der Beschaffung ist die Erstellung des in den Vergabeunterlagen beschriebenen Gesamtsystems, einschließlich der Herbeiführung der Betriebsbereitschaft durch den Auftragnehmer auf der Grundlage eines Werkvertrages und der Systemservice und die Weiterentwicklung des Gesamtsystems. Das Gesamtsystem besteht aus einer auftraggeberspezifisch angepassten marktüblichen Ticketsystemsoftware (On Premise bzw. in der rlp-Cloud des LDI /Miete), die den Anforderungen der modernen Ticketbearbeitung durch den Auftraggeber gerecht wird, inklusive zugehöriger auftraggeberspezifisch erstellter bzw. angepasster Integrationen in das IT-System des Auftraggebers gemäß den weiteren Regelungen, insbesondere gemäß den funktionellen und technischen Spezifikationen des Auftraggebers, vgl. Leistungsbeschreibung. Hierzu gehört u.a. die Integration der Ticketsystemsoftware in die vom Auftraggeber betriebene SAP-Landschaft, u.a. Anbindung an das Transportmanagement, die Abbildung verschiedener Auswertungen und Berichte, der Aufbau von Wissensdatenbanken und Migrationen aus verschiedenen Quellsystemen. Zur Herstellung des Gesamtsystems ist die Software u.a. einzurichten und zu konfigurieren, insbesondere Nutzer-Accounts anzulegen und Daten gemäß Leistungsbeschreibung bzw. Systemumgebung zu importieren, die Software über Schnittstellen an verschiedene Tools des Auftraggebers anzubinden, die geforderte Automatisierung herzustellen, eine hohe Interoperabilität mit den benannten Drittsystemen herzustellen, zu testen, Testinstanzen einzurichten und zu betreiben, den Onboarding-Prozess erfolgreich inkl. Schnittstellenintegration zu den Drittsystemen und Schulungen abzuschließen. Eine produktive Nutzung nach Abnahme des Gesamtsystems muss für alle angebundenen Nutzer des Auftraggebers, vgl. Leistungsbeschreibung, zum 01.08.2027 vertragsgemäß möglich sein. Nähere Einzelheiten können Sie den beigefügten Vergabeunterlagen, insbesondere Leistungsbeschreibung, Systemumgebung und Vertrag, entnehmen.

result.text: The Authority is seeking to appoint a suitably experienced and compliant Bidder to provide a secure, efficient and fully compliant electronic bulk ("e‐Bulk") solution for the end-to-end administration of DBS applications. The solution must support the Authority's Registered Body status and provide a fully hosted, cloud-based platform that enables the secure processing, tracking and management of DBS applications across multiple Council services and user groups. The Successful Provider must be an approved DBS e-Broker, authorised to submit applications on behalf of Registered Bodies. The Authority requires an accessible, bilingual in Welsh and English, compliant with Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WGAC) 2.2 AA accessibility standards, and capable of supporting multiple Council service areas and user roles. An optional Digital Identity Verification service may also be awarded as part of the contract, subject to the Authority's assessment of the Provider's data protection, information governance and security arrangements. The procurement process will be conducted in four (4) stages. Bidders must successfully meet the requirements of each stage before progressing to the next stage of evaluation. Where a stage is assessed on a pass/fail basis, bidders must achieve a "Pass" outcome in order to proceed. Where a stage is subject to scored evaluation, bidders must achieve the minimum threshold score specified within the tender documentation. Any bidder that fails a pass/fail requirement, receives a score below the minimum required threshold, or otherwise fails to satisfy the requirements of a stage, will be excluded from further consideration and their tender submission will not be evaluated in subsequent stages. The Council reserves the right to reject any tender that fails to meet the mandatory requirements of this procurement exercise. Full details can be found in the ITT.

parts.source: Tämä on kutsu markkinakartoitukseen ja toimittajien info-tilaisuuteen, ei hankintailmoitus tai tarjouspyyntö. Keski-Uudenmaan hyvinvointialue valmistelee dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän (DPS) perustamista tutkimus-, kehitys-, innovaatio- ja osaamisen kehittämisen toiminnan (TKIO) keskeiseksi osaksi ja hankinta-alustaksi. Tarkoituksena on jatkaa neljä vuotta sitten käynnistettyä toimintaa perustamalla hankintajärjestelmän uudelleen. Hankintajärjestelmän muodostaa hankintayksikön tutkimus-, kehittämis- ja innovaatiokumppanien sopimuksella säädellyn yhteistyömallin rakenteen. Se tuottaa tutkimustietoa, kehittämispalveluita ja innovaatioita tilaajan kehittämistoiminnan ja johtamisen perustaksi. Hankintajärjestelmän kohteena ovat: Innovaatiopalvelut Palvelujärjestelmien kehittäminen Hankepalvelut Strateginen kehittäminen Tiedeyhteisöt Lisäksi hankinnan kohteena ovat pilotointi- ja kokeilupalvelut sekä jatkuvan kehittämisen ja hallinnoinnin palvelut tilaajan käyttöön. Ensimmäiseksi hankintajärjestelmän sisäiseksi kilpailutukseksi on suunniteltu strategisen kehittämisen asiantuntijapalvelujen hankintaa. Hyvinvointialue kutsuu toimittajia mukaan markkinakartoitukseen hankintajärjestelmän valmisteluun ja ensimmäiseen sisäiseen kilpailutukseen liittyen. Info-tilaisuus hankintajärjestelmän perustamisesta ja ensimmäisestä sisäisestä kilpailutuksesta järjestetään: Aika: 6.10.2025 klo 14 - 15 Paikka: Videoyhteys Microsoft Teams-sovelluksella Ilmoittautuminen: 3.10.2025 klo 12 mennessä ilmoittautumislomakkeella. Ilmoittautumislomake löytyy ja ilmoittautumaan pääsee kopioimalla alla olevan linkin ja liittämällä sen selaimen hakukenttään: https://forms.office.com/pages/responsepage.aspx?id=zMQa0zMklUOHWD8aR-fN1lKrfd2M3JZEqmTZrGkxT_JUNVEwWDhTT0U5QVMxNlVKTzlWMklQRE03UC4u&route=shorturl Videoyhteyden linkki tilaisuuteen liittymistä varten ja mahdollinen ennakkomateriaali lähetetään ilmoittautuneille sähköpostitse ennen tilaisuutta. Hyvinvointialue toteuttaa markkinakartoitusta harkintansa mukaan myös muilla tavoin, kuten lähettämällä luonnosasiakirjoja toimittajien kommentoitavaksi ja erillisillä tapaamisilla. Asiakirjojen kommentointimahdollisuus tarjotaan kaikille infotilaisuuksiin ilmoittautuneille toimittajille, jotka ovat ilmoittautuneet ohjeiden mukaisesti. Hyvinvointialue valitsee osallistujat mahdollisiin erillisiin tapaamisin ilmoittautuneiden joukosta, toimittajien yhdenvertaisen ja tasapuolisen kohtelun vaatimukset huomioiden. Kiinnostuksen ilmaiseminen ja osallistuminen kartoitukseen ei sido toimittajaa osallistumishakemuksen jättämiseen tai tarjouskilpailuun osallistumiseen. Se ei myöskään ole edellytyksenä myöhemmin varsinaiseen tarjouskilpailuun osallistumiselle.

result.text: Our Workplace Innovation Leadership Academy supports the ongoing development of business leaders at all levels and stages of experience. The Leadership Academy delivers programmes under a framework agreement with multiple suppliers across the Scottish Enterprise area, the programme plays a key role in cultivating leadership capability and innovation within businesses. The current framework expires early April 2026 and we anticipate commencing a new procurement process in December 2025. To inform this process, we are seeking to engage with the market to better understand current capabilities and approaches to delivering high-impact leadership development. We welcome expressions of interest from suppliers who possess specialist knowledge, proven experience, and the capacity to deliver innovative and effective leadership programmes tailored to diverse business needs. The Workplace Innovation Leadership Development Framework will consist of a series of one-day workshops, one-to-one coaching sessions, and topic specific diagnostic tools, delivered over a period of 2 - 6 months, depending on the Lot. Delivery will follow a hybrid model, combining online and face-to-face formats to maximise accessibility and impact. The Framework will deliver programmes across the Scottish Enterprise area, responding to demand. Where appropriate, programmes may also be delivered in collaboration with other enterprise agencies across Scotland. Lot 1: Transformational Leadership Programme. A cohesive leadership programme designed for both emerging and established leaders, with consistent core themes and tailored content to reflect each group's unique needs and experiences. Lot 2: Innovating Leadership: AI, Data & Emerging Tech. To empower leaders to embed AI, data, and emerging tech into strategy, foster ethical leadership, and drive internal innovation in a tech-enabled world. Lot 3: Growth Through Risk & Ambition. To support leaders in evaluating growth strategies, embracing risk as a catalyst for innovation, and exploring strategic options like investment, mergers, and ESG-aligned finance. Encourages a culture of learning through experimentation. Lot 4: Leadership in Times of Geopolitical & Economic Volatility. Helps leaders build resilience, agility, change capability and foresight to lead through uncertainty, global disruption, and change—while staying focused on long-term sustainability and stakeholder trust.

result.text: Welcome to submit tenders for Migrationsverket. Migrationsverket hereby invites suppliers to submit tenders in this procurement of a contact centre. The procurement relates to a new contact centre platform (hereinafter referred to as the System). The System shall handle the answering of telephone calls and e-mail messages from the general public and manage the routing and follow-up of incoming cases (emails and incoming calls). The System shall provide functionality for Callback and a module for scheduling. Queue and individual statistics shall also be handled in the System. After the implementation of the System is completed, approximately 200 concurrent agents and 20 administrators are estimated to work in the System. Migrationsverket receives approximately 1 400 000 incoming calls and 400 000 emails per year in the current contact centre system. The System needs to be dimensioned to cope with the demand, which may vary over time. The System shall be hosted as a private cloud service. The core functions of the System – that is, the management of calls, e-mails and the scheduling module – shall be hosted in a server hall owned or exclusively rented by the supplier (or its subcontractor) and this shall have its physical location within the EU/EEA. The supplier shall have full technical and administrative control over the hardware, network and operating platform in the server hall. Migrationsverket will provide a separate service for encrypting free text in incoming e-mail messages before they reach the System. This encryption service shall be hosted locally by Migrationsverket. The technical design of the service is not yet fully defined, but will be developed in dialogue with the supplier during the implementation project. The System shall be able to handle e-mail flows where free text content is encrypted upon receipt and decrypted close to the client in the agent's web browser through a component provided by Migrationsverket. The supplier is not responsible for the development or operation of this encryption service, but shall ensure that the System is technically compatible with its mode of operation and supports secure handling of encrypted e-mail messages in accordance with the specification of requirements. Integrations with the Windows environment and Migrationsverket's telephony operator shall be included. In the procurement, the tenderer shall tender: A private cloud service that is complete and fulfils the mandatory requirements set out in the procurement and the evaluation requirements accepted by the supplier.An implementation project that includes planning, integrations, configuration of system settings, fine-tuning and testing of the System to a fully operational condition.The System shall be set up in a test and training environment, as well as a production environment.Integrations with Migrationsverket's system, which appear in the Specification of Requirements.Necessary documentation for the implementation of integration(s).Documentation.Training.Option regarding, inter alia, a screen sharing function (co-browsing) and chat functionConsultancy services in connection with the System.Services for support, fault clearance and further development of the System

parts.source: Välkomna att lämna anbud till Migrationsverket. Migrationsverket bjuder härmed in leverantörer att lämna anbud i denna upphandling av kontaktcenter. Upphandlingen avser en ny kontaktcenterplattform (vidare kallad Systemet). Systemet ska hantera besvarande av telefonsamtal och e-postmeddelanden från allmänheten och hantera styrning och uppföljning av inkomna ärenden (mail och inkomna samtal). Systemet ska tillhandahålla funktionalitet för Callback och en modul för schemaläggning. Kö- och individstatistik ska också hanteras i Systemet. Efter att införandet av Systemet är genomfört beräknas cirka 200 samtidiga Agenter och 20 Administratörer arbeta i Systemet. Migrationsverket tar emot cirka 1 400 000 inkommande samtal och 400 000 mail per år i nuvarande kontaktcentersystem. Systemet behöver vara dimensionerat för att klara av efterfrågan, som kan variera över tid. Systemet ska driftas som privat molntjänst. Systemets kärnfunktioner – det vill säga hantering av samtal, e-post och schemaläggningsmodul – ska driftas i en serverhall som ägs eller exklusivt hyrs av leverantören (eller dess underleverantör) och denna ska ha sin fysiska placering inom EU/EES. Leverantören ska ha full tekniskt och administrativ kontroll över hårdvara, nät och driftplattform i serverhallen. Migrationsverket kommer att tillhandahålla en separat tjänst för kryptering av fritext i inkommande e-postmeddelanden innan dessa når Systemet. Denna krypteringstjänst ska driftas lokalt av Migrationsverket. Den tekniska utformningen av tjänsten är ännu inte fullt definierad, utan kommer att utvecklas i dialog med leverantören under införandeprojektet. Systemet ska kunna hantera e-postflöden där fritextinnehåll är krypterat vid mottagande och dekrypteras klientnära i Agentens webbläsare genom en komponent som tillhandahålls av Migrationsverket. Leverantören ansvarar inte för utveckling eller drift av denna krypteringstjänst, men ska säkerställa att Systemet är tekniskt kompatibelt med dess funktionssätt och stödjer säker hantering av krypterade e-postmeddelanden i enlighet med kravspecifikationen. Integrationer mot Windowsmiljön och Migrationsverkets telefonioperatör ska ingå. Anbudsgivaren ska i upphandlingen offerera: Privat molntjänst som är komplett och uppfyller de i upphandlingen uppställda obligatoriska kraven och de utvärderingskrav som Leverantören accepterat.Införandeprojekt som inkluderar planering, Integrationer, Konfigurering av systeminställningar, intrimning och testning av Systemet till fullt driftfärdigt skick.Systemet ska bli uppsatt i en test- och utbildningsmiljö, samt produktionsmiljö.Integrationer mot Migrationsverkets System, vilka framgår av Kravspecifikationen.Nödvändig dokumentation för genomförande av Integration/er.Dokumentation.Utbildning.Option om bl.a. skärmspeglingsfunktion (co-browsing) och chattfunktionKonsulttjänster i anknytning till Systemet.Tjänster för support, felrättning och vidareutveckling av Systemet

result.text: The NHS Counter Fraud Authority (NHSCFA) is a health authority charged with identifying, investigating and preventing fraud and other economic crime within the NHS and the wider health group. As a health authority focused entirely on counter fraud work, the NHSCFA is independent from other NHS bodies and directly accountable to the Department of Health and Social Care (DHSC). THE NHSCFA currently operate two separate systems for the provision of an intelligence database and a case management system. The intention is to identify if there is a single solution that can replace the existing systems. If that is not possible then the aim would be to have two separate products that connect and align with each other to avoid duplication and operational inefficiencies. This market engagement exercise seeks the views and opinions of those organisations that may be interested in delivering the requirements. The scope of this market engagement covers is provided within the draft service specification. This exercise and any subsequent responses are in no way legally binding on any party. Participation in the engagement exercise is not a mandatory requirement for participating in any potential future procurement; however, responses received will assist to inform the Contracting Authority as to the level of interest from the market and will be used to evidence a decision as to whether or not to undertake a competitive procurement. The Market Engagement Questionnaire and current Service Specifications can be downloaded from SAP Ariba Portal at the below link: https://discovery.ariba.com/rfx/23496944 Please return your completed MEQ through the Portal no later than 5pm on 30 October 2025.

result.text: The Rheumazentrum Mittelhessen has decided to tender for a complete hospital information system for the site, which fulfils the KHZG funding requirements 3- 6 and which, furthermore, maps all administrative and clinical processes of an acute, AHB and (DRV) rehabilitation clinic. At the site in Bad Endbach, an acute clinic with 80 beds and an Anschlussheilbehandlung (AHB) and rehabilitation clinic with 36 beds are available for the holistic therapy of acute and chronic rheumatic diseases. The clinic complex also includes two practices with medical rheumatology consultations and an outpatient therapy facility for physiotherapy, physical therapy and occupational therapy. Over the years, the clinic area has been constantly modernised and the infrastructure expanded. The Rheumazentrum Mittelhessen has decided to tender for a complete hospital information system for the site, which fulfils the KHZG funding requirements 3- 6 and which, furthermore, maps all administrative and clinical processes of an acute, AHB and (DRV) rehabilitation clinic. The future HIS is to be set up in such a way that it is the patient-leading system in interaction with other subsystems/modules. The HIS is to be introduced on the basis of a "best practice" approach within the framework of joint project work. The contractor is accordingly expected to provide a consultative and optimising process approach within the framework of the software implementation. The software to be supplied must have the capabilities and instruments that, for example, enable users to manage the patient's treatment progress as efficiently as possible, as well as to document and bill services quickly, in a revenue-secure manner and in compliance with the KHZG (FTB 3-6). The providers are therefore requested to submit a tender for a complete KHZG-compliant HIS including all necessary services for implementation and maintenance/service, which fulfils the mandatory criteria of the KHZG funding requirements 2 - 6 (the mandatory criteria for the admission and treatment management of the FTB 2 are fulfilled via the portal solution of the company Samedi, the discharge and transfer management via the solution of the company Verbund Pflegehilfe (see "Interfaces" tab of Annex 1), the contractor only owes the connection in this area in accordance with the technical requirements and interoperability standards of the KHZG). The new HIS is intended to significantly support the digitalisation and efficiency of hospital processes and thus optimise patient care.

parts.source: Das Rheumazentrum Mittelhessen hat sich entschieden, ein komplettes Kranken-hausinformationssystem für den Standort auszuschreiben, welches die KHZG-Fördertatbestände 3- 6 erfüllt und welches darüber hinaus alle administrativen und klinischen Prozesse einer Akut-, AHB- und (DRV-) Rehaklinik abbildet. An dem Standort in Bad Endbach stehen zur ganzheitlichen Therapie akuter und chronischer rheumatischer Erkrankungen eine Akutklinik mit 80 Betten und eine An-schlussheilbehandlungs- (AHB) und Rehabilitationsklinik mit 36 Betten zur Verfü-gung. Zum Klinikkomplex gehören außerdem zwei Praxen mit ärztlicher Rheuma-sprechstunde und eine ambulante Therapieeinrichtung für Physiotherapie, physikali-sche Therapien und Ergotherapie. Im Laufe der Jahre wurde der Klinikbereich stän-dig modernisiert und die Infrastruktur ausgebaut. Das Rheumazentrum Mittelhessen hat sich entschieden, ein komplettes Kranken-hausinformationssystem für den Standort auszuschreiben, welches die KHZG-Fördertatbestände 3- 6 erfüllt und welches darüber hinaus alle administrativen und klinischen Prozesse einer Akut-, AHB- und (DRV-) Rehaklinik abbildet. Das künftige KIS ist dahingehend aufzusetzen, dass es im Zusammenspiel mit weiteren Subsys-temen/ Modulen das patientenführende System ist. Das KIS soll auf Basis eines "Best-Practice"-Ansatzes im Rahmen einer gemeinsamen Projektarbeit eingeführt werden. Vom Auftragnehmer wird entsprechend ein beratender und optimierender Prozessansatz im Rahmen der Softwareimplementierung erwartet. Die zu liefernde Software muss über die Möglichkeiten und Instrumente verfügen, die z.B. die Anwen-der in den Stand versetzen, den Behandlungsverlauf des Patienten so effizient wie möglich zu steuern, sowie die Leistungen schnell, erlössicher und KHZG-konform (FTB 3-6) zu dokumentieren und abzurechnen. Die Anbieter werden daher gebeten, ein Angebot über ein komplettes KHZG-konformes KIS inklusive aller notwendigen Dienstleistungen zur Implementierung und zur Wartung/ Service abzugeben, welches die Muss-Kriterien der KHZG-Fördertatbestände 2 - 6 erfüllt (die Muss-Kriterien für das Aufnahme- und Behandlungsmanagement des FTB 2 werden über die Portallö-sung der Fa. Samedi, das Entlass- und Überleitungsmanagement über die Lösung der Fa. Verbund Pflegehilfe erfüllt (s. Reiter "Schnittstellen" der Anlage 1), der Auf-tragnehmer schuldet in diesem Bereich entsprechend nur die Anbindung gemäß technischer Anforderungen und Interoperabilitätsstandards des KHZG). Das neue KIS soll die Digitalisierung und Effizienz der Krankenhausprozesse maßgeblich un-terstützen und damit die Patientenversorgung optimieren.

result.text: The subject matter of the procurement includes the provision of the required software licences, the central administration of the host systems, the support of high-availability functions and the support service for integration into the existing IT infrastructure. Lot LOT-0001: VMware Subscriptions. The aim of the procurement is to ensure the support-capable, highly available and licence-compliant continued operation of the existing virtualisation infrastructure as well as to obtain accompanying integration support. By providing modern VMware infrastructure components, specifically VMware vSphere Foundation (VVF), as well as commissioning specialist services, a stable, economical and future-proof further development of the central operating platform is guaranteed. In addition to the provision of the required software licences, this comprises in particular ensuring the central administration of all host systems as well as the continuous maintenance of mission-critical high-availability functions for the server infrastructures.

parts.source: Der Beschaffungsgegenstand beinhaltet die Bereitstellung der erforderlichen Softwarelizenzen, die zentrale Verwaltung der Hostsysteme, die Unterstützung von Hochverfügbarkeitsfunktionen und die Unterstützungsleistung für die Integration in die bestehende IT-Infrastruktur. Lot LOT-0001: VMware Subscriptions. Ziel der Beschaffung ist die Sicherstellung des supportfähigen, hochverfügbaren und lizenzkonformen Weiterbetriebs der bestehenden Virtualisierungsinfrastruktur sowie die Einholung begleitender Integrationsunterstützung. Durch die Bereitstellung moderner VMware-Infrastrukturkomponenten, konkret der VMware vSphere Foundation (VVF), sowie die Beauftragung fachspezifischer Dienstleistungen wird eine stabile, wirtschaftliche und zukunftssichere Weiterentwicklung der zentralen Betriebsplattform gewährleistet. Dies umfasst neben der Bereitstellung der erforderlichen Softwarelizenzen insbesondere die Sicherstellung der zentralen Verwaltung aller Hostsysteme sowie die durchgängige Aufrechterhaltung geschäftskritischer Hochverfügbarkeitsfunktionen für die Serverinfrastrukturen.

result.text: Further to the UK1 Pipeline Notice published on 19th November 2025 by BlueLight Commercial Limited (ref: 2025/S 000-077692) in relation to a Victim & Citizen Engagement Technology Solution which will be used by UK law enforcement agencies, this UK2 Preliminary Market Engagement Notice is issued to inform the market of a potential future opportunity. This Pre-Market Engagement Notice is issued solely for the purposes of information gathering and engagement with the market. It does not constitute a call for competition and create any obligation on the Authority to proceed with a procurement exercise, or enter into any commercial arrangement. Please note the procurement route and anticipated publication date for this opportunity are yet to be determined. These elements will be confirmed following completion of the market engagement process and development of the Authority’s commercial strategy. Any future procurement will be subject to separate formal notice and the publication of full procurement documentation via the Find a Tender Service (FTS). BlueLight Commercial Limited (BLC) are conducting Preliminary Market Engagement to gain a better understanding of the market, supplier appetite, capacity, and capability, as well as perceived risks and opportunities. Any learnings will be used to formulate the associated procurement strategy. BLC work in collaboration with blue light organisations to maximise commercial benefit to UK emergency services. The focus of this solution will be improving Victim & Citizen Engagement, building trust and confidence, reducing demand within control rooms, and reducing the costs of serving the public by using innovative software to keep both victims and citizens more engaged. The aim is to ensure all forces have access to the most effective, reliable, and innovative solutions available in the market. This Solution needs to facilitate the force contact engagement from first contact with a police force to final closure of the contact, and via integration with police systems, e.g. Command and Control, Records Management Systems providing contact and updates throughout the journey without the need to call the force contact centre. It seeks to further drive standardisation and consistency, whilst helping forces to develop capability and invest in technology which will not only improve the service at first point of contact but will improve the overall contact experience. This Solution must facilitate Victim & Citizen engagement to reduce failure demand whilst proactively engaging to ensure high levels of customer (internal and external) trust and confidence. The delivery of the desired solution may be considered to follow the same customer service path as an online application or ordering process. For example, acknowledgement of the initial contact, time appropriate follow up contacts at defined points within the communication journey, and a closure contact at the end of the process. All communication will be auditable and align with the Victims code as appropriate. We are looking for solutions that can meet individual force needs and achieve the following: *Improve experience of members of the public accessing the policing service *Provide the public with consistent updates in a timely manner, *Improve public trust, confidence, and satisfaction, *Reduce Contact Management demand, *Improve force's overall Contact Management performance. Lot 1: .

result.text: With this RFI Yle invites interested suppliers to participate in the market dialogue held prior publishing the call for tenders (RFQ). Supplier should provide real-time HTML5 based graphics solutions in following areas: A) On screen, i.e. “lower third” graphics B) Full screen graphics C) Background videowall graphics D) Graphics controller In this RFI, Yle is not looking for augmented reality or virtual reality production solutions, otherwise known as AR, XR or VR systems. Parts A, B, C, and D can be offered as a single solution or independently of each other. This means, Yle is not necessarily looking for a company-wide solution; a solution for a single part (A,B,C,D) may turn out to be a reasonable solution. If not all parts are offered, a recommendation of compatible other solutions / products that fill in the missing parts is required. The offered solution for parts A, B, C, or D should be capable of serving Yle’s production environment. The entirety of it consists of 12 tv studios, 3 OB trucks, 1 playout centre and roughly dozen cloud live streaming units. Current graphic device count is roughly 200 devices, 50 real-time rendering servers and 6 non linear editing (NLE) rendering servers. Content filling clients have around 1300 installations. In this RFI, Yle is looking to identify the solutions available in the market that could meet Yle’s needs. In the RFI process, Yle may schedule meetings with a few chosen suppliers. If possible, setting up a hands-on test environment with key features of the system, would be helpful for better understanding. Please find the list of basic components for each part A-D as well as the detailed description of the object of the procurement in the document "RFI - Real-time HTML5 Graphics System". You can find the document in tender portal (https://tarjouspalvelu.fi/yleisradiooy?id=585018&tpk=7d09db49-a4a7-443a-9948-ce0fb71ab59f) or contacting tarjoukset.yle(at)yle.fi. Kindly note that in this RFI, Yle has specified the need for real-time graphic system(s), as previously described in the RFI for Real-time Graphics Systems. INTERESTED? Interested suppliers are invited to take part in the market dialogue by sending a request to participate by email to tarjoukset.yle(at)yle.fi at latest by 5th of December 2025. In case you have any questions, please don’t hesitate to contact us. Please include a description or additional appendices covering the following topics in your email: 1) Description of the solution you provide, including a description of which key features are included in your solution 2) A short company presentation, including the size of the company in terms of revenue and number of employees. 3) Your previous experience and few appropriate reference cases. 4) Reference architecture view 5) Description of your licence and pricing model 6) Description of your cyber security policies and continuity planning 7) Description of your GDPR policies We look forward to your replies. We will review the answers as soon as they are received. In case Yle decides to have meetings or short discussions with a few suppliers, we’ll thrive to send the invitations during January 2026 at the latest. The agenda will focus on how your solution could fit our needs.

result.text: The Deutsche Nationalbibliothek has the statutory mandate to collect its holdings both physically and digitally and to make them available to the general public. In order to fulfil the associated tasks and objectives as efficiently and purposefully as possible, an enterprise architecture optimally aligned with business skills is required. The diversity and scope of the tasks necessitate an extensive and complex business, information and technology architecture. In order to make strategic decisions on a sound basis, the Deutsche Nationalbibliothek requires an IT system for the management, maintenance and flexible evaluation of the data underlying the enterprise architecture. The procurement procedure includes the procurement of an Enterprise Architecture Management System (EAM)

parts.source: Die Deutsche Nationalbibliothek hat den gesetzlichen Auftrag, ihre Bestände sowohl physisch als auch digital zu sammeln und der breiten Öffentlichkeit verfügbar zu machen. Um die hiermit verbundenen Aufgaben und Ziel möglichst effizient und zielgerichtet zu erfüllen bedarf es einer auf die Geschäftsfertigkeiten optimal ausgerichtet Unternehmensarchitektur. Die Vielfältigkeit und der Umfang der Aufgaben bedingen eine umfangreiche und komplexe Geschäfts-, Informations- und Technologiearchitektur. Um strategische Entscheidungen auf einer fundierten Grundlage zu treffen, benötigt die Deutsche Nationalbibliothek ein IT-System zur Verwaltung, Pflege und flexiblen Auswertung der der Unternehmensarchitektur zugrundeliegenden Daten. Das Vergabeverfahren umfasst die Beschaffung eines Enterprise Architecture Management Systems (EAM)

result.text: The subject of the procurement is an appointment booking and video conferencing system (hereinafter also the "System") for use by the City of Mikkeli's customer services. The System to be procured must enable the management of customer service appointments for the City of Mikkeli's employment services and customer meetings via video conferencing through a single system. The objective is to procure a SaaS ready-made solution that is easy to use, meets data protection and other legislative requirements, and can be implemented on a rapid schedule. The procurement seeks a comprehensive appointment booking and video conferencing system as a ready-made solution that offers pre-built functions for managing appointments and conducting video conferences. A ready-made solution refers to a finished end product that can be configured for the Subscriber's use without the procurement involving the development of a completely bespoke system. In the initial phase, the System will be for the use of the City of Mikkeli's employment services. Later, the City of Mikkeli must have the option to expand the use of the System to other units. The procurement seeks one (1) party with overall responsibility to supply the System as a SaaS service. The overall service must include the necessary software interfaces, programs, firmware, licences, and maintenance and support services in accordance with the call for tenders and its appendices. The contract period is estimated to begin in November 2026 and the contract is valid until further notice.

parts.source: Hankinnan kohteena on ajanvaraus- ja videoneuvottelujärjestelmä (myöhemmin myös ”Järjestelmä”) Mikkelin kaupungin asiakaspalveluiden käyttöön. Hankittavan Järjestelmän tulee mahdollistaa Mikkelin kaupungin työllisyyspalveluiden asiakaspalvelun ajanvarauksien hallinnan ja asiakastapaamiset videoneuvotteluna yhden järjestelmän kautta. Tavoitteena on hankkia SaaS valmisratkaisuna helppokäyttöinen, tietosuoja- ja muun lainsäädännön vaatimukset täyttävä kokonaisratkaisu, joka voidaan ottaa käyttöön nopeassa aikataulussa. Hankinnassa tavoitellaan kattavaa ajanvaraus- ja videoneuvottelujärjestelmää valmisratkaisuna, joka tarjoaa valmiit toiminnot ajanvarausten hallintaan ja videoneuvotteluiden toteuttamiseen. Valmisratkaisulla tarkoitetaan valmista päätuotetta, jota voidaan konfiguroida Tilaajan käyttöön ilman, että hankinnan kohteena on kokonaan räätälöidyn järjestelmän kehittäminen. Ensivaiheessa Järjestelmä tulee Mikkelin kaupungin työllisyyspalveluiden käyttöön. Myöhemmin Mikkelin kaupungilla tulee olla mahdollisuus laajentaa Järjestelmän käyttöä muihin yksiköihin. Hankinnalla haetaan yhtä (1) kokonaisvastuullista toimittajaa toimittamaan Järjestelmä SaaS palveluna. Kokonaispalvelun tulee sisältää tarvittavat käyttöliittymät, ohjelmat, varusohjelmistot, lisenssit ja ylläpito- tukipalvelut tarjouspyynnön ja sen liitteiden mukaisesti. Sopimuskauden on arvioitu alkavan marraskuussa 2026 ja sopimus on toistaiseksi voimassa oleva.

result.text: Scotland has the highest drug and alcohol related death rates in the UK and Europe. People with substance use issues (PWSUI) often need help outside normal 'office' hours or from a distance from offices, and support is not uniformly available throughout Scotland. The support landscape in Scotland is fragmented, hard to navigate, and varies by locality. When support isn’t readily available (or isn’t trusted), people and their families and friends often default to emergency services or remain unsupported. As a result, those who use substances often experience avoidable crisis escalation, or remain in extremely difficult situations, and support services miss opportunities for early, harm-reducing interventions. The Preventing Harm, Promoting Recovery: Scotland’s Alcohol & Drugs Strategic Plan 2026 – 2035 specifically addresses the crucial need to tackle early intervention and widen an individual’s ‘circle of support’. This ‘circle of support’ is at the heart of this Challenge, and a successful solution would enable people to access the right support sooner, regardless of locality. It should harness the power of existing trusted services, family and community to reduce avoidable demand on emergency and NHS services – and if possible, create a ‘feedback loop’ of learning, intelligence and insight so that the overall issue can be tackled in a continually improving manner.
