result.text: Verkehrsgesellschaft Landkreis Gifhorn mbH (VLG) intends to gradually convert its bus fleet to electromobility within the framework of the requirements of the Clean Vehicles Procurement Act. For this purpose, electric buses and the charging infrastructure required for their operation are to be procured and integrated into operational processes. VLG plans to initially provide charging infrastructure for initially 11 vehicles by the year 2027. A charging and load management system is to be introduced for the centralised control and monitoring of charging processes, for limiting grid load as well as for supporting operational vehicle dispatching and vehicle stabling. With the introduction of electromobility, additional requirements arise for the planning and control of vehicle deployment, charging processes and available electrical power. Vehicle availability, battery charge state, energy demand, planned departure times, charging point occupancy and available grid capacity must in future be brought together and taken into account in a system-supported manner. The initial expansion stage comprises the charging infrastructure for 11 vehicles. The exact number and design of the charging points, their technical properties as well as the operational systems and data sources to be integrated are described in a binding manner in the quantity framework, in the interface descriptions and in the appendices to this specification. The increasing requirements in the course of the progressive electrification of the bus fleet as well as the expansion of the charging infrastructure require a high-performance charging, load and energy management system. With the introduction of an LMS, charging processes are to be controlled taking into account the boundary conditions from charging infrastructure, vehicle data, battery charge states and range requirements. The LMS must control the charging processes in such a way that the charge states required for the planned vehicle deployment are reached in good time. The charging infrastructure is to be integrated into the LMS so that the status of the charging units can be centrally monitored and controlled.

parts.source: Die Verkehrsgesellschaft Landkreis Gifhorn mbH (VLG) beabsichtigt, ihre Busflotte im Rahmen der Anforderungen des Saubere-Fahrzeuge-Beschaffungs-Gesetzes schrittweise auf Elektromobilität umzustellen. Hierzu sollen Elektrobusse sowie die für deren Betrieb erforderliche Ladeinfrastruktur beschafft und in die betrieblichen Abläufe integriert werden. Die VLG plant, bis zum Jahr 2027 zunächst Ladeinfrastruktur für zunächst 11 Fahrzeuge bereitzustellen. Zur zentralen Steuerung und Überwachung der Ladevorgänge, zur Begrenzung der Netzlast sowie zur Unterstützung der betrieblichen Fahrzeugdisposition und Fahrzeugaufstellung soll ein Lade- und Lastmanagementsystem eingeführt werden. Mit der Einführung der Elektromobilität entstehen zusätzliche Anforderungen an die Planung und Steuerung des Fahrzeugeinsatzes, der Ladevorgänge und der verfügbaren elektrischen Leistung. Fahrzeugverfügbarkeit, Batterieladezustand, Energiebedarf, geplante Abfahrtszeiten, Ladepunktbelegung und verfügbare Netzleistung müssen zukünftig systemgestützt zusammengeführt und berücksichtigt werden. Das initiale Ausbaustadium umfasst die Ladeinfrastruktur für 11 Fahrzeuge. Die genaue Anzahl und Ausprägung der Ladepunkte, deren technische Eigenschaften sowie die einzubindenden betrieblichen Systeme und Datenquellen werden im Mengengerüst, in den Schnittstellenbeschreibungen und in den Anlagen zu diesem Lastenheft verbindlich beschrieben. Die steigenden Anforderungen im Zuge der fortschreitenden Elektrifizierung der Busflotte sowie der Ausbau der Ladeinfrastruktur erfordern ein leistungsfähiges Lade-, Last- und Energiemanagement. Mit der Einführung eines LMS sollen die Ladeprozesse unter Berücksichtigung der Randbedingungen aus Ladeinfrastruktur, Fahrzeugdaten, Batterieladezuständen und Reichweitenanforderungen gesteuert werden. Das LMS muss die Ladevorgänge so steuern, dass die für den geplanten Fahrzeugeinsatz erforderlichen Ladezustände rechtzeitig erreicht werden. Die Ladeinfrastruktur ist in das LMS zu integrieren, sodass der Status der Ladeeinheiten zentral überwacht und gesteuert werden kann.

rejected.text: Consultants from COWI are currently conducting a feasibility study for Sporveien in Oslo. The purpose of this study is to define technology-independent and supplier-independent functional requirements for the future signalling system of the Oslo tram network, which consists of more than 130km of tracks with almost 100 stopping points. The tram infrastructure in Oslo has a history stretching back over 150 years, and has recently seen significant investment in modern rolling stock. This provides a unique opportunity to assess future solutions for a modern signalling system, and Sporveien has expressed a desire to invest in a future signalling system for the trams. As part of this project, we wish to gather information from suppliers of signalling and light rail systems. We therefore invite relevant suppliers to share information about your solutions, technologies, and experiences. We are particularly interested in systems that support safe, modern operation and that are adaptable to both the current and future needs of the Oslo tram network. Additionally, Sporveien AS and COWI AS are planning a dialogue conference with suppliers in Oslo on November 13th. This conference will provide an opportunity to discuss future collaborations and explore new opportunities for growth and development. We hope to see you at this conference. Once we have established contact with your organisation and received your company’s contact information we will send you a letter of invitation with the complete agenda. Please see https://www.sporveien.no/for-leverandorer/trikkens-fremtidige-signalsystem/dialogue-conference/ for more information.

result.text: South Lanarkshire Council seeks a Creative Consultancy to deliver a Market Assessment, Branding Strategy, Website Development, Content Library and Wayfinding Strategy for the Douglas Valley Outdoor Recreation and Adventure Tourism initiative within the Hagshaw Energy Cluster. 1. Market Assessment Review existing project documentation and identify implications for branding, marketing and website development. Analyse visitor data, market trends and audience segmentation, including visitor case studies. Benchmark comparable projects and destinations. Provide recommendations to inform branding, website design, content and future marketing activity. 2. Branding Development Develop and consult on three branding concepts before producing a final identity. Create brand assets including logo, name, tagline, colours, fonts and digital/print applications. Produce brand guidelines covering signage, interpretation, promotional materials and integration with existing site branding. Include recommendations for social media and future marketing activity. 3. Website Design, Build and Launch Create a branded website promoting Douglas Valley as a destination to live, work, visit and enjoy, supporting ambitions to attract up to 100,000 annual visits by 2036. Develop a scalable, content-led website with a planned lifespan of ten years. Include six core pages: Home, About, Explore, See & Stay, News and Contact. The Explore section will feature an interactive map highlighting key recreational and active travel routes, points of interest and route information including distance, elevation, difficulty and duration. Build the site on an accessible CMS suitable for community and council users. Host on a secure UK-based platform with maintenance and support arrangements. Ensure accessibility compliance and provide flexible management of route information and temporary diversions. 4. Photography and Video Library Establish a copyright-cleared library of photography and short-form video content for web, social media and print use. Source content through community engagement, youth-focused workshops and professional photography where required. Content will reflect identified visitor segments and feature strong people-focused imagery. Coverage will include renewable energy, local communities, nature, heritage and identity, local economy and outdoor recreation. Key locations include Coalburn, Douglas, Glenbuck, Glespin, Lesmahagow, Mainshill, Muirkirk, Poneil, Rigside, Douglas Water and Spireslack, alongside significant natural, heritage and recreation assets. 5. Wayfinding Strategy and Design Guidance Develop a first-phase wayfinding strategy focused on Coalburn, Douglas, Glespin, Douglasdale Community Woodland and connecting active travel routes. Establish a hierarchy of signage including gateway signs, orientation panels, interpretation boards, directional signage and waymarkers. Produce a spatial strategy identifying suitable signage locations. Develop design guidance covering dimensions, materials, specification, siting and future rollout. Prepare detailed proposals for priority installations to support future procurement. Work with Community Action Lanarkshire on implementation of information signs, directional signage and waymarkers along the NCN-Coalburn-Douglas route. Ensure all strategy, design and implementation follow inclusive design principles. Lot 1: . result.text: Rentenbank intends to procure Microsoft licences. With this procurement procedure, Rentenbank is seeking a contractor to procure these licences as a Licensing Solution Partner (LSP) and Enterprise Software Advisor (ESA) and to provide accompanying services. Rentenbank currently uses licence packages including services, the contract term of which ends on 31.01.2027. Rentenbank aims to replace these licences with new licences with a uniform term. The desired contract term is 48 months starting from 01.02.2027. Rentenbank reserves the right to terminate the concluded contract with a unilateral (by the client) termination option after 36 months.

result.text: The Contracting Authority is tendering a contract regarding a common Operating Platform for the Contracting Authority's IT system portfolio. After Transition In, where the Support Systems are transitioned to the Operating Platform, the Supplier shall be responsible for operation, including Data Centre operation/Hybrid Cloud Custom Services/Hybrid Cloud Standard Services and Infrastructure operation, as well as Support and maintenance of the Operating Platform. Furthermore, after Transition In, the Supplier must ensure Subsequent Transitions to and Transformations of the Operating Platform. The purpose of the common Operating Platform is, among other things, to obtain secure and stable operation with high availability as well as a modern technological platform with a high degree of scalability that supports the needs of the Customer and the municipalities. It is the Contracting Authority's business need that all Services are delivered with high delivery reliability and robustness, and that the Supplier demonstrates proactivity in the collaboration. In addition to the focus on secure and stable operation, the Supplier must ensure a successful Transition In of the Support Systems with the least possible disruption to the Contracting Authority's business, as well as Subsequent Transitions and ongoing Transformation, including a gradual transition to Hybrid Cloud Standard Services and, to the extent that it supports the needs of the Contracting Authority and the municipalities, Managed Public Cloud Services. In connection with Transition In, a high level of information security must be established, which must be continuously maintained and improved throughout the Contract. The contract has the following 4 main services: I. Transition In, where the Contracting Authority initially wishes for the establishment of and secure and stable transfer to an Operating Platform for the Support Systems, based on Hybrid Cloud Services, with the implementation of, for example, project management, transition organisation, building of operational capacity, transfer of Environments and data, and takeover of knowledge from the Outgoing Supplier. Subsequently, the Contracting Authority wishes to carry out successive Subsequent Transitions for a number of the Contracting Authority's other IT systems from the current operating models to the Operating Platform, based on Hybrid Cloud Services. II. Ongoing Services for the Operating Platform, including; a. Support; b. Hybrid Cloud Services, including Hybrid Cloud Standard Services and Hybrid Cloud Custom Services; c. Tools for supporting Application Suppliers; d. Governance, Operational Processes, security services, Documentation, and operational reporting. III. Service catalogue with the use of standardised methods, technologies, and services, through which the Contracting Authority wishes to be able to provision services on a cloud platform that; a) Offers a wide range of services; b) Is accessible via the public internet; c) Has a publicly available price structure with settlement of services according to consumption on subscription terms. IV. Methods and tools for supporting collaboration with the Contracting Authority and the Contracting Authority's application suppliers, where the Contracting Authority wishes for the delivery of the future operating platform to be supported by proactive collaboration across the Contracting Authority's IT system portfolio.

parts.source: Ordregiver udbyder kontrakt vedrørende en fælles Driftsplatform for ordregivers IT-systemportefølje. Efter Transition Ind, hvor Støttesystemerne transitioneres til Driftsplatformen, skal Leverandøren forestå drift, herunder Datacenterdrift/Hybrid Cloud Custom Services/Hybrid Cloud Standard Services og Infrastrukturdrift, samt Support og vedligeholdelse af Driftsplatformen. Desuden skal Leverandøren efter Transition Ind sikre Efterfølgende Transitioner til og Transformationer af Driftsplatformen. Formålet med den fælles Driftsplatform er blandt andet at få en sikker og stabil drift med en høj tilgængelighed samt en tidssvarende teknologisk platform med en høj grad af skalerbarhed, der understøtter Kundens og kommunernes behov. Det er ordregivers forretningsmæssige behov, at alle Ydelser leveres med høj leverancesikkerhed og robusthed, samt at Leverandøren udviser proaktivitet i samarbejdet. Ud over fokus på sikker og stabil drift, skal Leverandøren sikre en vellykket Transition Ind af Støttesystemerne med mindst mulig forstyrrelse af ordregivers forretning samt Efterfølgende Transitioner og løbende Transformation, herunder gradvis overgang til Hybrid Cloud Standard Services og i det omfang, det understøtter ordregivers og kommunernes behov, Managed Public Cloud Services. Der skal i forbindelse med Transition Ind etableres et højt informationssikkerhedsniveau, som løbende skal vedligeholdes og forbedres gennem hele Kontrakten. Kontrakten har følgende 4 hovedydelser: I. Transition Ind, hvor ordregiver i første omgang ønsker etablering af og sikker og stabil overflytning til en Driftsplatform for Støttesystemerne, baseret på Hybrid Cloud Services, med gennemførelse af fx projektstyring, transitionsorganisation, opbygning af driftskapacitet, overførsel af Miljøer og data og overtagelse af viden fra Afgivende Leverandør. Efterfølgende ønsker ordregiver at gennemføre successive Efterfølgende Transitioner for en række af ordregivers øvrige IT-systemer fra de nuværende driftsmodeller til Driftsplatformen, baseret på Hybrid Cloud Services. II. Løbende Ydelser til Driftsplatformen, herunder; a. Support; b. Hybrid Cloud Services, herunder Hybrid Cloud Standard Services og Hybrid Cloud Custom Services; c. Værktøjer til understøttelse af Applikationsleverandører; d. Governance, Operationelle Processer, sikkerhedsydelser, Dokumentation og driftsrapportering. III. Servicekatalog med anvendelse af standardiserede metoder, teknologier og services, hvorigennem ordregiver ønsker at kunne provisionere services på en cloudplatform der; a) Udbyder et bredt sortiment af services; b) Er tilgængelig via det offentlige internet; c) Har er en offentligt tilgængelig prisstruktur med afregning af services efter forbrug på abonnementsvilkår. IV. Metoder og værktøjer til understøttelse af samarbejde med Ordregiver og Ordregivers applikationsleverandører, hvor ordregiver ønsker at leverancen af den fremtidige driftsplatform er understøttet af et proaktivt samarbejde på tværs af ordregivers IT-systemportefølje.

result.text: AI infrastructure components are being procured to expand the contracting authority's existing structure due to increased requirements resulting from project participation. Lot LOT-0001: AI Existing Infrastructure Extension - Project Racoon. 2.1 NVIDIA Deep Learning System DGX B300 Cluster - Lot 1 Required procurement of four NVIDIA DGX B300 systems for the efficient processing of computationally intensive AI issues (e.g. medical imaging, digital pathology, omics, and NLP). The system serves as central infrastructure and enables the flexible provision of GPU workstation environments for university partners in the RACOON joint project via advanced virtualization with DGX OS / NVIDIA Enterprise AI. The new systems integrate seamlessly into the existing management infrastructure, which is based on the NVIDIA Base Command Manager and NVIDIA Mission Control. This ensures highly efficient, consistent administration without additional familiarisation or migration effort for the operations team. Since all algorithms and AI models are based on the proprietary NVIDIA CUDA architecture, the system has no technical alternative; a transition to other architectures or APIs would be associated with a disproportionately high and economically unjustifiable effort. In addition, the existing GPU cluster management is built natively on this software stack. The selected Blackwell generation (B300) offers the only adequate performance class with 8x NVIDIA B300 GPUs, 2304 GB total memory, and a 800 Gbit/s InfiniBand connection. Furthermore, the enormous power density (10 U in the rack at max. 15,1 kW per system) guarantees resource-saving integration into the capacity-limited data centre. Lot LOT-0002: AI Existing Infrastructure Extension - Projects Athene. 2.2 NVIDIA GPU servers, network, and Spark cluster - Lot 2 The procurement serves to expand and optimize the existing infrastructure of the Research Compute Cluster (RCC) to meet the growing demand for high-performance resources for AI and data-intensive research applications. The NVIDIA DGX Spark systems enable the development, testing, and inference of AI models in the same NVIDIA software environment as the central GPU servers of the RCC. As a result, developed applications can be transferred to the higher-performance RCC resources without fundamental adaptations. The additional GPU server expands the central computing capacity of the RCC and is used in particular for medical AI, image analysis, genomics/metagenomics, as well as the training and inference of large AI models. Integration takes place into the existing Slurm-based infrastructure. To connect the additional components, the existing management and BMC network infrastructure is also expanded by a technically identical SuperMicro SSE-G3748R-SONIC. This ensures a uniform and operationally consistent infrastructure without establishing a separate network solution.

parts.source: Beschafft werden KI-Infrastrukturkomponenten zur Erweiterung der bereits bestehenden Bestandsstruktur des Auftraggebers aufgrund gestiegener Anforderungen durch Projektteilnahmen. Lot LOT-0001: KI-Bestandsinfrastruktur-Erweiterung - Projekt Racoon. 2.1 NVIDIA Deep Learning System DGX B300-Cluster - Los 1 Erforderliche Beschaffung von vier NVIDIA DGX B300 Systemen zur effizienten Bearbeitung rechenintensiver KI-Fragestellungen (z. B. medizinische Bildgebung, digitale Pathologie, Omics und NLP). Das System dient als zentrale Infrastruktur und ermöglicht über fortschrittliche Virtualisierung mit DGX OS / NVIDIA Enterprise AI die flexible Bereitstellung von GPU-Arbeitsplatzumgebungen für universitäre Partner im RACOON Verbundprojekt. Dabei fügen sich die neuen Systeme nahtlos in die bereits bestehende Management-Infrastruktur ein, welche auf dem NVIDIA Base Command Manager und NVIDIA Mission Control basiert. Dies sichert eine hocheffiziente, konsistente Administration ohne zusätzlichen Einarbeitungs- oder Migrationsaufwand für das Betriebsteam. Da sämtliche Algorithmen und KI-Modelle auf der proprietären NVIDIA CUDA-Architektur basieren, ist das System technisch alternativlos; eine Umstellung auf andere Architekturen oder APIs wäre mit einem unverhältnismäßig hohen und wirtschaftlich nicht vertretbaren Aufwand verbunden. Zudem baut das vorhandene GPU-Cluster-Management nativ auf diesem Software-Stack auf. Die gewählte Blackwell-Generation (B300) bietet mit 8x NVIDIA B300 GPUs, 2304 GB Gesamtspeicher und einer 800 Gbit/s InfiniBand-Anbindung die einzig adäquate Leistungsklasse. Die Integration erfolgt in die bestehende Slurm-basierte Infrastruktur. Zur Anbindung der zusätzlichen Komponenten wird zudem die bestehende Management- und BMC-Netzinfrastruktur durch einen technisch identischen SuperMicro SSE-G3748R-SONIC erweitert. Dadurch wird eine einheitliche und betrieblich konsistente Infrastruktur ohne Aufbau einer separaten Netzwerklösung sichergestellt.

Helsinki currently has a total of approximately 500 traffic light control units and uses several control and monitoring systems. parts.source: Tämä asiakirja ei ole hankintailmoitus tai tarjouspyyntö vaan kutsu markkinavuoropuheluun. Helsingin kaupungin Kaupunkiympäristön toimiala (jäljempänä tilaaja) on valmistelemassa Liikennevalojen keskusohjausjärjestelmän hankintaa. Helsingin kaupungin kaupunkiympäristön toimiala on hankkimassa palveluhankintana uutta liikennevalojen ohjaus- ja valvontajärjestelmää. Hankittavan uuden järjestelmän on tarkoitus korvata elinkaarensa loppupuolella oleva liikennevalojen ohjaus- ja valvontajärjestelmä, jonka piirissä on noin 200 ohjauskojetta. Helsingissä on nykyisin yhteensä noin 500 liikennevalojen ohjauskojetta ja käytössä useampia ohjaus- ja valvontajärjestelmiä. Hankittavaan järjestelmään tullaan liittämään lähtökohtaisesti ohjauskojeita vain RSMP-rajapintaa käyttäen. Tilaajan kojekanta käsittää eri kojemallien laitteita eri aikakausilta, eikä osa nykyisistä kojeista tue RSMP-rajapintaa. Moninaisen kojekannan ohjaus- ja valvontajärjestelmältä edellytetään tukea RSMP-rajapinnan uusimpien versioiden ohella myös usealle vanhemmalle nykyisten ohjauskojeiden tukemille versioille. Kaupunki tulee uusimaan lähivuosina vanhempia ohjauskojeita erillishankkeina ja uusittavat ohjauskojeet liitetään hankittavaan järjestelmään kojevaihtojen yhteydessä. Lisätietoa hankinnan kohteesta kuvattu dokumentissa Hankinnan esittely, sekä liitteessä tekninen ympäristö ja vastuurajat. Tässä markkinavuoropuhelussa on tarkoitus selvittää markkinoita kyseisten palveluiden osalta ja saada hankintaa koskevaa tietoa, jotta hankinta voidaan toteuttaa tarkoituksenmukaisesti. Tietopyynnön avulla saatu aineisto voi vaikuttaa siihen, miten hankinnan kriteerit asetetaan ja mitä hankintamenettelyä tullaan käyttämään. Hankintayksikkö ei sitoudu tässä ilmoituksessa tai sen liitteissä ilmoitettuihin tietoihin, vaan valmistelun edetessä hankinnan kohde ja vaatimukset voivat muuttua. Pyydämme ilmoittamaan, mikäli vastaus näkemyksenne mukaan sisältää liikesalaisuuksia tai muuta salassa pidettävää tietoa. Pyydämme yksilöimään ja merkitsemään nämä tiedot selvästi. Tietopyynnössä annetut vastaukset eivät ole toimittajaa sitovia, eikä vastaaminen ole edellytyksenä myöhemmin varsinaiseen tarjouskilpailuun osallistumiselle. Tietopyyntöön vastaaminen tai vastaamatta jättäminen ei vaikuta mahdollisen toimittajan asemaan varsinaisessa tarjouskilpailussa. Tietopyyntöön vastaamisesta ei makseta korvausta. Pyydämme vastaamaan tietopyynnön Forms kyselyssä esitettyihin kysymyksiin mahdollisimman kattavasti. Vastaukset pyydetään kirjoittamaan kysymysten yhteydessä oleviin kenttiin. Markkinavuoropuhelu tilaisuuksiin ilmoittautuminen tapahtuu käyttämällä samaa edellä mainittua Forms kyselyä, jonne osallistuja ilmoittaa parhaiten sopivan ajan markkinavuoropuhelin tilaisuuteen. Markkinavuoropuhelu tilaisuuksissa käytettävä kieli on suomi tai englanti. Linkki: https://forms.office.com/e/sWs6DmPME6

rejected.text: The Tribal Colleges and Universities Program (TCUP) provides awards to federally recognised 1 Tribal Colleges and Universities, Alaska Native-serving institutions, and Native Hawaiian-serving institutions to promote high quality science (including sociology, psychology, anthropology, linguistics, economics and bioeconomics, statistics, and other social and behavioural sciences; natural sciences; computer science, including, but not limited to, artificial intelligence, quantum information science, and cybersecurity), technology, engineering and mathematics (STEM), STEM education, research, and outreach. Support is available to TCUP-eligible institutions (see the Additional Eligibility subsection of Section IV of this solicitation) for transformative capacity-building or community engagement projects through Instructional Capacity Excellence in TCUP Institutions (ICE-TI) , Targeted STEM Infusion Projects (TSIP) , TCUP for Secondary and Elementary Teachers in STEM (TSETS) , TCU Enterprise Advancement Centres (TEA Centres) , Cyberinfrastructure Health, Assistance, and Improvements (CHAI) , and Preparing for TCUP Implementation (Pre-TI) . Collaborations led by TCUP institutions that involve non-TCUP institutions of higher education are supported through TCUP Partnerships , with the participation of other NSF programmes to support the work of non-TCUP institutions. Finally, research studies that further the scholarly activity of individual faculty members are supported through Small Grants for Research (SGR) . Through the opportunities highlighted above, as well as collaborations with other National Science Foundation (NSF) divisions and directorates, and other organisations, TCUP aims to increase Native individuals' participation in STEM careers, improve the quality of STEM programmes at TCUP-eligible institutions, and facilitate the development of a strong STEM enterprise in TCUP institutions' service areas. TCUP supports transformative capacity-building, community engagement, or research projects at TCUP-eligible institutions through the following funding tracks: Instructional Capacity Excellence in TCUP Institutions (ICE-TI) projects provide support to design, implement, and assess comprehensive institutional improvements in STEM education and research capacity at TCUP-eligible institutions of higher education. By strengthening STEM education and STEM education research, successful projects will increase the number of STEM students and improve the quality of their preparation. ICE-TI projects create and/or adapt and assess innovative models and materials for teaching and learning in STEM, embody knowledge about how students learn most effectively in STEM teaching and learning activities, and bring STEM disciplinary advances into the undergraduate or graduate experience. The objective of this strand is to expand STEM degrees offered by TCUP-eligible institutions or significantly enhance instructional approaches. Targeted STEM Infusion Projects (TSIP) support the attainment of a short-term, well-defined goal to improve the quality of STEM education at an eligible institution. Targeted STEM Infusion Projects could, for example, enhance academic infrastructure by systematically adding traditional knowledge to the scope or content of a STEM course, updating curricula, modernising laboratory research equipment, developing and delivering professional development for K-12 STEM educators, or improving the computational infrastructure. The objective of this strand is to expand STEM degrees or significantly enhance instructional approaches. TCUP for Secondary & Elementary Teachers in STEM (TSETS) supports in-service professional development in STEM disciplinary or STEM education content and/or research for K-12 STEM teachers in the relevant service area. Examples of project activities include, but are not limited to, professional development involving seminar series and engagement in STEM instruction and content during the academic year, structured series of summer intensive workshops and trainings, and summer research opportunities. The objective of this strand is to broaden the instructional capacity for STEM in the K-12 workforce and thereby to the entire community, and to build the capacity for STEM disciplinary or education research among participating educational professionals. TCU Enterprise Advancement Centres (TEA Centres) coalesce the STEM and/or STEM education expertise into a team, designed to support and promote the STEM goals, needs, aspirations, or interests of the chartering reservation or tribe(s). TEA Centres may address a critical tribal or community need or focus on a realm of research or design that is beyond the scope of individual research grants or that is of interest to multiple tribes. The objective of this strand is to build on the capacity developed through prior TCUP support and apply expertise to collaborations with communities in the institution’s service area, or nationally. The Cyberinfrastructure Health, Assistance, and Improvements (CHAI) strand supports projects at TCUP-eligible institutions of higher education to upgrade the cyberinfrastructure necessary to conduct, expand, manage and administer STEM programmes of study, including research. The objective of this strand is to equip TCUP institutions to meet the demands of virtual instruction, advanced computing, and data science opportunities. Preparing for TCUP Implementation (Pre-TI) provides support for activities that prepare an institution for Implementation-level projects. Consequently, they are available only to TCUP-eligible institutions of higher education that have never received TCUP support, have not received TCUP support within the previous five years, or are embarking on a significantly novel STEM strategic plan.

rejected.text: Examples of supported activities include completing an institutional assessment of its current STEM instructional capacity, or engaging in conversations necessary to formulate a shared vision of what that capacity should be and how to achieve it. Pre-TI awards can support staff and faculty release time, travel, stakeholder gatherings, and associated administrative costs. The objective of this strand is to conduct self-studies and formulate strategic plans for the development of STEM instructional programmes of study. The TCUP Partnerships strand provides support for collaborations that will improve TCUP institutions' instructional and research capacity in STEM fields supported by NSF; attract, retain, and support TCUP students in internships and research endeavours deemed to be necessary for a complete curriculum offering; and engage partner universities to provide an academic grounding and a successful transition for students who wish to study or attain degrees in STEM fields supported by NSF. TCUP Partnerships broaden the number of scientific disciplines available to students at TCUP institution through collaborations with non-TCUP institutions. Active Pre-Engineering Education Collaboratives or Partnerships in Geoscience Education awards are not affected by this revision. The objective of this strand is the development, through instructional and research capacity-building, of academic and career pathways for TCUP students through supporting collaborative projects between and among TCUP and non-TCUP institutions. Interested teams of collaborators for which a TCUP institution serves as lead should contact the TCUP programme directors. Support for non-TCUP partners must be obtained from other NSF programmes, which follows the procedures of the prior Partnership strands. Small Grants for Research (SGR) strand support STEM or STEM Education faculty members at TCUP-eligible institutions to initiate or pursue research projects or programmes that may include undergraduate or graduate student engagement. Awards are intended to help further the faculty member's research capability and effectiveness; improve research and teaching at his or her home institution and create and study new models and innovations in STEM teaching and learning. International research or collaborations are strongly encouraged. TCUP students may seek support for international research opportunities under the guidance of a TCUP STEM or STEM education faculty member and an international research collaborator. These awards are particularly appropriate as a means of recruiting and retaining highly qualified scientists, engineers, and educators at TCUP-eligible institutions. The objective of this strand is to support faculty research and professional development that build research capacity at TCUP institutions. [1] Executive Order 13021 defines Tribal Colleges and Universities ("tribal colleges") as those institutions cited in section 532 of the Equity in Educational Land-Grant Status Act of 1994 (7 U.S.C. 301 note), and other institutions that qualify for funding under the Tribally Controlled Community College Assistance Act of 1978, (25 U.S.C. 1801 et seq.), as well as Navajo Community College as authorised in the Navajo Community College Assistance Act of 1978, Public Law 95-471, Title II (25 U.S.C. 640a note). The term "Alaska Native-serving institution" means an institution of higher education that is an eligible institution under section 1058(b) of the Higher Education Act; and that, at the time of submission, has an undergraduate enrolment that is at least 20 percent Alaska Native students. The term "Native Hawaiian-serving institution" means an institution of higher education that is an eligible institution under section 1058(b) of the Higher Education Act; and that, at the time of submission, has an undergraduate enrolment that is at least 10 percent Native Hawaiian students. Most TCUP-eligible institutions of higher education are two-year or community colleges. See the Who May Submit Proposals section in this solicitation for further details.

The objective of this strand is the development, through instructional and research capacity-building, of academic and career pathways for TCUP students through supporting collaborative projects between and among TCUP and non-TCUP institutions. Interested teams of collaborators for which a TCUP institution serves as lead should contact the TCUP program directors. Support for non-TCUP partners must be obtained from other NSF programs, which follows the procedures of the prior Partnership strands. Small Grants for Research (SGR) strand support STEM or STEM Education faculty members at TCUP-eligible institutions to initiate or pursue research projects or programs that may include undergraduate or graduate student engagement. Awards are intended to help further the faculty member's research capability and effectiveness; improve research and teaching at his or her home institution and create and study new models and innovations in STEM teaching and learning. International research or collaborations are strongly encouraged. TCUP students may seek support for international research opportunities under the guidance of a TCUP STEM or STEM education faculty member and an international research collaborator. These awards are particularly appropriate as a means of recruiting and retaining highly qualified scientists, engineers, and educators at TCUP-eligible institutions. The objective of this strand is to support faculty research and professional development that build research capacity at TCUP institutions. [1] Executive Order 13021 defines Tribal Colleges and Universities ("tribal colleges") as those institutions cited in section 532 of the Equity in Educational Land-Grant Status Act of 1994 (7 U.S.C. 301 note), and other institutions that qualify for funding under the Tribally Controlled Community College Assistance Act of 1978, (25 U.S.C. 1801 et seq.), as well as Navajo Community College as authorized in the Navajo Community College Assistance Act of 1978, Public Law 95-471, Title II (25 U.S.C. 640a note). The term "Alaska Native-serving institution" means an institution of higher education that is an eligible institution under section 1058(b) of the Higher Education Act; and that, at the time of submission, has an undergraduate enrollment that is at least 20 percent Alaska Native students. The term "Native Hawaiian-serving institution" means an institution of higher education that is an eligible institution under section 1058(b) of the Higher Education Act; and that, at the time of submission, has an undergraduate enrollment that is at least 10 percent Native Hawaiian students. Most TCUP-eligible institutions of higher education are two-year or community colleges. See the Who May Submit Proposals section in this solicitation for further details.

result.text: An IT application for the digitalisation of processes relating to trichinella testing, the management of monitoring samples in the animal health sector and management in the event of an outbreak of African Swine Fever (ASF) is to be procured as a SaaS cloud solution. The IT application must be compatible with the hunting statistics application of Condition – Integrierte Softwarelösungen GmbH. This is used in the Free State of Thuringia to record bag data (data on wild animals killed by hunters). The IT application should be available both as a web application (usable in common browsers) and as a mobile app application (iOS and Android operating systems). Within the scope of the tender, an app is defined as an application that must be installed on a mobile device before use by the user and can only be used there. As a rule, this takes place on a smartphone or tablet using a so-called app store. There will be two main user groups: a) administrative or laboratory staff b) non-administrative users (e.g. those authorised to hunt). The non-administrative users record data on killed or slaughtered animals. If necessary, they also submit applications for the examination of these animals for trichinella and/or certain animal diseases to the competent authorities or the competent testing facility of the Free State of Thuringia. The test results should be retrievable via the IT application. The competent authorities (veterinary and food monitoring offices of the districts and independent cities - veterinary authorities) operate the trichinella testing laboratories. These should be able to access the application data recorded by external users in the IT application via their own user interface and transmit the test results back to the applicants. In addition, laboratory software should be made available to the competent authorities, with the help of which testing activities can be documented on the basis of the application data. In the case of monitoring samples in the animal health sector, the client's laboratory at the Thuringian State Office for Consumer Protection is the competent testing facility. The laboratory software (LIMS) in use there should be able to access the information on the samples entered by the users via the HIT database. The IT application must therefore have an interface to the HIT database. A direct connection to the LIMS is not intended. The IT application is to be made available to administrative staff for mapping internal administrative processes as well as to affected users outside the administration for data entry and application submission, and for receiving notices from the competent authorities. While the use cases of trichinella testing, management of monitoring samples in the animal health sector and the interface to the hunting statistics application are to be available permanently, the use case of management in the event of an outbreak of African Swine Fever (ASF) is only to be usable and available on an ad-hoc basis. Furthermore, introductory support and training for the staff of the competent authorities should be included in the offer as an initial service. The contract is concluded via an EVB-IT cloud contract. The procurement is carried out by the client for use by all districts and independent cities in Thuringia. The use of the IT application for the aforementioned purposes is mandatory for the districts and independent cities. For hunters, however, use is optional. This means that they can refrain from using the IT application. The previous analogue system for sampling will initially be continued in parallel. Lot LOT-0000: Provision, operation (incl. hosting) and support of an IT application for the digitalisation of processes relating to trichinella testing, the management of monitoring samples in the animal health sector, management in the event of an outbreak of African Swine Fever (ASF) and an interface to the hunting statistics application. The 21 veterinary and food monitoring offices of the 22 districts and independent cities in the Free State of Thuringia are, among other things, responsible for receiving and testing samples of slaughtered or killed animals intended for human consumption for Trichinella spp. Furthermore, there are responsibilities with regard to granting permission for the taking of samples intended for trichinella testing by non-administrative persons. Citizens who wish to make use of the aforementioned administrative services should be enabled to record the required application data digitally in accordance with the principles of the Online Access Act (OZG), to submit the application paperlessly to the respective competent veterinary and food monitoring office and to receive the notices from the competent authorities. In addition, the possibility should be created to comply with further reporting obligations (e.g. the recording of hunting bags by hunters) in digital form. The testing of wild boar for Trichinella spp. only takes place if the animal is to become food. Based on experience to date, this leads to the testing of up to 30.000 head of wild boar per year in Thuringia. These figures fluctuate. In addition, the veterinary monitoring authorities are responsible for implementing regular monitoring of killed wild animals for certain animal disease pathogens. Depending on the current animal health status, the number of samples is expected to vary between approx. 5.000 and 30.000 samples per year.

parts.source: Es soll eine IT-Anwendung zur Digitalisierung der Vorgänge in Bezug auf die Trichinenuntersuchung, das Management von Monitoring-Proben im Tiergesundheitsbereich und das Management im Falle eines Ausbruches der Afrikanischen Schweinepest (ASP) als SaaS-Cloud-Lösung beschafft werden. Die IT-Anwendung muss kompatibel zur Jagdstatistik-Anwendung der Condition – Integrierte Softwarelösungen GmbH sein. Mit dieser werden im Freistaat Thüringen die Streckendaten (Daten der von Jägern erlegten Wildtiere) erfasst. Die IT-Anwendung soll sowohl als Web- (nutzbar in den gängigen Browsern) als auch Mobile App-Anwendung (Betriebssysteme iOS und Android) zur Verfügung stehen. Als App wird im Rahmen der Ausschreibung eine Anwendung definiert, die vor Verwendung durch den Nutzer auf einem mobilen Gerät installiert werden muss und auch nur dort genutzt werden kann. In der Regel erfolgt dies auf einem Smartphone oder Tablet mithilfe eines sogenannten App-Stores. Es wird zwei wesentliche Nutzergruppen geben: a) Verwaltungs- bzw. Labormitarbeiter b) verwaltungsexterne Nutzer (z. B. Jagdausübungsberechtigte) Die verwaltungsexternen Nutzer erfassen Daten zu erlegten bzw. geschlachteten Tieren. Erforderlichenfalls stellen diese zudem Anträge zur Untersuchung dieser Tiere auf Trichinen und/oder bestimmte Wildtierseuchen bei den zuständigen Behörden bzw. der zuständigen Untersuchungseinrichtung des Freistaates Thüringen. Die Untersuchungsergebnisse sollen über die IT-Anwendung abrufbar sein. Die zuständigen Behörden (Veterinär- und Lebensmittelüberwachungsämter der Landkreise und kreisfreie Städte - Veterinärbehörden) betreiben die Trichinenuntersuchungslabore. Diese sollen über eine eigene Nutzeroberfläche auf die durch die externen Nutzer in der IT-Anwendung erfassten Antragsdaten zugreifen und die Untersuchungsergebnisse an die Antragssteller zurück übermitteln können. Zudem soll für die zuständigen Behörden eine Laborsoftware zur Verfügung gestellt werden, mit Hilfe dieser auf Basis der Antragsdaten die Untersuchungstätigkeiten dokumentiert werden können. Im Falle der Monitoring-Proben im Tiergesundheitsbereich ist das Labor des Auftraggebers im Thüringer Landesamt für Verbraucherschutz die zuständige Untersuchungseinrichtung. Die dort in Nutzung befindliche Laborsoftware (LIMS) soll über die HIT-Datenbank auf die von den Nutzern eingegebenen Informationen zu den Proben zugreifen können. Die IT-Anwendung muss daher über eine Schnittstelle zur HIT-Datenbank verfügen. Eine direkte Verbindung zum LIMS ist nicht vorgesehen. Die IT-Anwendung soll den Verwaltungsmitarbeitenden zur Abbildung verwaltungsinterner Vorgänge sowie betroffenen Nutzern außerhalb der Verwaltung zur Datenerfassung und Antragsstellung gegenüber sowie dem Empfang von Bescheiden von den zuständigen Behörden zur Verfügung stehen. Während die Anwendungsfälle Trichinenuntersuchung, Management von Monitoring-Proben im Tiergesundheitsbereich sowie die Schnittstelle zur Jagdstatistikanwendung dauerhaft zur Verfügung stehen sollen, soll der Anwendungsfall des Managements im Falle eines Ausbruches der Afrikanischen Schweinepest (ASP) nur anlassbezogen nutz- und verfügbar sein. Darüber hinaus soll auch eine Einführungsunterstützung sowie Schulung der Mitarbeitenden der zuständigen Behörden im Angebot als initiale Leistung enthalten sein. Vertragsschluss erfolgt über einen EVB-IT Cloud-Vertrag. Die Beschaffung erfolgt durch den Auftraggeber zur Nutzung durch alle Landkreise und kreisfreien Städte in Thüringen. Die Verwendung der IT-Anwendung für die vorgenannten Zwecke ist für die Landkreisen und kreisfreien Städten verpflichtend. Den Jägern ist die Verwendung dagegen freigestellt. Das bedeutet, diese können von der Verwendung der IT-Anwendung absehen. Das bisherige analoge System zur Probenahme wird vorerst parallel weitergeführt. Lot LOT-0000: Bereitstellung, Betrieb (inkl. Hosting) und Support einer IT-Anwendung zur Digitalisierung der Vorgänge in Bezug auf die Trichinenuntersuchung, das Management von Monitoring-Proben im Tiergesundheitsbereich, das Management im Falle eines Ausbruches der Afrikanischen Schweinepest (ASP) und einer Schnittstelle zur Jagdstatistik-Anwendung. Die 21 Veterinär- und Lebensmittelüberwachungsämter der 22 Landkreise und kreisfreien Städte im Freistaat Thüringen sind unter anderem zuständig für die Entgegennahme und Untersuchung von Proben geschlachteter oder erlegter Tiere, die für den Verzehr durch den Menschen vorgesehen sind, auf Trichinella spp. Darüber hinaus bestehen Zuständigkeiten im Hinblick auf die Erlaubniserteilung zur Entnahme von Proben, die zur Untersuchung auf Trichinen vorgesehen sind, durch verwaltungsexterne Personen. Den Bürgerinnen und Bürgern, die die vorgenannten Verwaltungsleistungen in Anspruch nehmen möchten, soll ermöglicht werden, die erforderlichen Antragsdaten nach den Grundsätzen des Online-Zugangsgesetzes (OZG) digital zu erfassen, den Antrag papierlos dem jeweils zuständigen Veterinär- und Lebensmittelüberwachungsamt zu übermitteln und die Bescheide der zuständigen Behörden zu empfangen. Zudem soll die Möglichkeit geschaffen werden, weiteren Berichtspflichten (z. B. die Erfassung der Jagdstrecken durch Jägerinnen und Jäger) in digitaler Form nachzukommen. Die Untersuchung von Wildschweinen auf Trichinella spp. erfolgt nur dann, wenn das Tier zu einem Lebensmittel werden soll. Dies führt nach den bisherigen Erfahrungen pro Jahr zur Untersuchung von bis zu 30.000 Stück Schwarzwild in Thüringen. Diese Zahlen schwanken. Darüber hinaus sind die Behörden der Veterinärüberwachung für die Umsetzung eines regelmäßigen Monitorings von erlegten Wildtieren auf bestimmte Tierseuchenerreger verantwortlich. In Abhängigkeit vom aktuellen tierseuchenrechtlichen Status variiert die Probenzahl voraussichtlich zwischen ca. 5.000 und 30.000 Proben im Jahr.

result.text: Data entry and application submission as well as the receipt of notices should also be enabled here for the respective affected citizens. The recorded data should be transmitted via the application to the State Office for Consumer Protection responsible for testing the samples. The application part for the management of ASF outbreaks should be based on the aforementioned application parts in terms of operation (esp. the monitoring of killed wild animals for certain animal disease pathogens) and interact with them in terms of content in accordance with the technical requirements. This application part should be activatable on an ad-hoc basis for each affected authority (veterinary authorities of the districts and independent cities and, if applicable, the client). Use should take place not only in the event of an ASF outbreak in Thuringia but also in the context of exercises in preparation for an outbreak. A final application part includes the recording and reporting of hunting bags by hunters. This report includes all huntable animal species. For this documentation obligation, the bag data from the aforementioned application parts should be reusable, but it should also be possible to record new bag data. A corresponding interface is to be provided for the necessary data exchange with the hunting statistics application of Condition – Integrierte Softwarelösungen GmbH. The hunters already have direct access to the hunting statistics application. The interface should enable them to gain access from within the IT application and thus facilitate reporting through data transfer. The application is to be provided for use by administrative staff in the Free State of Thuringia as well as the respective affected citizens in the Free State of Thuringia. As a result, the licence and terms of use must enable use by employees of the state, the municipalities and by non-administrative persons. The number of future users cannot be precisely quantified at present, as the use of the IT application is optional for hunters. However, the number of hunters in Thuringia can be a guide; it amounts to approx. 13.000. In addition, there are approx. 100 administrative staff.

parts.source: Die Datenerfassung und Antragsstellung sowie der Empfang der Bescheide sollen hier ebenso für die jeweils betroffenen Bürgerinnen und Bürger ermöglicht werden. Die erfassten Daten sollen über die Anwendung an das für die Untersuchung der Proben zuständige Landesamt für Verbraucherschutz übermittelt werden. Der Anwendungsteil für das Management von ASP-Ausbrüchen soll sich bedientechnisch an den vorgenannten Anwendungsteilen (insb. dem Monitoring von erlegten Wildtieren auf bestimmte Tierseuchenerreger) orientieren und inhaltlich mit diesen gemäß den fachlichen Anforderungen interagieren. Dieser Anwendungsteil soll anlassbezogen je betroffener Behörde (Veterinärbehörden der Landkreise und kreisfreien Städte und gegebenenfalls der Auftraggeber) aktivierbar sein. Eine Verwendung soll neben einem Ausbruch der ASP in Thüringen auch im Rahmen von Übungen zur Vorbereitung auf den Ausbruchsfall erfolgen. Ein letzter Anwendungsteil umfasst die Erfassung und Meldung der Jagdstrecken durch die Jägerinnen und Jäger. Diese Meldung umfasst alle jagdbaren Tierarten. Für diese Dokumentationspflicht sollen sich die Erlegedaten aus den vorgenannten Anwendungsteilen nachnutzen, aber auch neue Erlegedaten erfassen lassen können. Für den erforderlichen Datenaustausch mit der Jagdstatistik-Anwendung der Condition – Integrierte Softwarelösungen GmbH ist eine entsprechende Schnittstelle vorzusehen. Die Jägerinnen und Jäger haben bereits direkten Zugriff auf die Jagdstatistik-Anwendung. Die Schnittstelle soll es ihnen ermöglichen, aus der IT-Anwendung heraus Zugriff zu nehmen und so die Meldung durch Datenübernahme zu erleichtern. Die Anwendung soll für die Nutzung durch Verwaltungspersonal im Freistaat Thüringen sowie die jeweils betroffenen Bürgerinnen und Bürger im Freistaat Thüringen bereitgestellt werden. Dadurch müssen die Lizenz- und Nutzungsbedingungen eine Nutzung durch Beschäftigte des Landes, der Kommunen und durch verwaltungsexterne Personen ermöglichen. Die Anzahl der künftigen Nutzer kann derzeit nicht genau beziffert werden, da die Nutzung der IT-Anwendung den Jägerinnen und Jägern freigestellt ist. Jedoch kann die Zahl der Jägerinnen und Jäger in Thüringen ein Anhaltspunkt sein, sie beläuft sich auf ca. 13.000. Hinzu kommen ca. 100 Verwaltungsmitarbeiterinnen und -mitarbeiter.

result.text: Unite Procurement UK Limited (part of Unite Holding SE), on behalf of the UK Ministry of Defence (MoD), invites qualified suppliers to join the Unite Procurement Platform to support the provision of the following items. This onboarding will establish a flexible, competitive supply base for low-value, high-volume procurement. The Unite Procurement Platform (Unite | Simplify indirect procurement with our smarter platform) provides a compliant route to market for UK Public Sector organisations to source approved products efficiently and transparently. Scope of Supply • Item: NVG-compatible finger torches • Quantity: 1,425 units • Use case: Field operations requiring hands-free, low-signature illumination Security and Sourcing Given operational sensitivities and supply chain assurance, priority will be afforded to UK-based suppliers and manufacturers to maintain supply chain integrity and reduce dependency on overseas sources. Non-UK suppliers may be considered where risk and assurance requirements are fully met. Background NVG finger torches are critical for discrete, task-level illumination in contested and training environments. Suppliers should demonstrate experience supplying defence, blue light, or similarly regulated sectors, with proven capability in quality management, traceability, and ongoing product support. How to Apply Interested suppliers should contact Unite Procurement UK Limited to register interest and provide: • Company profile and certifications (e.g., ISO 9001), product conformity (CE/UKCA where applicable) • Product specifications confirming NVG compatibility, mounting method, modes, runtime, power, IP rating, and materials • Evidence of prior defence or regulated-sector supply • Delivery plan for 1,425 units, including lead times, production capacity, and logistics to UK destinations • Warranty terms, returns handling, and maintenance/repair options (if applicable) • Pricing proposal, including any volume breaks and spares/accessory options Further details on Unite onboarding will be provided upon expression of interest and can also be found at www.mercateo.co.uk. Multi-Supplier Approach Unite Procurement UK Limited does not intend to appoint a sole supplier. Multiple suppliers may be onboarded to ensure competition, resilience, and choice for the MoD and associated organisations. Timelines Suppliers are encouraged to express their interest by the stated closing date for early consideration. Applications to join the Unite Procurement Platform are welcomed on a rolling basis thereafter. Unite Procurement UK Limited reserves the right to review and onboard suppliers continuously to meet evolving requirements. Contact For enquiries and expressions of interest, please email: defence.support@unite.eu Please include "Unite Onboarding - NVG Finger Torches (Qty 1,425)" in the subject line and reference relevant technical specifications in your submission.

result.text: This tender concerns the conclusion of a contract for the Contracting Authority's procurement of an integrated financial and payroll system with a special focus on secure, stable and efficient operation. The contract covers the supply and implementation of the solution as well as subsequent operation, maintenance and support. The financial part includes debtors, collection, etc., and the payroll part also includes rostering. The operational service constitutes a central element of the contract and includes full responsibility for the daily operation of the solution, including ensuring high availability, performance and operational stability. The purpose of the tender is to establish a future-proof and robust platform that supports the Contracting Authority's financial and payroll administration efficiently and with a high degree of automation, quality and operational reliability, including state-of-the-art technological capabilities in the form of support for machine learning and artificial intelligence, as well as other tools that can contribute to increased automation and decision support.

parts.source: Nærværende udbud vedrører indgåelse af kontrakt om Ordregivers anskaffelse af et integreret økonomi- og lønsystem med særligt fokus på sikker, stabil og effektiv drift. Kontrakten omfatter levering og implementering af løsningen samt den efterfølgende drift, vedligeholdelse og support. Under økonomidelen ligger såvel debitor, opkrævning mv., og under løndelen hører også vagtplan. Driftsydelsen udgør et centralt element i kontrakten, og omfatter det fulde ansvar for løsningens daglige drift, herunder sikring af høj tilgængelighed, performance og driftsstabilitet. Formålet med udbuddet er at etablere en fremtidssikret og robust platform, der understøtter Ordregivers økonomi- og lønadministration effektivt og med høj grad af automatisering, kvalitet og driftssikkerhed, herunder tidssvarende teknologiske muligheder i form af understøttelse af maskinlæring og kunstig intelligens samt andre værktøjer, der kan bidrage til øget automatisering og beslutningsstøtte.

result.text: Gender equality is a constitutional mandate pursuant to Article 3 Paragraph 2 of the Basic Law (GG) and increasing the labour market participation of women is also an objective of the Coalition Agreement (KoaV) (lines 407-409). In order to meet these obligations and objectives, strengthening the economic independence of women and men and promoting economic equality is a declared goal of the Federal Government. This goal has been incorporated into both the Annual Economic Report 2026 and the 7 Poverty and Wealth Report of the Federal Government. Imparting economic orientation knowledge over the life course (e.g., financial consequences of part-time work, care work, and tax bracket selection) is a central lever for this. The work of the "Economic Independence" office is also intended to build upon this. For the professional, evidence-based, and communicative support of the responsible specialist unit, the establishment and operation of an external "Economic Independence" office is being tendered throughout Europe for the period from 01.02.2027 to 31.12.2029. Further information can be found in the tender documents.

parts.source: Die Gleichstellung der Geschlechter ist ein Verfassungsauftrag nach Art. 3 Abs. 2 GG und die Erhöhung der Erwerbsbeteiligung von Frauen ist zudem Ziel des KoaV (Zeilen 407-409). Um diesen Verpflichtungen und Zielen nachzukommen, ist die Stärkung der wirtschaftlichen Eigenständigkeit von Frauen und Männern bzw. die Förderung der ökonomischen Gleichstellung ein erklärtes Ziel der Bundesregierung. Dieses Ziel wurde sowohl im Jahreswirtschaftsbericht 2026 als auch im 7. Armuts- und Reichtumsbericht der Bundesregierung hinterlegt. Die Vermittlung von ökonomischem Orientierungswissen im Lebensverlauf (z. B. finanzielle Folgen von Teilzeit, Care-Arbeit und Steuerklassenwahl) ist hierfür ein zentraler Hebel. Hier soll auch die Arbeit der Geschäftsstelle „Wirtschaftliche Eigenständigkeit“ anknüpfen. Zur fachlichen, evidenzbasierten und kommunikativen Unterstützung des zuständigen Fachreferats wird für den Zeitraum vom 01.02.2027 bis 31.12.2029 die Einrichtung und der Betrieb einer externen Geschäftsstelle „Wirtschaftliche Eigenständigkeit“ europaweit ausgeschrieben. Weitere Informationen entnehmen Sie bitte den Vergabeunterlagen.

result.text: The objective of the procurement is to acquire IT project manager and expert resources to support, among other things, the definition, programming, testing and management of the Finnish Tax Administration's new and existing systems. The expert resources will operate in projects, development tasks and ongoing service production. The purpose of the procurement is to secure specialist expertise and sufficient resources. The procurement is divided into six (6) lots, for each of which three (3) suppliers and three (3) reserve suppliers will be selected. The lots and their contents are described in more detail below. More detailed descriptions of the contents of the assignments for the procurement lots are described in the appendix Description of the subject matter of the procurement in section 3. The objective is for the contract to enter into force on 16.11.2026. The contract shall be valid for 72 months. Verohallinto develops and maintains digital services primarily as cloud-based and cloud-native solutions. The development work utilises application, integration, data and platform services provided by the Microsoft Azure cloud platform, as well as modern software development, information security and operational practices. Solutions vary in scope and criticality from mission-critical core applications to more limited services targeting specific business needs. The subject matter of the procurement for this lot is expert services for cloud-based software development implemented in the Microsoft Azure environment. The lot includes in particular architecture design for cloud solutions and cloud applications, application and integration development, DevOps, the development and maintenance of cloud platforms, and the technical information security of cloud environments and applications. Key expert roles include cloud solution architect, cloud application architect, cloud software developer, integration developer, cloud DevOps specialist, cloud platform specialist and technical information security specialist.; The subject matter of the procurement for this lot is expert services for applications and information system solutions utilising artificial intelligence, generative artificial intelligence and machine learning. The solutions are implemented primarily in the Microsoft Azure cloud environment, utilising the artificial intelligence capabilities offered by Microsoft Foundry and other Azure services. The solutions can be standalone AI applications or parts of broader information systems, digital services and software solutions. Expert work concerning new technologies may relate to the assessment of the possibilities, suitability, information security and risks of technologies, experiments and prototyping, software and hardware integration, the development of embedded systems, preparation for deployment, or the practical utilisation of technologies. Key expert roles for AI applications include AI application specialists, AI developers, AI solution architects, machine learning specialists and software developers participating in the implementation of AI applications.; The subject matter of the procurement for this lot is expert services aimed at improving the efficiency, quality and transparency of the organisation's operational and data-driven processes through automation, hyper-automation, analytics and systematic development methods. The subject matter of the procurement for this lot is primarily process automation expert services as well as process analytics and process development expert services in a cloud-based operating environment.; The Finnish Tax Administration's technological operating environment strongly includes the development of infrastructure, analytics, information security and cloud services. The Finnish Tax Administration uses the Gentax core taxation system and several smaller systems (e.g. supporting administration). The National Incomes Register and the Positive Credit Register are also the responsibility of the Finnish Tax Administration. The subject matter of the procurement for this lot includes: - project manager services for the development, creation and deployment of operating models and processes, as well as the development of related applications. The scope of impact of operational development can be internal to the organisation and/or customer-related. - technical project manager services, particularly for the areas of infrastructure and information security - Scrum master/team lead services for operational and technical development teams.; The subject matter of the procurement for this lot is IT service management expert services for the ServiceNow environment, as well as expert services specialised in ServiceNow development for architecture, consulting and development tasks. The tasks include ICT architecture and expert tasks in the ServiceNow modules used by the Finnish Tax Administration, including (* supplemented 4.9.2026): • ITSM (IT Service Management) • ITOM (IT Operations Management) • ITBM / SPM (Strategic Portfolio and Demand Management) • SecOps / SIR* (Security Operations) • IRM (Risk Management)* • CMDB (Configuration Management)* • IAM / AM (Access Management, Identity Management)* Expert tasks may include system development, configuration, maintenance, testing and training tasks for the modules in question, as well as related functional and technical architecture design.; The subject matter of the procurement for this lot is user-driven development expert services. By expert service, we mean working under the direction of the Finnish Tax Administration as part of the Finnish Tax Administration's development teams or in close cooperation with them, consulting, business sparring and/s or the implementation of various assignments. Verohallinto can also order fixed-price assignments for e.g. system accessibility audits.
