result.text: Organisational, professional and technical consultancy services for an omnichannel transformation project. The Audi BKK is planning to implement a future-proof omnichannel platform for customer advice in order to ensure consistent, seamless and personalised support across all relevant communication channels. In addition to connecting to existing systems of the Audi BKK, new digital contact channels for customer communication are to be provided, networked with one another and further optimised or automated. In future, customer advice is to be structured into first-level and second-level support. To prepare for the implementation of an omnichannel platform and to create the necessary organisational, professional and technical prerequisites, the contracting authority is hereby tendering for advisory support services to accompany and implement measures in the omnichannel context. Based on a completed as-is analysis and determination of the status quo, organisational, professional and technical measures and objectives have been derived. The results are documented in an omnichannel roadmap and are divided into a conception phase and a transformation phase (see attached annex). The concepts and optimisations developed (and potentially still emerging) during the conception phase are to be consolidated and driven forward by the contractor in their implementation and execution. The contractor shall effectively manage, methodically implement and document the omnichannel transformation process. The contractor shall support the technical and functional requirements for a suitable omnichannel platform during the derivation and survey phase in order to ensure a robust catalogue of requirements for the subsequent tendering and procurement of an omnichannel platform. The objective of this tender is to conclude a contract with a contractor for a period of two years, with planned contractual extension options. The contracting authority estimates the scope of the contract at approximately 800 consultant days.

parts.source: Organisatorische, fachliche und technische Beratungsleistungen zu einem Omnikanal-Transformationsprojekt Die Audi BKK plant, die Implementierung einer zukunftsfähigen Omnikanalplattform für die Kundenberatung einzuführen, um eine konsistente, medienbruchfreie und personalisierte Betreuung über alle relevanten Kommunikationskanäle hinweg zu gewährleisten. Neben der Anbindung an Bestandssysteme der Audi BKK sollen auch neue, digitale Kontaktkanäle für die Kundenkommunikation bereitgestellt, miteinander vernetzt und weiter optimiert bzw. automatisiert werden. Künftig soll die Kundenberatung differenziert nach First- und Second-Level ausgerichtet werden. Zur Vorbereitung der Implementierung einer Omnikanalplattform und Schaffung der dafür erforderlichen organisatorischen, fachlichen und technischen Voraussetzungen schreibt die Auftraggeberin vorliegend beratende Unterstützungsleistungen zur Begleitung und Umsetzung von Maßnahmen im Omnikanalkontext aus. Auf Grundlage einer bereits abgeschlossenen IST-Analyse und Ermittlung des Status quo wurden organisatorische, fachliche und technische Maßnahmen wie Zielsetzungen abgeleitet. Die Ergebnisse sind in einer Omnikanal-Roadmap dokumentiert und gliedern sich in eine Konzeptions- und Transformationsphase (siehe beigefügte Anlage). Die in der Konzeptionsphase erarbeiteten (und ggf. noch entstehenden) Konzepte und Optimierungen sind vom Auftragnehmer in ihrer Umsetzung und Implementierung zu konsolidieren und voranzutreiben. Der Auftragnehmer soll den Prozess der Omnikanaltransformation wirksam steuern, methodisch umsetzen und dokumentieren. Die technischen und funktionalen Anforde-rungen an eine geeignete Omnikanalplattform soll der Auftragnehmer während der Ableitungs- und Erhebungsphase begleiten, um einen belastbaren Anforderungskatalog zur späteren Ausschreibung und Beschaffung einer Omnikanalplattform sicher zu stellen. Ziel dieser Ausschreibung ist der Abschluss eines Vertrags mit einem Auftragnehmer für einen Zeitraum von zwei Jahren, wobei vertragliche Verlängerungsmöglichkeiten geplant sind. Die Auftraggeberin schätzt den Auftragsumfang auf etwa 800 Beratertage.

result.text: Avfall Sør would like to invite the market to a dialogue on the future solution for weighing residual waste at the recycling stations. The aim is to find a system with a high degree of automation/self-service, user friendliness and effective customer flow. It must take care of HSE considerations and be adapted to both the current and future needs for effective resource utilisation and sustainable operation. Avfall Sør has three recycling stations with high availability and access control. The residue waste is collected in large containers with compression; either closed compressor containers or open containers with rolling compressors. This can be changed, but a compressor system is wanted and protection from weather and wind. Key figures are given in the annex. We would like to charge for residual waste based on the weighted amount per customer, in order to comply with the polluter-payer principle and to ensure that sorting pays off. Avfall Sør has examined known systems in the market, but not found satisfactory systems. We would therefore like to have a dialogue with a tenderer who believes that they can offer this. The system must handle weighing and payment of residue waste in an efficient and user friendly way, without a requirement for dedicated manpower. Integration to established systems is not required, but we would like to present the possibilities. Tenderers are invited to submit a solution proposal with a description of relevant systems and price estimates, as well as a reference system. Deadline: 10.12.25, 16.00.Solution proposal can be sent in communication module in Mercell. Deadline for this: 03.12.25, 16:00.

result.text: We will commission projects which aim to increase democratic participation among groups who are less likely to be registered to vote and those who face other barriers. More information on these groups can be found in the attached EOI document. We will commission projects grouped under the following Lots: Lot 1: Action research projects, to pilot new and innovative approaches to democratic engagement in England Lot 2: Accessible voting projects, to support disabled and neurodivergent voters across the UK Lot 3: Digital engagement projects, to engage new and diverse audiences and explore the role that digital engagement can have in increasing participation We welcome a wide range of initiatives. We will encourage innovation and creativity from partners, while incorporating best practice in education and community engagement. Initiatives could include traditional education interventions, activities to upskill professionals and trusted community voices, initiatives to build capacity to deliver democratic engagement, events, tech-based solutions, and awareness raising activities. We will work in partnership with commissioned organisations to determine what success looks like and how we measure impact. Projects should explore a range of topics based on what is important to their audiences, such as: - Registering to vote - The voter ID requirement - Ways to vote - How to identify mis- and disinformation - What to expect at the polling station - Upcoming changes to elections This call is intended for organisations with a proven track record of delivering community or democratic engagement activities. While we welcome diverse expertise, applications from organisations whose primary focus is academic research, consultancy or market analysis are discouraged unless they are part of a joint bid led by an organisation with the required experience. Next steps If you are interested in applying for this tender, please register your interest. 1. Register on the portal The expected invitation to tender will be published on the Electoral Commission's Procurement Portal, please register as a supplier by following this link https://intendhost.co.uk/electoralcommission If you need help with registering, please may you contact the In-tend Technical Helpdesk on 0114 407 0065. 2. Contact procurement, register interest Once you have registered on the portal, please contact us stating which lot/s you intend on applying for. There is no need to formally respond to the tender at this stage with an application. To express interest, please: 1. Register on the Electoral Commission's In-Tend Procurement Portal 2. Email procurement@electoralcommission.org.uk with confirmation of interest. Please include 'WP132 Democratic Engagement Projects 2025-30' in the subject line. Contact details Name: The Electoral Commission - Procurement Team Email address: procurement@electoralcommission.org.uk

result.text: Revolutionizing Engineering Departments (hereinafter referred to as RED) is designed to build upon previous efforts in engineering education research. Specifically, previous and ongoing evaluations of the NSF Engineering Education and Centers Division program and its predecessors, as well as those related programs in the Directorate for STEM Education, have shown that prior investments have significantly improved the first year of engineering students’ experiences, incorporating engineering material, active learning approaches, design instruction, and a broad introduction to professional skills and a sense of professional practice – giving students an idea of what it means to become an engineer. Similarly, the senior year has seen notable change through capstone design experiences, which ask students to synthesize the technical knowledge, skills, and abilities they have gained with professional capacities, using reflective judgment to make decisions and communicate these effectively. However, this ideal of the senior year has not yet been fully realized, because many of the competencies required in capstone design, or required of professional engineers, are only partially introduced in the first year and not carried forward with significant emphasis through the sophomore and junior years. The Directorates for Engineering (ENG) and STEM Education (EDU) are funding projects as part of the RED program, in alignment with the Improving Undergraduate STEM Education (IUSE) framework and Professional Formation of Engineers (PFE) initiative. These projects are designing revolutionary new approaches to engineering education, ranging from changing the canon of engineering to fundamentally altering the way courses are structured to creating new departmental structures and educational collaborations with industry. A common thread across these projects is a focus on organizational and cultural change within the departments, involving students, faculty, staff, and industry in rethinking what it means to provide an engineering program. In order to continue to catalyze revolutionary approaches, while expanding the reach of those that have proved efficacious in particular contexts, the RED program supports four tracks: RED Planning (Track 1), RED Adaptation and Implementation (Track 2), RED Innovation (Track 3), and RED Innovation Partnerships (Track 4). Two- and four-year institutions are encouraged to submit to any track as appropriate for their goals and context. RED Planning (Track 1) projects will support capacity-building activities at institutions of special interest to NSF’s mission, including two-year engineering-centered programs building transfer partnerships, two-year or four-year institutions in EPSCoR jurisdictions, Primarily Undergraduate Institutions (PUIs), and Institutions of Higher Education (IHEs) in order to create more opportunities in engineering for students in every part of the country. Planning projects should provide the support for such institutions to explore the development of a RED Projects in Tracks 2, 3, & 4. RED Adaptation and Implementation (Track 2) projects will adapt and implement evidence-based organizational change strategies and actions to the local context, which helps propagate this transformation of undergraduate engineering education. RED Innovation (Track 3) projects will develop new, revolutionary approaches and change strategies that enable the transformation of undergraduate engineering education. RED Innovation Partnerships (Track 4) projects will achieve the same goals as Track 3 projects across multiple institutions. Of particular interest to this track are projects partnering two-year institutions with other eligible institutions. Projects in tracks 2, 3, & 4 will include consideration of the cultural, organizational, structural, and pedagogical changes needed to transform one or more departments to ones in which students are engaged, develop their technical and professional skills, and establish identities as professional engineers or technologists. The focus of projects in these tracks should be on the department’s disciplinary courses and program. RED project initiatives are expected to be institutionalized at the end of the funding period. Proposals are especially encouraged that address areas of increased national interest including but not limited to advanced manufacturing, advanced wireless, artificial intelligence, biotechnology, microelectronics and semiconductors, net zero technologies, sustainability, systems engineering, and quantum engineering.

result.text: Scottish Government and NHSScotland are exploring options for a single national Infection Prevention Control eSurveillance solution that will ensure consistent application across all of NHSScotland. This will replace the existing disparate systems across Health Boards. The national solution will need to: - Integrate and be interoperable with some of the numerous NHS Scotland existing systems. - Provide efficient local and national reporting. - Provide real time data (e.g. providing alerts to flag identification of an infection, provide up to date reporting) - Be available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week and must have an extremely high degree of resilience in order to minimise any periods of scheduled or unscheduled downtime. Vendors of future solutions should note that this resilience should include but not be limited to Failover and Disaster Recovery of the system with limited technical intervention. This soft market test is being conducted to determine what solutions may be available, determine the scope of any future procurement to enable the delivery of a national solution, and to ascertain indicative costs. result.text: This Challenge presents an exciting opportunity to make a positive difference in protecting children in Scotland from harm, an area of the highest priority for the Scottish Cabinet and partners. Scotland’s child protection system relies on Inter-Agency Referral Discussions (IRDs) to make timely safeguarding decisions for children (over 17,000 IRDs took place during 2024-25). IRDs are effective and work well as a process, however they are currently supported by fragmented IT systems, manual processes and localised records. This results in duplication, delays, and barriers to information sharing across agencies and local authorities. These inefficiencies increase administrative burden, reducing time available for direct support to children and families. The Scottish Government, Police Scotland and the National Social Work Agency (TBC) are seeking innovative solutions that will enable secure streamlined multi-agency information sharing for the existing IRD process, as well as providing real-time local and national data to improve child protection outcomes across Scotland.

result.text: Delivery/provision of a cloud-based software system for time recording (time management - ZWS) & personnel deployment planning (PEP) for medical services, nursing services & other service types. The subject of the procurement procedure is the provision of a cloud-based software solution (Software as a Service) for time recording (time management – ZWS) and personnel deployment planning (PEP) for the medical service (approx. 720 employees), the nursing service (approx. 2.180 employees) and other service types (approx. 1.372 employees – medical-technical service, functional service, administrative service, personnel of the training centres). In addition, approx. 500 internal and approx. 300 external students must also be managed in the system. A market-available standard solution is expressly being tendered, which can be adapted to the client's requirements through parameterisation. Individual solutions or in-house developments are excluded. This applies in particular to the bidirectional interface to the existing SAP ERP R/3 HCM infrastructure as well as to the new SAP S/4HANA environment. Further requirements for implementation, parameterisation, training and process standardisation are part of the tender documents or the specifications. The software must cover the following task areas in particular and must be provided as an integrated overall solution: -Personnel deployment planning incl. holiday and absence management (PEP) -Time management (ZWS) -Preparatory payroll accounting through the creation of collective agreement-relevant wage types in hourly or € values -Employee Self Service (ESS) -Manager Self Service (MSS) -Reporting and statistics. The interaction of these task areas is indispensable for efficient and modern personnel deployment planning, control and accounting. For this reason, these tasks must be closely linked and should appear as a single unit from a technological and user perspective. The solution must be able to be integrated without problems into the IT infrastructure available at the KC (SAP ERP R/3 HCM & SAP S/4HANA HCM & SAP IS-H/i.s.h.med) and must necessarily communicate with the software solutions already in use via standardised interfaces (state of the art). Both master data as well as attendance, absence and wage data must flow uni- and bidirectionally (depending on the data type) via the interfaces. The interface must necessarily work with change data records (data records to be changed in SAP are deleted and newly created or overwritten with new data records) in order to ensure the highest degree of automation and to minimise the need for manual intervention as far as possible. To map smooth processes, the PEP solution must ensure a consistent, secure and media-break-free data exchange. This is essential, especially for employee payroll accounting, and if it were to fail, it would have a lasting negative impact on the operation of the KC. The most automated transfer possible of required data from the legacy systems must be ensured. The new PEP solution must be able to import data from the IS-H/i.s.h.med, convert it into personnel requirements and integrate it into the deployment planning. With the help of the PEP solution, the wage types currently required at the Klinikum Chemnitz for the correct payroll accounting of all service types must be generated in accordance with the collective agreement regulations and transferred to the SAP HCM payroll and salary system in a time-controlled manner. In the medical collective agreement, 39 different wage types must currently be mapped, and in the non-medical collective agreement, 32 wage types. In some cases, wage types are created on an individual employee basis and depend on different conditions such as department, employee qualification, individual agreement. Especially with on-call duties, it happens that within a department, on-call duties are remunerated according to a fixed flat rate or according to the collective agreement regulations. The software solution must be able to map these constellations even within a month (see also the specifications). The connection of employees to the new PEP software solution is to take place in pre-defined waves. Accordingly, it must be ensured that some of the employees continue to be managed on the SAP PEP and other employees on the new PEP solution. The contractor must ensure that both systems function productively in parallel for the duration of the implementation and rollout and do not influence each other. The S/4HANA migration of the SAP ERP R/3 HCM planned in 2026 (Unicode conversion, database migration and S/4 application) must be taken into account. This concerns both project management and the function (bidirectional integration with the legacy systems HCM and ERP and the migration target, no PEP function maintenance after S/4HANA migration in the HCM). In addition, integration with the parallel project S/4HANA migration is required. The PEP solution is to be introduced on the current SAP HCM version ECC 8. Starting 2026, the transition of the SAP ERP R/3 HCM to SAP S/4HANA HCM is to take place, and with it the migration of the PEP software to the new system. Accordingly, it is assumed that the contractor has already successfully migrated the interfaces of their software solution from SAP ECC to S/4HANA and that all required functions are also fully available in the integration with an S/4HANA system (HCM and ERP). A project-specific EVB-IT cloud contract & service contract will be concluded for the procurement. The draft contract is part of this publication as well as the tender documents for the initial offer and can be further specified by the client within the framework of the procurement negotiations. The procurement is for a minimum contract term of 36 months after operational readiness has been established.

parts.source: Lieferung/Bereitstellung eines cloudbasierten Softwaresystems zur Zeiterfassung (Zeitwirtschaft - ZWS) & Personaleinsatzplanung (PEP) für ärztlichen Dienst, pflegerischen Dienst & weitere Dienstarten Gegenstand des Vergabeverfahrens ist die Bereitstellung einer cloudbasierten Softwarelösung (Software as a Service) zur Zeiterfassung (Zeitwirtschaft – ZWS) und Personaleinsatzplanung (PEP) für den ärztlichen Dienst (ca. 720 Mitarbeiter:innen), den pflegerischen Dienst (ca. 2.180 Mitarbei-ter:innen) und weitere Dienstarten (ca. 1.372 Mitarbeiter:innen – medizinisch-technischer Dienst, Funktionsdienst, Verwaltungsdienst, Personal der Ausbildungsstätten). Zusätzlich müssen auch ca. 500 interne sowie ca. 300 externe Schüler:innen im System geführt werden. Es wird ausdrücklich eine marktverfügbare Standardlösung ausgeschrieben, die durch Parametrierung auf die Bedarfe der Auftraggeberin anpassbar ist. Individuallösungen oder Eigenentwicklungen sind ausgeschlossen. Dies gilt insbesondere für die bidirektionale Schnittstelle zur bestehenden SAP ERP R/3 HCM-Infrastruktur sowie zur neuen SAP S/4HANA-Umgebung. Weitere Anforderungen an Implementierung, Parametrierung, Schulungen und Prozessstandardisierung sind Bestandteil der Vergabeunterlagen bzw. des Leistungsverzeichnisses. Die Software muss insbesondere folgende Aufgabenbereiche abdecken und ist in einer integrierten Gesamtlösung bereitzustellen: -Personaleinsatzplanung inkl. Urlaubs- und Abwesenheitsmanagement (PEP) -Zeitwirtschaft (ZWS) -Vorbereitende Lohnabrechnung durch Bildung tarifvertraglich relevanter Lohnarten in Stunden- oder €-Werten -Employee Self Service (ESS) -Manager Self Service (MSS) -Reporting und Statistiken Das Zusammenwirken dieser Aufgabenbereiche ist für eine effiziente und zeitgemäße Personaleinsatzplanung, -steuerung und -abrechnung unabdingbar. Aus diesem Grund müssen diese Aufgaben eng verknüpft sein und sollen sich aus technologischer Sicht und aus Nutzersicht als eine Einheit darstellen. Die Lösung muss problemlos in die im KC vorliegende IT Infrastruktur (SAP ERP R/3 HCM & SAP S/4HANA HCM & SAP IS-H/i.s.h.med) eingebunden werden können und zwingend über standardisierte Schnittstellen (aktueller Stand der Technik) mit den bereits genutzten Softwarelösungen kommunizieren. Über die Schnittstellen müssen sowohl Stammdaten, als auch An- und Abwesenheits- sowie Lohndaten uni- und bidirektional (je nach Datenart) fließen. Die Schnittstelle muss zwingend mit Änderungsdatensätzen arbeiten (zu ändernde Datensätze im SAP werden gelöscht und neu angelegt oder mit neuen Datensätzen überschrieben), um den höchsten Grad der Automatisierung zu gewährleisten und die Notwendigkeit manuellen Eingreifens bestmöglich zu minimieren. Zur Abbildung reibungsloser Prozesse muss die PEP Lösung einen konsistenten, sicheren und medienbruchfreien Datenaustausch sicherstellen. Gerade für die Abrechnung der Mitarbeiter ist dies unerlässlich und würde bei Ausbleiben den Betrieb des KC nachhaltig negativ beeinträchtigen. Eine möglichst automatisierte Übernahme erforderlicher Daten aus den Altsystemen muss sichergestellt werden. Die neue PEP-Lösung muss Daten aus dem IS-H/i.s.h.med importieren, in Personalbedarf wandeln und in die Einsatzplanung integrieren können. Mit Hilfe der PEP-Lösung müssen die aktuell am Klinikum Chemnitz für die korrekte Lohnabrechnung aller Dienstarten benötigten Lohnarten entsprechend der tariflichen Regelungen erzeugt und zeitgesteuert an das Lohn- und Gehaltssystem SAP HCM übergeben werden. Im ärztlichen Tarifvertrag müssen aktuell 39 unterschiedliche Lohnarten, im nichtärztlichen Tarifvertrag 32 Lohnarten abgebildet werden. Teilweise entstehen Lohnarten mitarbeiterindividuell und abhängig von unterschiedlichen Bedingungen wie Abteilung, Qualifikation des Mitarbeiters, individuelle Vereinbarung. Gerade bei Rufdiensten kommt es vor, dass innerhalb eines Bereichs Rufdienste nach einer festen Pauschale oder nach den tarifvertraglichen Regelungen vergütet werden. Die Softwarelösung muss in der Lage sein, diese Konstellationen auch untermonatig abzubilden (siehe hierzu auch Leistungsverzeichnis) Die Anbindung der Mitarbeiter an die neue PEP-Softwarelösung soll in vorher festgelegten Wellen erfolgen. Demnach muss sichergestellt sein, dass ein Teil der Mitarbeiter weiter am SAP PEP und andere Mitarbeiter an der neuen PEP-Lösung geführt werden. Der Auftragnehmer muss sicherstellen, dass für den Zeitraum der Implementierung und des Rollouts beide Systeme parallel produktiv funktionieren und sich nicht gegenseitig beeinflussen. Die in 2026 geplante S/4HANA-Migration des SAP ERP R/3 HCM (Unicode-Umstellung, Datenbankmigration und S/4-Anwendung) ist zwingend zu berücksichtigen. Dies betrifft sowohl das Projektmanagement, als auch die Funktion (bidirektionale Integration mit den Altsystemen HCM und ERP und dem Migrationsziel, keine PEP-Funktion Pflege nach S/4HANA-Migration im HCM). Zusätzlich ist eine Integration mit dem Parallelprojekt S/4HANA-Migration erforderlich. Die PEP-Lösung soll auf der aktuellen SAP HCM Version ECC 8 eingeführt werden. Beginnend 2026 soll der Umstieg des SAP ERP R/3 HCM auf SAP S/4HANA HCM erfolgen und damit auch die Migration der PEP-Software auf das neue System. Demnach wird vorausgesetzt, dass der Auftragnehmer die Schnittstellen seiner Softwarelösung bereits erfolgreich von SAP ECC auf S/4HANA migriert hat und alle geforderten Funktionen vollumfänglich auch in der Integration mit einem S/4HANA System (HCM und ERP) zur Verfügung stehen. Für die Beschaffung wird ein projektspezifischer EVB-IT-Cloudvertrag & -Dienstvertrag geschlossen. Der Vertragsentwurf ist Teil dieser Veröffentlichung sowie der Vergabeunterlagen zum Erstangebot und kann durch den Auftraggeber im Rahmen der Vergabeverhandlungen weiter konkretisiert werden. Die Beschaffung erfolgt für eine Mindestvertragslaufzeit von 36 Monaten nach Herstellung der Betriebsbereitschaft.

rejected.text: DESCRIPTION OF THE PROCUREMENT AND MARKET DIALOGUE The subject of the planned procurement is the acquisition of expert services for the establishment, development and operation of a centralised AI and Data Factory service (hereinafter the “AI & Data Factory”). The AI and Data Factory will support the Contracting Entity in developing, deploying, maintaining and continuously improving data, artificial intelligence, machine learning and analytics solutions and capabilities throughout their lifecycle. The AI and Data Factory service may include, but is not limited to, the following services: Decision Intelligence and Data Platform services Design, development, testing, deployment and continuous lifecycle management of Decision Intelligence solutions, including business intelligence, data science, machine learning, deep learning, generative AI and agentic AI, as well as related data platform capabilities. The services may include, for example: - design and implementation of data, business intelligence, advanced analytics, machine-learning and AI solutions; - continuous development, maintenance, monitoring and lifecycle management of Decision Intelligence solutions; - continuous validation and quality assurance, including model behaviour, outputs, end-result quality, data quality and data usage; - development, deployment and operation of AI and AI agent governance practices; - development, operation and continuous improvement of data platforms; and - other AI-, data-, analytics- and technology-related expert and consulting services supporting the objectives of the procurement. Data Governance and Management services Data governance and data management services may be provided as part of projects, continuous development activities and ongoing data management operations. The services may include, for example: - external data sourcing, data content development, data validation and data migration; - continuous data quality monitoring and improvement; and - development, implementation and follow-up of master data management processes for agreed data domains. The services are expected to be delivered in close collaboration with the Contracting Entity’s internal experts and other suppliers. The preliminary allocation of responsibilities between the Contracting Entity and the Supplier or Suppliers will be further specified based on the procurement preparation and market dialogue. The Contracting Entity intends to select 3 - 5 or more Suppliers. The final procurement and service delivery model, including the number of Suppliers and the allocation of responsibilities, will be determined during the preparation of the procurement. OBJECTIVES OF THE MARKET DIALOGUE The Contracting Authority seeks market input on the planned scope of the procurement, service model, preliminary service descriptions, procurement structure, competence requirements, commercial models and other elements relevant to the successful establishment and operation of the AI Factory. Suppliers are encouraged not only to comment on the Contracting Authority's preliminary proposals, but also to challenge the proposed approaches and suggest alternative, innovative or more effective solutions and operating models based on their experience, market practices and emerging AI capabilities. The Contracting Authority particularly welcomes ideas that may improve the scope, structure, flexibility, scalability, commercial model or long-term effectiveness of the procurement. The purpose of the market dialogue is to utilise market expertise in developing the procurement and to ensure that the final approach is feasible, proportionate, future-proof and aligned with market capabilities, while enabling innovation and the effective adoption of evolving AI technologies, services and operating models. PRELIMINARY TIMETABLE - Market dialogue: H2/2026 - Publication of the Invitation to Tender: Q1/2026 - Evaluation of tenders: H1/2027 - Procurement decision: H1/2027 - Contract commencement: H1/2027 ADDITIONAL INFORMATION This notice is a Prior Information Notice. It is not a contract notice or a call for tenders. The Prior Information Notice includes an invitation to participate in a market dialogue. All interested suppliers are invited to participate in technical discussions with the Contracting Entity concerning the planned procurement. The purpose of the dialogue is to discuss the procurement at a general level and to obtain market feedback on the proposed scope and definition of the procurement. Suppliers interested in participating in the market dialogue are requested to submit their expression of interest by email to tommi.aarnio@vr.fi no later than 28 September 2026 at 12:00 noon (Finnish time). Participation in the market dialogue does not oblige the Contracting Entity to proceed with the procurement, nor does it oblige suppliers to participate in any subsequent tendering procedure. Interested suppliers will be provided with preliminary procurement materials and/or questions for review and comments. The Contracting Entity may organise written consultation rounds, joint market dialogue sessions and, where considered appropriate, bilateral meetings with selected suppliers. The Contracting Entity reserves the right to amend the scope, content, procurement model, timetable and market dialogue process during the preparation of the procurement. No compensation will be paid to suppliers for participating in the market dialogue or for providing comments.

result.text: This is not a contract notice or a call for tenders, but a request for information, through which the South Karelia Wellbeing Services County invites system suppliers to register for a potential procurement. This is a request for information/market dialogue, through which Etelä-Karjalan hyvinvointialue is surveying potential system suppliers for a shift planning and working time management system. The wellbeing services county is responsible for social and healthcare and rescue services. It is the largest employer in the region, employing approximately 5 500 professionals from various fields. The vision is to be a pioneering community, which is why the wellbeing services county has accessible services, the healthiest population in Finland, and the happiest employees. Strategic priorities include impactful services that meet people's needs, as well as a skilled and motivated frontline team. The goal is, among other things, that all services are clearly guided by indicators derived from operational impact and that operations are organised in an economically sustainable manner. The personnel programme of Etelä-Karjalan hyvinvointialue is based directly on the main strategy guiding the organisation, where one of the key priorities is investing in personnel. Well-being personnel do the right things in the right way and serve their customers in the best possible way. Realising these requires efficient, secure, and user-friendly solutions. The shift planning system plays a central role in supporting the smoothness of everyday operations, the well-being of personnel at work, and cost-efficiency. The market dialogue is open to all suppliers that can offer comprehensive solutions falling within the scope of this solution package. The information obtained can be used to assess what kind of solutions are on the market, what benefits they produce, and how they suit the needs of the wellbeing services county. Through the market dialogue, the wellbeing services county aims to: 1. Understand system functionalities and key use cases 2. Clarify integration possibilities with existing systems and platforms 3. Obtain an overview of pricing models and cost structures (no individual tenders) 4. Survey delivery and service models 5. Obtain concrete examples and demos from suppliers, which can be used to illustrate the suitability of the solutions for the needs of the wellbeing services county. The focus of the dialogue is on solutions that are already in production or available on the market. Suppliers are requested to present systems and services that are available and where key functionalities are already implemented. Presentations of solutions under development or only at the concept level are not desired in this context. Registration for the market dialogue is made by the service provider's response regarding the system on offer. Marketing videos are not accepted as responses. The response must indicate the following: - What ready-made solutions and services they offer - In what kind of environments the solutions have been implemented (example descriptions, not mandatory references) - Key features of the solution that they wish to present in the market dialogue. All participants are offered equal opportunities to receive information about the market dialogue. The dialogue does not bind Etelä-Karjalan hyvinvointialue to initiate a procurement, and no procurement decisions will be made based on it. If the contracting authority considers it necessary, the possibility of holding individual meetings is reserved. The market dialogue will focus particularly on how the solutions can support the key operations of the wellbeing services county. These are not procurement requirements, but subject areas intended as a basis for discussion and illustration: - Usability - Mobile use of the system - Technical features - The system as a support for well-being at work - Personnel and competence - Data-driven management and reporting - Implementation, training, and change management - Continuous service and development - Pricing and lifecycle services. Participating suppliers are requested to provide presentations on different use cases. Participating suppliers have the opportunity to illustrate their solutions through demos or practical example situations. The wellbeing services county will provide questions and use case examples in advance, which will guide the discussion and ensure that the presentations of different suppliers can be compared equally. The market dialogue will be carried out as supplier-specific meetings via remote connection (Teams). The duration of an individual meeting is approximately 120–150 minutes. The supplier has the opportunity to present their solution and its key features. The wellbeing services county will also present pre-defined questions that support the equality and comparability of the discussion. Meetings will be held on the following days: 15.9., 18.9., 23.9. and 28.9.2026. The exact time will be agreed upon with the registered suppliers based on the order of registration and the coordination of schedules. The language of any presentations/meetings is Finnish. Registrations and brochures about the systems are requested to be sent by 11.9.2026 at 12:00 to the email address: hankinnat@ekhva.fi. This request for information/market survey does not request, and no tenders are given to this request for information; instead, this ONLY requests information related to the procurement. Participation or non-participation in the market dialogue does not affect the tenderer's position in a potential call for tenders. The market dialogue invitation does not bind the respondent (supplier) to participate in a call for tenders, and responding to this notice is not a prerequisite for participating in the actual call for tenders later. The grounds for the decision-making of the call for tenders will be specified during the process. Those participating in the market survey do not have the right to receive compensation for participation. The contracting authority does not commit to carrying out the procurement in question. The submitted material will be treated as confidential in accordance with Section 24 of the Act on the Openness of Government Activities, subsection 1, point 20.

parts.source: Tämä ei ole hankintailmoitus eikä tarjouspyyntö, vaan tietopyyntö, jolla Etelä-Karjalanhyvinvointialue pyytää järjestelmätoimittajia ilmoittautumaan mahdollista kilpailutusta varten. Kyseessä on tietopyyntö/markkinavuoropuhelu, jolla Etelä-Karjalan hyvinvointialue kartoittaa mahdollisia työvuorosuunnittelu- ja työajanhallintajärjestelmän järjestelmätoimittajia. Hyvinvointialue vastaa sosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon sekä pelastustoimen palveluista. Se on maakunnan suurin työnantaja, jossa työskentelee noin 5 500 eri alojen ammattilaista. Visiona on olla edelläkävijäyhteisö, jonka vuoksi hyvinvointialueella on saavutettavat palvelut, Suomen hyvinvoivin väestö ja onnellisimmat työntekijät. Strategisina painopisteinä ovat kohtaavat ja vaikuttavat palvelut sekä osaava ja motivoitunut etujoukkue. Tavoitteena on muun muassa, että kaikkia palveluita ohjataan selkeästi toiminnan vaikuttavuudesta johdetuilla mittareilla ja toiminta on organisoitu taloudellisesti kestävällä tavalla. Etelä-Karjalan hyvinvointialueen henkilöstöohjelma pohjautuu suoraan organisaatiota ohjaavaan päästrategiaan, jossa yhtenä kärkenä panostetaan henkilöstöön. Hyvinvoiva henkilöstö tekee oikeita asioita oikealla tavalla ja asiakastaan parhaalla tavalla palvellen. Näiden toteutuminen edellyttää tehokkaita, turvallisia ja käyttäjäystävällisiä ratkaisuja. Työvuorosuunnittelujärjestelmällä on keskeinen rooli arjen toiminnan sujuvuuden, henkilöstön työhyvinvoinnin ja kustannustehokkuuden tukemisessa. Markkinavuoropuhelu on avoin kaikille toimittajille, joilla on tarjota tämän ratkaisukokonaisuuden piiriin kuuluvia kokonaisratkaisuja. Saatavan tiedon avulla voidaan arvioida, millaisia ratkaisuja markkinoilla on, millaisia hyötyjä ne tuottavat ja miten ne soveltuvat hyvinvointialueen tarpeisiin. Markkinavuoropuhelun avulla hyvinvointialue pyrkii: 1. Ymmärtämään järjestelmien toiminnallisuuksia ja keskeisiä käyttötapauksia 2. Selvittämään integraatiomahdollisuuksia olemassa oleviin järjestelmiin ja alustoihin 3. Saamaan yleiskuvan hinnoittelumalleista ja kustannusrakenteista (ei yksittäisiä tarjouksia) 4. Kartoittamaan toimitus- ja palvelumalleja 5. Saamaan toimittajilta konkreettisia esimerkkejä ja demoja, joiden avulla voidaan havainnollistaa ratkaisujen soveltuvuutta hyvinvointialueen tarpeisiin Vuoropuhelun painopisteenä ovat ratkaisut, jotka ovat jo tuotannossa tai markkinoilla saatavilla. Toimittajia pyydetään esittelemään järjestelmiä ja palveluita, jotka ovat käytettävissä ja joissa keskeiset toiminnallisuudet ovat valmiiksi toteutettuja. Kehitteillä olevien tai vasta konseptitasolla olevien ratkaisujen esittelyä ei tässä yhteydessä toivota. Markkinavuoropuheluun ilmoittaudutaan palveluntuottajan vastauksella tarjolla olevasta järjestelmästä. Vastauksiksi eivät kelpaa markkinavideot. Vastauksesta on käytävä ilmi seuraavat asiat: - Mitä valmiita ratkaisuja ja palveluja he tarjoavat - Minkälaisissa ympäristöissä ratkaisuja on otettu käyttöön (esimerkkikuvauksia, ei pakollisia referenssejä) - Ratkaisun keskeisiä ominaisuuksia, joita he haluavat esitellä markkinavuoropuhelussa Kaikille osallistujille tarjotaan yhdenvertaiset mahdollisuudet saada tietoa markkinavuoropuhelusta. Vuoropuhelu ei sido Etelä-Karjalan hyvinvointialuetta käynnistämään hankintaa eikä sen perusteella tehdä hankintapäätöksiä. Mikäli hankintayksikkö katsoo tarpeelliseksi, varataan mahdollisuus käydä yksilökohtaisia tapaamisia. Markkinavuoropuhelussa keskitytään erityisesti siihen, miten ratkaisut voivat tukea hyvinvointialueen keskeisiä toimintoja. Nämä eivät ole hankintavaatimuksia, vaan keskustelun ja havainnollistamisen pohjaksi tarkoitettuja aihealueita: - Käytettävyys - Järjestelmän mobiilikäyttö - Tekniset ominaisuudet - Järjestelmä työhyvinvointia tukevana - Henkilöstö ja osaaminen - Tiedolla johtaminen ja raportointi - Käyttöönotto, koulutus ja muutosjohtaminen - Jatkuva palvelu ja kehitys - Hinnoittelu ja elinkaaripalvelut Osallistuvilta toimittajilta pyydetään esityksiä erilaisista käyttötavoista. Osallistuvilla toimittajilla on mahdollisuus havainnollistaa ratkaisujaan demon tai käytännön esimerkkitilanteiden kautta. Hyvinvointialue toimittaa etukäteen kysymykset ja käyttötapausesimerkit, jotka ohjaavat keskustelua ja varmistavat, että eri toimittajien esityksiä voidaan vertailla yhdenvertaisesti. Markkinavuoropuhelu toteutetaan toimittajakohtaisina tapaamisina etäyhteydellä (Teams). Yksittäisen tapaamisen kesto on noin 120–150 minuuttia. Toimittajalla on mahdollisuus esitellä ratkaisunsa sekä sen keskeiset ominaisuudet. Hyvinvointialue esittää lisäksi etukäteen määriteltyjä kysymyksiä, jotka tukevat keskustelun yhdenvertaisuutta ja vertailtavuutta. Tapaamisia järjestetään seuraavina päivinä: 15.9., 18.9., 23.9. ja 28.9.2026. Tarkka ajankohta sovitaan ilmoittautuneiden toimittajien kanssa ilmoittautumisjärjestyksen ja aikataulujen yhteensovittamisen perusteella. Mahdollisten esittelyjen/tapaamisten kieli on Suomi. Ilmoittautumiset ja esitteet järjestelmistä pyydetään lähettämään 11.9.2026 klo 12:00 mennessä sähköpostiosoitteeseen: hankinnat@ekhva.fi Tällä tietopyynnöllä/markkinakartoituksella ei pyydetä eikä tähän tietopyyntöön anneta tarjouksia, vaan tällä pyydetään VAIN hankintaan liittyviä tietoja. Markkinavuoropuheluun osallistuminen tai osallistumatta jättäminen ei vaikuta tarjoajan asemaan mahdollisessa tarjouskilpailussa. Markkinavuoropuhelukutsu ei sido vastaajaa (toimittajaa) tarjouskilpailuun osallistumiseen, eikä tähän ilmoitukseen vastaaminen ole edellytyksenä myöhemmin varsinaiseen tarjouskilpailuun osallistumiselle. Tarjouskilpailun päätöksenteon perusteet tarkentuvat prosessin aikana. Markkinakartoitukseen osallistuvilla ei ole oikeutta saada korvausta osallistumisesta. Hankintayksikkö ei sitoudu toteuttamaan asianomaista hankintaa. Toimitettu materiaali käsitellään luottamuksellisena julkisuuslain 24 §:n 1 momentin 20 kohdan mukaan.

result.text: NOTICE: Application Process as of April 6th EDA is excited to announce the launch of its new grants management platform: the Economic Development Grants Experience (EDGE). EDGE was developed to streamline the application and grants management process by implementing a single platform with increased transparency, improved user experience, higher data quality, and more efficiency throughout the entire grant lifecycle. As of April 6th, 2023, applications can no longer be submitted on Grants.gov, and will ONLY be accepted through EDGE. To apply in EDGE, please go to: sfgrants.eda.gov. More information on how to apply is provided in the full NOFO. PARTNERSHIP PLANNING program instructions: Please note that applicants will be invited to submit applications through EDGE for the Partnership Planning program. For more information, please reach out to your EDA point of contact. Program Description: EDA makes planning and local technical assistance investments to support economic development, foster job creation, and attract private investment in economically distressed areas of the United States. Under the Planning program, EDA makes Partnership Planning, Short-Term Planning, and State Planning awards to eligible recipients to create and implement regional economic development plans designed to build capacity and guide the economic prosperity and resiliency of an area or region. More specifically, EDA makes Partnership Planning investments to designated planning organizations (i.e., District Organizations) serving EDA-designated Economic Development Districts and to Indian Tribes to facilitate the development, implementation, revision, or replacement of Comprehensive Economic Development Strategies (CEDS), which articulate and prioritize the strategic economic goals of recipients’ respective regions. EDA also makes Short-Term and State Planning awards for economic development planning activities that guide the eventual creation and retention of high-quality jobs, particularly for the unemployed and underemployed in the Nation’s most economically distressed regions. Under the Local Technical Assistance program, EDA makes awards to strengthen the capacity of local or State organizations, institutions of higher education, and other eligible entities to undertake and promote effective economic development programs through projects such as feasibility studies, impact analyses, disaster resiliency plans, and project planning. *Please note: While the published Notice of Funding Opportunity (available under "Related Documents") states that the ED900A form and the SF424B form are both required for a complete application, these forms are no longer required and have therefore been removed from the package template.

result.text: Siemens-Betriebskrankenkasse (SBK) intends to procure cloud computing services (IaaS and PaaS) to modernise and strengthen its IT infrastructure. The contract comprises the secure, efficient and legally compliant provision of compute, storage, database and platform services as well as connection to the existing on-premises environment. The services must fulfil the operation of critical infrastructures in accordance with BSI-KritisV, the sector-specific security standards (B3S-GKV/PV) as well as all technical, organisational and legal requirements by the start of the contract (anticipated at the beginning of 2026). The objective is a high-performance, scalable and sustainable cloud environment for the stable operation of IT workloads and the processing of social data.

Die Services müssen den Betrieb kritischer Infrastrukturen nach BSI-KritisV, die branchenspezifischen Sicherheitsstandards (B3S-GKV/PV) sowie alle technischen, organisatorischen und rechtlichen Anforderungen bis Vertragsbeginn (voraussichtlich Anfang 2026) erfüllen. result.text: Medway Council (‘the Authority’) is a unitary authority based in Kent, consisting of the main towns of Strood, Rochester, Chatham, Gillingham, and Rainham. The highway network in the Medway towns covers approximately 840km, with 110km of A roads, 37km of B roads, 97km of C road, and 596km of unclassified roads. A safe and effective transport network is therefore key to Medway’s sustainability, both economically and environmentally. To help achieve this the Council are inviting applications to join Medway Council’s Road Safety Audit Framework (MCRSAF). The MCRSAF will allow the Authority, as the Overseeing Organisation, to quickly and efficiently commission an outside contractor to undertake road safety audits on behalf of the Authority for highway schemes and interventions. The aim is to have a pool of high-quality auditors that the Authority can call upon to undertake Road Safety Audits quickly, cost effectively, to a high standard, and in accordance with the requirements and methodology of GG119 of the Design Manual for Roads and Bridges, with the Authority acting as the Overseeing Organisation. The Framework Contract is anticipated to commence on 1st November 2026 and will continue for a period of two years, with the option of extending the Framework Contract for an additional two years thereafter, via two separate one year extensions. For more information about this opportunity, please visit the eSourcing portal at: https://www.delta-esourcing.com/tenders/UK-UK-Chatham:-Road-inspection-services./7664JF53XM To respond to this opportunity, please click here: https://www.delta-esourcing.com/respond/7664JF53XM Lot 1: .

result.text: The contracting authorities are conducting a competitive dialogue for the development of a chatbot for the Bergisches Servicecenter as well as for the administrations of the three contracting authorities in accordance with the provisions of the German Public Procurement Ordinance (VgV). The tender aims to develop a chatbot for the Bergisches Servicecenter and the three contracting authorities, which is to be used to execute or perform, among other things, both the services of the Bergisches ServiceCenter and the services of the administrations of the cities of Remscheid, Solingen and Wuppertal at the level of information provision to the public and interaction regarding the administrative services of the three cities. In the future, the chatbot is to be further developed in line with the current state of the art, particularly at the interaction and transaction level as well as for internal administrative support. The contracting authorities shall be entitled, both jointly for the Bergisches Servicecenter and individually, to call off services from the contractor regarding the developed chatbot (cf. draft contract, Annex C to the 2. Letter of Procedure). The subject of the contract is the development of a chatbot system to fulfil service tasks or services of the Bergisches Servicecenter at the level of information provision to the population of the cities of Remscheid, Solingen and Wuppertal. Regarding the functional scope of the chatbot, the solution concepts must take into account the future further development of the interaction and transaction level as well as the possibility of internal administrative support. Furthermore, the subject of the contract also includes the maintenance, further development and adaptation of the chatbot system. On the one hand, the chatbot system should be able to implement, within the framework of providing information to citizens, companies and other information seekers, in particular direct information on available services, forwarding to corresponding services and information, and prospectively, at the interaction and transaction level, among other things, advice on services. On the other hand, with regard to internal administration, the chatbot system is prospectively intended to support, among other things, text management, research assistants and an internal service bot. The chatbot is to be implemented in particular as a multilingual, AI-supported large language model, with transparent, consistent and friendly or citizen-oriented language, with constant citation of sources, and in compliance with data protection and IT security law.

parts.source: Die Auftraggeber führen einen wettbewerblichen Dialog zur Entwicklung eines Chatbots für das Bergische Servicecenter sowie für die Verwaltungen der drei Auftraggeber nach den Regelungen der Vergabeverordnung (VgV) durch. Mit der Ausschreibung soll für das Bergische Servicecenter sowie für die drei Auftraggeber ein Chatbot entwickelt werden, mit dem unter anderem sowohl die Angebote des Bergischen ServiceCenters als auch die Angebote der Verwaltungen der Städte Remscheid, Solingen und Wuppertal auf der Ebene der Informationsbereitstellung gegenüber der Bevölkerung und die Interaktion bzgl. der Verwaltungsleistungen der drei Städte ausgeführt bzw. wahrgenommen werden soll. Zukünftig soll der Chatbot entsprechend des aktuellen Stands der Technik weiterentwickelt werden, insbesondere auf der Interaktions- und Transaktionsebene sowie auch zur internen Verwaltungsunterstützung. Die Auftraggeber sollen sowohl gemeinsam für das Bergische Servicecenter als auch jeweils einzeln berechtigt sein, Leistungen vom Auftraggeber hinsichtlich des entwickelten Chatbots abrufen zu können (vgl. Vertragsentwurf, Anlage C zum 2. Verfahrensbrief). Auftragsgegenstand ist die Entwicklung eines Chatbotsystems zur Erfüllung von Serviceauf-gaben bzw. Angeboten des Bergischen Servicecenters auf der Ebene der Informationsbereitstellung gegenüber der Bevölkerung der Städte Remscheid, Solingen und Wuppertal. In den Lösungskonzepten ist bezüglich des Funktionsumfangs des Chatbots die zukünftig wei-tere Entwicklung der Interaktions- und Transaktionsebene sowie die Möglichkeit der internen Verwaltungsunterstützung zu berücksichtigen. Weiterhin ist Gegenstand des Auftrags auch die Pflege, Weiterentwicklung und Anpassung des Chatbotsystems. Das Chatbotsystem soll zum einen im Rahmen der Informationsbereitstellung für Bürger, Unternehmen und andere Informationssuchende insbesondere direkte Auskünfte zu verfüg-baren Dienstleistungen, Weiterleitungen zu entsprechenden Leistungen und Informationen sowie perspektivisch auf Interaktions- und Transaktionsebene unter anderem Beratungen zu Dienstleistungen umsetzen können. Hinsichtlich der internen Verwaltung sollen zum anderen perspektivisch durch das Chatbotsystem unteranderem die Textverwaltung, Rechercheassistenten und ein interner Servicebot unterstützt werden. Der Chatbot soll insbesondere multilingual, als KI-gestütztes Large-Language-Model, mit transparenter, widerspruchsfreier und freundlicher bzw. bürgernaher Sprache, mit stetiger Angabe von Quellen sowie unter Beachtung von datenschutz- und IT-sicherheitsrechtlicher Konformität umgesetzt werden.

result.text: An industry dialogue and market consultation have shown that no high-performance gigabit infrastructure with an offer of corresponding telecommunications services is currently available area-wide in the regional authority in accordance with the objectives of the Gigabit Framework 2.0 and will not be available in the coming years. The regional authority has therefore applied for funding for area-wide gigabit expansion using the viability gap funding model under the guideline "Funding to support the gigabit expansion of telecommunications networks in the Federal Republic of Germany - Federal Gigabit Guideline 2.0 (Federal Gigabit Guideline 2.0)" dated 31 March 2023 in the version of the 1 amendment dated 30.04.2024 ("Gigabit Guideline 2.0") and has received the notification of the final amount of the grant. The funding provided under this funding programme using the viability gap funding model (hereinafter: funds) is to be passed on by regional authorities to telecommunications companies within the meaning of EU state aid law as investment aid for the construction and operation of gigabit networks. The Stadt Münchberg (hereinafter: concession grantor) is conducting an open, transparent, economic and non-discriminatory selection procedure based on funding regulations in accordance with the guideline and framework specified above in order to select a network operator who can implement the establishment and operation of a gigabit network with a public subsidy. Applicants are given the opportunity to submit a bid by the end of the bidding period. Please refer to the attached documents for details.

result.text: Smart Applications Management Limited (SAM) is the trading name of South West Smart Applications Limited, a Membership based central purchasing body, which owns and runs the National Mobilities Procurement Hub for its Members. The Goods and Services will be supplied via Award Without Competition and by Competitive Selection Process. Lot 1 of this Framework is seeking the provision of On Vehicle Digital Technology (AVL, CCTV, APC, TLP, Comms, On Bus Destination, AVA, Bridge Strike Systems & Vehicle Compute Capability). Lot 1 - has 9 parts: Lot 1 - Part 1 - Automated Vehicle Location (AVL) Solution Provision of an integrated Automated Vehicle Location solution capable of accurately determining and communicating vehicle location in real time. The solution shall support route, journey and stop association, estimated arrival/departure information and integration with other onboard and back-office systems. Requirements include resilient positioning, industry-standard data interfaces, remote configuration, monitoring, diagnostics, reporting, security and ongoing support throughout the solution lifecycle. Lot 1 - Part 2 - Closed Circuit Television (CCTV) Solution Provision of a comprehensive onboard CCTV solution providing appropriate internal and external vehicle coverage for passenger safety, operational management and incident investigation. The solution shall support continuous high-quality recording, secure storage and retrieval, authorised access and evidential integrity. Requirements include integration with other onboard systems, equipment health monitoring, remote diagnostics, secure communications, configurable camera arrangements and enhanced analytics where required. Lot 1 - Part 3 - Automatic Passenger Counting (APC) Solution Provision of an Automatic Passenger Counting solution capable of accurately recording passenger boarding and alighting and determining vehicle occupancy without driver intervention. The solution shall provide reliable passenger-count data for operational, planning and passenger-information purposes and integrate with onboard and central systems. Requirements include appropriate counting accuracy, standardised interfaces, secure data transfer, reporting, monitoring, diagnostics, remote management and resilient operation. Lot 1 - Part 4 - Traffic Light Priority (TLP) Solution Provision of a Traffic Light Priority solution enabling suitably equipped vehicles to request priority at traffic signals based on vehicle location, route and operational circumstances. The solution shall support configurable and conditional priority strategies and integration with vehicle, roadside and central systems. Requirements include secure, low-latency communications, monitoring and reporting, remote configuration, interoperability, performance analysis, testing, cybersecurity and ongoing technical support. Lot 1 - Part 5 - Comms Tool (Radio) Solution Provision of an onboard communications solution enabling reliable and secure voice and data communication between drivers, vehicles and operational control functions. The solution shall support operational messaging, service information, alerts and emergency communications through an appropriate driver interface. Requirements include integration with other onboard systems, secure communications, operational logging, remote configuration, equipment monitoring, diagnostics and resilient operation across the vehicle fleet. Lot 1 - Part 6 - On-Bus Destination Solution Provision of integrated on-bus destination equipment capable of clearly displaying route and destination information to passengers and intending passengers. Solutions shall support appropriate front, side and rear displays, accessibility and visibility requirements and integration with onboard systems to automate displayed information. Requirements include remote configuration, operational overrides, equipment monitoring, diagnostics, secure communications, robust vehicle-grade equipment and ongoing maintenance and support. Lot 1 - Part 7 - Audio Visual Passenger Information (AVA) Solution Provision of an accessible onboard Audio Visual Passenger Information solution delivering automated visual and audible information concerning routes, destinations, next stops, disruptions and other relevant passenger messages. The solution shall integrate with vehicle location and onboard systems to trigger information accurately. Requirements include accessible presentation, remote and priority messaging, configurable content, secure communications, monitoring, diagnostics, resilient operation and ongoing system support. Lot 1 - Part 8 - Bridge Strike Prevention Solution Provision of an onboard Bridge Strike Prevention solution designed to reduce the risk of vehicles approaching or striking structures with insufficient clearance. The solution shall use vehicle dimensions together with accurate location, mapping and detection information to provide timely audible and visual driver warnings. Requirements include reliable hazard identification, minimisation of false alerts, offline resilience, secure updates, event logging, diagnostics and onboard-system integration. Lot 1 - Part 9 - Vehicle Compute Capability (VCC) Solution Provision of a robust onboard Vehicle Compute Capability providing a shared computing platform for hosting, integrating and managing multiple vehicle applications and data services. The solution shall provide sufficient processing capacity, storage and future scalability while supporting secure application separation and interoperability. Requirements include edge processing, secure communications, remote software management, monitoring and diagnostics, onboard-system integration and future expansion throughout its operational lifecycle. Lot 2 is for Franchising and Wider Transport Ticketing & Payment Consultancy Services.

Lot 2 is for Franchising and Wider Transport Ticketing & Payment Consultancy Services. It has 6 Parts: Lot 2 - Part 1 - Franchised Bus Scheme Development and Implementation Support The provision of specialist consultancy services to support the development, assessment and implementation of bus franchising schemes. Services may include business cases, network and commercial design, financial modelling, consultation, procurement, mobilisation, integrated fares and ticketing, assets and technology, contract management, service permits, independent assurance and stakeholder engagement. Lot 2 - Part 2 - Transport Ticketing Management Policy Advice The provision of strategic, policy and management consultancy relating to transport ticketing and payment systems. Services may encompass ITSO, Stored Value, contactless EMV, barcode and QR ticketing, Account Based and Multi-Token Ticketing, Mobility as a Service, and wider ticketing initiatives across public-sector authorities, transport operators and national organisations. Lot 2 - Part 3 - Transport Ticketing Technical & Revenue Scheme Delivery The provision of technical consultancy and delivery support for transport ticketing schemes, including development of technical specifications, implementation and integration of ITSO and other ticketing technologies, Electronic Ticket Machines and ticketing readers. Lot 2 - Part 4 - Transport Ticketing Governance, Research and Competitive Bidding Services The provision of specialist support relating to transport ticketing governance, research, procurement and competitive funding or bidding activities. Services may include governance advice for public and commercial organisations, preparation of grant, tender and franchise submissions, support for public procurement exercises, and research activities contributing to sustainable transport policy and delivery. Lot 2 - Part 5 - Entitlement (Concessionary) Travel Management Services The provision of management, policy and project support for entitlement and concessionary travel schemes, with particular emphasis on revenue reimbursement and apportionment. Services may include multi-operator and multimodal schemes, multiple ITSO HOPS and Customer Management Systems, and schemes operating across multiple ticketing channels, technologies and participating organisations. Lot 2 - Part 6 - Technical Entitlement (Concessionary) Support Services The provision of specialist technical support for entitlement and concessionary travel schemes, including reimbursement implementation, revenue modelling and apportionment, ETM data analysis, national reimbursement guidance and alternative allocation methodologies. Services may also encompass auditable datasets, payment reporting, stakeholder-led revenue solutions and expert technical evidence supporting appeals, tribunals or legal proceedings. Lot 2 Goods and Services will be supplied via Award Without Competition and by Competitive Selection Process.

result.text: INVITATION TO MARKET DIALOGUE With this RFI Yle invites interested suppliers to participate in the market dialogue held prior publishing the call for tenders (RFP). With this RFI Yle gathers insights and proposals for solutions that will help us achieve a system (or systems), which meets all Yle's requirements as well as both the current and future production needs. The system and all of its components should create an environment, which workflows are easy for users, and which communicates flawlessly with other systems that Yle has. Yle is looking for either a) a single vendor system with all the features or; b) a modular solution from different vendors. The description and object of the RFI, as well as the schedule of the procurement process, are preliminary and Yle will specify the needs and objectives of the procurement in the final RFP. It may also be that no invitation to tender is published in case Yle decides not to proceed with the renewal. At this point Yle is looking to identify the solutions available in the market that could meet Yle’s needs. It is possible that there will be round 2 of RFI before publishing the final request for proposals (RFP). In case, at this point, Yle feels it is needed, we will schedule meetings with the few chosen suppliers. Please see the appendix of this RFI for further information. INTERESTED? Interested suppliers are invited to take part in the market dialogue by sending a request to participate by email to tarjoukset.yle(at)yle.fi at latest by 15th of November 2025. In case you have any questions, please don’t hesitate to contact us. Please include a description or additional appendices covering the following topics in your email: - Description of the solution you provide, including a description of which key features are included in your solution - A short company presentation, including the size of the company in terms of revenue and number of employees. - Your previous experience and few appropriate reference cases. - Reference architecture view - Description of your licence and pricing model - Description of your cyber security policies and continuity planning - Description of your GDPR policies - Your general agreement terms and conditions and description of SLA terms if possible We will review the answers as soon as they are received.

result.text: Project reason TenneT requires a portfolio management system (PMS) to support electricity trading in the short-term market (day-ahead and intraday) in Germany. Objective of the tender The objective is the procurement of a high-performance PMS to support electricity trading. In accordance with TenneT's architectural guidelines, the solution is to be cloud-based, preferably operated in the tenderer's cloud. In coordination with TenneT, deployment in a third-party provider's cloud (e.g. Azure) or at TenneT is also possible. The system must enable the management of multiple portfolios and support the processes for participating in day-ahead and intraday auctions as well as continuous intraday trading. The system will be used in the electricity trading sector and must cover the following main functions: - Portfolio management - Connection to power exchanges - Trading overviews & GUI - Algo-trader / trading support in continuous intraday trading - Data management - Reporting & analysis - Settlement - Schedule management Scope of services - Provision of a COTS software solution (licences) - Support & maintenance of this solution (maintenance) - Hosting of the solution - Application management services - Consulting and training services Procedural notice A detailed specification of services as well as other procedural-relevant documents will be provided after signing a non-disclosure agreement. Please send this to us completed and signed via the Mercell messaging function. The tender is being conducted in accordance with the SektVO (Sectoral Procurement Ordinance) via a negotiated procedure with a call for competition. Accordingly, TenneT is already bound to confidentiality pursuant to Section 15 SektVO. As things stand, the value of the tender cannot be reliably estimated.

parts.source: Projektanlass TenneT benötigt ein Portfoliomanagementsystem (PMS) zur Unterstützung des Stromhandels im Kurzfristmarkt (Day-Ahead und Intraday) in Deutschland. Ziel der Ausschreibung Ziel ist die Beschaffung eines leistungsfähigen PMS zur Unterstützung des Stromhandels. Entsprechend der architektonischen Vorgaben der TenneT soll die Lösung cloudbasiert, bevorzugt in der Cloud des Bieters betrieben werden. Abgestimmt mit TenneT ist auch eine Bereitstellung in der Cloud eines Drittanbieters (z.B. Azure) oder bei TenneT möglich. Das System muss die Verwaltung mehrerer Portfolien ermöglichen und die Prozesse für die Teilnahme an den Day-Ahead- und Intraday-Auktionen sowie dem kontinuierlichen Intradayhandel unterstützen. Das System wird im Bereich Stromhandel eingesetzt und hat folgende Hauptfunktionen abzudecken: - Portfoliomanagement - Anbindung an die Strombörsen - Handelsübersichten & GUI - Algo-Trader/Handelsunterstützung im kontinuierlichen Intraday-Handel - Datenmanagement - Reporting & Analyse - Abrechnung - Fahrplanmanagement Leistungsumfang - Zur-Verfügung-Stellung einer COTS Software Lösung (Lizenzen) - Support & Maintenance dieser Lösung (Wartung) - Hosting der Lösung - Application Management Services - Beratungs- und Schulungsleistungen Verfahrenshinweis Eine detaillierte Leistungsbeschreibung, sowie weitere Verfahrensrelevante Dokumente werden nach Unterzeichnung einer Geheimhaltungsvereinbarung bereitgestellt. Senden Sie uns diese bitte ausgefüllt und unterschrieben per Mercell Nachrichtenfunktion zu. Die Ausschreibung erfolgt gemäß SektVO im Verhandlungsverfahren mit Teilnahmewettbewerb. Demnach ist TenneT bereits gemäß §15 SektVO zur Vertraulichkeit verpflichtet. Der Ausschreibungswert kann, Stand jetzt, nicht belastbar geschätzt werden.

rejected.text: The employee survey in The Norwegian Defence Estates Agency is carried out annually, usually at the end of January/February. The Norwegian Defence Estates Agency has had a very high response percentage in recent years, between 82 % and 87%. In 2025, the survey was sent out to just over 2,000 respondents. The Norwegian Defence Estates Agency currently uses Rambøll as its supplier and they are responsible for the entire process - from dispatching and administration to analysing the results. The results will be presented in an insight report that will be presented to the management team. With new competence in the HR department, including HR analyst competence, Forsvarsbygg is now considering taking a greater degree of ownership of the survey. The Norwegian Defence Estates Agency is looking at an option to administer the survey itself and get access to raw data, so that own analyses can be carried out, etc. Practical aspects of the market dialogue: There is a form (Excel sheet) that can be answered and the deadline is set at 12:00 1 December 2025. Input and form are submitted by using the communication module in Mercell. Based on received responses, the Norwegian Defence Estates Agency will make an assessment and possibly call in some suppliers for 1:1 conversations - if the Norwegian Defence Estates Agency deems it appropriate. These 1:1 meetings are likely to take place via Teams (possibly physically at The Norwegian Defence Estates Agency at Grev Wedels plass 5).
