result.text: Framework agreement for the supply of conference, presentation and media technology including the provision of lot-related associated services for the purpose of holding video conferences as part of hybrid committee meetings of municipal authorised retrieval beneficiaries in Schleswig-Holstein North Region: District of Nordfriesland, District of Schleswig-Flensburg, City of Flensburg; Central Region: District of Dithmarschen, District of Plön, District of Rendsburg-Eckernförde, District of Steinburg, City of Kiel, City of Neumünster; South Region: District of Ostholstein, District of Segeberg, District of Pinneberg, District of Stormarn, District of Lauenburg Duchy, City of Lübeck; The subject matter of this lot is the supply, assembly, commissioning and documentation of permanently installed projection screens for municipal meeting rooms (meeting rooms, conference halls or similar) and service. The services comprise in particular: • On-site measurements • Supply of the screens including all fixing materials • Dismantling and disposal of old screens (in individual cases) • Assembly and ready-for-use installation • Electrical connection for motor control • Functional testing • Instruction of the client (for retractable screens) • Handover of documentation • Disposal of packaging material Installation generally takes place in existing buildings during ongoing operations. In individual cases, installation takes place as part of the redesign of a meeting or conference room.; The subject matter of this lot is the supply of mobile projection screens including transport bags for flexible use in municipal meeting, conference and event rooms. The screens are used for changing locations within municipal properties and must be capable of being transported, set up and operated by one person. The supply comprises: • Mobile projection screen • Stand or support system • Transport and protective bag • Operating instructions • Proof of warranty • Delivery to the place of performance; The subject matter of this lot is the supply of a fully integrated, ultra-mobile media trolley for holding: • Council meetings • Committee meetings • Hybrid committee meetings • Hybrid citizen assemblies Operation is carried out by changing users without special media technology knowledge. The solution must be designed as a compact all-in-one unit and contain all components for image, audio and voice transmission.; The subject matter of this lot is all services for the ready-for-use handover of a permanently installed projection system consisting of ceiling projector(s), ceiling bracket(s), signal transmission, control technology, cabling and all accessories required for operation, including planning, assembly, cabling, configuration, instruction and documentation, as well as service. The system is used to display presentations, meeting documents, video conferences, live streams and other media content in council, committee, meeting and conference rooms.; The subject matter of this lot is the supply, setup, ready-for-use handover of mobile projection systems (beamers) including transport accessories, connection cables and all components required for operation, as well as service. The devices are intended for flexible use in council, committee, meeting, training and event rooms for displaying presentations, meeting documents, video conferences and multimedia content. The projectors must be usable at different locations within the administration without permanent installation.; The subject matter of this lot is the supply, assembly, commissioning and ready-for-use handover of interactive all-in-one collaboration boards with an integrated touch display, whiteboard function, video conferencing technology, loudspeaker system, microphone array and screen sharing, as well as service. The systems are used to hold face-to-face, hybrid and video conferences as well as for the joint editing of documents, presentations and meeting documents. The contractor shall assume responsibility for delivery, assembly, configuration, commissioning, documentation, training and support.; The subject matter of this lot is the supply, assembly, commissioning and calibration of a permanently installed sound reinforcement system for voice transmission in committee and meeting rooms, as well as service. The system is used to support face-to-face, hybrid and video conferences and is designed for continuous operation in municipal meeting rooms. The contractor shall assume all services required for ready-for-use handover, including an on-site appointment for stock-taking, specialist planning, cabling, assembly, configuration, documentation, instruction and service.; The subject matter of this lot is the supply of mobile conference speakers (speakerphones/soundbar) for use in meeting and committee rooms, as well as service. The devices are used to hold face-to-face, hybrid and video conferences with multiple participants and must be compatible with common conference platforms.; The subject matter of this lot is the supply, setup, commissioning and ready-for-use handover of a wireless digital conference microphone system for council, committee, advisory board and committee meetings. The system consists of member and chairmanship microphone units including gooseneck microphones, integrated loudspeakers, battery systems, charging infrastructure, control unit, accessories and all components required for operation. The system must be suitable for face-to-face meetings, hybrid meetings, live streams, recordings and connection to video conferencing systems. The contractor shall assume planning, supply, configuration, commissioning, instruction, documentation and service.;

parts.source: Rahmenvereinbarung über die Lieferung von Konferenz-, Präsentations- und Medientechnik einschließlich Erbringung losbezogener hiermit verbundener Dienstleistungen zum Zweck der Durchführung von Videokonferenzen im Rahmen hybrider Gremiensitzungen kommunaler Abrufberechtigter in Schleswig-Holstein Region Nord: Kreis Nordfriesland, Kreis Schleswig-Flensburg, Stadt Flensburg; Region Mitte: Kreis Dithmarschen, Kreis Plön, Kreis Rendsburg-Eckernförde, Kreis Steinburg, Stadt Kiel, Stadt Neumünster; Region Süd: Kreis Ostholstein, Kreis Segeberg, Kreis Pinneberg, Kreis Stormarn, Kreis Herzogtum-Lauenburg, Stadt Lübeck; Gegenstand dieses Loses ist die Lieferung, Montage, Inbetriebnahme und Dokumentation von fest installierten Projektionsleinwänden für Räume für kommunale Sitzungen (Besprechungs-räume, Sitzungssäle oder ähnliche) und Service. Die Leistungen umfassen insbesondere: • Aufmaß vor Ort • Lieferung der Leinwände einschließlich sämtlicher Befestigungsmaterialien • Demontage und Entsorgung von Altleinwänden (im Einzelfall) • Montage und betriebsfertige Installation • elektrische Anbindung bei Motorsteuerung • Funktionsprüfung • Einweisung des Auftraggebers (bei einziehbaren Leinwänden) • Übergabe der Dokumentation • Entsorgung von Verpackungsmaterial Die Installation erfolgt in der Regel in Bestandsgebäuden während des laufenden Betriebs. In Einzelfällen erfolgt die Installation im Rahmen einer Neugestaltung eines Sitzungs- oder Be-sprechungsraumes.; Gegenstand dieses Loses ist die Lieferung von mobilen Projektleinwänden einschließlich Transporttaschen für den flexiblen Einsatz in kommunalen Sitzungs-, Besprechungs- und Veranstaltungsräumen. Die Leinwände werden für wechselnde Einsatzorte innerhalb kommunaler Liegenschaften verwendet und müssen von einer Person transportiert, aufgebaut und betrieben werden können. Die Lieferung umfasst: • Mobile Projektionsleinwand • Stand- bzw. Tragesystem • Transport- und Schutztasche • Bedienungsanleitung • Garantienachweise • Lieferung an den Erfüllungsort; Gegenstand dieses Loses ist die Lieferung eines vollständig integrierten, ultra-mobilen Medienwagens zur Durchführung von: • Ratssitzungen • Ausschusssitzungen • Hybriden Gremiensitzungen • Hybriden Bürgerversammlungen Die Bedienung erfolgt durch wechselnde Nutzende ohne besondere medientechnische Kenntnisse. Die Lösung muss als kompakte All-in-one-Einheit ausgeführt sein und sämtliche Komponenten zur Bild-, Ton- und Sprachübertragung beinhalten.; Gegenstand dieses Loses sind sämtliche Leistungen zur betriebsbereiten Übergabe eines fest installierten Projektionssystems bestehend aus Deckenprojektor(en), Deckenhalterung(en), Signalübertragung, Steuerungstechnik, Verkabelung sowie sämtlichem für den Betrieb erforderlichen Zubehör einschließlich Planung, Montage, Verkabelung, Konfiguration, Einweisung und Dokumentation sowie Service. Das System dient der Darstellung von Präsentationen, Sitzungsunterlagen, Videokonferenzen, Livestreams und sonstigen medialen Inhalten in Rats-, Ausschuss-, Besprechungs- und Konferenzräumen.; Gegenstand dieses Loses sind Lieferung, Einrichtung und betriebsbereite Übergabe mobiler Projektionssysteme (Beamer) einschließlich Transportzubehör, Anschlusskabeln und aller für den Betrieb erforderlichen Komponenten sowie Service. Die Geräte dienen der flexiblen Nutzung in Rats-, Ausschuss-, Besprechungs-, Schulungs- und Veranstaltungsräumen zur Darstellung von Präsentationen, Sitzungsunterlagen, Videokonferenzen und multimedialen Inhalten. Die Projektoren müssen ohne feste Installation an unterschiedlichen Standorten innerhalb der Verwaltung einsetzbar sein.; Gegenstand dieses Loses sind Lieferung, Montage, Inbetriebnahme und betriebsbereite Übergabe interaktiver All-in-one Collaboration Boards mit integriertem Touchdisplay, Whiteboard-Funktion, Videokonferenztechnik, Lautsprechersystem, Mikrofonarray und Bildschirmfreigabe sowie Service. Die Systeme dienen der Durchführung von Präsenz-, Hybrid- und Videokonferenzen sowie der gemeinsamen Bearbeitung von Dokumenten, Präsentationen und Sitzungs-unterlagen. Der Auftragnehmer übernimmt Lieferung, Montage, Konfiguration, Inbetriebnahme, Dokumentation, Schulung und Support.; Gegenstand dieses Loses sind Lieferung, Montage, Inbetriebnahme und Einmessung eines fest installierten Beschallungssystems für die Sprachübertragung in Gremien-, Ausschuss- und Besprechungsräume sowie Service. Das System dient der Unterstützung von Präsenz-, Hybrid- und Videokonferenzen und ist für einen dauerhaften Betrieb in kommunalen Sitzungsräumen ausgelegt. Der Auftragnehmer übernimmt sämtliche zur betriebsbereiten Übergabe erforderlichen Leistungen einschließlich Vor-Ort-Termin zur Bestandsaufnahme, Fachplanung, Verkabelung, Montage, Konfiguration, Dokumentation, Einweisung und Service.; Gegenstand dieses Loses ist die Lieferung von mobilen Konferenzlautsprechern (Speakerphones/Soundbar) zur Nutzung in Sitzungs-, Besprechungs- und Gremienräumen sowie Service. Die Geräte dienen der Durchführung von Präsenz-, Hybrid- und Videokonferenzen mit mehreren Teilnehmern und müssen mit gängigen Konferenzplattformen kompatibel sein.; Gegenstand dieses Loses sind Lieferung, Einrichtung, Inbetriebnahme und betriebsbereite Übergabe eines drahtlosen digitalen Konferenzmikrofonsystems für Rats-, Ausschuss-, Bei-rats- und Gremiensitzungen. Das System besteht aus Mitglieds- und Präsidiumssprechstellen einschließlich Schwanenhalsmikrofonen, integrierten Lautsprechern, Akkusystemen, Ladeinfrastruktur, Steuerungseinheit, Zubehör sowie sämtlichen für den Betrieb erforderlichen Komponenten. Das System muss für Präsenzsitzungen, hybride Sitzungen, Livestreams, Aufzeichnungen sowie die Anbindung an Videokonferenzsysteme geeignet sein. Der Auftragnehmer übernimmt Planung, Lieferung, Konfiguration, Inbetriebnahme, Einweisung, Dokumentation und Service.;

result.text: The subject matter of this lot comprises the supply, installation, commissioning and operational handover of a professional wireless handheld microphone system, including microphone stands, charging equipment, radio receivers, accessories and all components required for use. The system is used for voice transmission at council, committee, advisory board, meeting and hybrid events as well as public sessions. The contractor shall undertake all services required for operational handover, including supply, installation, configuration, frequency planning, calibration, documentation, briefing and service.; The subject matter of this lot comprises the supply, assembly, setup, commissioning and operational handover of professional PTZ room cameras (pan-tilt-zoom) for use in meeting, conference, committee and council chambers. The cameras are used for high-quality video recording of meetings, discussions, video conferences, live streams and hybrid events. The contractor shall undertake all services including planning, on-site measurements, supply, assembly, cabling, configuration, commissioning, documentation, briefing and service.; The subject matter of this lot comprises the supply, setup and operational handover of mobile intelligent conference camera systems for council, committee, meeting, training and conference rooms, as well as service. The systems must enable comprehensive audio and video capture of in-person participants and be suitable for hybrid meetings and video conferences. The systems shall consist at least of: • camera system • microphone array • loudspeaker system • power supply unit • connection cables • transport accessories (transport bag or transport case) • required software; The subject matter of this lot comprises the supply, assembly, setup, commissioning and operational handover of frontal video conferencing camera systems (video bars) for meeting, conference, committee, training and body rooms, as well as service. The systems must integrate camera, microphone array and loudspeaker system into a single device and be suitable for hybrid meetings, video conferences, digital collaboration and presentations. The systems are intended in particular for mounting on or beneath interactive displays, smartboards or large screens. The contractor shall undertake supply, documentation and support.; The subject matter of this lot comprises the supply, setup and operational handover of accessory components for media, presentation and conference technology, as well as service. The components are used for signal transmission, connection of mobile end devices, expansion of presentation systems and management of multiple signal sources within meeting, training, conference and body rooms. The contractor shall supply all accessory components including necessary adapters, connecting cables and documentation.

parts.source: Gegenstand dieses Loses sind Lieferung, Aufbau, Inbetriebnahme und betriebsbereite Übergabe eines professionellen drahtlosen Handmikrofonsystems einschließlich Mikrofonständern, Ladeeinrichtungen, Funkempfängern, Zubehör und aller zur Nutzung erforderlichen Komponenten. Die Kameras dienen der hochwertigen Videoerfassung von Sitzungen, Besprechungen, Videokonferenzen, Livestreams und hybriden Veranstaltungen. Der Auftragnehmer übernimmt sämtliche Leistungen einschließlich Planung, Vor-Ort-Aufmaß, Lieferung, Montage, Verkabelung, Konfiguration, Inbetriebnahme, Dokumentation und Einweisung sowie Service.; Gegenstand dieses Loses sind Lieferung, Einrichtung und betriebsbereite Übergabe mobiler intelligenter Konferenzkamerasysteme für Rats-, Ausschuss-, Besprechungs-, Schulungs- und Konferenzräume sowie Service. Die Systeme müssen eine vollumfängliche Audio- und Videoerfassung von Präsenzteilnehmenden ermöglichen und für hybride Sitzungen sowie Videokonferenzen geeignet sein. Die Systeme bestehen mindestens aus: • Kamerasystem • Mikrofonarray • Lautsprechersystem • Netzteil • Anschlusskabeln • Transportzubehör (Transporttasche oder Transportkoffer) • erforderlicher Software; Gegenstand dieses Loses sind Lieferung, Montage, Einrichtung, Inbetriebnahme und betriebs-bereite Übergabe von frontalen Videokonferenzkamerasystemen (Videobars) für Besprechungs-, Konferenz-, Ausschuss-, Schulungs- und Gremienräume sowie Service. Die Systeme sind insbesondere für die Montage an oder unter interaktiven Displays, Smartboards oder Großbildschirmen vorgesehen. Der Auftragnehmer übernimmt Lieferung, Dokumentation und Support.; Gegenstand dieses Loses sind Lieferung, Einrichtung und betriebsbereite Übergabe von Zubehörkomponenten für die Medien-, Präsentations- und Konferenztechnik sowie Service. Die Komponenten dienen der Signalübertragung, Anbindung mobiler Endgeräte, Erweiterung von Präsentationssystemen sowie der Verwaltung mehrerer Signalquellen innerhalb von Besprechungs-, Schulungs-, Konferenz- und Gremienräumen. Der Auftragnehmer liefert sämtliche Zubehörkomponenten einschließlich notwendiger Adapter, Anschlussleitungen und Dokumentationen.

result.text: In line with technological evolution and the principles established in the Digitalisation Plan for Public Administrations and the National Cybersecurity Strategy, the trend in public sector corporate networks is moving towards architectures based on separate and isolated networks, using protocols running over Layer-3, such as SD-WAN, to create convergent communications services that enable: - Operational efficiency to be increased and management costs to be reduced. - Intelligent and proactive traffic management to be incorporated, particularly through the application of advanced analytics and artificial intelligence techniques. - Native integration with perimeter security systems and operations centres (SOC) to be facilitated. - The use of hybrid links (fibre, 4G/5G, Internet, etc.) to be permitted, guaranteeing high availability of services. - Scalability and flexibility to be ensured when opening new offices or launching new municipal services. In the field of office interconnection, the City Council of Ávila aims for an even more advanced and robust approach, replacing SD-WAN-based networks with Layer-2 networks capable of transporting VLANs based on the 802.1Q protocol. One of the fundamentals of this requirement is not to lose performance, such as the extremely low latency currently enjoyed, which is characteristic of campus networks or metropolitan area networks, constituted by point-to-point circuits. The City Council of Ávila is promoting an evolution towards a communications model based on the principles of robustness, agility, security, integration and scalability, in order to guarantee a modern, efficient and resilient infrastructure that supports the institution's digital transformation and continuous improvement in the provision of services to citizens. Based on this, the telecommunications services of the City Council of Ávila are being tendered, covering the areas of fixed and mobile telephony, broadband Internet access, data transmission between offices and associated services, as well as the maintenance of the infrastructures necessary for their correct provision. The contract seeks the provision of the related services and the comprehensive maintenance of the equipment and infrastructures necessary to guarantee the correct provision of the services throughout their validity, including the essential LAN equipment to provide the VoIP service, understanding that these are essential services for the proper functioning of the City Council.

parts.source: En línea con la evolución tecnológica y los principios establecidos en el Plan de Digitalización de las Administraciones Públicas y la Estrategia Nacional de Ciberseguridad, la tendencia en las redes corporativas del sector público se orienta hacia arquitecturas basadas en redes separadas y aisladas, mediante protocolos que corren sobre Layer-3, como es el caso de SD-WAN, para crear servicios convergentes de comunicaciones que permitan: - Incrementar la eficiencia operativa y reducir los costes de gestión. - Incorporar una gestión inteligente y proactiva del tráfico, especialmente mediante la aplicación de técnicas de analítica avanzada e inteligencia artificial. - Facilitar la integración nativa con los sistemas de seguridad perimetral y centros de operaciones (SOC). - Permitir el uso de enlaces híbridos (fibra, 4G/5G, Internet, etc.) garantizando la alta disponibilidad de los servicios. - Asegurar la escalabilidad y flexibilidad ante la apertura de nuevas sedes o la puesta en marcha de nuevos servicios municipales. En el ámbito de interconexión de sedes el Ayuntamiento de Ávila pretende un planteamiento aún más evolucionado y robusto, sustituyendo las redes basadas en SD-WAN por redes Layer-2 con capacidad para transportar VLAN basándose en el protocolo 802.1Q. Uno de los fundamentos de esta exigencia es no perder prestaciones, como la extremadamente baja latencia de la que se disfruta en la actualidad, que caracteriza a las redes de campus o redes metropolitanas, constituidas por circuitos punto a punto. El Ayuntamiento de Ávila impulsa una evolución hacia un modelo de comunicaciones que se sustenta en los principios de robustez, agilidad, seguridad, integración y escalabilidad, con el fin de garantizar una infraestructura moderna, eficiente y resiliente que soporte la transformación digital de la institución y la mejora continua en la prestación de servicios al ciudadano. En base a ello se licitan los servicios de telecomunicaciones del Ayuntamiento de Ávila, comprendiendo los ámbitos de telefonía fija y móvil, acceso a Internet de banda ancha, transmisión de datos entre sedes y servicios asociados, así como el mantenimiento de las infraestructuras necesarias para su correcta prestación. El contrato procura la prestación de los servicios relacionados y el mantenimiento integral de los equipos e infraestructuras necesarios para garantizar la correcta prestación de los servicios durante toda su vigencia, incluyendo el equipamiento LAN imprescindible para proporcionar el servicio VoIP, entendiendo que se trata de servicios esenciales para el adecuado funcionamiento del Ayuntamiento

result.text: 2M-IT Oy operates on an in-house principle and conducts competitive tendering for, as well as produces, ICT solutions and services for its owner-customers as their affiliated and joint procurement entity. The owner-customer, the Wellbeing Services County of Southwest Finland (the end customer of the procurement, “End Customer”), has, together with 2M-IT Oy, initiated a competitive dialogue procedure via a contract notice and invitation to participate, the subject of which is the licences and usage rights (“Technology Licences”) for an ERP entity (“Technology”) produced as a SaaS service, which concerns technology consisting of the functional areas of finance, logistics and procurement, as well as limited additional services directly related to the Technology that are specified during the procurement procedure, such as expert, support, product, interface, information security, access rights, technical environment or continuity assurance services, insofar as they relate directly to the use, management, maintenance or development of the offered SaaS technology during the contract period. 2M-IT Oy will, as the contracting authority, own the Technology Licences to be procured. Two procurements will be implemented in the TALOHA ERP programme: the procurement of technology licences and the procurement of a system integrator. The competitive tendering concerning this contract notice and invitation to participate will first implement the technology licence procurement, and it is aimed specifically at technology suppliers. The attached Project Description and its appendices contain more detailed preliminary information on, among other things, the procurement procedure, the description of the subject of the procurement, the progress of the procurement procedure, the application for participation and the selection of candidates, as well as the selection and award criteria.

parts.source: 2M-IT Oy toimii in-house-periaatteella ja kilpailuttaa sekä tuottaa ICT-ratkaisuja ja palveluja omistaja-asiakkailleen niiden sidos- ja yhteishankintayksikkönä. Omistaja-asiakas Varsinais-Suomen hyvinvointialue (hankinnan loppuasiakas, ”Loppuasiakas”) on yhdessä 2M-IT Oy:n käynnistänyt hankintailmoituksella ja osallistumispyynnöllä kilpailullisen neuvottelumenettelyn, jonka kohteena ovat talouden, logistiikan ja hankinnan toiminnallisista osa-alueista muodostuvan teknologiaa koskevan SaaS-palveluna tuotettavan ERP-kokonaisuuden (”Teknologia”) lisenssit ja käyttöoikeudet (”Teknologialisenssit”) sekä Teknologiaan välittömästi liittyvät, hankintamenettelyn aikana täsmentyvät rajatut lisäpalvelut, kuten asiantuntija-, tuki-, tuote-, rajapinta-, tietoturva-, käyttöoikeus-, teknisen ympäristön tai jatkuvuuden varmistamiseen liittyvät palvelut siltä osin kuin ne liittyvät suoraan tarjottavan SaaS-teknologian käyttöön, hallintaan, ylläpitoon tai sopimuskauden aikaiseen kehittämiseen. 2M-IT Oy tulee hankintayksikkönä omistamaan hankittavat Teknologialisenssit. TALOHA ERP-ohjelmassa tullaan toteuttamaan kaksi hankintaa: teknologiaa koskevien lisenssien hankinta ja systeemi-integraattorin hankinta. Tätä hankintailmoitusta ja osallistumispyyntöä koskevalla kilpailutuksella toteutetaan ensin teknologian lisenssihankinta, ja se on suunnattu erityisesti teknologiatoimittajille. result.text: Henneberg Clinics - Mobile Laboratory Automation and Robotics The subject matter is the planning, delivery, integration, conformity assessment, commissioning, acceptance and service of a fully mobile robotics/automation solution for barcode-supported sample flow between intake, pre-analytics, analysis systems, special dispensing, cooling and archiving. The solution must function as an overall system with laboratory equipment, LIS/middleware, building infrastructure and operator processes. Not the subject matter of this lot are medical laboratory services, the permanent provision of laboratory personnel, or the immediate procurement of transport or cleaning robots. Laboratory equipment and laboratory IT are procured separately. However, the robotics contractor remains responsible for the complete mechanical, electrical, software, control and safety engineering integration of the overall system they offer. Target image and functional equivalence: • Permanent robotics-supported in-house laboratory operations at the Hildburghausen site from 01.01.2027; no transitional supply. The first expansion stage is the mobile laboratory robotics system. • Documented peak intake: maximum approx. 30 samples per hour. The solution must not be unnecessarily oversized for this, but must demonstrate a comprehensible operational reserve. • Fully mobile, autonomously navigating robotics systems (AMR) or functionally equivalent mobile automation solutions are permitted. Stationary robot cells, linearly guided systems and permanently installed tracks do not meet the target image. • The solution offered is not an isolated robotics island: it is seamlessly integrated into order, sample, equipment, result, priority and error management and networked via a centrally provided orchestration and fleet management software. The software and platform architecture must be provably scalable for subsequent transport and cleaning robotics at two sites of the clinic association. A common or interoperable traffic logic, building and elevator interfaces, identity and certificate management, as well as a uniform operating and service concept must be provided. The initial procurement must not create unnecessary binding to proprietary laboratory equipment or closed building interfaces. Open, documented interface specifications that can be handed over to the contracting authority are a minimum requirement; a device-side extension to SiLA 2 or a functionally equivalent open standard must be presented. The contractor must describe the entry with a robust core workflow and the subsequent expansion with additional tasks, grippers, equipment, rooms and robotics domains in a technically and commercially comprehensible manner.

parts.source: Henneberg-Kliniken - Mobile Laborautomation und Robotik Gegenstand ist Planung, Lieferung, Integration, Konformitätsbewertung, Inbetriebnahme, Abnahme und Service einer vollständig mobilen Robotik-/Automationslösung für den barcodegestützten Probenfluss zwischen Eingang, Präanalytik, Analysesystemen, Sonderausgabe, Kühlung und Archiv. Die Lösung muss als Gesamtsystem mit Laborgeräten, LIS/Middleware, Gebäudeinfrastruktur und Betreiberprozessen funktionieren. Nicht Gegenstand dieses Loses sind die medizinische Laborleistung, die dauerhafte Gestellung des Laborpersonals sowie die sofortige Beschaffung von Transport- oder Reinigungsrobotern. Laborgeräte und Labor-IT werden gesondert beschafft. Der Auftragnehmer Robotik bleibt jedoch für die vollständige mechanische, elektrische, softwareseitige, steuerungs- und sicherheitstechnische Integration seines angebotenen Gesamtsystems verantwortlich. Zielbild und funktionale Gleichwertigkeit: • Dauerhafter robotikgestützter Eigenlaborbetrieb am Standort Hildburghausen ab 01.01.2027; keine Übergangsversorgung. Die erste Ausbaustufe ist das mobile Laborrobotiksystem. • Dokumentierte Spitzenannahme: maximal ca. 30 Proben je Stunde. Die Lösung darf dafür nicht unnötig überdimensioniert sein, muss aber eine nachvollziehbare Betriebsreserve ausweisen. • Zulässig sind vollständig mobile, autonom navigierende Robotiksysteme (AMR) oder funktional gleichwertige mobile Automationslösungen. Stationäre Roboterzellen, lineargeführte Systeme und fest installierte Fahrbahnen erfüllen das Zielbild nicht. • Die angebotene Lösung ist keine isolierte Robotikinsel: Sie wird durchgängig in Auftrags-, Proben-, Geräte-, Ergebnis-, Prioritäts- und Fehlermanagement integriert und über eine zentral bereitgestellte Orchestrierungs- und Flottenmanagementsoftware vernetzt. Die Software- und Plattformarchitektur muss nachweisbar für spätere Transport- und Reinigungsrobotik an zwei Standorten des Klinikverbunds skalierbar sein. Gemeinsame oder interoperable Verkehrslogik, Gebäude- und Aufzugsschnittstellen, Identitäts- und Zertifikatsverwaltung sowie ein einheitliches Betriebs- und Servicekonzept sind vorzusehen. Die Erstbeschaffung darf keine unnötige Bindung an proprietäre Laborgeräte oder geschlossene Gebäudeschnittstellen erzeugen. Offene, dokumentierte und an den Auftraggeber übergebbare Schnittstellenspezifikationen sind Mindestanforderung; eine geräteseitige Erweiterung auf SiLA 2 oder einen funktional gleichwertigen offenen Standard ist darzustellen. Der Auftragnehmer hat den Einstieg mit einem belastbaren Kernworkflow und die spätere Erweiterung um zusätzliche Aufgaben, Greifer, Geräte, Räume und Robotikdomänen technisch und kaufmännisch nachvollziehbar zu beschreiben.

result.text: The IT business division of UKJ has committed itself at the current time to the manufacturer Hewlett-Packard Enterprise (HPE) as the equipment supplier for extensions and substitutions of the existing IT infrastructure and therefore intends to conclude a framework agreement for the procurement of HPE system components. This is due to the fact that a comprehensive and almost complete data centre infrastructure from the manufacturer HPE exists, which must be permanently expanded and partially or substantially renewed as part of lifecycle management. Changing manufacturer would be associated with very high effort and high switching costs. The tender for the framework agreement pursues the objective of enabling an expansion of the existing IT infrastructure during the contract period, replacing components as part of lifecycle management that are technically or economically obsolete and, beyond that, the delivery of original HPE products. The services comprise the delivery, consultancy and maintenance of HPE products in the fields of IT infrastructure, servers, storage, cloud or the provision of HPE software (incl. rental software) as well as associated services. Installation and configuration services as well as measures to establish operational readiness are not explicitly part of the scope of the tender, unless they are listed in the price sheet or form part of the items in the price sheet or the included maintenance service. These measures will be commissioned separately by the contracting authority as needed.

parts.source: Der GB IT des UKJ legt sich zum aktuellen Zeitpunkt auf den Hersteller Hewlett-Packard Enterprise (HPE) als Ausstatter für Erweiterungen und Substitutionen der bestehenden IT-Infrastruktur fest und beabsichtigt daher den Abschluss einer Rahmenvereinbarung zur Beschaffung von HPE-Systemkomponenten. Dies ist darin begründet, dass eine flächendeckende und nahezu vollständige RZ-Infrastruktur des Herstellers HPE existiert, welche permanent erweitert und im Rahmen eines Lifecycle-Managements partiell oder substantiell erneuert werden muss. Ein Herstellerwechsel wäre mit sehr hohem Aufwand und hohen Wechselkosten verbunden. Die Ausschreibung der Rahmenvereinbarung verfolgt die Zielstellung, im Vertragszeitraum eine Erweiterung der bestehenden IT-Infrastruktur zu ermöglichen, im Rahmen des Lifecyclemanagements Komponenten zu ersetzen, welche technisch oder wirtschaftlich veraltet sind und darüber hinaus die Lieferung von Original HPE Produkten. Die Leistungen umfassen die Lieferung, Beratung und Wartung von HPE-Produkten im Bereich IT-Infrastruktur, Server, Speicher, Cloud- bzw. der Bereitstellung von HPE-Software (inkl. Mietsoftware) sowie dazugehöriger Dienstleistungen. Installations- und Konfigurationsdienstleistungen sowie Maßnahmen zur Herstellung der Betriebsbereitschaft gehören nicht explizit zum Inhalt der Ausschreibung, soweit sie nicht im Preisblatt aufgeführt oder Bestandteil der Positionen im Preisblatt oder der inkludierten Wartungsleistung sind. Diese Maßnahmen werden bei Bedarf durch den Auftraggeber separat beauftragt.

Hankinnan kohteena on intranet-palvelukokonaisuuden ja verkkosivuston haltuunotto, ylläpito-, tuki- ja jatkokehityspalvelut (jäljempänä "Palvelut"). Palvelut toteutetaan tilaajan olemassa olevien WordPress -julkaisujärjestelmällä toteutetuille intranet-sivustolle ja julkiselle hyvaep.fi- verkkosivustolle. Verkkosivuston osalta hankinnan kohteeseen sisältyy myös olemassa olevan verkkosivuston siirto neuvottelumenettelyn lopputuloksena valituksi tulleen toimittajan hallinnoimaan ympäristöön. Hankittavat ylläpito-, tuki- ja jatkokehityspalvelut jakautuvat kahdelle eri osa-alueelle: Osa-alue 1: hyvinvointialueen intranet-sivusto (Palvelut hankitaan on-premises -palveluna) Osa-alue 2: hyvinvointialueen hyvaep.fi -verkkosivusto (Palvelut hankitaan SaaS-palveluna) Tarjoajan tulee jättää yksi tarjous, joka kattaa molemmat osa-alueet. Hankinnan kohde on kuvattu tarkemmin alustavassa tarjouspyynnössä ja sen liitteissä. result.text: The contracting authority is planning the supply of eligible connections in accordance with the Gigabit Directive 2.0 through a gigabit-capable network based on FTTB technology by means of awarding a grant to a network operator (funding gap). The aim is to eliminate still existing grey areas. The project is to be funded by means of a federal grant for a funding gap model pursuant to no. 3.1 of the directive "Funding to support the gigabit expansion of telecommunications networks in the Federal Republic of Germany" of 31.03.2023, in the amending version of 13.01.2025 (Gigabit Directive 2.0), as well as pursuant to the "Administrative regulation of the Ministry of the Interior on the co-financing of the federal directive "Funding to support the gigabit expansion of telecommunications networks in the Federal Republic of Germany" (VwV Gigabitmitfinanzierung)". Neuenstein is a town in the Hohenlohekreis district in the Franconian-characterised northeast of Baden-Württemberg. It belongs to the Heilbronn-Franken Regional Association. The town is divided into seven districts: Neuenstein, Kirchensall with Neureut, Kleinhirschbach, Obersöllbach, Eschelbach, Kesselfeld and Grünbühl. Neighbouring municipalities are Kupferzell, Waldenburg, Öhringen, Zweiflingen, Forchtenberg, Niedernhall and Künzelsau. These are (clockwise, starting in the west): Öhringen, Zweifingen, Forchtenberg, Niederhall, Künzelsau, Kupferzell, Waldenburg. For the Stadt Neuenstein, supplying citizens and commercial enterprises with high-performance and future-proof broadband services is an important task in the sense of services of general interest, economic promotion and securing the business location. With the requirement for high data rates and long transmission distances between networks, the expansion of fibre-optic technology in particular plays a decisive part. Parts of the municipal area of Neuenstein are still insufficiently supplied with broadband connections within the meaning of the Gigabit Directive 2.0. The project area was therefore analysed in advance regarding available bandwidths and any planned self-expansion by private-sector telecommunications companies by carrying out a market consultation procedure in order to determine the expansion area of eligible broadband expansion based on the Gigabit Directive 2.0. Here, the results of the conducted market consultation were taken into account in compliance with the provisions of European state aid law and published on the central online platform of the federal project sponsor. It became apparent that the gigabit capability of the network is not given in parts of the queried area and therefore eligible connections within the meaning of the Gigabit Directive 2.0 are present.

parts.source: Der Auftraggeber plant die Versorgung der förderfähigen Anschlüsse gemäß Gigabit-Richtlinie 2.0 durch ein gigabitfähiges Netz auf Basis der FTTB-Technologie mittels der Vergabe einer Zuwendung an einen Netzbetreiber (Wirtschaftlichkeitslücke). Ziel ist die Beseitigung noch vorhandener Grauer Flecken. Das Projekt soll mittels einer Zuwendung des Bundes für ein Wirtschaftlichkeitslückenmodell nach Nr. 3.1 der Richtlinie „Förderung zur Unterstützung des Gigabitausbaus der Telekommunikationsnetze in der Bundesrepublik Deutschland“ vom 31.03.2023, in der Änderungsfassung vom 13.01.2025 (Gigabit-Richtlinie 2.0), sowie nach der sowie nach der „Verwaltungsvorschrift des Innenministeriums zur Mitfinanzierung der Bundes-Richtlinie „Förderung zur Unterstützung des Gigabitausbaus der Telekommunikationsnetze in der Bundesrepublik Deutschland“ (VwV Gigabitmitfinanzierung)“ gefördert werden. Neuenstein ist eine Stadt im Hohenlohekreis im fränkisch geprägten Nordosten Baden-Württembergs. Sie gehört zum Regionalverband Heilbronn-Franken. Die Stadt gliedert sich in sieben Stadtteile: Neuenstein, Kirchensall mit Neureut, Kleinhirschbach, Obersöllbach, Eschelbach, Kesselfeld und Grünbühl. Nachbargemeinden sind Kupferzell, Waldenburg, Öhringen, Zweiflingen, Forchtenberg, Niedernhall und Künzelsau. Diese sind (im Uhrzeigersinn, beginnend im Westen): Öhringen, Zweifingen, Forchtenberg, Niederhall, Künzelsau, Kupferzell, Waldenburg. Für die Stadt Neuenstein ist die Versorgung der Bürgerinnen und Bürger sowie der Gewerbetreibenden mit leistungsfähigen und zukunftsträchtigen Breitbanddiensten ein wichtiger Auftrag im Sinne der Daseinsvorsorge, Wirtschaftsförderung sowie der Standortsicherung. Mit der Anforderung hoher Datenraten und langen Übertragungsstrecken zwischen Netzwerken spielt gerade der Ausbau der Glasfasertechnologie eine entscheidende Rolle. Teile des Stadtgebiets Neuenstein sind noch unzureichend mit Breitbandanschlüssen im Sinne der Gigabit-Richtlinie 2.0 versorgt. Das Projektgebiet wurde somit im Vorlauf hinsichtlich der verfügbaren Bandbreiten und evtl. geplanter Eigenausbauten der privatwirtschaftlichen TK-Unternehmen mittels der Durchführung eines Markterkundungsverfahrens analysiert, um das Ausbaugebiet des förderfähigen Breitbandausbaus auf Basis der Gigabit-Richtlinie 2.0 zu bestimmen. Hierbei wurden die Ergebnisse der durchgeführten Markterkundung unter Einhaltung der Vorschriften des europäischen Beihilferechts berücksichtigt und auf der zentralen Online-Plattform des Projektträgers des Bundes veröffentlicht. Es wurde deutlich, dass in Teilen des abgefragten Gebiets die Gigabit-Fähigkeit des Netzes nicht gegeben ist und somit förderfähige Anschlüsse im Sinne der Gigabit-Richtlinie 2.0 vorliegen.

result.text: This is not a call for competition. The London Borough of Croydon is undertaking preliminary market engagement in relation to the potential commissioning of an Erasmus+ teacher/educator training and international mobility programme for Croydon schools. The Council is seeking expressions of interest only from organisations with demonstrable previous experience of managing and delivering Erasmus+ projects and international education mobility programmes on behalf of schools or public-sector organisations. The appointed provider would be expected to provide end-to-end programme management, including: • Previous experience of successfully managing and delivering Erasmus+ projects, including details of the number and type of projects delivered • Management and coordination of international teacher training, CPD and school visits across European destinations, with destinations to be confirmed • Organisation and management of participant travel, accommodation, and associated logistics • Support with participant recruitment and selection, including ensuring appropriate eligibility and allocation processes • Management of Erasmus+ grant administration, financial monitoring, evidence, and reporting requirements • Support for safeguarding, risk management and participant welfare throughout the programme • Delivery or commissioning of high-quality teacher CPD and training aligned to the agreed programme objectives • Development and implementation of programme evaluation, impact measurement, and outcomes reporting • Monitoring and reporting on participant outcomes and the wider impact of the programme on participating schools; and • Effective stakeholder management and communication with the Council, schools, training providers, and international partners. The programme is intended to support Croydon schools in developing practice in areas including inclusion and SEND, digital and AI-enabled education, wellbeing, sustainability, innovation, and oracy/communication-rich learning, aligned with relevant Erasmus+ priorities. Providers should only register an interest where they can demonstrate the relevant specialist experience, capacity, international networks and organisational infrastructure required to manage an Erasmus+ mobility programme from participant selection through to final evaluation and grant reporting. Registering your interest Providers wishing to participate must register their interest through the correspondence area no later than 21 September 2026 Please complete the sections provided in the document attached and return via the messaging area on the inTend Portal: Following the registration deadline, the Council will review responses and may engage with organisations whose experience and capabilities align with the requirements. This market engagement exercise is intended to inform the Council's understanding of the market and potential future commissioning arrangements. It does not constitute a procurement process, and participation does not provide any advantage in any future procurement activity. Organisation name Main contact name and job title Contact email address A brief response confirming: • the number of Erasmus+ projects your organisation has previously managed • your experience of managing international school/teacher mobility programmes • your experience of grant administration and reporting • your ability to manage travel, accommodation, participant selection, safeguarding, CPD and evaluation; and • a brief example of a comparable programme successfully delivered. Word Limit: 250 words The London Borough of Croydon use the Intend portal to manage supplier records and to run procurement activities. If you do not yet have an account, please register, if you do have an account, It is essential that your company information on Intend matches the details held by Companies House, please do log in and check this. Intend Portal: https://in-tendhost.co.uk/croydontenders/aspx/Home Register on the Central Digital Platform If you haven’t already, please register your organisation on the Central Digital Platform. This is a government-wide initiative to streamline supplier engagement and improve transparency. Again please do ensure your information matches your Companies House details. Central Digital Platform Registration: https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/procurement-act-2023-short-guides/suppliers-how-to-register-your-organisation-and-first-administrator-on-find-a-tender-in-three-easy-steps-html We appreciate your cooperation and look forward to working together. result.text: The BWI GmbH (hereinafter referred to as "BWI") is considering awarding a framework agreement for the continuation and scaling of internet transit access with up to 500 Gbit/s at the Bördeland site in the amount of up to 14.869.161,11 € Euros (net) up to 22.303.741,67 Euros (net) (upper limit) by means of a negotiated procedure with a call for competition pursuant to Section 11 paragraph 1 sentence 1 alternative 2 of the Ordinance on the Award of Public Contracts (VSVgV). The framework agreement will be concluded for a maximum term of 7 years (3 years initial term, with an option to extend 4 times by 12 months each). The contractor shall provide the BWI with an IP transit broadband line to the internet for the Bördeland data centre as a service. This includes the provision of a blackholing procedure as an ISP procedure (Internet Service Provider procedure) for protection against DDoS attacks. Blackholing refers to the automatic redirection of Denial of Service (DoS) and Distributed Denial of Service (DDoS) attacks to a so-called black hole so that these attacks run into a void. This avoids any impact of such IT attacks on the internet lines and services as well as the connected DMZ (demilitarised zone as a security transition) and the downstream IT-SysBw network. The blackholing procedure is a provider procedure that is tied to the respective provider technology. The service itself is provided without exception in the IT infrastructure of the same ISP. result.text: The Region of Southern Denmark is facing the procurement of a new regional IT solution for the imaging diagnostics areas (hereinafter the "Solution"). The Solution must encompass RIS, PACS, VNA, Clinical Viewer as well as support for breast cancer screening and constitutes the central clinical tool for radiological and nuclear medicine departments at the Region of Southern Denmark. The Solution must be put into operation at 4 hospital units distributed across 12 radiological departments, 3 nuclear medicine departments as well as the regional breast cancer screening. The Region of Southern Denmark has several hundred imaging modalities and performs over 1 million examinations annually. The Solution must support an efficient clinical workflow in a patient-safe and user-friendly manner, as well as ensure the coherent patient pathway across hospital units, departments and specialties. The Solution must be a robust, stable and well-functioning tool in the clinicians' daily work while simultaneously possessing the flexibility necessary to accommodate future improvement initiatives and changed needs. The tendered procurement is described in further detail in Appendix-03 with sub-appendices. The procurement itself encompasses functionality to support workflows within radiology, nuclear medicine and mammography screening, as well as the storage of imaging diagnostics examinations. The procurement furthermore encompasses the implementation and maintenance of the new solution. BDSYD principles: The procurement is made on the basis of four overarching principles, which the Parties must correspondingly use as fundamental principles for the Solution and the collaboration: • Efficient support of the patients' journey: The Solution is patient-safe, labour-saving, intuitive and user-friendly. • Stable operation: The large volume of imaging diagnostics examinations can take place securely, unperturbed by downtime and operational stoppages to the benefit of patients, employees and efficiency. • Performance: Short system response times in the solution and good performance, which is important for patients, employees and efficiency. • Standard solution: The Solution is well-functioning and well-tested in a comparable setup and has open and well-defined interfaces. There is an option for the Central Denmark Region and the North Denmark Region for the procurement of a corresponding solution, cf. Appendix-19 with sub-appendices. The Region of Southern Denmark is conducting the procurement on behalf of all the regions, and separate contracts will subsequently be concluded between the chosen Supplier and the individual region. It is noted that the Region of Southern Denmark has geoblocking in relation to a number of countries as listed in Appendix-02.A. The list can be requested by contacting via the communication tab on the Ethics tender site and can be received by interested suppliers upon a confidentiality declaration from the requesting party. This has been accounted for in the determined tender deadline.

parts.source: Region Syddanmark står over for at skulle anskaffe en ny regional IT-løsning til de billeddiagnostiske områder (herefter "Løsningen"). Løsningen skal omfatte RIS, PACS, VNA, Klinisk Viewer samt understøttelse af brystkræftscreeningen og udgør det centrale kliniske værktøj for radiologiske og nuklearmedicinske afdelinger hos Region Syddanmark. Løsningen skal ibrugtages på 4 sygehusenheder fordelt på 12 radiologiske afdelinger, 3 nuklearmedicinske afdelinger samt den regionale brystkræftscreening. Region Syddanmark råder over flere hundrede billeddannende modaliteter og udfører over 1 mio. undersøgelser årligt. Løsningen skal patientsikkert og brugervenligt understøtte en effektiv klinisk arbejdsgang samt sikre det sammenhængende patientforløb på tværs af sygehusenheder, afdelinger og specialer. Løsningen skal være et robust, stabilt og velfungerende værktøj i klinikernes daglige arbejde og samtidig have den fleksibilitet, der er nødvendig for at imødekomme fremtidige forbedringstiltag og ændrede behov. Den udbudte anskaffelse er uddybende beskrevet i Bilag-03 med underbilag. Selve anskaffelsen omfatter funktionalitet til understøttelse af arbejdsgangene inden for radiologi, nuklearmedicin og mammografiscreening samt lagring af billeddiagnostiske undersøgelser. Anskaffelsen omfatter endvidere implementering og vedligeholdelse af den nye løsning. BDSYD-principper: Anskaffelsen foretages med grundlag i fire overordnede principper, som Parterne tilsvarende skal benytte som grundlæggende principper for Løsningen og samarbejdet: • Effektiv understøttelse af patienternes vej: Løsningen er patientsikker, arbejdskraftbesparende, intuitiv og brugervenlig. • Stabil drift: Den store produktion af billeddiagnostiske undersøgelser kan foregå sikkert, uforstyrret af nedetid og driftsstop til fordel for patienter, medarbejdere og effektivitet. • Performance: Korte system-svartider i løsningen og god performance, hvilket er vigtigt for patienter, medarbejdere og effektivitet. • Standardløsning: Løsningen er velfungerende og velafprøvet i et sammenligneligt setup samt har åbne og veldefinerede snitflader. Der er option til Region Midtjylland og Region Nordjylland om anskaffelse af tilsvarende løsning, jf. Bilag-19 med underbilag. Region Syddanmark gennemfører udbuddet på vegne af alle regionerne, og der indgås efterfølgende særskilte kontrakter mellem den valgte Leverandør og den enkelte region. Det bemærkes, at Region Syddanmark har geoblokering ift. en række lande som oplistet i Bilag-02.A. Listen kan rekvireres ved henvendelse via kommunikationsfanen på udbudssitet Ethics og kan modtages af interesserede leverandører mod en fortrolighedserklæring fra den rekvirerende part. Der er taget højde for dette i den fastlagt tilbudsfrist.

rejected.text: This is not a contract notice or a call for tenders, but a request for information, through which the South Karelia and Päijät-Häme wellbeing services counties invite system suppliers to register for a potential procurement. This is a request for information/market dialogue, through which the South Karelia and Päijät-Häme wellbeing services counties are surveying potential system suppliers for an income and asset assessment service for the determination of client fees for social welfare home care and housing services (communal and 24-hour housing). It can also be utilised in family law services for the compilation of maintenance payment calculations and potentially for other social welfare calculations. Through this request for information, the South Karelia and Päijät-Häme wellbeing services counties are surveying digital solutions for the compilation of income and asset assessments for client fee decisions using robotics. The client fee decision is made in connection with the client's service decision, and this has an impact on the management of the client's process as well as on the suspension and termination of invoicing. The objective of the survey is to determine what kind of product solutions containing the functionalities described below are available on the Finnish market. Through the market dialogue, the wellbeing services counties aim to: 1. Obtain information on the market supply and the solutions of different suppliers 2. Potential implementation of integrations to different platforms or systems 3. Assess the implementation of information security and data protection 4. Obtain an overview of pricing models and cost structures (no individual tenders) 5. Survey delivery and service models The market dialogue is open to all suppliers that can offer product solutions falling within the scope of this solution entity. The focus of the dialogue is on solutions based on the automatic compilation of income and asset assessments to support client fee decisions. Suppliers are requested to present services that are under development or ready-made solutions. A supplier participating in the dialogue is expected to present the functionality to be deployed into production and information on how cooperation with the necessary actors has been taken into account in the preparation of the income and asset assessment service for the implementation of integrations. There is no need for a system solution based on process guidance, as this would increase unnecessary recording due to system changes. The key data contents consist of, among other things, the Tax Administration's income register and tax decisions, and Kela's benefit information. In connection with the registration, suppliers are requested to briefly describe: Purpose and environment of use The system must be suitable for use by the wellbeing services county for the management of the following service forms - income and asset assessment for home care - income and asset assessment for communal housing, - income and asset assessment for 24-hour housing - maintenance payment calculation for family law services, which is part of a maintenance agreement made by parents. Information on both parents is needed for the maintenance payment calculation. - In all fees, the income information of spouses must be taken into account if necessary User groups are - child welfare officers - those making client fee decisions in the wellbeing services counties Key functionalities - to produce, as part of the determination of client fees, income and asset information, based on which a proposal for the amount of the client fee or ability to pay is formed - the calculation must not be saved in the income and asset assessment service, i.e. it does not create an archiving obligation. However, it must be possible to generate a PDF/PDF-A from the document, which the wellbeing services county can attach as part of the decision and archive in a manner it deems appropriate. Integrations - Data transfer connection to the Tax Administration (income register and tax information) via the LIPA service bus - Data transfer connection to Kela's benefit information service via the LIPA service bus Technical requirements - The system must meet the DPIA information security requirements - Data flow diagram and architecture description - User authentication and access management - Generation and management of log data Additional information - What other essential features does your solution contain? - How is the system implementation typically carried out? - What kind of support and training do you offer? - Estimate from decision to implementation - Need for the wellbeing services county's resources Answers to the questions are requested to be sent by 14.9.2026 at 15:00. Answers are requested to be brief and informative. Answers are requested to be sent to the address hankinnat@ekhva.fi and hankinnat@paijatha.fi Message subject: "Market survey - Income and asset assessment service system" With this request for information/market survey, no tenders are requested, nor will any tenders be given to this request for information, but ONLY information related to the procurement is requested. Participating or not participating in the market survey/request for information does not affect the tenderer's position in a potential call for tenders. The market dialogue invitation does not bind the respondent (Supplier) to participate in a call for tenders, and responding to this notice is not a prerequisite for participating in the actual call for tenders later. Those participating in the market survey do not have the right to receive compensation for participation. The contracting authority does not commit to carrying out the procurement in question. Decisions on launching a potential procurement process will be made after the market survey. The submitted material will be treated as confidential according to section 24 subsection 1 point 20 of the Act on the Openness of Government Activities. The South Karelia and Päijät-Häme wellbeing services counties thank you in advance for your answers. They are valuable in defining our system needs and in preparing a potential procurement.

The aim of the market survey is to find out what kind of product solutions containing the functionalities described below are available on the Finnish market. The focus of the dialogue is on solutions based on the automated compilation of income and wealth assessments to support client fee decisions. Suppliers are requested to present services that are under development or ready-made solutions. The core data contents consist of, inter alia, the Incomes Register and tax decisions of the Finnish Tax Administration, and benefit data from Kela. In connection with registration, suppliers are requested to briefly describe: Purpose of use and environment The system must be suitable for the wellbeing services county's use for managing the following service forms: - income and wealth assessment for home care - income and wealth assessment for community-based housing, - income and wealth assessment for round-the-clock living - maintenance calculation for family law services, which forms part of a maintenance agreement concluded by parents. The maintenance calculation requires the data of both parents. - In all fees, the income data of spouses must be taken into account where necessary User groups include - children's supervisors - makers of client fee decisions in wellbeing services counties Key functionalities - produce, as part of the determination of client fees, income and wealth data on the basis of which a proposal for the amount of the client fee or solvency is formed - the calculation must not be saved in the income and wealth assessment service, meaning it does not create an archiving obligation. However, it must be possible to generate a PDF/PDF-A document from the document, which the wellbeing services county can attach as part of the decision and archive in a manner it deems fit. Integrations - Data transfer connection to the Finnish Tax Administration via the LIPA service bus (Incomes Register and tax data) - Data transfer connection to Kela's benefit data service via the LIPA service bus Technical requirements - The system must meet DPIA information security requirements - Data flow diagram and architecture description - User authentication and access control - Generation and management of log data Additional information - What other essential features does your solution include? - How is the implementation of the system typically carried out? - What kind of support and training do you offer? - Estimate from decision to implementation - The wellbeing services county's resource requirement Responses to the questions are requested to be sent by 14.9.2026 at 15:00. Responses are requested to be brief and informative. Responses are requested to be sent to hankinnat@ekhva.fi and hankinnat@paijatha.fi Message subject: "Market survey - Income and wealth assessment service system" This RFI/market survey does not request tenders nor are tenders submitted in response to this RFI; it requests ONLY information related to the procurement. Participation or non-participation in the market survey/RFI does not affect the tenderer's position in a potential tendering procedure. The market dialogue invitation does not bind the respondent (Supplier) to participate in a tendering procedure, nor is responding to this notice a prerequisite for participating in the actual tendering procedure later. Those participating in the market survey are not entitled to receive compensation for their participation. The contracting authority does not undertake to carry out the procurement in question. Decisions on launching a potential procurement process will be made after the market survey. The submitted material will be treated as confidential in accordance with section 24 subsection 1 paragraph 20 of the Act on the Openness of Government Activities. The wellbeing services counties of South Karelia and Päijät-Häme thank you in advance for your responses. They are valuable in defining our system needs and preparing for a potential procurement.

parts.source: Tämä ei ole hankintailmoitus eikä tarjouspyyntö, vaan tietopyyntö, jolla Etelä-Karjalan ja Päijät-Hämeen hyvinvointialueet pyytävät järjestelmätoimittajia ilmoittautumaan mahdollista kilpailutusta varten. Kyseessä on tietopyyntö/markkinavuoropuhelu, jolla Etelä-Karjalan ja Päijät-Hämeen hyvinvointialueet kartoittavat mahdollisia järjestelmä Toimittajia Tulo- ja varallisuusselvityspalvelu sosiaalihuollon kotihoidon ja asumispalveluiden (yhteisöllinen ja ympärivuorokautinen asumisen) asiakasmaksun määrittelyyn. Sekä perheoikeudellisissa palveluissa elatusapulaskelman koostamiseen ja mahdollisesti muihin sosiaalihuollon laskelmiin hyödynnettävissä. Tällä tietopyynnöllä Etelä-Karjalan ja Päijät-Hämeen hyvinvointialueet kartoittavat digitaalisia ratkaisuja asiamaksupäätösten tulo- ja varallisuusselvityksen koostamiseen robotiikalla. Asiakasmaksupäätös tehdään asiakkaan palvelupäätökseen liittyen ja tällä on vaikutus asiakkaan prosessin hallintaan sekä laskutuksen keskeytyksiin ja päättymisiin. Kartoituksen tavoitteena on selvittää, millaisia alla kuvattuja toiminnallisuuksia sisältäviä tuoteratkaisuja on saatavilla Suomen markkinoilla. Markkinavuoropuhelun avulla hyvinvointialueet pyrkivät: 1. Saamaan tietoa markkinoiden tarjonnasta ja eri toimittajien ratkaisuista 2. Mahdolliset integraatioiden toteutus eri alustoille tai järjestelmiin 3. Arvioimaan tietoturvan ja tietosuojan toteutusta 4. Saamaan yleiskuvan hinnoittelumalleista ja kustannusrakenteista (ei yksittäisiä tarjouksia) 5. Kartoittamaan toimitus- ja palvelumalleja Markkinavuoropuhelu on avoin kaikille toimittajille, joilla on tarjota tämän ratkaisukokonaisuuden piiriin kuuluvia tuoteratkaisuja. Vuoropuhelun painopisteenä ovat ratkaisut, jotka pohjautuvat tulo- ja varallisuusselvityksen automaattiseen koostamiseen asiakasmaksupäätöksen tueksi. Toimittajia pyydetään esittelemään palveluita, jotka ovat kehitteillä tai valmiita ratkaisuja. Vuoropuheluun osallistuvan toimittajan edellytetään esittävän tuotantoon käyttöönotettava toiminnallisuus ja tieto siitä, miten tulo- ja varallisuusselvityspalvelun valmistelussa on huomioitu yhteistyö tarvittavien toimijoiden kanssa integraatioiden toteuttamiseksi. Toiminnalla ei ole tarvetta prosessiohjaukseen perustuvalla järjestelmäratkaisulla, sillä se lisäisi ylimääräistä kirjaamista järjestelmämuutosten myötä. Keskeiset tietosisällöt muodostuvat mm. Verottajan tulorekisteristä ja verotuspäätöksistä, Kelan etuustiedoista. Ilmoittautumisen yhteydessä toimittajia pyydetään lyhyesti kuvaamaan: Käyttötarkoitus ja -ympäristö Järjestelmän tulee soveltua hyvinvointialueen käyttöön seuraavien palvelumuotojen hallintaan - kotihoidon tulo- ja varallisuusselvitys - yhteisöllisen asumisen tulo- ja varallisuusselvitys, - ympärivuorokautisen asumisen tulo- ja varallisuusselvitys - perheoikeudellisten palveluiden elatusapulaskelma, joka on osa vanhempien tekemää elatussopimusta. Elatusapulaskelmaan tarvitaan molempien vanhempien tiedot. - Kaikissa maksuissa on tarvittaessa huomioitava puolisoiden tulotiedot Käyttäjäryhmiä ovat - lastenvalvojat - hyvinvointialueiden asiamaksupäätösten tekijät Keskeiset toiminnallisuudet - tuottaa osana asiakasmaksujen määrittelyä tulo- ja varallisuustiedot, joiden perusteella muodostuu ehdotus asiakasmaksun suuruudesta tai maksuvalmiudesta - laskelma ei saa tallentua tulo- ja varallisuusselvityspalveluun, eli ei muodosta arkistointivelvoitetta. Asiakirjasta on kuitenkin voitava muodostaa PDF/PDF-A, jonka hyvinvointialue voi liittää osaksi päätöstä ja arkistoida katsomallaan tavalla. Integraatiot - LIPA palveluväylän kautta tiedonsiirtoyhteys Verohallintoon (tulorekisteri ja verotustiedot) - LIPA palveluväylän kautta tiedonsiirtoyhteys Kelan etuustietopalveluun Tekniset vaatimukset - Järjestelmän tulee täyttää DPIA-tietoturvavaatimukset - Tietovirtakaavio ja arkkitehtuurikuvaus - Käyttäjän tunnistautuminen ja pääsyn hallinta - Lokitietojen muodostuminen ja hallinnointi Lisätiedot - Mitä muita oleellisia ominaisuuksia ratkaisunne sisältää? - Miten järjestelmän käyttöönotto tyypillisesti toteutetaan? - Millaista tukea ja koulutusta tarjoatte? - Arvio päätöksestä käyttöönottoon - Hyvinvointialueen resurssien tarve Vastaukset kysymyksiin pyydetään lähettämään 14.9.2026 klo 15:00 mennessä. Vastaukset pyydetään lyhyesti ja informatiivisesti. Vastaukset pyydetään lähettämään osoitteeseen hankinnat@ekhva.fi sekä hankinnat@paijatha.fi Viestin otsikko: "Markkinakartoitus - Tulo- ja varallisuusselvitys palvelujärjestelmä" Tällä tietopyynnöllä/markkinakartoituksella ei pyydetä eikä tähän tietopyyntöön anneta tarjouksia, vaan tällä pyydetään VAIN hankintaan liittyviä tietoja. Markkinakartoitukseen/tietopyyntöön osallistuminen tai osallistumatta jättäminen ei vaikuta tarjoajan asemaan mahdollisessa tarjouskilpailussa. Markkinavuoropuhelukutsu ei sido vastaajaa (Toimittajaa) tarjouskilpailuun osallistumiseen, eikä tähän ilmoitukseen vastaaminen ole edellytyksenä myöhemmin varsinaiseen tarjouskilpailuun osallistumiselle. Markkinakartoitukseen osallistuvilla ei ole oikeutta saada korvausta osallistumisesta. Hankintayksikkö ei sitoudu toteuttamaan asianomaista hankintaa. Päätökset mahdollisen hankintaprosessin käynnistämisestä tehdään markkinakartoituksen jälkeen. Toimitettu materiaali käsitellään luottamuksellisena julkisuuslain 24 §:n 1 momentin 20 kohdan mukaan. Etelä-Karjalan ja Päijät-Hämeen hyvinvointialueet kiittävät etukäteen vastauksistanne. Ne ovat arvokkaita järjestelmätarpeidemme määrittelyssä ja mahdollisen hankinnan valmistelussa.

result.text: United Utilities is seeking to establish a framework for the supply, storage, stock management, fulfilment and delivery of water efficiency devices and flow regulators. The framework will support United Utilities’ AMP8 and AMP9 water demand reduction commitments, including reductions in domestic Per Capita Consumption and non-household business demand. The requirement is divided into two lots: Lot 1 covers water efficiency devices, associated fulfilment services and a UU-branded customer water usage survey and ordering platform; Lot 2 covers flow regulators in agreed sizes, flow rates and specifications. Appointed supplier(s) must be able to provide compliant, reliable and scalable products and services that support planned programmes, customer campaigns, bulk orders and changes in operational demand. Suppliers must demonstrate product quality, regulatory compliance, supply chain resilience, accurate reporting, effective stock management and appropriate customer support. This includes relevant approvals and assurance evidence, secure handling of customer data where applicable, and the ability to respond flexibly as programme volumes and priorities evolve. The overall objective is to secure a robust, value-for-money supply arrangement that enables United Utilities to deliver water efficiency activity at scale, maintain continuity of supply, protect customer experience and contribute to measurable reductions in water consumption across the North West. Lot LOT-0001: PRO005128-Goods-Framework-Water Saving Devices - Lot 1. Supply, storage, stock management, picking, packing, fulfilment and delivery of water efficiency devices such as flow regulators, water butts, shower regulators, tap inserts, showerheads, cistern devices, toilet leak detection strips and other approved or innovative water saving products. Lot LOT-0002: PRO005128-Goods-Framework-Water Saving Devices - Lot 2. Supply, storage, stock management, fulfilment and delivery of flow regulators in a range of sizes, flow rates and specifications suitable for UU programmes. Devices must meet all applicable regulatory, quality and testing requirements, including WRAS and Regulation 31 approval where required.

result.text: The ITZBund requires services in the field of Software Lifecycle Management (SLM) for deployed software development and project management solutions. The aim of this tender is to conclude a framework agreement to ensure the operation as well as the maintenance and (further) development of the existing software development and project management platform Cloud and the specialist applications of the ITZBund based on it. In addition, sovereignty is to be strengthened by expanding the open source tools to be procured. By open source, the ITZBund means software whose source code is freely available. In principle, everyone is permitted to use, analyse, modify and pass on this software free of charge and without content-related restrictions in object and source code. Requirements of the respective relevant open source licence, in particular regarding licence texts, copyright notices or copyleft effects, remain unaffected. The tendered services include services along the entire software lifecycle, in particular operational services, maintenance and support services, support services in connection with releases and rollouts, as well as needs-based new and further developments of existing software and software-related tools. The contracting authority, which can call off services commissioned by its customers, is entitled to call off services. The operation of the procured software products generally takes place at the ITZBund; exceptions in special individual cases allow operation at the contracting authority's customers with their own licensing. The services mentioned at the beginning are tendered in five lots: - Lot 1: Ensuring the maintenance and (further) development of the deployed software development and project management platform Cloud - Lot 2: Ensuring the operation and automated rollout of releases of the deployed software development and project management platform Cloud - Lot 3: Provision of Sonatype software products - Lot 4: Provision of an open source issue tracker including, in particular, training, support, further development and migration services - Lot 5: Provision of an open source wiki including, in particular, training, support, further development and migration services This service description considers the subject matter of Lot 5: The subject of this lot is the provision of an open source wiki including associated training, support, further development and migration services. For the total contract term of 4 years, the estimated calculated costs result in an upper limit of 1.450 instances and 162.608 person-hours (PH) or 20.326 person-days (PD).

parts.source: Das ITZBund benötigt Dienstleistungen im Bereich des Software Lifecycle Managements (SLM) für eingesetzte Softwareentwicklungs- und Projektmanagementlösungen. Ziel dieser Ausschreibung ist der Abschluss eines Rahmenvertrages zur Sicherstellung des Betriebs sowie der Pflege und (Weiter-)Entwicklung der bestehenden Softwareentwicklungs- und Projektmanagementplattform Cloud sowie darauf aufbauender Fachanwendungen des ITZBund. Zudem soll die Souveränität durch die Erweiterung zu beschaffender Open Source Tools gestärkt werden. Unter Open Source versteht das ITZBund Software, deren Quellcode frei verfügbar ist. Grundsätzlich ist es jedermann gestattet, diese unentgeltlich und inhaltlich unbeschränkt im Objekt- und Quellcode zu benutzen, zu analysieren, zu verändern und weiterzugeben. Vorgaben der jeweils einschlägigen Open Source Lizenz, insbesondere zu Lizenztexten, Urhebervermerken oder Copyleft-Effekten, bleiben unberührt. rejected.text: The NSF Engineering Directorate (ENG) has launched a multi-year initiative, the Professional Formation of Engineers, to create and support an innovative and inclusive engineering profession for the 21 st century. Professional Formation of Engineers (PFE) refers to the formal and informal processes and value systems by which people become engineers. It also includes the ethical responsibility of practising engineers to sustain and grow the profession in order to improve quality of life for all peoples. The engineering profession must be responsive to national priorities, grand challenges, and dynamic workforce needs; it must be equally open and accessible to all. Professional Formation of Engineers includes, but is not limited, to: Introductions to the profession at any age; Development of deep technical and professional skills, knowledge, and abilities in both formal and informal settings/domains; Development of outlooks, perspectives, ways of thinking, knowing, and doing; Development of identity as an engineer and its intersection with other identities; and Acculturation to the profession, its standards, and norms. The goal of the Research in the Formation of Engineers (RFE) program is to advance our understanding of professional formation. It seeks both to deepen our fundamental understanding of the underlying processes and mechanisms that support professional formation and to demonstrate how professional formation is or can be accomplished. Ultimately RFE aims to transform the engineer-formation system, and thus the impact of proposed projects on this system must be described. Principal Investigators (PIs) should provide a roadmap detailing how they envision the proposed research will eventually broadly impact practice within the engineer-formation system, even if these activities are not within the scope of the submitted proposal. In order to accomplish its goals, RFE welcomes proposals in two categories: Research Projects, and Design and Development Projects. Research Projects address fundamental questions of professional formation, while Design and Development Projects provide new approaches to achieving professional formation. Additional details are provided below. Projects in both categories should address the iterative cycle in which research questions that advance understanding are informed by practice and the results of research are, in turn, translated into practice. In other words, proposals should explain how the research results will travel, translate, transfer, or scale. Successful projects identify specific target audiences, effective communication channels, and novel partnerships to ensure effective propagation and scaling. Proposal titles should begin with either “Research:” or “Design and Development:” as appropriate. Research Projects Research proposals are particularly welcome in the following areas: Research that addresses lifelong learning by the engineering workforce. Research on the impact of engineering education research. Proposals addressing this topic could investigate questions such as: How can we measure the impacts of engineering education research? What are effective strategies for scaling reforms? How can we translate knowledge from research to practice? What are the roles of technologies, networks and communities in achieving impact? RFE does not support efficacy, effectiveness, or scale-up studies for specific interventions. Research that addresses culture change in engineering education. Included in this topic are investigations of normative cultures of engineering at any level in the engineering education ecosystem and how these cultures may disadvantage certain groups. Research that addresses engineering formation at the two-year college level in both formal and informal settings. Research that addresses engineering formation at the graduate education level in both formal and informal settings. Research that investigates engineering in P-12 settings. Research in this area could include understanding of approaches to engineering in P-12, how to develop engineering ways of thinking, or the relationship between practices within the sciences and mathematics and engineering thinking. Research on the transitions between education levels, e.g., from high school to two-year college, high school to four-year college/university, two-year college to four-year college/university, undergraduate to graduate school, education settings to the workforce or professoriate, etc. Research that addresses the relationship between engineering and the public. Proposals addressing this topic could consider the social impact of engineering solutions, citizen engineering, education of an informed public, etc. Research that develops or adapts novel methodologies and frameworks appropriate for studying the professional formation of engineers, and especially minoritised, marginalised, or underserved populations. Research that addresses ways in which new technologies (such as artificial intelligence and machine learning) are changing engineering education. Research to transform engineering education so that all students encounter environmental and social sustainability principles as an integrated part of their education and are equipped with the tools needed to incorporate these principles into their future research, careers, and innovations. Proposals submitted to the Research Projects category should have clear research questions informed by an appropriate theoretical framework and a research design that includes sampling, data collection, and data analysis methods. This category will not support proposals that seek funding primarily to develop tools, curriculum, or laboratories, or that seek to implement classroom innovations that have already been shown to be effective in engineering. The program will evaluate the value of proposals by considering the impact and the cost. Research track projects that are small, exploratory, or speculative are especially encouraged.
