result.text: This is a request for information, which is not a procurement notice or call for tenders. The purpose of the request for information is to gather information concerning the subject of the procurement for a future competition. Responding to the request for information is not a prerequisite for participating in the competition. To ensure the success of the future competition, however, it would be important for tenderers to provide the contracting authority with the requested information as broadly as possible. The request for information does not oblige Servica Oy to carry out the procurement as described in the request for information or its annexes, and the tendering procedure may also not be carried out. No compensation will be paid to those who responded to the request for information for responding to it or participating in presentation events related to it. Servica Oy is preparing the Digital internal control system competition. The purpose of the request for information is to obtain further clarification on the applicability and appropriateness of the minimum requirements of the call for tenders. Tenderers are requested to familiarise themselves with the contracting authority's preliminary call for tenders and draft contract, as well as other relevant annexes. The contracting authority aims to comply with the principles of public procurement in the procurement, which are equality, non-discrimination, transparency and proportionality. The contracting authority asks tenderers to pay attention to the following matters: 1) Is sufficient information related to the procurement available in the call for tenders to make submitting a tender possible? 2) Are the requirements of the call for tenders in proper proportion to the quality of the procurement and the characteristics of the services? 3) Are there requirements or conditions in the call for tenders that could prevent the emergence of equal and non-discriminatory competition? 4) Is there incorrect or contradictory information in the call for tenders? 5) Is the presented pricing model such that submitting a tender is possible? Commenting on matters other than those above is also permitted. The deadlines mentioned in the call for tenders are not final and will only be determined when the procurement notice is published. RESPONDING TO THE REQUEST FOR INFORMATION A potential tenderer may participate in the request for information by sending comments no later than Thursday 23.10.2025 by 16:00. Responding takes place by email to the address hankinnat@servica.fi. Please title your message as follows: "Request for information: Digital internal control system [company name]". The information provided will be treated confidentially. The contracting authority may submit clarifying follow-up questions to tenderers. The contracting authority is not obliged to answer questions or change the content of the procurement based on the tenderers' responses. By responding to the request for information, the tenderer accepts these terms. Tietopyyntöön vastaaminen ei ole edellytys kilpailutukseen osallistumiselle. Tulevan kilpailutuksen onnistumisen varmistamiseksi olisi kuitenkin tärkeää, että tarjoajat antaisivat hankintayksikölle mahdollisimman laajasti pyydettyjä tietoja. Tietopyyntö ei velvoita Servica Oy:tä toteuttamaan hankintaa tietopyynnössä tai sen liitteissä kuvatulla tavalla ja tarjouskilpailu voidaan myös jättää toteuttamatta. Tietopyyntöön vastanneille ei makseta korvausta tietopyyntöön vastaamisesta tai siihen liittyviin esittelytilaisuuksiin osallistumisesta. Servica Oy valmistelee Digitaalinen omavalvontajärjestelmä -kilpailutusta. Tietopyynnön tarkoituksena on saada lisäselvitystä tarjouspyynnön vähimmäisvaatimusten soveltuvuudesta ja tarkoituksenmukaisuudesta. Tarjoajia pyydetään tutustumaan hankintayksikön alustavaan tarjouspyyntö- ja sopimusluonnokseen, sekä muihin olennaisiin liitteisiin. Hankintayksikkö pyrkii noudattamaan hankinnassa julkisten hankintojen periaatteita, joita ovat tasapuolisuus, syrjimättömyys, avoimuus ja suhteellisuus. Hankintayksikkö pyytää tarjoajia kiinnittämään huomiota seuraaviin asioihin: 1) Onko tarjouspyynnössä saatavilla riittävästi tietoa hankintaan liittyen, jotta tarjoaminen on mahdollista? 2) Ovatko tarjouspyynnön vaatimukset oikeassa suhteessa hankinnan laatuun ja palveluiden ominaisuuksiin nähden? 3) Onko tarjouspyynnössä vaatimuksia tai ehtoja mitkä voisivat estää tasapuolisen ja syrjimättömän kilpailun syntymisen? 4) Onko tarjouspyynnössä virheellistä tai ristiriitaista tietoa? 5) Onko esitetty hinnoittelumalli sellainen, että tarjoaminen on mahdollista? Myös muihin kuin yllä oleviin asioihin kommentointi on sallittua. Tarjouspyynnössä mainitut määräajat eivät ole lopullisia ja määräytyvät vasta kun hankintailmoitus julkaistaan. Vastaaminen tapahtuu sähköpostitse osoitteeseen hankinnat@servica.fi. Otsikoikaa viestinne seuraavasti: "Tietopyyntö: Digitaalinen omavalvontajärjestelmä [yrityksen nimi]". Hankintayksikkö ei ole velvollinen vastaamaan kysymyksiin tai muuttamaan hankinnan sisältöä tarjoajien vastauksien perusteella. Vastaamalla tietopyyntöön tarjoaja hyväksyy nämä ehdot. result.text: Work package "UDP Migration Support" as part of the Urban Data Management (UDM) project In September 2024, the implementation phase began in the project "Establishment of Urban Data Platform (UDP) and Migration of Geographic Information System (GIS)". The Federal City of Bonn is relying on the open source project Civitas Core for the establishment of the UDP. With the Universal Urban Data App addon, the basics are in place that allow applications from the old GIS to be migrated to the UDP. In the conception phase of the project, approx. 300 applications to be migrated were identified. 80 percent of these applications support the enforcement of statutory services. Since the previous GIS can no longer be operated, the migration must be completed as quickly as possible. A valid estimate determines a total effort of 5197 person-days (PD) here. This effort will mainly be provided by internal employees in the 3 areas of requirement clarification, development and support. Support services amounting to roughly 650 PD up to the year 2028 are to be procured in the tender. Due to advancing support by AI, the contracting authority assumes that the migration duration can be decisively reduced. The focus of the procurement is on support services to be provided using the existing platform tools of the UDP. The migration is to be provided in accordance with the respective trades' existing Bonn guidelines such as data modelling, Geoserver configuration, Universal Urban Data Addon configuration, Masterportal configuration. Independent development work on the tools of the platform itself is not planned within the scope of the contract, or only to a very small extent and after prior consultation.

parts.source: Arbeitspaket "Migrationsunterstützung UDP" im Rahmen des Projekts Urban Data Management (UDM) Im September 2024 hat die Umsetzungsphase im Projekt "Aufbau Urban Data Platform (UDP) und Migration Geoinformationssystem (GIS)" begonnen. Die Bundesstadt Bonn setzt beim Aufbau der UDP auf das Open Source Projekt Civitas Core. Mit dem Addon Universal Urban Data App liegen die Grundlagen vor, die es erlauben, Anwendungen des alten GIS in die UDP zu migrieren. In der Konzeptionsphase des Projekts wurden ca. 300 zu migrierende Anwendungen identifiziert. 80 Prozent dieser Anwendungen unterstützen den Vollzug gesetzlicher Leistungen. Da das bisherige GIS nicht mehr weiter betrieben werden kann, ist die Migration so schnell wie möglich zu vollziehen. Eine valide Schätzung ermittelt hier einen Gesamtaufwand von 5197 Personentagen (PT). Dieser Aufwand wird hauptsächlich von internen Mitarbeitenden in den 3 Bereichen Anforderungsklärung, Entwicklung und Support geleistet werden. In der Vergabe sollen Unterstützungsleistungen im Umfang von grob 650 PT bis zum Jahr 2028 eingekauft werden. Aufgrund der fortschreitenden Unterstützung durch KI geht der Auftraggeber davon aus, dass die Migrationsdauer entscheidend reduziert werden kann. Der Schwerpunkt der Vergabe liegt auf Unterstützungsdienstleistungen unter Nutzung der vorhandenen Plattform-Werkzeuge der UDP zu erbringen. Die Migration ist nach den bestehenden Bonner Guide Lines der jeweiligen Gewerke wie Datenmodellierung, Geoserver Konfiguration, Universal Urban Data Addon Konfiguration, Masterportal Konfiguration zu erbringen. Eigenständige Entwicklungsarbeiten an den Werkzeugen der Plattform selbst sind im Rahmen des Auftrages nicht oder nur in sehr geringem Umfang und nach vorheriger Absprache vorgesehen.

result.text: The Energie Vorpommern GmbH (hereinafter: EVP) intends to re-award the commercial management for the sales division. The EVP is an energy supply company and supplies customers with electricity and natural gas in, among other places, the towns of Grimmen, Gützkow, Wolgast and the surrounding villages, as well as the island of Usedom. In the natural gas sector, the EVP is the basic supplier in the aforementioned region. The subject of this tender is the award of commercial services for energy operations. The contractor's activities include commercial management for the sales division. Details regarding the scope of services and the remuneration system can be found in the attached draft service contract (Annex A). The following points highlight essential key aspects. The individual service requirements arise in particular from the contract annexes (1a to 1h). The contractor's activities include the services described in more detail in contract annex 1: Description of Services, from the following areas: - Sales in general (cf. contract annex 1a: Sales) - Finance and accounting (cf. contract annex 1b: Finance and accounting) - Legal services (cf. contract annex 1c: Legal services) - Shared services sales (cf. contract annex 1d: Shared services) - Payroll accounting (cf. contract annex 1e: Payroll accounting) - Controlling and other services (cf. contract annex 1f: Controlling and other services) - Energy data management (cf. contract annex 1g: Energy data management) - IT infrastructure (cf. contract annex 1h: IT infrastructure) Furthermore, the contractor shall ensure the prior transfer of the EVP's digital data from the system of the previous service provider, SERVICE PLUS GMBH, to the new system. The EVP will inform the successful bidder upon award whether the data migration is to be carried out. The data migration must be completed by no later than 31.12.2027 in accordance with the concept to be created by the contractor (contract annex 5: Concept for data migration), so that the assumption of commercial management is possible for the contractor from this point in time. The EVP intends to award the services initially from 01.01.2027 to 31.12.2032, combined with the option of contract extension. The contract shall automatically extend by a further three years each time if the contract is not terminated by one of the contracting parties 18 months before the end of the term.

parts.source: Die Energie Vorpommern GmbH (nachfolgend: EVP) beabsichtigt die kaufmännische Betriebsführung für den Bereich Vertrieb neu zu vergeben. Die EVP ist ein Energieversorgungsunternehmen und versorgt Kunden unter anderem in den Städten Grimmen, Gützkow, Wolgast und den umliegenden Ortschaften sowie der Insel Usedom mit Strom und Erdgas. Im Bereich Erdgas ist die EVP Grundversorger in der v. g. Region. Gegenstand dieser Ausschreibung ist die Vergabe von kaufmännischen Dienstleistungen für den Energiebetrieb. Die Tätigkeit des Auftragnehmers umfasst die kaufmännische Betriebsführung für den Bereich Vertrieb. Die Einzelheiten zum Leistungsumfang sowie zur Vergütungssystematik sind dem beigefügten Entwurf des Dienstleistungsvertrages (Anlage A) zu entnehmen. Im Folgenden wird auf wesent-liche Eckpunkte hingewiesen. Die einzelnen Leistungsanforderungen ergeben sich insbesondere aus den Vertragsanlagen (1a bis 1h). Die Tätigkeit des Auftragnehmers umfasst die in der Vertragsanlage 1: Leistungsbeschreibung näher beschriebene Leistungen aus den folgenden Bereichen: - Vertrieb allgemein (vgl. Vertragsanlage 1a: Vertrieb) - Finanzen und Rechnungswesen (vgl. Vertragsanlage 1b: Finanzen und Rechnungswesen) - Juristische Dienste (vgl. Vertragsanlage 1c: Juristische Dienste) - Shared Services Vertrieb (vgl. Vertragsanlage 1d: Shared Services) - Personalabrechnung (vgl. Vertragsanlage 1e: Personalabrechnung) - Controlling und sonstige Leistungen (vgl. Vertragsanlage 1f: Controlling und sonstige Leistungen) - Energiedatenmanagement (vgl. Vertragsanlage 1g: Energiedatenmanagement) - IT-Infrastruktur (vgl. Vertragsanlage 1h: IT-Infrastruktur) Darüber hinaus stellt der Auftragnehmer die vorherige Übertragung der digitalen Daten der EVP aus dem System des bisherigen Dienstleisters, der SERVICE PLUS GMBH, auf das neue System sicher. Die EVP wird den obsiegenden Bieter mit dem Zuschlag darüber informieren, ob die Datenmigration durchzuführen ist. Die Datenmigration muss nach Maßgabe des durch den Auftragnehmer zu erstellenden Konzepts (Vertragsanlage 5: Konzept zur Datenmigration) spätestens bis zum 31.12.2027 abgeschlossen sein, sodass die Übernahme der kaufmännischen Betriebsführung für den Auftragnehmer ab diesem Zeitpunkt möglich ist. Die EVP beabsichtigt, die Leistungen zunächst vom 01.01.2027 bis zum 31.12.2032, verbunden mit der Möglichkeit der Vertragsverlängerung, zu vergeben. Der Vertrag verlängert sich jeweils automatisch um weitere drei Jahre, wenn der Vertrag nicht 18 Monate vor Ablauf der Laufzeit von einer Vertragspartei gekündigt wird.

result.text: The Espoo Region Joint Authority for Education (Omnia) is planning to put out to tender financial and payroll administration and HR systems and related services. The systems would be procured as a SaaS service, and for some areas of finance, payroll administration and HR, the procurement of the service is also being considered, whereby, for example, payroll would come to Omnia as a comprehensive service. The content emphasis and scope of the tender (only statutory services or broader, system procurement as a SaaS service or extensive comprehensive service procurement) will be specified further before the publication of the contract notice. Regarding statutory financial and payroll administration functionalities, Omnia's current goal is for the new solution (or comprehensive service) to be in use from 1.1.2027 onwards. Omnia invites suppliers to participate in a market dialogue, the goal of which is to obtain a comprehensive picture of the systems and services available on the market. With the help of the information obtained, Omnia will evaluate what kind of benefits they produce and how they would be suitable for Omnia's needs. The market survey is open to all suppliers that have systems or services belonging to this solution entity to offer. The focus of the market survey is on solutions that are already in production or available on the market. Suppliers are requested to present systems and services that are available and where the key functionalities are already implemented. The presentation of solutions under development or only at the concept level is not desired in this context. WRITTEN REQUEST FOR INFORMATION Omnia offers all suppliers an open opportunity to provide their comments in writing and to submit possible service descriptions and other attachments by email. Written observations are requested by Mon 13.10.2025 at 12.00 via the Forms form: https://forms.office.com/e/x36eWVynyU. Service descriptions and other attachments can be submitted on the same schedule by email to emma.strengell@kpmg.fi. Omnia may request a meeting or additional information from those participating in the request for information if it considers it necessary.

parts.source: Espoon seudun koulutuskuntayhtymä suunnittelee talous- ja palkkahallinnon sekä HR-järjestelmien ja niihin liittyvien palveluiden kilpailuttamista. Järjestelmät hankittaisiin SaaS-palveluna, ja joihinkin talous-, palkkahallinnon ja HR:n osa-alueisiin harkitaan myös palvelun hankkimista, jolloin esimerkiksi palkanlaskenta tulisi Omnialle kokonaispalveluna. Kilpailutuksen sisällöllistä painotusta ja laajuutta (vain lakisääteiset palvelut vai laveammin, järjestelmähankinta SaaS-palveluna vai laaja kokonaispalveluhankinta) täsmennetään vielä ennen hankintailmoituksen julkaisua. Lakisääteisten talous- ja palkkahallinnon toiminnallisuuksien osalta Omnian tämänhetkinen tavoite on, että uusi ratkaisu (tai kokonaispalvelu) olisi käytössä 1.1.2027 alkaen. Omnia kutsuu toimittajia osallistumaan markkinavuoropuheluun, jonka tavoitteena on saada kokonaiskuva markkinoilla olevista järjestelmistä ja palveluista. Saatavan tiedon avulla Omnia arvioi, millaisia hyötyjä ne tuottavat ja miten ne soveltuisivat Omnian tarpeisiin. Markkinakartoitus on avoin kaikille toimittajille, joilla on tarjota tämän ratkaisukokonaisuuden piiriin kuuluvia järjestelmiä tai palveluita. Markkinakartoituksen painopisteenä ovat ratkaisut, jotka ovat jo tuotannossa tai markkinoilla saatavilla. Toimittajia pyydetään esittelemään järjestelmiä ja palveluita, jotka ovat käytettävissä ja joissa keskeiset toiminnallisuudet ovat valmiiksi toteutettuja. Kehitteillä olevien tai vasta konseptitasolla olevien ratkaisujen esittelyä ei tässä yhteydessä toivota. KIRJALLINEN TIETOPYYNTÖ Omnia tarjoaa kaikille toimittajille avoimesti mahdollisuutta antaa kommenttejaan kirjallisesti sekä toimittaa mahdollisia palvelukuvauksia ja muita liitetiedostoja sähköpostitse. Kirjallisia huomioita pyydetään viimeistään ma 13.10.2025 klo 12.00 Forms-lomakkeella: https://forms.office.com/e/x36eWVynyU. Palvelukuvaukset ja muut liitetiedostot voi toimittaa samalla aikataululla sähköpostitse emma.strengell@kpmg.fi. Omnia voi pyytää tietopyyntöön osallistuvilta tapaamista tai lisätietoja, mikäli katsoo sen tarpeelliseksi.

result.text: The Legal AI Workspace software to be procured must serve as a specialised working environment to support legal professional work within the KfW Group using generative artificial intelligence. The software will be used in particular for legal research, analysis and the preparation of legal content, as well as for the (partially) automated creation, revision and structuring of documents and other legal work results. Users are personnel from the Legal department as well as other specialist departments and subsidiaries within the KfW Group. A Legal AI Workspace connects large language models with specialised processing layers that are optimised for working with legal content. It differs from general AI assistants in that it brings together legal professional processes in a unified working environment and employs mechanisms that are indispensable for professional legal practice. These include, in particular: the traceable anchoring of generated statements in verifiable sources, the structured processing of complex documents, and the rule-based review of contract content. The software must provide the following core functions. Legal research: The software must be able to answer complex legal questions based on relevant legal sources. Every generated statement must be traced back to concrete, verifiable sources (in particular statutes, case law, commentary literature) and made transparent for the users. KfW considers integrated access to curated legal databases to be a quality-enhancing feature. Furthermore, the software must be able to work with documents and internal knowledge databases provided by KfW. Document analysis and contract evaluation: The software must be able to process and evaluate the content of documents, including complexly structured contracts, tabular content and scanned documents, without essential structural information being lost. This includes the ability to systematically and completely compare contract content against specified review standards. Text creation and drafting support: The software must support the creation and revision of legal texts, in particular contract drafts, memoranda and opinions. Proposed changes must be able to be tracked directly in the document; the mere provision of generated text for manual adoption by the users does not meet the requirements. The software complements a general AI software already in use at KfW. The new software will be operated as an independent tool and will use a model infrastructure provided by the contractor. It is expected that the software will achieve significant increases in efficiency and quality in daily legal advice, document creation and review, and recurring standard legal tasks. Without prejudice to the provision of the software as a Service (SaaS) described in this document and the usage rights granted in connection therewith, the provision of the software must be carried out in such a way that it at least satisfies the intended purpose. KfW is entitled to at least the usage rights required to fulfil the intended purpose. The contractor is therefore liable for the following services: (a) provision of software with the functional scope, (b) execution of a project for the implementation of the software, (c) operation as SaaS, (d) provision of additional services as required, (e) termination support. Further details can be found in the 'Service Description' and in particular the mandatory criteria in accordance with the annex to the Service Description 'Mandatory and Optional Criteria'. parts.source: Die zu beschaffende Software Legal AI Workspace muss als spezialisierte Arbeitsumgebung die juristische Facharbeit im KfW‐Konzern mithilfe von generativer künstlicher Intelligenz unterstützen. Die Software wird insbesondere für juristische Recherche, Analyse und Aufbereitung von Rechtsinhalten sowie für die (teil-)automatisierte Erstellung, Überarbeitung und Strukturierung von Dokumenten und sonstigen juristischen Arbeitsergebnissen eingesetzt. Benutzer sind die Personen des Bereichs Recht sowie weiterer Fachbereiche und Töchter im KfW‐Konzern. Ein Legal AI Workspace verbindet große Sprachmodelle mit spezialisierten Verarbeitungsschichten, die für die Arbeit mit rechtlichen Inhalten optimiert sind. Er unterscheidet sich von allgemeinen KI‐Assistenten dadurch, dass er juristische Fachprozesse in einer einheitlichen Arbeitsumgebung zusammenführt und Mechanismen einsetzt, die für die professionelle Rechtsanwendung unabdingbar sind. Dazu zählen insbesondere: die nachvollziehbare Verankerung generierter Aussagen in überprüfbaren Quellen, die strukturierte Verarbeitung komplexer Dokumente sowie die regelbasierte Prüfung von Vertragsinhalten. Die Software muss die nachfolgenden Kernfunktionen bereitstellen. Rechtsrecherche: Die Software muss in der Lage sein, komplexe juristische Fragestellungen auf Grundlage einschlägiger Rechtsquellen zu beantworten. Jede generierte Aussage muss auf konkrete, überprüfbare Quellen (insbesondere Gesetze, Rechtsprechung, Kommentarliteratur) zurückgeführt und für die Benutzer transparent gemacht werden. Die KfW betrachtet den integrierten Zugang zu kuratierten juristischen Datenbanken als qualitätssteigerndes Merkmal. Die Software muss darüber hinaus mit von der KfW bereitgestellten Dokumenten und internen Wissensdatenbanken arbeiten können. Dokumentenanalyse und Vertragsauswertung: Die Software muss Dokumente, einschließlich komplex strukturierter Verträge, tabellarischer Inhalte und gescannter Unterlagen, inhaltlich verarbeiten und auswerten können, ohne dass wesentliche Strukturinformationen verloren gehen. Dies umfasst die Fähigkeit, Vertragsinhalte gegen vorgegebene Prüfungsmaßstäbe systematisch und vollständig abzugleichen. Texterstellung und Entwurfsunterstützung: Die Software muss die Erstellung und Überarbeitung juristischer Texte unterstützen, insbesondere von Vertragsentwürfen, Vermerken und Stellungnahmen. Änderungsvorschläge müssen unmittelbar im Dokument nachvollzogen werden können; eine bloße Bereitstellung von generiertem Text zur manuellen Übernahme durch die Benutzer genügt den Anforderungen nicht. Die Software ergänzt eine bei der KfW bereits eingesetzte allgemeine KI‐Software. Die neue Software wird als eigenständiges Werkzeug betrieben und nutzt eine von dem Auftragnehmer bereitgestellte Modellinfrastruktur. Es wird erwartet, dass die Software deutliche Effizienz- und Qualitätssteigerungen in der täglichen Rechtsberatung, bei der Dokumentenerstellung und ‐prüfung sowie bei wiederkehrenden rechtlichen Standardaufgaben erreichen wird. Unbeschadet der in diesem Dokument beschriebenen Bereitstellung der Software as a Service (SaaS) und der dazu ggf. eingeräumten Nutzungsrechte hat die Bereitstellung der Software so zu erfolgen, dass sie dem Einsatzzweck mindestens genügt. Der KfW stehen hierfür mindestens die Nutzungsrechte zu, die erforderlich sind, um den Einsatzzweck zu erfüllen. Der Auftragnehmer schuldet somit die folgenden Leistungen: (a) Bereitstellung einer Software mit dem Funktionsumfang, (b) Durchführung eines Projekts zur Einführung der Software, (c) Betrieb als SaaS, (d) Je nach Bedarf Erbringung zusätzlicher Leistungen, (e) Beendigungsunterstützung. result.text: Background Arendal municipality has an ongoing need for graphical services connected to information material and visual communication aimed at inhabitants and internal target groups. The municipality produces some material itself, but needs external assistance for assignments that are more complex, time consuming or require special professional competence. The procurement shall ensure access to capacity and relevant competence within graphical design, at the same time as the municipality takes care of the need for uniform visual communication and clear identity. The municipality shall be one sender. It is also important to ensure that material and visual deliveries fulfil the requirements for universal design and ensure accessible and understandable communication for different user groups. The municipality therefore needs to establish a new framework agreement that provides predictable access to graphical assistance as needed, both for smaller ongoing assignments and for major or more strategic deliveries. Description of the assignment The procurement is for graphic services for Arendal municipality. The delivery shall cover the development and production of various types of graphical material and visual elements, including information material, reports, presentations, templates, graphics for digital surfaces, infographics, illustrations and professional design consultancy services. The assignments will vary in extent and complexity. The municipality needs a tenderer who can assist with both smaller, limited assignments and large deliveries that require more planning and close cooperation with the contracting authority. Minor assignments means limited deliveries such as, for example, an ad, poster, presentation or simple illustration. Larger deliveries means assignments that include planning, coordination and multiple sub-services, such as a report or campaign material. The deliveries shall be able to be used further in the municipality ́s own channels and tools, and it is important that the deliveries can be further developed and adapted internally. The framework agreement shall also include the design of profile material and profile articles, as well as graphic materials connected to the use of, among other things, vehicles, buildings and work clothes. Web design for arendal.kommune.no is not included in the procurement. It is important to have clear contact points, effective clarifications and a good understanding of the municipality ́s graphical profile, communication needs and targets for clear, available and recognisable communication.

result.text: The Ministry of Defence (MOD), through the Defence AI Accelerator Task Force (TF RAID), intends to procure a secure, scalable capability to support operational planning across Defence. TF RAID exists to accelerate the responsible adoption of artificial intelligence (AI) and data-enabled capabilities in support of Defence outcomes, working with users, technical specialists and industry to identify, test and transition operationally relevant solutions. This requirement is expected to support operational planners by improving access to authorised planning information, enabling reusable machine-readable planning knowledge, orchestrating analytical services, and supporting the modelling, testing and comparison of alternative Courses of Action (COAs). The procurement will be structured as a single competition with 2 Lots: - Lot 1 will focus on planning data, knowledge and analytical orchestration services; and - Lot 2 will focus on COA testing, evaluation and adaptation services. Suppliers are invited to bid for 1 or both lots. Together, the Lots are intended to improve the speed, quality, traceability and robustness of operational planning while maintaining appropriate human oversight, governance, transparency, security and interoperability within Authority-approved environments, including those handling information up to SECRET UK EYES ONLY where required. MOD will be seeking to compete this requirement through the Government Commercial Agency Artificial Intelligence Dynamic Purchasing System (AI DPS/RM6200). Participation in any subsequent competition will therefore be limited to suppliers appointed to the relevant Lots of the AIDPS Framework who pass the shortlist filter exercise. Lot 1: Planning Data, Knowledge and Analytical Orchestration Services (PDKAOS). The requirement is expected to support operational planning activities through the integration of planning data, machine-readable planning knowledge and advanced analytical services. The Authority seeks a capability that improves the speed, quality and scale of operational planning whilst maintaining appropriate human oversight, governance, transparency and security. Requirement Summary: The Authority requires an initial capability to support operational planners by enabling them to: • Discover, access and exploit authorised planning information from multiple sources. • Create and maintain reusable representations of planning knowledge, expertise, assumptions, dependencies and relationships. • Assemble, configure and reuse analytical services in support of operational planning tasks. • Improve traceability between planning inputs, analytical activities and planning outputs. • Reduce dependency on fragmented information sources, manual processes and specialist knowledge bottlenecks. The capability is expected to support planning activity across multiple domains, operational functions and echelons of command rather than providing a single-purpose planning application. Lot 2: COA Testing, Evaluation and Adaptation Services for Operational Planning. The requirement is expected to support operational planning activities through the representation of operational environments, modelling of Courses of Action (COAs), evaluation of alternative scenarios and adversary responses, and generation of evidence-based insights to support planning and decision-making. The Authority seeks a capability that improves the speed, quality and robustness of operational planning whilst maintaining appropriate human oversight, governance, transparency and security. The Authority requires an initial capability to support operational planners by enabling them to: • Represent operational environments, actors, assumptions, constraints and dependencies in reusable and machine-readable forms. • Model, test and compare alternative Courses of Action. • Explore multiple operational scenarios, environmental conditions, assumptions and adversary responses. • Generate evidence-based insights to support adaptation and refinement of operational plans. • Improve traceability between planning inputs, analytical activities and planning outputs. • Reduce reliance on manual wargaming, fragmented information sources and time-intensive analytical processes. The capability is expected to support planning activity across multiple domains, operational functions and echelons of command rather than providing a single-purpose planning application.

result.text: The Sir John Brunner Foundation Multi-Academy Trust (Cheshire) is undertaking pre-market engagement in relation to a proposed procurement for the management of community lettings and facilities hire across part of its estate. The initial scope is expected to include Middlewich High School and Sir John Deane's Sixth Form College, with the possibility of future extension to other Trust sites, subject to suitability, value for money and operational requirements. The Trust's wider estate includes The County High School, Leftwich and (from November) primary academies in the Northwich area. The Trust is seeking to understand the market for managed lettings services and to inform the development of its final specification, procurement route and commercial model. The proposed requirement is expected to involve the management, marketing, booking, administration and operational delivery of lettings and community use of school and college facilities outside core educational hours. The Trust's objectives are to: increase utilisation of facilities outside normal school and college hours; improve and expand access for local clubs, voluntary organisations and community groups; support sustainable community use, particularly for local and regular users; ensure safeguarding, site security, supervision and operational control during lettings activity; reduce the administrative and operational burden on academy staff; protect the condition, readiness and availability of facilities for core educational use; increase income through improved utilisation and broader use of facilities, rather than relying solely on price increases; and establish a professional, compliant and scalable lettings model capable of operating across multiple academy sites where appropriate. The facilities potentially within scope include, but are not limited to, indoor sports halls, outdoor pitches, all-weather/3G or astro facilities, playing fields, performance and assembly spaces, classrooms, specialist teaching areas, changing rooms, car parking and ancillary facilities. The final list of facilities will be confirmed following engagement with the market. The Trust is particularly interested in engaging with providers able to deliver one or more of the following models: a fully managed lettings service, including marketing, bookings, customer management, income collection, staffing, supervision, safeguarding, compliance and reporting; a managed bookings and staffing model, including provider-led marketing, customer management and revenue administration, with operational delivery agreed between the provider and the Trust; and/or advice on appropriate commercial structures, including revenue share, guaranteed income, management fee or hybrid models. At this stage, the Trust does not intend to pursue a software-only booking platform as the primary solution, as the requirement includes a need for operational delivery, staffing and site supervision, particularly at Middlewich High School. However, the Trust welcomes feedback on systems and technology used to support managed lettings services. The Trust anticipates that any future contract would require the successful provider to demonstrate robust arrangements for: on-site staffing and supervision; safeguarding, site security and incident escalation; access control, opening, closing and site handover; cleaning, facility reset and reporting of damage or defects; customer service and complaints management; protection and transition of existing community users where possible; pricing strategy and affordability for local community users; financial reporting, reconciliation, VAT information and income remittance; performance reporting and attendance at formal contract review meetings; and orderly exit and transfer of booking/customer data at the end of the arrangement. The Trust is considering a phased implementation approach, with Sir John Deane's Sixth Form College and non-pitch lettings at Middlewich High School potentially commencing first, followed by Middlewich High School pitch or astro lettings at a later stage to allow appropriate transition and notice for existing users. result.text: NOTICE: PLEASE READ - April 6, 2023 EDA is excited to announce the launch of its new grants management platform: the Economic Development Grants Experience (EDGE). EDGE was developed to streamline the application and grants management process by implementing a single platform with increased transparency, improved user experience, higher data quality, and more efficiency throughout the entire grant lifecycle. As of April 6th , 2023, applications can no longer be submitted on Grants.gov, and will ONLY be accepted through EDGE. Once your concept proposal has been reviewed, you will receive an invitation to apply in EDGE. More information on how to apply is provided in the full NOFO. You must submit concept proposals to rnta@eda.gov. Program Description EDA provides strategic investments on a competitive merit basis to support economic development, foster job creation, and attract private investment in economically distressed areas of the United States. Under this NOFO, EDA solicits applications from applicants in order to provide investments that support research and technical assistance projects under EDA’s R&E and NTA programs. Grants and cooperative agreements made under these programs are designed to leverage existing regional assets and support the implementation of economic development strategies that advance new ideas and creative approaches to advance economic prosperity in distressed communities. This NOFO employs a two-step application process: (1) the Concept Proposal and (2) the Full Application. EDA will only review Full Applications submitted by applicants who first submitted a Concept Proposal. Any Full Application received from an applicant that did not submit a Concept Proposal will be deemed ineligible and not considered for funding. For the Concept Proposal, applicants may use the optional template available at https://eda.gov/programs/rnta/resources/. Full Applications must be submitted through Grants.gov using the link that EDA will provide with its response to the Concept Proposal. *Please note: While the published Notice of Funding Opportunity (available under "Related Documents") states that the ED900A form and the SF424B form are both required for a complete application, these forms are no longer required and have therefore been removed from the package template.

The aim is to obtain comprehensive information to support the implementation of a potential future tender. The subject and content of the procurement will be specified and defined in the final published call for tenders. With this invitation, we request tenderers interested in the procurement to register and participate in the dialogue concerning the procurement. These materials will be reviewed together during the session. However, the contracting authority is not obliged to take into account the responses received in the market dialogue when drafting the call for tenders.

parts.source: Tämä ei ole hankintailmoitus eikä tarjouspyyntö, vaan kutsu markkinavuoropuheluun, jolla Kaarinan kaupunki kartoittaa markkinoita varhaiskasvatuksen avoimen lähdekoodin eVaka-järjestelmän käyttöönotto-, ylläpito-, tuki- ja kehityspalvelujen kilpailutusta varten. KUTSU MARKKINAVUOROPUHELUUN Tämän markkinavuoropuhelun tarkoituksena on kartoittaa markkinoilla olevia toimijoita sekä kerätä toimittajien kommentteja. Tavoitteena on saada kattavasti tietoa mahdollisen tulevan kilpailutuksen toteutuksen tueksi. Hankinnan kohde ja sisältö tarkentuu ja määritetään lopulliseen julkaistavaan tarjouspyyntöön. Tällä kutsulla pyydämme hankinnasta kiinnostuneita tarjoajia ilmoittautumaan ja osallistumaan hankintaa koskevaan vuoropuheluun. Vuoropuhelulla haetaan tietoa markkinoilla toimivista tarjoajista ja tarjolla olevien palveluiden ominaisuuksista suhteessa tilaajan tarpeisiin. Tavoitteena on saada palautetta sekä mahdollisia kehitysehdotuksia valmisteilla olevaan tarjouspyyntökokonaisuuteen. Markkinavuoropuhelu Markkinavuoropuhelut toteutetaan alustavan aikataulun mukaisesti ti 22.9.2026 klo 12-14 välisenä aikana etäyhteydellä Teams-kokouksena. Keskustelutilaisuudet järjestetään enintään kolmen (3) toimittajan kanssa. Mikäli markkinavuoropuheluun ilmoittautuneita yrityksiä on yli kolme (3), valitsee hankintayksikkö omista lähtökohdistaan sopivimmat toimittajat vuoropuheluun. Markkinavuoropuhelun tarkoituksena on tiedottaa markkinoita tulevasta kilpailutuksesta, kartoittaa markkinoiden tilannetta, mahdollistaa kommenttien esittäminen tulevasta hankinnasta sekä saada hankintaa koskevaa tietoa, jotta varsinainen tarjouskilpailu voidaan toteuttaa mahdollisimman tarkoituksenmukaisella tavalla. Markkinavuoropuhelutilaisuudessa esitellään tulevan hankinnan tarkoitus ja tavoitteet sekä yleisesti hankintaprosessi aikatauluineen (ei sitova). Hankintayksikkö varaa oikeuden toimittaa ilmoittautuneille ennakkokysymyksiä sekä luonnoksen tarjouspyyntöasiakirjoista ennen tilaisuutta. Nämä materiaalit käydään yhdessä läpi tilaisuuden aikana. Toimittajia pyydetään valmistautumaan tilaisuuteen enintään 10 minuutin esityksellä, jossa esitellään yrityksen toiminta, keskeiset osaamisalueet sekä hankinnan kannalta tarkoituksenmukaiset palvelut. Tilaisuudessa toimittajilla on myös mahdollisuus esittää kysymyksiä sekä tehdä ehdotuksia hankintaan liittyen. Markkinavuoropuhelu tullaan toteuttamaan suomen kielellä. Vuoropuheluun osallistumisesta ei makseta korvausta eikä hankintayksikkö korvaa markkinavuoropuheluun osallistumiseen aiheutuvista kustannuksista. ILMOITTAUTUMINEN Kaikkia kiinnostuneita alan toimijoita pyydetään ilmoittautumaan markkinavuoropuheluun viimeistään 15.9.2026 klo 11.00 mennessä osoitteessa https://kaarina.toimittajapalvelu.fi/ Ilmoittautumista koskevat lisätiedot: hankinnat@kaarina.fi ILMOITUKSEN LISÄTIEDOT Tämä ilmoitus on kutsu markkinavuoropuheluun. Tällä ilmoituksella ei pyydetä tarjouksia. Tämä ilmoitus ei velvoita hankintayksikköä toteuttamaan varsinaista hankintaa, eikä hankintayksikkö sitoudu tekemään tämän ilmoituksen mukaisia hankintoja. Ilmoitetut tiedot hankinnasta tai hankintamenettelystä eivät ole hankintayksikköä sitovia mahdollisessa myöhemmässä hankintamenettelyssä. Tähän markkinavuoropuheluun osallistumatta jättäminen ei estä mahdolliseen tarjouskilpailuun osallistumista, eikä vuoropuheluun osallistuminen vaikuta tarjoajan asemaan varsinaisessa tarjouskilpailussa. Markkinavuoropuhelussa esiin tulleet tiedot säilyvät täysin luottamuksellisina ja niitä tullaan käyttämään ainoastaan mahdollisen hankinnan kehittämiseen ja suunnitteluun. Hankintayksikkö ei kuitenkaan ole velvollinen ottamaan huomioon markkinavuoropuhelussa saatuja vastauksia tarjouspyynnön laadinnassa.

result.text: Artificial Intelligence (AI) Discovery and consultancy services for artificial intelligence (AI), implementation, support of AI systems, end-to-end partnerships, and access to a range of AI technologies. Updates 21 November 2025: We have extended this agreement until 23 February 2029. You will be able to buy and run tenders for services until the new expiry date. Description A Dynamic Purchasing System (DPS) that provides public sector organisations with access to a wide range of Artificial Intelligence (AI) services. What you can buy RM6200 Artificial Intelligence (AI) supports organisations at every stage of their AI journey. It supports: Users new to AI: you can purchase discovery services to help understand AI and its benefits. Established AI users: obtain licensing, customization, and support from suppliers. End-to-end support: choose comprehensive partnerships if you need both discovery and ongoing support. Available AI product types General AI applications, augmented decision making, data and analytics, and virtual assistants or chatbots. Medical AI Technology Health and social care bodies can specifically access applications such as: medical imaging software non-imaging diagnostic software symptom-based software. These applications support functions like screening, diagnosis, and improving system efficiency, in line with the AI in Health and Care Award. Contracts awarded under this agreement can last up to 4 years, based on how complex your project is. The DPS allows you to shortlist suppliers based on your needs using a range of filters. Once you have established your shortlist you can use this to run a further competition. Benefits complies with government standards, including the Data Ethics Framework and AI Procurement Guidelines reduces buying times through an easier route to market ensures ethical buying and supports strong ethics processes offers commercial flexibility to meet the public sector’s AI needs allows supplier shortlisting based on quality, price, and cultural fit (including social value ) provides a dynamic pool of suppliers that can evolve with the market includes bespoke Intellectual Property Rights (IPR) terms for the AI market promotes standards for AI and data-driven technology in healthcare Products and suppliers Please read the 'How to buy' tab below for detailed instructions on how to find out which suppliers are on this agreement. Lot 1: Artificial Intelligence (AI) Expires: 23/02/2029 How to buy Register as a buyer. Note: although pages are headed ‘Supplier registration’ this is also where you can register as a buyer Go to the Artificial Intelligence DPS and log in with your username and password. Click on ‘confirm’ at the bottom of the text, and agree to the terms of use. On your ‘Manage your DPS Category Exports’ page you now have 2 options (in the bottom right-hand corner of the page): view appointed suppliers Buyers are encouraged to conduct pre-market engagement before using the filters click on the link to create a new category export, this is how you filter the suppliers that can meet your needs Use the filtering tool to specify your needs, this will create a list of capable suppliers. Attach filters descriptions document in this section. save your filtered list of capable suppliers by clicking the ‘Save Category’ option shortlisted suppliers are a 100% match to the buyers selected filters from your ‘Manage your Category Exports’ page you can then export the list of suppliers and contact details (export is to an Excel spreadsheet) Log out of the DPS. Use the list to run a further competition. Invite the suppliers identified by the DPS to bid against your detailed specification and evaluation criteria. The list is valid for 2 working days only, from the date of its creation, because new suppliers may be applying to join at any point. if your further competition excludes eligible suppliers it could breach procurement regulations get a fresh supplier list (steps 3.2 to 5) if you do not use your list within 2 working days by clicking the ‘Search Again’ option for your export you can use your own eSourcing tool or the our eSourcing too l to run a further competition. Our eSourcing tool is free to use for public sector Evaluate responses and award the contract. Detailed buyer guidance is available in the documents section. You can watch the How to use the Artificial Intelligence Dynamic Purchasing System video. Documents Updates Crown Commercial Service (CCS) became Government Commercial Agency (GCA) on 1 April 2026. Documents published before this date may still refer to CCS. All contract documents remain valid for existing and new contracts, and there are no changes to how you work with us.

result.text: Liverpool City Region Combined Authority is seeking to appoint suitably qualified, experienced suppliers to provide a range of land, property and asset valuation services across its diverse operational and commercial estate. These services are required to support the effective management, governance and strategic development of the Authority's assets, ensuring compliance with statutory, regulatory, accounting, insurance and asset management requirements. It is anticipated that the procurement will be structured into the following Lots: Lot 1: Insurance Valuations Lot 2: Commercial/Public Asset Valuations Lot 3: DEC for non-dwellings public/operational Buildings Lot 4: Other Asset-Related Services Suppliers must be registered on the Chest in order to participate in the tender: https://procontract.due-north.com/Register The dates specified in this Notice remain subject to change. Lot 1: Insurance Valuations. The provision of insurance valuation reports in accordance with CIPFA and RICS regulations on a rolling programme. Lot 2: Commercial / Public Asset Valuations . Ad-hoc valuations of commercial and public assets in line with the RICS Valuation Professional Standards ("Red Book") Lot 3: DEC for non-dwellings public/operational Buildings. Display Energy Certificates and/or Energy Performance Certificates with supporting advisory report . Lot 4: Other Asset-Related Services. General valuation advice, condition/dilapidation surveys, etc.

rejected.text: The Universitätsklinikum Heidelberg (UKHD) is one of the largest and most renowned medical centres in Germany. Every year, approximately 80.000 patients are treated on a full-time or part-time inpatient basis in its specialist clinics, and more than 1.000.000 patients are cared for on an outpatient basis. The Heidelberg campus brings together scientific institutes and clinics of the UKHD, offers extensive opportunities for collaboration with the life sciences and humanities faculties of the university, and simultaneously maintains established partnerships with internationally renowned non-university large-scale research institutions. The increasing complexity and rising demands on IT infrastructure in the healthcare sector require reliable and efficient management of the IT landscape. In the context of the UKHD, it is of crucial importance that operational and clinical applications run constantly and without disruption to ensure optimal patient care and smooth operations. As part of this procurement procedure, the University Hospital is issuing a framework agreement for the provision of support services in IT application management (expected) from 1. February 2027 for the following 4 years (planned) incl. extension options. A gradual transition to transfer the services from the existing operation, which is outsourced to an external service provider, is planned for the period Q1/Q2 2027. The full takeover of the provision of all contractual services into regular operation is to take place by no later than 01.07.2027. The Centre for Digitalisation and Information Technology (ZDI) of the Universitätsklinikum Heidelberg is operationally divided into individual areas. Supported by contractors as external service providers, they assume end-to-end responsibility regarding the IT of the respective core processes of the contracting authority in order to be able to ensure secure and stable operation, as well as the further development of IT services. Directly affected by the tender and the subject of the procurement are the areas for Operational Information Systems (BIS), for Hospital Information Systems (KIS), for Integration, Special Systems and Archiving (ISA), as well as the ZDI itself. The scope of the tender covers the contracting authority's service requirements for operational services in application management. This includes, in particular, smooth application operation, the rapid and permanent resolution of incidents and problems, as well as releases, upgrades and updates in coordination with the contracting authority. Furthermore, this includes other supporting project services that are in direct or close substantive connection with the aforementioned operational services. In this regard, the future contractor is expected to provide comprehensive and holistic services within the framework of a managed service in order to implement the requirements of the contracting authority regarding IT architecture, IT security and IT service integration. The integration of IT services based on the ITIL v4 framework must be provided holistically for all specialist departments. In this context, the contracting authority will manage the contractor(s) and provide the IT hardware required at the contracting authority's locations as well as a portion of the required software licences.

parts.source: Das Universitätsklinikum Heidelberg (UKHD) gehört zu den größten und renommiertesten medizinischen Zentren in Deutschland. Jedes Jahr werden in dessen Fachkliniken circa 80.000 Patienten voll- und teilstationär behandelt und mehr als 1.000.000 Patienten ambulant betreut. Der Heidelberger Campus vereint wissenschaftliche Institute und Kliniken des UKHD, bietet reichhaltige Möglichkeiten der Zusammenarbeit mit lebens- und geisteswissenschaftlichen Fakultäten der Universität und hält gleichzeitig etablierte Kooperationen mit international renommierten außeruniversitären Großforschungseinrichtungen bereit. Die zunehmende Komplexität und die steigenden Anforderungen an die IT-Infrastruktur im Gesundheitswesen erfordern eine zuverlässige und effiziente Verwaltung der IT-Landschaft. Im Kontext des UKHD ist es von entscheidender Bedeutung, dass die betrieblichen und klinischen Anwendungen stets verfügbar und störungsfrei laufen, um eine optimale Patientenversorgung und einen reibungslosen Betrieb zu gewährleisten. Im Rahmen dieses Vergabeverfahrens schreibt das Universitätsklinikum einen Rahmenvertrag zur Erbringung von Unterstützungsleistungen im IT-Applikationsmanagement (voraussichtlich) ab dem 1. Februar 2027 für die folgenden 4 Jahren (geplant) inkl. Verlängerungsoptionen aus. Eine möglichst schrittweise Transition zur Überführung der Leistungen aus dem bestehenden an einen externen Dienstleister ausgelagerten Betrieb ist für den Zeitraum Q1/Q2 2027 geplant. Die vollständige Übernahme der Erbringung aller vertragsgegenständlichen Leistungen in den Regelbetrieb soll spätestens zum 01.07.2027. Das Zentrum für Digitalisierung und Informationstechnologie (ZDI) der Universitätsklinikum Heidelberg wird operativ in einzelne Bereiche unterteilt. Sie übernehmen unterstützt durch Auftragnehmer als externe Dienstleistungserbringer die Ende-zu-Ende-Verantwortung in Bezug auf die IT der jeweiligen Kernprozesse des Auftraggebers, um einen sicheren und stabilen Betrieb, aber auch die Weiterentwicklung der IT-Leistung sicherstellen zu können. Direkt von der Ausschreibung und dem Vergabegegenstand betroffen sind die Bereiche für Betriebliche Informationssysteme (BIS), für Krankenhaus-Informationssysteme (KIS), für Integration, Spezialsysteme und Archivierung (ISA) sowie direkt das ZDI selbst. Mit dem Ausschreibungsumfang wird der Servicebedarf des Auftraggebers von Betriebsleistungen im Applikationsmanagement abgedeckt. Dies beinhaltet insbesondere den reibungslosen Applikationsbetrieb, das schnelle und dauerhafte Beheben von Incidents und Problems sowie Releases, Upgrades und Updates in Abstimmung mit dem Auftraggeber. Außerdem umfasst dieser weitere unterstützende Projektleistungen, welche im direkten oder nahen inhaltlichen Zusammenhang mit den vorgenannten Betriebsleistungen stehen. result.text: Cold homes, damp, mould and fuel poverty are driving poor health outcomes, increasing pressure on healthcare services and deepening inequalities. While Registered Social Landlords are investing in warmer, more energy-efficient housing and responding to new regulatory requirements, fuel poverty means many vulnerable residents remain at risk, even in high-quality homes. Current approaches are often reactive and lack mechanisms to target support for those that might be the very most vulnerable, addressing issues only after harm has occurred. This Challenge seeks innovative solutions that can help registered social landlords identify where housing conditions, fuel poverty and individual vulnerability combine to create the greatest risk of harm, then translate that insight into practical, targeted action that combats these impacts, improves tenants’ health and wellbeing outcomes, protects homes and makes better use of limited housing and support resources. Solutions must be affordable at RSL scale, protect tenant privacy, and connect insight to action so that Cloch can complete investigation and repair work within statutory timescales.

rejected.text: The far-reaching impact and rate of innovation in the computer and information science and engineering fields has been remarkable, generating economic prosperity and enhancing the quality of life for people throughout the world. More than a decade ago, the National Science Foundation’s (NSF) Directorate for Computer and Information Science and Engineering (CISE) established the Expeditions in Computing (Expeditions) programme to build on past successes and provide the CISE research and education community with the opportunity to pursue ambitious, fundamental research agendas that promise to define the future of computing and information. In planning Expeditions projects, investigators are strongly encouraged to come together within or across departments or institutions to combine their creative talents in the identification of compelling, transformative research agendas that look ahead by at least a decade and promise disruptive innovations in computer and information science and engineering for many years to come. Now funded at levels up to $15,000,000 for seven years, Expeditions projects represent some of the largest single investments currently made by the CISE directorate. Together with the Science and Technology Centres and the National Artificial Intelligence Research Institutes that CISE supports, Expeditions projects form the centrepiece of the directorate's centre-scale award portfolio. With awards funded at levels that promote the formation of large research teams, CISE recognises that concurrent research advances in multiple fields or sub-fields are often necessary to stimulate deep and enduring outcomes. The awards made in this programme will complement research areas supported by other CISE programmes, which target particular computer and information science and engineering fields. Additionally, CISE offers Innovation Transition (InTrans) awards for teams nearing the end of their Expeditions as well as Secure and Trustworthy Cyberspace (SaTC) and Cyber-Physical Systems (CPS) Frontier projects. The goal of InTransis to continue the long-term vision and objectives of CISE’s centre-scale projects. Through InTrans awards, CISE will provide limited funds to match industry support.

result.text: An IT application is to be procured as a SaaS cloud solution for the digitisation of processes relating to trichinella testing, the management of monitoring samples in the animal health sector, and management in the event of an outbreak of African Swine Fever (ASF). The IT application must be compatible with the hunting statistics application from Condition – Integrierte Softwarelösungen GmbH. This is used in the Free State of Thuringia to record bag data (data on wild animals killed by hunters). The IT application should be available both as a web application (usable in common browsers) and as a mobile app (iOS and Android operating systems). Within the scope of the tender, an app is defined as an application that must be installed on a mobile device before use by the user and can only be used there. As a rule, this takes place on a smartphone or tablet using a so-called app store. There will be two main user groups: a) administrative or laboratory staff b) non-administrative users (e.g. authorised hunters). The non-administrative users record data on killed or slaughtered animals. If necessary, they also submit applications for the testing of these animals for trichinella and/or certain wildlife diseases to the competent authorities or the competent testing facility of the Free State of Thuringia. The test results should be retrievable via the IT application. The competent authorities (veterinary and food monitoring offices of the districts and independent cities - veterinary authorities) operate the trichinella testing laboratories. These should be able to access the application data recorded by external users in the IT application via their own user interface and transmit the test results back to the applicants. In addition, laboratory software should be made available to the competent authorities, with the help of which testing activities can be documented on the basis of the application data. In the case of monitoring samples in the animal health sector, the client's laboratory at the Thuringian State Office for Consumer Protection is the competent testing facility. The laboratory software (LIMS) in use there should be able to access the information on the samples entered by the users via the HIT database. The IT application must therefore have an interface to the HIT database. A direct connection to the LIMS is not intended. The IT application is to be made available to administrative staff for mapping internal administrative processes, as well as to affected users outside the administration for data entry and application submission, and for receiving notifications from the competent authorities. While the use cases of trichinella testing, management of monitoring samples in the animal health sector, and the interface to the hunting statistics application are to be available permanently, the use case of management in the event of an outbreak of African Swine Fever (ASF) is only to be usable and available on an ad-hoc basis. Furthermore, introductory support and training for the staff of the competent authorities should be included in the offer as an initial service. The contract is concluded via an EVB-IT cloud contract. The procurement is carried out by the client for use by all districts and independent cities in Thuringia. The use of the IT application for the aforementioned purposes is mandatory for the districts and independent cities. For hunters, however, use is optional. This means they can refrain from using the IT application. The previous analogue system for sampling will continue to be used in parallel for the time being. The 21 veterinary and food monitoring offices of the 22 districts and independent cities in the Free State of Thuringia are, among other things, responsible for receiving and testing samples of slaughtered or killed animals intended for human consumption for Trichinella spp. Furthermore, there are responsibilities with regard to granting permission for the taking of samples intended for trichinella testing by non-administrative persons. Citizens who wish to make use of the aforementioned administrative services should be enabled to record the required application data digitally in accordance with the principles of the Online Access Act (OZG), to submit the application paperlessly to the respective competent veterinary and food monitoring office, and to receive the notifications from the competent authorities. In addition, the possibility should be created to comply with further reporting obligations (e.g. the recording of hunting bags by hunters) in digital form. The testing of wild boar for Trichinella spp. only takes place if the animal is to become food. Based on experience to date, this leads to the testing of up to 30.000 head of wild boar per year in Thuringia. These figures fluctuate. In addition, the veterinary surveillance authorities are responsible for implementing regular monitoring of killed wild animals for certain animal disease pathogens. Depending on the current animal health status, the number of samples is expected to vary between approx. 5.000 and 30.000 samples per year. Data entry and application submission as well as the receipt of notifications should also be made possible here for the respective affected citizens. parts.source: Es soll eine IT-Anwendung zur Digitalisierung der Vorgänge in Bezug auf die Trichinenuntersuchung, das Management von Monitoring-Proben im Tiergesundheitsbereich und das Management im Falle eines Ausbruches der Afrikanischen Schweinepest (ASP) als SaaS-Cloud-Lösung beschafft werden. Die IT-Anwendung muss kompatibel zur Jagdstatistik-Anwendung der Condition – Integrierte Softwarelösungen GmbH sein. Mit dieser werden im Freistaat Thüringen die Streckendaten (Daten der von Jägern erlegten Wildtiere) erfasst. Die IT-Anwendung soll sowohl als Web- (nutzbar in den gängigen Browsern) als auch Mobile App-Anwendung (Betriebssysteme iOS und Android) zur Verfügung stehen. Als App wird im Rahmen der Ausschreibung eine Anwendung definiert, die vor Verwendung durch den Nutzer auf einem mobilen Gerät installiert werden muss und auch nur dort genutzt werden kann. In der Regel erfolgt dies auf einem Smartphone oder Tablet mithilfe eines sogenannten App-Stores. Es wird zwei wesentliche Nutzergruppen geben: a) Verwaltungs- bzw. Labormitarbeiter b) verwaltungsexterne Nutzer (z. B. Jagdausübungsberechtigte) Die verwaltungsexternen Nutzer erfassen Daten zu erlegten bzw. geschlachteten Tieren. Erforderlichenfalls stellen diese zudem Anträge zur Untersuchung dieser Tiere auf Trichinen und/oder bestimmte Wildtierseuchen bei den zuständigen Behörden bzw. der zuständigen Untersuchungseinrichtung des Freistaates Thüringen. Die Untersuchungsergebnisse sollen über die IT-Anwendung abrufbar sein. Die zuständigen Behörden (Veterinär- und Lebensmittelüberwachungsämter der Landkreise und kreisfreie Städte - Veterinärbehörden) betreiben die Trichinenuntersuchungslabore. Diese sollen über eine eigene Nutzeroberfläche auf die durch die externen Nutzer in der IT-Anwendung erfassten Antragsdaten zugreifen und die Untersuchungsergebnisse an die Antragssteller zurück übermitteln können. Zudem soll für die zuständigen Behörden eine Laborsoftware zur Verfügung gestellt werden, mit Hilfe dieser auf Basis der Antragsdaten die Untersuchungstätigkeiten dokumentiert werden können. Im Falle der Monitoring-Proben im Tiergesundheitsbereich ist das Labor des Auftraggebers im Thüringer Landesamt für Verbraucherschutz die zuständige Untersuchungseinrichtung. Die dort in Nutzung befindliche Laborsoftware (LIMS) soll über die HIT-Datenbank auf die von den Nutzern eingegebenen Informationen zu den Proben zugreifen können. Die IT-Anwendung muss daher über eine Schnittstelle zur HIT-Datenbank verfügen. Eine direkte Verbindung zum LIMS ist nicht vorgesehen. Die IT-Anwendung soll den Verwaltungsmitarbeitenden zur Abbildung verwaltungsinterner Vorgänge sowie betroffenen Nutzern außerhalb der Verwaltung zur Datenerfassung und Antragsstellung gegenüber sowie dem Empfang von Bescheiden von den zuständigen Behörden zur Verfügung stehen. Während die Anwendungsfälle Trichinenuntersuchung, Management von Monitoring-Proben im Tiergesundheitsbereich sowie die Schnittstelle zur Jagdstatistikanwendung dauerhaft zur Verfügung stehen sollen, soll der Anwendungsfall des Managements im Falle eines Ausbruches der Afrikanischen Schweinepest (ASP) nur anlassbezogen nutz- und verfügbar sein. Darüber hinaus soll auch eine Einführungsunterstützung sowie Schulung der Mitarbeitenden der zuständigen Behörden im Angebot als initiale Leistung enthalten sein. Vertragsschluss erfolgt über einen EVB-IT Cloud-Vertrag. Die Beschaffung erfolgt durch den Auftraggeber zur Nutzung durch alle Landkreise und kreisfreien Städte in Thüringen. Die Verwendung der IT-Anwendung für die vorgenannten Zwecke ist für die Landkreisen und kreisfreien Städten verpflichtend. Den Jägern ist die Verwendung dagegen freigestellt. Das bedeutet, diese können von der Verwendung der IT-Anwendung absehen. Das bisherige analoge System zur Probenahme wird vorerst parallel weitergeführt. Die 21 Veterinär- und Lebensmittelüberwachungsämter der 22 Landkreise und kreisfreien Städte im Freistaat Thüringen sind unter anderem zuständig für die Entgegennahme und Untersuchung von Proben geschlachteter oder erlegter Tiere, die für den Verzehr durch den Menschen vorgesehen sind, auf Trichinella spp. Darüber hinaus bestehen Zuständigkeiten im Hinblick auf die Erlaubniserteilung zur Entnahme von Proben, die zur Untersuchung auf Trichinen vorgesehen sind, durch verwaltungsexterne Personen. Den Bürgerinnen und Bürgern, die die vorgenannten Verwaltungsleistungen in Anspruch nehmen möchten, soll ermöglicht werden, die erforderlichen Antragsdaten nach den Grundsätzen des Online-Zugangsgesetzes (OZG) digital zu erfassen, den Antrag papierlos dem jeweils zuständigen Veterinär- und Lebensmittelüberwachungsamt zu übermitteln und die Bescheide der zuständigen Behörden zu empfangen. Zudem soll die Möglichkeit geschaffen werden, weiteren Berichtspflichten (z. B. die Erfassung der Jagdstrecken durch Jägerinnen und Jäger) in digitaler Form nachzukommen. Die Untersuchung von Wildschweinen auf Trichinella spp. erfolgt nur dann, wenn das Tier zu einem Lebensmittel werden soll. Dies führt nach den bisherigen Erfahrungen pro Jahr zur Untersuchung von bis zu 30.000 Stück Schwarzwild in Thüringen. Diese Zahlen schwanken. Darüber hinaus sind die Behörden der Veterinärüberwachung für die Umsetzung eines regelmäßigen Monitorings von erlegten Wildtieren auf bestimmte Tierseuchenerreger verantwortlich. In Abhängigkeit vom aktuellen tierseuchenrechtlichen Status variiert die Probenzahl voraussichtlich zwischen ca. 5.000 und 30.000 Proben im Jahr. Die Datenerfassung und Antragsstellung sowie der Empfang der Bescheide sollen hier ebenso für die jeweils betroffenen Bürgerinnen und Bürger ermöglicht werden. Die erfassten Daten sollen über die Anwendung an das für die Untersuchung der Proben zuständige Landesamt für Verbraucherschutz übermittelt werden. result.text: This document is not a procurement notice or invitation to tender, but a request for information. The Urban Environment Division of the City of Helsinki (hereinafter referred to as the contracting authority) is preparing the procurement of an application for infrastructure construction supervision and situational awareness. The objective of the procurement is to acquire and implement an infrastructure construction monitoring system that enables the management of infrastructure project contracts in field conditions using modern digital tools. The subject of the procurement is a monitoring system in which project-related data, documents, communication and monitoring take place centrally through a single system. The system will improve the situational awareness of contracts and information flow between different stakeholders, speed up reactions to identified shortcomings and reduce the nuisance caused to city residents by infrastructure projects. This is a new procurement and currently the City of Helsinki does not have a system intended for the management and monitoring of the implementation phase of infrastructure construction contracts. Currently, project-related data is scattered across different systems, operating models vary by contract and contractor, a large proportion of communication takes place by email, and entries related to contract management processes, such as reporting, site diaries and handling of shortcomings, are made manually and on paper. The Urban Environment Division has previously piloted and test-used digital tools intended for the management of infrastructure sites, and based on these, significant benefits have been observed, especially in the preparation of inspection reports and the sharing of information between various parties. The infrastructure construction monitoring system, which is the subject of the procurement, will be acquired as a ready-made software as a service (SaaS), including software licences, support and maintenance services, complementary expert services related to the software service including product consulting, customer-specific minor development and training services, as well as implementation in the contracting authority's operating environment. The implementation includes necessary definitions, configurations, development and integration measures, testing and user training. The objective is that the acquired system will be put into use in all new infrastructure construction contracts and selected ongoing projects based on project-specific assessment. The objective of the procurement is that the acquired monitoring system has been put into use by the end of June 2026. Further information on the subject of the procurement is described in the document Description of the subject of the procurement. The purpose of this request for information is to survey the market regarding the services in question and to obtain information concerning the procurement so that the procurement can be carried out appropriately. The contracting authority does not commit to carrying out this procurement. This is an enquiry/request for information concerning a planned procurement. parts.source: Tämä asiakirja ei ole hankintailmoitus tai tarjouspyyntö vaan tietopyyntö. Helsingin kaupungin Kaupunkiympäristön toimiala (jäljempänä tilaaja) on valmistelemassa Infrarakentamisen valvonnan ja tilannekuvan sovelluksen hankintaa. Hankinnan tavoitteena on hankkia ja ottaa käyttöön infrarakentamisen seurantajärjestelmä, joka mahdollistaa infrahankkeiden urakoiden hallinnan kenttäolosuhteissä nykyaikaisilla, digitaalisilla työkaluilla. Hankinnan kohteena on seurantajärjestelmä, jossa urakkaan liittyvät tiedot, dokumentit, viestintä ja seuranta tapahtuvat keskitetysti yhden järjestelmän kautta. Järjestelmän avulla parannetaan urakoiden tilannekuvaa ja tiedonkulkua eri sidosryhmien välillä, nopeutetaan havaittuihin puutteisiin reagoimista ja vähennetään infrahankkeista kaupunkilaisille aiheutuvia haittoja. Kyseessä on uusi hankinta ja nykytilassa Helsingin kaupungilla ei ole käytössään infrarakennuttamisen urakoiden toteutusvaiheen hallintaan ja seurantaan tarkoitettua järjestelmää. Tällä hetkellä urakoihin liittyvät tiedot sijaitsevat hajallaan eri järjestelmissä, toimintamallit vaihtelevat urakoittain ja urakoitsijoittain, suuri osa viestinnästä tapahtuu sähköpostitse ja urakoiden hallintaprosesseihin, kuten raportointiin, työmaapäiväkirjoihin ja puutteiden käsittelyyn liittyvät kirjaukset tehdään manuaalisesti ja paperipohjaisesti. Kaupunkiympäristön toimiala on aiemmin pilotoinut ja koekäyttänyt infratyömaiden hallintaan tarkoitettuja digitaalisia työkaluja, ja näiden perusteella on havaittu merkittäviä hyötyjä erityisesti katselmusraporttien laadinnassa ja tiedon jakamisessa eri osapuolten kesken. Hankinnan kohteena oleva infrarakentamisen seurantajärjestelmä hankitaan valmiina ohjelmistopalveluna (SaaS) sisältäen ohjelmistojen käyttöoikeudet, tuki- ja ylläpitopalvelun, täydentävät ohjelmistopalveluun liittyvät asiantuntijapalvelut sisältäen tuotekonsultoinnin, asiakaskohtaisen pienkehittämisen sekä koulutuspalvelut sekä käyttöönotto Tilaajan toimintaympäristössä. Käyttöönotto sisältää tarvittavat määrittelyt, konfiguroinnit, kehittämis- ja integraatiotoimenpiteet, testauksen sekä käyttäjäkoulutukset. Tavoitteena on, että hankittava järjestelmä otetaan käyttöön kaikissa uusissa infrarakennuttamisen urakoissa sekä valituissa käynnissä olevissa hankkeissa hankekohtaisen harkinnan perusteella. Hankinnan tavoitteena on, että hankittava seurantajärjestelmä on otettu käyttöön kesäkuun 2026 loppuun mennessä. Lisätietoa hankinnan kohteesta kuvattu dokumentissa Hankinnan kohteen kuvaus. result.text: The Department for Work and Pensions introduced the Crisis and Resilience Fund from 1 April 2026. The Fund provides local authorities with funding to support households experiencing financial hardship or an unexpected financial shock and to help residents build longer-term financial resilience. Southwark Council is developing a hub-and-spoke model to support the delivery of the Resilience Services and Community Coordination elements of the Fund. The Council is considering commissioning a Hub Delivery Organisation (HDO) to provide a central and accessible route into financial-resilience support for Southwark residents. The Council will retain responsibility for administering Council-managed crisis and housing-related payments, determining eligibility, making formal decisions on applications for financial assistance and submitting formal management-information returns to the Department for Work and Pensions. Further information about the emerging HDO service model, the areas being considered, local delivery and accessibility, case management, reporting, and the indicative contract value and duration is set out in the accompanying Draft Service Specification. The final scope and delivery model have not been determined. Therefore, the Council is carry out a Preliminary Market Engagement (PME) where respondents are invited to use the information provided via the portal, see engagement process description further down in this notice. Respondents are requested to use both documents when completing the questionnaire and should clearly state any assumptions made in their responses. Lot 1: . None

result.text: Carmarthenshire County Council is undertaking an Early Market Engagement exercise to better understand the care rostering, scheduling and workforce management solutions currently available within the market. The Council currently utilises a rostering and scheduling solution across its Residential and Domiciliary Care Services and wishes to engage with suppliers to understand available products, functionality, market developments and delivery models that may support future service requirements. This exercise is intended to inform future planning and does not represent a commitment to undertake a procurement process. The Council is particularly interested in solutions that support: • Domiciliary Care scheduling and visit management. • Residential Care rostering and workforce management. • Workforce resource teams and shared staffing models. • Mobile working for frontline care staff. • Leave, absence and availability management. • Skills, compliance and workforce competency management. • Payroll, travel and workforce payment processes. • Reporting, operational oversight and management information. • Continuity of care and workforce utilisation. • Integration with care management, HR, payroll, finance and identity management systems. The Council intends to provide a high-level requirements document to interested suppliers and may invite suppliers to demonstrate how their solution supports the functional areas identified. Participation in this engagement is for information and planning purposes only and does not commit the Council to any procurement or award. All interested parties are encouraged to register their interest by 22/09/26 to participate in the demonstration sessions which we are planning to hold in October. Details of any formal tender will be provided in due course. Lot 1: . None
