result.text: The purpose of the contract is the provision of technical assistance and management services for the Technical Support Office for European Projects (OATPE) of the Provincial Council of Valencia. These services include specialised technical assistance and consultancy for the municipalities of the province, the Provincial Council of Valencia itself, as well as any public law entity in which a municipality participates where its role is relevant (hereinafter "key agents"). The projected contract is a service contract for the management and execution of a technical office dependent on the Provincial Council of Valencia, which will cover its need to assist and advise on the search, acquisition, and management of EU funds for local entities, promote the transfer of knowledge linked to European projects among technicians and elected officials of the province of Valencia, enable the submission of European projects in which the Provincial Council of Valencia is a partner or associate partner to the European Union, and bring Europe and funding programmes closer to and disseminate them to the local administration. The specialised technical assistance and consultancy service that is the subject of this contract will be carried out by the contractor from its own offices/facilities (by telephone, electronically, by email, and/or through the website of the Provincial Council of Valencia), and any member of the assigned technical team must also travel to the municipalities and territories that so require, as well as to the premises of the Provincial Council of Valencia.

parts.source: El contrato tiene por objeto la prestación del servicio de asistencia técnica y gestión de la Oficina de Ayuda Técnica para Proyectos Europeos (OATPE) de la Diputación de Valencia. Dichos servicios de asistencia técnica especializada y consultoría para los municipios de la provincia, la propia Diputación de Valencia, así como cualquier entidad de derecho público en la que participe un municipio donde su papel sea relevante (en adelante “agentes clave”). El contrato proyectado es un contrato de servicios para la gestión y ejecución de una oficina técnica dependiente de la Diputación de Valencia que cubrirá la necesidad que tiene la misma para asistir y asesorar en la búsqueda, captación y gestión de fondos comunitarios para entidades locales, promover la transferencia de conocimientos vinculados a los proyectos europeos entre los técnicos y cargos electos de la provincia de Valencia, posibilitar la presentación de proyectos europeos en el que la Diputación de Valencia sea socio, o socio asociado, a la Unión Europea, y acercar y difundir Europa y los programas de financiación a la administración local. El servicio de asistencia técnica especializada y consultoría objeto del presente contrato será realizado por el adjudicatario desde sus propias oficinas/ instalaciones (telefónico, telemático, por correo electrónico y/o a través de la web de la Diputación de Valencia) debiendo también desplazarse cualquier miembro del equipo técnico adscrito, tanto a los municipios y territorios que así lo requieran, como a las dependencias de la Diputación Provincial de Valencia.

result.text: The UK Government's Partnering for Accelerated Climate Transitions (UK PACT) programme is inviting proposals from qualified suppliers or consortia to deliver technical assistance to the government of Bangladesh. Bangladesh is establishing the foundations for participation in high-integrity carbon markets, including Article 6, CORSIA and voluntary carbon markets. While progress has been made through the establishment of a carbon market framework and supporting governance arrangements, further support is needed to operationalise these systems across government, strengthen institutional coordination, and enable Bangladesh to use carbon markets to support delivery of its NDC 3.0 unconditional mitigation targets. The assignment will provide targeted technical assistance and capacity building to strengthen Bangladesh's carbon market governance, authorisation processes, MRV, reporting and institutional readiness. Working with relevant government agencies, including MoEFCC, DoE, the Power Division, Ministry of Finance and other line ministries, the project will support practical implementation of carbon market rules, CORSIA readiness, UNFCCC reporting requirements, and inclusive, high-integrity market participation. Key outputs are expected to include governance and coordination tools, an authorisation and safeguards toolkit, CORSIA readiness and reporting support, a structured government capacity-building programme, and sector readiness briefs identifying future carbon market investment opportunities. The project aims to strengthen Bangladesh's ability to participate in high-integrity carbon markets, unlock climate finance, improve institutional capability, and support implementation of national climate targets. Interested suppliers are invited to review the documentation provided in this notice, and submit their applications to: targetedfund@ukpact.co.uk

result.text: The subject of the BR quotation study is the collection of data on the use and evaluation of BR services on radio, television and various digital platforms (BR's own platforms web/app, ARD Mediathek, ARD Sounds and other podcast platforms, YouTube, Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, Twitch, Snapchat) among the Bavarian and German population. In order to be able to make statements both for BR services for a Bavarian audience and for BR services with a supra-regional focus (services in Das Erste, ARD Mediathek and ARD Sounds; various digital services), three survey waves per year are to be conducted, comprising one Bavaria-wide and one nationwide survey in each case. The contract begins on 01.01.2027 and has a term of 12 months until 31.12.2027 (= basic term). This contract shall automatically extend after the expiry of the basic term by up to three times for 12 months each time, unless either party terminates this contract in writing 4 months prior to expiry. The aim is to collect quantitative (awareness, reach, target group exhaustion) and qualitative key performance indicators (overall rating, missing, public value) for Bayerischer Rundfunk's services, in particular also for those that cannot be evaluated, or can only be evaluated in part, via the currency studies in the audio and video market.

parts.source: Gegenstand der BR-Angebotsstudie ist die Erhebung von Daten zu Nutzung und Bewertung von BR-Angeboten im Radio, Fernsehen und auf unterschiedlichen digitalen Plattformen (BR eigene Plattformen Web/App, ARD-Mediathek, ARD-Sounds und andere Podcast-Plattformen, YouTube, Instagram, Facebook, Tiktok, Twitch, Snapchat) in der bayerischen und deutschen Bevölkerung. Um sowohl für BR-Angebote für ein bayerisches Publikum als auch für BR-Angebote mit überregionalem Fokus (Angebote in Das Erste, ARD-Mediathek und ARD-Sounds; verschiedene Digitalangebote) Aussagen treffen zu können, soll in drei Erhebungswellen pro Jahr jeweils eine bayernweite und eine deutschlandweite Erhebung durchgeführt werden. Der Vertrag beginnt am 01.01.2027 und hat eine Laufzeit von 12 Monaten bis zum 31.12.2027.(=Grundlaufzeit). Dieser Vertrag verlängert sich nach Ablauf der Grundlaufzeit automatisch bis zu drei Mal um jeweils 12 Monate, wenn keine der beiden Parteien diesen Vertrag 4 Monate vor Ablauf schriftlich kündigt. Ziel ist die Erhebung quantitativer (Bekanntheit, Reichweiten, Zielgruppenausschöpfung) und qualitativer Kennzahlen (Globalurteil, Vermissen, Public Value) für die Angebote des Bayerischen Rundfunks, insbesondere auch für jene, die über die Währungsstudien im Audio- und Video-Markt nicht oder nur in Teilen auswertbar sind.

result.text: PSD Scotland intends to procure a Service Integration and Management contract for the transition, stabilisation and continued delivery of selected national digital services supporting health and care across Scotland. The successful supplier will act as prime contractor and provide a single point of accountability for end-to-end service delivery, integration and performance. The supplier will also be responsible for the management of any subcontractors and dependencies with other providers and Authority teams. The initial priority will be to maintain continuity and stabilise these business-critical services as they transition away from the existing National IT Contract, while establishing a strong foundation for subsequent improvement and modernisation. Lot 1: . PSD Scotland intends to procure a Service Integration and Management contract for selected national digital services supporting clinical, operational and administrative functions across NHS Scotland. The procurement will establish replacement arrangements for services currently delivered under the National IT Contract, which is due to expire on 31 March 2028. The principal objective is to maintain uninterrupted delivery of these business-critical services throughout transition and thereafter. The anticipated scope includes services and applications supporting Primary and Community Care, National Screening and Child Health, together with other services confirmed in the procurement documents. Depending on the requirements of each service, the contract may include application support, maintenance and development, as well as the associated infrastructure, platform, integrations and data services. IT Service Management capabilities are also required for end-to-end operation. The detailed application scope, service boundaries and allocation of responsibilities will be defined in the tender documentation. The successful supplier will act as the prime contractor, providing a single point of accountability for the contract. The supplier will be expected to coordinate its subcontractors and work effectively with the Authority’s retained teams and other internal and external providers. Service continuity will take precedence during the initial transition, followed by stabilisation to address supportability, resilience, cyber security, regulatory compliance and technical-debt risks. Once services have been stabilised, the supplier will support proportionate and staged modernisation through software and infrastructure engineering practices. Intended outcomes include: -Secure, compliant and resilient services -Clear and measurable service performance -Visibility of costs and dependencies -Improved value for money The supplier will also be expected to support knowledge transfer, effective service ownership, data portability and robust exit arrangements, reducing long-term supplier dependency and preserving future competition. The Authority will retain accountability for strategic direction, governance, business outcomes and service ownership throughout the contract.

result.text: I. Solution regarding User and Access Management for the Capital Region of Denmark. The contracting authority is tendering a contract for a solution for User and Access Management for the future Capital Region of Denmark. At the time of tender, the contracting authority has different solutions in the Capital Region of Denmark and Region Zealand respectively. In connection with the establishment of the Capital Region of Denmark, the contracting authority requires a new standardised Identity Governance & Administration solution (hereinafter referred to as the solution). The solution is to be used across the contracting authority's organisation, platforms and systems. The solution must ensure that the contracting authority achieves standardised, automated and secure administration of and control over access to systems and data, as well as system support for management oversight, control of employee access, and other user- and access-management-related tasks. The solution must furthermore ensure mobility and flexibility for employees and effectively support organisational changes. The delivery and solution must support the contracting authority in achieving the following benefits: creating unique identities for all employees regardless of form of employment, replacing current solutions with 1 solution, ensuring 60% of all system access takes place via automated processes based on data standardization, and enabling the same ordering process to be used for all manually assigned system access. The solution must be delivered as a cloud-based service hosted by the supplier in a data centre. II. Main services: 1) The delivery. The delivery of the IGA solution is expected to consist of 3 partial deliveries, A-C. In partial delivery A, the supplier must establish the foundation of the solution, establish basic functionality, connect the solution to source data (including HR data systems), assist with data migration, and onboard technical applications (such as AD, ServiceNow, CyberArk, Beyond-Trust, Imprivata and EntraID). In addition, the supplier must assist the contracting authority with planning, designing business roles, developing integration concepts, and establishing the necessary processes for efficient onboarding of user systems (such as the health platform, diagnostic systems, administrative systems, etc.). The supplier must also assist the contracting authority with test activities, as well as training of the contracting authority's employees, partly in the use of the solution and partly in order to enable the contracting authority's employees to a large extent to carry out the onboarding of user systems themselves, including the establishment of the contracting authority's internal operational processes. Partial delivery B) The supplier must assist with the onboarding of the contracting authority's business-critical systems (including the health platform and central diagnostic systems), test activities, continued training of the contracting authority's employees, and the establishment of extended functionality (such as management oversight & delegation). Partial delivery C) The supplier must assist with the onboarding of a group of selected user systems with a focus on ensuring that all integration concepts have been tested. In addition, the supplier must continue to assist with test activities and final training of the contracting authority's employees so that they can stand on their own two feet. 2B) Ongoing services: The supplier must deliver the necessary software and be responsible for hosting, operation, support and maintenance of both standard software and any customer-specific software. The supplier must ensure efficient, secure and stable operation of the solution while complying with service targets for factors such as availability and response time. The supplier must make a professional IT Service Management function available to ensure that the supplier, in cooperation with the customer, can effectively handle incidents and other operational and business-continuity-oriented situations. 3) Ordering services: The supplier must continuously deliver consultancy services as needed, including ongoing support for the onboarding of user systems after the delivery has been completed, as well as any adaptations of the solution, such as connectors. In addition, the supplier must continuously provide training of the contracting authority's employees as needed.

parts.source: I. Løsning vedr. Bruger- og Adgangsstyring til Region Østdanmark. Ordregiver udbyder en kontrakt vedr. en løsning til Bruger- og Adgangsstyring til den fremtidige Region Østdanmark. På udbudstidspunktet har Ordregiver forskellige løsninger i hhv. Region Hovedstaden og Region Sjælland. I forbindelse med etableringen af Region Østdanmark har Ordregiver behov for en ny standardiseret Identity Governance & Administration-løsning (herefter benævnt løsningen). Løsningen skal anvendes på tværs af Ordregivers organisation, platforme og systemer. Løsningen skal sikre at Ordregiver opnår en standardiseret, automatiseret og sikker administration af og kontrol med adgange til systemer og data, samt systemunderstøttelse af ledelsestilsyn, kontrol med medarbejdernes adgange samt øvrige bruger- og adgangsstyringsrelaterede opgaver . Løsningen skal endvidere sikre mobilitet og fleksibilitet for med-arbejdere og effektivt understøtte organisationsændringer. Leverancen og løsningen skal understøtte Ordregiver i at opnå følgende gevinster: at få skabt unikke identiteter for alle med-arbejdere uanset ansættelsesform, at de nuværende løsninger erstattes med 1 løsning, at 60% af alle systemadgange sker via automatiserede processer på baggrund af datastandardisering, samt at der kan anvendes samme bestillingsproces for alle manuelt tildelte systemadgange. Løsningen skal leveres som en cloud-baseret tjeneste hostet af Leverandøren i et datacenter. II. Hovedydelser: 1) Leverancen. Levering af IGA-løsningen består forventeligt af 3 delleverancer, A-C. I delleverance A skal Leverandøren etablere løsningens fundament, etablere grundlæggende funktionalitet, forbinde løsningen til fødekildedata (herunder HR data-systemer), bistå med datamigrering samt onboarde tekniske applikationer (såsom AD, ServiceNow, CyberArk, Beyond-Trust, Imprivata og EntraID). Derudover skal Leverandøren bistå Ordregiver med planlægning, med at designe forretningsroller, udvikle integrationskoncepter, samt etablere de nødvendige processer for effektiv onboarding af anvendersystemer (såsom sundhedsplatfor-men, diagnostiske systemer, administrative systemer etc.). Leverandøren skal desuden bistå Ordregiver med testaktiviteter, samt uddannelse af Ordregivers medarbejdere, dels i anvendelsen af løsningen og dels i forhold til at gøre Ordregivers medarbejdere i stand til i vidt omfang selv at foretage onboarding af anvendersystemer, herunder opbygning af Ordregivers interne driftsprocesser. Delleverance B) Leverandøren skal bistå med onboarding af Ordregivers forretningskritiske systemer (herunder Sundhedsplatformen og centrale diagnostiske systemer), testaktiviteter, fortsat oplæring af Ordregivers medarbejdere samt etablering af udvidet funktionalitet (såsom ledelsestilsyn & delegering). Delleverance C) Leverandøren skal bistå med onboarding af en gruppe udvalgte anvender-systemer med fokus på at sikre at samtlige integrationskoncepter er afprøvet. Derudover skal Leverandøren fortsat bistå med testaktiviteter samt afsluttende oplæring af Ordregivers medarbejdere til at stå på egne ben. 2B) Løbende ydelser: Leverandøren skal levere den nødvendige software samt stå for hosting, drift, support og vedligeholdelse af såvel standardprogrammel samt evt. kundespecifikt programmel. Leverandøren skal sikre effektiv, sikker og stabil drift af løsningen under overholdelse af servicemål til bl.a. tilgængelighed og reaktionstid. Leverandøren skal stille en professionel lT Service Management funktion til rådighed, som sikrer at leverandøren i samarbejde med kunden effektivt kan håndtere incidents og øvrige drifts- og business con-tinuity orienterede situationer. 3) Bestillingsydelser: Leverandøren skal løbende levere konsulentydelser efter behov, bl.a. til fortsat støtte til onboarding af anvendersystemer efter Leverancen er gennemført, samt til evt. tilpasninger af løsningen, som f.eks. connectorer. Derudover skal Leverandøren løbende levere undervisning af Ordregivers medarbejdere efter behov.

result.text: 1. Contracting Authority The EWE Group, headquartered in Oldenburg, is one of the large regional energy supply companies in Germany. EWE is active in various business areas, including energy (gas/electricity), telecommunications, information technology, mobility and hydrogen. With over 10.000 employees and a turnover of around 8,7 billion euros in the 2024 financial year, EWE is one of the significant players in the German energy industry. EWE pursues a clear strategy towards a sustainable, innovative and future-oriented energy supply - including through projects in the field of wind energy and the hydrogen economy. The EWE Group is predominantly in municipal hands and supplies around one million households in the electricity segment alone. 2. Subject of the tender The EWE Group as the contracting authority (CA) intends to procure a software solution for Business Process Management (BPM) that meets the company's specific professional and technical requirements. The subject of the tender is the acquisition, implementation and operation of BPM software, including initial user training and the migration of existing data and process models from the legacy system to the new system. The software should enable intuitive modelling of processes - with a focus on Business Process Model and Notation (BPMN). For this purpose, user-friendly drag-and-drop editors are required for the simple creation, adaptation and maintenance of process models. In addition, the following functionalities are required: - Independently configurable workflows, e.g. for the approval of process models - Extensive commenting and collaboration options for all user groups - Versioning of process models and the possibility to manage several variants of a process - Comprehensive reporting and analysis functions Also desired are: - A flexibly configurable authorisation and role concept - Interfaces to other IT systems to support import and export processes, in particular: * Import of data from IT systems (e.g. organisational units) * Export of data to third-party systems, such as analysis platforms like SAP Datasphere, Snowflake or Azure OneLake

parts.source: 1. Auftraggeber Der EWE-Konzern mit Hauptsitz in Oldenburg zählt zu den großen regionalen Energieversorgungsunternehmen in Deutschland. EWE ist in verschiedenen Geschäftsfeldern tätig, darunter Energie (Gas/Strom), Telekommunikation, Informationstechnologie, Mobilität und Wasserstoff. Mit über 10.000 Mitarbeitenden und einem Umsatz von rund 8,7 Milliarden Euro im Geschäftsjahr 2024 gehört EWE zu den bedeutenden Akteuren der deutschen Energiewirtschaft. EWE verfolgt eine klare Strategie hin zu einer nachhaltigen, innovativen und zukunftsorientierten Energieversorgung - unter anderem durch Projekte im Bereich Windenergie und Wasserstoffwirtschaft. Der EWE-Konzern befindet sich überwiegend in kommunaler Hand und versorgt allein im Stromsegment rund eine Million Haushalte. 2. Gegenstand der Ausschreibung Der EWE-Konzern als Auftraggeber (AG) beabsichtigt, für das Business Process Management (BPM) eine Softwarelösung zu beschaffen, die den spezifischen fachlichen und technischen Anforderungen des Unternehmens entspricht. Gegenstand der Ausschreibung sind der Erwerb, die Einführung und der Betrieb einer BPM-Software einschließlich der initialen Schulung der Anwenderinnen und Anwender sowie der Migration bestehender Daten- und Prozessmodelle vom Altsystem in das neue System. Die Software soll eine intuitive Modellierung von Prozessen ermöglichen - mit Schwerpunkt auf der Business Process Model and Notation (BPMN). Hierfür sind benutzerfreundliche Drag-and-drop-Editoren zur einfachen Erstellung, Anpassung und Pflege von Prozessmodellen erforderlich. Darüber hinaus werden folgende Funktionalitäten gefordert: - Eigenständig konfigurierbare Workflows, z. B. zur Freigabe von Prozessmodellen - Umfangreiche Kommentierungs- und Kollaborationsmöglichkeiten für alle Benutzergruppen - Versionierung von Prozessmodellen und die Möglichkeit, mehrere Varianten eines Prozesses zu verwalten - Umfassende Reporting- und Analysefunktionen Erwünscht sind zudem: - Ein flexibel konfigurierbares Berechtigungs- und Rollenkonzept - Schnittstellen zu anderen IT-Systemen zur Unterstützung von Import- und Exportprozessen, insbesondere: * Import von Daten aus IT-Systemen (z. B. Organisationseinheiten) * Export von Daten in Drittsysteme, etwa in Analyseplattformen wie SAP Datasphere, Snowflake oder Azure OneLake

The purpose of the contract is the procurement of the complete service which contemplates the creation, installation, development, implementation, configuration, maintenance, technical support and training of an comprehensive service that allows the Community of Madrid to have a complete technological solution for carrying out self-examinations comprising the tests for the exercise of the profession of driver of hire vehicles with driver (VTC) in the Community of Madrid. Project scope: The scope of the project consists of the provision of an comprehensive service, managed by a single contact person, which covers all the phases necessary to comply with the technical and functional requirements and compliance with the service levels described in this document. This service must contemplate the implementation and commissioning of the examination booths comprising the following work: 1. Analysis, construction, implementation, commissioning and supervision of the service. It will carry out the definition of processes and functional specifications, current situation analysis, functional design, documentation of requirements and modules, detailed technical design, system development, implementation, stabilization, knowledge management and supervision of the examination service. 2. Preventive Maintenance: Continuous improvement of the system through testing, updates and improvement proposals. Corrective: Resolution of functional and technical incidents, performance optimization and continuous support. Evolutionary: Incorporation of functional and technical improvements requested by managers. 3. Training Training plan and transfer of technical and functional knowledge for personnel of the Directorate General for Transport and Mobility and Madrid Digital. Includes personalized courses, pre-commissioning training, subsequent updates and annual refreshers. 4. Support and Incident Management Support service after entry into production, without changes in functionality. Resolution times and incident types (blocking, intermediate, low) are defined. Detailed resolution reports are generated.

Certification is not currently planned, but could become relevant from a perspective standpoint (e.g. due to customer requirements). The external Information Security Officer shall be assigned the following tasks in particular: - Development and implementation of security strategies: Creation of security concepts, policies and guidelines tailored to the specific needs of the LMS. This includes the further development of the Information Security Management System (ISMS). - Risk management: Implementation and continuous updating of risk analyses and business impact analyses (BIA) to identify and assess potential threats. - Reporting: Establishment of reporting processes as well as regular evaluation and presentation of security-related information to the specialist departments and management. - Continuous monitoring: Monitoring the effectiveness of the implemented security measures and, as required, adjustment of the implemented measures. - Compliance with statutory requirements: Ensuring that the LMS complies with all relevant laws, regulations and industry standards in the field of information security. - Security incidents: Investigation, processing and risk assessment of security incidents incl. taking measures for damage limitation - Collaboration: Close cooperation with the internal "Information Security Manager" as well as the other specialist departments (especially IT) as well as the Security Operations Center (SOC), the Data Protection Officer and management - Internal and external audits: Support in preparation for internal and external audits on information security - Technical security measures: Involvement in the conception, evaluation and decision on the introduction or modernisation of technologies (e.g. new EDR solution, network segmentation), which is why corresponding IT and IT security architecture know-how should be available with the contractor. The contractor does not have to be responsible for the decisions, but must be able to advise accordingly in the sense of an advisory function in accordance with their role. The subject matter of the procedure is now the Europe-wide procurement of services of an external Information Security Officer (ISO) by means of a negotiated procedure with a preceding call for competition. Further information on the content of the tender will be made available to the bidders who are invited to submit tenders. The services are to be awarded for a period of 24 months (2 years), provisionally commencing on 1 April 2026.

parts.source: Die Landesmesse Stuttgart GmbH & Co. KG (LMS) schreibt Leistungen eines externen Informationssicherheitsbeauftragten (ISB) aus. Die LMS beabsichtigt, Leistungen eines externen Informationssicherheitsbeauftragten (ISB) zu beauftragen, um das Sicherheitsniveau ganzheitlich und nachhaltig zu verbessern. Angedacht ist die Umsetzung eines international anerkannten Standards für Informationssicherheits-Managementsysteme. Das Sicherheitsniveau der LMS soll sich hierbei an der ISO 27001 anlehnen. Eine Zertifizierung ist aktuell nicht geplant, könnte aber perspektivisch relevant werden (z.B. aufgrund Kundenanforderungen). Folgende Aufgaben werden dem externen Informationssicherheitsbeauftragten insbesondere übertragen: - Entwicklung und Umsetzung von Sicherheitsstrategien: Erstellung von Sicherheitskonzepten, Policys Leitlinien, die auf die spezifischen Bedürfnisse der LMS zugeschnitten sind. Hierzu gehört die Weiterentwicklung des Informations-Sicherheits-Management-Systems (ISMS). - Risikomanagement: Durchführung und kontinuierliche Aktualisierung von Risikoanalysen und Business Impact Analysen (BIA) zur Identifikation und Bewertung potenzieller Gefährdungen. - Berichtswesen: Aufbau von Reporting-Prozessen sowie regelmäßige Auswertung und Präsentation sicherheitsrelevanter Informationen gegenüber den Fachbereichen und der Geschäftsführung. - Kontinuierliche Überwachung: Überwachung der Wirksamkeit der implementierten Sicherheitsmaßnahmen sowie bedarfsweise Anpassung der umgesetzten Maßnahmen. - Einhaltung gesetzlicher Anforderungen: Sicherstellung, dass die LMS alle relevanten Gesetze, Vorschriften und Industriestandards im Bereich Informationssicherheit einhält. - Sicherheitsvorfälle: Untersuchung, Bearbeitung und Risikobewertung von Sicherheitsvorfällen inkl. Ergreifen von Maßnahmen zur Schadensbegrenzung - Zusammenarbeit: Enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem internen "Manager Informationssicherheit" sowie den anderen Fachbereichen (insbesondere IT) sowie dem Security Operations Center (SOC), dem Datenschutzbeauftragten und der Geschäftsführung - Interne und externe Audits: Unterstützung bei der Vorbereitung auf interne und externe Audits zur Informationssicherheit - Technische Sicherheitsmaßnahmen: Einbindung in Konzeption, Bewertung und Entscheidung zur Einführung oder Modernisierung von Technologien (z.B. neue EDR-Lösung, Netzwerk-Segmentierung), weshalb entsprechendes IT- und IT-Sicherheits-Architektur Know-how beim Auftragnehmer vorhanden sein sollte. Der Auftragnehmer muss die Entscheidungen nicht verantworten, aber entsprechend im Sinne einer Advisory Funktion gemäß seiner Rolle beraten können. Gegenstand des Verfahrens ist nun die europaweite Vergabe von Leistungen eines externen Informationssicherheitsbeauftragten (ISB) im Wege eines Verhandlungsverfahrens mit vorgeschaltetem Teilnahmewettbewerb. Nähere Informationen zum Inhalt der Ausschreibung werden den Bietern zur Verfügung gestellt, die zur Angebotsabgabe aufgefordert werden. Die Leistungen sollen für einen Zeitraum von 24 Monaten (2 Jahre) vergeben werden, voraussichtlich beginnend am 1. April 2026.

result.text: The Scottish Government is pursuing a comprehensive programme to reform and modernise Scotland’s compulsory purchase system. Lot 1: . The overall aim of this research is to provide information about the compensation received by those whose land is acquired under compulsory purchase powers. The evidence generated through the research is intended to inform decisions on potential future legislation by the Scottish Government and scrutiny of any such legislation by the Scottish Parliament. The objectives of the project are to address the following questions: a. How frequently and to what extent are compensation payments affected by the prospect of future planning permission (“hope value”)? b. In cases where hope value is a factor, to what extent are payments affected by the timing, costs and risks of implementing any such prospective planning permission? c. To what extent does the current condition of property affect the market value calculated for the purpose of compensation?

result.text: Framework agreements for the provision and operation of an awareness platform along with supplementary services The State of Saarland and the Electronic Administration Zweckverband in Saarland (eGo-Saar) intend to award framework agreements for the provision and operation of an awareness platform along with supplementary services. The awareness platform serves to further raise employees' awareness of information security and the dangers of external cyber attacks. The platform is to consist of e-learning and phishing simulation modules and be provided as a SaaS solution. By means of corresponding reporting/analytics, data-driven, target group-appropriate measures are to be implemented and their success measured. The procurement procedure is being carried out by the Saarland IT Service Centre (IT-DLZ) for both contracting authorities.

Die Awareness-Plattform dient dazu, Mitarbeiter für das Thema Informationssicherheit und die Gefahren externer Cyber-Angriffe verstärkt zu sensibilisieren. Die Plattform soll aus den Modulen E-Learnings und Phishingsimulation bestehen und als SaaS-Lösung bereitgestellt werden. Mittels dazugehörenden Reportings/Analytics, sollen datengesteuert zielgruppengerechte Maßnahmen durchgeführt und deren Erfolg gemessen werden. Das Vergabeverfahren wird durch das IT-Dienstleistungszentrum des Saarlandes (IT-DLZ) für beide Auftraggeber durchgeführt.

result.text: The subject of the procurement is a quality and monitoring information system for the use of Helsingin kaupungin sosiaali-, terveys- ja pelastustoimiala, which is provided as a comprehensive service by the supplier selected for the procurement. The objective of the procurement is to create a unified, user-oriented information system that supports the quality and monitoring of service production, serving employees, supervisors and management, as well as the support and maintenance services that serve the operations. The background to the need and objective is the need to develop a unified system that gathers scattered monitoring data together and supports its systematic utilisation in management and decision-making. Changed legislation, especially the Act on the Supervision of Social and Health Services (741/2023), requires the improvement of the quality, consistency and reporting of monitoring data. The system entity that is the subject of the procurement includes the following architectural, functional and supportable modules: -Quality and monitoring entity (Monitoring tool) -Reporting sections, including irregularities, adverse events and hazards, and the entity of serious adverse events -Entity related to the activities of social and patient ombudsmen -Management of medication administration permits. The subject and requirements of the procurement are described in more detail in the annexes to the call for tenders.

result.text: The U.S. Embassy Athens Public Diplomacy Section (PDS Athens) of the U.S. Department of State is pleased to announce funding is available through its Public Diplomacy Grants Program in fiscal year 2025. This is an Annual Program Statement, outlining our funding priorities, the strategic themes we focus on, and the procedures for submitting requests for funding. Please carefully follow all instructions below. The deadline for grant applications is July 11, 2025. Funding decisions will be made on these applications on a rolling basis after this deadline, with a goal of informing all applicants of the final funding decision by September 30, 2025. Applicants may apply for funding between $25,000 and $100,000 . Please use the grant application documents and budget template found on the Embassy website https://gr.usembassy.gov/education/ . Purpose of Grants program: PDS Athens invites proposals for projects that strengthen ties between the United States and Greece through concrete demonstrations of cooperation between our two peoples, aiming at making America safer, stronger and more prosperous . All grant proposals must convey an element of American history, culture, or shared values. Competitive proposals should support a priority program area (see below). They should also include a connection with American expert/s, organization/s, or institution/s that will promote increased cooperation between the people of the United States and Greece even after the program has finished. Priority Program Areas: The Public Diplomacy Section is focused on the following priorities in the form of programs, exchanges, and media opportunities that: Promote American Excellence in Emerging Technologies Celebrate 250 Years of American Excellence: Spotlight on America’s Achievements, Innovation, and Leadership Promoting American Excellence in Emerging Technologies Greek students and professionals in emerging technologies have demonstrated a strong technical foundation that can be strategically leveraged to benefit U.S. technology firms and bolster American leadership in critical industries. By channeling this talent to serve the needs of American companies, we can reinforce U.S. technological dominance, strengthen innovation pipelines, and ensure that international engagement directly supports American economic and strategic priorities. We invite proposals aimed at enhancing U.S.-Greece technological cooperation in ways that clearly advance U.S. national interests. Proposals must focus on initiatives (not conferences) that help U.S. firms address critical workforce and skill shortages, expand the reach of American products and innovation standards, and create structured pathways for Greek talent to contribute to U.S.-driven innovation. Prioritized activities include, but are not limited to: Public-private partnerships that connect U.S. technology firms with high-potential Greek talent through American-led career readiness programs, skills development, and reskilling/upskilling initiatives tailored to U.S. industry standards and needs. Training modules designed for integration into Greek higher education or vocational curricula that: Align directly with the needs of U.S. employers; and Target high-demand fields such as artificial intelligence (AI), biotechnology, cybersecurity, data analytics, and cloud computing—strengthening the global competitiveness of U.S. firms. Innovation bootcamps that feature U.S. technologies, platforms, and products, familiarizing international talent with high-quality American tools and practices. Collaborative projects between U.S. technology companies and Greek educational institutions to promote the adoption and use of American-developed AI and other emerging technologies, reinforcing the global footprint of U.S. innovation. All proposals should demonstrate a clear benefit to the United States and prioritize American commercial and strategic interests, consistent with the principles of the America First policy. Celebrating 250 Years of American Excellence: Spotlight on America’s Achievements, Innovation, and Leadership On July 4, 2026, the United States will commemorate the 250th anniversary of the signing of the Declaration of Independence. This historic milestone presents a powerful opportunity to celebrate American excellence, leverage people-to-people ties, and highlight our achievements, legacies, and contributions as part of America’s story of excellence. We invite proposals that underscore American excellence and contribute to the celebration of America250 , highlighting this momentous occasion through impactful and engaging programs. We welcome submissions that promote U.S.-Greece bilateral engagement and spotlight American achievements, innovation, leadership, and the role of faith and religion in democratic societies. Proposals should feature initiatives (not conferences), and include activities such as (but not limited to): Podcasts and/or public lectures on U.S. history, its ties to Greece, democracy, and its global impact Roadshows showcasing 250 years of American innovation and U.S.-Greek cooperation Sports activities or themed games/events Secondary educational modules that will reach Greek classrooms and help to enhance Greek students’ and educators’ positive understanding of America All proposals should demonstrate a clear benefit to the United States and prioritize American strategic interests, consistent with the principles of the America First policy.

result.text: Istekki Oy invites applications for participation in a dynamic purchasing system (DPS), the subject of which is a secure communication service. The subject of the DPS is described in more detail in the invitation to participate and its appendices, particularly in the appendix Subject of the dynamic purchasing system. The dynamic purchasing system is divided into 12 different categories (sub-areas): 1: Secure mail: technology, licences, platform services and ready-made solutions 2: Spam filtering: technology, licences, platform services and ready-made solutions 3: DMARC reporting: technology, licences, platform services and ready-made solutions 4: Email protection: technology, licences, platform services and ready-made solutions 5. Secure forms: technology, licences, platform services and ready-made solutions 6. Secure workspace: technology, licences, platform services and ready-made solutions 7. Secure instant messaging: technology, licences, platform services and ready-made solutions 8. Secure file transfer: technology, licences, platform services and ready-made solutions 9. Critical communication: technology, licences, platform services and ready-made solutions 10. Unspecified procurement category - to be specified later 11. Unspecified procurement category - to be specified later 12. Unspecified procurement category - to be specified later A candidate may apply for categories 1-9. It is not possible to apply for unspecified categories 10-12 at the establishment stage. Istekki Oy reserves the possibility to establish categories 10-12 during the validity period of the dynamic purchasing system. Categories 10-12 may include technologies, licences, platform services and ready-made solutions for the secure communication service. The purpose of categories 10-12 is to enable flexible response to market developments and technological changes in secure communication services. All candidates who meet the suitability requirements stated in the ESPD form and the invitation to participate may apply to become a tenderer for the dynamic purchasing system. All candidates who meet the set suitability requirements will be accepted into the dynamic purchasing system. All interested candidates may request the right to participate in the dynamic purchasing system for the entire duration of the dynamic purchasing system. The number of candidates to be accepted into the dynamic purchasing system is not limited. A candidate applies to the dynamic purchasing system by submitting an application for participation. Istekki Oy may, if it wishes, shorten or extend the duration of the dynamic purchasing system by publishing a contract notice to that effect. rejected.text: We invite forward-leaning tenderers to register for our market dialogue for a future procurement of a tender implementation tool (KGV), with the accompanying options. The County Municipalities would like a modern and user-friendly tool that helps both the contracting authority and the tenderer with implementation competitions in a flexible way. Simple process and user support should be available by phone and email. The tool shall contribute to increased efficiency in the procurement work and reduce complexity, so that several parts of the entities can use the tool in line with the organisations' maturity. The contracting authorities are looking for a tool that offers efficient workflow and automated processes. The use ought to contribute to reducing the organisation's use of resources in procurement processes and contract follow-up and that the company can more easily comply with the regulations. The contracting authorities want a robust, modern and cloud-based system that uses new technology to enable efficient data processing, automation of work processes and seamless integration with the existing infrastructure in the counties. The solution is expected to be maintained, upgraded and developed to support legislative changes, adopt new technology, improve the user experience, and provide continual value during the contract period. It is important that the procured system is developed in line with the market and contributes to strengthening the digitalisation work for the procurement discipline. The system shall assist with the transition to a data-driven everyday life for procurement consultants. In the future, it may be necessary to integrate artificial intelligence into your infrastructure, such as with Microsoft 365 and Microsoft Azure, to improve employee efficiency and provide access to verified information from trusted data sources, while maintaining security and data quality. The contracting authority wants a tool that, in the long term, can connect artificial intelligence to data in KGV/KAV and other parts of the system, so that employees can obtain reliable information through interaction with artificial intelligence, independent of client. The main goals are: Streamlining of the procurement work, reduced complexity in the processes. Automation and improved workflow. Better compliance with the rules. Support for digitalisation and transition to data-driven processes. Future integration of artificial intelligence, especially with Microsoft 365 and Azure. Need for integration with archive system FINT (Joint County InTegraions). What is GOOD? FINT Arkiv – Novari IKS. FINT is a common digital platform that is used by Norwegian counties to standardise and make information available through open APIs. This contributes to increased efficiency, better data quality and reduced costs by enabling real-time reuse of data. FINT Arkiv-integration shall be used by county entities included in this competition. Other affiliated entities may require integration in other ways, adapted to their system landscape. As the Contracting Authority consists of several entities, different archive systems are currently used. With FINT Arkiv, however, the underlying archive system does not function as the interface for the integration - FINT provides a common interface regardless of which archive system is used. Fint Arkiv is used by all of the counties in the country, byantikvaren and Bymiljøetaten in Oslo kommune as well as Sametinget. With FINT Arkiv the counties get an API with a joint information model for standardised exchange of archive information. The counties that currently participate in this competition use three different archive systems: Tieto Evry - Public 360 Sikri - Elements Acos - WebSak+ Overall Requirement - Integration-friendly and data-driven system. The contracting authority shall use systems with open and documented APIs that enable safe and efficient integration. With limited internal resources for development, the contracting authority needs assistance to extract more value from the existing data. The tenderer shall develop integrations that are easy to implement, maintain and reuse - and that can be shared with other public entities when relevant. The system shall be based on open standards and it shall provide sufficient documentation for both technical and functional understanding. The Contracting Authority strives to procure systems that shall offer an open and documented API with sufficient functionality for safe and efficient integration with other systems and data sources. The API shall support standardised protocols and formats and be available for integration without a need for comprehensive adaptations. The integrations shall be designed with modular architecture that enables reuse and sharing with other public entities. All the necessary documentation connected to the API, data flow and process design shall be provided and suitable for both technical and functional understanding. The tenderer shall assist in implementing value from existing data and contribute to a more data-driven and coherent public sector.

result.text: On behalf of the Danish Tax Administration, the Agency for Development and Simplification (UFST) would like to invite suppliers to a market dialogue on a new system for handling new EU legislation in relation to the FASTER directive, which is intended to ensure better, simpler, and more uniform procedures for the relief of excess withholding tax on cross-border investments. The directive is intended to ensure that EU countries have the necessary tools to effectively tackle tax fraud and abuse. The directive can be found here FASTER. With this market dialogue, UFST seeks to gain important knowledge from potential suppliers on the market who have experience from similar areas or solutions. UFST would also like to investigate whether there is a standard solution on the market already that can meet our needs or whether there are plans to develop a solution to support the FASTER directive. The market dialogue should provide insight into whether a standard solution exists or is planned to be developed that can support our needs in relation to: 1. Reporting of several detailed information on dividends from certified financial intermediaries 2. Digital tax certificate residences (eTRC), so that investors only need to obtain one digital certificate from their home country to document which EU country they are residents in 3. A system for ‘relief-at-source’ of dividend tax that will integrate with our existing system-portfolio Examples of business and technical needs (non-exhaustive): • The solution must exchange data to other relevant IT systems in UFST • The solution must integrate access to external foreign IT systems including, for example, a common EU portal • The solution must provide access and the possibility of approval and deregistration of Danish investors • The solution must enable automatic reporting of control data from the certified financial intermediaries • The solution must support case processing so that administrative users can handle situations where reported control data is deficient • The solution must enable the issuance and revocation of eTRCs • The solution must enable the approval and deregistration of certified financial intermediaries • The solution must issue and enforce powers of attorney • Handling of access control and compliance with logging and security requirements • Automatic control of submission data In addition, UFST is interested in what considerations the suppliers make in relation to which technologies and technology stacks the solution is expected to be built on, and whether the solution is implemented in Cloud or On Premise. In addition, it is particularly interesting to have solutions from suppliers that can document experience with larger common solutions in OECD and/or the EU. For the development of the standard solution and its ongoing maintenance, UFST would also like to clarify how the supplier generally intends to ensure: • Maximum automation of workflows • Full compliance with the FASTER directive and functional support of it • User-friendliness, overview (e.g. status), and reporting options • Compliance with existing legislation in the area.

result.text: This PIN provides early information about the expected starting date and purchase volume for a pre-commercial procurement (PCP) carried out by the THERESA PCP project and about the open market consultation (OMC) that is organised in preparation of this pre-commercial procurement (PCP). The THERESA Buyers Group of healthcare providers have identified a shared need for innovative and sustainable solutions to treat hospital wastewater (HWW) at the source, before it reaches the municipal network, to reduce environmental and health risks linked to pharmaceutical residues, antimicrobial-resistant microorganisms and genes, and other hazardous contaminants. The THERESA PCP aims to stimulate the development of environmentally sustainable, cost-effective, and scalable on-site HWW treatment systems capable of efficiently removing cytostatic drugs, X-ray contrast agents, antibiotics, antimicrobial-resistant bacteria (ARB) and genes (ARG), while minimising energy consumption, chemical use, and carbon footprint. The contract notice is expected to be published in May-2026 and phase 1 to be started in January 2027, following the PCP timeline. The procurement will take the form of a Pre-Commercial Procurement (PCP) awarding R&D service contracts to several providers in parallel, through a phased and competitive process comprising three stages: Solution design, prototyping, and original development and validation/testing of the first products in real hospital environments. After each phase, intermediate evaluations will down-select the best-performing and most innovative solutions. The contractors with the best-value-for-money solutions will be offered a specific contract for the next phase. The PCP is a joint cross-border initiative coordinated by Fundación Miguel Servet (Spain) as Lead Procurer, on behalf of a Buyers Group of hospitals and public health institutions from Spain, Estonia, Poland, Belgium and the Netherlands, supported by technical and innovation partners. Testing is expected to take place in Spain, Estonia, Poland and the Netherlands to ensure adaptability. Price is not the only award criterion, and all criteria are stated only in the procurement documents. The selected contractors will retain ownership of the Intellectual Property Rights (IPRs) generated during the PCP and will be able to commercially exploit the developed solutions beyond the scope of the procurement. The R&D services will be carried out primarily within the European Union and/or countries associated with the Horizon Europe Programme. At least 50% of the total value of R&D activities will take place within the EU or associated countries. In addition, contractors must ensure that none of the contracted services are performed in countries nor by entities that are subject to EU restrictive measures under Article 29 of the Treaty on the European Union (TEU) and Article 215 of the Treaty on the Functioning of the EU (TFEU)23 (sanctions). They must ensure that none of the goods procured or used for the procurement were developed, produced or supplied in countries or by entities that are subject to such restrictive measures. Duration of the contract in months: 30 months (January 27 to June 29). The duration covers all three PCP phases: Solution design, prototyping, and original development and validation/testing of the first products. The PCP is expected to start after the publication of the Contract Notice and to end upon completion of the validation phase. This contract is not subject to renewal.

result.text: This Notice of Funding Opportunity (NOFO) invites exploratory grant applications, hereafter referred to as the Novel Experiential Technologies Assisting Individual learning Hubs or NExT AI Hubs (formerly Learning Disabilities Innovation Hubs), to address the impact of Artificial Intelligence (AI) technologies on developmental outcomes in children diagnosed with or at risk for developing a specific learning disability (SLD) impacting reading, writing, and mathematics. NExT AI Hubs include a single Research Project and a Leadership Core that support the goals and aims of the Hub. This NOFO seeks to serve as a catalyst to 1) speed the maturation of nascent/novel, high-impact, high-risk research that advances understanding of the role AI technology plays in supporting, improving, or limiting the learning, cognitive, and socio-emotional needs of children at risk for or diagnosed with SLDs, 2) build an evidence base for the SLD community to inform policy or practice, and 3) provide project-embedded, career-enhancing research and professional development opportunities to support the next generation of transdisciplinary SLD scientists. This initiative provides opportunities to support planning and building a body of research and corresponding intellectual infrastructure to enable NExT AI investigators to compete for large research and program project opportunities in the future.This NOFO aims to integrate research topics that are of relevance to various research programs at the Eunice Kennedy Shriver National Institute of Child Health and Human Development (NICHD) and align with the NICHD Strategic Plan. The NOFO intends to build cross-programmatic, transdisciplinary and cross-cutting scientific research, and critically nurture the development of early career investigators capable of conducting this research.

result.text: This is not a procurement notice nor a call for tenders, but a request for information through which Etelä-Karjalan hyvinvointialue is surveying system suppliers to register for a potential tendering procedure. The wellbeing services county is responsible for social welfare, healthcare and rescue services. It is the largest employer in the region, employing approximately 6 000 professionals from various fields. Our vision is to be a pioneering community where services are accessible, the wellbeing of our population is among the best in Finland, and the occupational wellbeing of our employees is high. Our mission is to increase the health, functional capacity and security of our residents throughout their lives. Our values are “Mie turvaan”, “Mie uskallan”, “Mie vastaan” and “Mie välitän”. Strategic priorities include investing in personnel, smooth processes and the gradation of services. The realisation of these requires efficient, safe and user-friendly digital solutions. The roster planning system plays a central role in supporting the smooth flow of everyday operations, the occupational wellbeing of the staff and cost-efficiency. The purpose of the market dialogue is to obtain a comprehensive overview of the roster planning systems and related services available on the market. The information obtained can be used to assess what kinds of solutions exist on the market, what benefits they generate and how they suit the needs of the wellbeing services county. Through the market dialogue, the wellbeing services county aims to: 1. Obtain information on the market offering and various suppliers' solutions 2. Understand the functionalities and key use cases of the systems 3. Explore integration possibilities with existing systems and platforms 4. Assess the implementation of information security and data protection 5. Gain an overview of pricing models and cost structures (no individual tenders) 6. Survey delivery and service models 7. Obtain concrete examples and demos from suppliers to illustrate the suitability of the solutions for the needs of the wellbeing services county. The market dialogue is open to all suppliers that can offer systems or services falling within the scope of this solution package. The focus of the dialogue is on solutions that are already in production or available on the market. Suppliers are requested to present systems and services that are available and where the key functionalities have already been implemented. The presentation of solutions under development or merely at the concept stage is not desired on this occasion. In connection with registration, suppliers are requested to briefly describe: • what ready-made solutions and services they offer • in what kinds of environments the solutions have been deployed (example descriptions, no mandatory references) • the key features of the solution that they wish to present in the market dialogue All participants are offered equal opportunities to obtain information regarding the market dialogue. The dialogue does not bind Etelä-Karjalan hyvinvointialue to initiate a procurement, nor are procurement decisions made on the basis of it. If there is a large number of registered suppliers, the wellbeing services county may hold both a joint information session and a limited number of individual meetings. The market dialogue focuses in particular on how solutions can support the key operations of the wellbeing services county. These are not procurement requirements, but thematic areas intended as a basis for discussion and illustration: • User management and information security • Working hours and shift management • Consideration of collective agreements and local agreements • Competence, qualifications and occupational health management • Usability and multi-user support • Reporting and information-driven management • Integrations with other systems • Mobile usage and employee services • Main administration, maintenance and support services • Intelligence and automation Pricing models and lifecycle services Participating suppliers have the opportunity to illustrate their solutions also through a demo or practical example scenarios. The wellbeing services county will provide a set of questions in advance to guide the discussion and ensure that the presentations of different suppliers can be compared on an equal basis. The market dialogue will be conducted as supplier-specific meetings via remote connection (Teams). The duration of an individual meeting is approximately 60 to 90 minutes. The supplier will have the opportunity to present their solution and its key features. The wellbeing services county will also ask pre-defined questions that support the equality and comparability of the discussion. Meetings will be held on the following days: 21.10., 22.10., 27.10., 28.10. and 29.10.2025. The exact time will be agreed with the registered suppliers based on the order of registration and schedule coordination. The language of potential presentations/meetings is Finnish. Registrations are requested to be sent by 3.10.2025 at 12:00. This request for information / market survey does not request tenders to be submitted nor are tenders given in response to this request for information; it requests ONLY procurement-related information. Participating or refraining from participating in the market survey / request for information does not affect the tenderer's position in any potential tendering procedure. The market dialogue invitation does not bind the respondent (supplier) to participate in the tendering procedure, nor is responding to this notice a precondition for participating in the actual tendering procedure later. Those participating in the market survey have no right to compensation for participation. The contracting authority does not undertake to carry out the procurement in question. Decisions on launching a potential procurement process will be made after the market survey. The submitted material will be handled as confidential in accordance with section 24, subsection 1, point 20 of the Act on the Openness of Government Activities.

parts.source: Tämä ei ole hankintailmoitus eikä tarjouspyyntö, vaan tietopyyntö, jolla Etelä-Karjalan hyvinvointialue kartoittaa järjestelmätoimittajia ilmoittautumaan mahdollista kilpailutusta varten. Hyvinvointialue vastaa sosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon sekä pelastustoimen palveluista. Se on maakunnan suurin työnantaja, jossa työskentelee noin 6 000 eri alojen ammattilaista. Visiomme on olla edelläkävijäyhteisö, jossa palvelut ovat saavutettavia, väestömme hyvinvointi on Suomen huippua ja työntekijöidemme työhyvinvointi korkea. Missiomme on lisätä asukkaidemme terveyttä, toimintakykyä ja turvaa läpi elämän. Arvojamme ovat “Mie turvaan”, “Mie uskallan”, “Mie vastaan” ja “Mie välitän”. Strategisina painopisteinä ovat henkilöstöön panostaminen, prosessien sujuvuus ja palveluiden porrastus. Näiden toteutuminen edellyttää tehokkaita, turvallisia ja käyttäjäystävällisiä digitaalisia ratkaisuja. Työvuorosuunnittelujärjestelmällä on keskeinen rooli arjen toiminnan sujuvuuden, henkilöstön työhyvinvoinnin ja kustannustehokkuuden tukemisessa. Markkinavuoropuhelun tarkoituksena on saada kokonaiskuva markkinoilla olevista työvuorosuunnittelujärjestelmistä ja niihin liittyvistä palveluista. Saatavan tiedon avulla voidaan arvioida, millaisia ratkaisuja markkinoilla on, millaisia hyötyjä ne tuottavat ja miten ne soveltuvat hyvinvointialueen tarpeisiin. Markkinavuoropuhelun avulla hyvinvointialue pyrkii: 1. Saamaan tietoa markkinoiden tarjonnasta ja eri toimittajien ratkaisuista 2. Ymmärtämään järjestelmien toiminnallisuuksia ja keskeisiä käyttötapauksia 3. Selvittämään integraatiomahdollisuuksia olemassa oleviin järjestelmiin ja alustoihin 4. Arvioimaan tietoturvan ja tietosuojan toteutusta 5. Saamaan yleiskuvan hinnoittelumalleista ja kustannusrakenteista (ei yksittäisiä tarjouksia) 6. Kartoittamaan toimitus- ja palvelumalleja 7. Saamaan toimittajilta konkreettisia esimerkkejä ja demoja, joiden avulla voidaan havainnollistaa ratkaisujen soveltuvuutta hyvinvointialueen tarpeisiin Markkinavuoropuhelu on avoin kaikille toimittajille, joilla on tarjota tämän ratkaisukokonaisuuden piiriin kuuluvia järjestelmiä tai palveluita. Vuoropuhelun painopisteenä ovat ratkaisut, jotka ovat jo tuotannossa tai markkinoilla saatavilla. Toimittajia pyydetään esittelemään järjestelmiä ja palveluita, jotka ovat käytettävissä ja joissa keskeiset toiminnallisuudet ovat valmiiksi toteutettuja. Kehitteillä olevien tai vasta konseptitasolla olevien ratkaisujen esittelyä ei tässä yhteydessä toivota. Ilmoittautumisen yhteydessä toimittajia pyydetään lyhyesti kuvaamaan: • mitä valmiita ratkaisuja ja palveluja he tarjoavat • minkälaisissa ympäristöissä ratkaisuja on otettu käyttöön (esimerkkikuvauksia, ei pakollisia referenssejä) • ratkaisun keskeisiä ominaisuuksia, joita he haluavat esitellä markkinavuoropuhelussa Kaikille osallistujille tarjotaan yhdenvertaiset mahdollisuudet saada tietoa markkinavuoropuhelusta. Vuoropuhelu ei sido Etelä-Karjalan hyvinvointialuetta käynnistämään hankintaa eikä sen perusteella tehdä hankintapäätöksiä. Mikäli ilmoittautuneita toimittajia on runsaasti, hyvinvointialue voi toteuttaa sekä yhteisen infotilaisuuden että rajatun määrän yksilökohtaisia tapaamisia. Markkinavuoropuhelussa keskitytään erityisesti siihen, miten ratkaisut voivat tukea hyvinvointialueen keskeisiä toimintoja. Nämä eivät ole hankintavaatimuksia, vaan keskustelun ja havainnollistamisen pohjaksi tarkoitettuja aihealueita: • Käyttäjähallinta ja tietoturva • Työaikojen ja työvuorojen hallinta • TES- ja paikallisten sopimusten huomiointi • Osaamisen, pätevyyksien ja työterveyden hallinta • Käytettävyys ja monikäyttäjätuki • Raportointi ja tiedolla johtaminen • Integraatiot muihin järjestelmiin • Mobiilikäyttö ja työntekijäpalvelut • Pääkäyttäjyys, ylläpito ja tukipalvelut • Älykkyys ja automaatio • Hinnoittelumallit ja elinkaaripalvelut Osallistuvilla toimittajilla on mahdollisuus havainnollistaa ratkaisujaan myös demon tai käytännön esimerkkitilanteiden kautta. Hyvinvointialue toimittaa etukäteen kysymyspatteriston, joka ohjaa keskustelua ja varmistaa, että eri toimittajien esityksiä voidaan vertailla yhdenvertaisesti. Markkinavuoropuhelu toteutetaan toimittajakohtaisina tapaamisina etäyhteydellä (Teams). Yksittäisen tapaamisen kesto on noin 60–90 minuuttia. Toimittajalla on mahdollisuus esitellä ratkaisunsa sekä sen keskeiset ominaisuudet. Hyvinvointialue esittää lisäksi etukäteen määriteltyjä kysymyksiä, jotka tukevat keskustelun yhdenvertaisuutta ja vertailtavuutta. Tapaamisia järjestetään seuraavina päivinä: 21.10., 22.10., 27.10., 28.10. ja 29.10.2025. Tarkka ajankohta sovitaan ilmoittautuneiden toimittajien kanssa ilmoittautumisjärjestyksen ja aikataulujen yhteensovittamisen perusteella. Mahdollisten esittelyjen/tapaamisten kieli on Suomi. Ilmoittautumiset pyydetään lähettämään 3.10.2025 klo 12:00 mennessä. Tällä tietopyynnöllä/markkinakartoituksella ei pyydetä eikä tähän tietopyyntöön anneta tarjouksia, vaan tällä pyydetään VAIN hankintaan liittyviä tietoja. Markkinakartoitukseen/tietopyyntöön osallistuminen tai osallistumatta jättäminen ei vaikuta tarjoajan asemaan mahdollisessa tarjouskilpailussa. Markkinavuoropuhelukutsu ei sido vastaajaa (toimittajaa) tarjouskilpailuun osallistumiseen, eikä tähän ilmoitukseen vastaaminen ole edellytyksenä myöhemmin varsinaiseen tarjouskilpailuun osallistumiselle. Markkinakartoitukseen osallistuvilla ei ole oikeutta saada korvausta osallistumisesta. Hankintayksikkö ei sitoudu toteuttamaan asianomaista hankintaa. Päätökset mahdollisen hankintaprosessin käynnistämisestä tehdään markkinakartoituksen jälkeen. Toimitettu materiaali käsitellään luottamuksellisena julkisuuslain 24 §:n 1 momentin 20 kohdan mukaan.

result.text: Invitation to market dialogue. Sykehusinnkjøp HF hereby invites tenderers to a market dialogue for the procurement of a laboratory information system for the health companies in Helse Nord. The market dialogue is a part of the preliminary work for the procurement and is being carried out because the Contracting Authority would like input for the procurement from potential suppliers, possibly also from other interested parties. As a part of this process, suppliers are invited to provide input to the procurement prior to the announcement. The feedback makes it possible to make a decision about the type of procurement and procurement procedure. Based on input from the market dialogue, the Contracting Authority will, as needed, open to a closer dialogue with some of the suppliers for further details and discussions. The contracting authority would like input on the following points: Short presentation of the supplier/tendererWhich the specialist areas the system is meant to cover (see further information on all disciplines within the laboratory service in annex "Invitation to market dialogue") About the solution, including brief information on functionality, possibilities and limitations, and: Describe how the system is built up in the tender documentation. modules, and which advantages this provides. How the system is deployed to clients; web based and/or sw deployed on clients. By the latter; whether there are specific requirements for clients. How the system will be deployed back-end. Describe how the system supports portable devices (tablets etc.). References to customers where the system is in use (and possibly which parts of the system they use). The tenderer ́s thoughts on how the system will support future development within the disciplines, e.g. within AI, integrations (i.a. FHIR), personalised medicine, etc. Input for the procurement as regards the expected functionality described in chapter 5 (see annex "Invitation to Market Dialogue"):How does the system ensure user friendliness, intuitive user interface and training? How does the system cover the overall description and for each of the disciplines covered by the solution? If there is functionality that cannot be offered we would like to know this. Which disciplines the solution covers and whether it covers all disciplines within the laboratory service (note possible exceptions for transfusion medicine/blood bank). How the system supports decision support functionality. How the solution supports artificial intelligence. How the system supports personalised medicine. How does the system support different integration mechanisms with other systems (FHIR, message exchange in accordance with Norwegian requirements, etc.?) Delivery. Which factors affect delivery time and how do you handle risk? All the functionalities are ready developed and can be delivered. If there is functionality that needs to be developed, it is desirable to know. Delivery model: cloud and/or local installation. If the system is cloud compatible; about Norwegian requirements are complied with. Whether there are specific requirements for HW and underlying SW-platform for customers. Short proposals as to how the system will be implemented at Customer Provisions that the Customer is expected to fulfil. Frequency of release bicycles and response to new functionality and error recovery. Integrations: does this require assistance from customers? Describe the pricing model and what factors affect the total cost of ownership (TCO) Licenses Maintenance/support price driven factors. And input that the tenderer deems important. Deadline for written feedback on the above mentioned points from interested parties: 28.11.2025. This is only a prior information notice in order to get information on the market and to have a dialogue with relevant suppliers. The actual competition may be announced at a later date. Feedback on or questions to the market survey is done in the Mercell communication module. After this market survey, the contracting authority will assess the need to hold meetings(s) with relevant interested parties.

Es unterstützt die speziellen Anforderungen der Augenheilkunde, insbesondere die Dokumentation von Befunden, Bilddaten und operativen Eingriffen. result.text: East Sussex Fire Authority (ESFA) on behalf of East Sussex Fire and Rescue Service require to replace their Live Fire Training Building situated on our Training Centre site in Maresfield East Sussex. This exercise is being created to replace the previous exercise called Live Fire Training Building (but with the same reference number) as we ran into portal constraints that blocked this being an open tender open to all new interested parties. To do so we had to cease the previous exercise and commence a new one. Our intention is to replace essentially what we have now on a like for like basis but taking into account some design changes identified that will improve both flexibility in use and reduce the impact we have on the environment. We have a fairly clear idea of what we want, and that we can afford it, and believe we have a basic understanding of who might be able to supply what we require in a fairly small niche market. However, the aim of this document is to allow the market to confirm, or otherwise, our assumptions and for us to gather some information that will allow us to prepare an equitable tender that any capable supplier could bid for. As well as establishing capable suppliers we are very keen to establish whether this can be achieved as a single supplier integrated project, or not. Whilst we may consider alternative innovative approaches, we believe that a steel framed metal structure or container-based solution is likely to be all that we can afford and of which, we have a lot of experience being the basis of the current unit. This Tender will be managed electronically via the In-Tend Portal. It can be reached via: https://sell2.in-tend.co.uk/blpd/home Contractors need to be registered to use the portal and registered against us as a Contracting Entity, but registration is free and further information on how this is achieved, can be found at: https://sell2.in-tend.co.uk/blpd/register If you are unsure about your company's registration status, or have problems accessing the tender on the portal, please contact In-Tend Portals support at: https://in-tend.co.uk/contact-us/ If you have any difficulties with the In-Tend Portal that you are unable to resolve through the Sell2UK helpdesk, please email procurement@esfrs.org. UK2 PME was previously completed via a separate exercise - https://www.find-tender.service.gov.uk/Notice/072670-2025 Lot 1: . None

result.text: HTE is a field of chemistry that expanded exponentially in the past five years, and most pharmaceutical companies are currently using it in their workflows. This methodology allows multi-parameter optimisation of chemical reactions but also synthesis of multiple compounds (96 to 384) on a small-scale using plate chemistry. Combined with the implementation of Direct-to-Biology (D2B) approaches, which involves the direct testing of non-purified mixtures, biological data is obtained faster. The combination of these methods greatly improves the Design, Make, Test, and Analyse (DMTA) cycle. Lot 1: . The option is a cloud-based design platform, accessible via a secure web interface, offering enhanced scalability and reduced infrastructure overhead. The solution will integrate with a University of Dundee-hosted virtual machine to enable secure data exchange and computational workflows. Installation of server-side components will be managed by the DDU Data Management and Computational Chemistry teams, with network provisioning supported by DTS. Ongoing maintenance and updates will be provided by the vendor.

rejected.text: Banedanmark expects to publish the tender for acquiring a solution to monitor and diagnose railway telecommunications and signalling systems in Spring 2026. To be sure that the process for tender and the contract is aligned with the capabilities of the market, Banedanmark wishes to invite potential vendors for a written market dialogue and verbal hearing regarding the upcoming tender for acquiring a solution to monitor and diagnose railway telecommunications and signalling systems. The purpose of the market dialogue is to get the markets feedback on the scope and if it is aligned with the market regarding the composition of the products/services, the commercial conditions, the price structure, market conditions, risks, and the partnership after having entered the contract etc. In that way Banedanmark will be able to optimize the tender material accordingly to how the market is today before making the tender public. The market dialogue process is the following: Banedanmark has attached an appendix to this document, which Banedanmark request the potential vendors to answer and return via EU-Supply. - Appendix 1 Questionnaire and answers (Potential vendors must fill out this document). The potential vendors must return their answers through EU-Supply not later than 05.12.2025 Depending on the answer’s Banedanmark will have the option to invite potential vendors to a digital meeting via Microsoft Teams. The selection of potential vendors to the meeting will be done through the criteria, to secure a representative of the market, to discuss the answers and possible implications. The topics in Appendix 1 will provide the initial questions for the market dialogue. If the potential vendors are invited for a meeting and find it relevant, they are welcome to send any suggestions for other topics that should be discussed during the market dialogue. The digital meeting will be held, if relevant, 11.12.2025 and 12.12.2025. Banedanmark will, with the invite to the digital meeting, send a Teams link. The duration of the meeting is approx. 1,5 hours (CET+1) in the span of 8-16 Thursday (11.12.2025) and 8-12 Friday (12.12.2025). If the potential vendor suggests meeting times/dates, Banedanmark will try to accommodate those requests.
