result.text: Abertay University is a specialist university based in Dundee with approximately 5,000 students. The University is seeking to modernise and enhance its digital experience platforms to better support student recruitment, engagement, communication and service delivery. As part of this market engagement exercise, suppliers are asked to consider the University's scale, resources and strategic ambitions when outlining potential solutions, delivery approaches and indicative costs. This will help ensure responses are proportionate to Abertay's requirements while providing a sustainable foundation for future digital transformation initiatives. Abertay University is seeking to engage with the market to understand the availability of solutions capable of delivering a modern, integrated digital experience platform, or integrated set of platforms and services, to support the University's website, intranet and web/mobile portal requirements. Lot 1: . The University is seeking to improve student recruitment and conversion, enhance staff and student engagement, strengthen digital communications, simplify content management and provide a more joined-up and personalised digital experience across its key digital channels The scope includes: - A public-facing website serving as the University's primary digital channel for student recruitment and conversion, marketing and communications, promotion of courses and research, and engagement with prospective students, partners and external stakeholders. - A staff and student intranet platform providing audience-specific content and communications. - A web and mobile portal experience (currently delivered through the myday platform) providing staff and students with personalised access to university services, learning resources, communications, academic information and other digital services. The University is interested in understanding whether these requirements are best met through a single platform, a suite of integrated products, or an alternative architectural approach, together with the associated benefits, risks, implementation considerations and indicative costs. The University wishes to gather information from suppliers on potential solutions, delivery approaches, operating models, implementation considerations and indicative costs to inform a future procurement strategy and business case.

result.text: The subject matter of this tender is to determine the perspectives of private customers, corporate customers, service providers, and business partners in a structured form. The attitudes, needs, and requirements of these groups are of interest in order to ensure the demand-driven optimisation and further development of products, services, and performance in the competitive environment. These similar services are multiple surveys (telephone, online, or written) carried out in several survey waves over a period of twelve months. In this context, the services of the first survey wave commissioned under this contract are essentially repeated in further survey waves. Further details can be found in point C and point B.3 of the specification of services.

result.text: The Council requires a hub where users can access the system and have the ability to find any needed legislation or regulation to help ensure that whatever project they are working on is compliant with government law and standards. Lot 1: . The Council requires a hub where users can access the system and have the ability to find any needed legislation or regulation to help ensure that whatever project they are working on is compliant with government law and standards. A portal is currently used for this requirement that has 2 parts. The first part is the Construction Information Service legislation and technical information management solution. This service ensures that Fife Council will have access to the correct, current and complaint business critical information year-round. This service provides the Council access to 27,000 full-text PDFs with the ability to save, view, print, download, copy and paste any of these documents. There are over 350 publishers that add documents to this service. Fife Council require something equal in quality and quantity to this. The second part of the portal is Occupational Health & Safety Information Service. This single source library holds more than 90,000 documents from more than 400 publishers. The focus of this service is Health, Safety, Environmental and Fire. This service relates to risk management, hazardous substances and operations, control principles, movement of people and vehicles. Fife Council also require something that is equal in quality and quantity to this part of the portal. Overall, the current solution allows access to over 2.3 million industry standards, over 10 thousand engineering manuals, handbooks, reference books, over 76 million technical articles, journals and books, over 107 million patents, patent applications, unity models and abstracts and over 39 million industry-to-industry reference links across all hosted content

The final decision on the number of framework agreement suppliers will be made at a later date, cf. the tender documentation point 1.2.1.2 sub-contracts will be national, whilst two of the sub-contracts will cover, but not limited to, our locations in Haugesund and Ålesund.All call-offs will occur with the use of mini-competitions between the suppliers with agreement within the relevant sub-contract Framework agreement, will be signed for a period of two years with an option for 1+1 year. The procurement has a maximum estimated value of NOK 554 million. Need and value can vary within the different sub-contracts and competence areas.

result.text: The German Academic Exchange Service (DAAD) is the world's largest organisation for the international exchange of students and researchers as well as the internationalisation of German universities. Since its foundation in the year 1925, the DAAD has supported over 2,9 million academics at home and abroad. As an association, it is supported by German universities and student bodies. In addition to awarding scholarships, the DAAD promotes the internationalisation of German universities, strengthens German studies and the German language abroad, supports developing countries in building efficient universities and advises decision-makers in cultural, educational and development policy. To this end, it maintains an external network with regional offices, information centres and information points in more than 60 countries. Worldwide, more than 1.200 committed employees in Bonn, Berlin and regional offices work towards the goals of the DAAD. The DAAD is financed predominantly from federal funds from the Federal Foreign Office, the Federal Ministry of Education and Research, the Federal Ministry for Economic Cooperation and Development and the European Union. Other sponsors include foreign governments, companies, foundations and the Stifterverband für die Deutsche Wissenschaft. The DAAD is inviting tenders for services in the areas of usability, user experience and continuous success measurement. A contractor (AN) is sought with specific competence and experience in the areas of usability, user experience, conducting user acceptance tests, continuous success measurement, optimisation and requirements analysis. The AN designs and conducts user-centred studies (e.g. usability tests, acceptance tests, user surveys, target group interviews), continuously measures the success of existing and new features, analyses information architecture, navigation and interaction design and derives concrete optimisation proposals from this. In addition, it supports the DAAD in requirements analysis and prioritisation of further development needs and documents the results in compact, decision-oriented reports for the product managers. The services mentioned below can be commissioned in combinations adapted to the respective project, both in individual studies and in long-term projects. Corresponding tasks may also have to be carried out for mobile apps under Android and/or iOS, possibly also accompanying development. So far, however, no development is specifically planned. The DAAD expects the following services from the contractor: a) Usability and user acceptance tests (in-person or remote) b) User surveys and target group interviews (in-person or remote) c) Laboratory use or rental for in-person tests d) Conception of customised UX monitoring systems for continuous success measurement e) Creation of personas and user structure analyses f) Workshops and design thinking (in-person or remote) g) Consulting, continuous optimisation support, content review and expert analysis h) Result documentation and presentation i) Web analysis and user tracking For further information, please refer to the service description in Annex 02.

parts.source: Der Deutsche Akademische Austauschdienst e.V. (DAAD) ist die weltweit größte Organisation für den internationalen Austausch von Studierenden und Wissenschaftlern sowie die Internationalisierung der deutschen Hochschulen. Seit seiner Gründung im Jahr 1925 hat der DAAD über 2,9 Millionen Akademikerinnen und Akademiker im In- und Ausland unterstützt. Er wird als Verein von den deutschen Hochschulen und Studierendenschaften getragen. Neben der Vergabe von Stipendien fördert der DAAD die Internationalisierung der deutschen Hochschulen, stärkt die Germanistik und die deutsche Sprache im Ausland, unterstützt Entwicklungsländer beim Aufbau leistungsfähiger Hochschulen und berät die Entscheider in der Kultur-, Bildungs- und Entwicklungspolitik. Er unterhält dafür ein Außennetzwerk mit Außenstellen, Informationszentren und Informationspunkten in mehr als 60 Ländern. Weltweit setzen sich mehr als 1.200 engagierte Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeiter in Bonn, Berlin und Außenstellen für die Ziele des DAAD ein. Der DAAD wird überwiegend aus Bundesmitteln des Auswärtigen Amts, des Bundesministeriums für Bildung und Forschung, des Bundesministeriums für wirtschaftliche Zusammenarbeit und Entwicklung und der Europäischen Union finanziert. Weitere Förderer sind ausländische Regierungen, Unternehmen, Stiftungen und der Stifterverband für die Deutsche Wissenschaft. Der DAAD schreibt Dienstleistungen in den Bereichen Usability, User Experience und kontinuierliche Erfolgsmessung aus. Gesucht wird ein Auftragnehmer (AN) mit spezifischer Kompetenz und Erfahrung in den Bereichen Usability, User Experience, Durchführung von User Acceptance-Tests, kontinuierliche Erfolgsmessung, Optimierung und Anforderungsanalyse. Der AN konzipiert und führt nutzerzentrierte Untersuchungen (z. B. Usability-Tests, Akzeptanztests, Nutzerbefragungen, Zielgruppeninterviews) durch, misst kontinuierlich den Erfolg bestehender und neuer Features, analysiert Informationsarchitektur, Navigation und Interaktionsdesign und leitet daraus konkrete Optimierungsvorschläge ab. Zudem unterstützt er den DAAD bei der Anforderungsanalyse und Priorisierung der Weiterentwicklungsbedarfe und dokumentiert die Ergebnisse in kompakten, entscheidungsorientierten Berichten für die Produktverantwortlichen. Die im Folgenden genannten Leistungen können in an das jeweilige Projekt angepassten Kombinationen sowohl in Einzelstudien als auch in längerfristig angelegten Projekten beauftragt werden. Entsprechende Aufgaben sind ggf. auch für mobile Apps unter Android und/oder iOS durchzuführen, möglicherweise auch begleitend zur Entwicklung. Bislang ist aber noch keine Entwicklung konkret geplant. Der DAAD erwartet vom Auftragnehmer folgende Leistungen: a) Usability- und User-Acceptance-Tests (Präsenz oder Remote) b) Nutzerbefragungen und Zielgruppeninterviews (Präsenz oder Remote) c) Labornutzung bzw. - anmietung für Präsenztests d) Konzeption maßgeschneiderter UX-Monitoringsysteme zu kontinuierlichen Erfolgsmessung e) Erstellung von Personas und Nutzerstrukturanalysen f) Workshops und Design-Thinking (Präsenz oder Remote) g) Beratung, kontinuierliche Optimierungsbegleitung, Content-Review und Expertenanalyse h) Ergebnisdokumentation und -präsentation i) Webanalyse und Nutzertracking Weitere Informationen entnehmen Sie bitte der Leistungsbeschreibung in Anlage 02.

parts.source: Rahmenvereinbarung Beschaffungsberatung und Vergabedienstleistungen für Fahrzeuge und Ausstattungen für den Katastrophenschutz Baden-Württemberg. Die Leistungen werden als Rahmenvereinbarung ausgeschrieben. Der Auftraggeber sucht einen Dienstleister, der ihn bei der Beschaffung von Fahrzeugen und Ausstattungen für den Katastrophenschutz unterstützt. Der Auftragnehmer muss insbesondere die folgenden vorwiegend technischen Leistungen erbringen, wobei die rechtliche Bewertung und Entscheidung beim Auftraggeber verbleibt: - Durchführung von Markterkundungen zu den zu beschaffenden Fahrzeugen und Ausstattungen für den Katastrophenschutz, insbesondere in Bezug auf den aktuellen Stand der Technik und die technischen Möglichkeiten - Erstellen von Leistungsbeschreibungen unter Berücksichtigung technischer Spezifikationen und der besonderen Bedarfe des Katastrophenschutzes - Erarbeiten von Vorschlägen für Eignungs- und Zuschlagskriterien, einschließlich technischer Bewertungskriterien - Bearbeiten von technischen Bewerber-/Bieterfragen - Bearbeiten von Rügen, insbesondere Erstellen von Rügeantwortschreiben - Auswertung von Teilnahmeanträgen bzw. Angeboten sowie Erarbeiten von Vergabevorschlägen zur Auftragsvergabe - Erstellen von Vorabinformationsschreiben - Erstellen von Vergabevermerken - Beratung in Nachprüfungsverfahren Darüber hinaus muss der Auftragnehmer den Auftraggeber optional auf jeweiligen Abruf nach dem jeweiligen Zuschlag im Beschaffungsprozess unterstützen und begleiten, zum Beispiel bei Baubesprechungen, Baumusterabnahmen, Güteprüfungen und Abnahmen und ggf. auch in Bezug auf die Gewährleistungsphase nach Abnahme. Rechtsberatungsleistungen sind vom Auftrag nicht umfasst. Die Leistungen werden in Form einer Rahmenvereinbarung ausgeschrieben. Die konkret zu erbringenden Leistungen sowie deren Fristen legt der Auftraggeber individuell in jedem Einzelauftrag fest. Der Auftragnehmer hat keinen Anspruch auf Abruf von Leistungen aus der Rahmenvereinbarung. Ein Anspruch auf Weiterbeauftragung besteht nicht. Art und Umfang der Einzelbeauftragung kann je Einzelprojekt variieren. Dem Auftraggeber steht für jeden aufgrund der Rahmenvereinbarung erteilten Einzelauftrag ein jederzeitiges ordentliches Kündigungsrecht zu. Der Auftraggeber behält sich vor, etwaige weitere besondere Leistungen zu beauftragen. Die Rahmenvereinbarung hat in Bezug auf die nicht-optionalen Leistungen gemäß § 21 Abs. 6 VgV eine Höchstlaufzeit von vier Jahren ab Beginn der Leistungen. Soweit der Auftraggeber die optionalen Leistungen abruft, gelten die Konditionen der Rahmenvereinbarung für die bis zum Erreichen der maximalen Laufzeit erteilten Einzelaufträge bis zu deren abschließender Bearbeitung durch den Auftragnehmer auch nach Beendigung dieser Rahmenvereinbarung fort. Die Höchstmenge der im Rahmen der Rahmenvereinbarung erwarteten Leistungen beläuft sich auf bis zu insgesamt 500 Fahrzeuge und Ausstattungen, die der Auftraggeber bei jedem Einzelauftrag im Rahmen von Einzelaufträgen gebündelt abrufen kann.

This includes: - Right to use the functions of the applications, including the specified modules for individual users in accordance with the total quantity defined further below - Costs incurred by the operation of the software at the manufacturer's site, under the requirement that the software, together with the specified modules and including all data storage, must run on systems that are protected within the EU by the requirements of the GDPR - Costs incurred by the operation of the software at the manufacturer's site, under the requirement that a dedicated, separate virtual/logical infrastructure is used by the manufacturer for the execution of the software, which ensures a strict separation of the software instance used by the ILB, including data storage, from other customers who use the same functions at the manufacturer's site. - Standard support from the product manufacturer - Right to use various connectors within the timeframe acquired by the right to use the software. - Separate instances for productive systems ("production instance") as well as development and test systems ("test instance") Further information on the nature and functionality of the software in question can be found in Part B, Service Description. One Identity Manager from OneIdentity Base Engine: One Identity Manager is a market-leading standard software for Identity Governance and Administration (IGA), which centrally controls user accounts, access rights and the associated risks in complex IT landscapes. The software enables seamless, transparent and audit-proof management of identities across on-premises, hybrid and cloud environments. One Identity Safeguard PASM: The core module secures the entire lifecycle of privileged access credentials; passwords and SSH keys are stored in a hardened vault (appliance or SaaS) and rotated automatically. Access credentials are released exclusively via a policy-based workflow with optional approval levels (e.g. four-eyes principle, time-limited access). In addition, this module acts as a proxy and records all administrative sessions (e.g. via RDP and SSH) without gaps. The recordings include video, keystrokes and metadata. The entire data traffic is monitored in real time, with predefined rules enabling the immediate blocking of suspicious or unwanted actions. This ensures complete, audit-proof traceability. Connectors: Licences must be offered for the items in Chapter 1.1 - Application list for interface integration. Note: a different, varying duration is required for each connector here.

result.text: Assumption of the technical programme management of programme P20 The subject of the contract is the assumption of the technical programme management of programme P20 (formerly Police 20/20 programme). Programme P20 was created to implement the Saarbrücken Agenda and is a multiproject spanning several implementation levels and years (target picture 2030+). Its core mandate is to replace the heterogeneous police IT landscape and to unify and harmonise all information systems of the German police forces taking into account applicable legal frameworks. For this purpose, uniform, modern procedures are to be provided that can be used by all police forces of the Federation and the Länder according to equal standards. In order to achieve the target picture 2030+ of police casework through programme P20, a step-by-step approach is pursued. In total, more than 45 projects currently fit together as individual building blocks to form the overall programme P20. Important intermediate pictures have already been achieved. A further important intermediate step is to be achieved in the year 2028.

parts.source: Übernahme der fachlichen Programmleitung des Programms P20 Gegenstand des Vertrags ist die Übernahme der fachlichen Programmleitung des Programms P20 (ehemals Programm Polizei 20/20). Das Programm P20 wurde zur Umsetzung der Saarbrücker Agenda geschaffen und ist ein Multiprojekt, welches sich über mehrere Umsetzungsebenen und -jahre erstreckt (Zielbild 2030+). Es hat den Kernauftrag, die heterogene polizeiliche IT-Landschaft abzulösen und das gesamte Informationswesen der deutschen Polizeien unter Berücksichtigung geltender rechtlicher Rahmenbedingungen zu vereinheitlichen und zu harmonisieren. Dazu sollen einheitliche, moderne Verfahren bereitgestellt werden, die von allen Polizeien des Bundes und der Länder nach gleichen Standards genutzt werden können. Um das Zielbild 2030+ der polizeilichen Sachbearbeitung durch das Programm P20 zu erreichen, wird eine schrittweise Vorgehensweise angestrebt. Insgesamt fügen sich aktuell mehr als 45 Projekte als einzelne Bausteine zum Gesamtprogramm P20 zusammen. Wichtige Zwischenbilder wurden bereits erreicht. Ein weiterer wichtiger Zwischenschritt soll im Jahr 2028 erreicht werden.

result.text: The subject of the contract is the upgrade and expansion of the multi-channel citizen information and service system 1555, which has been operated by 1/10/2022 as a single service hub for citizens and businesses regarding matters falling within the remit of the Ministry of Labour and Social Security and its supervised bodies. As part of the upgrade, the digital architecture and software subsystems, such as the web portal, knowledge base, artificial intelligence solutions and ticketing, are being enhanced so that 1555 can gradually transition from a predominantly voice-centric model to a balanced service model, where more complex and sensitive cases remain with human service through the reinforcement of specialised representatives, while simpler cases are closed via self-service services and automation. Specifically, the use of AI solutions is provided for both citizens and representatives, such as IVRs and AI agents for intent recognition and routing to digital solutions or appropriate specialised representatives, agent assist tools that retrieve content from the knowledge base to reduce errors and handling time, as well as analytics to understand requests and better plan staffing. At the same time, interoperability at the infrastructure or service level with the Citizen Request Management System (CC ticketing) and the utilisation of data from ticketing and the knowledge base are being enhanced, with provision for continuous improvement through feedback and conversation analysis. The operation of specialised consultants will be expanded and enhanced so that citizens have even greater access to personalised information. Digital systems will be further upgraded and new ones introduced with the aim of enhancing service delivery. A team of experts will be able to carry out targeted studies on specific subject matters of the serviced bodies, and surveys may also be conducted to further strengthen the bodies through the project. The development and management of the project are organised into work packages as follows: I. Public communication and service structure II. Technical Infrastructures III. Satisfaction surveys and Quality Assurance IV. Strengthening of bodies on specific subject matters – special surveys V. Project management VI. Service training Upgrade and expansion of a multi-channel citizen service system 1555

parts.source: Αντικείμενο της σύμβασης είναι η αναβάθμιση και επέκταση του Πολυκαναλικού συστήματος ενημέρωσης και εξυπηρέτησης πολιτών 1555, το οποίο λειτουργεί από τη 1/10/2022, ως ενιαίος κόμβος εξυπηρέτησης πολιτών και επιχειρήσεων για θέματα αρμοδιότητας του Υπουργείου Εργασίας και Κοινωνικής Ασφάλισης και των εποπτευομένων φορέων του. Στο πλαίσιο της αναβάθμισης, ενισχύεται η ψηφιακή αρχιτεκτονική και τα λογισμικά υποσυστήματα, όπως η διαδικτυακή πύλη, η γνωσιακή βάση, λύσεις τεχνητής νοημοσύνης και το ticketing, ώστε το 1555 να μεταβεί σταδιακά από ένα κυρίως φωνοκεντρικό μοντέλο σε ένα ισορροπημένο μοντέλο εξυπηρέτησης, όπου οι πιο σύνθετες και ευαίσθητες υποθέσεις παραμένουν σε ανθρώπινη εξυπηρέτηση, με ενίσχυση εξειδικευμένων εκπροσώπων, ενώ, οι απλούστερες υποθέσεις κλείνουν μέσω self service υπηρεσιών και αυτοματισμών. Ειδικότερα, προβλέπεται αξιοποίηση λύσεων ΑΙ τόσο προς τον πολίτη, όσο και προς τον εκπρόσωπο, όπως IVR και ΑΙ agent για αναγνώριση προθέσεων και δρομολόγηση σε ψηφιακές λύσεις ή στους κατάλληλους εξειδικευμένους εκπροσώπους, εργαλεία agent assist που αντλούν περιεχόμενο από τη γνωσιακή βάση για μείωση λαθών και χρόνου χειρισμού, καθώς και analytics για κατανόηση αιτημάτων και καλύτερο σχεδιασμό στελέχωσης. Παράλληλα, ενισχύεται η διαλειτουργικότητα σε επίπεδο υποδομών ή και services με το Σύστημα Διαχείρισης Αιτημάτων Πολιτών (CC ticketing) και η αξιοποίηση δεδομένων από το ticketing και τη γνωσιακή βάση, με πρόβλεψη συνεχούς βελτίωσης μέσω ανατροφοδότησης και ανάλυσης συνομιλιών. Η λειτουργία των εξειδικευμένων συμβούλων θα επεκταθεί και θα ενισχυθεί, ώστε οι πολίτες να έχουν ακόμα μεγαλύτερη πρόσβαση σε προσωποποιημένη πληροφόρηση. Τα ψηφιακά συστήματα θα αναβαθμιστούν περαιτέρω και θα εισαχθούν και νέα, με στόχο την ενίσχυση της εξυπηρέτησης. Ομάδα εμπειρογνωμόνων θα μπορεί να πραγματοποιεί στοχευμένες μελέτες σε ειδική θεματολογία των εξυπηρετούμενων Φορέων, καθώς και θα μπορούν να πραγματοποιούνται έρευνες, ώστε να ενισχύονται περαιτέρω και οι Φορείς μέσα από το έργο. Η ανάπτυξη και η διαχείριση του έργου γίνεται σε πακέτα εργασίας ως ακολούθως : I. I. Δομή επικοινωνίας και εξυπηρέτησης κοινού II. Τεχνικές Υποδομές III. Έρευνες ικανοποίησης και Διασφάλιση ποιότητας IV. Ενίσχυση φορέων σε θεματολογία – ειδικές έρευνες V. Διαχείριση έργου VI. Εκπαίδευση στην εξυπηρέτηση Αναβάθμιση και επέκταση πολυκαναλικού συστήματος εξυπηρέτησης πολιτών 1555

result.text: The Home Office (HO) is the government department responsible for safeguarding the nation through border control, immigration, passport issuance, policing, fire services, counter-terrorism and drugs policies. UK Visas and Immigration (UKVI) plays an integral role in delivering this vision, managing millions of applications annually, enabling foreign nationals to visit, study, work or settle in the UK. As part of the evolution of existing services, UKVI pursues the transformation and modernisation of services in a manner that enhances customer experience and ensures accurate and efficient outcomes. One of the core services delivered by UKVI is the Life in the UK test, an essential component of the route to settlement in the UK and to UK citizenship. The Life in the UK Secure Digital Test and Digital Online Learning Materials Service (LITUK) Project is procuring a new service; enabling the continued delivery of front-end services, balancing continuity with improvements and transformation. LITUK aims to move to a 'Digital-by-Default' approach, while upholding the rigorous standards necessary to support UKVI immigration decisions. The successful provider will deliver a service that combines technological innovation with security assurance, enabling customers to demonstrate their knowledge of life in the UK with confidence and convenience throughout their UK immigration journey. The purpose of this second round of Preliminary Market Engagement is to gather insights from the market regarding the desired solution, which will inform and support Departmental decision-making processes. At this stage, no final decisions have been made regarding the preferred solution. Please Note: the content of this Preliminary Market Engagement Notice may be subject to change. Lot 1: . None

result.text: Oulun kaupunki requests tenders for the procurement of passenger counting devices for Oulu region transport and related installation, maintenance and support services. The subject of the procurement is the supply of passenger counting devices to be installed in the public transport fleet of Oulu region transport (OSL), as well as related installation, maintenance, support and reporting services. The procurement includes the collection, transfer and reporting of passenger count data for the contracting authority's use in accordance with the invitation to tender and contract documents. The objective is to produce reliable passenger data to support the planning, monitoring and development of public transport. In the first phase of the procurement, passenger counting devices will be installed in 40 three-door BYD electric buses of Oulu region transport. During the contract period, the contracting authority may expand the use of the system to other vehicles in accordance with the terms of the invitation to tender and the contract.

result.text: This Market Engagement seeks to identify options to enable procurement of a dedicated backup collection tool for Operational Technology (OT) environments. The solution will ensure that the complete data state of critical OT assets is consistently captured and securely stored across multiple sites, serving as the organisation's data of last resort. The tool must collect the full backup state of OT assets including configurations, control logic, firmware, hardware metadata, and associated files. It must support both automated, policy-driven backup collection and authorised manual backup initiation, operating through secure and non-intrusive protocols that do not interact with OT control or programming interfaces and have no impact on live operations or safety-critical systems. The solution must be vendor-agnostic, deployable fully on-premise or within a private cloud, and capable of operating in air-gapped environments, with full audit trails and compliance reporting. parts.source: This Market Engagement seeks to identify options to enable procurement of a dedicated backup collection tool for Operational Technology (OT) environments. The solution will ensure that the complete data state of critical OT assets is consistently captured and securely stored across multiple sites, serving as the organisation's data of last resort. The tool must collect the full backup state of OT assets including configurations, control logic, firmware, hardware metadata, and associated files. It must support both automated, policy-driven backup collection and authorised manual backup initiation, operating through secure and non-intrusive protocols that do not interact with OT control or programming interfaces and have no impact on live operations or safety-critical systems. The solution must be vendor-agnostic, deployable fully on-premise or within a private cloud, and capable of operating in air-gapped environments, with full audit trails and compliance reporting. result.text: The subject of this tender is the procurement of a central, high-performance, scalable and highly available backup infrastructure for Magdeburg University Hospital. The aim of the tender is to provide a future-proof and demand-oriented expandable central backup solution that enables reliable backup as well as fast and reliable recovery of the business-critical and medically relevant data and IT systems arising at Magdeburg University Hospital. The solution to be procured must take into account the requirements for secure, highly available and permanently available operation in a KRITIS-relevant environment and thus make a significant contribution to the operational safety, fail-safe operation and resilience of the IT infrastructure of Magdeburg University Hospital. The overall solution to be procured is to consist of four coordinated system components: • a high-performance all-flash backup appliance for processing large amounts of data and a high number of parallel backup and restore processes, • a highly available backup storage system as the primary backup target with integrated deduplication function, • a high-performance enterprise rack server as a Veeam backup server as well as • two appropriately dimensioned enterprise rack servers as Veeam backup proxies. The backup infrastructure is to be designed in such a way that it takes into account the existing and foreseeable future requirements of Magdeburg University Hospital. In addition to the delivery of the required hardware and software, including all components and licences required for intended operation, the scope of services also includes the professional installation, configuration and integration of the overall solution into the existing IT infrastructure of Magdeburg University Hospital. Furthermore, the scope of services includes the commissioning of the overall solution as well as the execution of the required functional, performance and acceptance tests. The contractor must provide a fully functional and ready-for-operation overall solution that complies with the requirements laid down in the specification of services and the schedule of services. All services are to be provided in compliance with the legal, regulatory and technical requirements applicable at the time of service provision as well as the relevant norms and standards. Lot LOT-0000: Central backup system. Procurement of a central, high-performance, scalable and highly available backup infrastructure for Magdeburg University Hospital. The specific functional requirements result from the schedule of services.

parts.source: Gegenstand dieser Ausschreibung ist die Beschaffung einer zentralen, leistungsfähigen, skalierbaren und hochverfügbaren Backup-Infrastruktur für das Universitätsklinikum Magdeburg. Ziel der Ausschreibung ist es, eine zukunftsfähige und bedarfsgerecht erweiterbare zentrale Backup-Lösung bereitzustellen, die eine zuverlässige Sicherung sowie eine schnelle und zuverlässige Wiederherstellung der im Universitätsklinikum Magdeburg anfallenden geschäftskritischen und medizinisch relevanten Daten und IT-Systeme ermöglicht. Die zu beschaffende Lösung soll den Anforderungen an einen sicheren, hochverfügbaren und dauerhaft verfügbaren Betrieb in einer KRITIS-relevanten Umgebung Rechnung tragen und damit einen wesentlichen Beitrag zur Betriebssicherheit, Ausfallsicherheit und Resilienz der IT-Infrastruktur des Universitätsklinikums Magdeburg leisten. Die zu beschaffende Gesamtlösung soll aus vier aufeinander abgestimmten Systemkomponenten bestehen: • eine hochperformante All-Flash-Backup-Appliance zur Verarbeitung großer Datenmengen sowie einer hohen Anzahl paralleler Backup- und Restore-Prozesse, • ein hochverfügbares Backup-Speichersystem als primäres Backup-Target mit integrierter Deduplizierungsfunktion, • einen leistungsfähigen Enterprise-Rack-Server als Veeam Backup Server sowie • zwei entsprechend dimensionierte Enterprise-Rack-Server als Veeam Backup Proxy Die Backup-Infrastruktur ist so auszulegen, dass sie den bestehenden und absehbaren zukünftigen Anforderungen des Universitätsklinikums Magdeburg Rechnung trägt. Der Leistungsumfang umfasst neben der Lieferung der erforderlichen Hard- und Software einschließlich sämtlicher für den bestimmungsgemäßen Betrieb erforderlicher Komponenten und Lizenzen auch die fachgerechte Installation, Konfiguration und Integration der Gesamtlösung in die bestehende IT-Infrastruktur des Universitätsklinikums Magdeburg. Weiterhin umfasst der Leistungsumfang die Inbetriebnahme der Gesamtlösung sowie die Durchführung der erforderlichen Funktions-, Leistungs- und Abnahmetests. Der Auftragnehmer hat eine vollständig funktionsfähige und betriebsbereite Gesamtlösung bereitzustellen, die den in der Leistungsbeschreibung und dem Leistungsverzeichnis festgelegten Anforderungen entspricht. Sämtliche Leistungen sind unter Beachtung der zum Zeitpunkt der Leistungserbringung geltenden gesetzlichen, regulatorischen und technischen Vorgaben sowie der einschlägigen Normen und Standards zu erbringen. Lot LOT-0000: Zentrales Backup-System. Beschaffung einer zentralen, leistungsfähigen, skalierbaren und hochverfügbaren Backup-Infrastruktur für das Universitätsklinikum Magdeburg. Die konkreten funktionalen Anforderungen ergeben sich aus dem Leistungsverzeichnis.

result.text: Gloucestershire ICB and Bristol, North Somerset and South Gloucestershire (BNSSG) ICB are merging to form a single integrated body in April 2027. Both organisations currently rely on external providers for the delivery of their IT services. A new, unified service model is required; one that supports the merged organisation from day one, is commercially sustainable, and is capable of evolving as the ICS matures. Six principles shape the design of the future service: 1. Cloud-first and 'secure by design'. All new and renewed services will be cloud-based wherever possible. On-premises infrastructure will be exited as part of transition. This is both a strategic choice and a compliance requirement under the Government Cloud First Policy and Technology Code of Practice. 2. Outcome-focused. The service is defined by what it must deliver, not how it must be delivered. The supplier is expected to bring expertise, innovation and accountability for outcomes, not simply execute a prescriptive technical specification. 3. Single point of accountability. The preferred model is a single managed service provider with end-to-end accountability for operational delivery. This avoids the fragmentation and unclear ownership that characterises the current multi-supplier landscape and reduces the management overhead on the ICB digital team. 4. Lean governance. The ICB digital team will provide strategic oversight, roadmap ownership and supplier governance. It will not carry operational delivery responsibilities. This reflects the lean, strategically focused character of the merged organisation and the direction set by the Model ICB Blueprint. 5. Interoperable by design. The service must integrate cleanly with nationally contracted NHS platforms, in particular NHS.net Connect, the Health and Social Care Network (HSCN) and NHS Secure Boundary Service, as well as local platforms, such as the Gloucestershire ICS WAN and into UHBW and Crown Datacentres in Corsham. Service interfaces with these platforms should be clearly defined before the procurement specification is finalised. 6. Sustainable. The ICB's carbon neutral commitments should be reflected in technology choices, including energy-efficient end-user devices, PoE-powered monitors and cloud-based infrastructure in preference to on-premises data centre equipment. The following service stacks are in scope for the new managed service, reflecting services currently provided across both incumbents, consolidated and extended to support the merged organisation: - Service desk. The primary user-facing support channel, available 08:00-18:00 Monday to Friday. - Desktop support. Onsite presence at both sites as and when required, including end-user support, moves, adds and changes to desktop arrangements, MFD, Audio Visual equipment, and Teams Room management. The onsite support model must include provision for routine physical tasks including WFH equipment management, peripheral replacement, cable and hardware swap-outs, and stock management. - End-user compute. Device lifecycle management including provisioning, refresh (five-year target cycle), configuration, and secure disposal. - Telephony and unified communications. Microsoft Teams Phone as the unified platform for the merged ICB. - Print. Cloud-managed secure print at both sites. - Meeting rooms. Physical teams Room management and audio-visual support at 2 locations with 15 meeting rooms at one and at Shire Hall, Gloucester and 9 at the second location. - Asset management. Asset tagging, recording, and lifecycle tracking for all ICB-owned IT equipment. - Supplier and procurement management. The supplier will assume management of all ongoing third-party technology relationships and will procure all IT equipment and recurring support contracts on behalf of the ICB. Licence management across the estate is required. - DSPT support. The supplier is expected to provide the ICB with the technical evidence and assurance data required to support annual DSPT submission, including patch management records, asset inventory, access control logs and incident reports. - Project, change and architecture. The supplier will own project and change management, problem management, and architecture design. - Digital signatures. Digital signature capability is required as part of the new service. Full details are provided in the service specification. The total maximum contract value for the initial 3-year Contract is £1,920,000 inclusive of VAT (where applicable). At the end of the initial contract term the Commissioner will have two, separate, consecutive one-year extension option periods that can be exercised at the discretion of the Commissioner, giving a maximum possible contract value of £2,700,000 inclusive of VAT (where applicable) over 5 years if the full contract term is fulfilled. The Commissioner is of the view that TUPE does not apply to this service. The Contracting Authority reserves the right to use the Direct Award procedure under the Procurement Act 2023 for any subsequent extensions or new contracts for similar requirements. The new contract will commence on 1st April 2027, although implementation of the services will start during January 2026. Lot 1: .

result.text: The City of Helsinki Urban Environment Division will establish a dynamic purchasing system within which comprehensive services for snow management solutions will be tendered. The dynamic purchasing system will remain valid until the end of 2033, unless the contracting entity shortens or extends the duration of the system. During the duration of the dynamic purchasing system, all interested candidates may submit a request for participation. The operation and scope of the dynamic purchasing system are described in more detail in the invitation to participate and its attachments. According to the preliminary estimate, dozens of procurements will be carried out within the dynamic purchasing system over the coming years. The total value of the procurements is estimated to be 65 000 000 EUR during the entire duration of the DPS for comprehensive service procurements. The dynamic purchasing system is designed to address procurement needs in the coming years, with a sufficient amount to achieve the objectives. This is an estimate, and the contracting authority is not committed to any specific procurement quantities. The number of procurements may be significantly lower than estimated if the objectives of the snow management system are met through other means. parts.source: Helsingin kaupungin kaupunkiympäristön toimiala perustaa dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän, jonka sisällä tullaan kilpailuttamaan lumenhallinnan ratkaisujen kokonaispalveluja. Dynaaminen hankintajärjestelmä on voimassa vuoden 2033 loppuun saakka, ellei hankintayksikkö lyhennä tai pidennä dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän kestoa. Dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän keston aikana kaikki kiinnostuneet ehdokkaat voivat tehdä siihen osallistumishakemuksen. Dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän toiminta ja kohde on kuvattu tarkemmin osallistumispyynnössä ja sen liitteissä. Alustavan arvion mukaan dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän sisällä toteutetaan kymmeniä hankintoja tulevien vuosien aikana. Hankintojen kokonaisarvo on koko kokonaispalveluhankintojen DPS:n voimassaolon aikana yhteensä arviolta 65 000 000 euroa. Dynaamisella hankintajärjestelmällä varaudutaan tulevien vuosien hankintatarpeisiin, joita toteutetaan tavoitteiden saavuttamiseksi riittävä määrä. Kyseessä on arvio, eikä tilaaja sitoudu mihinkään hankintamääriin. Hankintojen määrä voi olla merkittävästi arvioitua pienempi, mikäli lumenhallinnan kokonaisuuden tavoitteet täyttyvät muilla keinoin. result.text: Provision of a marketplace platform The advertised online portal is to be connected to SAP SRM as a catalogue via an interface based on the Open Catalog Interface (OCI) standard. In the intended process, the catalogue is called up by the user via a link from SAP SRM; it opens in a new browser window and is displayed there in a frame. In this catalogue, the user compiles a shopping basket from the required items. In the supplier's catalogue application, the user then completes the shopping basket after a verification step and initiates the transfer of the catalogue shopping basket to SAP SRM via the OCI interface. All items, quantities, and prices are transferred to the SRM shopping cart via the interface. The order is then completed by the user within the university according to a specified approval process and transmitted to the supplier. Direct order triggering from the supplier's online portal must not take place. The catalogue solution offered must therefore meet the conditions for connection from Appendix 5 "OCI Catalogue Performance Requirements" and for order transmission from Appendix 4 "IDOC Interface". SAP SRM is expected to be replaced by a successor product in the year 2026. Any necessary system adjustments to the marketplace connection will be supported by the contractor.

parts.source: Bereitstellung einer Marketplace-Plattform Das ausgeschriebene Online-Portal soll über eine Schnittstelle nach dem Open Catalog Interface (OCI)-Standard als Katalog an SAP SRM angebunden werden. Der Katalog wird im vorgesehenen Prozess über einen Link aus SAP SRM durch den Anwender aufgerufen, er öffnet sich in einem neuen Browserfenster und wird dort in einem Frame dargestellt. In diesem Katalog stellt der Anwender einen Warenkorb aus den benötigten Artikeln zusammen. In der Kataloganwendung des Lieferanten schließt der Anwender dann nach einem Prüfschritt den Warenkorb und stößt die Übertragung des Katalogwarenkorbs über die OCI-Schnittstelle an SAP SRM an. Über die Schnittstelle werden alle Artikel, Mengen und Preise in den SRM-Einkaufswagen übertragen. Die Bestellung wird dann durch den Anwender universitätsintern nach einem vorgegebenen Genehmigungsprozess abgeschlossen und an den Lieferanten übermittelt. Eine direkte Bestellauslösung aus dem Online-Portal des Lieferanten darf nicht erfolgen. Die angebotene Kataloglösung muss daher die Bedingungen für die Anbindung aus Anlage 5 "OCI-Katalog-Leistungsanforderungen" und für die Bestellübertragung aus Anlage 4 "IDOC-Schnittstelle" erfüllen. Das SAP SRM wird voraussichtlich im Jahr 2026 durch ein Nachfolgeprodukt ersetzt. Ggf. notwendige Systemanpassungen an der Marketplace-Anbindung werden vom Auftragnehmer begleitet.

result.text: Implementation of a heavy rainfall early warning system (SRFAS) for the City of Science Darmstadt. A functional heavy rainfall early warning system has already been established in the Fulda district, which is now to be implemented in the City of Science Darmstadt and optimised with regard to the integration of soil moisture sensor technology. The aim of the SRFAS is to develop an early warning system by deploying city-wide measurement sensors (including precipitation gauges, soil moisture sensors, sewer monitors) and using external data (including precipitation products from the German Meteorological Service), as a mandatory foundation for early or timely action by authorities, emergency services, and citizens. To estimate the required number of sensors and their location (including outside the Darmstadt municipal area), a study is to be conducted at the beginning. The SRFAS is intended to be a uniform overall system whose components are technically, functionally, and temporally linked to one another. Therefore, the contract is to be awarded as a total contract. It is based on an overall concept that is described in detail in the bill of quantities and must be fulfilled in its entirety. 1

parts.source: Implementierung eines Starkregenfrühalarmsystems (SRFAS) für die Wissenschaftsstadt Darmstadt Im Landkreis Fulda wurde bereits ein funktionsfähiges Starkregenfrühalarmsystem aufgebaut, das nun auch in der Wissenschaftsstadt Darmstadt implementiert und hinsichtlich Einbindung von Bodenfeuchtesensorik optimiert werden soll. Ziel des SRFAS ist es, durch Ausbringen einer stadtweiten Messsensorik (u.a. Niederschlagsmesser, Bodenfeuchtesensoren, Kanalwächter) und Nutzung externer Daten (u.a. Niederschlagsprodukte des Deutschen Wetterdienstes) ein Frühwarnsystem zu entwickeln, als zwingend notwendige Grundlage für ein früh- bzw. rechtzeitiges Handeln von Behörden, Einsatzkräften und Bürgerinnen und Bürgern. Zur Schätzung der benötigten Sensorenanzahl und deren Verortung (auch außerhalb der Gemarkung Darmstadts) soll zu Beginn eine Studie durchgeführt werden. Beim SRFAS soll es sich um ein einheitliches Gesamtsystem, dessen Bestandteile technisch, funktional und zeitlich miteinander verknüpft sind, handeln. Daher ist der Auftrag als Gesamtauftrag zu vergeben. Es basiert auf einem Gesamtkonzept, das im Leistungsverzeichnis detailliert beschrieben ist und in seiner Gesamtheit zu erfüllen ist. 1

result.text: This is not a contract notice or a call for tenders, but a request for information with which the contracting authority is conducting a market survey of potential tenderers and solutions available on the market for its procurement need. The information obtained through the market survey will be used in the preparation of the future procurement. Länsi-Uudenmaan hyvinvointialue (LUVN) has a need to procure technology to be taken home for the use of the wellbeing services county's residents, as well as an alarm system that receives the alarms produced by the aforementioned technology. Länsi-Uudenmaan hyvinvointialue is assembling and launching as its own operation a so-called Safety Assistance Service, the goal of which is to enable and support customers' independent coping in their own homes around the clock. A central element in the Safety Assistance Service is the technology utilised in it that is taken to homes or home-like services, and the receiving system for the alarms produced by them. With this request for information, LUVN wants to survey the technology solutions available on the market that are suitable for social and health care, that ensure the customer's safety at home, and solutions suitable for receiving alarms related to these. Länsi-Uudenmaan hyvinvointialue estimates that the procurement entity according to its needs will consist of the following parts, but changes may occur in the entity: - Technology installed at home for the customer's safety (e.g. sensors, detectors, wristbands) as well as their maintenance and backup device services - Safety alarm centre system and mobile software possibly related to it - Service implementation project - Continuous services, support, maintenance and service of the technology and alarm centre system - Expert services related to the aforementioned technology and its utilisation and use during the contract period according to the subscriber's need. To support the specification of its procurement needs, the planning of the procurement and the preparation of the tendering documents, Länsi-Uudenmaan hyvinvointialue wants to engage in a market dialogue with suppliers offering solutions corresponding to the procurement need. Through the market dialogue, the wellbeing services county hopes to receive information generally about solutions on the market corresponding to the object of the procurement. We are interested in your solutions and services related to safety technology supporting living at home and how the solutions direct alarms to the safety alarm receiving system and what features the receiving system includes. We also want to know what kind of information your system produces to support the planning of services offered to the customer for the professional, in addition to alarm information. Suppliers are requested to register for the market dialogue by email to the address: hankinta@luvn.fi Registration is requested to be sent by 3.10.2025 at 12. According to the wellbeing services county's plans, the market dialogue should include both discussion sessions and the exchange of written material, but the exact schedule of the dialogue will be specified later. parts.source: Tämä ei ole hankintailmoitus tai tarjouspyyntö, vaan tietopyyntö, jolla hankintayksikkö tekee markkinakartoitusta potentiaalisista tarjoajista ja markkinoilla olevista ratkaisuista hankintatarvettaan varten. Markkinakartoituksella saatuja tietoja käytetään tulevan hankinnan valmistelussa. Länsi-Uudenmaan hyvinvointialueella (LUVN) on tarve hankkia hyvinvointialueen asukkaiden käyttöön kotiin vietävää teknologiaa sekä hälytysjärjestelmä, joka ottaa vastaan em. teknologian tuottamia hälytyksiä. Länsi-Uudenmaan hyvinvointialue on kokoamassa ja käynnistämässä omana toimintana ns. Turva-auttamispalvelua, jonka tavoitteena on mahdollistaa ja tukea asiakkaiden itsenäistä selviytymistä omassa kodissaan ympäri vuorokauden. Keskeisenä elementtinä Turva-auttamispalvelussa on siinä hyödynnettävät kotiin tai kodinomaisiin palveluihin vietävä teknologia, ja niiden tuottamien hälytysten vastaanottojärjestelmä. LUVN haluaa tällä tietopyynnöllä kartoittaa markkinoilla olevia, sosiaali- ja terveydenhuoltoon soveltuvia, kotiin vietäviä asiakkaan turvaa varmistavia teknologiaratkaisuja ja näihin liittyvien hälytysten vastaanottoon soveltuvia ratkaisuja. Länsi-Uudenmaan hyvinvointialue arvioi tarpeidensa mukaisen hankintakokonaisuuden muodostuvan seuraavista osista, mutta kokonaisuudessa voi tapahtua muutoksia: - Asiakkaan turvaksi kotiin asennettava teknologia (esim. sensorit, anturit, rannekkeet) sekä näiden huolto- ja varalaitepalvelut - Turvahälytyskeskusjärjestelmä ja siihen mahdollisesti liittyvät mobiiliohjelmistot - Palvelun käyttöönottoprojekti - Teknologian ja hälytyskeskusjärjestelmän jatkuvat palvelut, tuki ja ylläpito ja huoltopalvelut - Sopimuksenaikaiset, edellä mainittuun teknologiaan ja sen hyödyntämiseen sekä käyttöön liittyvät asiantuntijapalvelut tilaajan tarpeen mukaan Hankintatarpeidensa täsmentämisen, hankinnan suunnittelun ja kilpailutusasiakirjojen laadinnan tueksi Länsi-Uudenmaan hyvinvointialue haluaa käydä markkinavuoropuhelua hankintatarvetta vastaavia ratkaisuja tarjoavien toimittajien kanssa. Markkinavuoropuhelulla hyvinvointialue toivoo saavansa tietoa yleisesti markkinoilla olevista hankinnan kohteen mukaisista ratkaisuista. Olemme kiinnostuneita ratkaisuistanne ja palveluistanne liittyen kotona asumista tukevaan turvateknologiaan ja siitä, miten ratkaisut ohjaavat hälytykset turvahälytysten vastaanottojärjestelmään ja mitä ominaisuuksia vastaanottojärjestelmä sisältää. Haluamme myös tietää, millaista tietoa järjestelmänne tuottaa ammattilaiselle asiakkaalle tarjottavien palvelujen suunnittelun tueksi hälytystiedon lisäksi. Toimittajia pyydetään ilmoittautumaan mukaan markkinavuoropuheluun sähköpostilla osoitteeseen: hankinta@luvn.fi Ilmoittautuminen pyydetään lähettämään 3.10.2025 klo 12 mennessä. Ilmoittautuminen tulee otsikoida seuraavasti: “Kodin turvapalvelulaitteet ja hälytysten vastaanottojärjestelmä” Sähköpostiviestin sisällöksi riittää toimittajan nimi sekä toimittajan yhteyshenkilön yhteystiedot. LUVN on yhteydessä mukaan ilmoittautuneiden toimittajien yhteyshenkilöihin sopiakseen markkinavuoropuhelun toteuttamisesta. Hyvinvointialueen suunnitelmien mukaan markkinavuoropuheluun tulisi sisältymään sekä keskustelutilaisuuksia että kirjallisen materiaalin vaihtoa, mutta täsmällinen vuoropuhelun aikataulu täsmentyy myöhemmin. Tilaaja varaa itselleen mahdollisuuden järjestää kirjallisen materiaalin kommentoinnin lisäksi kahdenkeskisiä markkinavuoropuhelukeskusteluja. Tilaaja varaa oikeuden valita sopivan määrän Toimittajia kahdenkeskisiin keskusteluihin kirjallisten vastauksien perusteella. Kahdenkeskisten keskustelujen ajankohdista sovitaan erikseen Toimittajien kanssa. Markkinakartoitusilmoitus ei velvoita hankintayksikköä toteuttamaan varsinaista hankintamenettelyä. Markkinakartoitusilmoituksessa esitetty hankinnan kuvaus ja hankintamenettelyn arvioitu aikataulu sekä muut tiedot ovat alustavia ja suuntaa-antavia ennakkotietoja. Yritysten vastaaminen tai vastaamatta jättäminen ei estä mahdolliseen hankintamenettelyyn osallistumista. Osallistumisesta ei makseta korvausta. Hankintayksikkö käsittelee ilmoittautuneiden yritysten antamia tietoja luottamuksellisesti, eikä yritysten nimiä tai muita tietoja ei julkaista.

Länsi-Uudenmaan hyvinvointialue is planning a tender process where the subject of the procurement is an HR system package for payroll, employment relationship management, personnel development, and travel and expense claim management, including an outsourced payroll service and a travel and expense claim service. The package also potentially includes a statutory archiving solution. The subject of the procurement also includes system implementation and commissioning, support and maintenance services, operational services, and further development services. Länsi-Uudenmaan hyvinvointialue’s payroll and travel and expense claim services are currently outsourced to Sarastia Oy. The services are managed in systems administered by the service provider, S365 HR and M2. S365 HR acts as the master data for personal information. Supervisors, employees and HR have access to the current HR system, which is currently used for employment lifecycle functions - HRD functions are not in use. The new system and service to be procured will support Länsi-Uusimaa’s desire to facilitate and lighten the administrative work of supervisors and to develop the HR system towards a more modern solution that includes HRD functions such as development discussions and the management of permits and qualifications. The goal is not only to select systems but also to build a functional and sustainable partnership with the supplier. The procurement tentatively includes, among other things, the following functionalities and features: - Outsourced payroll service, which will be implemented for all Länsi-Uudenmaan hyvinvointialue personnel, excluding social benefits. The service includes customer service for supervisors and employees. - Payroll system as part of the outsourced payroll service solution. - HR system, which acts as the client’s HR master and covers employment lifecycle management as well as HRD functions such as development discussions, management of permits and qualifications, and support for on-boarding and off-boarding processes. The system must have an electronic signature capability. - Travel and expense claim system, which will be implemented for all Länsi-Uudenmaan hyvinvointialue personnel. - Outsourced travel and expense claim service, which includes, among other things, customer service, weekly payments, and the handling of official reports. - Integrations with the subscriber’s other systems via interfaces. - Advanced automation technologies, which can be used to automate, for example, tasks related to supervisory work and the delivery of data to payroll. The procurement will be carried out using a competitive dialogue procedure. The preliminary procurement schedule is: - Publication of the contract notice by the end of September. - Participation applications by the end of October. - Selection of tenderers by the end of October. - Preliminary call for tenders and sending of invitations to negotiate in November. - Two rounds of negotiations, which will take place in weeks 48 and 50. - Final call for tenders in week 2-3/2026. - Procurement decision in March 2026. - Estimated start time for implementation April 2026. - Services and systems into production use 1.4.2027. Companies interested in the procurement are requested to register by 19.9.2025 at 12.00 to the address: hankinta@luvn.fi. The registration must be titled as follows: “HR kokonaisratkaisun hankinta” (Procurement of HR overall solution). result.text: Ambient Voice Technology (AVT) for Berkshire Healthcare NHS Foundation Trust Lot 1: . Berkshire Healthcare NHS Foundation Trust is seeking to procure an Ambient Voice Technology (AVT) solution to support clinical documentation across a range of services and care settings. The solution should enable clinicians to capture consultations and generate structured clinical outputs including but not limited to documentation, clinical record notes, summaries, and correspondence, while integrating seamlessly into existing clinical workflows and digital systems. The aim is to reduce administrative burden and support more meaningful patient interactions, improving the overall patient experience through more engaged consultations, higher quality documentation, reduced errors, improved continuity of care, and shorter turnaround times for clinic letters and updates. It should also enable clinicians to spend more time focusing on the patient, while maintaining high standards of clinical safety, transparency, and documentation quality. The solution must support use across a range of real-world clinical environments, including inpatient wards, outpatient clinics, and community settings, where factors such as background noise, shared spaces, and variable connectivity may impact performance. The solution must also support consultations involving third parties (e.g. carers, family members, or interpreters), ensuring accurate capture, speaker differentiation, and appropriate inclusion within the output. The contract will be for 2 years with optional extensions for two more years. The procurement will be undertaken using the Artificial Intelligence Dynamic Purchasing System (DPS) RM6200. If you wish to register on this DPS you can find out how to do so here: https://supplierregistration.cabinetoffice.gov.uk/dps/RM6200?nav=0 Please note that all bidders for this requirement must be certified under NHS England's Ambient Voice Technology Self-Certified Supplier Registry. Details can be found here: https://digital.nhs.uk/services/ambient-scribing/ambient-voice-technology-self-certified-supplier-registry. Additional information: Berkshire Healthcare NHS Foundation Trust intends to create a DPS supplier shortlist on 13th October 2026 with the intention of issuing a capability assessment on 14th October 2026, to be returned by 21st October 2026. The intention is for the tender documents to be issued on 10th November 2026 to those bidders who have met the capability assessment requirements. Berkshire Healthcare reserves the right to amend these dates.

result.text: The Scottish Government’s Directorate for Digital is seeking an innovative service management solution to support a growing portfolio of digital services, including ScotAccount, ScotPayments, mygov.scot, Cloud Platform Services, and more. As demand, complexity and user expectations increase, we require scalable, technology-enabled approaches that can grow as our services grow, while delivering value for money. A successful solution will help ensure resilient, secure and efficient service operations, reducing risks to service quality, productivity, revenue and public trust, while supporting the future development of Scotland’s digital public services. Lot 1: . CivTech’s mission is to drive daring and innovation in the public sector by collaboratively solving Challenges that make people’s lives better – and in doing so create generations of sustainable, high growth businesses. CivTech brings together public sector expertise and private sector innovation to solve real problems, develop new products, and deliver better, faster and easier services for everyone. Central to the approach is co-production with the citizen. Part of the Scottish Government’s Directorate for Digital, CivTech’s approach is helping transform public sector engagement with tech and innovation, delivering significant benefits to public services, producing genuine uplifts for the Scottish economy - and along the way, making lives better. Across the country there are problems public sector organisations would like to solve and in the current environment the need for smart, efficient and effective products has never been greater. The Scottish Government is aware innovation is a good way to create them and is committed to ensuring a large part of its tech spend goes to innovative businesses - whatever stage they’re at, or size they are. This is where CivTech comes in. The CivTech Innovation Flow is designed to create products as quickly and effectively as possible, and uses a true Accelerator model at the heart of its Innovation Flow model. For you – whether you’re an individual, team or company – it’s an opportunity to take on a Challenge, solve it, and win contracts with a blue-chip public sector organisation. You’ll build a product, and a business to take it as far as possible. Because here’s the kicker: the Challenges we issue aren’t ‘single organisation’ problems – most of the problems we are solving exist worldwide. In short: Open Challenges are set. Any organisation, team or individual can respond. Applications are assessed, and shortlisted proposals go into an Exploration Stage where they’re developed further together with the Challenge Sponsor and the CivTech [for which participating applicants are paid]. The best go through to the Accelerator – a period of intensive work to create the solution, and through CivTech’s unique business growth workshop system, a business capable of taking the product to the world. Please visit our website for information on CivTech and how to get involved https://www.civtech.scot/how-to-apply-civtech-12 https://www.civtech.scot/civtech-12-challenge-2-scaling-dynamically-service-management-capabilities

result.text: This is not a procurement notice or a request for tenders, but a market survey and request for information. The National ID forum (informal forum) has decided to organize a joint RFI event. The idea is to organize a single RFI involving several national agencies and ministries, which would maximize synergy benefits and be a cost-effective model. The ID Forum is a national informal cooperation forum that focuses on comprehensive identity management, its development, and creating a situational picture. The aim is to produce national services that develop capacity in identity management, coordinate training and information events, and improve the common situational awareness and ability to combat abuse. Identity is therefore at the heart of the forum and is dealt with within the remit of each member organization. The ID Forum consists of several Finnish agencies and ministries; Immigration Service (FIS), Border Guard Force (BGF), National Bureau of Investigations (NBI), National Police Board (NPB), Police departments, Customs, and Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MoFA). The subject of the RFI and information about the procedure are described in more detail in Appendix 1.

rejected.text: This is a prior information notice regarding a future procurement and an invitation to an information session concerning the procurement. This is not a contract notice or a call for tenders. Fintraffic Raide Oy (the "contracting authority") is preparing a dynamic purchasing system (DPS) for expert services for rail traffic control application development. The dynamic purchasing system is planned to be established during the end of 2025, and the first procurements within the DPS will be tendered in January 2026. The non-binding estimated value excluding VAT for the 15-year duration of the dynamic purchasing system is approximately 70 million euros. The contracting authority will organise an information session regarding the dynamic purchasing system to be established on Tuesday 25.11.2025 starting at 14:00. The duration of the session is approximately 2 hours. The contracting authority requests interested operators to register for the information session concerning the procurement in the Lyyti system at the address https://www.lyyti.fi/questions/997850cec4. We will send a calendar invitation with links to those who have registered by the morning of the event day at the latest. In the information session, the contracting authority will explain the objectives and content of the dynamic purchasing system to be established, as well as the procurement plan for procurements within the purchasing system. The information session is open to all interested operators. The session will not be recorded. The language of the session is Finnish. The presentation material for the information session will be published openly available after the session at a web address to be announced separately. A summary of the content of the information session will also be published in English after the session. The contracting authority reserves the right to conduct bilateral market dialogue with selected operators after the information session. The contracting authority may also organise a separate technical dialogue, in which it requests selected operators to comment on the preparatory material concerning the procurement before the publication of the actual contract notice. The contracting authority will not pay any compensation to operators for participating in the information session, market dialogue or technical dialogue.

parts.source: Tämä on ennakkoilmoitus tulevasta hankinnasta sekä kutsu hankintaa koskevaan infotilaisuuteen. Kyseessä ei ole hankintailmoitus tai tarjouspyyntö. Fintraffic Raide Oy:n ("hankintayksikkö") valmistelee raideliikenteenohjauksen sovelluskehityksen asiantuntijapalveluiden dynaamista hankintajärjestelmää (DPS). Dynaaminen hankintajärjestelmä on suunniteltu perustettavaksi loppuvuoden 2025 aikana, ja ensimmäiset DPS:n sisäiset hankinnat tullaan kilpailuttamaan tammikuussa 2026. Sitoumukseton ennakoitu arvonlisäveroton arvo 15 vuoden kestoiselle dynaamiselle hankintajärjestelmälle on n. 70 miljoonaa euroa. Hankintayksikkö järjestää perustettavaa dynaamista hankintajärjestelmää koskevan infotilaisuuden tiistaina 25.11.2025 klo 14:00 alkaen. Tilaisuuden kesto on noin 2 tuntia. Hankintayksikkö pyytää kiinnostuneita toimijoita ilmoittautumaan hankintaa koskevaan infotilaisuuteen Lyyti-järjestelmässä osoitteessa https://www.lyyti.fi/questions/997850cec4. Lähetämme kalenterikutsun linkkeineen ilmoittautuneille viimeistään tapahtumapäivän aamuna. Infotilaisuudessa hankintayksikkö kertoo perustettavan dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän tavoitteista, sisällöstä sekä hankintajärjestelmän sisäisten hankintojen hankintasuunnitelmasta. Infotilaisuus on avoin kaikille kiinnostuneille toimijoille. Tilaisuutta ei tallenneta. Tilaisuuden kieli on suomi. Infotilaisuuden esitysmateriaali julkaistaan avoimesti saataville tilaisuuden jälkeen erikseen ilmoitettavaan verkko-osoitteeseen. Tiivistelmä infotilaisuuden sisällöstä julkaistaan tilaisuuden jälkeen myös englannin kielellä. Hankintayksikkö pidättää itsellään oikeuden käydä infotilaisuuden jälkeen kahdenvälistä markkinavuoropuhelua valitsemiensa toimijoiden kanssa. Hankintayksikkö voi lisäksi järjestää erillisen teknisen vuoropuhelun, jossa se pyytää valitsemiaan toimijoita kommentoimaan hankintaa koskevaa valmistelumateriaalia ennen varsinaisen hankintailmoituksen julkaisemista. Hankintayksikkö ei maksa toimijoille mitään korvausta infotilaisuuteen, markkinavuoropuheluun tai tekniseen vuoropuheluun osallistumisesta.

result.text: Walk Wheel Cycle Trust wishes to commission an area-wide residents' travel behaviour and attitude "push-to-online" survey in up to 16 areas across the UK. The survey will gather data related to travel behaviour, satisfaction and attitudes about a range of issues related to walking, wheeling, cycling and public transport in their area among a representative sample of residents. The successful contractor will design a research methodology and questionnaire tools compatible with the previous methodology and questionnaire, conduct the survey fieldwork, clean and analyse the data and return specified outputs to Walk Wheel Cycle Trust for further analysis and modelling. Walk Wheel Cycle Trust intends to commission for one iteration of fieldwork in 2027. Surveys to take place in 16 areas across the UK. Each survey to secure at least 1,100 respondents. Please see Invitation to Tender for further details. Note that we are procuring for a single supplier framework, and there may be variations in the number of areas. Total value maximum of £675,000 for the core costs of the contract, based on the number of areas above. Note that the same opportunity will be published on Public Contracts Scotland, Sell2Wales and Find a Tender. Full instructions on how the bids can be submitted can be seen in the Invitation to Tender document.

parts.source: Tämä on tietopyyntö, joka ei ole hankintailmoitus tai tarjouspyyntö. Tietopyynnön tarkoituksena on kerätä hankinnan kohdetta koskevaa tietoa tulevaa kilpailutusta varten. Tietopyyntöön vastaaminen ei ole edellytys mahdolliseen myöhempään kilpailutukseen osallistumiselle. Tulevan kilpailutuksen onnistumisen varmistamiseksi olisi kuitenkin tärkeää, että potentiaaliset tarjoajat antaisivat hankintayksikölle mahdollisimman laajasti pyydettyjä tietoja. Tietopyyntö ei velvoita Istekki Oy:tä toteuttamaan hankintaa tietopyynnössä tai sen liitteissä kuvatulla tavalla ja tarjouskilpailu voidaan myös jättää toteuttamatta. Tämän tietopyynnön kohteena on avainkaapit ja järjestelmä, joka mahdollistaa fyysisten avainten ja muiden luovutettavien esineiden hallintaa, luovutuksien hallinnointia sekä avainkaappiratkaisuiden keskitettyä hallintaa. Tarkoituksena on kartoittaa järjestelmiin liittyvää kyvykkyyttä, lisäpalvelujen markkinatilannetta, tuotteita, sopimusehtoja ja toimittajien hinnoittelua. Pyydämme vastausta esittämiimme kysymyksiin, jotka ovat tämän tietopyynnön liitteessä "Tietopyyntö ja kysymykset". Hankinnan kohteena on avainkaapit, sekä järjestelmäkokonaisuus, joka mahdollistaa fyysisten avainten ja muiden esineiden hallinnan, luovutusten hallinnan ja arkistoinnin sekä avainkaappiratkaisujen keskitetyn hallinnan. Tietopyyntöön tulee vastata viimeistään 6.11.2025 klo 23.59 mennessä sähköpostitse osoitteeseen hankinnat@istekki.fi. Annetut tiedot käsitellään luottamuksellisesti. Tietopyyntövastauksessa pyydetään ystävällisesti ilmoittamaan halukkuudesta osallistua markkinavuoropuhelutapaamiseen. Saatujen vastausten perusteella Istekki valitsee oman harkintansa mukaan 1-5 Tarjoajaa esittelemään laitteita ja palveluitaan noin tunnin tapaamisessa Teamsin välityksellä. Tarkemmat tiedot vastaamisesta ja markkinavuoropuhelusta, sekä alustavat ajankohdat tapaamisille on ilmoitettu liitteessä "Tietopyyntö ja kysymykset" Tietopyyntöön vastanneille ei makseta korvausta tietopyynnön tekemisestä tai mahdollisiin tietopyyntöön liittyviin esittelytilaisuuksiin osallistumisesta. Tarjouspalvelu luo automaattisesti määräajat kysymysten jätölle ja tietopyyntöön vastaamiselle. Kyseisten määräaikojen sijaan noudatetaan tietopyyntöasiakirjan määräaikoja. Mahdolliset lisätietokysymykset tulee lähtökohtaisesti esittää osana tietopyyntövastauksia. Hankintayksikkö ei julkaise tietopyyntövaiheessa jätettyjä lisätietokysymyksiä.
