result.text: Award of services for the implementation of the Frankfurt Founders' Fund. We are looking for a contractor to take over the central management of the Frankfurt Founders' Fund and the numerous associated tasks. Background: The Founders' Fund, operated by Wirtschaftsförderung Frankfurt on behalf of the City of Frankfurt, has been a cornerstone of Frankfurt's start-up support since its introduction in 2010. The Frankfurt Founders' Fund has since established itself and is now an integral part of the start-up activities of the City of Frankfurt am Main, Wirtschaftsförderung Frankfurt and the Frankfurt-Rhine-Main ecosystem. In 2009, the foundation stone for the Frankfurt Founders' Fund was laid. The microfinance study commissioned at that time revealed that young companies were facing a financing gap for credit requirements. On this basis, the Frankfurt Founders' Fund was launched. The Frankfurt Founders' Fund project is currently being operated by an external contractor (hereinafter referred to as the Contractor) and is the responsibility of Wirtschaftsförderung Frankfurt GmbH as the contracting authority (hereinafter referred to as the Contracting Authority). In addition, professional administration is necessary to ensure transparency, efficiency and sustainability. The Contractor, who is commissioned with the administration and implementation of the fund, must therefore have sound experience in the field of start-up financing, project and portfolio management and, ideally, in working with public institutions. Furthermore, knowledge of risk management, supporting founders and developing suitable monitoring and evaluation instruments is required. The Contractor will work closely with the Bürgschaftsbank Hessen and partner banks and offer founders a proven financing and coaching model. An essential part of the success model is not just the financial support for start-ups, for which Wirtschaftsförderung Frankfurt assumes 80 % of the guarantee, but also extensive support included in the Founders' Fund programme in the form of coaching by the Contractor throughout the entire loan term. In summary, the Contracting Authority expects the following services from the new Contractor: - Organisational services - Information and enquiry management - Review and processing of financing enquiries - Support/accompaniment of financing projects - Measures for loan defaults, early warning system - Debt collection and processing - Reporting and monitoring - Marketing/communication - Cooperation and community network maintenance

parts.source: Vergabe von Dienstleistungen zur Umsetzung des Frankfurter Gründerfonds Gesucht wird ein Auftragnehmer der die zentrale Federführung des Frankfurter Gründerfonds übernimmt und die zahlreichen damit einhergehenden Aufgaben. Zum Hintergrund: Der von der Wirtschaftsförderung Frankfurt im Auftrag der Stadt Frankfurt betriebene Gründerfonds ist seit seiner Einführung im Jahr 2010 eine tragende Säule der Frankfurter Gründungsförderung. Der Frankfurter Gründerfonds hat sich seitdem etabliert und ist nun ein fester Bestandteil der Gründungs- und Startup-Aktivitäten der Stadt Frankfurt am Main, der Wirtschaftsförderung Frankfurt und des Ökosystems Frankfurt-Rhein-Main. Im Jahr 2009 wurde der Grundstein für den Frankfurter Gründerfonds gelegt. Die damals in Auftrag gegebene Mikrofinanzstudie ergab, dass junge Unternehmen mit einer Finanzierungslücke für Kreditbedarfe konfrontiert waren. Auf dieser Basis wurde der Frankfurter Gründerfonds ins Leben gerufen. Das Projekt Frankfurter Gründerfonds wird aktuell operativ von einem externen Auftragnehmer (nachfolgend AN) ausgeführt und von der Wirtschaftsförderung Frankfurt GmbH als Auftraggeber (nachfolgend AG) verantwortet. Zudem ist eine professionelle Verwaltung notwendig, um Transparenz, Effizienz und Nachhaltigkeit sicherzustellen. Der AN, der mit der Verwaltung und Umsetzung des Fonds beauftragt wird, muss daher über fundierte Erfahrung im Bereich Anschubfinanzierung, Projekt- und Portfoliomanagement und im Idealfall in der Zusammenarbeit mit öffentlichen Institutionen verfügen. Weiterhin sind Kenntnisse im Risikomanagement, in der Begleitung von Gründerinnen und Gründern sowie in der Entwicklung geeigneter Monitoring- und Evaluationsinstrumente erforderlich. Der AN wird eng mit der Bürgschaftsbank Hessen sowie Kooperationsbanken zusammenarbeiten und Gründerinnen und Gründern ein bewährtes Finanzierungs- und Coachingmodell bieten. result.text: UPDATED NOTICE - PLEASE READ: April 6, 2023 EDA is excited to announce the launch of its new grants management platform: the Economic Development Grants Experience (EDGE). EDGE was developed to streamline the application and grants management process by implementing a single platform with increased transparency, improved user experience, higher data quality, and more efficiency throughout the entire grant lifecycle. As of April 6th, 2023, applications can no longer be submitted on Grants.gov, and will ONLY be accepted through EDGE. To apply in EDGE, please go to: sfgrants.eda.gov. More information on how to apply is provided in the full NOFO. PARTNERSHIP PLANNING program instructions: Please note that applicants will be invited to submit applications through EDGE for the Partnership Planning program. For more information, please reach out to your EDA point of contact. Program Description: EDA makes planning and local technical assistance investments to support economic development, foster job creation, and attract private investment in economically distressed areas of the United States. Under the Planning program, EDA makes Partnership Planning, Short-Term Planning, and State Planning awards to eligible recipients to create and implement regional economic development plans designed to build capacity and guide the economic prosperity and resiliency of an area or region. More specifically, EDA makes Partnership Planning investments to designated planning organizations (i.e., District Organizations) serving EDA-designated Economic Development Districts and to Indian Tribes to facilitate the development, implementation, revision, or replacement of Comprehensive Economic Development Strategies (CEDS), which articulate and prioritize the strategic economic goals of recipients’ respective regions. EDA also makes Short-Term and State Planning awards for economic development planning activities that guide the eventual creation and retention of high-quality jobs, particularly for the unemployed and underemployed in the Nation’s most economically distressed regions. Under the Local Technical Assistance program, EDA makes awards to strengthen the capacity of local or State organizations, institutions of higher education, and other eligible entities to undertake and promote effective economic development programs through projects such as feasibility studies, impact analyses, disaster resiliency plans, and project planning. **Please note: While the published Notice of Funding Opportunity (available under "Related Documents") states that the ED900A form and the SF424B form are both required for a complete application, these forms are no longer required and have therefore been removed from the package template.

result.text: The Cairngorm National Park Authority (CNPA) Peatland ACTION team are commissioning pre-application surveys and protected species surveys for planned peatland restoration projects within its operational area. Pre-application surveys are used to quantify the peat resource where the restoration is to take place, determine eligibility for grant funding, and inform design of the restoration works. The surveys will also provide baseline data for future monitoring of restoration outcomes and habitat condition. The data derived from the surveys and subsequent design work may be used by the landowner or their representatives for the purposes of Peatland Code registration. Protected species surveys are required to provide data to inform restoration design and identify potential ecological constraints. Detailed methodologies are provided for both survey types alongside this SOR. Lot 1: . The detailed schedule relates to the site(s), listed in the table 1 in the tender documents. Where multiple sites are listed consultants can bid for individual Lots or all Lots. If an individual Lot is bid for, all surveys and sites listed under that that Lot must be included in the bid. High resolution maps will be available for surveyors with spatial data including site outlines and grid survey points where applicable (100m, HIA and 50m). There are hill tracks that access most of the survey areas however the survey will involve covering large areas of exposed, upland terrain off-road. Estate staff need to be contacted prior to the survey to arrange specific dates for access and to confirm any constraints present for each survey area. Contacts will be available from the CNPA following the contract award.

result.text: The Danish Agency for Digital Government (Digitaliseringsstyrelsen) operates on behalf of the Danish State a national qualified trust service for the management of qualified electronic signature creation devices under Regulation (EU) No 910/2014 as amended by Regulation (EU) 2024/1183 (eIDAS2). As part of securing and modernising the signing service to meet the requirements of eIDAS2, the Agency is procuring Data Diode solutions to be installed and operated within the Agency's data centres (currently two). The Contract includes an Option to extend the deployment to a third data centre and an Option to extend the Contract and replace the Data Diode Hardware. The Contract covers the Initial Delivery of certified Data Diode appliances, comprising dedicated Hardware and associated Software, certified in accordance with Common Criteria or EUCC at EAL4 or higher. The Initial Delivery includes all Licences, Documentation, and support necessary for the Agency to install and operate the Data Diode solutions as part of its trust service infrastructure. The Data Diode solutions must provide one way traffic from the Agency's isolated Root CA environment to other network zones, while preventing any data transfer in the reverse direction. The solutions must support integration with the Agency's existing infrastructure and the required protocols for transfer of files, time information, monitoring and logging data. The Supplier's principal obligations comprise: (a) the Initial Delivery of four Data Diode appliances for deployment across the Agency's production and staging environments in two data centers, together with the required Standard Software and deployment in the Agency's test and development environments; (b) Ongoing Services, including support and maintenance of the Standard Software and Hardware, security patching, product lifecycle management and hardware replacement; and (c)Ordered Services, comprising Time-Based Services (services for installation, configuration, key ceremonies, and similar tasks) and Options; and (d) Cross-cutting Services, comprising Documentation and security, provided as an integral part of the Ongoing Services and Ordered Services throughout the term of the Contract.

rejected.text: Udbuddet vedrører indkøb af en AI Mammografiløsning til henholdsvis Region Syddanmark og Region Midtjylland. Der er tale om et IT-system. For så vidt angår Region Midtjylland, er der alene tale om en option. Region Midtjylland kan således vælge eller undlade at udnytte optionen på indkøb af en AI Mammografiløsning. Som følge af et øget befolkningstal og stigende gennemsnitlig alder i befolkningen ses en stigning i forekomsten af brystkræft i Danmark. Der forventes en stigning fra ca. 4.800 i 2024 til ca. 5310 tilfælde af brystkræft i 2028. Tidlig opsporing med brystkræftscreening og behandling efter bedste praksis anses som afgørende elementer for at reducere brystkræftrelateret dødelighed og sygelighed hos kvinder. Screeningsprogrammet for brystkræft i Region Syddanmark foretager årligt ca. 70.000 screeninger. Derudover gennemføres der årligt ca. 17.000 kliniske mammografiundersøgelser. Det forventes, at ca. 10% af de kliniske mammografiundersøgelser udføres som tomosyntese. For Region Midtjyllands vedkommende bliver der årligt foretaget ca. 65.000 screeninger og ca. 15.000 kliniske mammografiundersøgelser. Hver screeningsundersøgelse består af 4 røntgenbilleder, 2 standardprojektioner pr. bryst. I tilfælde af tidligere brystkræft og brystbevarende operation suppleres med en 3. projektion. I dag bliver hver enkelt røntgenbillede gransket af to uafhængige mammaradiologer. Hvis der er uenighed, gennemgås billederne ved en 3. granskning. Der opleves generelt en stigende efterspørgsel på mammadiagnostik. Bl.a. henvises et stigende antal patienter til udredning i pakkeforløb for brystkræft som følge af en øgning i screeningspopulationen samt nye udrednings- og behandlingsmuligheder. Samtidig med det stigende behov for mammografiundersøgelser er der en landsdækkende udfordring med mangel på mammaradiologer. Kunstig intelligens (AI) løsninger baseret på deep learning-teknikken har i de seneste år vist store fremskridt inden for medicinsk billedanalyse, særlig med hensyn til påvisning af brystkræft på mammografier. Den udbudte AI-løsning skal implementeres på Region Syddanmarks fire sygehusenheder (Odense Universitetshospital. Sygehus Lillebælt, Sygehus Sønderjylland og Esbjerg/Grindsted Sygehus), der foretager mammografiundersøgelser. Formålet med anskaffelsen af en AI Mammografiløsning er dermed • at sikre at de nationale krav til brystkræftscreening kan opretholdes fremadrettet, og • at frigøre mammaradiolog-ressourcer til andre opgaver i forbindelse med opsporing af brystkræft. Løsningen skal således kunne aflaste ’1. granskeren’ i mammografi screeningsprogrammet samt yde beslutningsstøtte i den kliniske mammografi. Såfremt Region Midtjylland måtte udnytte optionen, vil løsningen hos Region Midtjylland skulle installeres på følgende sygehusenheder: Aarhus Universitetshospital, Regionshospitalet Viborg og Regionshospitalet Randers. Udbuddet omfatter overordnet følgende delydelser: • Selve AI-løsningen • Installation, opsætning, drift og kalibrering af systemet • Uddannelse af radiologer, systemforvaltning og driftspersonale • Vedligeholdelse og support af AI-løsningen Som en del af den udbudte Kontrakt udbydes endvidere følgende optioner for Ordregiver: • Mulighed for anvendelse af AI-løsningen i klinisk mammografi • Understøttelse af tomosyntese (3D) i mammografiscreening • Køb af yderligere screeninger jf. Bilag 3 For så vidt angår optioner henvises yderligere til Udkast til Kontrakt, pkt. 8, samt Bilag 2 og 3. Kontrakten, herunder Kravspecifikationen jf. Bilagene 1, 2 og 8, indeholder en uddybende beskrivelse af de udbudte produkter. Overtagelsesprøve i Region Syddanmark forventes godkendt primo juni 2026.

result.text: The tender concerns the procurement of an AI mammography solution for the Region of Southern Denmark and the Central Denmark Region, respectively. This is an IT system. As far as the Central Denmark Region is concerned, this is an option only. The Central Denmark Region may therefore choose to exercise or refrain from exercising the option to purchase an AI mammography solution. As a result of an increased population and an increasing average age in the population, an increase in the incidence of breast cancer is being seen in Denmark. An increase is expected from approx. 4.800 in 2024 to approx. 5310 cases of breast cancer in 2028. Early detection through breast cancer screening and best-practice treatment are considered crucial elements for reducing breast cancer-related mortality and morbidity in women. The breast cancer screening programme in the Region of Southern Denmark performs approx. 70.000 screenings annually. In addition, approx. 17.000 clinical mammography examinations are carried out annually. It is expected that approx. 10% of the clinical mammography examinations will be performed as tomosynthesis. For the Central Denmark Region, approx. 65.000 screenings and approx. 15.000 clinical mammography examinations are performed annually. Each screening examination consists of 4 X-ray images, 2 standard projections per breast. In cases of previous breast cancer and breast-conserving surgery, this is supplemented with a 3. projection. Today, each individual X-ray image is examined by two independent breast radiologists. If there is disagreement, the images are reviewed by a 3. examination. There is generally an increasing demand for breast diagnostics. Among other things, an increasing number of patients are being referred for investigation in fast-track breast cancer pathways as a result of an increase in the screening population as well as new investigation and treatment options. At the same time as the increasing need for mammography examinations, there is a nationwide challenge with a shortage of breast radiologists. Artificial intelligence (AI) solutions based on deep learning technology have in recent years shown great progress within medical image analysis, particularly with regard to the detection of breast cancer on mammograms. The tendered AI solution must be implemented at the Region of Southern Denmark's four hospital units (Odense University Hospital, Hospital Lillebælt, Hospital Sønderjylland and Esbjerg/Grindsted Hospital), which perform mammography examinations. The purpose of the acquisition of an AI mammography solution is therefore • to ensure that the national requirements for breast cancer screening can be maintained in the future, and • to free up breast radiologist resources for other tasks in connection with the detection of breast cancer. The solution must thus be able to relieve the "1. examiner" in the mammography screening programme as well as provide decision support in clinical mammography. Should the Central Denmark Region exercise the option, the solution for the Central Denmark Region will need to be installed at the following hospital units: Aarhus University Hospital, Regional Hospital Viborg and Regional Hospital Randers. The tender generally includes the following sub-services: • The AI solution itself • Installation, setup, operation and calibration of the system • Training of radiologists, system management and operating personnel • Maintenance and support of the AI solution As part of the tendered Contract, the following options are also offered for the Contracting Authority: • Possibility of using the AI solution in clinical mammography • Support for tomosynthesis (3D) in mammography screening • Purchase of additional screenings cf. Annex 3 Regarding options, reference is further made to the Draft Contract, clause 8, as well as Annex 2 and 3. The contract, including the Requirements Specification cf. Annexes 1, 2 and 8, contains a detailed description of the tendered products. The acceptance test in the Region of Southern Denmark is expected to be approved in early June 2026.

result.text: Migration of the OpenScape Voice telecommunications system including applications The contracting authority is tendering the procurement of server hardware, hypervisor, storage (vSAN), network switches and the execution of the software update of OpenScape Voice V10 to the current release V11 including all connected applications. As part of the migration, the VMware hypervisor is to be replaced with Proxmox. Since the existing OpenScape Contact Center cannot be virtualised on Proxmox and is no longer being further developed by the manufacturer Mitel, the migration is to take place to the Mitel CX Contact Center. In addition, the maintenance of the system including software maintenance is to be taken over. result.text: The subject of the tender is the conclusion of a framework agreement for the development and provision of a modular kit system for elements of mobility stations in the area of the city and district of Heilbronn. The aim is the standardisation and unification of the stations - particularly with regard to design, equipment and digital accessibility. The framework agreement enables those entitled to order - the city and district of Heilbronn, the 46 municipalities in the district, the municipal utilities of Heilbronn or other municipal self-governing operations - to call off individual modules as needed at their own expense on the basis of individual contracts. The elements tendered include signposting and information signage, secure bicycle parking facilities with a digital access, booking and payment system, passenger and bicycle shelters, and street furniture.

result.text: Spark DPS Buy emerging technology products and services, including Internet of Things (IoT), AI and automation, simulated environments, wearables and new improvements in security. Description Spark: the Technology Innovation Marketplace can help government and public sector to access new and emerging technology products. This dynamic purchasing system (DPS) uses a filter system that helps customers find suppliers. The filter system includes defined technology areas developed with customer input. It focuses on emerging technologies predicted to have the largest impact over the next 2 to 5 years. There are 8 technology areas you can filter by: Internet of Things (IoT) Artificial Intelligence (AI) and automation Simulated and enhanced environments Engineering/materials science Data Wearables Transport Security Each of these areas contains between 3 and 17 sub-categories. The DPS filters help customers to identify and shortlist suppliers. The 2 main filters are: problem area technology type You can also filter by: location security classification Suppliers can apply to join the marketplace at any time, and identify their areas of expertise as part of the application process. Successful suppliers need to demonstrate their ability to offer suitably innovative products that meet either of the following 2 definitions: radical innovation: offering a new product, service, process or strategy introduced into a market designed to make a significant impact by completely replacing existing technologies and methods for example, streaming services replacing video rental stores disruptive innovation: creates a new market and value network and eventually disrupts an existing market and value network displacing established market-leading firms, products and alliances for example, light emitting diodes (LEDs) replacing traditional light bulbs As well as their ability to provide innovative products, the supplier’s contract example needs to explain the benefits for the end user and must be approved and confirmed by the customer. Once an application is complete, it can take can take up to a maximum of 15 working days to assess and appoint a supplier to the marketplace. A downloadable copy of the bid pack is available on the supplier registration service . Benefits access to proven technology innovation to solve public sector problems agility and flexibility to meet the public sector’s changing technology needs this agreement has no lots, use the filter system to produce a list of potential suppliers based on your needs quality and price assessment filtered to an individual customer’s requirements an efficient tender process and approach to finding potential solutions, including the option of using a 2 stage competition process and supplier presentations can be used for any size project, there is no minimum or maximum value Products and suppliers Please read the 'How to buy' tab below for detailed instructions on how to find out which suppliers are on this agreement. These terms are explained in the customer guide. Register as a buyer on the Dynamic Purchasing System Marketplace. note: although pages are headed ‘Supplier registration’ this is also where you can register as a buyer Go to the RM6094 Spark DPS under Technology and choose the “access as a buyer” option and confirm your acceptance of the customer access agreement. On your “manage your DPS category exports” page you now have 2 options: view appointed suppliers. click on the link to create a new category export. This is how you filter the suppliers that can meet your requirements When creating a new category use the filtering tool (select all that apply) to specify your requirements and create your supplier shortlist. Save your filtered list of capable suppliers by clicking the “save category” option and give the shortlist a unique name specific to your competition. From your “manage your category exports” page, export the list of suppliers and contact details. Export is to an Excel spreadsheet. Quit the DPS. Use the list to run a further competition. Invite the suppliers identified by the DPS to bid against your detailed specification, evaluation criteria and contract format. the list is valid for only 2 working days, from the date of its creation, because new suppliers may apply to join at any point if your call for competition excludes eligible suppliers it potentially breaches procurement regulations. You will need to get a fresh supplier list (steps 3.2 to 5) if you do not use your list within 2 working days by clicking the “search again” option for your export use our eSourcing tool to run a call for competition the tool is free to use for public sector buyers, or you can use your organisation’s own procurement tool Your tender process should align with the value and complexity of your requirement. Suppliers will need a reasonable period of time to review and prepare a response. This includes allowing enough time for suppliers to ask clarification questions and consider your answers before the deadline for written responses. Evaluate the responses. Request from winning supplier(s) any required evidence that they can meet your requirements. Set a deadline for submitting evidence for 2 days. If you are satisfied with the evidence, award the contract. Where appropriate, notify of the award on Contracts Finder . Explanation of terms: Pre- tender market engagement (PTME) This is optional but recommended and allows you to communicate with suppliers ahead of issuing your final specification to ensure that the market has a clear understanding of your requirements.

result.text: This notice is not an official launch of our procurement(s), it is to alert the market to future opportunities and allow us to begin conversations that will shape plans for multiple future requirements. The Cabinet Office (Government Skills Group) is transforming the way learning and development (L&D) is designed, procured, and delivered across the Civil Service. Following the announcement by the Chief Secretary to the Prime Minister, the government is establishing the new National School of Government and Public Services (hereon The National School). The National School is tasked with delivering high-quality, targeted training to approximately 558,000 civil servants, developing executive leadership in the wider public sector, and to partner with public sector training bodies. The strategic goal of the National School is to shift away from the historically outsourced prime-supplier managed-service model. In its place, the Cabinet Office is building an insourced, hybrid capability. Under this new Future Operating Model (FOM), the Cabinet Office will directly manage core operations, standard curricula, and stakeholder engagement. However, expert external provision will remain a critical element of the programme. The National School transformation programme relies on three core, interdependent pillars to transition Civil Service training away from fully outsourced prime-supplier models toward an in-house, hybrid operating model by April 2028. Together, these pillars work to build direct relationships with suppliers, provide a modern digital learning infrastructure, and establish robust in-house operational workflows. Pillar 1: Future Supplier Partnerships (FSP) The FSP project serves as the commercial enabler of the new operating model, building the in-house capability required to buy learning services and manage supply chains directly. We aim to establish direct, value-driven contractual relationships with UK-based SMEs, universities, business schools, and niche providers. The project team have identified an indicative Three-Stage Roadmap to enable this delivery: Stage 1 (Immediate - April 2027): Procuring urgent digital and specialist training needs that cannot be fulfilled through existing frameworks. Stage 2 (April 2027-March 2028): Phased procurement for core, National School-sponsored curriculum, coaching, and talent programmes. Stage 3 (March 2028 onwards): On-going phased procurements falling out of Stages 1 and 2, depending on the length of contracts identified. The scope of the requirements will cover several key procurement categories, including, but not limited to, specialised coaching pools (including for neuro-diverse leaders), blended training delivery, learning design (retaining Crown Intellectual Property), access to subject matter experts including within academia, independent research and evaluation, helpdesk/admin surge, and off-the-shelf qualifications. Pillar 2: Future Technologies (FT) The Future Technologies project focuses on designing and implementing the digital architecture required to run a personalised training operation for approximately 558,000 civil servants. The core objective here is the setting up and integration of platforms to manage the access, booking, payments, and evaluation of learning materials. This involves transitioning away from heavy manual processes to maximise technological efficiencies. At this stage the project team has identified the central deliverable as a unified online portal allowing learners to access the full National School offering. Key technologies in scope for procurement include, but are not limited to, a new Learning Management System (LMS)/ Learning Experience Platform (LXP), Customer Relationship Management (CRM) systems to centralise stakeholder engagement, and design/delivery tools. Pillar 3: Future Learning Operations (FLO) The Learning Operations project is responsible for building the actual systems, processes, and internal capabilities required to run the day-to-day training operations in-house. Their core objective is establishing an integrated operational function by April 2028 that supports over 558,000 civil servants in completing their learning journeys. It is highly dependent on the digital and commercial pillars to develop the underlying platforms that support operations. Market Involvement As part of the initial phases of the programme, the project teams are keen to connect with the market and gain insight into current trends, operations and barriers. With this in mind, Cabinet Office and the project team have planned the following Sector Connector events.

result.text: Cefas requires the provision of specialist marine geotechnical services to support two vibracoring surveys within the Irish Sea Firth of Clyde or North Sea. The Supplier is required to achieve sediment cores each with a target penetration of up to 3 m from pre-planned stations for the delivery of our environmental sampling programme. The Supplier is required to provide a 3 metre vibrocorer, complete with spares, coring consumables (coring liners etc) core splitting and core cutting equipment, and suitable individuals to undertake operations of the vibrocorer on a 24 hrs period (2 x 12 hrs shifts back-to-back) alongside deck crew. The Supplier’s personnel will be accommodated onboard the RV Cefas Endeavour for the duration of the survey. Cefas will provide suitable onboard cabin accommodation, bedding and welfare facilities, together with meals and refreshments as part of the vessel’s normal catering provision. The RV Cefas Endeavour has en-suite accommodation for scientific and technical personnel. The Supplier should therefore not include separate accommodation or subsistence costs for periods spent onboard the vessel. Any specific dietary requirements should be notified to Cefas in advance of mobilisation. The Supplier will remain responsible for all travel and associated costs required to mobilise and demobilise its personnel and equipment to/from the agreed port, unless otherwise stated. This should be reflected in the quote provided. The survey is scheduled for approximately ten to twelve days between the 1st to the 16th of November with the flexibility of +/- 5 days each side, with the availability to mobilise and demobilise equipment either in Lowestoft or a Port on the Southwest coast. The port will be confirmed by Cefas as soon as possible. Suppliers must be prepared to mobilise and demobilise from either location. Suppliers must provide evidence of valid and appropriate offshore survival training and medical certification, including BOSIET or STCW95 and a UK Offshore Operators Association-approved medical, or suitable equivalents. Original hard copies of all required certification and documentation will be required for inspection upon request at the time of vessel mobilisation. Please note general arrangement drawings of the RV Cefas Endeavour can be supplied upon Contract award for operational logistics if required. Requirement: The Supplier will liaise with Cefas before mobilisation to confirm the operational requirements, vessel interfaces, equipment layout, power supply, lifting arrangements, programme and health and safety requirements. A mobilisation plan shall be prepared and agreed by both parties in advance of installation. The Supplier will provide a fully maintained and function-tested 3 m high-powered vibrocorer spread, including its control system, constant-tension winch, core barrels, workshop container, essential spares and associated ancillary equipment. The proposed system shall be suitable for operations in water depths of approximately 150 m. The vibrocorer spread shall be delivered to the nominated mobilisation port and installed aboard the RV Cefas Endeavour. Following installation, the Supplier will complete appropriate equipment inspections, function tests and deployment checks, including a wet test where practicable. The Supplier will provide suitably trained and experienced equipment technicians to install, operate, maintain and demobilise the vibrocoring equipment. The base provision shall comprise of four technicians for operations of up to 24 hours per day (two technicians per 12-hour shift). The two technicians will be supported by RV Cefas Endeavour crew for the safe deployment and recovery of equipment. At each survey location, the vessel shall establish a safe and stable working position before the vibrocorer is deployed to the seabed using the vessel’s suitable crane or A-frame and lifting winch. Cefas shall provide the station position and water-depth information for each deployment. Once seabed conditions and the survey position have been confirmed, the vibrocorer shall be operated until either: • the full available barrel penetration is achieved; • refusal is encountered due to the ground conditions; or • the deployment is stopped for operational or safety reasons. Following each attempt, the vibrocorer shall be recovered to deck and the retained sediment core removed from the barrel, visually inspected, split and transferred to Cefas personnel. The Supplier will undertake the acquisition of the sediment cores and check the samples and associated acquisition information before handing them to Cefas. Unless otherwise agreed, laboratory testing, detailed data processing, interpretation, and reporting are outside the Suppliers scope. The Supplier will maintain the vibrocorer spread throughout the offshore programme and provide suitable spare parts for key components to minimise operational downtime. Any equipment defects shall be reported promptly to the Cefas Survey Lead, together with proposed corrective action and any expected effect on the programme. The proposed provision includes full spares coverage for key components. On completion of the offshore work, the Supplier will safely isolate, dismantle and remove its equipment from the vessel at the nominated demobilisation port. The work area shall be left in a safe and satisfactory condition. The Supplier will carry out the Services in accordance with its approved health and safety and quality-management procedures, Cefas vessel requirements and all applicable legislation, including the Lifting Operations and Lifting Equipment Regulations 1998 (LOLER), where applicable. All offshore activities shall be appropriately risk assessed, and suitable method statements, lifting plans and operational procedures shall be agreed before mobilisation.

result.text: Artificial Intelligence (AI) methods demonstrate astonishing performance in many application areas and are increasingly used in areas that affect daily life. The field of cybersecurity has not remained untouched by AI either. New AI tools are published almost daily in this context, and large AI language models (LLMs) in particular are already being used today for various application purposes. At the same time, the threat landscape is changing significantly as benignly intended models are misused for attack purposes (dual use). As a consequence, it must sometimes be assumed that vulnerabilities will be discovered and exploited ever faster in future with the increasing capabilities of AI. Against this background, the defensive side must also take action, which is why this project is intended to investigate how AI can be used profitably in the SSDLC and what effects ongoing developments have on the security of software. For this purpose, the project is divided into three parts, with related but distinct services: In work package 1-4 [HM1.1], a study on the current state of the art and science in the field of AI in the Secure Software Development Life Cycle is to be drawn up. In addition, best practices for the use of identified AI tools are to be developed. The results are to be published. In work package 5-6 [HM2.1], based on the study and in cooperation with the BSI, the contractor shall review the evaluation criteria for AVA scoring in Common Criteria certification and update them in view of new circumstances. In addition, an implementation plan for the use of AI tools for conformity assessment bodies is to be created. In work package 7, a reference architecture is created for the Open CoDE platform, which illustrates how AI tools can be integrated into the Secure Software Development Life Cycle and the software environment of Open CoDE. Suitable tools are to be proposed in this regard. Lot LOT-0000: KI im Secure Software Development Life Cycle (KISDL). parts.source: Methoden der Künstlichen Intelligenz (KI) zeigen in vielen Anwendungsbereichen erstaunliche Leistungen und werden zunehmend in Bereichen eingesetzt, die das tägliche Leben beeinflussen. Auch das Gebiet der Cybersicherheit ist von KI nicht unberührt geblieben. Neue KI-Tools werden in diesem Kontext beinahe täglich veröffentlicht, und vor allem Große KI-Sprachmodelle (LLMs) werden bereits heute zu diversen Anwendungszwecken eingesetzt. Zugleich verändert sich auch die Bedrohungslage stark, da gutartig intendierte Modelle missbräuchlich zu Angriffszwecken (Dual Use) verwendet werden. Infolgedessen muss mitunter angenommen werden, dass Schwachstellen mit den zunehmenden Fähigkeiten von KI zukünftig immer schneller entdeckt und ausgenutzt werden. Vor diesem Hintergrund muss auch die Verteidigungsseite aktiv werden, weswegen in diesem Projekt untersucht werden soll, wie KI im SSDLC gewinnbringend eingesetzt werden kann und welche Auswirkungen die fortschreitenden Entwicklungen auf die Sicherheit von Software haben. Dazu ist das Projekt in drei Teile gegliedert, mit zusammenhängenden, aber unterschiedlichen Leistungen: In den AP 1-4 [HM1.1]soll eine Studie über den aktuellen Stand der Technik und der Wissenschaft im Bereich KI im Secure Software Development Life Cycle erstellt werden. Dazu sollen des Weiteren Best Practices für den Einsatz identifizierter KI-Tools erarbeitet werden. Die Ergebnisse sollen veröffentlicht werden. In den AP 5-6 [HM2.1] soll der AN auf Grundlage der Studie in Zusammenarbeit mit dem BSI die Bewertungskriterien für die AVA Bepunktung in der Common Criteria Zertifizierung überprüfen und mit Blick auf die neuen Gegebenheiten aktualisieren. Zudem ist ein Umsetzungsplan für den Einsatz von KI-Tools für Prüfstellen zu erstellen. Im AP 7 wird für die Plattform Open CoDE eine Referenzarchitektur erstellt, die darstellt, wie KI-Tools in den Secure Software Development Life Cycle und die Softwareumgebung von Open CoDE integriert werden können. Es sind hierbei geeignete Tools vorzuschlagen. Lot LOT-0000: KI im Secure Software Development Life Cycle (KISDL). result.text: In this context, all building files of department 6-63 - Building Inspection are to be digitised and imported into the existing DMS (enaio from the company Optimal Systems). Department 6-63 - Building Inspection expects both space savings and media-break-free case processing as a result. Lot LOT-0001: Scanning services for the digitisation of the building file archive of department 6-63 - Building Inspection. Key data These are approx. 970 linear metres of building files which are to be digitised in a legally compliant manner and in compliance with data protection regulations with security class "Normal" in accordance with TR-RESISCAN and subsequently imported into the DMS (enaio) of the company Optimal Systems. The importing into the DMS is carried out by the contracting authority. All building files are to be processed within 3 years (i.e. approx. 27 linear metres per month). Assumptions (estimated values/extrapolation): - per linear metre approx. 1.500 - 2000 sheets - 50% of the sheets are double-sided, i.e. 3.000 pages per linear metre - 27 linear metres of files per month * 3.000 pages per linear metre = 81.000 pages per month - The file volume per file amounts on average to 100 to 200 sheets of vouchers and drawings up to format DIN A3 as well as additionally about 5 to 10 large-format drawings or plans. The complete process steps from collection/recording, file preparation, scanning, indexing to the return of original documents etc. to the contracting authority are the responsibility of the service provider.

The EnBW Energie Baden-Württemberg AG intends, within the framework of this negotiated procedure with a call for competition, to award framework agreements for IT consulting: General IT consulting. This tender aims to conclude framework agreements for the provision of future-oriented, scalable and cost-effective IT consulting, starting from approx. 01.07.2026 until presumably 30.06.2029 with two extension options of 12 months each. As EnBW, we operate not only nationally but also in an international environment and therefore require services not only onshore but also nearshore; to establish a common understanding, these classifications are defined below: - Onshore: Germany, Austria - Nearshore: All European countries incl. Switzerland, UK and Turkey, but excl. Germany, Austria. Subject of the tender: General IT consulting The subject of the tender is divided into 5 service packages (LP): - LP1 - Software development & integration - LP2 - Operations and service management - LP3 - Support & packaging - LP4 - Project management services - LP5 - Architecture management services A detailed description of services for this tender can be found in Annex 05_Description_of_Services, 05.1_Annex_Software_Development_Process and 05.2_Annex_Project_Management_Process (Annexes 05.1-05.2 Publication in the negotiated procedure). Number of framework agreement partners: The contracting authority intends to award the contract to the most economical 5 bids and therefore plans to have 5 framework agreement partners.

Die vorliegende Ausschreibung hat den Abschluss von Rahmenverträgen für die Durchführung von einer zukunftsorientierten, skalierbaren und wirtschaftlichen IT-Beratung zum Ziel, beginnend ab ca. 01.07.2026 bis voraussichtlich 30.06.2029 mit zwei Verlängerungsoptionen von jeweils 12 Monaten zum Gegenstand. Schweiz, UK und Türkei, jedoch exkl. Deutschland, Österreich. result.text: This tender is for Phase 3 of the Helensburgh, Cardross and Dumbarton Cyclepath; linking the Helensburgh Waterfront segregated cycleway (OS Grid NS 29598 82259) to the existing section of the cyclepath adjacent to the A814 at the Red Burn (OS Grid NS 31655 81112), near the north-east corner of Morrisons Supermarket site, and will build upon the concept design developed for the majority of the route (Civic Engineers, 2025). Argyll & Bute Council wish to appoint an appropriately qualified and experienced design team to develop Phase 3 of the Helensburgh, Cardross and Dumbarton Cyclepath project from the current concept design through Developed (RIBA Stage 3) and Technical (RIBA Stage 4) Design, and to be Principal Designer during construction (RIBA Stage 5). The project will require the successful tenderer to complete a range of survey, design and in-depth engagement work, including in-depth community, stakeholder and landowner engagement, topographic and utilities surveys, equality impact assessment (EqIA) and Preliminary Environmental Assessment (PEA) to ensure route(s) identified have strong community, neighbour and landowner support and that the design drawings for the route(s) are robust, deliverable and of a high quality. These will all be subject to engagement with the community, businesses, landowners, neighbouring landowners, Argyll and Bute Council, Strathclyde Partnership for Transport (SPT) and Transport Scotland. result.text: Tampereen Vesi Oy (3381716-4) is a wholly owned subsidiary of the City of Tampere. The company was established in 2023 and, at the beginning of 2024, operations were transferred from the City of Tampere's municipal enterprise to a corporate form. Tampereen Vesi Oy provides water utility services in its operating area. The operating area mainly covers the zoned area of the City of Tampere. Tampereen Vesi Oy is inviting tenders for total payroll services, a time and attendance system and an HR system. The procurement is divided into parts as follows: PROCUREMENT PART A: Total payroll services (incl. payroll accounting, salary payment and expert services, as well as the payroll system used by payroll clerks) and a time and attendance system (incl. time and attendance tracking and shift planning). OPTION IN PROCUREMENT PART A: Travel management services (incl. travel ledger and travel and expense claim system). PROCUREMENT PART B: HR system (incl. personal data system and HRD system). A candidate may participate in both or only one of parts A or B. The procurement parts are independent, and a contractor will be selected separately for each part. In both procurement parts, the language of service is Finnish. All systems must have a Finnish-language user interface and instructions. The systems must enable a multi-company environment. In both procurement parts, the systems used will process personal data extensively, so data protection requirements must be taken into account. The systems must also have the possibility to restrict access rights on a role-based basis. Both procurement parts also include the commissioning of services and systems, related advisory and expert services, and system support services. The subject of the procurement is described in more detail in Annex 1 Preliminary service description. Information may be clarified during the procurement procedure. parts.source: Tampereen Vesi Oy (3381716-4) on Tampereen kaupungin kokonaan omistama tytäryhtiö. Yhtiö on perustettu vuonna 2023 ja vuoden 2024 alusta toiminta siirtyi Tampereen kaupungin liikelaitoksesta yhtiömuotoon. Tampereen Vesi Oy tuottaa toiminta-alueensa vesihuoltopalvelut. Toiminta-alue kattaa pääosin Tampereen kaupungin asemakaavoitetun alueen. Tampereen Vesi Oy kilpailuttaa kokonaispalkkapalvelut, työajanseurantajärjestelmän sekä HR-järjestelmän. Hankinta on jaettu osiin seuraavasti: HANKINNAN OSA A: Kokonaispalkkapalvelut (sis. palkanlaskenta-, palkanmaksu- ja asiantuntijapalvelut sekä palkanlaskijoiden käyttämän palkanlaskentajärjestelmän) sekä työajanseurantajärjestelmä (sis. työajanseurannan ja työvuorosuunnittelun) OPTIONA HANKINNAN OSASSA A: Matkustuksen hallintapalvelut (sis. matkareskontran sekä matka- ja kululaskujärjestelmän) HANKINNAN OSA B: HR-järjestelmä (sis. henkilötietojärjestelmän ja HRD-järjestelmän) Ehdokas voi osallistua molempiin tai ainoastaan jompaankumpaan osaan A tai B. Hankinnan osat ovat itsenäisiä ja sopimuskumppani valitaan kummassakin osassa erikseen. Kummassakin hankinnan osassa palvelun kieli on suomi. Kaikissa järjestelmissä on oltava suomenkielinen käyttöliittymä ja ohjeet. Järjestelmien tulee mahdollistaa moniyritysympäristö. Molemmissa hankinnan osissa käytettävissä järjestelmissä käsitellään laajasti henkilötietoja, joten tietosuojavaatimukset on huomioitava. Järjestelmissä on oltava mahdollisuus myös rajata käyttöoikeuksia roolipohjaisesti. Molempiin hankinnan osiin sisältyy lisäksi palveluiden ja järjestelmien käyttöönotto, niihin liittyvät neuvonta- ja asiantuntijapalvelut sekä järjestelmien käytöntukipalvelut. Hankinnan kohde on kuvattu tarkemmin liitteessä 1 Alustava palvelukuvaus. Tietoja on mahdollista tarkentaa hankintamenettelyn aikana. result.text: The competition is for the delivery of an electronic patient journal system (EPJ) for Voss herad, the Emergency Doctor Surgery and municipal doctor's office. The system shall therefore have close integration between the administrative systems, not to mention the trade systems in the municipality, so that double registrations and unnecessary work processes disappear. result.text: BIM Berliner Immobilienmanagement GmbH (BIM) intends to procure and introduce a new document management system (DMS) for company-wide use. The aim of the project is to provide a central, secure and audit-proof platform for managing, processing and archiving documents and files. The DMS is intended to support cross-departmental collaboration, reduce existing media discontinuity and ensure compliance with statutory, data protection and organisational requirements. Operation will initially take place on-premises in the BIM data centre. In the long term, the solution is intended to technically support hybrid and cloud-based operating models respectively. The scope of services comprises in particular: - Provision, implementation and introduction of the DMS software including installation, configuration and training, - Integration into existing systems, in particular SAP S/4HANA, email and office environments, - Migration of existing documents and metadata, - Design and implementation of defined workflows, archiving and authorisation structures, - Ensuring information security, digital accessibility and GDPR compliance, - Operation, maintenance and software support (support S) including service level management. The project is part of BIM's digitalisation strategy and is closely linked to the parallel projects "BIM SAP 2028" and "BitX", in which core business processes and specialist procedures are modernised and integrated. The contract term is 48 months with the option for a one-time extension of up to 24 months. The basis for the provision of services is the EVB-IT system contract in its currently valid version.

parts.source: Die BIM Berliner Immobilienmanagement GmbH (BIM) beabsichtigt die Beschaffung und Einführung eines neuen Dokumentenmanagementsystems (DMS) für den unternehmensweiten Einsatz. Ziel des Projekts ist die Bereitstellung einer zentralen, sicheren und revisionssicheren Plattform zur Verwaltung, Bearbeitung und Archivierung von Dokumenten und Akten. Das DMS soll die fachbereichsübergreifende Zusammenarbeit unterstützen, bestehende Medienbrüche reduzieren und die Einhaltung gesetzlicher, datenschutzrechtlicher und organisatorischer Vorgaben sicherstellen. Der Betrieb erfolgt zunächst On-Premises im Rechenzentrum der BIM. Perspektivisch soll die Lösung hybride bzw. cloudbasierte Betriebsmodelle technisch unterstützen. Der Leistungsumfang umfasst insbesondere: - Bereitstellung, Implementierung und Einführung der DMS-Software einschließlich Installation, Konfiguration und Schulungen, - Integration in bestehende Systeme, insbesondere SAP S/4HANA, E-Mail- und Office-Umgebungen, - Migration bestehender Dokumente und Metadaten, - Konzeption und Umsetzung definierter Workflows, Archivierungs- und Berechtigungsstrukturen, - Sicherstellung der Informationssicherheit, digitalen Barrierefreiheit und DSGVO-Konformität, - Betrieb, Wartung und Softwarepflege (Pflege S) einschließlich Service-Level-Management. Das Vorhaben ist Bestandteil der Digitalisierungsstrategie der BIM und steht in engem Zusammenhang mit den parallel laufenden Projekten „BIM SAP 2028“ und „BitX“, in denen zentrale Geschäftsprozesse und Fachverfahren modernisiert und integriert werden. Die Vertragslaufzeit beträgt 48 Monate mit der Option auf eine einmalige Verlängerung um bis zu 24 Monate. Grundlage der Leistungserbringung ist der EVB-IT Systemvertrag in der jeweils gültigen Fassung.

result.text: The National Aeronautics and Space Administration (NASA) Headquarters, Space Technology Mission Directorate (STMD) will be releasing an Umbrella NASA Research Announcement (NRA) titled “Space Technology Research, Development, Demonstration, and Infusion-2026 (SpaceTech-REDDI-2026)” on or about December 9, 2025. The solicitation is available by opening the NSPIRES homepage at https://nspires.nasaprs.com/ , selecting “Open” under "Solicitations," and searching "Space Technology Research, Development, Demonstration, and Infusion-2026 (SpaceTech-REDDI-2026)" un- der Solicitation #/Keyword(s). Proposals will be solicited through Appendices issued under this Umbrella SpaceTech-REDDI-2026 Solicitation, as technology topics are defined and funding is made available. See STMD Solicitations and Opportunities ( https://www.nasa.gov/stmd-solicitations-and-opportunities/ ) for anticipated releases. Once new Appendices are released, interested parties will be able to access the Appendices by selecting “Open” under "Solicitations," and searching “SpaceTech- REDDI-2026” in the “Solicitation #/ Keyword(s)” search area, and then selecting “List of Open Program Elements”. It is anticipated that this Umbrella NRA Solicitation (SpaceTech-REDDI-2026) will be open for one year and Umbrella SpaceTech-REDDI Solicitations will be issued annually. NASA STMD leads the development, demonstration, and infusion of transformational space technologies that solve critical stakeholder needs. As the tech base for civil space, STMD advances technology to sup- port future NASA, other government, and commercial missions. STMD investments aim to (1) advance U.S. space technology innovation and competitiveness in a global context, (2) encourage technology driven economic growth with an emphasis on the expanding space economy, and (3) inspire and develop a powerful U.S. aerospace technology community. STMD bolsters and funds ideas from entrepreneurs, researchers, and innovators across the country. Space technology research and development occurs at NASA centers, universi- ties, national labs, and small businesses. Interested proposers should monitor the NSPIRES website. NASA Headquarters maintains an electronic notification system to alert interested parties of program announcements, including solicitations and associated amendments. Subscription to this service is free to all registered users of NSPIRES at https://nspires.nasaprs.com . To add or change a subscription to the electronic notification system for a specific pro- gram or a NASA Mission Directorate, users should login to the database system and select “Account Management,” then “Email Subscriptions.” It is the responsibility of the prospective proposer to check this solicitation’s NSPIRES page for updates. Further questions concerning the Space Tech-REDDI-2026 solicitation may be sub- mitted to: HQ-STMD-SpaceTech-REDDI@nasaprs.com . Responses to inquiries will be answered by e-mail and may also be included in the Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ) document located on the NSPIRES page associated with the solicitation; anonymity of persons/institutions who submit questions will be preserved.

result.text: In the past almost 20 years since the founding of the Federal Government's Cultural and Creative Industries (KKW) initiative, the framework conditions, market structures, value chains and challenges for the KKW have changed fundamentally. Hardly any sector has been as strongly affected by the effects of the change brought about by transformation, the platform economy, digitalisation and artificial intelligence as the KKW, with impacts including on creative production, distribution and the exploitation of rights. The coming years will be characterised by further profound technological, economic and social upheavals. Digitalisation (especially artificial intelligence), sustainability and new forms of audience engagement have become the central drivers of change. After almost 20 years, it is therefore time to take stock on the one hand, and to look ahead and create foundations for strategic options for action on the other. In order to be able to conduct the further strategy process on an evidence-based footing, a qualitative and quantitative baseline study on future projections for the KKW is to be commissioned. The last baseline study, 'Macroeconomic Perspectives of the Cultural and Creative Industries', also produced on behalf of the BMWE, dates from the year 2009. The study is intended to develop a projection for the coming decade in order to provide strategic responses to structural changes in the sector. The aim is to critically examine the future viability of the KKW, to identify risks and to develop a forecast of opportunities and trends. The study 'Cultural and Creative Industries 2037' (working title) is intended to provide a foundation for the long-term strategic orientation of political and economic steering instruments with the help of future-oriented and forecasted scenario analyses. For a future projection up to 2037, it is therefore crucial not only to extrapolate existing growth trajectories, but to systematically include structural breaks, new value creation logics and disruptive technological developments in the forecast. The Federal Government's projections on macroeconomic growth are to be appropriately taken into account as a basis here. The study is intended to create a scientific foundation for the strategic further development of the Federal Government's Cultural and Creative Industries initiative and, in doing so, to provide in particular a long-term strategic orientation for political and economic steering instruments. The strategy is aimed prospectively at decision-makers from politics, business and administration, as well as at the actors in the cultural and creative industries themselves, who want to jointly set the course for a sustainable, innovative and economically strong creative ecosystem for the next generation. Lot LOT-0000: Study on future projection and development potential of the cultural and creative industries 2037. In the past almost 20 years since the founding of the Federal Government's Cultural and Creative Industries (KKW) initiative, the framework conditions, market structures, value chains and challenges for the KKW have changed fundamentally. Hardly any sector has been as strongly affected by the effects of the change brought about by transformation, the platform economy, digitalisation and artificial intelligence as the KKW, with impacts including on creative production, distribution and the exploitation of rights. The coming years will be characterised by further profound technological, economic and social upheavals. Digitalisation (especially artificial intelligence), sustainability and new forms of audience engagement have become the central drivers of change. After almost 20 years, it is therefore time to take stock on the one hand, and to look ahead and create foundations for strategic options for action on the other. In order to be able to conduct the further strategy process on an evidence-based footing, a qualitative and quantitative baseline study on future projections for the KKW is to be commissioned. The last baseline study, 'Macroeconomic Perspectives of the Cultural and Creative Industries', also produced on behalf of the BMWE, dates from the year 2009. The study is intended to develop a projection for the coming decade in order to provide strategic responses to structural changes in the sector. The aim is to critically examine the future viability of the KKW, to identify risks and to develop a forecast of opportunities and trends. The study 'Cultural and Creative Industries 2037' (working title) is intended to provide a foundation for the long-term strategic orientation of political and economic steering instruments with the help of future-oriented and forecasted scenario analyses. For a future projection up to 2037, it is therefore crucial not only to extrapolate existing growth trajectories, but to systematically include structural breaks, new value creation logics and disruptive technological developments in the forecast. The Federal Government's projections on macroeconomic growth are to be appropriately taken into account as a basis here. The study is intended to create a scientific foundation for the strategic further development of the Federal Government's Cultural and Creative Industries initiative and, in doing so, to provide in particular a long-term strategic orientation for political and economic steering instruments. The strategy is aimed prospectively at decision-makers from politics, business and administration, as well as at the actors in the cultural and creative industries themselves, who want to jointly set the course for a sustainable, innovative and economically strong creative ecosystem for the next generation.

parts.source: In den vergangenen fast 20 Jahren seit Gründung der Initiative Kultur- und Kreativwirtschaft (KKW) der Bundesregierung haben sich die Rahmenbedingungen, Marktstrukturen, Wertschöpfungsketten und Herausforderungen für die KKW grundlegend verändert. Kaum eine Branche ist von den Auswirkungen durch den Wandel von Transformation, Plattformökonomie, Digitalisierung und Künstliche Intelligenz so stark betroffen wie die KKW mit Auswirkungen u.a. auf kreative Produktion, Distribution und Rechteverwertung. Die kommenden Jahre werden durch weitere tiefgreifende technologische, wirtschaftliche und gesellschaftliche Umbrüche geprägt sein. Digitalisierung (insb. Künstliche Intelligenz), Nachhaltigkeit und neue Formen der Publikumseinbindung sind zu den zentralen Treibern der Veränderung geworden. Nach fast 20 Jahren ist es daher an der Zeit einerseits Bilanz zu ziehen, und andererseits den Blick nach vorne zu richten und Grundlagen für strategische Handlungsoptionen zu schaffen. Um den weiteren Strategieprozess evidenzbasiert führen zu können soll eine qualitative und quantitative Grundlagenstudie zur Zukunftsprojektion für die KKW in Auftrag gegeben werden. Die letzte Grundlagenstudie „Gesamtwirtschaftliche Perspektiven der Kultur und Kreativwirtschaft“, ebenfalls erstellt im Auftrag des BMWE, stammt aus dem Jahr 2009. Die Studie soll eine Projektion für die kommende Dekade entwickeln, um strategische Antworten auf strukturelle Veränderungen der Branche zu geben. Es geht darum, die Zukunftsfähigkeit der KKW kritisch zu beleuchten, Risiken zu identifizieren sowie eine Prognose zu Chancen und Trends zu entwickeln. Die Studie „Kultur und Kreativwirtschaft 2037“ (Arbeitstitel) soll mit Hilfe zukunftsorientierter und prognostizierter Szenario-Analysen ein Fundament für eine langfristige strategische Ausrichtung politischer und ökonomischer Steuerungsinstrumente liefern. Für eine Zukunftsprojektion bis 2037 ist daher entscheidend, nicht allein bestehende Wachstumsverläufe fortzuschreiben, sondern strukturelle Brüche, neue Wertschöpfungslogiken und disruptive technologische Entwicklungen systematisch in die Prognose einzubeziehen. Als Grundlagen sind hier die Projektionen der Bundesregierung zum gesamtwirtschaftlichen Wachstum angemessen zu berücksichtigen. Die Studie soll ein wissenschaftliches Fundament für die strategische Weiterentwicklung der Initiative Kultur- und Kreativwirtschaft der Bundesregierung schaffen und dabei insbesondere eine langfristige strategische Ausrichtung politischer und ökonomischer Steuerungsinstrumente liefern. Die Strategie richtet sich perspektivisch an Entscheidungsträgerinnen und -träger aus Politik, Wirtschaft, Verwaltung sowie an die Akteure der Kultur und Kreativwirtschaft selbst, die gemeinsam die Weichen für ein nachhaltiges, innovatives und wirtschaftlich starkes Kreativökosystem der nächsten Generation stellen wollen. rejected.text: Forsvarsministeriets Materiel- og Indkøbsstyrelse (FMI) wishes to enter into a contract regarding the delivery, operation, maintenance, support and further development of an internet-based booking system for the Danish Defence's pool vehicles. The existing system is to be replaced by a more modern, reliable and user-friendly solution that supports efficient booking, lending and returning of pool vehicles, and provides FMI with access to relevant operational and administrative data. The purpose of the contract is to ensure the Danish Defence has a comprehensive solution that, with a minimum of resource consumption from FMI, enables secure, flexible and efficient management of pool vehicles across the organisation. The solution must support both open and closed vehicle pools, be able to handle a large number of users and vehicles, and contribute to high availability and continuity in the Danish Defence's transport solutions. The contract includes the supplier's delivery, operation, maintenance, support and further development of the overall system, including both the application and the necessary infrastructure, for use by the Danish Defence's pool vehicles, as well as the delivery, installation and operation of electronic car-sharing equipment in the vehicles. The contract includes a start-up period consisting of a development period and an implementation period, during which the system is adapted, developed and commissioned in accordance with FMI's requirements. The supplier is responsible for the delivery of the application and for the necessary infrastructure, including hosting the system on servers located in Denmark. The system is delivered as an internet-based solution (SaaS), and the supplier is responsible for all operation of the underlying infrastructure. The supplier is responsible for the integration of existing data regarding users, pools, pool vehicles and bookings, as well as for any reuse of already installed electronic car-sharing equipment. The system must support self-service access for users, comprehensive administration and reporting functions for FMI, as well as technical support and a 24-hour helpdesk. The contract runs for 72 months from signature. The contract may be extended on the same terms up to 2 times for 24 months. It is a requirement that the development period must have a maximum duration of 6 months and that the implementation period must have a maximum duration of 6 months. The current system handles approx. 25.000 users and 2.800 pool vehicles. During the contract period, the solution is initially expected to be able to handle up to approx. 5.000 pool vehicles. Given the uncertain international security policy situation, however, the Danish Defence has a need for an option to scale the solution so that the application and the associated infrastructure can, at the Customer's request, be expanded to handle up to 10.000 pool vehicles without any degradation in functionality, response times, availability or the other requirements and service levels set out in the contract. Furthermore, the contract includes an option regarding the choice of access technology for the pool vehicles, whereby the Customer, instead of using the Danish Defence's existing access carriers (RFID etc.), may choose an access and locking system provided by the Supplier on the terms set out in the requirements specification and the contract.

parts.source: Forsvarsministeriets Materiel- og Indkøbsstyrelse (”FMI) ønsker at indgå en kontrakt vedrørende levering, drift, vedligeholdelse, support og videreudvikling af et internetbaseret bookingsystem til Forsvarets Puljekøretøjer. Det eksisterende system ønskes erstattet af en mere moderne, driftssikker og brugervenlig løsning, der understøtter effektiv booking, udlån og returnering af puljekøretøjer samt giver FMI adgang til relevante drifts- og administrationsdata. Formålet med kontrakten er at sikre Forsvaret en samlet løsning, der med et minimum af ressourceforbrug fra FMI muliggør en sikker, fleksibel og effektiv forvaltning af puljekøretøjer på tværs af organisationen. Løsningen skal understøtte både åbne og lukkede køretøjspuljer, kunne håndtere et stort antal brugere og køretøjer samt bidrage til høj tilgængelighed og kontinuitet i Forsvarets transportløsninger. Kontrakten omfatter leverandørens levering, drift, vedligeholdelse, support og videreudvikling af det samlede system, herunder såvel applikationen som den dertil nødvendige infrastruktur, til brug for Forsvarets puljekøretøjer samt levering, installation og drift af elektronisk delebiludstyr i køretøjerne. Kontrakten inkluderer en opstartsperiode bestående af en udviklingsperiode og en implementeringsperiode, hvor systemet tilpasses, udvikles og idriftsættes i overensstemmelse med FMI’s krav. Leverandøren er ansvarlig for levering af applikationen samt for den dertil nødvendige infrastruktur, herunder hosting af systemet på servere beliggende i Danmark. Systemet leveres som en internetbaseret løsning (SaaS), og leverandøren er ansvarlig for al drift af den bagvedliggende infrastruktur. Leverandøren er ansvarlig for integration af eksisterende data om brugere, puljer, puljekøretøjer og bookinger samt for eventuel genanvendelse af allerede installeret elektronisk delebiludstyr. Systemet skal understøtte selvbetjent adgang for brugere, omfattende administrations- og rapporteringsfunktioner for FMI samt teknisk support og døgnbemandet helpdesk. Kontrakten løber i 72 måneder fra underskrift. Kontrakten kan forlænges på samme vilkår med op til 2 gange 24 måneder. Det er et krav, at udviklingsperioden maksimalt må have en varighed på 6 måneder samt, at implementeringsperioden maksimalt må have en varighed på 6 måneder. Det nuværende system håndterer ca. 25.000 Brugere og 2.800 Puljekøretøjer. I kontraktperioden forventes løsningen som udgangspunkt at skulle kunne håndtere op til ca. 5.000 Puljekøretøjer. Henset til den usikre internationale sikkerhedspolitiske situation har Forsvaret imidlertid behov for en option på at kunne skalere løsningen, således at Applikationen og den tilhørende infrastruktur efter Kundens anmodning kan udbygges til at håndtere op mod 10.000 Puljekøretøjer uden forringelse af funktionalitet, svartider, tilgængelighed eller de øvrige i kontrakten fastsatte krav og servicemål. Herudover omfatter kontrakten en option vedrørende valg af adgangsteknologi til Puljekøretøjerne, hvorefter Kunden i stedet for at anvende Forsvarets eksisterende adgangsbærere (RFID mv.) kan vælge et adgangs- og låsesystem leveret af Leverandøren på de i kravspecifikationen og kontrakten fastsatte vilkår.

result.text: The primary objective of this contract is to conduct a comprehensive, large-scale study on the current state and effectiveness of cocoa farmer cooperatives and farmer groups in Ghana and Côte d’Ivoire (incorporating but not limited to cooperative societies in Ghana and COOP CA and COOP simplifié in Côte d’Ivoire). This study will represent the first nationally representative analysis of cocoa cooperatives and farmer groups across the two countries. It will uniquely combine data collection at two levels: (1) the organizational governance and operational management of cooperatives and farmer groups, and (2) the individual farmer members, including their engagement, benefits, and challenges. By integrating insights from behavioural economics, collective action theory, organizational studies, and development economics, the study will adopt an interdisciplinary approach to evaluate how structural, managerial, and behavioural factors influence cooperative performance and farmer outcomes. The reason for purchasing this service is to generate actionable insights that enable stakeholders, including farmers, cooperatives, policymakers, and certification bodies, to enhance the effectiveness and sustainability of cocoa production systems in Ghana and Côte d’Ivoire. Specifically, the study aims to assess the readiness of cocoa cooperatives for ARS1000 certification, evaluate cooperative governance and member engagement, and investigate household-level investment strategies, including investments in sustainable agricultural practices or household assets. The ultimate goal is to identify critical barriers and opportunities to strengthen cooperative capacity, improve resource allocation, and reduce the financial and operational burdens of compliance with sustainability standards, thereby contributing to a more sustainable cocoa production system in the region.

rejected.text: IKTNH shall hold a tender competition on GIS - map systems for insight and management. We consider all participating municipalities in this joint procurement to be a joint tender competition. The municipalities of Elves, Aurland, Austrheim, Austevoll, Etne, Fedje, Gulen, Masfjorden, Modalen, Osterøy, Samnanger, Sveio, Tysnes, Vaksdal and Vindafjord have established a joint ICT operations company, ICT Nordhordland municipal joint partnership (IKTNH). This enquiry is mainly for: Procurement of GIS Platform. It will be open for complete and/or sub-delivery with the following alternatives: 1. System for GIS, which only includes a map system for insight and theme data management. 2. System for GIS, which only includes a map system for administration. The procurement(s) shall ensure future-orientated systems for the municipalities in the cooperation, as well as to the greatest possible degree contribute to simplifying, improving and digitising work processes connected to map systems. The offered system must be in continual development and give users access to new versions and functionality. This also applies for the national joint components. The municipalities shall be offered new technologies as and when they become available and interesting. The functionality shall be available after the simplest possible price model that does not limit development, and with the greatest possible integration between different services and technologies. It is also a requirement that the system and the agreement, in all relevant areas, support an ever closer cooperation between the different municipalities and any new municipalities that become part of the cooperation. The tenderer shall contribute to the municipalities' work for sharing competence, training and experience exchange between the municipalities in the entire process. We require that the tenderer actively contributes to achieving all our aims.

result.text: A service partner is being sought to support the functional assurance of routine operations and the high availability of the SKSS terminal system with all its components. Services are expected for the further development of the software and for ensuring the high availability of the hardware used and the project-internal WLAN network. To maintain continuous and consistently high-quality service, as well as to minimise the effort required for induction and management, the staff deployed should remain the same for the duration of the contract. The objective is to conclude a framework agreement for IT services with a single business enterprise. IT services for the overall functional system, consisting of software, hardware and communication infrastructure, are being tendered as a framework agreement. All externally commissioned services for expansion and optimisation will take place in parallel with routine operations and must ensure the current project status. For data protection reasons, details of the content will only be disclosed after the contract has been awarded. Project management and coordination of all services under the framework agreement are the responsibility of the contracting authority. ROSTOCK PORT remains the owner and operator of the overall system, including the current and future source code.

parts.source: Zur Unterstützung bei der Funktionssicherung im Routinebetrieb und der Hochverfügbarkeit des Terminalsystems SKSS mit allen Komponenten wird ein Servicepartner gesucht. Erwartet werden Leistungen zur Weiterentwicklung der Software, Sicherstellung der Hochverfügbarkeit der eingesetzten Hardware und des projektinternen WLAN Netzes. Zur Aufrechterhaltung eines kontinuierlichen und qualitativ gleichbleibend guten Service, sowie zur Minimierung des Einweisungs- und Steuerungsaufwandes, sollen die eingesetzten Mitarbeiter für die Dauer der Beauftragung möglichst personenidentisch sein. Ziel ist der Abschluss einer Rahmenvereinbarung über IT-Serviceleistungen mit einem einzigen Wirtschaftsunternehmen. Ausgeschrieben werden IT Serviceleistungen für das funktionale Gesamtsystem bestehend aus Software, Hardware und Kommunikationsinfrastruktur als Rahmenvereinbarung. Alle extern beauftragten Leistungen zur Erweiterung und Optimierung erfolgen parallel zum Routinebetrieb und müssen den bisherigen Projektstand sicherstellen. Inhaltliche Details werden aus Datenschutzgründen erst nach Zuschlagserteilung bekannt gegeben. Projektmanagement und Koordination aller Leistungen der Rahmenvereinbarung obliegen dem Auftraggeber. ROSTOCK PORT bleibt Eigentümer und Betreiber des Gesamtsystems einschließlich des aktuellen und künftigen Quellcodes.

result.text: Helse Nord-Trøndelag HF, St. Olavs Hospital HF and Helse Møre og Romsdal HF have, by their clinics for mental health care, drug treatment, rehabilitation and habilitation need to use digital, standardised and normed review and mapping tools. The tools shall be used in mapping, reviewing, diagnosing patients in all age groups. They shall be based on recognised, standardised and normed methods. For example, cognitive ability tests, mapping executive functions, symptom mapping, function mapping, mapping of quality of life and mapping of patient satisfaction. We would like the different tools to be included in a digital platform where we as a customer can choose between different tools. As a minimum the delivery must include cognitive ability tests. The ability tests ought to include an option to also map verbal and non-verbal abilities. We are also interested in deliveries that cover parts of the needs, if one delivery does not cover all of the needs described here. Requirements for a digital system. We need a digital system that covers the needs outlined above, which ensure uniform administration, automatic scoring and reporting, which provides safe processing of sensitive data. The solution must also provide an option to use the existing paper based test set where the scoring still occurs digitally.
