result.text: MARKET DIALOGUE The subject matter of the market dialogue is the expert services in information security and data protection under preparation as well as the assessment services of conformity assessment bodies for information security for the needs of Väylävirasto. BACKGROUND AND OBJECTIVES Väylävirasto is putting out to tender the following two expert service procurements: Expert services in information security and data protection This tender procures experts to support the safeguarding and development of information and cyber security, data protection and information management of Väylävirasto. Väylävirasto has several different administrative or technical projects and undertakings underway in which operations are developed and existing information systems are renewed or new ones are ordered. What all these projects and undertakings have in common is that they must implement information security and the fulfilment of central government information security requirements in a manner suitable for the organisation. The subject matter of the procurement is information and cybersecurity consulting and auditing services. The work takes place largely in a multi-supplier environment, but also as internal consulting for individual projects or undertakings. Information security audits are also carried out regularly in the supplier environment. In addition, an assessment is made of, among other things, the impact of information security instructions directed at central government on the projects and operations of Väylävirasto. In addition to the office environment, the subject matter of the procurement is the infrastructures managed by Väylävirasto (Finnish Transport Infrastructure Agency), i.e. state-owned road, rail and waterways. Each transport mode has its own cyber security development needs, which in certain respects may differ significantly from each other. The aim of the procurement is to obtain a partner for Väylävirasto with which the organisation's and the various transport modes' information and cybersecurity development can be carried out. Assessment services of conformity assessment bodies for information security This tender procures conformity assessment body services to support the safeguarding of the information and cybersecurity, data protection and information management of Väylävirasto. Within the scope of this contract, conformity assessment bodies will produce assessment services in the role of an information security conformity assessment body approved by the Finnish Transport and Communications Agency (Traficom). When offering and producing assessment services, the information security conformity assessment bodies must comply with the current legislation, official regulations, recommendations, guidelines and other obligations directed at conformity assessment bodies by the authorities concerning conformity assessment body activities. Particular attention must be paid to the instruction issued to conformity assessment bodies by the Finnish Transport and Communications Agency for information security conformity assessment bodies 210/2016 O. During the course of the dialogue, the contracting entity will separately assess the need for a market dialogue regarding the assessment services of conformity assessment bodies for information security. The following dynamic purchasing systems (DPS) of Hansel Oy will be used as the procurement procedure for both tenders: Expert services in cyber security and data protection 2025 Assessment services of conformity assessment bodies for information security 2021–2028 Hansel Oy's dynamic purchasing systems are open to all, and all companies meeting the suitability requirements may join them. Those interested in participating in the tenders are therefore requested to join the dynamic purchasing systems. PRELIMINARY SCHEDULE The contracting entity's target schedule for carrying out the market dialogue and the procurement is: - Market dialogue 12/2025-1/2026 - Publication of the invitation to tender 1/2026 - Calculation period 1-2/2026 - Comparison of tenders 2/2026 - Procurement decision and continuation 2-3/2026 ----- ADDITIONAL INFORMATION ON THE NOTICE This notice is a prior information notice. This notice does not request tenders. The prior information notice is accompanied by an invitation to a market dialogue, whereby all suppliers interested in the procurement have the opportunity to conduct a technical dialogue concerning the procurement with Väylävirasto. The purpose of the technical dialogue is to conduct a general-level dialogue on the subject matter of the procurement and its definition. The technical dialogue does not bind Väylävirasto to carry out the procurement. Nor does the technical dialogue bind the supplier to participate in any potential competitive tendering. The technical dialogue is organised through commenting on draft versions of the invitation to tender material and answering the contracting entity's questions related to the subject matter of the procurement. The preliminary date for submitting the draft versions of the invitation to tender material and questions is 12.12.2025. The contracting entity reserves suppliers approximately two weeks for commenting. Instructions for registration: The supplier must declare its interest in participating in the market dialogue by 10.12.2025 at 12.00 at the latest by sending a message to the addresses paul.kinnunen@vayla.fi, pirita.tuikka@vayla.fi and aino.mannikko@vayla.fi with the subject heading: "Tietoturvan hankinnat- markkinavuoropuhelu" (Information security procurements - market dialogue). The supplier is requested to state in the message to which email addresses the market dialogue material will be delivered. The supplier is requested to state the following information in the message: - email address of the supplier's contact person. The contracting entity reserves the right to also invite suppliers to bilateral negotiations or to continue the technical dialogue in another separately notified manner, which will be notified of later if necessary. The descriptions presented in this prior information notice and the estimated publication date of the procurement notice, as well as the draft materials of the dialogue to be delivered later, are preliminary and indicative prior procurement information. Participating companies will not be paid compensation for answering or participating.

parts.source: MARKKINAVUOROPUHELU Markkinavuoropuhelun kohteena ovat valmistelussa olevat Tietoturvan ja tietosuojan asiantuntijapalvelut sekä tietoturvallisuuden arviointilaitosten arviointipalvelut Väyläviraston tarpeisiin. TAUSTAA JA TAVOITTEET Väylävirasto kilpailuttaa seuraavat kaksi asiantuntijapalveluhankintaa: Tietoturvan ja tietosuojan asiantuntijapalvelut Tällä kilpailutuksella hankitaan asiantuntijoita tukemaan Väyläviraston tieto- ja kyberturvallisuuden, tietosuojan ja tiedonhallinnan varmistamista ja kehitystä. Väylävirastolla on meneillään useita eri hallinnollisia tai teknisiä projekteja ja hankkeita, joissa kehitetään toimintaa ja uudistetaan olemassa olevia tai tilataan uusia tietojärjestelmiä. Yhteistä näissä kaikissa projekteissa ja hankkeissa on, että niissä tulee toteuttaa tietoturva ja valtiohallinnon tietoturvavaatimusten täyttäminen organisaatiolle sopivalla tavalla. Hankinnan kohteena on tieto- ja kyberturvallisuusturvakonsultointi- ja auditointipalvelut. Työskentely tapahtuu suurelta osin monitoimittajaympäristössä, mutta myös yksittäisten projektien tai hankkeiden sisäisenä konsultointina. Tietoturva-auditointeja tehdään myös säännöllisesti toimittajaympäristöön. Lisäksi arvioidaan mm. valtionhallintoon kohdistuvien tietoturvaohjeiden vaikutusta Väyläviraston hankkeisiin ja toimintaan. Toimistoympäristön lisäksi hankinnan kohteena ovat Väylän hallinnoimat infrastruktuurit, eli valtion omistamat tie-, rata- ja vesiväylät. Kullakin väylämuodolla on omat kyberturvallisuuden kehitystarpeet, jotka tietyiltä osin voivat poiketa toisistaan merkittävästi. Hankinnan tavoitteena on saada Väylävirastolle yhteistyökumppani, jonka kanssa organisaation ja eri väylämuotojen tieto- ja kyberturvallisuuden kehittämistä voidaan toteuttaa. Tietoturvallisuuden arviointilaitosten arviointipalvelut Tällä kilpailutuksella hankitaan arviointilaitospalveluja tukemaan Väyläviraston tieto- ja kyberturvallisuuden, tietosuojan ja tiedonhallinnan varmistamista. Tämän sopimuksen piirissä arviointilaitokset tuottavat arviointipalveluja Liikenne- ja viestintäviraston hyväksymän tietoturvallisuuden arviointilaitoksen roolissa. Tietoturvallisuuden arviointilaitosten tulee arviointipalveluita tarjotessaan ja tuottaessaan noudattaa arviointilaitostoimintaa koskevaa voimassa olevaa lainsäädäntöä, viranomaismääräyksiä, suosituksia, ohjeistuksia ja muita viranomaisten arviointilaitoksille kohdistamia velvoitteita. Erityisesti tulee huomioida Liikenne- ja viestintäviraston arviointilaitoksille antama ohje tietoturvallisuuden arviointilaitoksille 210/2016 O. Tilaaja arvioi vuoropuhelun kuluessa erikseen tarvetta markkinavuoropuhelulle tietoturvallisuuden arviointilaitosten arviointipalveluiden osalta. result.text: This is not a procurement notice or a call for tenders, but a Request for Information directed at potential Suppliers. Therefore, no tenders are requested or to be submitted in response to this request for information. No comments or questions received via the request for information will be answered. One of the tasks of the Finnish National Agency for Education is the publishing of learning materials and publications. Customers include both private individuals and organisations, in particular schools and educational institutions. Products are delivered to the customer either physically (e.g. textbooks) or digitally (e.g. electronic learning materials). We request up-to-date information on a comprehensive service encompassing product logistics, licensing, and online shop services. The service to be procured includes • a SaaS online shop solution where customers can purchase non-fiction books, textbooks, publications, and licences for digital learning materials published by the Finnish National Agency for Education, as well as downloadable files, using commonly used payment methods • a logistics and distribution service for textbooks and publications, including distribution to key resellers such as Library Service, bookshops, and learning material intermediaries • a digital product licence management service, and • a sales settlement service, including inventory value reporting. Service requirements • The online shop must serve our customers in Finnish, Swedish, and English. • The service must meet the accessibility requirements of the Act on the Provision of Digital Services. • It shall be possible to integrate the service with the Finnish National Agency for Education's digital learning platform (licence management) and product register. • The online shop solution must provide the capability for the Finnish National Agency for Education to edit the layout, texts, and settings of the online shop. In addition, it must be possible to add sample pages, reading samples, and promotional videos to the online shop. We request the following information 1. Does the Supplier have a comprehensive service meeting the above description to offer? 2. What pricing model does the Supplier use? 3. Based on the above description, does the Supplier have any comments on the potential requirement specification for the procurement? 4. Optional additional question: The Finnish National Agency for Education is exploring alternatives to replace its self-developed product information system and royalty register. Is it possible to tailor a product and royalty register into the Supplier's service that includes the necessary databases and user interface? The request for information does not oblige the contracting authority to carry out the actual procurement or to implement it in the manner described in the request for information. The contracting authority is not obliged to take account of responses received to the request for information when drawing up the call for tenders. Responding to the request for information does not bind the tenderer or affect the tenderer's position in any potential procurement procedure. No compensation will be paid for responding to the request for information or for any product demonstration.

result.text: This is a request for information, which is not a prior information notice, a contract notice or a call for tenders. The purpose of the request for information is to survey the market and collect information regarding the subject of the procurement for a future tendering process. Responding to the request for information is not a prerequisite for participating in the tendering process. To ensure the success of the future tendering process, it is important that tenderers provide the contracting authority with the requested information as extensively as possible. This request for information is used to clarify the supply available on the market regarding substitute management systems and suppliers. A substitute management system enables a single centralised service channel for the sudden substitute needs of professionals. With the help of a substitute management system, we want to streamline substitute management processes. The need is to find a modern and user-friendly, off-the-shelf SaaS system intended for the management and coordination of substitutes, as well as for the notification and booking of temporary work shifts. In addition, we want to improve and modernise the user experience of our substitute management systems so that the applicant experience and communication are improved. The systems must be integrable via standard interfaces with, among other things, the client organisation's user information and access rights management service. The objectives of the services are equal accessibility, timeliness and continuity. The goal of the procurement is to move from heavy services to proactive and preventive services, whereby the effectiveness of the services can be improved. We offer system solutions to our clients in the social and health care sector as well as the municipal sector. The scope of the future procurement, the procurement method and the parties will be specified as the preparation of the call for tenders progresses. DESCRIPTION OF THE PROCUREMENT The goal of the procurement is to find a system: - that is an easy-to-use, off-the-shelf SaaS solution - that can be integrated into the client organisation's AD and reporting environment via open interfaces - that is information secure and takes data protection into account - whose supplier has a clear implementation model that includes extensive documentation and guidance for the client and contracting organisation - that can be used on mobile devices and via a browser. In addition to the system procurement, the procurement includes connection interfaces to other systems, licences, a delivery project, maintenance and support for off-the-shelf software, as well as other separately ordered expert services, for example, the planning and implementation of system change and development needs and development projects. The solution must scale to the organisational structures of social and health service organisations and the municipal sector. The implementation of the solution must be based on generally used standards and system-independent interfaces. The solution to be procured must function as part of the existing technical and functional environment. The solution includes at least two separate environments in terms of its functions; production and test/training environments, which are identical in their basic structure. OPERATING ENVIRONMENT The following are descriptions of the operating environments of the organisations related to the request for information, which are requested to be used in describing the functionality and pricing model. Users of the data transmission system are, for example, users from wellbeing services counties and municipal organisations. Users of the information systems are also stakeholders and external users. RESPONDING TO THE REQUEST FOR INFORMATION The request for information must be answered by 25.9.2025 at 12:00. Responding takes place by email to the address hankinnat@istekki.fi. Please head your message as follows: "Markkinavuoropuhelu: Sijaisvälitysjärjestelmä" (Market dialogue: Substitute management system). Responses to the Questions attachment of the request for information must also be submitted with the response. You may also attach, for example, brochures to the response. Based on the responses received, Istekki Oy will select 3–5 suppliers to present their solutions in one-hour Teams meetings. The meeting between the selected respondent, Istekki and the representatives of the clients will be recorded. The information provided at the request for information stage will be treated as confidential. Please indicate in your request for information response which of the times below suit you best: Mon 29.9. at 10 – 11 Mon 29.9. at 13 – 14 Mon 29.9. at 14 – 15 Tue 30.9. at 11 – 12 Tue 30.9. at 12 – 13 Tue 30.9. at 13 – 14 The times will be confirmed supplier-specifically after the response time for the request for information. The tendering service automatically creates deadlines for submitting questions and responding to the request for information. Instead of these deadlines, the deadlines in the request for information document shall be followed.

parts.source: Tämä on tietopyyntö, joka ei ole ennakkoilmoitus, hankintailmoitus tai tarjouspyyntö. Tietopyynnön tarkoituksena on kartoittaa markkinoita ja kerätä hankinnan kohdetta koskevaa tietoa tulevaa kilpailutusta varten. Tietopyyntöön vastaaminen ei ole edellytys kilpailutukseen osallistumiselle. Tulevan kilpailutuksen onnistumisen varmistamiseksi on tärkeää, että tarjoajat antavat hankintayksikölle mahdollisimman laajasti pyydettyjä tietoja. Tällä tietopyynnöllä selvitetään markkinoilla olevaa tarjontaa sijaisvälitysjärjestelmistä ja toimittajista. Sijaisvälitysjärjestelmällä mahdollistetaan yksi keskitetty palvelukanava ammattilaisten äkillisiin sijaistustarpeisiin. Sijaisvälitysjärjestelmän avulla haluamme sujuvoittaa sijaisvälityksen prosesseja. Tarpeena on löytää sijaisten hallintaan ja koordinointiin, sekä keikkatyövuorojen ilmoittamiseen ja varaukseen tarkoitettu moderni ja käyttäjäystävällinen, valmistuotepohjainen SaaS-järjestelmä. Lisäksi haluamme parantaa sekä modernisoida sijaisvälitysjärjestelmiemme käyttökokemusta siten, että hakijakokemus ja -viestintä paranevat. Järjestelmien tulee olla integroitavissa standardeilla rajapinnoilla mm. asiakasorganisaation käyttäjätieto- ja käyttöoikeuksien hallintapalveluun. Palvelujen tavoitteina on yhdenvertainen saatavuus, oikea-aikaisuus ja jatkuvuus. Hankinnan tavoitteena on siirtyä raskaista palveluista ennakoiviin ja ennalta ehkäiseviin palveluihin, jolloin voidaan parantaa palveluiden vaikuttavuutta. Tarjoamme järjestelmäratkaisuja sosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon toimialan sekä kuntasektorin asiakkaillemme. Tulevan hankinnan laajuus, hankintatapa sekä osapuolet täsmentyvät tarjouspyynnön valmistelun edetessä. HANKINNAN KUVAUS Hankinnan tavoitteena on löytää järjestelmä, - joka on helppokäyttöinen, valmistuotepohjainen SaaS-ratkaisu - joka on integroitavissa asiakasorganisaation AD- ja raportointiympäristöön avoimien rajapintojen kautta - joka on tietoturvallinen ja tietosuojan huomioiva - jonka toimittajalla on selkeä käyttöönottomalli, joka sisältää laajan dokumentaation ja ohjeistuksen asiakas- ja tilaajaorganisaatiolle - joka on käytettävissä mobiililaitteilla ja selaimella Hankintaan kuuluu järjestelmähankinnan lisäksi liittymärajapinnat muihin järjestelmiin, lisenssit, toimitusprojekti, valmisohjelmistojen ylläpito ja tuki, sekä muita erikseen tilattavia asiantuntijapalveluja, esimerkiksi järjestelmän muutos- ja kehittämistarpeiden sekä kehittämisprojektien suunnittelu ja toteuttaminen. Ratkaisun tulee skaalautua sosiaali- ja terveyspalveluorganisaatioiden sekä kuntasektorin organisaatiorakenteisiin. Ratkaisun toteutuksen tulee perustua yleisesti käytettyihin standardeihin ja järjestelmäriippumattomiin rajapintoihin. Hankittavan ratkaisun tulee toimia osana olemassa olevaa teknistä ja toiminnallista ympäristöä. result.text: New operational control system [ELS] The Fraport AG, headquartered in Frankfurt am Main, is a world-leading airport operator. The company was founded in 1924 and operates Frankfurt Airport, one of the most significant air traffic hubs in the world. Furthermore, Fraport is involved in the management and operation of several other airports worldwide. Fraport currently operates the software (SW) ELDIS III from the company eurofunk at the Frankfurt am Main site as a KRITIS and LuftSIG-relevant system in the security control centre with the service areas of works fire brigade, rescue service and security as an operational control system, and in the integrated passenger flow control centre as a workflow system. The system currently in use is foreseeably reaching its technical limits, so that a replacement is necessary. The functions to be replaced by new systems include operational control and force deployment, hazard report management and the provision of geoinformation in the form of a geoproxy. Maintenance, servicing, service and support are also required for all new systems. Applicants must sign a confidentiality agreement provided by Fraport (see informational documents) and submit it together with the application to participate. After the call for competition, an indicative tender round will initially be carried out as part of the tender phase, which will then be followed by one or more binding tender rounds. Within the indicative tender round, the tenderers may propose changes to the contract, service description and annexes. Fraport will decide on their acceptance or rejection. The contracting authority points out now that the contractor must mandatorily provide the following evidence in the event of being requested to submit a binding tender: 1. All persons deployed in the project and in all maintenance, service and support services are German-speaking at least at level B2 according to the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages (CEFR) and are provided from a time zone UTC +0 to +3. 2. Proof of full access to the control of development resources and unrestricted authorisation to modify and expand the offered software and hardware. Due to the importance of the overall system to be procured here for the maintenance of flight operations and the mandatory framework schedule to be adhered to, Fraport may withdraw from the entire contract if the contractor culpably fails to provide, or fails to provide in accordance with the contract, services marked as "already available" in terms of hardware and software functions at the time of contract conclusion. The scope includes the delivery, agile (additional) development, commissioning with migration of legacy systems of a new operational control system for the security control centre and the integrated control centre for operational control and force deployment, the training of the employees of the Fraport AG as well as maintenance, service and support services.

parts.source: Neues Einsatzleitsystem [ELS] Die Fraport AG, mit Hauptsitz in Frankfurt am Main, ist ein weltweit führender Flughafenbetreiber. Das Unternehmen wurde 1924 gegründet und betreibt den Flughafen Frankfurt, eines der bedeutendsten Luftverkehrsdrehkreuze der Welt. Darüber hinaus ist Fraport an der Verwaltung und dem Betrieb von mehreren anderen Flughäfen weltweit beteiligt. Der Fraport betreibt am Standort Frankfurt am Main aktuell die Software (SW) ELDIS III der Fa. eurofunk als KRITIS und LuftSIG relevantes System in der Sicherheitsleitstelle mit den Dienstbereichen Werksfeuerwehr, Rettungsdienst sowie Security als Einsatzleitsystem und in der Integrierten Passagierflußleitstelle als Workflowsystem. Das aktuell im Einsatz befindliche System stößt absehbar an seine technischen Grenzen, so dass eine Ablösung notwendig ist. Die mit neuen Systemen abzulösenden Funktionen umfassen dabei die Einsatzleit- und Kräftedisposition, das Gefahrenmeldermanagement und die Bereitstellung von Geoinformationen in Form eines Geoproxy. Für alle neuen Systeme wird auch Wartung, Instandhaltung, Service und Support gefordert. Die Bewerber müssen eine von Fraport bereitgestellte Vertraulichkeitsvereinbarung (siehe informatorische Unterlagen) unterzeichnen und zusammen mit dem Teilnahmeantrag einreichen. Nach dem Teilnahmewettbewerb wird im Rahmen der Angebotsphase zunächst eine indikative Angebotsrunde durchgeführt, auf die dann eine oder mehrere verbindliche Angebotsrunden folgen. Innerhalb der indikativen Angebotsrunde können Änderungsvorschläge an Vertrag, Leistungsbeschreibung und Anhängen durch die Bieter angebracht werden. Fraport entscheidet über deren Annahme oder Ablehnung. Der Auftraggeber weist schon jetzt darauf hin, dass der Auftragnehmer im Falle der Aufforderung zur Abgabe eines verbindlichen Angebots zwingend die folgenden Nachweise zu erbringen hat: 1. Alle im Projekt und allen Wartung, Service und Supportleistung eingesetzte Personen sind deutschsprachig mindestens auf dem Niveau B2 gem. des europäischen Referenzrahmens für Sprachen (GER) und werden aus einer Zeitzone UTC +0 bis +3 zur Verfügung gestellt. 2. Nachweis eines vollumfänglichen Zugriff auf die Steuerung der Entwicklungsressourcen und uneingeschränkte Berechtigung zur Veränderung und Erweiterung der angebotenen Soft- und Hardware. Aufgrund der Bedeutung des vorliegend zu beschaffenden Gesamtsystems für die Aufrechterhaltung des Flugbetriebs zwingend notwendig einzuhaltenden Rahmenterminplan, kann Fraport vom gesamten Vertrag zurückzutreten, wenn der Auftragnehmer zum Vertragsschluss als "bereits verfügbar" gekennzeichnete Leistungen im Sinne von Hard- und Softwarefunktionen schuldhaft nach Vertragsschluss nicht oder nicht vertragsgemäß erbringt. Der Umfang umfasst die Lieferung, agile (Zusatz-)entwicklung, Inbetriebnahme mit Migration der Altsysteme eines neuen Einsatzleitsystem für die Sicherheitsleitstelle und die Integrierte Leitstelle zur Einsatzleitung- und Kräftedisposition, die Schulung der Mitarbeiter der Fraport AG sowie Wartungs-, Service- und Supportleistungen.

result.text: The contracting authority is tendering a contract regarding Transition In, development of the Modernised Support Systems, application operation, application maintenance, support, ordering services, including further development of the Support Systems, as well as Transition Out. The contract consists of the following 3 main services: I. Transition In, including, among other things, a secure and stable takeover of the application responsibility for the Support Systems, implementation of, for example, project management, transition organisation, transfer of source code and documentation, implementation of technical transition and necessary transformation, takeover of knowledge from the outgoing supplier as well as establishment of the operations organisation, including establishment of the collaboration with the operations supplier. II. Ongoing services for the Support Systems, including; a. Support, including, among other things, responsibility for Service Desk, user administration, handling of incidents, problems, service requests, early life support, cf. the operational processes, with the aim of ensuring high availability for the users; b. Application operation, including, among other things, database operation, operation of middleware, backup, restore, monitoring and logging, 2. and 3. line support, configuration, patch, and release and deployment management, cf. the operational processes, and operational reporting with high requirements for uptime and response times; c. Application maintenance, including, among other things, ongoing and preventive maintenance of the IT systems, minor changes, new versions, bug fixes, release management, cf. the operational processes, with the aim of supporting high requirements for uptime and response times; d. Governance, including close collaboration with the operations supplier, operational processes, security services, documentation and operational reporting. III. Agile development, e.g. via a design and planning phase, including proof of concept, as well as a development phase based on the supplier's product vision and advice. Development of the Modernised Support Systems takes place agilely in close collaboration between the parties regarding support for the contracting authority's business goals and needs, so that the Modernised Support Systems can be implemented after a time-limited period. Development includes any new functionality as well as any re-implementation and reuse of parts of the current Support Systems. Further development of the Support Systems also takes place agilely in close collaboration between the parties. It is the contracting authority's business need that all services are delivered with high delivery reliability and robustness, and that the supplier demonstrates proactivity in the collaboration. In Transition In, the supplier must take over the application responsibility for the Support Systems and, from the transition day, deliver ongoing services, including, among other things, application operation, application maintenance and further development, to the Support Systems. The further development will take place in a close, agile collaboration with the contracting authority. The supplier must also, in a close, agile collaboration with the contracting authority, carry out a modernisation of the Support Systems based on the contracting authority's modernisation wishes. The Support Systems are part of the overall joint municipal infrastructure, and the supplier must therefore collaborate partly with the other suppliers, including the operations supplier as well as suppliers who deliver other parts of the joint municipal infrastructure, and partly with users of the infrastructure. It is the contracting authority's business goal and need, among other things, to give parts of the current Support Systems a quality boost in the form of a modernisation that supports the Modernised Support Systems appearing attractive, reliable, future-proof and secure, so that the municipalities also in the future have a strong foundation to deliver the best digital services to the citizens in an increasingly more coherent, efficient and modern public sector.

Udvikling af de Moderniserede Støttesystemer sker agilt i tæt samarbejde mellem Parterne ift. understøttelse af ordregivers Forretningsmæssige Mål og Behov, således at de Moderniserede Støttesystemer kan implementeres efter en tidsbegrænset periode. Udvikling omfatter evt. ny funktionalitet samt evt. reimplementering og genbrug af dele af de Nuværende Støttesystemer. Videreudvikling af Støttesystemerne sker ligeledes agilt i tæt samarbejde mellem Parterne. Det er ordregivers forretningsmæssige behov, at alle Ydelser leveres med høj leverancesikkerhed og robusthed, samt at Leverandøren udviser proaktivitet i samarbejdet. Leverandøren skal i Transition Ind overtage applikationsansvaret for Støttesystemerne og fra Transitionsdagen levere Løbende Ydelser, herunder blandt andet Applikationsdrift, Applikationsvedligeholdelse og Videreudvikling, til Støttesystemerne. Videreudviklingen vil ske i et tæt, agilt samarbejde med ordregiver. Leverandøren skal ligeledes i et tæt, agilt samarbejde med ordregiver foretage en modernisering af Støttesystemerne ud fra ordregivers moderniseringsønsker. Støttesystemerne er en del af den samlede fælleskommunale infrastruktur, og Leverandøren skal derfor samarbejde dels med de Øvrige Leverandører, herunder Driftsleverandøren samt leverandører, der leverer øvrige dele af den fælleskommunale infrastruktur, dels med Anvendere af infrastrukturen. Det er ordregivers Forretningsmæssige Mål og Behov bl.a. at give dele af de Nuværende Støttesystemer et kvalitetsmæssigt løft i form af en modernisering, der understøtter, at de Moderniserede Støttesystemer fremstår attraktive, pålidelige, fremtidssikrede og sikre, så kommunerne også i fremtiden har et stærkt fundament til at levere de bedste digitale ydelser til borgerne i en tiltagende mere sammenhængende, effektiv og moderne offentlig sektor.

rejected.text: Short description The Landtag Brandenburg based in Potsdam is the parliament of the State of Brandenburg. The parliamentary administration acts as a service provider for the parliament and the citizens of the State of Brandenburg. The task of the parliamentary administration is to ensure the smoothest possible operation of parliamentary business and to create the organisational, personnel, technical and material conditions for the work of the members of the Landtag. Further information on the Landtag and the parliamentary administration can be found on the internet at: https://www.landtag.brandenburg.de/ In its activities, the parliamentary administration uses its own specialist IT procedure - the "Electronic Landtag Case Processing and Information System", or ELVIS for short. This supports parliamentary processes such as the preparation, implementation and follow-up of plenary and committee meetings as well as their corresponding record-keeping. It is currently used for daily work by around 60 of the 170 employees of the parliamentary administration. ELVIS no longer meets current technical and functional requirements. Therefore, this procurement procedure aims to find a provider for the introduction of a successor system. The new specialist IT procedure to be introduced bears the internal designation LISA.BB. The aim of the procurement procedure is the implementation of a modern, high-performance and future-proof system to succeed ELVIS, which supports the parliamentary work of the Landtag in a flexible and digital manner. LISA.BB is intended to map essential processes, in particular those of the plenary and committees, including record-keeping. The software-supported mapping of central workflows is intended to increase efficiency, transparency and traceability within the parliamentary administration. Seamless integration into existing and future third-party systems is intended to enable media-disruption-free end-to-end processes and avoid redundant data entry. The user interface should be designed to be user-friendly, accessible and intuitive, and the system architecture should be designed for extensibility, maintainability and adaptability to organisational and technical changes. Essential software components required for the operation of ELVIS will no longer be available in the foreseeable future. Therefore, the Landtag Brandenburg is aiming for the introduction of LISA.BB at the beginning of the year 2027. see short description

parts.source: Kurze Beschreibung Der Landtag Brandenburg mit Sitz in Potsdam ist das Parlament des Landes Brandenburg. Die Landtagsverwaltung ist Dienstleister für das Parlament und die Bürgerinnen und Bürger des Landes Brandenburg. Aufgabe der Landtagsverwaltung ist es, den möglichst reibungslosen Ablauf des parlamentarischen Betriebes sicherzustellen und die organisatorischen, personellen, technischen und materiellen Voraussetzungen für die Arbeit der Abgeordneten im Landtag zu schaffen. Mehr Informationen zum Landtag und zur Landtagsverwaltung finden sich im Internet unter: https://www.landtag.brandenburg.de/ Bei ihrer Tätigkeit nutzt die Landtagsverwaltung ein eigenes IT-Fachverfahren - das "Elektronische Landtags-Vorgangsbearbeitungs- und Informationssystem", kurz: ELVIS. Dieses unterstützt die parlamentarischen Abläufe wie die Vorbereitung, Durchführung und Nachbereitung der Sitzungen von Plenum und Ausschüssen sowie deren entsprechender Veraktung. Aktuell wird es von rund 60 der 170 Beschäftigten der Landtagsverwaltung für die tägliche Arbeit genutzt. ELVIS entspricht nicht mehr den aktuellen technischen und funktionalen Anforderungen. Daher soll mit dem vorliegenden Vergabeverfahren ein Anbieter für die Einführung eines Nachfolgesystems gefunden werden. Das neu einzuführende IT-Fachverfahren trägt die hausinterne Bezeichnung LISA.BB. Ziel des Vergabeverfahrens ist die Implementierung eines modernen, leistungsfähigen und zukunftsfähigen Systems als Nachfolge von ELVIS, das die parlamentarische Arbeit des Landtages flexibel und digital unterstützt. LISA.BB soll wesentliche Prozesse, insbesondere die des Plenums und der Ausschüsse inklusive der Veraktung abbilden. Die softwaregestützte Abbildung zentraler Arbeitsabläufe soll Effizienz, Transparenz und Nachvollziehbarkeit innerhalb der Landtagsverwaltung steigern. Eine nahtlose Integration in bestehende und künftige Drittsysteme soll medienbruchfreie End-to-End-Prozesse ermöglichen und redundante Dateneingaben vermeiden. Die Nutzeroberfläche soll benutzungsfreundlich, barrierearm und intuitiv gestaltet, die Architektur des Systems auf Erweiterbarkeit, Wartbarkeit und Anpassbarkeit an organisatorische und technische Veränderungen ausgelegt werden. Wesentliche für den Betrieb von ELVIS notwendige Softwarekomponenten werden in absehbarer Zeit nicht mehr zur Verfügung stehen. Daher strebt der Landtag Brandenburg eine Einführung von LISA.BB zu Beginn des Jahres 2027 an. siehe kurze Beschreibung

PLEASE REVIEW THE UPDATED ANNOUNCEMENT IN FULL FOR SUBMISSION TIME, UPDATED TOPIC, AND FUNDING AMOUNT AND SCHEDULE CHANGES FROM CYCLE 1** TACTICAL BEHAVIORS FOR AUTONOMOUS MANEUVER COLLABORATIVE RESEARCH PROGRAM (TBAM-CRP) Future Army forces will be called upon to operate and maneuver in multi-domain operations (MDO), against a modern and capable peer adversary. The battlefield of the future may impose additional constraints on maneuver forces such as disruption in communication as well as positioning services. To field a highly capable fighting force in this future battlefield, novel tactics and doctrines leveraging nascent technologies in robotics and autonomous systems (RAS) will need to be developed. Teams of RAS will serve an increasingly critical role in the future force to deliver situational awareness, defend key locations or positions, or take point in dynamic and hazardous situations. Resilience to disruptions, failures, or unexpected scenarios, is a key quality for teams of RAS to operate alongside other future Army forces. The US Army Combat Capabilities Development Command (DEVCOM) Army Research Laboratory (ARL) is focused on developing fundamental understanding and informing the art-of-the-possible for warfighter concepts through research to greatly improve the scope of mission capabilities of teams of RAS, develop robust and resilient approaches to plan under extreme conditions of uncertainty, to learn coordinated strategies for groups of agents to achieve a common objective, all within a complex maneuver environment including adversaries. The Tactical Behaviors for Autonomous Maneuver Collaborative Research Program (TBAM-CRP) is focused on developing and experimentally evaluating coordinated and individual behaviors for small groups of autonomous agents to learn doctrinal as well as novel tactics for maneuvering in military relevant environments. The TBAM-CRP will leverage developments in other internal and extramural programs as well as identify new research directions to find novel solutions to these maneuver problems in analogical simulations representing complex realistic terrain. The Tactical Behaviors for Autonomous Maneuver Collaborative Research Program (TBAM-CRP) will consist of a series of sprint efforts executed with annual program reviews. Each topic will be focused on addressing a different set of scientific areas which will support the research aims of an associated ARL researcher from a related internal essential research program (ERP) or mission-funded program. The TBAM-CRP has been developed in coordination with other related ARL-funded collaborative efforts (see descriptions of ARL collaborative alliances at https://www.arl.army.mil/business/collaborativealliances/) and shares a common vision of highly collaborative academia-industry-government partnerships; however, it will be executed with a program model adapted from the Scalable, Adaptive, and Resilient Autonomy (SARA), which established a new paradigm for collaborative research. Some key properties of this new approach are described below: • TBAM-CRP sprint topics will be offered on a two-year cycle. Proposals will be solicited for a possible two-year period structured as a first-year pilot followed by a second-year option where the option may be awarded based upon progress assessed at an annual review. The FOA will be amended annually to identify a specific problem statement and scope for that specific cycle. The topics for each cycle will be chosen to address the long-term program goal. • Five new topics (Cycles 1-5) are expected in FY22, 24, 26, 28, 30. Each topic will be carefully chosen based on the previous accomplishments in the prior cycle(s), the development of new technologies and capabilities in the broader research and development communities, and the Army’s evolving needs for future capabilities. • For each topic, funding will be provided to those Recipients selected under a cooperative agreement (CA). • Enhanced Research Program funding from ARL or Other Government Agencies (OGAs) may become available during a cycle which provides a mechanism for growth and enhancement within the TBAM-CRP. A proposal should not include any discussion of the Enhanced Research Program. Recipients receiving a CA will be notified and provided details if the opportunity for Enhanced Research Program funding becomes available during their award period of performance. • There is no limitation on the place of performance, although on-site collaboration at ARL facilities and with ARL researchers as well as with other Recipients are encouraged. Research outcomes in this program must, at the very least, be demonstrated in sophisticated simulations of relevant environments. Together with ARL collaborators, these results may be adapted for higher TRL experimentation on surrogate platforms at ARL test facilities such as the Robotics Research Collaboration Campus (R2C2) at Graces Quarters, Aberdeen Proving Ground, Maryland.

result.text: • Recipients will be furnished with access to the ARL Autonomy Stack software suite as well as all relevant simulation tools and multi-agent learning support. • Recipients will be provided with information about the current state of the Autonomous Systems Enterprise (ASE) with an overview of developments in the associated collaborative research alliances including Distributed and Collaborative Intelligent Systems and Technology (DCIST), Scalable, Adaptive, and Resilient Autonomy (SARA), as well as internal ARL essential research programs including the AI for Maneuver and Mobility (AIMM), Emerging Overmatch Technologies (EOT), and Versatile Tactical Power and Propulsion (VICTOR). Capabilities demonstrated in simulation should reflect significant appropriate developments. This midpoint review is expected to take place as a mini symposium where Recipients can share results with one another along with the ARL community to foster further collaboration. • At the end of the second year, a capstone demonstration will be executed by those Recipients receiving an option to their award in a set of simulated relevant environments, either those environment scenarios provided by the Government and other program performers, or optionally of a specific environment developed by the Recipient to exhibit their developed capability. Any system level capability demonstration that can be made with the internal ARL collaborator or description of capability development and program contribution can also be made at this time. These system demonstrations are expected to coincide to foster further integration and adoption with related internal research programs as well as partner organizations from within the DEVCOM, other Army and DoD service branches and agencies, in addition to other government agencies. Proposals that follow the requirements of the FOA will be evaluated in accordance with merit-based, competitive procedures. These procedures will include evaluation factors and an adjectival and color rating system. A review team, consisting of a qualified group of Government scientists and managers will evaluate the compliant proposals and provide the results of that evaluation to the decision-maker for the Government. Relevant internal research program materials approved for public release and contact information will be provided to potential proposers during introductory presentations to help facilitate identification of collaboration between proposers and individual ARL researchers or internal research programs. Additional connections to ARL programs can be identified during the proposal review process. Eligible applicants under this FOA include institutions of higher education, nonprofit organizations, and for-profit organizations (i.e., large and small businesses) for scientific research in the knowledge domains outlined throughout this Funding Opportunity. Federally Funded Research and Development Centers (FFRDC) may propose as well, with effort as allowed by their sponsoring agency and in accordance with their sponsoring agency policy.

result.text: The subject of the procurement is Fingrid’s purchase order and invoice management system delivered as a SaaS service. The software service is intended to support the entire procure-to-pay process in the target state, including purchase requests (free text, catalog, punchout catalog), purchase orders, order confirmations, receipt of goods, invoice receipt and processing. As part of the invoice processing functionality, the system must also include e-invoicing operator capabilities, enabling the sending and receiving of electronic invoices in accordance with applicable standards and integration requirements. Additionally, the system must include functionalities for supplier management, contract management, and mini competitions. The procured SaaS service must include user licenses for all Fingrid employees. The procurement also includes an implementation project, which is preliminarily planned to start during the first half of 2026. The implementation is intended to proceed in phases and be completed by Q4/2026. The support and advisory service included in the procurement serves as a second-level support channel (2nd line support) for Fingrid’s key users/application owners in case of incidents. In addition, during the contract period, the Client may procure development work, project work, and extensions to expand and improve the subject of the procurement. A more detailed description of the procurement is provided in Annex 1 of the procurement notice, Project Description.

result.text: The procurement is being carried out as a procurement consortium involving the City of Helsinki and DigiHelsinki Oy (hereinafter the "Client"). The subject of the procurement is delivery and operational services for Microsoft Dynamics 365 and Power Platform systems and related technologies (hereinafter also "Applications"), as well as further development and other expert services included in this package. Services refer to both expert services during implementation projects and development projects, as well as continuous services after implementation, such as support and maintenance services, further development, processing of change requests, technical expert support, architecture and integration expertise, service management tasks, and training. The services may include the definition, design, implementation, testing, and deployment of the Applications, as well as operation, maintenance, support, and development services, architecture services, any data migrations and integrations included in the implementations, support for process harmonisation during deliveries, and assessment of licence needs, as well as training services and documentation. The Applications to be implemented on the basis of this procurement subject will be produced on the Microsoft Dynamics 365 or Power Platform. A framework arrangement will be formed from the procurement, from which three suppliers will be selected in order of priority. The tendering process will be carried out using an open procedure. Each participant in the procurement consortium will make its own procurement decision and contract with the tenderers selected for the framework arrangement. The maximum value of the procurement is nine (9) million euros (VAT 0 %). Based on the framework arrangement, the Client and the Client's sectors, agencies, public utility services, and DigiHelsinki Oy may procure the Services or Continuous services referred to in the framework arrangement through separate delivery contracts. Delivery contracts may also relate to Applications implemented by the Client itself or in cooperation with other contractual partners. If several suppliers participate in the implementation, maintenance, or further development of the same Application, the division of responsibilities and the suppliers' cooperation obligations will be defined in the delivery contract. Deliveries may also include components implemented with other technologies in connection with Microsoft Dynamics 365 and Power Platform implementations, such as integration into an external database, interface, or software component, etc. The subject and scope of the procurement are set out in more detail in the call for tenders and its appendices.

parts.source: Hankinta toteutetaan hankintarenkaana, jossa on mukana Helsingin kaupunki ja DigiHelsinki Oy (jäljempänä "Tilaaja"). Hankinnan kohteena on Microsoft Dynamics 365 ja Power Platform -järjestelmiin ja näihin liittyviin teknologioihin (jäljempänä myös ”Sovellukset”) toimitus- ja käytönaikaisia palveluita sekä jatkokehitystä ja muita tähän kokonaisuuteen sisältyviä asiantuntijapalveluita. Palveluilla tarkoitetaan sekä käyttöönottoprojektien ja kehittämishankkeiden aikaisia asiantuntijapalveluja että käyttöönoton jälkeisiä jatkuvia palveluja, kuten tuki- ja ylläpitopalveluja, jatkokehitystä, muutospyyntöjen käsittelyä, teknistä asiantuntijatukea, arkkitehtuuri- ja integraatio-osaamista, palvelunhallintaan liittyviä tehtäviä sekä koulutuksia. Palvelut voivat sisältää Sovellusten määrittelyä, suunnittelua, toteutusta, testaamista, käyttöönottoja, sekä käyttö-, ylläpito-, tuki- ja kehityspalveluita, arkkitehtuuripalveluita, mahdollisia toteutuksiin sisältyviä datamigraatioita ja integraatioita, toimitusten aikaista prosessien harmonisointitukea ja lisenssitarpeiden arviointia sekä koulutuspalveluita ja dokumentointia. Tämän hankinnan kohteen pohjalta toteutettavat Sovellukset tuotetaan Microsoft Dynamics 365- tai Power Platform -alustalle. Hankinnasta muodostetaan puitejärjestely, johon valitaan kolme toimittajaa etusijajärjestyksellä. Kilpailutus toteutetaan avoimella menettelyllä. Hankintarenkaaseen osallistuvat tekevät kumpikin oman hankintapäätöksen ja sopimuksen puitejärjestelyyn valittujen tarjoajien kanssa. Hankinnan enimmäisarvo on yhdeksän (9) miljoonaa euroa (alv 0 %). Puitejärjestelyn perusteella Tilaaja ja Tilaajan toimialat, virastot, liikelaitokset ja DigiHelsinki Oy voivat hankkia Puitejärjestelyn tarkoittamia Palveluita tai Jatkuvia palveluita erillisillä toimitussopimuksilla. Toimitussopimukset voivat liittyä myös Tilaajan itse toteuttamiin tai yhteistyössä muiden sopimuskumppanien kanssa toteutettuihin Sovelluksiin. Jos saman Sovelluksen toteuttamiseen, ylläpitoon tai jatkokehittämiseen osallistuu useita toimittajia, vastuunjako ja toimittajien yhteistyövelvoitteet määritellään toimitussopimuksessa. Toimitukset voivat sisältää Microsoft Dynamics 365- ja Power Platform -toteutusten yhteydessä myös muilla teknologioilla toteutettuja komponentteja, kuten esimerkiksi integraation ulkoiseen tietokantaan, rajapintaan, tai ohjelmistokomponenttiin tms. Hankinnan kohde ja laajuus käy ilmi tarkemmin tarjouspyynnöstä ja sen liitteistä.

result.text: Helsingin kaupungin asunnot Oy (Heka) requests tenders for a purchase invoice accounting and routing solution using artificial intelligence (SaaS service) and related implementation, training and expert services. The objective of the procurement is to streamline the processing of purchase invoices, reduce manual work, improve the quality of accounting entries and increase the level of automated processing. The solution to be offered must enable: - analysis and utilisation of purchase invoice data - generation of accounting forecasts at invoice and line level - automated routing of invoices - continuous learning of the solution and improvement of forecasts based on usage - utilisation of corrections made by users in the development of models - reporting and monitoring of service performance. The solution must integrate with Heka's current purchase invoice system via the interfaces of the DataCycle360 system. A 24-month fixed-term contract will be concluded for the procurement, after which the contract period will continue until further notice. The contract will enter into force when the procurement contract has been signed by both parties. The more detailed content of the procurement, functional requirements, integration requirements and service level requirements are presented in the appendices to the call for tenders.

parts.source: Helsingin kaupungin asunnot Oy (Heka) pyytää tarjouksia ostolaskujen tiliöinti- ja reititysratkaisusta tekoälyä hyödyntäen (SaaS-palvelu) sekä siihen liittyvistä käyttöönotto-, koulutus- ja asiantuntijapalveluista. Hankinnan tavoitteena on tehostaa ostolaskujen käsittelyä, vähentää manuaalista työtä, parantaa tiliöintien laatua sekä nostaa automaattisen käsittelyn astetta. Tarjottavan ratkaisun tulee mahdollistaa: - ostolaskudatan analysointi ja hyödyntäminen - tiliöintiennusteiden muodostaminen lasku- ja rivitasolla - laskujen automatisoitu reititys - ratkaisun jatkuva oppiminen ja ennusteiden parantaminen käytön perusteella - käyttäjien tekemien korjausten hyödyntäminen mallien kehittämisessä - raportointi ja seuranta palvelun suorituskyvystä. Ratkaisun tulee integroitua Hekan nykyiseen ostolaskujärjestelmään DataCycle360-järjestelmän rajapintojen kautta. Hankinnassa tehdään 24 kuukauden määräaikainen sopimus, jonka jälkeen sopimuskausi jatkuu toistaiseksi voimassa olevana. Sopimus tulee voimaan, kun hankintasopimus on allekirjoitettu molempien osapuolten toimesta. Hankinnan tarkempi sisältö, toiminnalliset vaatimukset, integraatiovaatimukset sekä palvelutasovaatimukset on esitetty tarjouspyynnön liitteissä.

result.text: With this tender, University Medical Center Mainz intends to procure, implement and operate a new hospital information system. The subject of the contract is the implementation and operation of a hospital information system (HIS) for Universitätsmedizin der Johannes Gutenberg-Universität Mainz KöR (hereinafter referred to as "UM"). The project comprises the introduction of a hospital information system (HIS), which includes a clinical workstation system (CWS) with integrated patient administration and billing. The aim is to provide seamless, efficient and future-proof support for administrative and clinical processes and to ensure long-term operation. Further information on the subject of the tender can be found in the specification of services. This will be made available to all interested companies as part of the application procedure. Further information will be provided upon submission of a confidentiality agreement. Details can be found in Appendix 1 to these procurement documents.

parts.source: Die Universitätsmedizin Mainz beabsichtigt mit dieser Ausschreibung ein neues Krankenhausinformationssystem zu beschaffen, zu implementieren und zu betreiben. Gegenstand der Vergabe ist die Implementierung und der Betrieb eines Krankenhausinformationssystems (KIS) für die Universitätsmedizin der Johannes Gutenberg-Universität Mainz KöR (im Folgenden "UM"). Das Projekt umfasst die Einführung eines Krankenhausinformationssystems (KIS), welches ein klinisches Arbeitsplatzsystem (KAS) mit integrierter Patientenverwaltung und Abrechnung umfasst. Ziel ist es, eine durchgängige, effiziente und zukunftsfähige Unterstützung der administrativen und klinischen Prozesse bereitzustellen und den Betrieb langfristig sicherzustellen. Nähere Informationen zum Ausschreibungsgegenstand sind der Leistungsbeschreibung zu entnehmen. Diese wird im Rahmen des Teilnahmewettbewerbs allen interessierten Unternehmen bereitgestellt. Weitere Informationen werden gegen Abgabe einer Vertraulichkeitserklärung zur Verfügung gestellt. Die Einzelheiten sind der Anlage 1 zu diesen Vergabeunterlagen zu entnehmen.

result.text: South Lanarkshire Council are looking to notify the market of a potential future contract opportunity to deliver Sign In/Sign Out facilities for Operatives within Grounds Services and Waste Services, although it is possible that this may be extended to other Services within the Council in the future. This facility would initially be required for approximately 900 employees across 10 separate locations. Given the nature of the duties which these Operatives carry out, the use of cards, fobs, and lanyards is not practical for Health & Safety reasons. The preference would be to use fingerprint reader technology, although the facility to manually sign in or sign out using alternative methods, such as a username/password or PIN, would be required for both onsite and offsite use. As South Lanarkshire Council has recently implemented Oracle Fusion Cloud and uses the Oracle Time and Labour (OTL) module of that system within some Service Areas, it is a requirement that any Sign In/Sign Out System operates or integrates directly with the OTL module. The link between the two systems would allow for the transfer of sign in/sign out details, working patterns, annual leave, sickness absence, public holidays, season shutdowns, new starts, departures, etc. Grounds Services and Waste Services are looking to go out to tender in April 2026, with an award date of June 2026, and an implementation start date of September 2026. Please complete and return market engagement questionnaire to Georgie.Howley@southlanarkshire.gov.uk to register your interest. Lot 1: . result.text: The subject of the tender is the commissioning of strategic and operational consulting services for the health and long-term care insurance fund KNAPPSCHAFT (incl. cross-sectional areas and regional directorates). The overarching objective is the stabilisation and, in the long term, the consolidation of the KNAPPSCHAFT within the KBS network system as well as the creation of an efficient and competitive organisational structure. The specific service requirements include, among other things, the optimisation of management capability and performance in the core service areas of the KNAPPSCHAFT, the optimisation of financial processes in the joint carrier DRV KBS, the improvement of processes and efficiency, particularly with regard to personnel deployment, as well as the derivation of possible organisational adjustments, the redefinition of the strategic orientation and market position after successful consolidation, and support for transformation processes, change management, empowerment and communication. This is a framework agreement. The services are to be provided upon call-off by the contractor. The maximum call-off volume of the framework agreement is 23 million euros incl. VAT. There is no obligation to call off and, accordingly, no entitlement to remuneration.

parts.source: Gegenstand der Ausschreibung ist die Beauftragung von strategischen und operativen Beratungsleistungen für die Kranken- und Pflegeversicherung KNAPPSCHAFT (inkl. Querschnittsbereichen und Regionaldirektionen). Die übergeordnete Zielsetzung ist die Stabilisierung und perspektivisch die Konsolidierung der KNAPPSCHAFT innerhalb des Verbundsystems der KBS sowie die Schaffung einer effizienten und wettbewerbsfähigen Organisationsstruktur. Zur konkreten Leistungsanforderung gehören u.a. die Optimierung der Steuerungsfähigkeit und Leistungsfähigkeit in den Kernleistungsbereichen der KNAPPSCHAFT, die Optimierung der Finanzprozesse im Verbundträger DRV KBS, die Verbesserung der Prozesse und der Effizienz insbesondere im Hinblick auf den Personaleinsatz sowie Ableitung möglicher Organisationsanpassungen, die Neufestlegung der strategischen Ausrichtung und Marktposition nach erfolgter Konsolidierung sowie Begleitung der Transformationsprozesse, Change Management, Befähigung und Kommunikation. Es handelt sich um einen Rahmenvertrag. Die Leistungen sind nach Abruf durch den Auftragnehmer zu erbringen. Die abrufbare Höchstmenge der Rahmenvereinbarung liegt bei 23 Mio. Euro inkl. MwSt. Es besteht keine Abrufverpflichtung und entsprechend kein Vergütungsanspruch.

result.text: As part of the FSA’s commitment to ensure food is safe and is what it says it is, the FSA undertakes food safety risk assessments which underpin these decisions in line with the internationally recognised ‘Codex Working Principles for Risk Analysis for Food Safety’. A key component of food safety risk assessment is exposure assessment, which estimates the amount of a hazard consumed through the diet. Exposure assessment combines food consumption data with information on the concentrations of substances such as contaminants, food additives or pesticide residues in food to estimate the levels consumers may be exposed to. To conduct UK dietary exposure assessments, the FSA uses consumption data in combination with occurrence data for hazards and other substances in food. UK consumption data is primarily obtained from the UK National Diet and Nutrition Survey (NDNS). The National Diet and Nutrition Survey (NDNS) is a co-funded programme between the Department of Health and Social Care (DHSC) Office for Health Improvement and Disparities (OHID) and FSA. NDNS is a rolling programme which assesses the diet, nutrient intake and nutritional status of the general population of the UK. Tenders are invited to carry out the recoding of NDNS consumption data to FoodEx2, a standardised system for classifying and describing food. Lot 1: . None

result.text: Background and purpose Arendal is located in the central part of Sørlandet. The municipality has approx. 46,000 inhabitants. Arendal municipality has a decentralised school structure with 16 municipal primary and secondary schools, organised as independent entities with separate rectors and management groups. The schools include both combined 1st - 10th schools and pure primary schools (1st - 7th years), as well as a resource centre with tenders across the stages. The municipality has a total of approx. 5,000 pupils in the primary and lower secondary schools. Arendal municipality is in an ongoing change of the school structure. Two primary schools (1st – 7th years) and the secondary school for one school have been decided to be folded. The changes are planned to be implemented from 01.01.2027. The overall responsibility for the school area is at the school office, which follows up on joint priorities, quality work and regulations, and acts as a link between the political level and the schools. The cooperation between the school office and the schools will take place, among other things, through fixed meeting points and joint development work, at the same time that each school adapts the work to local needs. The adult education is organised as a part of the municipality ́s training and is also a user of relevant digital services. Arendal municipality needs a joint system for the administration, distribution and access management of digital teaching aids in primary and secondary schools. The municipality has used a system for this purpose over time and has developed good experience with procurement, licence management and access management in this area. The procurement will be carried out as a result of the expiry of the existing agreement and shall ensure the continuation and further development of this work. Information on the procurement and process is in the document Konkurransegrunnlag_Digital Platform for schools. Scope The estimated annual scope is challenging to estimate. This is connected with the complexity, changes in the school structure and a market with different actors. We estimate that the annual turnover will be NOK 3.0 million excluding VAT, which over 8 years will be NOK 24 million excluding VAT. The contract will have a valid amount of NOK 30 million excluding VAT during the contract period. The estimated scope is based on experiences with the current supplier, market dialogue and indicative prices in the market. The estimated scope is not binding for the contracting authority. The following is not included in this procurement: - Learning platform (LMS) and educational follow-up. - functionality connected to artificial intelligence (KI) - other school administrative systems. The procurement is for the administration and distribution of digital teaching aids and a learning tool. Handling printed teaching aids is not included. The procurement does not include discipline specific teaching aids or individual applications. Reservations All conditions that the tenderer has for the tender shall be stated in the point conditions in the requirement specification document. Alternative tenders Alternative tenders cannot be submitted. Documents Please see the attached documents. Note that the tenderer shall fill in information in the attached documents.

result.text: NHS Blood and Transplant (NHSBT) is procuring delivery partners for the Donor and Session Programme (DASP), a strategic digital transformation programme to modernise donor engagement, appointment booking, session management and related donor-facing and operational capabilities across blood, platelets and plasma. The procurement is divided into two Lots: Lot 1: Technical Implementation Partner The Technical Implementation Partner will support the technical implementation of the selected CRM Platform and associated digital ecosystem. The scope includes solution design, configuration, integration, data migration, testing, deployment, transition, implementation governance, technical assurance and operational readiness. Suppliers tendering for Lot 1 must align their Tender Response to one of the eligible CRM Platforms identified in the Invitation to Tender documents. The proposed technical solution, implementation approach and associated commercial submissions must be prepared consistently on the basis of the selected CRM Platform. Lot 2: Business Change Partner The Business Change Partner will support the business change, adoption and operational transformation required to implement DASP successfully. The scope includes operating model and workforce transformation, stakeholder engagement, change impact assessment, communications, learning and capability development, adoption planning, business readiness, benefits realisation and transition to business as usual. NHSBT intends to award a single-supplier contract for each Lot. Suppliers may tender for either Lot or both Lots but must submit a complete and independently compliant Tender Response for each Lot tendered for. result.text: Puolustusvoimien logistiikkalaitos (hereinafter the contracting authority) invites you to submit a request to participate in the Haapajärvi charging plant production line development project for the Finnish Defence Forces in accordance with this call for requests to participate and its annexes. Subject of the procurement: Planning and development site located in the production area of the Haapajärvi unit of the explosives centre. The main tasks are: The contracting authority wishes to develop the production line using automation and robotics. The aim is simultaneously to minimise the number of personnel. The candidate must state the number of personnel required for the modernised line at the stated capacities. The contracting authority has selected the following objects for automation: Renewal of the existing lower conveyor, including automation of the existing laboratory work (includes thread cleaning and inspection, attaching / installing the intermediate piece, and loading the upper conveyor), automation of the attachment of the existing cavity base and automation of the existing weighing operation. The procurement includes all necessary design work, dismantling of obsolete technology, and delivery and installation of new technology in the explosive premises (IP54 T4) as a turnkey delivery in accordance with the procurement documents. The selected supplier must design all possible operations of the procurement object to be automated and to operate automatically. Likewise, the machines and equipment to be modernised must be designed to function as independent parts of the rest of the existing production equipment. The modernised line must meet the ergonomics requirements and capacity needs with 81 VRTKR, 120 VRTKR and 155 TKR products. There are various versions of these products, and these versions are specified in separately delivered drawings. The main tasks included in the delivery are listed as follows: 1) Production capacity in accordance with requirements and minimisation of the number of personnel 2) Renewal of the existing lower conveyor 3) Automation of the operations of the existing laboratory work (including thread cleaning and inspection, installation of the detonator, attaching / installing the intermediate piece, and loading the upper conveyor) 4) Automation of the operations of the existing cavity base attachment 5) Automation of the existing weighing operation. Items 2 to 5 include design, dismantling of the existing redundant part, and necessary equipment deliveries and installations. The objective is to carry out the procurement (including the design phase) during the years 2026 to 2027, such that the timing of the installation of the new technology would be as follows: Working hours at the site are possible 19.07.2027 to 15.10.2027 (weeks 29 to 41). The delivery must be ready by 15.10.2027. Working on site is permitted during installations around the clock every day of the week, if necessary. Before starting the installations, the selected supplier must carry out all necessary design. The selected supplier must present (in written and oral form) the entire implementation proposal for the procurement (including necessary plans and capacity calculations) to the Customer in good time, i.e. when the necessary plans are, in the supplier's opinion, ready for presentation. The final implementation documentation is included in the delivery scope of the procurement. The contracting parties shall agree on the more precise installation schedule within the aforementioned delivery schedule in accordance with the terms of the procurement contract to be signed after the selection of the supplier. The final acceptance is preceded by trial runs (cold run / hot run), capacity runs, training, delivery of final documentation and official inspections. The new equipment must be fully ready for use and production by 15.10.2027. The contracting authority will send the invitation to tender and its annexes (incl. technical specification) on the basis of this call for requests to participate to the tenderers approved by the contracting authority.

parts.source: Puolustusvoimien logistiikkalaitos (jäljempänä hankintayksikkö) pyytää osallistumishakemustanne Haapajärven lataamon tuotantolinjaston kehittämishankintaan Puolustusvoimille tämän osallistumishakemuspyynnön ja sen liitteiden mukaisesti. Hankinnan kohde: Räjähdekeskuksen Haapajärven toimipisteen tuotantoalueella sijaitseva suunnittelu- ja kehittämiskohde Päätehtävät ovat: Hankintayksikkö haluaa kehittää tuotantolinjastoa automatisoinnin ja robotiikan avulla. Tavoitteena on samalla henkilömäärän minimointi. Ehdokkaan tulee ilmoittaa modernisoidulla linjastolla tarvittava henkilömäärä ilmoitetuilla kapasiteeteilla. Hankintayksikkö on valinnut automatisoinnin kohteiksi: Nykyisen alapuolisen kuljettimen uusinta, mukaan lukien nykyisen laboroinnin automatisoinnin (sisältää kierteen puhdistus ja tarkastus, välikappaleen kiinnittäminen / asentaminen, sekä yläpuolisen kuljettimen lastaus), nykyisen onteloperän kiinnityksen automatisointi ja nykyisen punnitustoiminnon automatisointi. Hankinta sisältää kaiken tarvittavan suunnittelutyön, vanhentuneen tekniikan purkamisen sekä uuden tekniikan toimittamisen ja asentamisen räjähdetiloihin (IP54 T4) hankinta-asiakirjojen mukaisena kokonaistoimituksena. Valittavan toimittajan tulee suunnitella hankinnan kohteen kaikki mahdolliset toiminnot automatisoitaviksi ja automaattisesti toimiviksi. Samoin tulee suunnitella modernisoitavat koneet ja laitteet itsenäisesti toimiviksi osiksi muuta olemassa olevaa tuotantolaitteistoa. Modernisoidun linjaston tulee täyttää ergonomiavaatimukset ja kapasiteettitarpeet 81 VRTKR, 120 VRTKR ja 155 TKR tuotteilla. Kyseisillä tuotteilla on eri versioita ja nämä versiot selviävät erikseen toimitettavista piirustuksista. Toimitukseen kuuluvat päätehtävät lueteltuna: 1) Vaatimusten mukainen tuotantokapasiteetti sekä henkilömäärän minimointi 2) Nykyisen alapuolisen kuljettimen uusinta 3) Nykyisen laboroinnin (sisältäen kierteen puhdistus ja tarkastus, räjäyttimen asentaminen, välikappaleen kiinnittäminen / asentaminen, sekä yläpuolisen kuljettimen lastaus) toimintojen automatisointi 4) Nykyisen onteloperän kiinnityksen toimintojen automatisointi 5) Nykyisen punnitustoiminnon automatisointi. Kohdat 2 - 5 sisältävät suunnittelun, nykyisen turhaksi jäävän osuuden purkamisen sekä tarvittavat laitteistotoimitukset ja asennukset. Tavoitteena on toteuttaa hankinta (mukaan lukien suunnitteluvaihe) vuosien 2026 - 2027 aikana, siten että uuden tekniikan asennusajankohta olisi seuraavan mukainen: Kohteessa työaika on mahdollista 19.07.2027 - 15.10.2027 (viikot 29 - 41). Toimituksen on oltava valmiina 15.10.2027 mennessä. Työskentely kohteessa sallittu asennuksien aikana tarvittaessa ympäri vuorokauden viikon jokaisen päivänä. Ennen asennusten aloittamista valittavan toimittajan on toteutettava kaikki tarvittava suunnittelu. Valittavan toimittajan tulee esitellä (kirjallisessa ja suullisessa muodossa) koko hankinnan toteutusehdotus (mukaan lukien tarvittavat suunnitelmat sekä kapasiteettilaskelmat) Asiakkaalle hyvissä ajoin, ts. kun tarvittavat suunnitelmat ovat toimittajan mielestä esittelyvalmiita. Lopullinen toteutusdokumentaatio sisältyy hankinnan toimitussisältöön. Sopijaosapuolet sopivat tarkemman asennusajankohdan edellä mainitussa toimitusaikataulussa allekirjoitettavan hankintasopimuksen ehtojen mukaisesti toimittajan valinnan jälkeen. Lopullista vastaanottoa edeltää koekäytöt (kylmäkoe- / kuumakoekäyttö), kapasiteettiajot, koulutukset, loppudokumentaation toimitus ja viranomaistarkastukset. Uusien laitteistojen tulee olla täysin käyttö- ja tuotantovalmiina 15.10.2027. Hankintayksikkö lähettää tarjouspyynnön ja sen liitteet (ml. tekninen määritelmä) tämän osallistumishakemuspyynnön perusteella hankintayksikön hyväksymille Tarjoajille.

result.text: Transport Technology (opening 2) Summary This framework agreement helps public sector organisations buy transport technology. It is now reopening to enable new suppliers to join. For more information on framework durations, see the original Find a Tender Notice . You can email info@gca.gov.uk if you have any questions. management solutions artificial intelligence (AI) powered traffic management tools environmental monitoring systems network management solutions transport infrastructure for road, rail, aviation and behavioural initiatives to prevent trespassing, property damage, theft and anti-social behaviour to enhance security to monitor vehicles to detect and manage moving traffic offences for incident safety and emergency response Lot 6: Zero emission vehicle infrastructure: electric vehicle infrastructure such as: professional services vehicle charging points back end platforms energy generation alternative fuel infrastructure and storage management and maintenance services Lot 7a: Systems and Platforms – Systems Integration: create a unified transport system. Services include: combining client hardware, software and other components system integration project management configuration testing and optimisation maintenance and support security and compliance Lot 7b: Systems and Platforms – Smart Ticketing: includes: system integration specifically for smart ticketing data services goods and services for ticketing payment and fare collection systems intelligent asset management transport management systems and real time monitoring platforms that support the management of transport networks licensing, deployment and configuration of platforms Lot 8a: Active and Passive Infrastructure – Network Devices: includes: delivery, installation, and support of communication devices wired, wireless, and mobile transport communications IoT devices systems, equipment and connectivity services for road, rail, maritime and aviation sectors Lot 8b: Active and Passive Infrastructure – Cabinets, Furniture, Storage and Ancillaries: includes: infrastructure services for management of the network Lot 8e: Active and Passive Infrastructure – Detectors, Informing and Communication Technologies: includes: detectors close circuit television cameras information systems and digital message signs and signals emergency road and tunnel telephones handheld radios Supplier engagement This framework, the second scheme in the Transport Technology
