result.text: The purpose of the tender is to contract operational services related to the crop monitoring and yield forecasting activities of the JRC.D.5 unit (MARSOP). Implementing Article 25 of the horizontal regulation of the Common Agricultural Policy REG (EU) 2021/2116 on Monitoring Agricultural Resources (MARS), JRC.D.5 provides DG AGRI with timely, independent, and high-quality information on crop state and development, including quantitative forecasts of agricultural yields and production in the EU and neighbouring countries. This information is used by DG AGRI to ensure food security and for decision-making in agricultural markets. The JRC provides matching staff for agricultural analysts and experts producing monthly JRC MARS Bulletins for Commission-internal and public use, which are well received by private sector stakeholders, academics and the general public. Such services have been outsourced since 2000 (MAROSP1-6), financed through a co-delegation with DG AGRI. The operational services sustain the operation and further development of the MARS Crop Yield Forecasting System (MCYFS) at the heart of the crop monitoring activities at D.5. For the current procurement, we plan to organize the operational services for the MARS System in three different lots: - Lot 1: Acquisition and processing of agro-meteorological information - Lot 2: Acquisition and processing of satellite data - Lot 3: Processing of agronomic information from crop models and statistics. Lot 1 - Acquisition and processing of agro-meteorological information: The objective of Lot 1 is to acquire and process in near real-time (NRT) agro-meteorological data for ingestion and use in the MARS System. The sources of meteorological data to be acquired and processed are basically two: observed weather data from meteorological stations in Europe, and modelled weather data generated at the European Centre for Medium-range Weather Forecasts (ECMWF) at various lead times. Data processing includes quality control, spatial and temporal aggregation, and NRT ingestion into the MARS System. Lot 2 - Acquisition and processing of satellite data: Lot 2 supports the remote sensing infrastructure of the MARS System for Europe and global coverage with specific, tailored products. The service comprises NRT data collection, pre-processing and computation of derived products for the remote sensing satellites MODIS/VIIRS as well as Copernicus products. Lot 3 - Processing of agronomic information from crop models and statistics: Services of this lot include the NRT execution of crop growth models over Europe driven by weather data for specific target crops as well as NRT processing of the Water Satisfaction Index at global level. The repeated collection and quality-control and processing of agricultural statistics, pheonological data, and other agronomic information is an intrinsic part of this lot.

result.text: Der Landkreis Nienburg/Weser plans the new construction of a fire brigade technical centre (FTZ) in the commercial area of the town of Lemke, municipality of Marklohe. This is a replacement building for the existing FTZ in Verdener Landstraße in Nienburg. The room programme comprises approx. 8.200 m2 of usable space, as well as approx. 9.140 m2 of outdoor areas – movement and exercise areas. A building site with an area of approx. 3,4 ha is available for this purpose. As part of the project, the erection of a building automation system is planned. Building automation comprises the automation, room automation and management level for monitoring, control, regulation and visualisation of the technical systems. Two central automation focuses are planned in the project. In addition to this, automation focuses are located in the vehicle hall, workshop hall and logistics hall respectively. For room automation, room automation distributors are arranged in the respective sub-distribution areas of electrical engineering. These room automation distributors map the functions of room automation. The integration of sun protection actuators, window contacts and the valves of the underfloor heating is carried out via I/O modules, which are connected to the room automation distributors. Lighting is integrated via KNX-DALI actuators installed in the electrical engineering sub-distributions. The respective interfaces and communication paths are to be coordinated accordingly with the electrical engineering and building automation trades. For the system technology, approx. 500 physical data points and approx. 550 shared data points are planned in the project. In the area of room automation, approx. 700 physical data points and approx. 2.000 shared data points are present.

parts.source: Der Landkreis Nienburg/Weser plant den Neubau einer Feuerwehrtechnischen Zentrale (FTZ) im Gewerbegebiet des Ortes Lemke, Gemeinde Marklohe. Es handelt sich um einen Ersatzneubau für die bestehende FTZ in der Verdener Landstraße in Nienburg. Das Raumprogramm umfasst ca. 8.200 m2 Nutzflächen, sowie ca. 9.140 m2 Außenbereiche – Bewegungs- und Übungsflächen. Hierzu steht ein ca. 3,4 ha großes Baufeld zur Verfügung. Im Rahmen des Projektes ist die Errichtung einer Gebäudeautomationsanlage vorgesehen. Die Gebäudeautomation umfasst die Automations-, Raumautomations- und Managementebene zur Überwachung, Steuerung, Regelung und Visualisierung der technischen Anlagen. Im Projekt sind zwei zentrale Automationsschwerpunkte vorgesehen. Ergänzend hierzu werden jeweils Automationsschwerpunkte in der Fahrzeughalle, Werkstatthalle und Logistikhalle verortet. Für die Raumautomation werden in den jeweiligen Unterverteilungsbereichen der Elektrotechnik Raumautomationsverteiler angeordnet. Diese Raumautomationsverteiler bilden die Funktionen der Raumautomation ab. Die Einbindung der Sonnenschutzantriebe, Fensterkontakte sowie der Ventile der Fußbodenheizung erfolgt über I/O-Module, welche auf die Raumautomationsverteiler aufgeschaltet werden. Die Beleuchtung wird über KNX-DALI-Aktoren eingebunden, welche in den Unterverteilungen der Elektrotechnik installiert werden. Die jeweiligen Schnittstellen und Kommunikationswege sind mit den Gewerken Elektrotechnik und Gebäudeautomation entsprechend abzustimmen. Für die Anlagentechnik sind im Projekt ca. 500 physikalische Datenpunkte sowie ca. 550 gemeinsame Datenpunkte vorgesehen. result.text: The purpose of this contract is the SERVICES FOR THE ANALYSIS, DESIGN, DEVELOPMENT AND IMPLEMENTATION OF A VIRTUAL AGENT COORDINATION SYSTEM (CoVA) APPLIED TO INTERGENERATIONAL ASSISTANCE FOR THE ADMINISTRATION OF THE PRINCIPALITY OF ASTURIAS which enables a proactive and efficient administration, covering both processes and people and the technology necessary for its proper use, security and management. This contract is part of Public Procurement of Innovative Technology (CPTI), its purpose has an innovative content and employs functional specifications, rather than technical requirements: It is aimed at the acquisition of a service that does not exist in the Principality of Asturias, but can be developed in a reasonable time, given that the technology is at a degree of development that allows it to do so. The main tasks included in this contract are the following: a. Implementation of a virtual agent coordination system based on artificial intelligence applied to intergenerational assistance for the Administration of the Principality of Asturias that allows the exploitation of the data generated and managed. b. All services necessary for the commissioning of the contracted elements, necessary subscriptions/licences, as well as their management and maintenance during the pilot demonstration phase. c. The exploitation of the potential of the data of the Administration of the Principality of Asturias (hereinafter, APA) to implement new forms of public management based on interoperability and data analytics. d. Establish the technological and procedural bases for the implementation of a proactive administration that allows the optimisation of public expenditure while maximising its performance. e. The development of techniques/rules for the automated management and classification of data, documents and files using advanced Artificial Intelligence techniques. f. The incorporation of deep learning techniques since these digitalisation processes can produce immense amounts of data for training and thus be able to provide processing that increases efficiency, effectiveness and intelligence in the processing of data in the processes of Public Administrations. g. The creation of a corporate data space that includes origin data, those that may have been inferred during the scope of use of the system, as well as facilitating interoperability and administrative processing circuits. h. Creation of a proactive care and assistance environment with citizens. i. Creation of a specialised sandbox that serves as an ideation and experimentation environment. j. Integration with the APA's electronic file processing system (SITE), and other applications and systems indicated in these specifications. k. Ensuring the artificial intelligence (AI) supply chain, for which measures will be implemented to guarantee the integrity and security of the artificial intelligence models at all stages, components and data used, with strict legal compliance with EU Regulation 2024/1689, and compliance with the decree 98/2025 regulating the use of artificial intelligence in the Administration of the Principality of Asturias.

Este contrato se enmarca en la Compra Pública de Tecnología Innovadora, (CPTI), su objeto tiene un contenido innovador y emplea especificaciones funcionales, y no requisitos técnicos: Se orienta a la adquisición de un servicio que no existe en el Principado de Asturias, pero puede desarrollarse en un tiempo razonable, dado que la tecnología está en un grado de desarrollo que así lo permite. Las tareas principales incluidas en este contrato son las siguientes: a. Implementación de un sistema de coordinación virtual de agentes basados en inteligencia artificial aplicados a la asistencia intergeneracional para la Administración del Principado de Asturias que permita el aprovechamiento de los datos generados y gestionados. b. Todos los servicios necesarios para la puesta en marcha de los elementos contratados, suscripciones/licencias necesarias, así como su gestión y mantenimiento durante la fase piloto de demostración. c. El aprovechamiento del potencial de los datos de la Administración del Principado de Asturias (en adelante, APA) para implementar nuevas formas de gestión pública basada en la interoperabilidad y analítica de datos. d. Establecer las bases tecnológicas y procedimentales para la implantación de una Administración proactiva que permita la optimización del gasto público maximizando su rendimiento. e. El desarrollo de técnicas/reglas para la gestión automatizada y clasificación de datos, documentos y expedientes mediante técnicas avanzadas de Inteligencia Artificial. f. La incorporación de técnicas de aprendizaje profundo (Deep Learning) ya que en estos procesos de digitalización pueden producir inmensas cantidades de datos para el entrenamiento y así poder dar un procesamiento que incremente la eficiencia, la eficacia y la inteligencia en el tratamiento de los datos en los procesos de las Administraciones Públicas. g. La creación de un espacio de datos corporativo que incluya los datos en origen, aquellos que se hayan podido inferir durante en el ámbito de uso del sistema, así como facilitar la interoperabilidad y circuitos de tramitación administrativa. h. Creación de un entono de atención y asistencia proactiva con la ciudadanía. i. Creación de un sandbox especializado que sirva de entorno de ideación y para la experimentación. j. Integración con el sistema de tramitación electrónica de expedientes (SITE) de la APA, y otras aplicaciones y sistemas indicados en este pliego. k. Asegurar la cadena de suministro de la inteligencia artificial (IA), para lo que se implementarán las medidas para garantizar la integridad y seguridad de los modelos de inteligencia artificial en todas las etapas, componentes y datos utilizados, con estricto cumplimiento legal del Reglamento UE 2024/1689, y cumplimiento con el decreto 98/2025 que regula el uso de la inteligencia artificial en la Administración del Principado de Asturias.

result.text: As a university of excellence with around 44.000 students, Universität Hamburg (UHH) is not only one of Germany's strongest research universities and largest universities – as a venue for research, teaching and education, it is above all a modern knowledge organisation. Nowadays, this knowledge is primarily held in the form of digital information and processed and imparted using digital tools. However, digitalisation goes far beyond the digital representation of information and its processing using digital methods: In the sense of a synergetic interaction between analogue and digital, digitality has long been an integral part of the reality of studying, research, teaching, learning, life and work at UHH. The corresponding digitalisation strategy of UHH is understood as a university-wide frame of reference for a reflective approach to the opportunities and challenges of digital transformation as well as the successful implementation of digitalisation projects and undertakings. The project "Support by a Managed Security Service Provider (MSSP)" aims to cover the security requirements of UHH's existing IT through a suitable service provider, provided this is not met by internal capacities. The subject of this procurement is the establishment and operation of a Security Operations Centre based at UHH, funded by the BWFG: ▪ Universität Hamburg (UHH) ▪ Hamburg University of Applied Sciences (HAW) ▪ Hamburg University of Technology Universität Hamburg (TUHH) ▪ HafenCity University Hamburg Universität Hamburg (HCU) ▪ Hamburg University of Fine Arts (HfBK) ▪ Hamburg University of Music and Theatre (HfMT). result.text: NHS Scotland intends to establish a national Framework Agreement for the provision of a Digital Diabetes Prevention and Primary Hypertension Programme. The programme will support individuals identified as being at risk of developing Type 2 Diabetes and/or those diagnosed with primary hypertension, through the delivery of evidence-based, digitally enabled lifestyle and behaviour change interventions. The Authority intends to appoint a single supplier to a national Framework Agreement. The procurement will be conducted using a Restricted Procedure, comprising a Selection Stage and an Invitation to Tender (ITT) stage. Suppliers will be shortlisted following evaluation of their suitability, technical and professional capability, capacity and relevant experience, with a maximum of five suppliers invited to submit a tender. Lot 1: . NHS Scotland intends to establish a national Framework Agreement for the provision of a Digital Diabetes Prevention and Primary Hypertension Programme. The Framework will support NHS Scotland's strategic objectives to improve population health outcomes, reduce health inequalities and support the prevention and management of long-term conditions through evidence-based, digitally enabled interventions. The requirement comprises a single integrated service with two pathways: - Digital Diabetes Prevention Programme (DDPP) for individuals identified as being at increased risk of developing Type 2 Diabetes; and - Primary Hypertension Programme (PHP) for individuals diagnosed with primary hypertension, supported through lifestyle and behaviour change interventions designed to improve health outcomes and reduce cardiovascular risk. The appointed Framework Participant will be required to deliver evidence-based, digitally enabled lifestyle and behaviour change interventions designed to support participants in achieving sustainable improvements in health behaviours and clinical outcomes. The service will utilise a digital platform/application supported by appropriately trained personnel, including health coaching and clinical governance arrangements, to facilitate participant engagement, self-management, education, monitoring and behaviour change. The service is expected to support a range of participant needs and will include, as appropriate, digital onboarding, risk assessment, lifestyle intervention, coaching support, educational resources, progress monitoring, outcome reporting and onward referral or escalation processes where clinically indicated. The Authority seeks a solution that is accessible, inclusive and capable of supporting diverse populations across Scotland, including individuals who may experience barriers to participation arising from geography, deprivation, language, disability or digital exclusion. The Framework Participant will be expected to work collaboratively with NHS Scotland, NHS Boards, Primary Care and other relevant stakeholders to support the promotion of the programme, participant recruitment and self-registration, service mobilisation, programme delivery, performance monitoring and continuous improvement. Current funding has been identified to support approximately 15,000 participants through the Diabetes Prevention pathway during the initial three-year term of the Framework Agreement. The Hypertension pathway is anticipated to support approximately 500 participants per annum. These figures are provided for information only and do not constitute a guarantee of volumes. The Authority reserves the right, subject to future funding availability and service requirements, to increase participant volumes and/or expand the scope of the Framework to include additional prevention cohorts, pathways, clinical indicators or service requirements that are closely aligned to the subject matter of the Framework Agreement. The Authority intends to appoint a single supplier to a national Framework Agreement. The procurement will be conducted using a Restricted Procedure. parts.source: NHS Scotland intends to establish a national Framework Agreement for the provision of a Digital Diabetes Prevention and Primary Hypertension Programme. The programme will support individuals identified as being at risk of developing Type 2 Diabetes and/or those diagnosed with primary hypertension, through the delivery of evidence-based, digitally enabled lifestyle and behaviour change interventions. The Authority intends to appoint a single supplier to a national Framework Agreement. The procurement will be conducted using a Restricted Procedure, comprising a Selection Stage and an Invitation to Tender (ITT) stage. Suppliers will be shortlisted following evaluation of their suitability, technical and professional capability, capacity and relevant experience, with a maximum of five suppliers invited to submit a tender. Lot 1: . NHS Scotland intends to establish a national Framework Agreement for the provision of a Digital Diabetes Prevention and Primary Hypertension Programme. The Framework will support NHS Scotland's strategic objectives to improve population health outcomes, reduce health inequalities and support the prevention and management of long-term conditions through evidence-based, digitally enabled interventions. The requirement comprises a single integrated service with two pathways: - Digital Diabetes Prevention Programme (DDPP) for individuals identified as being at increased risk of developing Type 2 Diabetes; and - Primary Hypertension Programme (PHP) for individuals diagnosed with primary hypertension, supported through lifestyle and behaviour change interventions designed to improve health outcomes and reduce cardiovascular risk. The appointed Framework Participant will be required to deliver evidence-based, digitally enabled lifestyle and behaviour change interventions designed to support participants in achieving sustainable improvements in health behaviours and clinical outcomes. The service will utilise a digital platform/application supported by appropriately trained personnel, including health coaching and clinical governance arrangements, to facilitate participant engagement, self-management, education, monitoring and behaviour change. The service is expected to support a range of participant needs and will include, as appropriate, digital onboarding, risk assessment, lifestyle intervention, coaching support, educational resources, progress monitoring, outcome reporting and onward referral or escalation processes where clinically indicated. The Authority seeks a solution that is accessible, inclusive and capable of supporting diverse populations across Scotland, including individuals who may experience barriers to participation arising from geography, deprivation, language, disability or digital exclusion. The Framework Participant will be expected to work collaboratively with NHS Scotland, NHS Boards, Primary Care and other relevant stakeholders to support the promotion of the programme, participant recruitment and self-registration, service mobilisation, programme delivery, performance monitoring and continuous improvement. Current funding has been identified to support approximately 15,000 participants through the Diabetes Prevention pathway during the initial three-year term of the Framework Agreement. The Hypertension pathway is anticipated to support approximately 500 participants per annum. These figures are provided for information only and do not constitute a guarantee of volumes. The Authority reserves the right, subject to future funding availability and service requirements, to increase participant volumes and/or expand the scope of the Framework to include additional prevention cohorts, pathways, clinical indicators or service requirements that are closely aligned to the subject matter of the Framework Agreement. The Authority intends to appoint a single supplier to a national Framework Agreement. The procurement will be conducted using a Restricted Procedure. Suppliers will first be assessed at Selection Stage through completion of the Single Procurement Document (SPD) and Pre-Qualification Questionnaire (PQQ), which will assess suitability, technical and professional capability, capacity and relevant experience. A maximum of five suppliers will be shortlisted and invited to participate in the Invitation to Tender stage.

result.text: The subject of the contract is cross-business-area strategy and management consulting for KfW and its subsidiaries IPEX, KfW Capital, and DEG (hereinafter also: individual clients). The consulting is provided within the framework of fixed-term individual contracts and supports the Board of Management/Executive Board and top management (in particular division or department heads who report directly to the Board of Management/Executive Board) with strategic and organisational issues in all business areas. The consulting services are expected to concern: - Development and review of business models, strategies, and target images, including promotional policy, banking, and regulatory aspects. - Analysis, optimisation, and redesign of organisational structures and business processes, particularly in the context of digital transformation. - Development and evaluation of fund solutions, public-private partnerships, and models for mobilising private capital. - Consulting on strategic and process-related issues in the field of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and generative AI (GenAI), particularly regarding governance, organisation, and best practices (no technical implementation). - Conducting market, competition, and impact analyses, including benchmarking, market trends, and best-practice comparisons. - Support in identifying and evaluating investment needs, regulatory hurdles, and other specific research questions. - Moderation of workshops, conducting interviews, and presentation of results. The estimated quantity is 4.200 consultant days over the entire term. Information on the lots: Within the framework of the agreement for the provision of consulting services, KfW will, in addition to strategy and management consulting (Lot 1), also tender a further lot (Lot 2) for specialist consulting. Lot 1 comprises consulting services for cross-business-area strategy and management consulting for the KfW Bankengruppe as well as its subsidiaries IPEX, KfW Capital, and DEG. Lot 2 comprises specialist, division-specific, and cross-business-area specialist consulting for KfW and its subsidiaries IPEX, KfW Capital, and DEG. An applicant or a consortium of applicants may only apply for one lot, § 30 para. 1 VgV. Multiple applications for both lots are inadmissible. The restriction serves the clear separation between the provision of strategic and specialist consulting services.

parts.source: Leistungsgegenstand ist die geschäftsfeldübergreifende Strategie- und Managementberatung der KfW und ihrer Tochtergesellschaften IPEX, KfW Capital und DEG (im Folgenden auch: Einzelauftraggeber). Die Beratung erfolgt im Rahmen befristeter Einzelaufträge und unterstützt jeweils den Vorstand/die Geschäftsführung und das Top-Management (insbesondere Bereichs- oder Abteilungsleiter, die direkt an den Vorstand/die Geschäftsführung berichten) bei strategischen und organisatorischen Fragestellungen in allen Geschäftsfeldern. Die Beratungsleistungen betreffen voraussichtlich: - Entwicklung und Überprüfung von Geschäftsmodellen, Strategien und Zielbildern, einschließlich förderpolitischer, bankfachlicher und regulatorischer Aspekte. - Analyse, Optimierung und Neugestaltung von Organisationsstrukturen und Geschäftsprozessen, insbesondere im Kontext der digitalen Transformation. - Entwicklung und Bewertung von Fondslösungen, öffentlich-privaten Partnerschaften und Modellen zur Mobilisierung von Privatkapital. - Beratung zu strategischen und prozessbezogenen Fragestellungen im Bereich Künstliche Intelligenz (KI) und generativer KI (GenAI), insbesondere zu Governance, Organisation und Best Practices (keine technische Umsetzung). - Durchführung von Markt-, Wettbewerbs- und Wirkungsanalysen, einschließlich Benchmarking, Markttrends und Best-Practice-Vergleichen. - Unterstützung bei der Identifikation und Bewertung von Investitionsbedarfen, regulatorischen Hürden und weiteren spezifischen Research-Fragestellungen. - Moderation von Workshops, Durchführung von Interviews und Präsentation von Ergebnissen. Die Schätzmenge beträgt 4.200 Beratertage über die gesamte Laufzeit. Information zu den Losen: Im Rahmen der Vereinbarung zur Bereitstellung von Beratungsdienstleistungen wird die KfW neben der Strategie- und Managementberatung (Los 1) auch ein weiteres Los (Los 2) für fachspezifische Beratung ausschreiben. Los 1 umfasst Beratungsleistungen für geschäftsfeldübergreifende Strategie- und Managementberatung für die KfW Bankengruppe sowie deren Tochtergesellschaften IPEX, KfW Capital und DEG. Los 2 umfasst die fach-, bereichs- sowie geschäftsfeldübergreifende Fachberatung der KfW und ihrer Tochtergesellschaften IPEX, KfW Capital und DEG. Ein Bewerber bzw. eine Bewerbergemeinschaft darf sich nur auf ein Los bewerben, § 30 Abs. 1 VgV. Mehrfachbewerbungen für beide Lose sind unzulässig. Die Beschränkung dient der klaren Trennung zwischen der Erbringung strategischer und fachlicher Beratungsleistungen.

result.text: Keski-Uudenmaan hyvinvointialueen TKIO procurement system (hereinafter procurement system) forms a central part of the contracting authority's research, development, innovation and competence development activities and procurement platform. It forms the structure of a cooperation model regulated by an agreement between the subscriber and the research, development and innovation partners. The purpose of the services to be competed in the procurement system is to produce research data, development services and innovations as a basis for the subscriber's development activities and management. The procurement system is divided into categories as follows: Category 1 Innovation services Category 2 Development of service systems Category 3 Project services Category 4 Strategic development Category 5 Scientific communities In addition, the subject matter of the procurement includes piloting and experimentation services as well as continuous development and management services for the subscriber's use. The subject matter of the procurement and the operation of the procurement system are described in more detail in the appendix "Principles of the TKIO dynamic purchasing system". The minimum requirements for each category and the competence requirements for applicants at the establishment stage are described in more detail in this call for participation. The subscriber shall define the subject matter and requirements of the assignments to be competed in the procurement system in more detail in each internal call for tenders of the procurement system. The procurement system shall be valid until 31.10.2029, during which time the internal call for tenders of the procurement system shall be carried out. The subscriber may extend the validity of the procurement system with a new contract notice. Suppliers may apply to join the procurement system at the establishment stage and later during its validity by submitting a request to participate in accordance with the call for participation. The procurement procedure is two-stage. To be able to submit tenders, a supplier must first submit a request to participate and be admitted to the procurement system. After this, the supplier may submit tenders by responding to the call for tenders sent by the contracting authority. The contracting authority shall carry out internal competitions within the procurement system in the future as needed. Requests to participate may be submitted to the dynamic purchasing system throughout its duration. All applicants meeting the suitability requirements shall be admitted to the dynamic purchasing system. Actual procurements shall be made through internal competitions of the dynamic purchasing system, in which the subject matter of the procurement is described and specified. Participation in the internal competitions of the DPS is not possible unless the supplier has been admitted to the procurement system. The submission of a request to participate and admission to the procurement system does not oblige the supplier to submit a tender, but suppliers may submit tenders at their discretion. The contracting authority estimates that the value excluding value added tax of the planned procurements covered by the dynamic purchasing system at the time of publication of the call for participation is 5,6 million euros, taking into account all procurements potentially made within the system. The estimate is preliminary and based on the procurement need known at this time. The contracting authority does not commit to any procurement quantities or minimum purchase obligations with this notice. Category 1 Innovation services includes the generation of innovations and futures research. The purpose of innovation services is to produce innovative solutions and new methods for the organisation and production of services in an impactful way. Innovation can also aim, for example, at anticipating the demand for services and substantive change needs. Innovations include, for example, digital operating models, solutions related to the innovative utilisation of technology, or the utilisation of robotics and artificial intelligence in social welfare and healthcare services. Central to innovations is the consideration of customer experience, quality, impact and cost perspectives. Innovations may also relate to operational monitoring models, measurement of results or strategic work. The result of an innovation may also be a commercialised product or service. Category 1 Innovation services additionally includes Piloting and experimentation services, the purpose of which is to test new innovations and services resulting from assignments or other cooperation in practice. Continuous development and management, the purpose of which is the implementation of new or redesigned services, systems or operations resulting from the results of assignments such that the implementation includes their continuous development as part of service production or other activities of the subscriber. See appendix "Principles of the TKIO dynamic purchasing system" for more details.; Category 2 Development of service systems is expert service, the purpose of which is the development of services, service processes, service networks and service systems. The development of service systems includes the collection and analysis of data on the current state, needs and impact of services. The data is utilised in development activities. The development of service systems may include the production of various methods and tools for the subscriber's needs to support the implementation of changes. The service may include the implementation of stakeholder involvement, for example through service design or equivalent means. The development of service systems may also include coaching service, the purpose of which is to support the subscriber in development activities and the consolidation of results. Category 2 Development of service systems additionally includes - Piloting and experimentation services, the purpose of which is to test new innovations and services resulting from assignments or other cooperation in practice. - Continuous development and management, the purpose of which is the implementation of new or redesigned services, systems or operations resulting from the results of assignments such that the implementation includes their continuous development as part of service production or other activities of the subscriber. See appendix "Principles of the TKIO dynamic purchasing system" for more details.;

parts.source: Keski-Uudenmaan hyvinvointialueen TKIO hankintajärjestelmä (jatkossa hankintajärjestelmä) muodostaa hankintayksikön tutkimus-, kehitys-, innovaatio- ja osaamisen kehittämisen toiminnan keskeisen osan ja hankinta-alustan. Se muodostaa tilaajan ja tutkimus-, kehittämis- ja innovaatiokumppanien sopimuksella säädellyn yhteistyömallin rakenteen. Hankintajärjestelmässä kilpailutettavien palvelujen tarkoituksena on tuottaa tuottavat tutkimustietoa, kehittämispalveluita ja innovaatioita tilaajan kehittämistoiminnan ja johtamisen perustaksi. Hankintajärjestelmä on jaettu luokkiin seuraavasti: Luokka 1 Innovaatiopalvelut Luokka 2 Palvelujärjestelmien kehittäminen Luokka 3 Hankepalvelut Luokka 4 Strateginen kehittäminen Luokka 5 Tiedeyhteisöt Lisäksi hankinnan kohteena ovat pilotointi- ja kokeilupalvelut sekä jatkuvan kehittämisen ja hallinnoinnin palvelut tilaajan käyttöön. Hankinnan kohde ja hankintajärjestelmän toiminta on kuvattu tarkemmin liitteessä ”TKIO dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän periaatteet”. Kunkin luokan vähimmäisvaatimukset sekä hakijoita koskevat perustamisvaiheen osaamisvaatimukset kuvataan tarkemmin tässä osallistumispyynnössä. Tilaaja määrittelee kussakin hankintajärjestelmän sisäisessä tarjouspyynnössä tarkemmin hankintajärjestelmässä kilpailutettavien toimeksiantojen kohteen ja vaatimukset. Hankintajärjestelmä on voimassa 31.10.2029 saakka, minä aikana hankintajärjestelmän sisäiset tarjouskilpailut tehdään. Tilaaja voi jatkaa hankintajärjestelmän voimassaoloa uudella hankintailmoituksella. Toimittajat voivat hakeutua hankintajärjestelmään perustamisvaiheessa ja myöhemmin sen voimassaoloaikana jättämällä osallistumishakemuksen osallistumispyynnön mukaisesti. Hankintamenettely on kaksivaiheinen. Päästäkseen jättämään tarjouksia toimittajan on ensin jätettävä osallistumishakemus ja tultava hyväksytyksi hankintajärjestelmään. Tämän jälkeen toimittaja voi tehdä tarjouksia vastaamalla hankintayksikön lähettämään tarjouspyyntöön. Hankintayksikkö toteuttaa jatkossa sisäisiä kilpailutuksia hankintajärjestelmässä tarpeen mukaan. Dynaamiseen hankintajärjestelmään voi jättää osallistumishakemuksia koko sen keston ajan. Dynaamiseen hankintajärjestelmään otetaan mukaan kaikki soveltuvuusvaatimukset täyttävät hakijat. Varsinaiset hankinnat tehdään dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän sisäisillä kilpailutuksilla, joissa kuvataan ja tarkennetaan hankinnan kohde. DPS:n sisäisiin tarjouskilpailuihin ei voi osallistua, ellei toimittajaa ole hyväksytty hankintajärjestelmään. Osallistumishakemuksen jättäminen ja hankintajärjestelmään hyväksyminen ei velvoita toimittajaa tekemään tarjousta, vaan toimittajat voivat tehdä tarjouksia harkintansa mukaan. Hankintayksikkö arvioi osallistumispyynnön julkaisuhetkellä dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän kohteena olevien suunniteltujen hankintojen arvonlisäverottomaksi arvioiduksi määräksi 5,6 miljoonaa euroa huomioiden kaikki järjestelmässä mahdollisesti tehdyt hankinnat. Arvio on alustava ja perustuu tällä hetkellä tiedossa olevaan hankintatarpeeseen. Hankintayksikkö ei sitoudu mihinkään hankintamääriin tai määräostovelvoitteisiin tällä ilmoituksella. Luokassa 1 Innovaatiopalveluihin kuuluu innovaatioiden tuottaminen ja tulevaisuustutkimus. Innovaatiopalveluiden tarkoituksena on tuottaa tilaajalle innovatiivisia ratkaisuja ja uusia menetelmiä palvelujen järjestämiseksi ja tuottamiseksi vaikuttavalla tavalla. Innovaatiolla voidaan myös pyrkiä esimerkiksi palveluiden kysynnän ja sisällöllisten muutostarpeiden ennakointiin. Innovaatioita ovat esimerkiksi digitaaliset toimintamallit, teknologian innovatiiviseen hyödyntämiseen liittyvät ratkaisut tai robotiikan ja tekoälyn hyödyntäminen sosiaali- ja terveyspalveluissa. Innovaatioissa keskeistä on asiakaskokemuksen, laadun, vaikuttavuuden ja kustannusten näkökulmien huomioiminen. Innovaatiot voivat liittyä myös toiminnan seurantamalleihin, tulosten mittaamiseen tai strategiseen työhön. Innovaation tuloksena voi syntyä myös kaupallistettava tuote tai palvelu. Luokan 1 Innovaatiopalveluihin sisältyy lisäksi Pilotointi- ja kokeilupalvelut, joiden tarkoituksena on kokeilla uusia, toimeksiantojen tai muun yhteistyön tuloksena syntyneitä innovaatioita ja palveluja käytännössä. Jatkuva kehittäminen ja hallinnointi, jonka tarkoituksena on toimeksiantojen tuloksena syntyneiden uusien tai uudelleen muotoiltujen palveluiden, järjestelmien tai toimintojen toteutus siten, että toteutukseen sisältyy niiden jatkuva kehittäminen osana palvelutuotantoa tai muuta tilaajan toimintaa. Katso tarkemmin liite ”TKIO dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän periaatteet”.; Luokassa 2 Palvelujärjestelmien kehittäminen on asiantuntijapalvelua, jonka tarkoituksena on palvelujen, palveluprosessien, palvelujen verkostojen ja palvelujärjestelmien kehittäminen. Palvelujärjestelmien kehittämiseen kuuluu tiedon kerääminen ja analyysi nykytilasta ja tarpeista ja palveluiden vaikuttavuudesta. Tietoa hyödynnetään kehittämistoiminnassa. Palvelujärjestelmien kehittämiseen voi kuulua erilaisten menetelmien ja työkalujen tuottaminen tilaajan tarpeisiin muutosten toteuttamisen tueksi. Palveluun voi sisältyä sidosryhmäosallisuuden toteuttamista esimerkiksi palvelumuotoilun tai vastaavin keinoin. Palvelujärjestelmien kehittämiseen voi sisältyä myös valmennuksellista palvelua, jonka tarkoituksena on tukea tilaajaa kehittämistoiminnassa ja tulosten vakiinnuttamisessa. Luokan 2 Palvelujärjestelmien kehittämiseen sisältyy lisäksi - Pilotointi- ja kokeilupalvelut, joiden tarkoituksena on kokeilla uusia, toimeksiantojen tai muun yhteistyön tuloksena syntyneitä innovaatioita ja palveluja käytännössä. - Jatkuva kehittäminen ja hallinnointi, jonka tarkoituksena on toimeksiantojen tuloksena syntyneiden uusien tai uudelleen muotoiltujen palveluiden, järjestelmien tai toimintojen toteutus siten, että toteutukseen sisältyy niiden jatkuva kehittäminen osana palvelutuotantoa tai muuta tilaajan toimintaa. Katso tarkemmin liite ”TKIO dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän periaatteet”.;

result.text: Category 3 Project Services includes the entire project process management for the subscriber's research, development and innovation activities. Project services include project planning services, project management services and project services. Category 3 Project Services also includes: - Piloting and experimentation services, the purpose of which is to test new innovations and services resulting from assignments or other cooperation in practice. - Continuous development and management, the purpose of which is the implementation of new or redesigned services, systems or operations resulting from assignments, such that the implementation includes their continuous development as part of service production or other subscriber operations. See the appendix 'TKIO dynamic purchasing system principles' for more details.; Category 4 Strategic development consulting is an expert service intended to provide the subscriber with comprehensive support for development activities and change management, from the perspectives of organiser management and service production. Strategic development consulting produces versatile and comprehensive information, expertise and insights into the development of social and health services and specialised medical care, as well as large-scale integration projects. The consulting offers expert knowledge for promoting the effectiveness, customer-orientation and quality of innovation and development activities in social welfare, health services and specialised medical care, as well as for the design, analysis and implementation of new operating models and process complexes. The strategic development consulting expert service includes versatile expertise in improving the effectiveness and productivity of social and health services, financing systems, improving service accessibility, designing service systems and networks, developing data-driven management capabilities and future forecasting. Strategic development can also include service production management services, which can be used to achieve significant cost savings when service production and the producer field in accordance with procurement contracts can be managed more systematically and purposefully. The service production management service can also help the contracting authority to find consistent and replicable operating processes for managing service providers, with which better service effectiveness, customer satisfaction, quality and cost-efficiency can be achieved. Category 4 Strategic development also includes: - Piloting and experimentation services, the purpose of which is to test new innovations and services resulting from assignments or other cooperation in practice. - Continuous development and management, the purpose of which is the implementation of new or redesigned services, systems or operations resulting from assignments, such that the implementation includes their continuous development as part of service production or other subscriber operations. See the appendix 'TKIO dynamic purchasing system principles' for more details.; Category 5 For the scientific community, the procurement system acts as a cooperation platform and procurement channel towards the scientific community, such as universities, higher education institutions, educational institutions, centres of expertise and research institutes. Services procured from the scientific community in the procurement system may include services considered to be scientific activities, which in their content complement projects implemented within the framework of TKIO cooperation. Scientific activity may include any research activity and services in accordance with the subject of the procurement system, but a scientific and research perspective is always emphasised in these services. Services and research activities may be such that the benefit obtained accrues for use in operations other than those of the contracting authority. Services procured from the scientific community may also be research and development services where the benefit obtained accrues exclusively for use in the contracting authority's operations and the contracting authority compensates for the service performed in full. The nature of the service is specified in each call for tenders within the procurement system. Services can also be ordered from the scientific community directly without a call for tenders within the procurement system, if the conditions for the procurement act's scope exemption concerning research and development services (9 section 1 subsection 13 point) are met. Category 5 Scientific community also includes: - Piloting and experimentation services, the purpose of which is to test new innovations and services resulting from assignments or other cooperation in practice. See the appendix 'TKIO dynamic purchasing system principles' for more details.

parts.source: Luokan 3 Hankepalvelut pitää sisällään tilaajan tutkimus-, kehittämis- ja innovaatiotoimintaan liittyvien hankkeiden hankeprosessin hallinnoinnin kokonaisuuden. Hankepalveluihin kuuluvat hankesuunnittelupalvelut, hankejohtopalvelut ja projektipalvelut. Luokan 3 Hankepalveluihin sisältyy lisäksi - Pilotointi- ja kokeilupalvelut, joiden tarkoituksena on kokeilla uusia, toimeksiantojen tai muun yhteistyön tuloksena syntyneitä innovaatioita ja palveluja käytännössä. - Jatkuva kehittäminen ja hallinnointi, jonka tarkoituksena on toimeksiantojen tuloksena syntyneiden uusien tai uudelleen muotoiltujen palveluiden, järjestelmien tai toimintojen toteutus siten, että toteutukseen sisältyy niiden jatkuva kehittäminen osana palvelutuotantoa tai muuta tilaajan toimintaa. Katso tarkemmin liite ”TKIO dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän periaatteet”.; Luokan 4 Strategisen kehittämisen konsultointi on asiantuntijapalvelua, jonka tarkoituksena on mahdollistaa tilaajalle kokonaisvaltainen tuki kehittämistoimintaan ja muutoshallintaan, järjestäjäohjauksen ja palvelutuotannon näkökulmista. Strategisen kehittämisen konsultointi tuottaa monipuolista ja kokonaisvaltaista tietoa, osaamista ja näkemyksiä sosiaali- ja terveyspalveluiden sekä erikoissairaanhoidon kehittämisestä ja laajoista integrointihankkeista. Konsultointi tarjoaa asiantuntijaosaamista sosiaalihuollon, terveyspalveluiden ja erikoissairaanhoidon innovaatio- ja kehittämistoiminnan vaikuttavuuden, asiakaslähtöisyyden ja laadun edistämiseen sekä uusien toimintamallien ja prosessien kokonaisuuksien suunnitteluun, analysointiin ja käyttöönottoon. Strategisen kehittämisen konsultoinnin asiantuntijapalveluun kuuluu monipuolinen osaaminen sosiaali- ja terveyspalveluiden vaikuttavuuden ja tuottavuuden parantamisesta, rahoitusjärjestelmistä, palveluiden saavutettavuuden parantamisesta, palvelujärjestelmien ja verkostojen suunnittelusta, tiedolla johtamisen kyvykkyyden kehittämisestä ja tulevaisuuden ennakoinnista. Strateginen kehittäminen voi sisältää myös palvelutuotannon ohjauspalvelua, jonka avulla voidaan saavuttaa merkittäviä kustannussäästöjä, kun hankintasopimusten mukaista palvelutuotantoa ja tuottajakenttää saadaan ohjattua systemaattisemmin ja tavoitteellisemmin. Palvelutuotannon ohjauspalvelu voi myös auttaa hankintayksikköä löytämään palveluntuottajien johtamiseen johdonmukaiset ja monistettavissa olevat toimintaprosessit, joiden avulla voidaan saavuttaa palvelujen parempaa vaikuttavuutta, asiakastyytyväisyyttä, laatua ja kustannustehokkuutta. Luokan 4 Strategiseen kehittämiseen sisältyy lisäksi - Pilotointi- ja kokeilupalvelut, joiden tarkoituksena on kokeilla uusia, toimeksiantojen tai muun yhteistyön tuloksena syntyneitä innovaatioita ja palveluja käytännössä. - Jatkuva kehittäminen ja hallinnointi, jonka tarkoituksena on toimeksiantojen tuloksena syntyneiden uusien tai uudelleen muotoiltujen palveluiden, järjestelmien tai toimintojen toteutus siten, että toteutukseen sisältyy niiden jatkuva kehittäminen osana palvelutuotantoa tai muuta tilaajan toimintaa. Katso tarkemmin liite ”TKIO dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän periaatteet”.; Luokan 5 Tiedeyhteisöille hankintajärjestelmä toimii yhteistyöalustana ja hankintakanavana tiedeyhteisöihin, kuten yliopistoihin, korkeakouluihin, oppilaitoksiin, osaamiskeskuksiin ja tutkimuslaitoksiin päin. Hankintajärjestelmässä tiedeyhteisöiltä hankittava palvelu voi pitää sisällään tieteelliseksi toiminnaksi katsottavia palveluita, jotka sisällöltään täydentävät TKIO yhteistyön puitteissa toteutettavia hankkeita. Tieteellinen toiminta voi pitää sisällään mitä tahansa hankintajärjestelmän kohteen mukaista tutkimustoimintaa ja palveluita, mutta näissä palveluissa korostuu aina tieteellinen ja tutkimuksellinen näkökulma. Palvelut ja tutkimustoiminta voivat olla sellaisia, joista saatava hyöty koituu muidenkin kuin hankintayksikön toiminnassa käytettäväksi. Tiedeyhteisöiltä hankittavat palvelut voivat olla myös sellaisia tutkimus- ja kehittämispalveluita, joista saatava hyöty koituu yksinomaan hankintayksikön toiminnassa käytettäväksi ja hankintayksikkö korvaa suoritetun palvelun kokonaan. Palvelun luonne täsmennetään kussakin hankintajärjestelmän sisäisessä tarjouskilpailussa. Tiedeyhteisöiltä voidaan tilata palveluja myös suoraan ilman hankintajärjestelmän sisäistä kilpailutusta, mikäli hankintalain tutkimus- ja kehittämispalveluja koskevan soveltamisalapoikkeuksen (9 § 1 mom. 13-kohta) edellytykset täyttyvät. Luokkaan 5 Tiedeyhteisöt sisältyy lisäksi - Pilotointi- ja kokeilupalvelut, joiden tarkoituksena on kokeilla uusia, toimeksiantojen tai muun yhteistyön tuloksena syntyneitä innovaatioita ja palveluja käytännössä. Katso tarkemmin liite ”TKIO dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän periaatteet”.

rejected.text: The National Institute on Aging (NIA) intends to publish a Notice of Funding Opportunity (NOFO) to solicit applications that develop or incorporate novel, cutting-edge study designs/methods/analytic approaches through the use of machine learning, artificial intelligence, and adaptive designs to allow the discovery of health/function profiles at the level of the individual and that could lead to the implementation of personalised prevention plans/interventions for cognitive/brain health in older adults. The initiative would allow for both basic research in animal models, as well as the development of profiles for humans, which would span levels of analysis from cellular to societal. Applications are not being solicited at this time. Notice is being provided to allow potential applicants sufficient time to develop meaningful collaborations and responsive projects. This NOFO will utilise the R01 activity code. Investigators with expertise and insights into this area of aging research are encouraged to begin to consider applying for this new NOFO.

rejected.text: THIS INFORMATION REQUEST IS AN INVITATION TO AN INFORMATION SESSION REGARDING THE PROCUREMENT OF PTT SERVICES. ICT service production for the City of Jyväskylä has been reorganised in recent years so that the operational production of basic IT services has largely been outsourced. The upcoming procurement will ensure that the service package meets the city's current and developing needs and supports efficient, secure and reliable daily operations throughout the organisation. Currently, basic IT services are produced for the City of Jyväskylä as the following service packages: - User and support services (Service Desk, remote and on-site support, Helppari) - Workstation, equipment and lifecycle services - Management and operation of the ICT environment - Server monitoring and operating services at the operating system level - Communications SPOC, terminal connection and support services. - Cyber security services (technical information security and anomaly management) - Service management and production management (ITSM system and system integration between the Supplier and the Customer, SLA, change management) The aim of the upcoming competitive tendering is to reorganise the services so that the service level and user experience are consistent and predictable, service production is transparently managed and measurable, and the overall package supports the city's operations in a cost-effective manner. The aim is also to strengthen proactivity and continuous development and to ensure that the services take into account the special characteristics of the administrative network and educational network. The current state and objectives described above serve as the starting point for the service areas and requirements defined in more detail in the upcoming call for tenders.

result.text: UHS is seeking to engage with interested parties to discuss and refine an opportunity to become a strategic endoscopy partner to the Trust. UHS provides a regional endoscopy service to a population of 3m+, offering a comprehensive range of diagnostic and therapeutic interventions. Following a fire earlier this year, UHS has reviewed its long-term endoscopy requirements and is considering a new purpose-built regional diagnostic endoscopy centre situated close to the main hospital. UHS has existing endoscopy equipment to the value of approximately £8-10m. This will need to be refreshed throughout this contract. UHS has an indicative budget of £20-25m for the design and construction of the new centre. This will be designed to meet current and projected future endoscopy and motility needs, 'a one-stop-shop' and be an important centre to both trial new technology and techniques and provide training for the next generation of the endoscopy workforce. This opportunity is to explore and discuss how a partnership approach may drive better outcomes for patients, for innovation, for UHS clinicians, and for the partner[S(1.1][L(1.2]. This opportunity may include, but not necessarily be limited to: 1: Provision of endoscopy equipment to a new offsite location, both for the use of clinicians undertaking NHS clinical activity, and for use as a test bed for innovation and new technique development, and for use within a training environment. 2: Regional Training Centre: The physical co-location of experienced UHS staff, clinicians, data, patients with an industry partner seeking to promote best practice and create future workforce. 3: Joint Innovation Deal & Test Bed: The provision of a live, data-rich NHS environment to validate new technology, and techniques, for example artificial intelligence (AI) diagnostic tools and ergonomic designs and potentially the exploitation of emerging shared Intellectual Property. This would also include SME and VCSE participation for research and innovation. 4: Commercial Sponsorship Opportunity with Associated Rights and Benefits: In addition to the core procurement opportunities above, there is potential to explore a complementary commercial sponsorship arrangement, which may include the provision of value-in-kind goods and/or services that support contract delivery. This strategic partnership approach would identify and agree a range of associated rights and benefits for suppliers who also become sponsors. These may include appropriate sponsor recognition, opportunities for collaboration and innovation, shared learning, thought leadership engagement, and other mutually agreed activities that support the objectives of all parties. UHS, with support from the Department of Health and Social Care (DHSC), is trialling the integration of commercial sponsorship into this procurement opportunity to explore how strategic partnerships can deliver additional value while supporting the successful delivery of contract outcomes. Whilst this notice is not intended to create a commitment to a contract, it is running alongside a live funded NHS capital project to develop designs and take forward the concept of a regional endoscopy centre. This hybrid procurement and sponsorship model is being piloted by the Department of Health and Social Care (DHSC) and UHS, offering potential suppliers a unique opportunity to play an active role in delivering a best-in-class new facility for patients: supporting improved care, championing innovation and delivering lasting benefits for all parties. To ensure fair and open competition in any future procurement, the developing design and specification will remain supplier-neutral and will not be tailored to any specific manufacturer, supplier or solution.

result.text: Vantaan kaupunki is planning the procurement of a new cultural heritage system to replace the current collection management system (Kirsti), which was implemented in 2014. The current system is technically obsolete, slow, and difficult to develop. The goal is a modern, easy-to-use, and efficient solution that supports museum operations, cultural heritage management, and digital transition. The system must support, among other things, object, image, AV, paper, and cultural environment archives, a reference library, actor information, and press clippings. Integrations are required for Finna, Finto, MapInfo, Matti, the Finnish Heritage Agency's spatial data, and the PAS service. Key features: efficient search, clarity, ease of use, and compliance with GDPR requirements. Users: Museum staff, consultants, authorities, collection service customers, and the public via Finna. Targeted benefits: Better availability of information, increased work efficiency, reduction of unnecessary work, and improvement of processes. Strategic importance: supports the digital transition, has a broad impact, and generates value for over 10 000 residents.

parts.source: Vantaan kaupunki suunnittelee uuden kulttuuriperintöjärjestelmän hankintaa korvaamaan nykyisen kokoelmanhallintajärjestelmän (Kirsti), joka on otettu käyttöön vuonna 2014. Nykyinen järjestelmä on teknisesti vanhentunut, hidas ja vaikeasti kehitettävissä. Tavoitteena on moderni, helppokäyttöinen ja tehokas ratkaisu, joka tukee museotoimintaa, kulttuuriperinnön hallintaa ja digitaalista siirtymää. Järjestelmän tulee tukea mm. esine-, kuva-, AV-, paperi- ja kulttuuriympäristöarkistoja, käsikirjastoa, toimijatietoja ja lehtileikkeitä. Vaaditaan integraatiot Finnaan, Fintoon, MapInfoon, Mattiin, Museoviraston paikkatietoon ja PAS-palveluun. Keskeiset ominaisuudet: tehokas haku, selkeys, helppokäyttöisyys ja GDPR-vaatimusten täyttäminen. Käyttäjät: Museon henkilökunta, konsultit, viranomaiset, kokoelmapalvelujen asiakkaat ja yleisö Finnan kautta. Tavoiteltavat hyödyt: Parempi tiedon saatavuus, työskentelyn tehostuminen, turhan työn väheneminen ja prosessien parantuminen. Strateginen merkitys: tukee digitaalista siirtymää, vaikuttaa laajasti ja tuottaa arvoa yli 10 000 kuntalaiselle.

result.text: IT services are being awarded. The subject matter of the contract is the design, implementation, quality assurance and support during commissioning and operation of the new reporting platform of WIBank (Wirtschafts- und Infrastrukturbank Hessen), an institution within an institution (Anstalt in der Anstalt - AIDA) within Landesbank Hessen-Thüringen (Helaba). In addition, this includes the ongoing further development of the platform created as part of the project. All services are to be provided on the basis of a framework agreement and therefore only upon separate call-off/individual order. Lot LOT-0001: Award of IT services: WIBank Reporting Platform. The subject matter of the contract is the design, implementation, quality assurance and support during commissioning and operation of the new reporting platform of WIBank (Wirtschafts- und Infrastrukturbank Hessen), an institution within an institution (Anstalt in der Anstalt - AIDA) within Landesbank Hessen-Thüringen (Helaba). In addition, this includes the ongoing further development of the platform created as part of the project. The existing info portal currently forms the central data warehouse and reporting system of WIBank. It consolidates data from various source systems and provides reports based on this as well as returns for funding programmes of the European Union, the Federal Government and the State of Hesse. The subject matter of the project is the provision of a new reporting platform for the finance and accounting, risk management and treasury departments. This includes in particular the connection of SAP WIBank as the initial operational source system, the setup of the "Regulatory Reporting" data mart, the transfer of historical data from the existing info portal and the implementation of the defined target reports. Upon completion of the project, the developed platform will be expanded as part of continuous further development. This includes in particular the connection of further source systems, the setup of additional data marts and the migration of further reports from the existing info portal. In the long term, the existing info portal is to be completely replaced and decommissioned. All services are to be provided on the basis of a framework agreement and therefore only upon separate call-off/individual order. The upper limit for call-offs from the framework agreement amounts to a total of EUR 6,5 million (gross). For further details, reference is made to Appendix I 02 - Appendix 0_Specification of Services.

parts.source: Es werden IT-Leistungen vergeben. Der Leistungsgegenstand ist die Konzeption, Implementierung, Qualitätssicherung sowie die Unterstützung bei Inbetriebnahme und Betrieb der neuen Reporting-Plattform der WIBank (Wirtschafts- und Infrastrukturbank Hessen), einer Anstalt in der Anstalt (AIDA) in der Landesbank Hessen-Thüringen (Helaba). Darüber hinaus umfasst dieser die laufende Weiterentwicklung der im Rahmen des Projekts entstehenden Plattform. Sämtliche Leistungen sind auf Grundlage einer Rahmenvereinbarung und mithin erst auf gesonderten Abruf/Einzelauftrag hin zu erbringen. Lot LOT-0001: Vergabe von IT-Leistungen: WIBank Reporting Plattform. Der Leistungsgegenstand ist die Konzeption, Implementierung, Qualitätssicherung sowie die Unterstützung bei Inbetriebnahme und Betrieb der neuen Reporting-Plattform der WIBank (Wirtschafts- und Infrastrukturbank Hessen), einer Anstalt in der Anstalt (AIDA) in der Landesbank Hessen-Thüringen (Helaba). Darüber hinaus umfasst dieser die laufende Weiterentwicklung der im Rahmen des Projekts entstehenden Plattform. Das bestehende Infoportal bildet derzeit das zentrale Data-Warehouse- und Berichtssystem der WIBank. Es konsolidiert Daten aus verschiedenen Quellsystemen und stellt darauf basierende Berichte sowie Meldungen für Förderprogramme der Europäischen Union, des Bundes und des Landes Hessen bereit. Gegenstand des Projekts ist die Bereitstellung einer neuen Reporting-Plattform für die Fachbereiche Finanz- und Rechnungswesen, Risikomanagement und Treasury. Hierzu zählen insbesondere die Anbindung von SAP WIBank als initialem operativen Quellsystem, der Aufbau des Data Marts „Meldewesen“, die Übernahme historischer Daten aus dem bestehenden Infoportal sowie die Umsetzung der definierten Zielberichte. Nach Abschluss des Projekts wird die entwickelte Plattform im Rahmen einer kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung ausgebaut. Dies umfasst insbesondere die Anbindung weiterer Quellsysteme, den Aufbau zusätzlicher Data Marts sowie die Migration weiterer Berichte aus dem bestehenden Infoportal. Langfristig soll das bestehende Infoportal vollständig abgelöst und außer Betrieb genommen werden. Sämtliche Leistungen sind auf Grundlage einer Rahmenvereinbarung und mithin erst auf gesonderten Abruf/Einzelauftrag hin zu erbringen. Die Obergrenze für Abrufe aus dem Rahmenvertrag beträgt insgesamt EUR 6,5 Mio. (brutto). Für die weiteren Einzelheiten wird auf die Anlage I 02 - Anlage 0_Leistungsbeschreibung verwiesen.

result.text: The procurement to be carried out is classified as an administrative services contract, given that its object consists of performance obligations involving the development of an activity or directed at obtaining a result other than a works contract or supply contract, as established in articles 17 and 25 of Law 9/2017 of 8 November, on Public Sector Contracts (hereinafter, LCSP). In the Canary Islands, GUIRRE is the Canary Islands Waste Information System, an in-house tool of the Department of Ecological Transition and Energy developed to respond to data management in the field of waste and for the communication thereof to the Ministry with competence in the matter. Through the aid proposed in the Sectoral Conference, it is proposed to procure a service to, via GUIRRE:  Improve the exchange of information with eSIR.  Automation and digitalisation of administrative procedures, management and electronic processing of files and databases relating to waste regulations.  Information analysis and data processing. Likewise, the digitalisation of administrative procedures within the competence of the Autonomous Community is sought in order to adapt them to the requirements established in Royal Decree 203/2021 of 30 March, approving the Regulations on the performance and operation of the public sector by electronic means, to guarantee easily usable and accessible digital services, aligned with European interoperability frameworks, and which allow intelligent automation (via Business Process Management and/or Robotic Process Automation) in all or part of them. All of this would lead to:  An improvement in the quality of the public service. Unified management of administrative procedures. Automation and digitalisation of administrative procedures.  Greater ease in the work of professionals.  A monitoring and legality control system.  An electronic administrative management system Said object corresponds to the following codes of the European Commission's Common Procurement Vocabulary (CPV) nomenclature 72200000 Software programming and consulting services 72600000 Computer support and consulting services

parts.source: La contratación a realizar se califica como contrato de servicios de carácter administrativo, en cuanto que su objeto son prestaciones de hacer consistentes en el desarrollo de una actividad o dirigidas a la obtención de un resultado distinto de una obra o suministro, tal y como establece el artículos 17 y 25 de la Ley 9/2017, de 8 de noviembre, de Contratos del Sector Público (en adelante, LCSP). En Canarias, GUIRRE es el Sistema de Información de Residuos de Canarias, una herramienta propia de la Consejería de Transición Ecológica y Energía desarrollada para dar respuesta a la gestión de datos en materia de residuos y para la comunicación de los mismos al Ministerio con competencias en la materia. A través de las ayudas planteadas en la Conferencia Sectorial se propone contratar un servicio para, mediante GUIRRE:  Mejorar del intercambio de información con eSIR.  Automatización y digitalización de procedimientos administrativos, gestión y tramitación telemática de expedientes y bases de datos relativos a la normativa de residuos.  Análisis de la información y procesamiento de datos. Asimismo, se busca la digitalización de los procedimientos administrativos competencia de la Comunidad autónoma con objeto de adaptarlos a los requerimientos establecidos en el Real Decreto 203/2021, de 30 de marzo, por el que se aprueba el Reglamento de actuación y funcionamiento del sector público por medios electrónicos, para garantizar servicios digitales fácilmente utilizables y accesibles, alineados con los esquemas de interoperabilidad europeos, y que permitan la automatización inteligente (a través de Business Process Management y/o Robotic Process Automation) en todo o parte de los mismos. Todo ello conllevaría a una:  Mejora en la calidad del servicio público. Gestión unificada de los procedimientos administrativos. Automatización y digitalización de procedimientos administrativos.  Mayor facilidad en la labor de los profesionales.  Sistema de seguimiento y control de la legalidad.  Sistema telemático de gestión administrativa Dicho objeto corresponde a los siguientes códigos de la nomenclatura Vocabulario Común de Contratos de la Comisión Europea (CPV) 72200000 Servicios de programación de software y de consultoría 72600000 Servicios de apoyo informático y de consultoría

result.text: The services requested under this procurement procedure are the continuation of Software Assurance as well as the acquisition of licences incl. Software Assurance for software products from Microsoft and / or the acquisition of online products from Microsoft that Microsoft offers via the corporate programme, in accordance with the terms of the framework agreement (corporate agreement) of the Federal Ministry of the Interior (BMI) and Microsoft via a corresponding commercial partner. The services requested in the context of this procurement procedure are described in the specification of services (Section 6 of the procurement documents) including the appendices listed therein. The technical, legal and organisational framework conditions are contained in Section 5. Westdeutscher Rundfunk Köln (WDR) is advertising a framework agreement on behalf of the following broadcasting corporations and institutions of the broadcasting corporations: ARD-Hauptstadtstudio (ARD-HSB, represented by rbb), ARD ZDF Deutschlandradio Beitragsservice (ZBS), Bayerischer Rundfunk (BR), Deutschlandradio (DLR), Deutsche Welle (DW), Hessischer Rundfunk (HR), Informationsverarbeitungszentrum (IVZ, represented by rbb), Mitteldeutscher Rundfunk (MDR), Norddeutscher Rundfunk (NDR), Radio Bremen (RB), Rundfunk Berlin-Brandenburg (rbb), Saarländischer Rundfunk (SR), Südwestrundfunk (SWR), Westdeutscher Rundfunk (WDR) and Zweites Deutsches Fernsehen (ZDF). Also eligible are all other companies affiliated with the aforementioned broadcasting corporations and institutions, provided that these are "Authorised Institutions" within the meaning of the opening clause of the BMI contract. Affiliated and authorised companies associated with the aforementioned broadcasting corporations and institutions that do not meet the minimum order quantity of 250 qualified devices or users intend, if required, to join together with the affiliated broadcasting corporations and institutions in accordance with the BMI contract, Appendix 1 Section 3, a., (iii) to form a joint accession in order to reach the minimum order quantity. The framework agreement shall enter into force upon the award of contract and shall end upon expiry of the BMI corporate agreement, which entered into force on 01.06.2025, on 31.05.2028 or, taking into account its extension option, on 31.05.2029. During the term of the framework agreement, eligible entities may make accessions to the BMI corporate agreement. In doing so, each eligible entity may, if required and where applicable, also make accessions on the basis of various enrolments (e.g. EA Enterprise, EA SCE, EA Subscription enrolment). The effective date of each accession shall mark the commencement of a separate framework agreement (see template agreement in the appendix) between the respective eligible entity as the client and the commercial partner as the contractor. These individual framework agreements have independent terms, which are presented below, and shall therefore also apply to the respective contracting parties beyond the aforementioned end of the term of the framework agreement where applicable. Each eligible entity that makes an accession / concludes a framework agreement acts under its own responsibility, places orders and pays at its own expense. Joint and several liability between the various eligible entities is excluded. Insofar as individual clients guarantee minimum purchase quantities, these result from the appendix Minimum Purchase Quantities.xlsx of these procurement documents. Purchase quantities going beyond this are not guaranteed. The respective framework agreement shall end after 36 months without the need for termination. The framework agreement partner grants the clients the right to extend the respective framework agreement once by one year under the same conditions. The respective client must declare the exercise of the option in writing to the framework agreement partner before the expiry of the contract. The subsequent further extension option shall serve in particular the purpose of ensuring the possibility of an interruption-free commissioning of Software Assurance as well as operation for the respective client if a procurement procedure for such commissioning cannot be carried out / completed in good time. The framework agreement partner therefore grants the clients the right in each case to extend the respective framework agreement once again by up to 6 further months. The conditions may change for this extension period. An adjustment of the dealer's mark-up or markdown on its purchase prices may be made by mutual agreement in this case. The dealer must explain the circumstances altering the calculation. Insofar as further adjustments to the framework agreement have to be made due to Microsoft licence programme changes, these shall likewise be coordinated by mutual agreement. If and to the extent that valid successor agreements already exist between the Federal Ministry of the Interior and Microsoft at the time the extension option for the further 6 months is exercised - where applicable also on the basis of a different Microsoft licence programme -, these may be selected as the basis. The framework agreement partner further agrees that during this extension term, any client may terminate the framework agreement at any time and without observing a notice period and carry out a change of commercial partner. The currently existing EA accessions expire for all eligible entities on 31.05.2026. It is intended to make accessions to the new BMI corporate agreement on the following dates: 01.06.2026 The clients will announce the products and quantities for their respective initial orders in good time. The contractor will then promptly provide the respective client with the prices valid for the initial order, taking into account the Microsoft price and the discount for the EA commercial partners in accordance with the BMI corporate agreement as well as the mark-up or markdown to be offered.

parts.source: Bei den im Rahmen dieses Vergabeverfahrens angefragten Leistungen handelt es sich um die Fortführung von Software-Assurance sowie den Erwerb von Lizenzen inkl. Software-Assurance für Softwareprodukte der Fa. Microsoft und / oder den Erwerb von Online-Produkten der Firma Microsoft, die Microsoft über das Konzernprogramm anbietet, nach den Bedingungen des Rahmenvertrages (Konzernvertrages) des Bundesministeriums des Inneren (BMI) und der Fa. Microsoft über einen entsprechenden Handelspartner. Die im Rahmen dieses Vergabeverfahrens angefragten Leistungen sind in der Leistungsbeschreibung (Ziffer 6 der Vergabeunterlagen) einschl. der darin aufgeführten Anlagen beschrieben. Die technischen, rechtlichen und organisatorischen Rahmenbedingungen sind in Ziffer 5 enthalten. Der Westdeutsche Rundfunk Köln (WDR) schreibt eine Rahmenvereinbarung im Auftrag folgender Rundfunkanstalten und Einrichtungen der Rundfunkanstalten aus: ARD-Hauptstadtstudio (ARD-HSB, vertreten durch rbb), ARD ZDF Deutschlandradio Beitragsservice (ZBS), Bayerischer Rundfunk (BR), Deutschlandradio (DLR), Deutsche Welle (DW), Hessischer Rundfunk (HR), Informationsverarbeitungszentrum (IVZ, vertreten durch rbb), Mitteldeutscher Rundfunk (MDR), Norddeutscher Rundfunk (NDR), Radio Bremen (RB), Rundfunk Berlin-Brandenburg (rbb), Saarländischer Rundfunk (SR), Südwestrundfunk (SWR), Westdeutscher Rundfunk (WDR) und Zweites Deutsches Fernsehen (ZDF). Bezugsberechtigt sind auch alle weiteren mit den vorgenannten Rundfunkanstalten und Einrichtungen verbundenen Unternehmen, soweit es sich bei diesen um "Berechtigte Einrichtungen" im Sinne der Öffnungsklausel des Vertrages des BMI handelt. Mit den vorgenannten Rundfunkanstalten und Einrichtungen verbundene und berechtigte Unternehmen, die die Mindestbestellmenge von 250 qualifizierten Geräten oder Nutzern nicht aufweisen, beabsichtigen sich bei Bedarf gemäß BMI-Vertrag, Anlage 1 Ziffer 3, a., (iii) mit den verbundenen Rundfunkanstalten und Einrichtungen zu einem gemeinsamen Beitritt zusammenzuschließen, um die Mindestbestellmenge zu erreichen. Die Rahmenvereinbarung tritt mit der Zuschlagserteilung in Kraft und endet mit Ablauf des Konzernvertrages des BMI, der am 01.06.2025 in Kraft getreten ist, zum 31.05.2028 bzw. unter Berücksichtigung dessen Verlängerungsoption zum 31.05.2029. Während der Laufzeit der Rahmenvereinbarung können die Bezugsberechtigten Beitritte zum BMI-Konzernvertrag tätigen. Dabei kann jeder Bezugsberechtigte bei Bedarf ggf. auch Beitritte auf der Basis verschiedener Enrollments tätigen (bspw. EA-Enterprise-, EA-SCE-, EA-Subscription-Enrollment). Mit dem Wirksamkeitsdatum eines jeden Beitritts beginnt jeweils ein separater Rahmenvertrag (siehe Mustervertrag in der Anlage) zwischen dem jeweiligen Bezugsberechtigten als Auftraggeber und dem Handelspartner als Auftragnehmer. Diese einzelnen Rahmenverträge haben eigenständige Laufzeiten, die nachfolgend dargestellt sind, und gelten somit für die jeweiligen Vertragsparteien ggf. auch über das vorgenannte Laufzeitende der Rahmenvereinbarung hinaus. Jeder Bezugsberechtigte, der einen Beitritt tätigt / Rahmenvertrag abschließt, tritt eigenverantwortlich auf, bestellt und zahlt auf eigene Rechnung. Eine gesamtschuldnerische Haftung zwischen den verschiedenen Bezugsberechtigten ist ausgeschlossen. Soweit einzelne Auftraggeber Mindest-Abnahmemengen garantieren, ergeben sich diese aus der Anlage Mindestabnahmemengen.xlsx dieser Vergabeunterlagen. Darüber hinaus gehende Abnahmemengen werden nicht garantiert. Der jeweilige Rahmenvertrag endet nach 36 Monaten, ohne dass es einer Kündigung bedarf. Der Rahmenvertragspartner räumt den Auftraggebern das Recht ein, den jeweiligen Rahmenvertrag einmal um ein Jahr zu gleichen Konditionen zu verlängern. Die Ausübung der Option hat der jeweilige Auftraggeber gegenüber dem Rahmenvertragspartner schriftlich vor Ablauf des Vertrages zu erklären. Die nachfolgende weitere Verlängerungsoption soll insbesondere dem Zweck dienen, die Möglichkeit einer unterbrechungsfreien Beauftragung der Softwareassurance sowie den Betrieb für den jeweiligen Auftraggeber sicherzustellen, falls ein Vergabeverfahren für eine solche Beauftragung nicht rechtzeitig durchgeführt/ abgeschlossen werden kann. Der Rahmenvertragspartner räumt den Auftraggebern daher jeweils das Recht ein, den jeweiligen Rahmenvertrag nochmals um bis zu 6 weitere Monate zu verlängern. Die Konditionen können sich für diesen Verlängerungszeitraum ändern. Eine Anpassung des Händler- Auf- bzw. Abschlages auf seine Einkaufspreise kann in diesem Fall einvernehmlich erfolgen. Der Händler hat die kalkulationsändernden Umstände zu erläutern. Sofern aufgrund lizenzprogrammlicher Änderungen von Microsoft ggf. weitere Anpassungen des Rahmenvertrages erfolgen müssen, werden diese ebenfalls einvernehmlich abgestimmt. Sofern und soweit zum Zeitpunkt der Ausübung der Verlängerungsoption um die weiteren 6 Monate bereits gültige Nachfolgeverträge zwischen dem Bundesministerium des Inneren und Microsoft bestehen - ggf. auch auf der Basis eines anderen Microsoft-Lizenzprogrammes -, können diese als Grundlage gewählt werden Der Rahmenvertragspartner stimmt ferner zu, dass während dieser Verlängerungslaufzeit jeder Auftraggeber jederzeit und ohne Einhaltung einer Frist den Rahmenvertrag kündigen und einen Wechsel des Handelspartners vornehmen kann. Die aktuell bestehenden EA-Beitritte laufen für alle Bezugsberechtigten am 31.05.2026 aus.
